papers.title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeWAM 用 decoder-free 的 JEPA 潜变量统一前向、逆向、逆动力学与策略四种模式的双向 Transformer，并提出在策略头噪声空间而非原始动作空间做 MPC 规划。线性探针从其潜变量读取机器人与物体状态优于前向-only 的 Le World Model 和基于重建的 WAM；闭环表现与同编码器、同规模的 flow-matching 策略持平，同时额外提供世界模型。
Motivation: 世界动作模型 (WAM) 通常建立在重建式表征上，这类表征携带噪声与冗余信息，使下游动作预测与规划变难。
Method: 提出 LeWAM：一个双向 Transformer，覆盖 forward、backward、inverse dynamics 与 policy prediction 四种模式，在 decoder-free 的 JEPA 潜空间上端到端联合训练；规划时不在原始动作采样，而是在策略头的噪声空间做 diffusion-steering 式 MPC，以避免利用动力学模型误差。
Result: 线性探针从 LeWAM 潜变量读取机器人与物体状态优于常规 Le World Model（前向-only JEPA 世界模型），且对视觉干扰的忽略程度与 LeWM 相当、远优于重建式 WAM；闭环评估中 LeWAM 与在同一编码器、同等规模下训练的 flow-matching 策略表现相当；在噪声空间规划可改善这些 WAM 的闭环表现，而在原始动作空间采样会让 MPC 利用动力学模型的不准确。
Conclusion: 作者主张 WAM 应建立在 decoder-free JEPA 潜表征上，并把规划从原始动作空间移到策略头噪声空间，这样既能匹配专用策略的闭环能力，又保留世界模型本身。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
papers.abstract_en: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViSkill 把 VLM 智能体的成功交互编码成视觉原生的 skill card，检索到的技能同时指导推理与奖励塑形，成功轨迹再回写技能库，形成技能积累与策略改进互相强化的闭环。在 Sokoban、FrozenLake、PrimitiveSkill 上总体成功率 0.89，加冷启动初始化升到 0.91，超过全部评测的闭源与开源基线，且比标准 PPO 收敛更快。
Motivation: 现有技能增强智能体以文本为中心，把空间布局和动作-状态对应线性化成语言，丢失几何结构；已有视觉化尝试又把技能构建与策略优化分开，二者互促未被探索。
Method: ViSkill 将成功交互编码为 VLM 智能体可直接读取的复合视觉 skill card；检索到的技能同时用于推理引导与 reward shaping，成功轨迹再蒸馏回技能库形成闭环反馈；另提供可选的冷启动 (cold-start) 初始化机制加速早期学习。
Result: 在 Sokoban、FrozenLake、PrimitiveSkill 三个基准上总体成功率 0.89，加入冷启动初始化后 0.91；优于全部评测的专有与开源基线，收敛速度快于标准 PPO。
Conclusion: 视觉原生技能库与策略优化构成闭环后，技能积累和策略改进可以互相带动，冷启动进一步加速早期学习。

papers.title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpaceCast-Bench 用 observe-transform-infer 框架评测视觉语言模型的预测性空间推理（从观测构建场景、预判干预后果），而非读出输入中已可见的空间关系。3,862 题、182 个真实场景、16 类任务分静态感知/局部预测/全局预测三级，21 个模型中最强者仅 58.0% 对人类 87.2%，空间专用模型接近随机；用其程序化生成数据微调可把 Qwen3-VL-4B 从 34.0% 提到 65.7%。
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准主要测空间感知——直接读出输入里已可见的关系，而真实空间智能要求从观测构造场景、预判干预如何改变场景并推理未观测结果，这一能力此前缺少直接且可诊断的评测。
Method: 提出 SpaceCast-Bench，围绕 observe-transform-infer 框架构建 3,862 道题、覆盖 182 个真实场景与 16 类任务，按静态感知、局部预测、全局预测三个层级递进，分别要求场景理解、空间状态更新与对未观测结果的关系推理；另做受控分析考察 bridge views 与显式 3D 证据的作用，并用程序化生成数据做微调实验。

papers.title: Learning Kilometer-Scale Weather Prediction with Global-Regional Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Kilometer-scale regional weather forecasting is essential for local weather warnings and weather-sensitive decisions. Existing data-driven approaches often rely on numerical forecasts for large-scale guidance or require additional training of global forecasting components. Pretrained global weather models offer an efficient source of large-scale forecasts, motivating their reuse to guide high-resolution regional prediction. However, this coupling requires aligning global and regional representations across different grids and integrating global guidance with local interactions to advance regional states. We propose ScaleCast, a regional forecasting framework that addresses these challenges through Global-Regional Alignment. Its Global-Regional Conversion module aligns joint global and regional representations with regional locations, while the Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics block combines aligned guidance with regional neighborhood interactions. Experiments using ERA5 global analyses on a 0.25-degree grid and CERRA regional reanalysis at 5.5 km spacing demonstrate improved regional forecasts across surface and upper-air variables, with a single trained model supporting multiple global forecast drivers (i.e., Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES) without specific retraining. Fine-tuning on HRRR at 3 km spacing further demonstrates the framework's adaptability to a different regional domain and spatial resolution. Windstorm case studies show improved cyclone positioning and core-pressure estimates, while comparisons with HadISD station observations show closer agreement with local temperature and humidity changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScaleCast 用 Global-Regional Conversion 模块把预训练全球模型的表征按区域位置对齐到区域网格，再由 Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics 块把对齐后的引导与区域邻域交互结合来推进区域状态。在 ERA5（0.25°）驱动 CERRA（5.5 km）的实验中，地表与高空变量预报均改善，且同一个训练好的模型无需重训即可支持 Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES 三种全球驱动；在 HRRR 3 km 上微调后同样适配新区域与分辨率。
Motivation: 公里级区域预报要么依赖数值模式提供大尺度引导，要么需要额外训练全球预报组件；预训练全球模型可作高效的大尺度来源，但其网格与区域网格不同、表征难以直接耦合。
Method: 提出 ScaleCast 的 Global-Regional Alignment：Global-Regional Conversion 模块将联合的全球-区域表征与区域位置对齐，Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics 块再把对齐后的引导与区域邻域交互融合以推进区域状态；用 ERA5 全球分析（0.25°）驱动 CERRA 区域再分析（5.5 km），并在 HRRR（3 km）上微调。
Result: 在 CERRA 5.5 km 上，地表与高空变量的区域预报均较既有做法改善，且单一模型无需重训即可接受 Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES 三种全球预报驱动；在 HRRR 3 km 微调后适配了不同区域域与空间分辨率。风暴个例中气旋定位与中心气压估计改善，与 HadISD 站点观测对比显示对局地温度与湿度变化的刻画更接近实测。
Conclusion: 复用预训练全球模型并做跨网格表征对齐，可以在不重训全球组件的前提下提升公里级区域预报，并跨驱动与跨区域域保持可用。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. Regional geometry metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow preserves the specified geometry in high-control regions and enables plausible shape variation in low-control areas. A user study further indicates that the resulting balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom remains competitive in overall quality. When evaluating appearance on fixed geometry, text-conditioned routing achieves state-of-the-art prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy. Qualitative results additionally show localized routing of image cues. The project page is available at SpaceFlow3D.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpaceFlow 是一个免训练的本地可控 3D 生成流程：文本加一组几何基元，每个基元代表一个物体部件并被赋予局部控制级别，生成流过程中强制执行这些空间约束，外观合成时把生成结构分割并匹配到基元、每个部件只吃自己分配的文本或图像提示以限制跨部件泄漏。区域几何指标显示高控制区保持指定几何、低控制区允许合理形变，固定几何上的外观评估中文本条件路由达到 SOTA 的提示忠实度与颜色/材质准确度。
Motivation: 现有 3D 生成方法缺少显式局部控制：几何贴合通常由一个全局控制强度定义，外观无法在局部指定。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 流程：文本描述加几何基元集合，每个基元作为物体部件代理并分配局部控制级别（严格跟随输入形状或允许生成补全）；结构生成阶段在 generative flow 过程中强制空间约束，外观合成阶段对生成结构做分割并与基元匹配，各部件仅以分配的文本或图像 cue 为条件。
Result: 区域几何指标表明高控制区域保持指定几何、低控制区域产生合理形变；用户研究显示几何保真与生成自由度的平衡在总体质量上仍具竞争力；在固定几何上评估外观时，文本条件路由达到 state-of-the-art 的 prompt faithfulness 与颜色/材质准确度；定性结果展示图像 cue 的局部路由。
Conclusion: 把控制强度下放到逐基元的局部级别并在生成流中强制执行，可以在保持几何贴合的同时保留局部生成自由度，外观也能按部件独立指定而不跨区泄漏。

papers.title: Prospective Prediction of OOD Degradation from Source-Side Training Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We study whether persistent out-of-distribution (OOD) degradation can be predicted before it is directly observed using only source-side training dynamics. In a controlled shortcut-learning setting, a simple logistic regression predictor develops a clear prospective signal, while training time alone does not. Temporal summaries of the source-side quantities are substantially more informative than their current values. When transferred without additional training from a CNN to an MLP, confidence and entropy dynamics retain substantial predictive information. These results provide a proof of principle that source-side training dynamics can contain an early warning signal for future OOD failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在受控的 shortcut-learning 设定下，仅用源域训练动态 (source-side training dynamics) 就能在 OOD 退化实际出现之前预测它：逻辑回归预测器给出清晰的前瞻信号，而单看训练时间没有。时间序列摘要比当前时刻值信息量大得多，且从 CNN 无需再训练迁移到 MLP 后，置信度与熵的动态仍保留可观的预测信息。
Motivation: OOD 退化通常要等到直接观察到失败才能确认，缺少在失败发生前的早期预警手段；本文检验源域侧的训练动态是否已提前携带这类信号。
Method: 在受控 shortcut-learning 设定中，用逻辑回归作为预测器，输入为源侧训练动态的时间序列摘要（含置信度与熵等量），并与仅用训练时间的基线对照；再把训练好的预测器不加额外训练地从 CNN 迁移到 MLP。
Result: 逻辑回归预测器发展出清晰的前瞻信号，而仅用训练时间则没有；时间序列摘要比当前值信息量大得多；不经再训练从 CNN 迁移到 MLP 后，置信度与熵动态仍保留大量预测信息。
Conclusion: 源侧训练动态可作为未来 OOD 失败的早期预警信号，这是一个 proof of principle；跨架构（CNN→MLP）迁移时置信度与熵动态仍有效。

papers.title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HRIL 用模态嵌入上的经验跨矩张量 (cross-moment tensor) 显式建模多路交互，经 Tucker 分解得到 core tensor，再加一个防止能量集中、保住高阶耦合容量的 synergy-aware 正则。在受控 synergy 任务与真实多模态基准上，相比现有对比学习方法一致提升，且在由协同交互主导的任务上增益明显。
Motivation: 多模态自监督表征学习中，跨模态交互复杂，协同信息（只在多模态联合配置下出现、任一单模态都无法恢复的任务相关信号）难以被现有对比方法保留。
Method: 提出 Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL)：在模态嵌入上构造经验跨矩张量表示多路交互，用 Tucker 分解得到 core tensor，并引入 synergy-aware 正则防止能量集中，以保留高阶耦合容量。
Result: 在受控 synergy 任务与真实世界基准上，相比现有多种多模态对比方法取得一致提升，在由协同交互主导的任务上增益显著；代码已发布于 github.com/brightest66/HRIL。
Conclusion: 协同信息体现为模态间的高阶统计依赖，可作为显式建模联合交互的原则性目标，从而在多模态表征中保留协同信号。

papers.title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to identify and use geometric relations in diagrams. Recent methods address this challenge by converting geometric entities, relations, and constraints into explicit textual representations for the model to reason over. However, effective formalization is highly non-trivial: on Geometry3K, structure injection fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones among 200 examples. Redundant relations can distract the model, while ambiguous references to diagram elements can lead it to apply constraints incorrectly. This suggests that the key challenge is not merely extracting more geometric facts, but organizing them into representations that support downstream reasoning. To fully exploit the power of formalization, we further propose GeoReform, a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than a fixed parser output. GeoReform executes the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. On Geometry3K, GeoReform improves Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0\% to 56.0\%. Extensive experiments and analyses across geometry reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that effective formalization is crucial for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.

papers.title: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
papers.abstract_en: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM-BlockFE 把长文本离线编译成可执行特征程序，线上推理不再调用 LLM：增量追加不可变代码块，用下游模型评估候选特征，并以深度校准信用分配的块级回滚加多轨迹交错搜索避开贪心次优。在两个公开与两个私有数据集上，全量数据比较中 AUC 较各数据集最强基线绝对提升 0.0069–0.0358；五个已上线金融风控应用的监控显示 KS 较现有人工策略提升 0.02–1.56 个百分点。
Motivation: 工业风控依赖结构化数据模型，但大量有价值信息埋在非长文本里；人工特征工程费时，而让 LLM 处理每条实时输入又达不到部署要求。
Method: LLM 引导的离线特征构建框架：增量追加不可变代码块生成特征程序，用下游模型给候选特征打分；针对贪心搜索易陷次优，引入基于深度校准信用分配 (depth-calibrated credit allocation) 的块级回滚机制，并以交错方式推进多条独立搜索轨迹，通过共享各轨迹探索方向的固定描述减少冗余探索；搜索结束后冻结程序，部署提取结构化特征供下游预测模型使用。
Result: 在两个公开与两个私有数据集的全量数据比较中，LLM-BlockFE 相对每个数据集的最强基线取得 0.0069 至 0.0358 的绝对 AUC 提升；五个已上线的金融风控应用的上线后监控显示，相对现有人工设计策略取得 0.02 至 1.56 个百分点的绝对 KS 提升。
Conclusion: 把长文本到特征的转换固化为可执行程序、把 LLM 留在离线搜索阶段，可以在不增加在线推理成本的前提下同时抬高离线 AUC 与线上 KS。

papers.title: GenIA: Generative Reconstruction with Test-Time Input Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing complete 3D object assets from monocular or sparse multi-view observations remains challenging. Generative 3D foundation models can complete object geometry beyond the observed views, but their predictions may not faithfully reproduce the observed geometry, appearance, or pose. We introduce GenIA, a framework for test-time input-aligned generation that grounds SAM3D's generative prior in geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model. We improve object pose by deriving translation and scale from geometry while retaining the learned rotation prior, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, cross-observation fusion, and differentiable rendering guidance during denoising. An optional post-denoising refinement further adapts the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement to the observations. Our framework also supports externally supplied geometry; when given temporal shapes of dynamic objects, it recovers a shared, input-aligned canonical appearance and stable world-space placement. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, GenIA improves pose prediction and object reconstruction from monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, outperforming recent optimization-based, per-frame image-to-3D, and video-to-4D methods. Our project page is available at https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenIA 在不重训 3D 生成基础模型的前提下，把 SAM3D 的生成先验对齐到单目或多视角的几何与光度观测：位姿的平移与尺度取自几何、旋转保留学习先验，外观靠可见性偏置注意力、跨观测融合与可微渲染引导在去噪中对齐。在合成与真实基准上，它同时改善位姿预测与物体重建，胜过近期的优化式、逐帧 image-to-3D 与 video-to-4D 方法。
Motivation: 从单目或稀疏多视角重建完整 3D 物体资产仍困难：生成式 3D 基础模型能补出观测视角之外的几何，但其预测未必忠实复现已观测到的几何、外观与位姿。
Method: GenIA 是测试时输入对齐生成框架：位姿上由几何推导平移与尺度、保留学到的旋转先验；外观上在去噪过程中用 visibility-biased attention、cross-observation fusion 与可微渲染引导 (differentiable rendering guidance) 对齐；可选的去噪后精修再调整外观 latent、轻量 decoder adapters 与物体摆放。框架还接受外部给定几何，例如动态物体的时间序列形状，以恢复共享的、输入对齐的规范外观与稳定的 world-space 摆放。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上，GenIA 从单目、多视角与动态输入出发均改善位姿预测与物体重建，优于近期的优化式方法、逐帧 image-to-3D 方法与 video-to-4D 方法。
Conclusion: 生成式 3D 基础模型可以在不重训的条件下通过测试时输入对齐忠实贴合观测，位姿与外观分别由几何约束和渲染引导负责。

papers.title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARC 是一套提升机器人基础模型 (RFM) 零样本性能的推理配方：以绑定下一动作、解释因果结构的推理轨迹为核心，配合从既有演示自动生成轨迹的标注管线，以及按模型架构定制的微调与推理适配。用它从 DROID 构建 ARC-Trace-DROID 而不采集新机器人数据，π0.5 与 Cosmos3-Nano-Policy 在 RoboLab-120 和 MolmoSpaces 上刷新 SOTA，RoboLab-Reasoning-50 最高提升 50 个百分点，真机任务成功率提升 82.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 当前改进 RFM 的主流路径是更大模型、更多演示和大规模训练，成本高昂；作者指出存在一条互补路径，即用正确的推理配方在不新增机器人演示、不做基础规模训练的前提下提升零样本任务性能。
Method: ARC 含三个成分：绑定机器人下一动作并解释因果结构（为何该动作合适、应产生何种效果）的推理轨迹；从既有演示自动生成这些轨迹的可扩展标注管线，据此构建 ARC-Trace-DROID（数据来自 DROID，不采集新数据）；以及让 VLA（如 π0.5）和 WAM（如 Cosmos3-Nano-Policy）学会用轨迹做控制的适配策略，微调与推理按各模型架构和能力定制。
Result: 在 RoboLab-120 与 MolmoSpaces 上建立新的零样本 SOTA，RoboLab-Reasoning-50 上增益最高达 50 个百分点；真机上 π0.5 的任务成功率提升 82.2 个百分点。作者称这些增益是在不增加机器人演示、不做基础规模训练的情况下前所未有的。
Conclusion: 在不追加演示和大规模训练的条件下，让既有 SOTA RFM 使用因果接地的推理轨迹做控制，即可大幅抬高零样本任务成功率，与扩大模型和数据的路线互补。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WorldAlign: Decoupled 4D Reward for World-Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Faithful visual world simulation requires generated videos to maintain 4D world consistency, encompassing both static and dynamic consistency. Static consistency requires coherent 3D structure in static environments across viewpoints, while dynamic consistency requires plausible subject motion and consistent appearance over time. Geometry-aware post-training offers a promising way to improve world consistency. However, existing methods often rely on a static-scene assumption. Even those that accommodate dynamic scenes struggle to provide reliable static-consistency feedback, while dynamic consistency is often overlooked or inadequately assessed. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldAlign, a decoupled 4D reward framework that semantically separates static regions and dynamic subjects and provides feedback by aligning each with a world prior suited to its assumptions. For static regions, WorldAlign aligns static geometry with a geometric world prior through semantically guided masked reprojection, enabling more reliable static-consistency evaluation; an auxiliary camera-motion reward discourages nearly static solutions. For dynamic subjects, WorldAlign uses a strong vision-language model (VLM) as a dynamic world prior and constructs a VLM-as-a-judge reward based on sample-specific checklists that assess dynamicity, physical plausibility, shape, and texture consistency. This decoupled design enables more effective online post-training without requiring human preference annotations. Across two pretrained image-to-video generators, Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, WorldAlign jointly improves static and dynamic consistency over existing methods without suppressing overall or subject motion. These results support decoupled world-prior alignment for more faithful visual world simulation. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/.
papers.comment: Includes an appendix with implementation details, human evaluation, and additional ablation analysis. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldAlign 提出解耦的 4D 奖励框架，把静态区域与动态主体分开对齐各自的世界先验：静态部分用语义引导的掩码重投影对齐几何先验并加相机运动奖励抑制近静止解，动态部分用 VLM-as-a-judge 按样本清单打分。在 Wan2.1 与 Wan2.2 两个预训练图生视频模型上，该框架在不压制整体与主体运动的前提下同时提升静态与动态一致性。
Motivation: 几何感知后训练多依赖静态场景假设，能处理动态场景的方法也难以给出可靠的静态一致性反馈，而动态一致性常被忽略或评估不足，导致生成视频难以维持 4D 世界一致性。
Method: 解耦 4D 奖励框架：静态区域经语义引导的掩码重投影 (semantically guided masked reprojection) 与几何世界先验对齐，并附加相机运动奖励避免近静止解；动态主体以强 VLM 为动态先验，构建基于样本专属检查清单的 VLM-as-a-judge 奖励，评估 dynamicity、物理合理性、形状与纹理一致性，用于无需人工偏好标注的在线后训练。
Result: 在 Wan2.1 与 Wan2.2 两个预训练图生视频生成器上，WorldAlign 相对现有方法同时改善静态与动态一致性，且不抑制整体运动或主体运动。
Conclusion: 按静态与动态解耦、各自对齐合适世界先验的奖励设计，可在无人工偏好标注的在线后训练中更忠实地做视觉世界模拟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Marformer: A Transformer for Predicting Missing Data Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Real decisions are made under incomplete information. If we observe only some of the random variables we need, we can predict the others. The \textbf{conditional marginals} over the missing variables are the key ingredient for computing Bayes risk and Value of Information (VOI), the expected gain from acquiring one more observation before deciding. We present the Marformer, a Transformer trained to directly predict conditional marginals given any set of observed values. Like BERT, which is trained to predict missing words from context, the Marformer constructs a hidden-vector representation for each distribution $p(X_i)$ and iteratively refines it through attention to other distributions $p(X_j)$. Unlike generative approaches, the Marformer does not model the full joint distribution, requires no domain knowledge of the data-generating process, and makes all predictions in a single forward pass. We evaluate across three synthetic domains with missing data---Bayesian networks, discretized multivariate Gaussians, and structured annotation data. The Marformer can match or outperform classical missing-data methods, even when those methods are given the true model family and prior that generated the synthetic data. We also evaluate on a real annotation dataset, where the Marformer outperforms the evaluated baselines at the largest training size. In both cases, the Marformer is substantially faster than the evaluated generative baselines.
papers.comment: 45 pages, 19 figures; presented in part in a COLM 2026 keynote
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Marformer 是一个直接预测条件边缘分布 (conditional marginals) 的 Transformer：给定任意观测变量子集，为每个缺失变量 p(X_i) 维护一个隐向量表示并经注意力在各分布间迭代精化，单次前向即输出全部条件边缘，用于计算 Bayes risk 与 Value of Information。在三个含缺失数据的合成域（Bayesian networks、离散化多元高斯、结构化标注数据）上，它匹配或超过即使被给出真实生成模型族与先验的经典缺失数据方法；在真实标注数据集上于最大训练规模处超过所评测基线，且比所评测生成式基线快得多。
Motivation: 真实决策建立在不完整信息之上：只观测到部分随机变量时需要推断其余变量，而计算 Bayes risk 与 VOI 的关键输入是缺失变量上的条件边缘分布。经典缺失数据方法通常需要已知数据生成过程的模型族与先验，生成式方法则要建模完整联合分布、成本高。
Method: Marformer 仿照 BERT 从上下文预测缺失词的训练方式，为每个分布 p(X_i) 构造隐向量表示，通过对其它分布 p(X_j) 的注意力迭代精化；不建模完整联合分布，不需要数据生成过程的领域知识，所有预测在单次前向传播中完成。评测覆盖 Bayesian networks、离散化多元高斯、结构化标注数据三个合成域，外加一个真实标注数据集。
Result: 在三个合成缺失数据域上，Marformer 匹配或超过经典缺失数据方法——即使这些方法被给出生成合成数据的真实模型族与先验；在真实标注数据集上，于最大训练规模处超过所评测基线；两种设定下其速度都显著快于所评测的生成式基线。
Conclusion: 直接回归条件边缘分布是一条可行路线：无需联合分布建模与领域先验，单次前向即可支撑 Bayes risk 与 VOI 计算，并在合成与真实标注任务上取得与经典方法相当或更好且更快的结果。

papers.title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OnTrack 是面向 LLM agent 轨迹的流式结构监控机制，用最优传输 (optimal transport) 在每步约一毫秒内比对 agent 的步骤与依赖同历史成功运行的差异，从而实时告警或阻断不可逆操作。在 SWE-bench 轨迹上，仅凭前 8 步对失败轨迹的排序优于内容相似度方法（AUROC +0.057），配合中止策略可省下约 18% 会烧在失败运行上的算力，被中止的运行中 83% 确实正走向失败（6 次中止有 5 次正确）。
Motivation: LLM agent 在行程规划、股票交易、IT 事故分诊等场景中自主执行不可逆操作，现有方案要么用监控 agent 给每一步增加成本与延迟，要么事后审计日志，此时 token 已烧掉、损害已发生。
Method: 提出流式结构感知最优传输监控：把 agent 的步骤与依赖同记录的成功运行逐步比对，在毫秒级每步延迟内告警或阻断。按访问权限分三档评估：完全参考访问（历史运行与工具 schema）、中间访问（仅工具 schema）、无先验知识（仅生成中的步骤日志），监控能力随访问下降从计划违规检测退化到识别循环、停滞与重复工具调用。
Result: 在 SWE-bench 轨迹上，仅用前 8 步将失败轨迹排在成功轨迹之下的能力优于内容相似度方法，AUROC 提升 +0.057；配合中止策略节省约 18% 本会消耗在失败运行上的算力，被中止的运行中 83% 实际正走向失败，6 次中止有 5 次正确。
Conclusion: 结构感知的流式轨迹比对可以在每步约一毫秒的开销内提前识别即将失败的 LLM agent 运行，从而在损害发生前中止并节省算力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentGarten 把模拟器/游戏引擎与共享神经渲染器耦合成实时交互世界：仿真后端维护持久世界状态并执行程序定义的交互规则，渲染器从统一接口导出的结构化条件生成视觉观测。用 Adversarial Forcing 让历史 prefill 经精确回放可微，并加入真实数据对抗监督。经验蒸馏为 playbook 后，agent 仅 4 轮即达到传统强化学习需要数百万轮的学习效率。
Motivation: 智能体能学到什么受限于练习环境：环境既要状态、规则、动力学一致，又要观测符合真实视觉分布，跨多样世界同时做到这两点仍是瓶颈。
Method: 将预训练视频模型适配到几何条件，提出 Adversarial Forcing 做蒸馏——通过精确回放使历史 prefill 可微，让后期预测的损失回传到渲染器对先前观测的编码，并加入真实数据对抗监督；再优化推理以支持实时交互。agent 每轮经验蒸馏成 playbook 供后续 agent 继承与改进。
Result: 实证研究显示学习效率大幅提升：agent 仅用 4 轮学习，而传统强化学习对照需要数百万轮。
Conclusion: 新世界可以写成代码并经同一接口渲染，环境数量与难度可随 agent 一起扩展，使智能体通过交互经验持续进化。

papers.title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Koopman operator theory provides a linear framework for analyzing nonlinear dynamical systems and has become a major tool for data-driven modeling. A central challenge, however, is that finite-dimensional approximations computed by methods such as extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) require the dictionary to be specified a priori. Recent machine-learning approaches address this limitation by learning the dictionary from data, predominantly using artificial neural network (ANN) autoencoder architectures. Although kernel methods offer an alternative with greater interpretability and tractability for theoretical analysis, they have received little attention in this setting. We introduce extended dynamic mode decomposition with kernel-based dictionary learning (EDMD-kDL), a kernel-based method for learning finite-dimensional Koopman embeddings directly from data. The method combines ideas from collocation methods and bilevel optimization to simultaneously learn a kernel dictionary and the corresponding Koopman approximation. We evaluate EDMD-kDL against state-of-the-art ANN-based approaches on a range of numerical experiments, including global sea-surface-temperature forecasting and learning directly from video data. Across all tested settings, EDMD-kDL achieves performance comparable to or better than the ANN-based methods. Moreover, in contrast to standard kernel methods, the proposed approach is scalable to large datasets by design since the size of the required kernel matrices depends on the number of collocation points rather than the size of the training dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EDMD-kDL：用核函数字典替代需先验指定的字典，结合配置法 (collocation) 与双层优化同时学习 Koopman 嵌入及其线性近似。在含全球海表温度预报与视频学习的数值实验中，性能与 ANN 方法相当或更好，且核矩阵规模只随配置点数而非训练集大小增长，因而可扩展到大数据集。
Motivation: EDMD 等有限维 Koopman 近似要求事先给定字典；现有学习字典的机器学习方法几乎都用 ANN 自编码器，核方法在该方向少有人做，而标准核方法又难以扩展到大规模数据。
Method: 提出 EDMD-kDL：以核诱导的字典学习有限维 Koopman 嵌入，结合配置法与双层优化，同时学习核字典与对应的 Koopman 线性近似；核矩阵尺寸由配置点数决定而非训练样本数。
Result: 在一系列数值实验上与最先进的 ANN 方法对比，包括全球海表温度 (sea-surface temperature) 预报和直接从视频数据学习；在所有测试设定中 EDMD-kDL 性能与 ANN 方法相当或更优，并可扩展到大规模数据集。
Conclusion: 核字典学习加双层优化能在保持可解释性与理论可分析性的同时达到 ANN 自编码器水平的 Koopman 建模性能，且通过配置点控制核矩阵规模解决标准核方法的扩展性问题。

papers.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.

papers.title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HANS 是首个面向真实教育场景的手写答题卡数据集，覆盖数学公式、自然语言、手绘表格及删除线等噪声，并配细粒度标注；配套的 NA-GOT 端到端框架通过特征级轻量噪声抑制模块与解码阶段噪声感知注意力实现两阶段降噪，在答案过程识别的准确率与稳定性上均取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有文档解析与手写识别基准面向结构良好的印刷文档或孤立数学表达式，缺少能刻画学生答题卡多行推导、文本与公式混排、删除线等噪声的数据集。
Method: 提出 NA-GOT 端到端框架：特征级轻量噪声抑制模块做第一阶段降噪，解码阶段引入噪声感知注意力 (noise-aware attention) 做第二阶段，构成两阶段噪声抑制；训练与评测基于 HANS 数据集。
Result: HANS 对现有方法构成实质挑战；NA-GOT 在答案过程识别的准确率与稳定性上均取得显著提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 面向真实答题卡的噪声感知解析需要专门数据集与两阶段降噪架构，HANS 与 NA-GOT 提供了这一组合，数据集计划在论文发表时公开。

papers.title: Closing the Horizon Gap in Policy Optimization for Adversarial MDPs
papers.abstract_en: We consider policy optimization for online episodic tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs) with adversarial losses and bandit feedback. Policy optimization updates the policy locally at each state and avoids optimization over the occupancy-measure polytope, but its existing regret bounds are larger by a factor of the horizon $H$ than those of occupancy-measure-based algorithms. We close this gap by using regularized $Q$-functions, which allow us to control the stability of the local updates jointly over all state-action pairs rather than separately at each state. The resulting algorithm attains high-probability regret bounds of $\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$ for known transitions and $\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$ for unknown transitions, where $S$ is the number of states, $A$ the number of actions, and $T$ the number of episodes. Both bounds improve the horizon dependence of existing policy optimization bounds, and the latter matches the best-known bound. We further extend the algorithm to adversarial linear-mixture MDPs and obtain the same improvement in the horizon dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对抗损失、bandit 反馈的在线回合制表格 MDP 中，用正则化 Q 函数把局部策略更新的稳定性在所有状态-动作对上联合控制，从而消掉策略优化类算法相对占用测度 (occupancy-measure) 算法多出的 H 因子。已知转移下高概率遗憾界为 Õ(√(HS(H+A)T))，未知转移下为 Ó(HS√(AT))，后者与最优已知界匹配；对抗线性混合 MDP 上同样改善了对 H 的依赖。
Motivation: 策略优化只在每个状态局部更新策略、避开占用测度多面体上的优化，但现有遗憾界比基于占用测度的算法多出一个 H 因子，这个 horizon gap 限制了其理论竞争力。
Method: 引入正则化 Q 函数 (regularized Q-functions)，使局部更新的稳定性可以在全部状态-动作对上联合控制，而非逐状态分别控制；算法进一步扩展到对抗线性混合 MDP (adversarial linear-mixture MDP)。
Result: 已知转移下高概率遗憾界 Õ(√(HS(H+A)T))，未知转移下 Õ(HS√(AT))，其中 S 为状态数、A 为动作数、T 为回合数；两者都改善了现有策略优化界对 H 的依赖，未知转移界与最优已知界匹配，线性混合 MDP 扩展获得同样的 H 依赖改善。
Conclusion: 联合控制跨状态-动作的更新稳定性足以让表格对抗 MDP 的策略优化达到与占用测度方法同阶的 horizon 依赖，未知转移情形已到最优已知水平。

papers.title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 法律推理忠实性审计：把判决所援引的法条/判例换成无关权威、保持案情不变，从隐状态解码模型判决的变化。七个开源模型（8B–70B）在四个法律基准上，被要求指名权威时正确率 66.7%–100%，但换权威后判决随之改变的比例在 CaseHOLD 上仅 0.0%–21.7%、ECHR/SCOTUS 30.0%–76.7%、ContractNLI 43.3%–50.0%；指名权威因此是判决依赖性的差代理。
Motivation: 大模型用指名法条或判例来为判决背书，被当作判决确实由该权威推出的证据；需要直接检验这种解释是否真的承载判决依赖，以及它能否充当合规或审计材料。
Method: 反事实审计：固定案情、把被指名的法律权威替换为无关权威，从模型隐状态解码演化中的判决；覆盖七个开源模型（8B–70B）与四个涵盖司法和合同推理的基准（CaseHOLD、ECHR、SCOTUS、ContractNLI），另含一个尽力复现的法律推理 LoRA 模型（第 6 节），并做对抗指令注入的红队评测与排除提示措辞噪声、混淆采样的复核。
Result: 要求指名管辖权威时，模型在 66.7%–100% 的生成中给出正确权威；换权威后判决改变的比例为 CaseHOLD 0.0%–21.7%、ECHR 与 SCOTUS 30.0%–76.7%、ContractNLI 43.3%–50.0%。模型规模与专用法律推理模型都未缩小该差距。五个核心模型的红队评测中，服从藏在案情里的对抗指令比例 73.3%–96.4%，远高于判决换手敏感性，且在模型排名上无一例外地成立。两项发现均通过排除提示措辞噪声与混淆采样的复核。
Conclusion: 指名法律权威是判决对其依赖性的差代理，而同一判决仍单独暴露于对抗操纵；生成的法律解释不宜直接当作合规或审计材料。

papers.title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
papers.abstract_en: When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.
papers.journal_ref: EMNLP2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用认知谦逊 (epistemic humility, EH) 评测 LLM agent 在知识冲突下的行为，拆成轨迹级的 Identify、Solve、Escalate (ISE) 三维度，并在受控冲突与多步执行中的自然冲突两种设定下各配无冲突对照。评测四个 agent 后发现任务准确率高不等于更谦逊：部分高准确率配置能在执行中识别冲突，却在错误的最终答案里不传达未解决的不确定性；agent 常在早期步骤检测到冲突，却在后续步骤中丢失或不解决。模型级干预能提升 EH，但往往以牺牲任务准确率为代价。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 系统评测几乎只看任务成功，无法说明当检索证据与模型先验矛盾时，agent 是修正答案、承认不确定，还是坚持错误结论。
Method: 把 EH 操作化为轨迹级 ISE 三维度；构造知识冲突场景（参数化知识与检索证据矛盾，或两个上下文来源互相矛盾），分受控冲突与多步 agentic 执行中的自然冲突两类，各配匹配的无冲突对照，评测四个 agent。
Result: 四个 agent 上，更高任务准确率并不对应更高 EH：一些高准确率配置在执行中识别冲突，却未在错误最终答案中传达未解决的不确定性；轨迹分析显示 agent 常在执行早期检测到冲突，但在后续步骤中未能维持或解决；模型级干预可提升 EH，但通常以任务准确率下降为代价。
Conclusion: 认知谦逊并非模型单独的属性，而是 backbone 模型、agent harness 与评测环境三者交互的产物；提升 EH 与保住任务准确率之间存在权衡。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 提出用认知谦逊 (epistemic humility, EH) 评测 LLM agent 在知识冲突下的行为，拆成轨迹级的 Identify、Solve、Escalate (ISE) 三维度，并在受控冲突与多步执行中的自然冲突两种设定下各配无冲突对照。评测四个 agent 后发现任务准确率高不等于更谦逊：部分高准确率配置能在执行中识别冲突，却在错误的最终答案里不传达未解决的不确定性；agent 常在早期步骤检测到冲突，却在后续步骤中丢失或不解决。模型级干预能提升 EH，但往往以牺牲任务准确率为代价。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 agentic 系统评测几乎只看任务成功，无法说明当检索证据与模型先验矛盾时，agent 是修正答案、承认不确定，还是坚持错误结论。
summary_sections.method: 把 EH 操作化为轨迹级 ISE 三维度；构造知识冲突场景（参数化知识与检索证据矛盾，或两个上下文来源互相矛盾），分受控冲突与多步 agentic 执行中的自然冲突两类，各配匹配的无冲突对照，评测四个 agent。
summary_sections.result: 四个 agent 上，更高任务准确率并不对应更高 EH：一些高准确率配置在执行中识别冲突，却未在错误最终答案中传达未解决的不确定性；轨迹分析显示 agent 常在执行早期检测到冲突，但在后续步骤中未能维持或解决；模型级干预可提升 EH，但通常以任务准确率下降为代价。
summary_sections.conclusion: 认知谦逊并非模型单独的属性，而是 backbone 模型、agent harness 与评测环境三者交互的产物；提升 EH 与保住任务准确率之间存在权衡。

papers.title: Subspace Uncertainty and Sharp Sampling Thresholds on the Boolean Cube
papers.abstract_en: We study Gaussian regression under squared population $L_2$ loss in a known $m$-dimensional subspace of degree-at-most-$k$ functions on the $d$-dimensional Boolean cube. Random inputs can undersample regions essential for prediction, delaying the parametric rate even when the model is known. For fixed $q_0<1/2$, $1\le k\le q_0d$, and sufficiently large fixed $A$, the worst-subspace sample threshold for minimax error $Aσ^2(m+t)/n$ with confidence $1-e^{-t}$, $t\ge\log4$, is \[ N=(m+t)\exp\{E_{d,k}+O(k^{1/3})\}, \quad E_{d,k}=dΨ(k/d), \] where $Ψ(q)=\log2-\mathsf H(\tfrac12-\sqrt{q(1-q)})$ and $\mathsf H$ is binary entropy with natural logarithms. The upper bound holds for every feasible $m$; the matching lower bound holds when $m\le\binom d{\lfloor k^{1/3}\rfloor}$ or $t\ge m$. We sharpen the Polyanskiy--Samorodnitsky uncertainty principle in two respects. First, for fixed leakage $ρ\in(0,1)$, the smallest set carrying a fraction $1-ρ$ of a nonzero degree-at-most-$k$ polynomial's energy has probability $\exp\{-E_{d,k}+O_{ρ,q_0}(k^{1/3})\}$. An Airy-kernel construction proves that the remainder cannot be $o(k^{1/3})$ in general. Second, we construct a subspace of dimension $\binom d{\lfloor k^{1/3}\rfloor}$ such that every function in the subspace has at least a fraction $1-ρ$ of its energy on the same set, whose probability is at most $\exp\{-E_{d,k}+C_{ρ,q_0}k^{1/3}\}$. For sufficiently large $k$, this set is a Hamming ball. A striking consequence is an exponential cost of noise: the parametric rate can require $(m+t)4^k\exp\{-O(k^{1/3})\}$ samples, whereas $O((m+t)2^k)$ suffice for noiseless identification. As $k\to\infty$ with $k/d\to0$, the noisy threshold is $(m+t)\exp\{2k+o(k)\}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 d 维 Boolean cube 上已知 m 维、次数至多 k 的函数子空间内做高斯回归，随机输入会欠采样对预测关键的区域，使参数收敛速率被推迟。最坏子空间的 minimax 误差 Aσ²(m+t)/n 所需样本阈值为 N=(m+t)exp{E_{d,k}+O(k^{1/3})}，E_{d,k}=dΨ(k/d)，Ψ(q)=log2−H(1/2−√(q(1−q)))；噪声使代价指数化：含噪阈值约 (m+t)4^k exp{−O(k^{1/3})}，而无噪声辨识只需 O((m+t)2^k)，k→∞ 且 k/d→0 时为 (m+t)exp{2k+o(k)}。
Motivation: 随机输入可能欠采样对预测必需的区域，即使模型已知也会推迟参数速率；Polyanskiy–Samorodnitsky 不确定性原理在能量集中集合的尺度与共享集合构造两方面仍可 sharpen。
Method: 在已知 m 维 degree-at-most-k 子空间上分析平方总体 L2 损失的高斯回归 minimax 误差，导出最坏子空间样本阈值（上界对所有可行 m 成立，下界在 m≤C(d,floor(k^{1/3})) 或 t≥m 时匹配）；用 Airy-kernel 构造证明 O(k^{1/3}) 余项一般不可改进为 o(k^{1/3})，并构造维数为 C(d,floor(k^{1/3})) 的共享能量集中子空间，充分大 k 时该集合为 Hamming ball。
Result: 最坏子空间阈值 N=(m+t)exp{E_{d,k}+O(k^{1/3})}，E_{d,k}=dΨ(k/d)，Ψ(q)=log2−H(1/2−√(q(1−q)))，置信度 1−e^{−t}，t≥log4，固定 q0<1/2、1≤k≤q0d；泄漏 ρ∈(0,1) 下承载 1−ρ 能量的最小集合概率为 exp{−E_{d,k}+O_{ρ,q0}(k^{1/3})}，Airy-kernel 构造表明余项不能是 o(k^{1/3})；共享集合概率至多 exp{−E_{d,k}+C_{ρ,q0}k^{1/3}}。噪声代价指数级：含噪需 (m+t)4^k exp{−O(k^{1/3})}，无噪声 O((m+t)2^k) 即可；k→∞ 且 k/d→0 时含噪阈值为 (m+t)exp{2k+o(k)}。
Conclusion: Boolean cube 上低次子空间回归的样本复杂度由 E_{d,k}=dΨ(k/d) 加 k^{1/3} 级余项刻画，且噪声把辨识代价从 2^k 抬到 4^k；不确定性原理的余项阶 k^{1/3} 在一般情形不可改进。

papers.title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPD（Geometry-Privileged Distillation）把深度、语义与 BEV 线索渲染成紧凑文本、按问题路由给教师，在 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 中对错误轨迹施加 privileged KL 并叠加 GRPO，部署模型仍只吃 RGB。在 4B backbone 上 GPD 在 VSI-Bench 达 57.1，MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench、ViewSpatial 四项平均 37.6，同时优于 GRPO 与 answer-privileged OPSD。
Motivation: VLM 的空间推理受制于 RGB 输入不直接提供几何证据：现有方案要么在推理时注入 3D（架构与延迟代价），要么只用结果奖励监督最终答案，而空间错误源头在感知，深度或方向误判只能靠场景真实几何纠正。
Method: GPD 将 depth、semantic、BEV 三类几何线索渲染为紧凑文本，按问题条件路由 (question-conditioned routing) 送给教师模型，与参考答案并列；对错误轨迹施加 privileged KL 损失并增强 GRPO 的 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD)，学生部署时保持 RGB-only。
Result: 在 4B backbone 上，GPD 在 VSI-Bench 取得 57.1，在 MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench、ViewSpatial 上平均 37.6，优于 GRPO 与 answer-privileged OPSD；消融显示 3D 与 answer privilege 互补、按问题路由优于全上下文注入、只对错误轨迹蒸馏更有效。
Conclusion: 把几何证据作为教师权限信息、仅在错误轨迹上做特权蒸馏，可在不改变 RGB-only 部署的前提下提升 VLM 空间推理。

papers.title: SplitJEPA: Learning Invariant and Variant Latent Worlds without Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Understanding a dynamical world calls for more than a latent state that summarizes its observations: the state should also be organized into the factors that stay shared across related observations and the factors that vary between them. For example, a robot pushing a cube to a goal should take the same action when the camera shifts or the lights dim, since nothing in the scene has moved. Existing approaches to this decomposition commonly obtain it through reconstruction, so the latent variables must first explain the entire observational world before their organization can be trusted. Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) model the latent state directly and never reconstruct, yet no existing result recovers the invariant and variant parts of the state they learn. How to learn the invariant-variant structure of the latent world without paying for its reconstruction therefore remains open. To close this gap, we introduce SplitJEPA, a JEPA that jointly recovers the latent state and its invariant and variant organization directly in representation space, without any reconstruction. We prove that, under stationary Gaussian predictive dynamics and a full-rank variation condition, SplitJEPA identifies the invariant and variant subspaces up to independent block-wise isometries, without introducing an observation decoder. Since the guarantee needs no decoder, the result extends reconstruction-free latent recovery to invariant-variant block identification. Experiments on synthetic nonlinear systems and robotic manipulation tasks support the theoretical results and show their practical value for both robustness and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SplitJEPA 在不重建观测的前提下，直接在表示空间把潜状态拆成跨相关观测共享的不变分量与随观测变化的可变分量。在平稳高斯预测动力学加满秩变化条件下，可证该分解在各自独立的分块等距 (block-wise isometry) 意义下可辨识，且无需引入观测解码器；合成非线性系统与机器人操作实验支持该理论结果，并显示其在鲁棒性与效率上的实用价值。
Motivation: 现有不变/可变分解依赖重建，潜变量须先解释整个观测世界才能信任其组织；JEPA 虽免重建，但没有结果能恢复所学状态中的不变与可变部分。
Method: SplitJEPA 在 JEPA 框架内于表示空间联合恢复潜状态及其不变/可变分块组织，不使用观测解码器；理论在平稳高斯预测动力学与满秩变化条件下证明分块可辨识性，实验用合成非线性系统与机器人操作任务检验。
Result: 证明在平稳高斯预测动力学与满秩变化条件下，SplitJEPA 恢复的不变与可变子空间在独立分块等距意义下可辨识，且不引入观测解码器；合成非线性系统与机器人操作实验支持该理论，并展示鲁棒性与效率两方面的实用价值。
Conclusion: 免重建的潜恢复可以扩展到不变-可变分块识别：只要预测动力学平稳高斯且变化满秩，无需解码器即可在表示空间中把潜世界拆成不变与可变两部分。

papers.title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出先验障碍 (prior barrier) 度量预训练模型对竞争概念相对目标概念的支持强度，发现其呈长尾分布，导致头概念与尾概念在 SFT 起点不同。据此提出 PASS：构造参考导出概念、估计每条指令的区分证据，并把预算自适应分配给当前覆盖不足的概念。在四个 backbone-budget 设置上一致优于七种 SFT 指令选择方法，消融显示自适应分配优于均匀分配。
Motivation: SFT 所需概念在预训练中获得的支持程度差异很大，长尾概念起点更高、需要额外指令才能学好，而现有指令选择方法未按这一差异分配有限预算。
Method: PASS 先构造参考导出概念 (reference-derived concepts)，估计每条指令对概念提供的区分证据，再把选择预算自适应分配给当前选择下仍覆盖不足的概念；并给出长尾先验障碍下 SFT 的预测风险界，刻画先验障碍与累积证据如何共同决定性能。
Result: 在四个 backbone-budget 设置上一致优于七种 SFT 指令选择的 state-of-the-art 方法；消融实验显示 PASS 的自适应分配一致优于均匀分配。
Conclusion: 先验障碍的长尾分布决定了 SFT 的指令预算应按概念覆盖缺口而非均匀分配，风险界把先验障碍与累积证据共同纳入预测性能刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing
papers.abstract_en: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. To study this gap, we introduce RISEBench, the first benchmark for evaluating Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and extend it to RISEBench++, a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ extends the taxonomy into a hierarchical scheme spanning six reasoning dimensions: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, and Counterfactual Reasoning, together with Hybrid Reasoning integrating multiple reasoning types across multi-turn edits. These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. We expand input formats to include multi-image conditioning and scale the benchmark to 1000 human-annotated test cases, released in English and Chinese. We also improve our evaluation framework, assessing Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility with human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge approach for more reliable and calibrated judgements. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, outperforming most strong existing approaches across diverse RISE tasks. We evaluate 58 visual editing approaches, including 34 open-source models, 19 closed-source models, and 5 agentic methods. The results reveal substantial challenges in reasoning-based visual editing, with even the strongest evaluated approach, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, achieving only 56.6% accuracy. RISEBench++ highlights the limitations of contemporary editing models, provides insights, and indicates future directions for reasoning-aware visual editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RISEBench 与 RISEBench++，评测推理驱动的视觉编辑 (Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing)：按六大推理维度分层为 12 个子类、65 种细粒度任务，含多图条件输入，共 1000 个人工标注测试用例（英中双语）。评测 58 个编辑方法（34 开源、19 闭源、5 agentic），最强的 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst 仅达 56.6% 准确率，说明推理式编辑仍是明显短板。
Motivation: LMM 在视觉理解与生成上进展显著，但在复杂指令遵循、外观一致性保持和灵活输入格式的视觉编辑上仍困难，且此前没有针对推理式编辑的评测基准。
Method: 构建 RISEBench++：分层分类覆盖 Temporal、Causal、Spatial、Logical、Counterfactual 及跨多轮编辑的 Hybrid Reasoning 六个维度，分解为 12 子类 65 种任务类型，扩展到多图条件输入，1000 个人工标注用例；评测框架从 Instruction Reasoning、Appearance Consistency、Visual Plausibility 三方面结合人工评委与 LMM-as-a-judge。另提出训练无关的 RISE-Agent，整合推理规划、工具增强执行与验证器引导精修。
Result: 评测 58 个视觉编辑方法（34 开源、19 闭源、5 agentic）；最强方法 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst 准确率仅 56.6%；RISE-Agent 在多种 RISE 任务上超过多数强现有方法。
Conclusion: 当代编辑模型在推理式视觉编辑上存在实质短板，需要面向推理感知 (reasoning-aware) 的编辑方法；RISE-Agent 表明训练无关的智能体式规划与验证精修是一条可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI agent 当作固定权重下的启发式学习 (heuristic learning) 引擎，形式化为 Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL)，在含 12 个真实对抗游戏、1,920 个历史人类程序的 AAArena 基准上让 agent 解读规则、选对手、看回放并改写游戏策略。Opus5.5 + Claude Code 拿下 6 枚金牌，但没有任何配置攻克其余 6 条人类阶梯，规则越复杂表现越差。
Motivation: 对抗游戏中从少量样本学习和自适应策略仍然困难；现有 AI agent 缺少把对局经验转成可执行策略修订的标准化评测场景。
Method: 形式化 AHL 范式：模型权重固定，AI agent 作为学习引擎迭代修订游戏策略及其支撑软件；评测协议仿照真实游戏竞赛，agent 需解读规则、选择对手、分析回放，并在固定对局与评测预算内追求最高排名，同时评测多种模型与 harness 配置。
Result: AAArena 含 12 个真实对抗游戏与 1,920 个归档人类程序；Opus5.5 配 Claude Code 获得 6 枚金牌，其余 6 条人类阶梯无任何被测配置登顶；规则说明更复杂的游戏表现普遍更弱；消融显示对手选择与密集反馈支持策略改进，agent 既能从自身对局的 on-policy 回放、也能从他人对局的 off-policy 回放中学习。
Conclusion: 启发式学习在对抗游戏中确有登顶潜力，但游戏理解、策略实现与长程策略开发仍是持续瓶颈，且瓶颈随规则复杂度上升。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Ambient Discrete Diffusion: Using the Wrong Data at the Right Time for Data Efficient Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce RefineMix, a framework for training discrete diffusion models under severe data scarcity, a common constraint in scientific applications. RefineMix uses out-of-distribution data at selected diffusion times to improve generalization without biasing the sampling distribution. Although this strategy has been explored in continuous diffusion, discrete diffusion presents a distinct challenge: unlike Gaussian noise, masking preserves domain information in surviving tokens, limiting the use of related data at high noise levels. At low noise levels, however, the domains effectively disjoint supports become an advantage, allowing the model to learn from both in-domain and out-of-distribution data without biasing the sampler. We formalize these intuitions and provide a theoretical analysis for the proposed method. Experimentally, across five domain-shift settings, RefineMix matches or outperforms in-domain finetuning and data mixing. For protein sequence generation, finetuning with just 197 in-domain examples nearly doubles the fraction of generated proteins that are simultaneously novel, foldable, and in-family compared to standard finetuning.
papers.comment: 10 pages. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops (BeNTo, DiffuLM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefineMix 在离散扩散训练中于选定扩散时间引入 out-of-distribution 数据以缓解数据稀缺：高噪声（masking）阶段保留域内信息会污染采样分布，低噪声阶段两域支撑集近乎不相交，此时混入外部数据可同时利用两域而不偏置 sampler。在五个 domain-shift 设定中其表现持平或优于 in-domain finetuning 与 data mixing；蛋白序列生成上仅用 197 个域内样本微调，使同时满足 novel、foldable、in-family 的生成蛋白占比接近标准微调的两倍。
Motivation: 科学应用中域内数据极度稀缺，而离散扩散的 masking 噪声不像高斯噪声那样抹掉域信息，直接套用连续扩散的外部数据混用策略会偏置采样分布。
Method: RefineMix 按扩散时间选择性注入 out-of-distribution 数据：在低噪声阶段利用两域近乎不相交的支撑集同时学习域内与域外数据，并给出该策略的理论分析；评测覆盖五个 domain-shift 设定，对比 in-domain finetuning 与 data mixing。
Result: 五个 domain-shift 设定中 RefineMix 持平或优于 in-domain finetuning 和 data mixing；蛋白序列生成任务上，仅用 197 个域内样本微调，使同时 novel、foldable、in-family 的生成蛋白比例接近标准微调的两倍。
Conclusion: 离散扩散中外部数据的可用性随噪声时间变化，只在低噪声阶段混入 OOD 数据即可在不偏置采样分布的前提下显著提升数据稀缺场景的生成质量。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VFold 提出对称感知的 value cache 合并策略，在不改动 LLM 架构、不增加解码开销的前提下压缩 KV cache；该策略还能与高压缩比量化或 key cache pruning 叠加，达到任一方法单独无法企及的压缩比，且额外代价极小。
Motivation: 长上下文解码时 KV cache 占用主导显存，现有层间相似性压缩技术多需改动模型架构并带来可观开销。
Method: 对称感知的 value cache merging：利用层间 cache 相似性合并 value cache，避免有害性能下降与架构改动；可与高压缩比量化或 key cache pruning 组合使用。
Result: 提出可与既有 cache 压缩技术组合，达到任一方法单独无法达到的压缩比，额外成本极小；摘要未给出具体压缩比或评测数字。
Conclusion: value cache 中存在大量未被利用的容量，是内存约束下扩展上下文窗口的简单而高效的方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContiLNN 用双向闭式连续时间模块 (Bi-CfC) 在二维医学图像修复骨干上做跨层建模，以切片索引间隔调制门控、无需数值 ODE 积分，并用参考引导一致性约束跨切片一阶与二阶强度差。在 CT 去噪、MRI 超分辨率、低计数 PET 修复三任务上，五个训练种子平均 PSNR 较 Restore-RWKV 分别提升 0.1907、1.0176、1.2482 dB，RMSE 均更低；七切片剖面显示较 Bi-GRU 延迟低 52.8%、峰值 GPU 显存低 57.0%。
Motivation: 医学图像修复中解剖连续性是有用的互补信息，但切片采样间隔不规则、局部解剖变化大，跨切片建模既要响应采样差异又不能牺牲平面内保真度。
Method: 在二维修复骨干上并联 Bi-CfC 跨切片模块，用切片索引间隔调制由局部特征与隐状态决定的门控，避免数值 ODE 积分；参考引导一致性 (reference-guided consistency) 对齐跨切片一阶与二阶强度差，另加来自冻结骨干的蒸馏以保持平面内保真。

papers.title: asdex: Automatic Sparse Differentiation in JAX
papers.abstract_en: Many tasks in scientific computing and machine learning require the Jacobian or Hessian matrix of a function. Automatic differentiation (AD) computes these derivatives to machine precision, but materializing a dense $m \times n$ Jacobian requires $n$ forward-mode or $m$ reverse-mode AD passes, one per column or row. For a large class of functions, each output depends on only a few inputs, making the derivative matrix sparse. Automatic sparse differentiation (ASD) exploits this structure in four steps: detection of the input-agnostic sparsity pattern, coloring of a graph to group columns or rows that can share an AD pass, compressed differentiation to compute a compressed derivative matrix with one AD pass per color, and finally decompression into the original sparsity pattern. The number of colors, and hence of AD passes, is often independent of the problem dimension: a banded Jacobian with $b$ contiguous bands, for instance, only ever requires $b$ colors, regardless of its size. asdex offers the first standalone ASD toolkit in the popular JAX ecosystem. With asdex.jacobian and asdex.hessian, it provides sparse drop-in replacements for jax.jacobian and jax.hessian.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: asdex 是 JAX 生态中首个独立的自动稀疏微分 (ASD) 工具包，通过检测输入无关稀疏模式、图着色分组可共享 AD pass 的列/行、压缩微分解压四步，把稠密 m×n Jacobian 所需的 n 次前向或 m 次反向 AD pass 压到每种颜色一次。带状 Jacobian 只需 b 种颜色，pass 数常与问题维度无关；asdex.jacobian 与 asdex.hessian 可直接替换 jax.jacobian 和 jax.hessian。
Motivation: 物化稠密 Jacobian 需要 n 次前向或 m 次反向 AD pass，对大规模科学计算与机器学习中的稀疏导数结构是不必要的开销。
Method: ASD 四步流程：检测输入无关的稀疏模式、对图着色以分组可共享一次 AD pass 的列或行、每种颜色一次 pass 算出压缩导数矩阵、再解压回原稀疏模式；在 JAX 中以 asdex.jacobian 和 asdex.hessian 提供 drop-in 替换。
Result: 带 b 条连续带的 Jacobian 只需 b 种颜色，与矩阵规模无关；颜色数（即 AD pass 数）通常独立于问题维度。arXiv comment 标注全文含 1 张表。
Conclusion: 对输出仅依赖少量输入的函数，稀疏模式检测加图着色可把 AD pass 数从与维度成正比降到与维度无关，asdex 让这一能力在 JAX 中开箱可用。

papers.title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RiCo 用接触表面点的稀疏邻域表示刚体交互，把跨物体推理限制在邻近表面、在刚体内部传播接触信息，从而保留细粒度接触细节。在 MOVi 基准上，100 帧位置误差较基线降低 31-35%，朝向误差降低约 38%，相对真值的穿透时间差与平均深度差为 11.0% 与 2.22 mm，并可零样本泛化到含 270 个物体的场景。
Motivation: 端到端世界模型对整场景或整物体预测交互，但刚体接触本质上是局部的，只有邻近表面直接交换接触力；建模所有场景点对代价过高，局部接触细节容易丢失。
Method: Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo)：以接触表面点的稀疏邻域表示物体间交互，每个点的状态与其邻近表面的相对几何、运动和物理属性结合，再在物体各点上推理这些局部接触如何共同影响运动；跨物体推理限定在邻近表面，接触信息在刚体内部传播。
Result: 在 MOVi 基准上，RiCo 相比基线将 100 帧位置误差降低 31-35%、朝向误差降低约 38%；接触保真度方面，相对真值的穿透时间差为 11.0%、平均深度差为 2.22 mm；零样本从小规模训练场景泛化到含 270 个物体的场景，真实多球碰撞实验给出 sim-to-real 迁移的初步证据。
Conclusion: 把刚体交互的跨物体推理限制在局部接触邻域、同时在刚体内传播接触信息，可在不建模全部点对的前提下同时提高精度与接触保真度，并具备向大规模场景和真实系统的外推能力。

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Data Fusion for Treatment Effect Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) identify treatment effects without confounding but are often small, whereas observational studies (OBS) are large but may be confounded. Many estimators combining a small RCT with a large OBS have been developed for the average treatment effect (ATE) and the conditional ATE (CATE). However, existing ATE estimators either make assumptions on the OBS or do not borrow enough power from them. The CATE has been studied less than the ATE. Existing CATE methods either assume the OBS are unconfounded, rely on a model of the confounding function, or accept bias in exchange for lower variance. We therefore propose a framework that, without special assumptions on the OBS, fuses the OBS and the RCT by preserving the unbiasedness of RCT-based estimation while borrowing power from the large OBS to boost precision. Applying this principle, we build an ATE estimator, AIPW-Fusion, with closed-form weights and confidence intervals, and two CATE learners, DR-Fusion and R-Fusion. Experiments corroborate our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不对观测研究 (OBS) 作特殊假设的前提下，把小规模 RCT 与大规模 OBS 融合：保留 RCT 估计的无偏性，同时借 OBS 提升精度。据此构造 ATE 估计量 AIPW-Fusion（闭式权重与置信区间）和两个 CATE 学习器 DR-Fusion、R-Fusion，实验结果与理论发现一致。
Motivation: RCT 无混杂但样本小，OBS 样本大却可能有混杂；现有 ATE 估计量要么对 OBS 加假设、要么借力不足，CATE 方面已有方法或假设 OBS 无混杂、或依赖混杂函数模型、或以偏差换方差。
Method: 提出一个融合框架：以 RCT 估计的无偏性为约束，从大 OBS 借取信息提升精度，且不对 OBS 作特殊假设；在此原则下构造 AIPW-Fusion（闭式权重与置信区间）以及 CATE 学习器 DR-Fusion 与 R-Fusion，并做实验验证。
Result: 实验结果与框架的理论发现一致；ATE 估计量 AIPW-Fusion 给出闭式权重与置信区间，CATE 学习器为 DR-Fusion 和 R-Fusion。
Conclusion: 在不加特殊 OBS 假设的条件下，可以同时保住 RCT 的无偏性并借大 OBS 提高精度，这一原则可落到 ATE 与 CATE 的具体估计量上。

papers.title: Composite Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion with Optimal Oracle Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We consider stochastic nonsmooth nonconvex composite optimization, which includes several important problems such as constrained optimization and the regularized training of neural networks. The objective is the sum of a possibly nonsmooth nonconvex Lipschitz function and a convex regularizer, and the function is accessed through stochastic gradients or function values. The goal is to find a point that satisfies a Goldstein-type stationarity condition designed for composite objectives. To our knowledge, no oracle complexity bound for this setting is known under first-order access, and existing complexities under zeroth-order access are suboptimal. To handle this issue, we employ the framework of online-to-nonconvex conversion, which chooses update directions by an online learner and is known to achieve optimal rates for noncomposite problems. We extend the framework to our composite scenario by introducing new losses for the learner, which contain the regularizer itself rather than its linearization and for which a variant of online mirror descent achieves low regret. We show that the resulting algorithm finds such a point with $O(δ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ stochastic gradient queries or $O(dδ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ function-value queries, where $δ$ is the Goldstein radius, $\varepsilon$ is the stationarity tolerance, and $d$ is the dimension. These rates match the optimal ones for noncomposite nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, demonstrating that the additional convex regularizer does not worsen the oracle complexity. We also give rates for the smooth case and present numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对随机非光滑非凸复合优化（目标为非凸 Lipschitz 函数加凸正则项），把 online-to-nonconvex conversion 框架扩展到复合情形：为在线学习器设计含正则项本身（而非其线性化）的新损失，用 online mirror descent 变体获得低遗憾，从而以 O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 次随机梯度查询或 O(dδ^{-1}ε^{-3}) 次函数值查询达到 Goldstein 型复合驻点条件，与非复合情形的最优速率一致，即凸正则项不恶化 oracle 复杂度。
Motivation: 一阶访问下该复合设定此前没有已知的 oracle 复杂度界，零阶访问下的已有复杂度又是次优的；而该设定涵盖约束优化与神经网络正则化训练等重要问题。
Method: 采用 online-to-nonconvex conversion 框架，由在线学习器选择更新方向；为复合目标构造含正则项本身的新损失函数，并证明其变体 online mirror descent 具有低遗憾，进而给出随机梯度与函数值两种访问模式下的查询复杂度界，另附光滑情形的速率。
Result: 随机梯度查询复杂度 O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3})，函数值查询复杂度 O(dδ^{-1}ε^{-3})，其中 δ 为 Goldstein 半径、ε 为驻点容差、d 为维度；这些速率与非复合非光滑非凸优化的最优速率相同，光滑情形另给速率，并给出数值实验。
Conclusion: 作者主张：在该复合设定下附加的凸正则项不恶化 oracle 复杂度，所得速率对复合与非复合情形同为最优。

papers.title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.

TL;DR: SparseDecoding 把剪枝校准数据换成稠密模型自回归解码（排除 prefill）时逐层采集的激活，使 Hessian 与解码期激活分布对齐，并配一个带 bitmask 索引与定步遍历的 N:M SpMV kernel。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B/32B 的长文本生成基准上一致优于固定文本校准，A100 上端到端解码加速最高 1.48×。

Method: 算法侧：从稠密模型自回归生成（不含 prefill）过程中的逐层激活构造校准矩阵，把剪枝目标与解码激活对齐；系统侧：实现面向解码的优化 N:M 稀疏矩阵-向量 kernel，采用 bitmask 索引与固定步长遍历。
