papers.title: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DVLA-RL++ 在少样本学习中用互补语义净化 (CSP) 与反事实强化学习门控 (CRG) 隔离图像-文本对齐里的上下文污染：CSP 生成本征与干扰描述并与各 support token 比对，用歧义相关的拒绝边际稀疏分配证据、本征语义锚填补剩余质量，CRG 以识别性能与干扰暴露平衡的奖励学习逐层融合强度。在标准、细粒度与跨域基准上达到 SOTA，相对 DVLA-RL 平均提升 1.4%。
Motivation: 少样本学习里图文高一致性可能同时来自物体本征属性与偶发上下文，使 support 原型易受上下文污染，用文本语义补足视觉样本的路线因此失真。
Method: 在 DVLA-RL 上加两个模块：CSP 从标注 support 生成本征与干扰描述，逐 token 比对一致性，以歧义依赖的拒绝边际做稀疏证据分配，并用本征语义锚填补未分配质量作为视觉证据不可靠时的回退；CRG 用平衡识别性能与干扰暴露的奖励学习逐层语义融合强度，同一 episode 上独立执行的参考轨迹提供配对学习信号。理论部分把保留证据与锚质量关联到原型稳定性，并给出无偏 on-policy 梯度估计的条件。
Result: 在标准、细粒度与跨域三类基准上取得 SOTA 准确率，相对 DVLA-RL 平均提升 1.4%。
Conclusion: 把上下文干扰显式分离并用 RL 门控逐层融合，可在少样本识别中稳定原型并超过原 DVLA-RL；作者给出保留证据与锚质量决定原型稳定性、以及无偏 on-policy 梯度估计成立的理论条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differentiable Systematic Resampling for Variational Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Particle filters are a standard tool for nonlinear state estimation, but their resampling step is discrete, preventing gradient-based learning in variational sequential Monte Carlo. We introduce Differentiable Systematic Resampling (DSR), a temperature-controlled relaxation of systematic resampling, that preserves the CDF-ordered, banded structure of systematic resampling while enabling full gradient flow. DSR converges to exact systematic resampling as the temperature vanishes, and we prove a pointwise exponential convergence rate for the induced bias. Compared to optimal-transport-based differentiable resampling, DSR avoids iterative solvers and has substantially lower computational overhead. Experiments on stochastic dynamical systems and real-world handwriting data show that DSR achieves comparable or superior filtering and dynamics learning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可微系统重采样 (Differentiable Systematic Resampling, DSR)，用温度控制的松弛替代变分序贯蒙特卡洛 (variational SMC) 中离散的 systematic resampling，保留其按 CDF 排序的带状结构并让梯度完整回传。温度趋于零时 DSR 收敛到精确 systematic resampling，且诱导偏差有点态指数收敛率证明；相比基于最优传输 (OT) 的可微重采样无需迭代求解器、计算开销显著更低，在随机动力系统与真实手写数据上滤波与动力学学习性能相当或更优。
Motivation: 粒子滤波的重采样步骤是离散操作，阻断了变分序贯蒙特卡洛中的梯度流，使基于梯度的学习无法进行；现有基于最优传输的可微重采样需要迭代求解器，计算开销大。
Method: DSR 对 systematic resampling 做温度控制的连续松弛，保持 CDF 有序的带状抽样结构，同时允许完整梯度流；理论上证明温度趋零时收敛到精确 systematic resampling，并给出诱导偏差的点态指数收敛速率；与 OT 类可微重采样相比不依赖迭代求解器。
Result: 温度趋零时 DSR 收敛到精确 systematic resampling，诱导偏差具有点态指数收敛率（已证明）；相比基于最优传输的可微重采样，避免迭代求解器且计算开销显著更低；在随机动力系统与真实手写数据 (handwriting data) 上，滤波与动力学学习性能与基线相当或更优。
Conclusion: 用温度松弛替代迭代式 OT 求解，可以在保留 systematic resampling 结构的同时打通变分 SMC 的梯度流，并以更低开销达到相当或更好的滤波与学习效果。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Recompose and Refine Latent Reasoning Flows for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning enables vision-language-action (VLA) models to transform multimodal observations into task-relevant internal states before generating continuous robot actions. While existing methods learn to generate or refine such states for each policy query, they discard successful reasoning after execution and therefore reconstruct similar computation from scratch. We present Reasoning and Flow Memory (FLOWMEM), a unified VLA model that turns successful latent computation into reusable reasoning experience. Rather than appending a fixed retrieved context, FLOWMEM dynamically retrieves and recomposes compatible latent fragments as the embodied context evolves, forming a reasoning route that follows the temporal structure and progress of successful computation. The route is then refined using current visual and proprioceptive evidence before it conditions action generation. Experiments on RoboMME and LIBERO-Plus show that FLOWMEM attains 48.0% and 77.3% success, outperforming memory-free policies by 1.7 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the value of reusing successful latent computation for closed-loop VLA control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLOWMEM 把 VLA 模型成功执行后的 latent reasoning 片段存成可复用记忆，随具身上下文演化动态检索并重组这些片段形成推理路线，再用当前视觉与本体感觉证据精修后条件化动作生成。在 RoboMME 与 LIBERO-Plus 上成功率分别达 48.0% 与 77.3%，比无记忆策略高 1.7 和 4.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 VLA latent reasoning 方法对每个策略查询重新生成或精修内部状态，执行成功后即丢弃，导致相似计算被反复从零重建。
Method: FLOWMEM 作为统一 VLA 模型：检索与重组兼容的 latent 片段（而非拼接固定检索上下文），使推理路线跟随成功计算的时序结构与进度；随后用当前视觉和本体感觉证据精修该路线，再条件化连续机器人动作生成。
Result: RoboMME 成功率 48.0%，LIBERO-Plus 成功率 77.3%；相对无记忆 (memory-free) 策略分别高出 1.7 和 4.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 复用成功的 latent 计算对闭环 VLA 控制有价值，记忆化推理路线优于每次从头重建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich its experience for future strategy updates. Across coding and agent-harness optimization benchmarks, EvoAlloc requires 59-82% fewer full evaluations and 61-89% fewer total LLM tokens to reach baseline-level performance. Moreover, under the same full-evaluation budget, EvoAlloc achieves 8.7-12.0% higher final performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoAlloc 是一个自我演化的资源分配 agent，把历史搜索与分配结果固化为可复用经验来修订分配策略，并用反事实探索偶尔评估被拒绝的候选以补充经验。在 coding 与 agent-harness 优化基准上，达到基线性能所需完整评估次数减少 59-82%、LLM token 减少 61-89%；同等完整评估预算下最终性能高 8.7-12.0%。
Motivation: LLM 程序进化依赖评估反馈，但完整评估计算昂贵；现有方法在整轮搜索中用固定分配策略，容易把资源浪费在低价值候选上、错过有潜力的候选。
Method: 提出自我演化的资源分配 agent EvoAlloc：周期性把既往搜索与分配结果整合为可复用经验，用经验指导后续策略修订；并引入反事实探索机制，偶尔评估被分配器拒绝的候选，把结果并入经验以更新策略。
Result: 在 coding 与 agent-harness 优化基准上，达到基线性能所需完整评估减少 59-82%、总 LLM token 减少 61-89%；在相同完整评估预算下最终性能高出 8.7-12.0%。
Conclusion: 让分配策略从搜索经验中自我演化并配合反事实探索，可以在更少评估与更少 token 的条件下达到乃至超过固定分配策略的最终性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is Memorization Context-Sensitive? Prefix-Based Extraction Beyond Isolated Prefixes
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can expose memorized training sequences under prefix-based extraction: given a prefix from a training example, the model may assign high probability to the original continuation. In deployed systems, however, prefixes are rarely evaluated in isolation. They often appear together with instructions, retrieved documents, or other task-specific context, as in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This motivates examining whether contextual conditioning mitigates memorization or merely changes the set of memorized samples that become extractable. We investigate this issue through paired item-level measurements of probabilistic suffix extraction. For each prefix-suffix pair, we score the target suffix under an empty prompt and under retrieved contexts of varying relevance, across three open-weight instruction-tuned models. We find that context does not simply erase memorization. Instead, extractable memorization consists of a context-robust core and a context-sensitive boundary. Many samples that are extractable without context remain extractable under the retrieved context, especially as the prefix length increases. At the same time, context mainly affects marginal samples near the extraction threshold: it suppresses some exposures, but also enables new ones that are missed by prefix-only evaluation. These findings qualify the view that RAG reduces memorization risk. Context can lower aggregate extraction by suppressing boundary cases, yet robustly extractable samples persist, and context-enabled extractability remains security-relevant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三个开源指令微调模型上做配对的前缀-后缀概率抽取测量：同一前缀分别在空提示与不同相关度的检索上下文下给目标后缀打分。结果是上下文并不消除记忆，而是留下一个 context-robust core 加一个 context-sensitive boundary——无上下文可抽的样本多数在检索上下文下仍可抽，且前缀越长越稳；上下文主要压制阈值附近的边缘样本，同时开启一批前缀-only 评测漏掉的新暴露。
Motivation: 部署系统里前缀几乎不会孤立出现，常与指令、检索文档同现（RAG）；此前的前缀抽取评测无法区分上下文是真正缓解记忆，还是只换了可抽取样本的集合。
Method: 对每个 prefix-suffix 对做配对的 probabilistic suffix extraction 打分：同一目标后缀在空提示与不同相关度的 retrieved contexts 下各评一次，覆盖三个开源指令微调模型，按样本级配对比较。
Result: 上下文不抹除记忆：无上下文可抽取的样本在检索上下文下大多仍可抽取，且随前缀长度增加更稳固；上下文主要作用于接近抽取阈值的边缘样本，既抑制部分暴露，也启用前缀-only 评测漏掉的新暴露，从而降低总体抽取量。
Conclusion: RAG 降低记忆风险的说法需要限定：上下文只压掉边界样本，robustly extractable 的核心样本依然存在，context-enabled 的新暴露仍有安全意义。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: All Verdicts are Not Equal: Rethinking LLM Judge Reliability
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Judge is the standard paradigm for NLP evaluation, yet its systemic reliability remains poorly understood despite being widely treated as a deterministic ground truth. We present a comprehensive reliability audit, stresstesting six frontier models across four benchmarks, five prompt formats, two presentation orders, three sampling temperatures, and ten repetitions per condition. Our empirical analysis reveals severe vulnerabilities: verdicts change across identical replications at temperature zero, position-order swaps flip the majority of verdicts on challenging tasks, and the most deterministic judge achieves perfect consistency by trivially repeating incorrect verdicts, agreeing with ground truth only 51% of the time. To formalize these multi-faceted failure modes, we introduce the trustworthy verdict rate (T ), a unified metric capturing the joint probability that an evaluation is reproducible, order-invariant, and accurate. UsingT , we derive a theoretical upper bound on accuracy imposed by position bias and show that reliability is item-specific rather than modellevel. Finally, we demonstrate that shifting from pairwise win-rate to holistic rubric scoring improves trustworthiness more than any single-format prompting intervention, offering an actionable framework for robust NLP evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge 已被当作确定性 ground truth 广泛使用，但其系统性可靠性缺乏理解：判决在相同重复、不同呈现顺序下不稳定，且一致性可能来自重复错误答案。

Result: 温度 0 下相同重复间判决仍会变化；位置顺序交换在难题上翻转多数判决；最确定的 judge 达到完美一致性但与 ground truth 仅 51% 一致；用 T 推导出位置偏差导致的准确率理论上界，并显示可靠性是 item-specific 而非 model-level；从 pairwise win-rate 转向 holistic rubric scoring 对 T 的提升大于任何单一格式提示干预。

papers.title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Perception Test 2026 挑战赛（ECCV 2026 workshop）设四条赛道：原基准的统一多选 videoQA 与 grounded videoQA，加上基于城市尺度步行视频的两条新赛道 KilometerAudio 与 KilometerVision。新赛道冠军方案表明复杂空间与多模态推理可由昂贵的 agentic pipeline 解决，而独立使用的多模态模型仍难以胜任。
Motivation: 城市尺度步行视频带来的长时程、大范围空间与多模态推理超出现有 videoQA 基准的覆盖范围，需要新评测来区分 agentic 方案与端到端多模态模型的能力差距。
Method: 报告介绍两条城市尺度新赛道所用的基准（KilometerAudio、KilometerVision），并汇总四条赛道的冠军方案，另有一个跨全部赛道参赛的 generalist 模型。
Result: 四条赛道各自的冠军方案被总结；跨全部赛道参赛的 generalist 模型取得尚可 (satisfactory) 的表现；城市尺度新赛道的冠军方案显示复杂空间与多模态推理可由昂贵的 agentic pipeline 解决。
Conclusion: 在城市尺度视听推理上，agentic pipeline 目前优于独立使用的多模态模型，代价是流程昂贵。

papers.title: Exploiting Gradients in Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Simulators based on differential equations are ubiquitous in science and engineering. They are often used in simulation-based inference to evaluate the posterior distribution of the input parameters based on real-world observations of the simulator outputs. However, inference becomes challenging when individual simulator evaluations are computationally expensive. In such cases, a Bayesian optimization-based active learning approach with Gaussian process surrogate models has been used to maximize the information obtained from a limited simulation budget. Recently, gradients of simulator outputs with respect to input parameters have become increasingly available, yet they are rarely exploited for inference. Even though we only need to learn the simulator input-output relationship, gradient information can provide an additional valuable signal to guide the active learning procedure. This is of particular interest in the case of expensive simulators, when sample efficiency is crucial. In this paper, we demonstrate how incorporating gradient information into the Gaussian process surrogate accelerates Bayesian optimization-based inference under a limited simulation budget. Our results show significant improvement in convergence speed from using gradient information. For reverse-mode differentiation, the inference efficiency gains are maintained when accounting for the additional computational cost. In contrast, for forward-mode differentiation, the inference speed-up does not outweigh the computational costs. These results indicate that gradient-enhanced surrogates are beneficial primarily in problems where the number of parameters exceeds the output dimensionality, where reverse-mode differentiation is efficient.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 11th International Conference on Machine Learning Technologies (ICMLT), Berlin, Germany, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在昂贵微分方程模拟器的贝叶斯推断中，把模拟器输出对输入参数的梯度喂进 Gaussian process 代理，可加速基于 Bayesian optimization 的主动学习。反向模式微分在扣除额外计算开销后仍保持推断效率增益，前向模式微分的加速则抵不过计算成本；结论是梯度增强代理主要在参数数目超过输出维度、反向模式划算时才值得用。
Motivation: 昂贵模拟器的 simulation-based inference 受限于模拟预算，现有 GP 代理主动学习只用输入输出样本，忽略了已日益可得的模拟器输出对输入参数的梯度信号。
Method: 把模拟器输出对输入参数的梯度作为额外训练信号纳入 Gaussian process 代理，驱动 Bayesian optimization-based 主动学习在有限模拟预算下选择下一个评估点；代码以 BOSIP.jl 开源。
Result: 加入梯度信息后推断收敛速度显著提升；对反向模式微分 (reverse-mode differentiation)，计入额外计算成本后效率增益仍保持；对前向模式微分 (forward-mode)，加速不足以抵消计算开销。
Conclusion: 梯度增强代理的收益取决于微分模式与维度结构：当参数数目超过输出维度、反向模式高效时才划算，前向模式不值得。

papers.title: A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把模拟 GelSight Mini 的稠密光流在 7×9 网格上聚合成 126 维特征，用于跨重力域分类载荷引起的旋转方向。重力只解释特征方差的 1.6%（R²=0.016），却使仅用地球数据训练的 XGBoost 准确率从 94.4% 掉到轨道重力下的 75.9%；在四个重力域上联合训练的单一模型达到 96.3% 总体准确率（各域 95.1%–97.0%），且不把重力作为输入。结论是仅凭地球重力表现不足以确立触觉感知的可迁移性，训练与验证必须覆盖重力引起的域偏移。
Motivation: 视觉触觉传感器的高分辨率图像处理对空间机器人等资源受限平台开销大，而触觉感知模型通常只在地球重力下训练和验证，重力引起的接触特征偏移可能破坏其跨重力域的可迁移性。
Method: 从模拟 GelSight Mini 采集稠密光流，在 7×9 网格上聚合为 126 维特征，用 XGBoost 分类载荷引起的旋转方向；训练覆盖 Earth、Mars、Moon、orbital 四个重力域，并测试把特征降到 40 维的紧凑版本。
Result: 重力造成特征 1.6% 的方差（R²=0.016）；仅地球训练的 XGBoost 准确率从地球 94.4% 降至轨道 75.9%；四域联合训练的单一模型总体准确率 96.3%，各域 95.1%–97.0%（不使用重力作为输入）；40 维特征保留 95.7% 准确率，XGBoost 单次推理仅 0.14 ms。
Conclusion: 地球重力下的性能不足以证明触觉感知可迁移到空间操作，训练与验证需显式覆盖重力引起的域偏移；126 维或 40 维的紧凑光流表示已足够支撑跨重力域的旋转分类。

papers.title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
papers.abstract_en: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIVIN 是一个基于 30 个真实居住住宅数字孪生的具身智能基准，用人在环流程（实例识别、建筑重建、物体生成与摆放，每步由人对照源观测校正）保留真实房间布局与杂物摆放，并评测 3D 检测、3D 导航与 loco-manipulation 等四类任务。评测显示现有方法在密集物体、遮挡、有限自由空间和受限交互区域下仍表现吃力。
Motivation: 现有住宅仿真资源在规模、真实对应性和交互就绪度之间取舍，缺少对真实家庭实际摆放方式的忠实可交互复刻，机器人难以在真实居住环境中迁移空间理解与操作能力。
Method: 构建 30 个多样真实住宅的数字孪生，保留观测到的房间布局、家具配置与日常物品；采用人在环工作流，包含实例识别、建筑重建、物体生成与摆放，每阶段中间结果由人对照源观测审核修正；在此基准上评测 3D detection、3D reconstruction、navigation、loco-manipulation 四项任务。
Result: 评测显示当前方法在真实居住住宅的密集物体摆放、遮挡、有限自由空间与受限交互区域条件下仍面临挑战；基准覆盖 30 个住宅。
Conclusion: 真实居住环境的杂乱与空间约束是当前具身 AI 空间理解与机器人交互的主要瓶颈，忠实复刻真实摆放的数字孪生基准是推进方向。

papers.title: MAST: Motif-Augmented Diffusion with Search Tree for Spectroscopic Molecular Structure Elucidation
papers.abstract_en: Elucidating molecular structures from spectra is a foundational problem in chemical and materials characterization, yet remains challenging due to spectral ambiguity and the vast molecular space. Although recent diffusion-based generators show strong promise for spectra-conditioned elucidation, existing methods struggle to learn robust spectra-structure relationships from limited paired data when relying solely on global spectral representation. Moreover, the repeated full sampling inference strategy incurs substantial computation overhead. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MAST}, a \textbf{M}otif-\textbf{A}ugmented diffusion framework with \textbf{S}earch \textbf{T}ree, for joint 2D-3D spectroscopic molecular structure elucidation. MAST introduces explicit, interpretable \emph{motif priors} as intermediate evidences throughout denoising, reducing conditional ambiguity and facilitating spectra-conditioned optimization. We further cast diffusion sampling as \emph{reward-guided tree search} to prioritize high-reward denoising trajectories, yielding a compact set of spectra-consistent candidates under limited budgets. On the QM9S multi-spectra benchmark, MAST achieves \textbf{94.89\%} exact recovery and improves 3D fidelity, while preserving high chemical validity and stability. Code is available at https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RACE 用「去掉额外推理后参考动作似然下降幅度」这一轻量信号估计跨轮动作支撑，判定哪些轮次的推理可删除，并把删除信号注入 SFT 与 agentic RL，让策略学会何时推理、何时直接行动。在四个代表性 agent benchmark 上，RACE 大幅降低推理成本，同时保持或提升任务性能。
Motivation: LLM agent 在轨迹每一轮都先推理，但早期推理往往仍能支撑后续动作；逐轮用生成式验证来判断是否需要再推理代价过高，缺少轻量的跨轮支撑估计手段。
Method: 提出 Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE)：先发现 Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) 程序，渐进找出删除后对当前及后续参考动作影响有限的推理轮次；再把这些 removal signals 同时用于 supervised fine-tuning 和 agentic reinforcement learning，使策略学会按需推理。
Result: 在四个代表性 agent benchmark 上的实验显示，RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost，同时 maintaining or improving task performance；核心信号是删除额外推理后后续参考动作的似然下降与这些动作在既有推理下是否仍可恢复高度一致。
Conclusion: 跨轮动作支撑可以用删除推理后的似然变化轻量估计，据此训练的策略能在不牺牲（甚至提升）任务表现的前提下削减推理开销。

papers.title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViMoD 针对高分辨率图像长视觉 token 序列的多步推理开销，提出按需视觉记忆：DART 学习内容自适应分组与聚合容量，把区域 token 压成可恢复的 Coarse 表示并链接原始 Fine token，TRACE 利用解码历史预判后续证据需求并选择、保留或替换活跃 Fine 组。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上以 20% 视觉 token 预算在全部八个推理基准上超过所有被评估基线，平均归一化分数比最强 one-shot 基线高 39.0%，额外可训练参数仅占冻结 backbone 的 0.0546%。
Motivation: 高分辨率图像的长视觉 token 序列让 MLLM 多步推理计算代价高昂；现有 one-shot 剪枝与聚合在解码前把视觉 token 压成固定上下文，但推理各阶段所需的视觉证据会变化，固定压缩上下文难以保留所有阶段需要的细节。
Method: ViMoD 由两个模块组成：DART（Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens）学习内容自适应的分组与聚合容量，构造与原始可恢复 Fine token 相连的紧凑 Coarse 表示；TRACE（Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence）整合解码历史来预判下一步证据需求，选择、保留或替换活跃 Fine token 组，选中的 Fine token 在冻结 backbone 上补充常驻 Coarse 上下文。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上、20% 目标视觉 token 预算下，ViMoD 在全部八个推理基准上超过所有被评估基线，平均归一化分数比最强的被评估 one-shot 基线提高 39.0%，相对冻结 backbone 仅增加 0.0546% 可训练参数。
Conclusion: 把视觉上下文做成可按需取回原始细粒度证据的结构，而非一次性压成固定表示，能在大幅压缩视觉 token 的同时保住多步推理质量，且几乎不增加可训练参数。

papers.title: Structure Tax: How Structured Output affects LLMs Performance
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models in production often requires constraining outputs to structured formats such as JSON or XML, and prior work treats the resulting accuracy loss as an inherent `structure tax'. We re-examine this claim by evaluating a battery of models, datasets and schemas, measuring task accuracy, confidence calibration, and hidden-state geometry. The tax turns out to depend on schema design rather than on structure per se: reasoning-first field ordering matches or exceeds free-form accuracy, while answer-first ordering causes steep drops, particularly in smaller models. Format sensitivity scales inversely with a task's own structural constraints, and schemas that preserve reasoning order also improve calibration with CKA showing greater separability between correct and incorrect representations in middle transformer layers. Our findings indicate that properly designed structured formats can match or exceed free-form performance, reframing the critical question from `whether to structure' to `how to structure' for optimal reasoning preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 结构化输出的准确率损失并非结构本身带来，而是 schema 设计决定：reasoning-first 字段顺序能匹配甚至超过自由格式，answer-first 顺序则造成急剧下降，小模型尤其明显。格式敏感度与任务自身结构约束成反比，且保持推理顺序的 schema 还改善置信度校准，CKA 显示中间层对正确与错误表征的可分性更强。
Motivation: 生产部署要求 LLM 输出 JSON/XML 等结构化格式，既有工作把随之而来的准确率损失当作不可避免的 structure tax，但该归因未经跨模型、跨数据集、跨 schema 的系统检验。
Method: 在多组模型、数据集与 schema 上评测，同时测量任务准确率、置信度校准 (confidence calibration) 与隐藏态几何 (hidden-state geometry)，并用 CKA 比较正确与错误表征在 transformer 中间层的可分性。
Result: reasoning-first 字段顺序匹配或超过自由格式准确率，answer-first 顺序导致急剧下降且小模型更严重；格式敏感度随任务自身结构约束增强而下降；保持推理顺序的 schema 提升校准，CKA 显示中间层正确/错误表征可分性更高。
Conclusion: 结构化输出的代价由 schema 设计而非结构本身决定，关键问题应从 whether to structure 转向 how to structure，以在保留推理能力的前提下选格式。

papers.title: Diffusion Removes Langevin's Conditioning Dependence: A Sharp Gaussian Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Despite their empirical success, why diffusion models overcome the bottlenecks of classical score-based samplers remains unclear. In this work, we leverage Gaussian distributions to isolate this phenomenon. We establish 2-Wasserstein convergence bounds for optimized hyperparameters, showing that diffusion processes achieve a sampling error of $O(\sqrt{dλ_{\max}}\log N/N)$, where $d$ is the dimension, $N$ the number of sampling steps, and $λ_{\max}$ the largest eigenvalue of the target covariance matrix. Unadjusted and underdamped Langevin dynamics suffer from an additional $\sqrtκ$ factor, where $κ$ is the condition number. These rates follow from spectral bounds which are sharp: we confirm them via matching first-order asymptotics as $N\rightarrow\infty$. Our analysis provides a rigorous characterization, in the Gaussian setting, of how time-dependent score trajectories remove condition-number dependence during sampling. By contrast, in the learning phase, we show that estimating the unnoised score by gradient descent leads to essentially the same estimator as estimating a noisy score, which suggests that the benefits of noising do not come from the learning phase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高斯目标上证明扩散采样的 2-Wasserstein 误差为 O(√(d·λmax)·log N/N)，不含条件数 κ；未调整 Langevin 与欠阻尼 Langevin 则额外带 √κ 因子。结论是去除条件数依赖来自采样阶段的时变 score 轨迹，而非加噪的训练阶段。
Motivation: 经典 score-based 采样器（Langevin 类）的收敛速率随目标协方差条件数 κ 恶化，而扩散模型实践上表现更好，但这一优势的来源缺少严格刻画。
Method: 以高斯分布为可控设定，对优化后的超参数推导 2-Wasserstein 收敛界，并用 N→∞ 的一阶渐近匹配验证谱界的 sharp 性；训练侧比较用梯度下降估计无噪 score 与估计含噪 score 的估计量。
Result: 扩散过程采样误差 O(√(d·λmax)·log N/N)，d 为维度、N 为采样步数、λmax 为目标协方差最大特征值；未调整与欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学额外多出 √κ 因子（κ 为条件数）。谱界由 N→∞ 的匹配一阶渐近确认为 sharp；训练阶段无噪 score 估计量与含噪 score 估计量本质相同。
Conclusion: 在高斯设定下，条件数依赖的消除由采样时的时变 score 轨迹带来，加噪的收益不来自学习阶段。

papers.title: Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EUA-Cal 把训练早期的模型当作不确定性锚点：用早期预测正则保留早期预测不确定性，用原型结构正则利用早期特征空间中的不确定性，联合抑制训练/微调导致的过度自信。在图像分类与多选问答、覆盖八个不同模型的实验中，其校准效果优于现有校准方法。
Motivation: 训练或微调后期精度提升有限，却显著抬高校准误差；早期模型保有的不确定性感知会随继续训练逐渐丢失，深度网络（含 LLM）因此趋于过度自信。
Method: 提出 EUA-Cal（Early model as an Uncertainty Anchor for Calibration）：以早期模型为锚，加入早期预测正则以保留早期预测不确定性，并加入原型结构正则以利用早期特征空间反映的不确定性，两者联合缓解过度自信。
Result: 在图像分类与多选问答两类任务、八个不同模型上的大量实验中，EUA-Cal 优于 state-of-the-art 校准方法；论文观察到后期训练/微调只带来边际精度增益却大幅增加校准误差。

papers.title: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MPGE 为冻结的分子图分类器统一生成三种解释视角：事实支撑 (factual/PT)、反事实敏感性 (CF) 与样本容忍度 (EXE)，共享约束形式化但分目标求解。在 GCN 上于 MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD、BBBP 评测：事实掩码平均仅保留 8.6%–15.5% 输入边，有界反事实覆盖 4.8%–67.6%，样本保留覆盖 98.9%–100.0%。
Motivation: GNN 分子性质预测的准确率不解释单个决策如何由图信息支撑；紧凑的保预测 rationale 也说不清哪些改动会翻转决策、哪些修改模型能容忍。
Method: MPGE 统一 factual、counterfactual、exemplar 三视角：PT 求保留同标签同置信度的紧凑边集，CF 求有界的改预测删除，EXE 求有界的非平凡保标签删除；共享约束形式化连接预测行为、紧凑度与编辑代价，分目标求解。将 CF-GNNExplainer 扩展到图分类，学习对称边排序并验证离散候选、记录失败搜索；另有返回 RDKit 净化分子的 BBBP fragment 后端。
Result: 在 MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD、BBBP 上用 semantic coverage、conditional quality、stability、runtime 评测主 GCN 实现：成功事实掩码平均保留输入边的 8.6%–15.5%；有界反事实覆盖 4.8%–67.6%；样本保留覆盖 98.9%–100.0%。探索性对照显示硬投影与保留节点信息的影响。
Conclusion: 三种视角可量化模型的支撑、敏感性与容忍度，但作者明确不把这些解释当作已验证的化学机制。

papers.title: Efficient and Generalizable Archetypal Analysis for Discrete Data
papers.abstract_en: Archetypal Analysis (AA) represents observations as convex combinations of extremal data-driven profiles, yielding interpretable low-dimensional descriptions of complex datasets. Classical AA relies on a least-squares objective, which is poorly suited to discrete observations such as binary, count, and categorical data. We introduce an efficient likelihood-based framework for AA supporting Bernoulli, Poisson, and multinomial observation models. Our optimization scheme employs local quadratic approximations of the negative log-likelihood, enabling constrained updates through sequential minimal optimization (SMO) and an active-set method. Scalability is improved by bounding the active set while preserving simplex feasibility. We further introduce a cross-validated predictive likelihood criterion for selecting the number of archetypes, providing a principled alternative to reconstruction-error heuristics and stability-based diagnostics. Synthetic experiments demonstrate computational efficiency and accurate recovery of model complexity. Applications to single-cell RNA sequencing, microbiome composition, and somatic mutation data show that the learned archetypes capture interpretable domain-specific structures while achieving competitive likelihood fits and stable solutions. Overall, the proposed framework enables efficient likelihood-based archetypal analysis of discrete data, complemented by predictive likelihood-based model selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Archetypal Analysis (AA) 的最小二乘目标换成似然框架，支持 Bernoulli、Poisson、 multinomial 三类离散观测，并用负对数似然的局部二次近似配合 SMO 与 active-set 做约束更新。合成实验显示计算高效且能准确恢复模型复杂度，在单细胞 RNA 测序、微生物组组成与体细胞突变数据上学到的 archetype 可解释、似然拟合有竞争力且解稳定。
Motivation: 经典 AA 用最小二乘目标，对二值、计数、类别这类离散观测不合适；archetype 数目又多依赖重构误差或稳定性启发式，缺少有原则的模型选择依据。
Method: 提出基于似然的 AA 框架，观测模型为 Bernoulli、Poisson 与 multinomial；优化用负对数似然的局部二次近似，通过 sequential minimal optimization (SMO) 与 active-set 方法执行约束更新，并对 active set 加界以提升可扩展性、同时保持 simplex 可行性；archetype 数目用交叉验证的预测似然 (predictive likelihood) 准则选择。
Result: 合成实验表明该框架计算高效并能准确恢复模型复杂度；在单细胞 RNA 测序、微生物组组成和体细胞突变数据上，学到的 archetype 捕获可解释的领域结构，似然拟合有竞争力且解稳定。
Conclusion: 离散数据的 AA 应当直接在似然上优化，并用预测似然而非重构误差启发式来选 archetype 数目，这样既高效又给出有原则的模型选择。

papers.title: Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Robotic systems operating over extended tasks must maintain a world state assembled from observations arriving at different times, with varying confidence and potential revisions. Conventional representations emphasize latest estimates, hindering fact provenance, decision reproduction, or execution auditing. We present Traceable World State (TWS), a middleware-neutral semantic representation and reference runtime for provenance-aware robot world state. A TWS snapshot captures entities, relations, observations, confidence, and revision metadata. Validated update operations transform snapshots immutably, ordered updates support deterministic replay, and a canonical SHA-256 hash chain ensures tamper-evident logs. We evaluate TWS through schema conformance, complete state lifecycles, deterministic replay, and fault injection. Passing 38 tests across Python 3.10-3.14, the framework detects record corruptions, broken hash links, sequence discontinuities, and world mismatches. Across ten public BEHAVIOR-1K task definitions, TWS imported 153 entities and 146 relations with successful validation. On 103 NVIDIA Unitree G1 simulated trajectories containing 78,369 frames, TWS achieved exact terminal-state replay in all episodes and detected 412/412 injected corruptions with a 1.72% storage overhead over Plain JSONL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Traceable World State (TWS)，面向机器人长任务的可溯源世界状态：快照记录实体、关系、观测、置信度与修订元数据，经校验的更新操作不可变地变换快照，有序更新支持确定性重放，SHA-256 哈希链保证篡改可检测。在 103 条 NVIDIA Unitree G1 仿真轨迹（78,369 帧）上全部实现终端状态精确重放，412/412 注入损坏全被检出，存储开销比 Plain JSONL 高 1.72%。
Motivation: 机器人长任务的世界状态由不同时刻、不同置信度且可能被修订的观测拼成，常规表示只保留最新估计，事实来源、决策复现与执行审计都难以追溯。
Method: TWS 是中间件无关的语义表示与参考运行时：快照含实体、关系、观测、置信度与修订元数据，经校验的更新操作对快照做不可变变换，有序更新支持确定性重放，规范 SHA-256 哈希链构成防篡改日志；评测覆盖 schema 一致性、完整状态生命周期、确定性重放与故障注入。
Result: Python 3.10–3.14 上通过 38 项测试，可检出记录损坏、哈希链断裂、序号不连续与世界状态不匹配；十个公开 BEHAVIOR-1K 任务定义中成功导入 153 个实体与 146 个关系；103 条 NVIDIA Unitree G1 仿真轨迹共 78,369 帧，全部片段实现终端状态精确重放，412/412 注入损坏被检出，存储开销较 Plain JSONL 高 1.72%。
Conclusion: 把来源与修订元数据、不可变更新和哈希链放进世界状态表示，可在极低存储开销下同时做到确定性重放与篡改可检测。

papers.title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HWAM 把人形机器人执行后的本体感受状态作为显式预测目标，与参考动作联合生成，从而把层级式 VLA/WAM 中的参考-执行差距 (action-execution gap) 纳入动作学习。三条条件路径（Policy、FDM、IDM）分别对齐部署条件、视觉结果与关节轨迹。在 LimX OLI 实体人形机器人的三个任务上成功率最高，Candy Picking 达 70.6%，对比 Fast-WAM 的 43.3%。
Motivation: 层级人形系统中策略输出的参考动作要经全身控制、动力学、平衡与接触才被执行，产生参考-执行差距；不显式建模已执行身体状态时，未来视觉预测必须同时解释场景演化与该差距，难以把动作与其物理结果对应。
Method: HWAM 联合生成参考动作与其已执行的身体状态（关节状态-动作联合生成），训练走三条互补条件路径：Policy 路径仅以当前观测为条件联合去噪状态-动作轨迹以匹配部署条件；Forward Dynamics Modeling (IDM 之外的 FDM) 以动作和执行后状态为条件预测未来视觉观测；Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) 从视觉过渡重建关节轨迹。
Result: 在 LimX OLI 实体人形机器人的三个真实任务上，HWAM 成功率在所评估基线中最高；Candy Picking 成功率 70.6%，Fast-WAM 为 43.3%。
Conclusion: 把已执行身体状态作为动作学习的显式预测目标，并用三条条件路径把策略参考、实际身体运动与视觉结果连起来，可在实体人形操作上提高成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: InterviewPlayground: A Simulation Environment for Evaluating AI Interviewers
papers.abstract_en: Increasingly, AI interviewers are being developed to elicit open-ended responses in applications like market research, public polling, preference elicitation, and social science research. However, evaluating AI interviewers is challenging because they function in extended, multi-turn interactions where they must adapt to participant behaviors. To address this need, we develop InterviewPlayground, a simulation environment for evaluating AI interviewers using simulated study participants whose behaviors are grounded in social theory. Simulated studies in InterviewPlayground produce an InterviewReportCard, which assesses the performance of AI interviewers using a suite of validated measures. To test whether our simulation-based evaluations predict performance with human participants, we conduct 15 real qualitative studies with five AI interviewers, three interview topics, and 450 human participants and compare them to simulated studies in InterviewPlayground. We find that AI interviewer performance in InterviewPlayground predicts performance in human studies with an average Pearson correlation of 0.86 across 12 measures, and the simulated interactions from InterviewPlayground reproduce key findings from behavioral analysis of AI interviewers in the human studies. Together, these findings support the validity of InterviewPlayground in assessing AI interviewer performance and examining potential failure modes. Our work contributes a simulation environment for AI interviewers supported with empirical validation, and more broadly, a roadmap for future work to develop validated, simulation-based evaluations of conversational AI systems.

papers.title: Examining Social Attribution in LLM Reasoning: A Theory-Guided Probing Methodology
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems where social attribution, the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents' social behaviors, plays a critical role. These processes involve judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and cognition through Attribution Theory, social attribution remains underexplored in AI, particularly LLM social reasoning. This paper provides the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs' judgments and their underlying internal mechanisms. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. Some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建社会归因基准 SAB-Bench（Vignette 与 Reality 两个子集，共 7,639 道责任/归咎判断题），评测 32 个 LLM 与 5 个非 LLM 基线，并用基于归因理论的 probing 方法检查隐藏层中 5 个归因维度的可解码性。发现 LLM 与人类判断的一致性可测但不完整，且随模型规模增大而正向提升；部分归因维度可从特定隐藏状态位置解码，其对判断的影响方向与人类归因理论一致。
Motivation: 归因理论在社会心理学中已成熟，但 LLM 的社会推理，特别是把外部事件归因于行动者责任与归咎的过程，在 AI 中几乎未被系统研究，缺少可评测的基准与对内部机制的检验手段。
Method: 以 Attribution Theory 为指导构建社会归因基准：Vignette 子集取归因理论研究中的经典情境，Reality 子集取真实社会叙事，合计 7,639 道责任/归咎判断题；在此之上评测 32 个代表性 LLM 与 5 个基础非 LLM 基线，并开发 probing 方法分析 5 个关键归因维度在潜空间表征中的可解码位置及其对判断的影响是否与人类归因一致。
Result: 在 7,639 道题、32 个 LLM 与 5 个非 LLM 基线上，LLM 与人类责任/归咎判断呈可测但不完整的一致性，且一致性与模型规模正相关；部分归因维度可从 LLM 隐藏状态的特定位置系统解码，其对最终判断的影响与人类 Attribution Theory 所指示的方向一致。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 已具备部分对齐人类的社会归因能力，但这种对齐不完整且依赖模型规模；归因维度在隐藏状态中存在位置特异的可解码表征，其作用方向与人类归因理论相符。数据与代码见 github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench。

papers.title: CausalDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models with Latent Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: World models for control must capture which aspects of the environment respond to the agent's actions and which are relevant to reward. Generative world models such as Dreamer 4 consist of a video tokenizer, which encodes each frame into a latent, and a dynamics model, which is pretrained to predict future latents from past latents and actions. Yet the tokenizer is trained with a reconstruction objective, without action or reward supervision, so its latent provides no explicit mechanism to separate controllable, uncontrollable, reward-relevant, and reward-irrelevant information. We propose \textit{CausalDreamer}, which keeps the tokenizer frozen and re-encodes its latent into a factored representation of four groups along two axes: controllability, where only the two controllable groups receive the action, and reward relevance, learned by predicting the reward from the two reward-relevant groups. The pretrained dynamics model is then fine-tuned to predict the factored representation. We evaluate \textit{CausalDreamer} and the pretrained world model it starts from with model-predictive planning on 20 MMBench2 tasks: 10 clean tasks seen during training and 10 unseen tasks, of which 6 are manipulated variants of clean tasks with a changed background, object, or maze layout, and 4 are new environments. We normalize returns so that a policy taking uniformly random actions scores 0 and an expert scores 1. \textit{CausalDreamer} achieves a 14\% higher normalized score than the pretrained world model on the clean tasks (0.199 vs.\ 0.175) and a 25\% higher score on the manipulated variants (0.307 vs.\ 0.246), while neither model scores meaningfully above the random policy in the new environments. Additionally, our analysis shows that the factored representation separates reward-irrelevant changes, such as a changed background, from its reward-relevant groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalDreamer 把冻结的视频 tokenizer 潜变量重编码为沿可控性与奖励相关性两个轴分解的四组表示，只给可控组喂动作、用奖励预测学出奖励相关组，再微调预训练 dynamics model 预测该分解表示。在 MMBench2 的 20 个任务上做 model-predictive planning，干净任务归一化得分比原世界模型高 14%（0.199 vs 0.175），改背景/物体/迷宫的变体高 25%（0.307 vs 0.246），新环境两者都不显著高于随机策略。
Motivation: Dreamer 4 类生成式世界模型的 tokenizer 只用重建目标训练，没有动作或奖励监督，其潜变量缺少区分可控/不可控、奖励相关/无关信息的显式机制，规划时容易把与奖励无关的变化当成状态信号。
Method: 冻结预训练 tokenizer，把每帧潜变量重编码为沿可控性与奖励相关性两轴分解的四组表示；仅两个可控组接收动作，两个奖励相关组通过预测 reward 学习；随后微调预训练 dynamics model，使其预测这一分解表示而非原始潜变量。
Result: 在 MMBench2 的 20 个任务（10 个训练见过的干净任务、10 个未见任务，其中 6 个是改背景/物体/迷宫布局的变体、4 个是全新环境）上做 model-predictive planning，归一化得分以随机策略为 0、专家为 1：干净任务 0.199 vs 0.175（高 14%），操纵变体 0.307 vs 0.246（高 25%）；新环境中两个模型都不显著高于随机策略。分析显示分解表示能把背景变化这类奖励无关因素与奖励相关组分开。
Conclusion: 在 tokenizer 潜变量上显式分解可控性与奖励相关性，能提升世界模型在见过任务及其扰动变体上的规划得分，但对全新环境无效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PulseBound: Future-Beat State Forecasting Under an Explicit Information Boundary
papers.abstract_en: Predictive representation learning from photoplethysmography (PPG) can violate causal information access even with causal attention, as normalization, nonlocal transforms, or companion views may depend on withheld samples. We introduce PulseBound, a PPG representation learner combining physiologically structured future-beat prediction with an explicit stored-window information boundary. A content-independent cutoff separates the visible prefix from the prediction target. Prefix-only normalization, suffix replacement before derived-view construction, and aligned masking ensure that encoder inputs depend only on the visible prefix and cutoff. This yields stored-suffix invariance: with fixed model state, randomness, prefix, and cutoff, changing the stored suffix cannot change the forecast context. A shared horizon-conditioned head predicts nine rhythm and morphology descriptors for up to four extractor-valid future beats, using elementwise validity masks; optional ECG-derived pulse-arrival-time supervision is restricted to training. On MIMIC and VitalDB groups held out from PulseBound backbone pretraining, PulseBound reduces nine-state transformed-space MAE relative to last-visible-beat persistence by 28.06% and 22.22%, respectively, with gains in MAE, MAE-Skill, and Spearman correlation across all 40 source-cutoff-horizon cells. In a separate comparison of seven models on 13 downstream tasks, PulseBound achieves the best mean on nine frozen linear-probe and seven full-fine-tuning tasks. Stored-suffix interventions cause zero recorded changes in forecast contexts or predictions, with zero suffix-input gradients at audited precision under the stored-window interface. These findings separate three testable aspects of predictive physiological representation learning: information access, supervised future structure, and transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PulseBound 为 PPG 预测式表征学习设定显式存储窗信息边界：内容无关 cutoff 切分可见前缀与预测目标，前缀归一化、后缀替换与对齐掩码保证编码器输入只依赖前缀，从而得到 stored-suffix invariance——固定模型状态、随机性、前缀与 cutoff 时改动存储后缀不改变预报上下文。在 MIMIC 与 VitalDB 上，九状态变换空间 MAE 相对 last-visible-beat persistence 分别降低 28.06% 与 22.22%。
Motivation: PPG 上的预测式表征学习即使用因果注意力也可能泄漏被扣留样本：归一化、nonlocal 变换或伴生视图都可能依赖后缀，破坏因果信息访问。
Method: 内容无关 cutoff 分离可见前缀与目标；仅前缀归一化、构造派生视图前先做后缀替换、对齐掩码，使编码器输入只依赖前缀与 cutoff；共享 horizon-conditioned head 用逐元素有效性掩码预测最多四个 extractor-valid 未来心拍的九个节律与形态描述子，可选 ECG 派生 pulse-arrival-time 监督仅限训练期。
Result: 在 PulseBound backbone 预训练中留出的 MIMIC 与 VitalDB 组上，九状态变换空间 MAE 相对 last-visible-beat persistence 分别降低 28.06% 与 22.22%，且在全部 40 个 source-cutoff-horizon 单元上 MAE、MAE-Skill 与 Spearman 相关均有提升；七个模型在 13 个下游任务对比中，PulseBound 在九个冻结线性探测与七个全微调任务上取得最佳均值；存储后缀干预在审计精度下产生零次预报上下文或预测变化，后缀输入梯度为零。
Conclusion: 把信息访问、有监督的未来结构与迁移三者分开检验是可行的：显式存储窗接口能在不牺牲下游迁移的前提下消除后缀泄漏。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Ghost tasking for parametrized Gaussian Processes solving linear differential equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed machine learning has gained significant attention in recent years. In regimes of limited data, parametrized Gaussian processes have become popular. Existing approaches, however, often face limitations, such as requiring parametrizable (also called controllable) systems or a large number of output tasks. In this work, we introduce a systematic procedure we call "ghost tasking", using auxiliary tasks to circumvent these limitations. We prove that such ghost tasks can render any non-parametrizable system effectively parametrizable, enabling algorithmic construction of parametrized Gaussian Processes while keeping the number of required tasks (i.e. output dimensions) and latent functions low. We find that ghost tasking performs especially well in an inverse problem setting, even with very few available data. We show the usage and power of ghost tasking in three experiments, providing systematic comparisons to the only other currently available method applicable to all experiments. We provide necessary syntax and explications for two computer algebra programs that compute parametrizations for systems with polynomial or rational coefficients. Our theoretical results extend to systems with meromorphic functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ghost tasking：用辅助任务（ghost tasks）把不可参数化的线性微分方程系统变成有效可参数化的系统，从而在输出维度和潜函数数量都很低的前提下构造参数化 Gaussian Process。证明该构造对任意非参数化系统成立，理论结果进一步覆盖亚纯函数系统；在三个实验中与目前唯一可覆盖全部实验的方法做系统对比，逆问题设定下数据极少时表现尤其好。
Motivation: 数据受限下的 physics-informed 参数化 GP 现有方法要么要求系统本身可参数化（可控），要么需要大量输出任务，限制了适用范围与成本。
Method: ghost tasking 通过引入辅助任务绕开上述限制，给出系统化流程以算法方式构造参数化 GP，并保持所需任务数（输出维度）与潜函数数低；另提供两个计算机代数程序的语法与说明，用于计算多项式或有理系数系统的参数化，理论结果推广到亚纯函数系统。
Result: 证明 ghost task 可使任意非参数化系统有效可参数化；三个实验中与目前唯一适用于全部实验的方法做系统对比，逆问题设定下即使可用数据极少也表现尤其好；理论结果扩展到亚纯函数系统。
Conclusion: 辅助任务是让参数化 GP 覆盖非参数化系统的通用构造手段，在数据稀少的逆问题中收益最大。

papers.title: Complexity of Grounded Semantics and Preferred Semantics in Finitary Argumentation Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: Abstract argumentation frameworks (AFs) introduced by Dung provide a formal foundation for non-monotonic reasoning in artificial intelligence. While decision problems for general infinite AFs typically reside at high levels of the analytical hierarchy ($Σ_1^1$ or $Π_1^1$), restricting the framework to be computably finitary reduces some of the complexity to the arithmetical hierarchy. In this paper, we present a complexity mapping of grounded and preferred semantics in computably finitary AFs across standard decision problems: credulous acceptance ($\Cred$), skeptical acceptance ($\Skep$), extension existence ($\Ex$), uniqueness ($\Uni$), and non-empty existence ($\NE$). For grounded semantics, credulous and skeptical acceptance are already known to be $Σ_1^0$-complete. We show that non-empty existence is also $Σ_1^0$-complete, whereas existence and uniqueness are trivial. These classifications are understood within the domain of valid computably finitary representations. For preferred semantics, using a computably finitely branching computation tree, $\Cred_{\pref}$ is shown to be in $Π_1^0$-c and $\NE_{\pref}$ is $Σ_2^0$-c. However, it is insufficient to reduce universal quantification and global uniqueness, leaving $\Skep_{\pref}$ in $Π_1^1$ and $\UniPref$ in $Σ_2^1$-c. Our results show the precise boundary where finitarity succeeds to bring reasoning down to the arithmetical hierarchy and where second-order quantification forces problems back into the analytical hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可计算有穷 (computably finitary) 抽象论证框架上给出 grounded 与 preferred 两种语义在五个判定问题上的复杂度映射：grounded 侧非空存在 (NE) 也是 Σ₁⁰-完全，而存在与唯一性平凡；preferred 侧 Cred 属于 Π₁⁰、NE 为 Σ₂⁰-完全，但 Skep 仍落在 Π₁¹、唯一性为 Σ₂¹-完全。结论是：有穷性只能把部分推理压进算术层级，一旦涉及全称量化与全局唯一性，二阶量化就把问题推回分析层级。
Motivation: 一般无穷 AF 的判定问题位于分析层级高位 (Σ₁¹ 或 Π₁¹)，把框架限制为可计算有穷后复杂度会降到算术层级，但哪些问题真的降下来、哪些降不下来，此前缺少系统刻画。
Method: 对 computably finitary AF 建立 grounded 与 preferred 语义在 Cred、Skep、Ex、Uni、NE 五个标准判定问题上的复杂度分类；preferred 语义用 computably finitely branching 计算树给出上界归约，并区分有效 computably finitary 表示这一前提。
Result: grounded：Cred 与 Skep 已知 Σ₁⁰-完全，本文证明 NE 也是 Σ₁⁰-完全，Ex 与 Uni 平凡。preferred：Cred 属于 Π₁⁰-完全，NE 为 Σ₂⁰-完全；Skep 留在 Π₁¹，UniPref 为 Σ₂¹-完全。
Conclusion: 有穷性把 grounded 全部与 preferred 的部分判定问题压进算术层级，但全称量化与全局唯一性使 Skep 与 Uni 必须回到分析层级，这构成 finitarity 有效与失效的精确边界。

papers.title: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 as Spotlight. Project page: https://react-vla.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REACT 用滚动去噪 (rolling denoising) 改写 flow-based VLA 的分块控制：维护带错位 flow 时间步的持久动作缓冲，每步用最新观测去噪整个时域，只执行最干净的一块，前移部分精化的未来块并在尾部补新噪声，使每个执行块在部署前经过多次近期观测的精化。在 RoboTwin 2.0 仿真与多平台真实双臂操作/动态控制任务上，相比频繁重规划与异步基线，任务成功率提高、反应延迟降低、轨迹更平滑。
Motivation: flow-based VLA 的分块控制存在闭环权衡：长动作块执行平滑但反应迟钝，频繁重规划提高反应性却带来动作不连续，需要在保留长时域上下文的同时提高重规划频率。
Method: 滚动去噪框架：持久动作缓冲加错位 flow timesteps，每个控制步用最新观测对整个时域去噪，执行最干净动作块、前移部分精化的未来块、尾部追加新噪声；另加 dual decoupling，把感知、VLM 编码、DiT 去噪与动作执行解耦，以在实际算力下支持高频观测更新与动作流式输出。
Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 仿真基准与覆盖双臂操作和动态控制的多机器人平台真实任务上，REACT 相比频繁重规划 (frequent-replanning) 与异步 (asynchronous) 基线同时提高任务成功率、降低反应延迟，并产生更平滑的轨迹。
Conclusion: 不必在长时域上下文与高频重规划之间二选一：滚动去噪加感知-编码-去噪-执行解耦能让 flow-based VLA 既反应快又保持平滑。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Test-Time Compute for Tabular Foundation Models: Mechanisms, Gains, and Limits
papers.abstract_en: Which forms of test-time compute improve the predictions of strong pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs)? We systematically study this along three axes: adaptation, aggregation, and context construction. Our evaluation spans modern TFMs across the TabArena benchmark, supplemented by experiments on wide and large-scale tables from OpenML. For adaptation, we introduce DiagScale, a diagonal query-key similarity update. It trains only 0.003-0.03% of model parameters and achieves gains comparable to full fine-tuning across three independently pretrained backbones. For aggregation, both pool composition and selection strategy matter. TabPFN-3 already averages predictions from different preprocessing variants of the same data, and adding more such predictions yields diminishing returns. With a broader pool of 96 configurations, greedy selection reduces error by 2.4% relative to the default predictor, but uniform averaging increases error. For context construction, attention-guided retrieval improves TabPFN-3's predictions on some large tables and supports source pools beyond the full context memory limit. The context expansion methods we test yield no consistent improvement. Taken together, our results suggest that adaptation and selective aggregation yield consistent benchmark-level gains. The benefits of context construction depend more on the task and data regime. Adaptation and aggregation over the same backbone yield further gains when combined, but require substantially more computation than default inference. These trade-offs motivate choosing strategies according to the available computation budget. Code is available at https://github.com/kanghui-learning/test-time-compute-for-tabular-foundation-models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统考察表格基础模型 (TFM) 的三类 test-time compute：adaptation、aggregation、context construction。DiagScale 只训 0.003–0.03% 参数即可在三个独立预训练 backbone 上取得与全量微调相当的增益；96 个配置的贪心选择使误差相对默认预测器降 2.4%，而均匀平均反而升误差；context 扩展方法无一致改善。作者据此建议按可用算力预算选策略。
Motivation: 强预训练表格基础模型在推理阶段该花多少计算、花在哪一类机制上缺乏系统对照，adaptation、aggregation、context construction 三条路径的收益与代价边界不清。
Method: 沿三条轴做系统研究：adaptation 引入 DiagScale（对角 query-key 相似度更新，仅训 0.003–0.03% 参数），在三个独立预训练 backbone 上与全量微调对比；aggregation 比较池组成与选择策略（贪心选择 vs 均匀平均，池含 96 个配置）；context construction 测试注意力引导检索与上下文扩展。评测用 TabArena benchmark，并在 OpenML 的宽表与大规模表上补充实验。
Result: DiagScale 训 0.003–0.03% 参数，增益与全量微调相当，跨三个独立预训练 backbone；96 配置池上贪心选择相对默认预测器降误差 2.4%，均匀平均升误差；TabPFN-3 已对同一数据的不同预处理变体取平均，再加预测收益递减；注意力引导检索在部分大表上改善 TabPFN-3 并支持超出全上下文记忆上限的源池，上下文扩展方法无一致改善；adaptation 与 aggregation 叠加在同 backbone 上进一步增益，但需远多于默认推理的计算。
Conclusion: adaptation 与选择性 aggregation 在 benchmark 层面带来稳定收益，context construction 的收益取决于任务与数据 regime，策略应按可用计算预算选择。

papers.title: The Polytopal Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how deep neural networks process information remains a central challenge. Existing interpretability methods often compromise structural fidelity, rely on prespecified corpora, or explain models post-hoc. We propose Polytopal Neural Networks (PNNs), a framework that extracts distinct layer-wise aspects by enforcing a polytope-based structure that is used directly in subsequent information processing. We scale our approach using learned corpus representations and an amortized simplex inference procedure and highlight how the framework also gives a direct route to vector quantized (VQ) training. In PNNs, observations are explicitly described by their alignment with layer-specific aspects. Empirical results show that imposing polytopal constraints on neural network representations preserves meaningful structures in the latent space with minimal degradation in performance, favorable compressed representations when compared to VQ representations in unsupervised learning, while also providing a performant new approach to VQ deep learning training. Our findings suggest that deep networks can enforce interpretable polytope-based representations, offering a principled path toward more transparent AI systems with minimal performance compromise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Polytopal Neural Network (PNN)：用多面体结构约束网络各层表示，使观测由其与层专属 aspect 的对齐显式描述，并把该结构直接用于后续信息处理。施加多面体约束后潜空间结构得以保留、性能损失极小，压缩表示优于无监督学习中的 VQ 表示，同时给出一种高效的 VQ 深度学习训练途径。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法会牺牲结构保真、依赖预设语料，或只做事后 (post-hoc) 解释，无法在网络内部直接形成可解释表示。
Method: PNN 通过多面体 (polytope) 结构约束逐层提取互异的 aspect，并将其直接接入后续信息处理；用 learned corpus representations 扩展规模，推理走 amortized simplex inference，并由此得到一条 vector quantized (VQ) 训练的直接路径。
Result: 实证结果显示：多面体约束在潜空间保留有意义结构且性能退化极小；相较 VQ 表示在无监督学习中给出更有利的压缩表示；同时构成一种 performant 的 VQ 深度学习训练新方法。
Conclusion: 深度网络可以强制形成可解释的多面体表示，在几乎不牺牲性能的前提下走向更透明的 AI 系统。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: An Interpretable Approach to PDE Solution Discovery via Structural Experience Distillation
papers.abstract_en: PDE solution discovery aims to identify explicit symbolic expressions for unknown physical fields from observations under known physical constraints. Existing methods, however, collapse data fidelity and physical consistency into a single terminal score used as the sole feedback signal, providing little information about which subexpressions are responsible for a candidate's final performance. This opaque terminal feedback severely limits the interpretability of the search process itself, offering no insight into why a candidate succeeds or fails. Consequently, reusable structures in otherwise suboptimal candidates are often discarded, whereas incidental syntax along successful search trajectories may be repeatedly reinforced. We propose SED-MCTS, a Monte Carlo tree search approach that distills structural experience from evaluated expressions and reuses it to guide subsequent symbolic solution search. Through counterfactual subtree interventions, SED-MCTS estimates local structural contributions, routes reliable evidence to the responsible construction edges, and preserves useful components in a refined structural archive. The approach naturally extends to coupled multiphysics systems. Across a diverse suite of PDE benchmarks, SED-MCTS achieves strong performance under a fixed evaluation budget and improves search efficiency and robustness under noisy or scarce observations.

papers.title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
papers.abstract_en: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentic-TTT 把 test-time training (TTT) 各算法封装成可调用工具，学习一个测试时策略来决定何时做 TTT、调用哪个算法、能否复用已有技能，并用决策带来的效用增益训练该策略。在作者的 benchmark 上，该策略相对 backbone 模型把 utility 提升近一倍，学会在效用与算力之间权衡，并能泛化到训练中未见的领域。
Motivation: TTT 并非普适有益：不同算法适用场景不同，选错方法会浪费测试时算力甚至损害模型性能，因此参数级自我改进需要模型自己判断何时、用哪种 TTT。
Method: 将 TTT 流程转为可调用工具 (callable tools)，把累积技能视为不断演化的部署环境，并依据决策观测到的效用增益 (utility gains) 训练测试时策略，由策略决定是否触发 TTT、选择算法与技能复用。
Result: 在作者的 benchmark 上，Agentic-TTT 的 utility 接近 backbone 模型的两倍；策略学会在 utility 与 compute 之间权衡，并泛化到训练期间未见过的领域。
Conclusion: 参数级自我改进需要 agency：让模型自主决定如何从部署经验中学习，可带来接近翻倍的效用并保持跨域泛化。

papers.title: Neural Network Verification for Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding
papers.abstract_en: Deep joint source-channel coding (DeepJSCC) transmits data end-to-end over wireless channels using a neural encoder-decoder, but reconstruction quality can degrade sharply under adversarial perturbations and channel disturbances; no method formally bounds this degradation for DeepJSCC. We present the first bound-propagation framework for verifying DeepJSCC's decoder, bounding worst-case reconstruction error over a given wireless channel's noise region. Current deep neural network (DNN) verifiers do not support three DeepJSCC decoder components: parametric rectified linear activations (PReLU), transposed convolutions, and Rayleigh fading. We extend state-of-the-art techniques for optimization of linear relaxation in DNN verification for PReLU, replace the transposed convolution with its restricted upsample-then-convolution form, and formulate Rayleigh fading as a structural perturbation prepended directly into the decoder, thereby reducing the dimensionality of the verification problem. We also instantiate Lipschitz-regularized global robustness training, denoted GloRo, improving global robustness and enabling tight certification of DeepJSCC models for the first time. On DeepJSCC model for image transmission, this global robustness training procedure combined with structural encoding lowers the median certified bound by up to 41% and certifies about ten times more safe cases (192 against 19) than GloRo with interval encoding at a 10-degree error in channel estimation. Over-the-air validation with an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) implementation on software-defined radio devices confirm the certificate holds on real hardware, with a worst observed error on radio link at 0.082 against a certified bound of 0.128.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个针对 DeepJSCC 解码器的 bound-propagation 验证框架，在给定无线信道噪声区域上给出最坏重建误差的形式化上界，并首次实现对 DeepJSCC 模型的紧致认证。扩展线性松弛优化以支持 PReLU、把转置卷积改写为 upsample-then-convolution、将 Rayleigh 衰落作为结构化扰动前置进解码器以降低验证维度，再配合 Lipschitz 正则的全局鲁棒训练 GloRo。在图像传输 DeepJSCC 上，全局鲁棒训练加结构化编码把中位认证上界最多降低 41%，信道估计误差 10 度时认证安全样本约 10 倍（192 对 19）；OFDM 软件无线电实测最坏误差 0.082，低于认证上界 0.128。
Motivation: DeepJSCC 端到端无线传输在对抗扰动与信道扰动下重建质量会急剧下降，而现有方法无法为 DeepJSCC 给出形式化的退化上界；现有 DNN 验证器也不支持 PReLU、转置卷积与 Rayleigh 衰落这三个解码器组件。
Method: 对线性松弛优化的 SOTA 技术做扩展以覆盖 PReLU；把转置卷积替换为其受限的 upsample-then-convolution 形式；把 Rayleigh 衰落表述为前置进解码器的结构化扰动，从而降低验证问题维度；并实例化 Lipschitz 正则的全局鲁棒训练 GloRo，用于提升全局鲁棒性并实现紧致认证。
Result: 在图像传输 DeepJSCC 模型上，全局鲁棒训练加结构化编码使中位认证上界最多降低 41%，在信道估计误差 10 度 (10-degree error in channel estimation) 下认证约 10 倍的安全样本（192 对 19，对比 GloRo 加 interval encoding）。基于 OFDM 的软件无线电 (SDR) 空口验证中，实测最坏误差 0.082，低于认证上界 0.128。
Conclusion: DeepJSCC 的最坏重建误差可以被形式化认证，且结构化编码与全局鲁棒训练能把上界收紧到可在真实射频硬件上成立的水平。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DataVista 是首个数据视频理解基准，含 961 个真实数据视频与 6,775 道评测题，按数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解三级能力框架组织，覆盖 10 个细粒度题型与 5 个主题领域。对 19 个主流 MLLM 的系统评测中最强的 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率 70.0%，仍远低于人类专家，Causal Reasoning 与 Narrative Structure 最差；增加帧数与加字幕主要提升数据感知和时序推理，对叙事理解增益有限。
Motivation: 数据视频把动态图表与叙事结合，要求跨图表跨时间整合证据并理解叙事组织，而现有基准只覆盖通用视频或静态图表，这一能力此前未被系统评测。
Method: 构建三级递进能力框架（数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解），下设 10 个细粒度题型、5 个主题领域，共 961 个真实数据视频与 6,775 道评测题；对 19 个主流 MLLM 做系统评测，并进一步分析模型回答以归类典型失败模式。
Result: 最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率 70.0%，仍远低于人类专家；模型在 Causal Reasoning 与 Narrative Structure 上表现最差；增加帧数与添加字幕主要改善数据感知与时序推理，对叙事理解提升有限；失败模式集中在图表读取、证据判断与指令理解。
Conclusion: 当前 MLLM 在数据视频的叙事层面明显落后于数据读取层面，且靠堆帧数和字幕补不回来，叙事理解需要新的能力路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MetaOPD: Meta-Learned Token Weighting for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using token-level teacher supervision. However, uniform weighting overlooks differences in token learning value, while existing weighting methods rely on predefined mappings from prediction signals to token weights. These mappings are not learned from the effectiveness of the resulting student updates, limiting their ability to adapt to evolving learning needs. In this paper, we propose MetaOPD, a bilevel optimization framework that jointly learns the student model and a lightweight token-weighting network. The inner objective updates the student through weighted OPD, while the outer objective optimizes the weighting network using validation loss on reference solutions after a virtual student update. Differentiating through this update connects weighting decisions to their effects on post-update performance, allowing the mapping from prediction signals to token weights to evolve alongside the student. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning and three out-of-domain datasets, covering two student scales and seven baselines, demonstrate the effectiveness of MetaOPD, with Avg@8/Pass@8 gains over OPD of 1.99/5.97 percentage points for the 0.6B student and 2.25/6.41 points for the 1.7B student.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaOPD 用双层优化同时训练学生模型和一个轻量 token 加权网络：内层按权重做 on-policy distillation 更新学生，外层在虚拟更新后用参考解的验证损失对加权网络求导，使预测信号到 token 权重的映射随学生演进。在六个数学推理与三个 out-of-domain 数据集、两个学生规模上，相对 OPD 的 Avg@8/Pass@8 提升为 0.6B 学生 1.99/5.97 个百分点、1.7B 学生 2.25/6.41 个百分点。
Motivation: on-policy distillation 对所有 token 均匀加权，忽略 token 学习价值差异；已有加权方法依赖人工预定义的预测信号到权重的映射，无法根据学生更新的实际效果自适应调整。
Method: 提出双层优化框架 MetaOPD：内层用 token 加权的 OPD 更新学生，外层以虚拟学生更新后在参考解上的验证损失优化轻量加权网络，并对这一更新过程求导，把加权决策与其对更新后性能的影响联系起来；对照七个基线，覆盖两个学生规模。
Result: 在六个数学推理数据集和三个 out-of-domain 数据集上，相对 OPD：0.6B 学生 Avg@8 提升 1.99 个百分点、Pass@8 提升 5.97 个百分点；1.7B 学生分别提升 2.25 和 6.41 个百分点。
Conclusion: 让 token 权重映射通过双层优化与学生更新效果挂钩并随之演化，可在数学推理与跨域任务上稳定优于均匀加权的 on-policy distillation。

summary_sections.result: 在六个数学推理数据集和三个 out-of-domain 数据集上，相对 OPD：0.6B 学生 Avg@8 提升 1.99 个百分点、Pass@8 提升 5.97 个百分点；1.7B 学生分别提升 2.25 和 6.41 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 让 token 权重映射通过双层优化与学生更新效果挂钩并随之演化，可在数学推理与跨域任务上稳定优于均匀加权的 on-policy distillation。

papers.title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VLM 在灾后建筑损伤评估中过度保守、几乎不报 Red 的问题，用机制可解释性定位与恐惧相关的情感方向，再以 activation steering 在推理时注入该方向。在 SeisMLLM-1K 测试集上，Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 基线只报出 27.0% 的真实不安全建筑且从不误报 Red（SDT 判据 c=+1.354，d'=1.521）；注入恐惧方向后 Red 召回升到 75.7%（p<0.001），判据翻到 c=-1.515，而 d'=-0.493 说明辨别力未提升。
Motivation: VLM 做灾后损伤评估时总体准确率看似够高，但召回率低、不愿宣布危险；需要区分这是感知能力不足还是决策判据偏移。
Method: 用信号检测理论 (SDT) 把决策分解为辨别力 d' 与判据 c；借恐惧使人规避风险的启发，在情绪丰富自然场景上定位情感方向，并用 sparse-neuron knockout 与 distributed steering 在留出情绪数据上做因果验证，再把该方向注入基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的两阶段 SeisMLLM 管线。
Result: 基线在 SeisMLLM-1K 测试集只标记 27.0% 的真实不安全建筑、从不误报 Red（c=+1.354，d'=1.521）；恐惧方向注入使 Red 召回升至 75.7%（p<0.001），减去同一方向则完全抑制 Red 预测；等范数随机方向与匹配的快乐方向无显著效应；机制是判据移动到 c=-1.515，而 d'=-0.493，辨别力未改善。
Conclusion: VLM 的危险决策判据可在推理时通过情感方向的 activation steering 直接调整而无需重训练，机制可解释性可用于诊断并控制工程应用中的 VLM 决策行为。

papers.title: Example-driven Parametrisations for Bayesian Shape Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimisation is the natural tool for shape design when objectives are expensive and non-differentiable, but it needs a compact yet expressive parameterisation of the search space. Hand-crafting one is a complex endeavour requiring domain expertise, and often yields implicit infeasible regions, artificial bounds, and coupled, unordered coordinates. We instead learn the parameterisation from a collection of existing designs, applying principal component analysis to the deformations between shapes. The result is a linear, interpretable search space in which the number of components explicitly trades expressivity against dimensionality. Across aerofoils, wings, and radio-frequency cavities, spanning 2D geometry to 3D aerodynamics and electromagnetics, we show improved sample efficiency and the ability to explore beyond the confines of hand-crafted baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把贝叶斯优化的形状搜索空间从手工参数化改为从既有设计集合中学习：对形状间的形变做 PCA，得到线性、可解释、维数可调的搜索空间。在 aerofoil、机翼与射频腔三类任务上，该学习参数化比手工基线更省样本，并能探索到手工参数化边界之外的区域。
Motivation: 昂贵且不可微的目标做形状设计时，搜索空间参数化要靠领域专家手工构造，常带来隐式不可行区域、人为边界以及耦合无序的坐标。
Method: 收集既有设计，对形状之间的形变做主成分分析 (PCA)，得到线性且可解释的搜索空间，其中主成分数目显式权衡表达力与维度；再把该参数化接入贝叶斯优化。
Result: 在 aerofoil、wing、radio-frequency cavity 三类任务上（覆盖 2D 几何到 3D 空气动力学与电磁学），相较手工参数化基线表现出更高的样本效率，并能探索到手工基线范围之外的区域。
Conclusion: 形状设计的搜索空间可以从既有设计中学习得到，用主成分数目直接控制表达力与维度的取舍，从而摆脱手工参数化的隐式约束。
Relevance: 0
