papers.title: Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Learning for Parallel MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Parallel magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction is an ill-posed inverse problem under undersampling. Multi-coil acquisition and Hankel lifting expose complementary repeated information: observations of the same anatomy across coils and repeated local k-space neighborhoods in overlapping windows. These dependencies guide recovery of missing k-space data. However, splitting lifted Hankel entries for self-supervision can place the original sample in both input and target, causing data leakage. We propose Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Reconstruction (HSSRecon), a scan-specific reconstruction framework for parallel magnetic resonance imaging. HSSRecon partitions data by physical acquisition units before Hankel lifting and applies multiplicity normalization to repeated Hankel copies in overlapping windows. Rather than learning a mapping that directly predicts missing data, the network learns a compact complex-valued Hankel subspace operator. Reconstruction is performed over the original k-space variables using a conjugategradient solver with hard data consistency. This design separates structural learning in the Hankel domain from data consistency in the physical domain: the former exploits multi-coil and local Hankel correlations, while the latter solves over unacquired degrees of freedom. We provide theoretical analyses of physicalgroup splitting and multiplicity normalization, and establish positive definiteness, uniqueness, hard data consistency, and a finite-step conjugate-gradient error bound for the system. On fastMRI brain data with three contrasts and three sampling masks, HSSRecon achieves competitive peak signal-to-noise ratio, structural similarity, and normalized mean squared error across six aggregated conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HSSRecon 是面向并行 MRI 重建的扫描内自监督框架：在 Hankel 提升前按物理采集单元切分数据以避免自监督泄漏，并对重叠窗中的重复 Hankel 拷贝做重数归一化；网络学一个紧致复值 Hankel 子空间算子，再用共轭梯度加硬数据一致性在原始 k 空间上重建。在 fastMRI 脑部数据三种对比度与三种采样掩膜共六个聚合条件下，PSNR、SSIM、NMSE 具有竞争力。
Motivation: 多线圈欠采样 MRI 是不适定逆问题；把 Hankel 提升后的条目直接拆分做自监督会把原始样本同时放进输入和目标，造成数据泄漏。
Method: HSSRecon 在 Hankel 提升前按物理采集单元分组切分，对重叠窗中重复的 Hankel 拷贝做重数归一化 (multiplicity normalization)；网络不直接预测缺失数据，而是学一个紧致复值 Hankel 子空间算子，重建在原始 k 空间变量上由共轭梯度 (conjugate gradient) 求解器配合硬数据一致性完成。作者给出物理分组切分与重数归一化的理论分析，并建立系统的正定性、唯一性、硬数据一致性以及有限步共轭梯度误差界。
Result: 在 fastMRI 脑部数据上，三种对比度、三种采样掩膜共六个聚合条件下，HSSRecon 的 PSNR、SSIM 与 NMSE 均具竞争力。
Conclusion: 把结构学习放在 Hankel 域、把数据一致性放回物理域，可以在不泄漏的前提下做扫描内自监督并行 MRI 重建，且求解器性质有理论保证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SWE-Journey: Towards More Realistic Evaluation of Coding Assistants through Long-Horizon, Multi-Turn Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex have become a major application of LLM agents, yet existing benchmarks remain far from real-world use, particularly in task horizon and interaction length. Code assistants require completing long chains of development work in continuously evolving repositories, while repeatedly clarifying requirements and adapting implementations through multi-turn interaction. To address these gaps, we introduce SWE-Journey, a benchmark for more realistic evaluation of coding assistants. To address the task-horizon gap, we propose a weak-to-strong synthesis pipeline that automatically constructs long-horizon coding tasks. To address the interaction gap, we mine four representative user personas from real interaction data and build a user-simulation agent to reproduce realistic code-assistance interactions. On average, models pass over 75% of tests for requested functionality with software architects, but fewer than 25% with non-coders. These results show that current coding assistants still fall short of enabling reliable coding for non-coders. We further analyze the reasons for this gap and identify asking right, finding right, and fixing right as key capabilities during interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Journey 是面向编码助手的长程、多轮交互基准：用弱到强合成流水线自动构造长任务链，再从真实交互数据挖掘四类用户画像并构建 user-simulation agent 复现需求澄清过程。平均而言模型在与软件架构师交互时通过所请求功能 75% 以上的测试，与非程序员交互时不足 25%，说明当前编码助手还不能让非程序员可靠地完成编码。
Motivation: 现有编码基准在任务时程与交互轮数上都远短于真实开发：真实场景需要在持续演化的仓库里完成长开发链，并反复澄清需求、调整实现。
Method: 提出弱到强 (weak-to-strong) 合成流水线自动构造长时程编码任务；从真实交互数据挖掘四类代表性用户画像 (personas)，构建 user-simulation agent 复现真实的代码辅助多轮交互，用以评测编码助手。
Result: 平均而言，模型在与软件架构师 (software architects) 交互时通过所请求功能 75% 以上的测试，而在与非程序员 (non-coders) 交互时通过率不足 25%；作者据此归纳出 asking right、finding right、fixing right 三项交互关键能力。
Conclusion: 当前编码助手在与非程序员的多轮交互中仍无法支撑可靠的编码交付，差距主要出在需求澄清与定位修复这三类交互能力上。

papers.title: Best of Both Worlds in Federated LSA: Speedup When Possible, Personalization Always
papers.abstract_en: We study personalized federated linear stochastic approximation (LSA), a framework which notably encompass personalized temporal difference learning. In this setting, heterogeneous agents collaborate to solve distinct linear fixed-point equations, each corresponding to an agent-specific learning problem. A central open question in personalized learning is whether a single method can adapt to an unknown level of heterogeneity by converging to each agent's personalized solution in all regimes while achieving a linear speedup in the number of agents when their learning problems are sufficiently similar. We answer this question affirmatively by introducing PF-LSA, a minimalist algorithm that mixes each agent's local stochastic update with the average update across agents, at no additional computational cost relative to standard federated methods. We prove that PF-LSA, achieves best-of-both-worlds guarantees without any prior knowledge on the level of heterogeneity. Our analysis is based on a sharp decomposition of the error into consensus and disagreement components. The consensus error decays rapidly, whereas the disagreement error decays more slowly but becomes negligible in low-heterogeneity regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PF-LSA：把每个 agent 的局部随机更新与跨 agent 平均更新混合，在无需事先知道异质性水平的情况下同时获得两种保证——异质性低时随 agent 数线性加速，异质性高时仍收敛到各自的个性化解。误差被分解为 consensus 与 disagreement 两部分，前者快速衰减，后者衰减较慢但在低异质性 regime 中可忽略。
Motivation: 个性化联邦学习的核心未决问题：能否用单一方法自适应未知的异质性水平，在所有 regime 都收敛到各 agent 的个性化解，同时在学习问题足够相似时取得随 agent 数的线性加速。
Method: PF-LSA 将每个 agent 的局部随机更新与跨 agent 平均更新做混合，相对标准联邦方法不增加计算开销；框架涵盖个性化 temporal difference learning 等线性不动点方程问题。分析基于把误差锐利分解为 consensus 与 disagreement 分量。
Result: 证明 PF-LSA 在无需任何异质性先验知识下取得 best-of-both-worlds 保证：consensus 误差快速衰减，disagreement 误差衰减较慢但在低异质性 regime 中变得可忽略，从而在问题足够相似时获得随 agent 数的线性加速。
Conclusion: 单一的局部-平均混合随机逼近即可同时覆盖个性化收敛与低异质性下的线性加速两个 regime，无需按异质性调参。

papers.title: Safe, Persistent, and Evolving Agent Harness for Understanding Partially Observable Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can invoke tools fluently, but enterprise workflows demand more than selecting the right tools: actions must strictly comply with organizational policies, tool feedback often conceals hidden side effects under partial observability, and long-horizon tasks require persistent state tracking across multiple records. To address these challenges, we introduce E-Ledger, a multi-agent harness for safe and persistent execution. E-Ledger employs a code approval layer that checks every proposed action against policy before execution, and maintains a world ledger of verified hidden rules alongside evidence-backed dynamic state. Because hidden rules are typically unknown a priori, we further propose WorldAbduct, an abductive, world-model-driven harness evolution framework. WorldAbduct diagnoses execution trajectories across four complementary views (state consistency, world-observation gap, policy-gate correctness, and goal judgment) to hypothesize latent rules, and verifies them through targeted abductive interactions before integrating them into the ledger. On the enterprise benchmark World of Workflows, E-Ledger with WorldAbduct improves safe task completion across four LLM backbones, outperforming the strongest evolution baseline by 5--15 percentage points. Experiments in ScienceWorld and DiscoveryWorld further show that abductive harness evolution carries over to scientific environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/E-LEDGER-WorldAbduct.

papers.title: New Lower Bound and Upper Bounds on the Regret for Online Sparse Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: We study online sparse linear regression (OSLR) where any algorithm is restricted to accessing only $b$ out of $d$ attributes per instance for prediction and $b_0\geq 0$ additional attributes after prediction, which was proved to be NP-hard. Previous work focused on designing computationally efficient algorithms under regularity assumptions, but did not characterize its information theoretic complexity. In this work, we give the first lower bound on the minimax regret of OSLR and design algorithms with better upper bounds without regularity assumptions. We characterize how minimax regret scales with problem-dependent parameters, capturing the information theoretic complexity of OSLR.
papers.comment: This work was accepted by IJTCS-FAW 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线稀疏线性回归 (OSLR) 中算法每次预测只能读 d 个属性中的 b 个、预测后再读 b0≥0 个属性，该问题已被证明 NP-hard。本文给出 OSLR minimax regret 的首个下界，并在不加任何正则性假设的前提下设计出更优上界的算法，从而刻画 regret 随问题相关参数的标度，即 OSLR 的信息论复杂度。
Motivation: 此前工作只在正则性假设下设计计算高效算法，OSLR 的信息论复杂度（minimax regret 下界）从未被刻画，无法判断计算受限与统计受限之间的差距。
Method: 给出 OSLR minimax regret 的首个下界，并构造不依赖正则性假设、上界更优的算法；regret 以问题相关参数（含每实例可访问属性数 b 与预测后追加访问数 b0）的标度形式刻画。
Result: 得到 OSLR minimax regret 的首个下界，以及在无正则性假设下上界更优的算法，regret 随问题相关参数的标度被显式刻画；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: OSLR 的信息论复杂度可由 minimax regret 对问题参数的标度刻画，且该刻画不需要任何正则性假设，为计算受限设定下的算法设计给出比较基准。

papers.title: $C_4$-Equivariant Flow Matching on Anisotropic Power-Diagram Graphs for Microstructure Generation
papers.abstract_en: Acquiring realistic microstructure data through Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) is costly and time consuming, often relying on specialised equipment. As microstructures strongly influence material properties, generating realistic samples is essential for modelling the behaviour of polycrystalline materials. We introduce a generative model for synthesising realistic polycrystalline microstructures using flow matching and graph neural networks. By representing microstructures as anisotropic power diagrams, our model learns a compact geometric parametrisation and can render generated samples at arbitrary pixel resolution. A $C_4$-equivariant architecture incorporates rotational symmetry directly into the model, ensuring that rotations of the input noise produce corresponding rotations of the generated microstructure. We also demonstrate how training-free guidance can be used to generate complex microstructures, based on user defined objective function. In particular, we generate microstructures resembling a copper weld, cast metal slab, 3D-printed stainless steel and heterogeneous lamella titanium.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshops on Representations for the Physical Sciences and Geometric Distributional Deep Learning. 12 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 C4 等变 flow matching 加图神经网络，把多晶微结构表示为各向异性 power diagram 的紧凑几何参数化，从而绕开昂贵的 EBSD 采集并按任意像素分辨率渲染生成样本。旋转输入噪声会得到相应旋转的生成微结构，且训练无关 guidance 可按用户目标函数生成复杂结构。
Motivation: 真实微结构数据依赖 EBSD 与专用设备，采集昂贵耗时，而微结构又直接决定多晶材料性能，因此需要能合成真实样本的生成模型。
Method: 以各向异性 power diagram 表示微结构，用 flow matching 与图神经网络学习其紧凑几何参数化；架构内建 C4 等变性，使输入噪声的旋转直接对应生成结果的旋转；推理时用 training-free guidance 按用户定义的目标函数引导生成。
Result: 生成的微结构可按任意像素分辨率渲染；旋转输入噪声产生相应旋转的微结构；按目标函数生成了铜焊缝、铸造金属板、3D 打印不锈钢与非均质层片钛四类复杂结构。
Conclusion: 把微结构压缩成 power diagram 几何参数并注入旋转等变性，可在不采集 EBSD 数据的情况下合成可控、可任意分辨率渲染的多晶微结构。

papers.title: Conditional Transfer from Controlled Pretraining Mixtures to Code
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tasks are increasingly used both as probes of language-model capability and as pretraining data. Both uses are often justified by loss reduction: falling loss is treated as informative, and faster loss reduction with more sampling as evidence that a task is worth sampling. We separate three signals. A task is diagnostic when its loss tracks global pretraining progress; it is teachable when its loss responds to its own token budget; and a data source transfers when including it improves a downstream target. We study controlled pretraining in which 70% of the corpus is fixed general Python and the remaining 30% is a simplex over three source families: OpenCodeInstruct, a curated suite of 12 code-adjacent synthetic tasks, and 15 literature-derived probe tasks. Across a task-budget sweep we detect teachability for 14 of 27 tasks, with a sharp asymmetry between the two synthetic families (10/12 curated versus 4/15 literature-derived). Teachability and downstream transfer give different rankings. On the mixture-simplex edge between the curated suite and OpenCodeInstruct, HumanEval pass@20 after a fixed fine-tuning stage rises from 15.9 at pure curated data to its highest observed value, 22.6, at a mixture that is 75% OpenCodeInstruct, then falls to 19.5 at pure OpenCodeInstruct. Curated synthetic data therefore has conditional value: it contributes as a limited share of a mixture that a target-aligned source still dominates. Finally, a loss-based adaptive scheduler exposes the mismatch between residual loss reducibility and downstream transfer. Across three 60k-step free-ratio runs, Ado drives the OpenCodeInstruct share below 5% within the first 5k steps and to 1.2--1.4% by the end of training, and underperforms its matched fixed-mixture controls by 2.4--11.0 percentage points. Optimizing near-term task-loss reduction moves the mixture away from the region that transfers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把合成任务的三种信号拆开：诊断性（loss 跟随全局预训练进度）、可教性（loss 响应自身 token 预算）、迁移性（加入后改善下游目标），并指出三者给出的排序不一致。在 70% 固定 Python + 30% 三源 simplex 的受控预训练中，27 个任务里 14 个表现出可教性（curated 10/12，literature-derived 4/15）；HumanEval pass@20 在 75% OpenCodeInstruct 混合处达峰值 22.6，而基于 loss 的自适应调度器 Ado 把 OpenCodeInstruct 压到 1.2–1.4%，比固定混合对照低 2.4–11.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 合成任务被同时当作能力探针和预训练数据，两种用途都用 loss 下降来辩护，但 loss 可教性与下游迁移并不等价，按 loss 选混合可能选错方向。
Method: 受控预训练：语料 70% 固定为通用 Python，其余 30% 在三个来源族上取 simplex——OpenCodeInstruct、12 个 curated 合成任务套件、15 个文献衍生 probe 任务；做 task-budget sweep 检测可教性，并在 curated 与 OpenCodeInstruct 的 simplex 边上做固定微调后评测，另用 loss 自适应调度器 Ado 与固定混合对照比较。
Result: 27 个任务中 14 个检测到可教性，curated 10/12 对 literature-derived 4/15；可教性与下游迁移给出不同排序。HumanEval pass@20 在纯 curated 时 15.9，75% OpenCodeInstruct 混合处升至最高 22.6，纯 OpenCodeInstruct 降至 19.5。三次 60k 步 free-ratio 运行中，Ado 在前 5k 步内把 OpenCodeInstruct 份额压到 5% 以下、训练结束时 1.2–1.4%，比匹配的固定混合对照低 2.4–11.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: curated 合成数据只有条件价值：它应作为被目标对齐来源主导的混合中的有限份额存在；优化近期 task-loss 下降会把混合推离真正迁移的区域。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: OX-NeRF: 3D X-ray Tomography Reconstruction from Sparse Views Using Implicit Neural Representation
papers.abstract_en: NeRF and Gaussian splatting methods have been successfully applied on X-ray scenes where the views are too sparse for 3D reconstruction via classical methods. Ultra-sparse scenes with 10 or fewer views such as those with high-rate or low-dose acquisition still, however, present a significant challenge. To address this problem we present a new framework, Optimised X-ray Neural Radiance Fields (OX-NeRF), that combines cross-scene feature learning with scene-specific optimisation to reconstruct sets of related scenes. OX-NeRF employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify cross-scene features while maintaining scene-specific multi-resolution hash grids of spatial features. The paired representations are fused and passed to a multilayer perceptron (MLP); the CNN, hash grids and MLP are then jointly optimised end-to-end. Benchmarking on parallel-beam and cone-beam X-ray datasets shows OX-NeRF provides significantly higher reconstruction accuracy on ultra-sparse scenes compared to existing radiance field methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OX-NeRF 把跨场景 CNN 特征与逐场景多分辨率 hash grid 表征融合后送入 MLP，端到端联合优化，用于 10 视角及以下的超稀疏 X 射线断层重建。在 parallel-beam 与 cone-beam X-ray 数据集上，其重建精度显著高于现有 radiance field 方法。
Motivation: 视角极少（10 个及以下）的高帧率或低剂量 X 射线采集下，经典 3D 重建与现有 NeRF/高斯泼溅方法都难以得到可用的断层重建。
Method: OX-NeRF 框架：CNN 提取跨场景特征，同时保留逐场景的多分辨率 hash grid 空间特征，两路表征融合后输入 MLP，CNN、hash grid 与 MLP 端到端联合优化，用于成组的相关场景重建。
Result: 在 parallel-beam 与 cone-beam X-ray 数据集的基准测试中，OX-NeRF 在超稀疏场景（10 视角及以下）上的重建精度显著高于现有 radiance field 方法。
Conclusion: 跨场景特征学习与逐场景优化相结合，可以在 10 视角及以下的超稀疏 X 射线采集上把 radiance field 重建精度抬到现有方法之上。

papers.title: Learning to Orchestrate Evolutionary Search: Progression-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic DE-CMA-ES Coordination in Optimization and Structural Model Updating
authors: Wanhuan Zhou (1) ((1) State Key Laboratory of Internet of Things for Smart City
(2) College of Water Conservancy and Hydropower Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Solving high-dimensional structural model updating problems requires an algorithm capable of navigating complex, non-convex landscapes with correlated parameters. Existing hybrid evolutionary algorithms typically rely on static architectures or fixed switching rules, resulting in disjointed search phases. To address this, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning-governed dynamic DE-CMAES Orchestration (DRL-DCO) algorithm, in which a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based actor-critic agent continuously governs the evolutionary process as a single, unified system rather than a mechanical concatenation of algorithms. Guided by a progression-aware state representation and a diversity-informed reward, the agent fluidly reallocates computational resources between the differencevector-based exploration of Differential Evolution (DE) and the covariance-guided exploitation of CMA-ES, while jointly regulating population size, elite preservation, and a restart mechanism to escape local optima. This allows DRL-DCO to autonomously transition between exploration-dominant, exploitation-dominant, and mixed-strategy regimes across generations. Beyond the training phase, the trained actor can operate in a supervision-free inference mode, where the internalized policy autonomously orchestrates DE and CMA-ES control from observed search states through forward inference alone, without critic evaluation or weight updates, enabling faster deployment while retaining full effectiveness. Validated on high-dimensional single-objective optimization benchmarks and the IASC-ASCE structural health monitoring benchmark, DRL-DCO achieves superior convergence accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art adaptive and hybrid evolutionary algorithms, as well as single-operator DRL-governed baselines.

TL;DR: 提出 DRL-DCO：用 DDPG actor-critic 连续调度 DE 与 CMA-ES 的探索-利用配比，并联合调节种群规模、精英保留与重启，取代固定切换规则的混合进化算法。训练后的 actor 可纯前向推理、无需 critic 与权重更新即可运行；在高维单目标优化基准与 IASC-ASCE 结构健康监测基准上，收敛精度与鲁棒性优于自适应/混合进化算法及单算子 DRL 基线。
Motivation: 高维结构模型修正要求在参数相关、非凸的复杂景观上搜索，而现有混合进化算法多用静态架构或固定切换规则，导致搜索阶段割裂、难以按进度重配资源。
Method: DRL-DCO 以 DDPG actor-critic 为主体：progression-aware 状态表示加 diversity-informed reward，指导 agent 在 DE 的差分向量探索与 CMA-ES 的协方差引导利用之间连续重分配算力，同时调控种群规模、精英保留与重启机制；训练完成后 actor 进入免监督推理模式，仅凭观测搜索状态做前向推理完成编排。
Result: 在高维单目标优化基准与 IASC-ASCE 结构健康监测基准上，DRL-DCO 的收敛精度与鲁棒性优于最先进的自适应与混合进化算法，也优于单算子 DRL 编排基线；免推理模式在不使用 critic 评估与权重更新的前提下保持全部效果并加快部署。
Conclusion: 把 DE 与 CMA-ES 的切换交给一个按进度感知的 DRL 策略统一编排，可自主在探索主导、利用主导与混合策略三种体制间过渡，且训练好的策略能以纯推理方式部署。

papers.title: Constitutional Gating and Deterministic Recovery for Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation: Ablations Against a Stateful Adversarial Gatekeeper
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems negotiating with a stateful counterpart waste model calls in three ways: polite loops that never meet the counterpart's hidden acceptance condition, malformed outputs that trigger retries, and compliance deadlocks in which the counterpart demands something the agent must refuse. We study a three-part control stack - a 5-Pillar runtime constitution, a 4-tier swarm (Director, three-agent majority vote, Monitor, schema hard gate) and Cognitive Annealing (deterministic deadlock detection, atomic purge of the agent-side context, a canonical recovery message) - against a released adversarial Gatekeeper whose acceptance rules are fixed regular expressions and whose LLM only renders reply text. The testbed has a known solution: it measures whether the stack executes a constitution-aligned strategy against swarm drift and recovers from deadlock, not whether it discovers anything. In five runs per configuration (30 runs; Gemini 2.5 Pro agents, Claude Haiku 4.5 Gatekeeper) we find: (i) the constitution and Director make an acceptable framing possible but not reliable - 0/5 baseline unlocks versus 1/5 and 2/5 with the constitution; when the swarm unlocks it does so in one turn with 7-8 calls and about 15k tokens (67-73% below baseline); when it does not, it costs 17-38% more; (ii) the Monitor and hard gate do not reduce unlocks and leave an audit trail; (iii) under a honeytrap-to-compliance deadlock, LLM-only steering escapes 0 of 5 times while atomic purge plus a canonical strike escapes 5 of 5 (Fisher $p = 0.008$) at the same call budget, with zero calls for the strike. LLM-written strikes failed the deterministic pre-flight 5 of 5 times although an LLM Monitor had approved four. Pre-registered hypotheses on average call and token reduction were not supported. Cost is bounded in every arm by deterministic stop rules; the stack adds recovery at no extra model cost.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures. The Gatekeeper, agents, constitution, lexicon, 30 run logs and analysis scripts are released (see Appendix F). Companion paper: arXiv:2610.09772
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向多智能体 LLM 与有状态对抗性对手的谈判，提出三层控制栈：5-Pillar 运行时宪法、4 层 swarm（Director、三代理多数投票、Monitor、schema 硬门）与 Cognitive Annealing（确定性死锁检测、原子清除代理侧上下文、规范化恢复消息）。在已知解的对抗 Gatekeeper 测试床上，honeytrap 死锁下纯 LLM 引导 0/5 次逃脱，原子清除加规范化 strike 5/5 次逃脱（Fisher p = 0.008）且 strike 零调用。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 与有状态对手谈判时，礼貌循环、格式错误重试和合规死锁三类浪费模型调用；作者指出测试床已知解，考察的是栈能否执行宪法对齐策略并从死锁恢复，而非发现新解。
Method: 三层控制栈：5-Pillar 运行时宪法、4 层 swarm（Director、三代理多数投票、Monitor、schema 硬门）、Cognitive Annealing（确定性死锁检测、原子清除代理侧上下文、canonical recovery message）。对手为已发布的对抗性 Gatekeeper，接受规则是固定正则表达式、LLM 只渲染回复文本；每配置 5 次运行，共 30 次，Gemini 2.5 Pro 作代理、Claude Haiku 4.5 作 Gatekeeper，并预注册平均调用与 token 下降假设。
Result: 基线解锁 0/5，加宪法后 1/5 与 2/5；成功解锁时单轮 7–8 次调用、约 15k tokens，比基线低 67–73%，失败时成本高 17–38%。Monitor 与硬门不降低解锁率并留下审计轨迹。honeytrap-to-compliance 死锁下 LLM-only steering 逃脱 0/5，原子清除加 canonical strike 逃脱 5/5（Fisher p = 0.008），调用预算相同且 strike 零调用；LLM 写的 strike 5/5 未通过确定性 pre-flight，尽管 LLM Monitor 曾批准其中四次。预注册的平均调用与 token 下降假设未获支持。
Conclusion: 宪法与 Director 能让可接受的 framing 变得可能但不可靠，而确定性恢复机制能在同等调用预算下可靠打破死锁；预注册的平均成本下降假设不成立，但每个分支的成本都被确定性停止规则界定，栈以零额外模型开销加入恢复能力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Design Creativity Bench: Measuring creativity in LLM-Generated UI
papers.abstract_en: As leading LLMs improve on capability evaluations, their limitations in producing creative outputs on design tasks remain insufficiently characterised. Our work introduces Design Creativity Bench, a benchmark that evaluates diversity and appropriateness in UI designs. It measures distinctiveness among models on the same prompt (originality), how much a model's designs change between two prompts for the same UI goal in different product domains (creative range), and the share of a brief's acceptance criteria each design meets (appropriateness). Originality is 0.592 for same-prompt design pairs from different models (95% CI [0.582, 0.602]), far below the 0.764 for same-prompt human-model pairs (95% CI [0.751, 0.778]). Creative range is 0.581 across models (95% CI [0.567, 0.597]), against 0.902 for human designs (95% CI [0.884, 0.919]). Appropriateness is above 90% for every model, and the best model reaches 99.2%, slightly above the 98.0% for human designs. Our work shows that the default output of LLMs, though generally appropriate, is substantially more repetitive than the human baseline. This calls for strong measures to address the issue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Design Creativity Bench 用 originality、creative range、appropriateness 三个维度度量 LLM 生成 UI 的多样性与合用性。同 prompt 下不同模型的 originality 仅 0.592，远低于人-模型配对的 0.764；creative range 0.581 对人类 0.902；而 appropriateness 每个模型都在 90% 以上、最佳模型 99.2% 略高于人类 98.0%。结论是 LLM 默认输出合用但高度重复，需要强措施提升设计多样性。
Motivation: LLM 在能力评测上持续进步，但在设计任务上产出创意的短板缺乏刻画：现有评测没有把同一 prompt 下的重复度、跨域变化幅度与需求满足度分开度量。
Method: 提出 Design Creativity Bench，测三个量：同 prompt 下模型间设计的 distinctiveness（originality）、同一 UI 目标在不同产品域两个 prompt 之间的变化幅度（creative range）、每个设计满足 brief 验收标准的比例（appropriateness），并以人-模型配对与人类设计作对照。
Result: 同 prompt 不同模型 originality 0.592（95% CI [0.582, 0.602]），同 prompt 人-模型配对 0.764（[0.751, 0.778]）；creative range 跨模型 0.581（[0.567, 0.597]），人类设计 0.902（[0.884, 0.919]）；appropriateness 每个模型均高于 90%，最佳模型 99.2%，略高于人类 98.0%。
Conclusion: LLM 默认 UI 输出基本合用但比人类基线重复得多，需要强措施解决多样性不足。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: LAIR-Net: Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Networks for Tabular Regression
papers.abstract_en: Deep randomized models fix hidden-layer parameters through random initialization and learn only closed-form readouts, typically adding depth by stacking random trans formations without target-aware control of hidden-state evolution. We propose LAIR Net, the Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Network, which mixes a shallow learned anchor into each hidden state through a leaky residual transition. We derive a depth uniform bound on input-perturbation sensitivity and use controlled simulations to attribute gains over a randomized baseline to the anchor rather than recursion or added capacity. Benefits emerge when a nonlinear target structure is learnable at the available noise level and diminish for nearly linear targets or dominant noise. Across 23 benchmark datasets, LAIR-Net achieves the best average rank among eight randomized networks and twelve conventional models, with relative performance associated with the same nonlinear-structure and noise quantities identified in simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAIR-Net 在深度随机模型的每个隐藏状态中通过 leaky residual transition 混入一个浅层可学习 anchor，从而对隐藏态演化做目标感知控制。它给出输入扰动敏感度的深度一致界 (depth uniform bound)，并用受控模拟把相对随机基线的增益归因于 anchor 而非递归或容量；在 23 个基准数据集上于八个随机网络与十二个常规模型中取得最佳平均排名，收益在目标非线性结构可学、噪声水平允许时出现，近线性目标或噪声主导时减弱。
Motivation: 深度随机模型只随机固定隐藏层参数、学闭式读出，堆叠随机变换时缺少对隐藏态演化的目标感知控制，深度增加带来的敏感度与收益来源都不清楚。
Method: 提出 Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Network (LAIR-Net)：用 leaky residual transition 把一个浅层可学习 anchor 混入每个隐藏状态；推导输入扰动敏感度的深度一致界；用受控模拟 (controlled simulations) 将增益归因于 anchor，与递归或新增容量区分开，并把表现与非线性结构和噪声量关联。
Result: 在 23 个基准数据集上，LAIR-Net 在八个随机网络 (randomized networks) 与十二个常规模型中取得最佳平均排名 (best average rank)；相对表现与模拟中识别出的非线性结构和噪声量相关；受控模拟显示增益来自 anchor 而非递归或容量，且在近线性目标或噪声主导时收益减弱。
Conclusion: 给深度随机模型加一个目标感知的浅层 anchor 是收益的来源，其有效性取决于目标非线性结构在给定噪声水平下是否可学。

papers.title: An Efficient Quantum Circuit for Flow Model Execution Using Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Flow models generate trajectories from an initial distribution to a target distribution by solving an ordinary differential equation defined by a velocity field. Flow matching learns this velocity field by modeling the transport dynamics between the two distributions. Wavefunction flow establishes a formal connection between flow models and quantum dynamics by introducing a continuity Hamiltonian, which drives the Schrödinger evolution of quantum states. In this paper, we investigate accurate and efficient quantum simulation of the wavefunction flow, thereby realizing the efficient implementation of flow models on quantum computers. We first leverage a quantum read-only memory (QROM)-based phase kickback framework for the wavefunction flow simulation, generating probability densities that closely match those produced by the corresponding conventional flow model. To address the high circuit-resource cost, we further incorporate a trained quantum neural network (QNN) into the phase kickback framework, replacing QROM for data encoding. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our proposed method implements flow models on quantum computers more efficiently, since it maintains the accuracy of wavefunction flow simulation compared with the QROM-based framework, and significantly reduces the circuit resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 wavefunction flow 的量子模拟做成可执行线路：先用 QROM 相位 kickback 框架生成与经典 flow model 接近的概率密度，再用训练好的 QNN 替换 QROM 做数据编码，在保持模拟精度的同时显著降低线路资源开销。
Motivation: 用量子计算机执行 flow model 时，QROM 数据编码的线路资源成本过高，制约了 wavefunction flow 量子模拟的可行性。
Method: 基于 continuity Hamiltonian 驱动的 Schrödinger 演化建立 wavefunction flow 与量子动力学的对应；先构造 QROM 相位 kickback (phase kickback) 框架生成概率密度，再将训练好的 quantum neural network (QNN) 嵌入该框架替代 QROM 完成数据编码。
Result: 数值实验表明所提方法生成的概率密度与相应经典 flow model 接近，精度与 QROM 框架相当，同时显著减少线路资源。
Conclusion: 用 QNN 替代 QROM 做数据编码，可以在不牺牲 wavefunction flow 模拟精度的前提下降低量子执行 flow model 的线路开销。

papers.title: HAND: A Biologically-Inspired Activation Function that Improves Generalisation and Sample Efficiency in Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: DNNs exhibit robustness and generalisation issues not seen in humans. They are also far less data-efficient learners, requiring considerably more training samples to accurately classify novel exemplars. Inductive bias could help with these issues by providing in-built mechanisms to improve generalisation, and hence, reduce reliance on learning from data. We incorporate a biologically-inspired inductive bias into a new activation function, HAND (Homeostasis, Accelerating Nonlinearity, and Divisive-nomalisation), and show its effectiveness with CNNs trained on image classification. Using HAND a ConvNeXt-tiny required 25 training epochs to reach the same accuracy on ImageNet1k as the unmodified model achieved after 200 epochs. Consistent with the effects of an inductive bias, the performance gap reduced with training time and increased data augmentation. When the volume of training data was reduced and unevenly distributed between classes (Long-tailed ImageNet) the improvements in accuracy were even larger and did not reduce with increased training time. Generalisation performance with the common-corruptions data, and the ability to reject samples from unknown classes, were unaffected or improved by HAND. Results generalised across CNN architectures and training data-sets. HAND can, therefore, reduce the required training time and/or the required volume and variety of training data, helping to improve sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出受生物启发的激活函数 HAND（Homeostasis、Accelerating Nonlinearity、Divisive-normalisation），把归纳偏置嵌入 CNN 的激活层。ConvNeXt-tiny 用 HAND 在 ImageNet1k 上只需 25 个 epoch 就达到未修改模型 200 epoch 的精度；训练时间越短、数据增强越少时优势越大，长尾与少样本设定下提升更明显且不随训练时间消失。
Motivation: DNN 在泛化与鲁棒性上不及人类，且样本效率低，需要远多于人类的训练样本才能准确分类新样本；作者认为内置归纳偏置可减少对数据量的依赖。
Method: 把三个生物启发机制（稳态 homeostasis、加速非线性 accelerating nonlinearity、除法归一化 divisive normalisation）组合成新激活函数 HAND，替换 CNN 现有激活后在图像分类上训练；在 ConvNeXt-tiny 等多种 CNN 架构与多个训练数据集上检验，并考察数据量缩减、类别不均衡（Long-tailed ImageNet）、common-corruptions 与未知类拒绝等设定。
Result: ConvNeXt-tiny 用 HAND 在 ImageNet1k 上 25 个 epoch 达到未修改模型 200 epoch 的同一精度；性能差距随训练时间增长和数据增强增多而收窄。训练数据量减少且类别分布不均（Long-tailed ImageNet）时精度提升更大，且不随训练时间增加而减弱。common-corruptions 数据上的泛化与拒绝未知类样本的能力不受影响或有提升；结果在多种 CNN 架构与训练数据集上复现。
Conclusion: HAND 这类生物启发归纳偏置可以缩短所需训练时间并降低对训练数据量与多样性的要求，从而提升样本效率，且在数据稀缺与长尾场景收益最大。

papers.title: ReTeach: Building a Self-Teacher through Multi-Round Reflection and Retry
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation can improve reasoning without a separately trained, more capable teacher, but its effectiveness depends on how the self-teacher gains an advantage over the student. Conditioning the teacher on reference answers or solutions can provide such an advantage, but this information may be unavailable. Reflection offers a way to derive explicit error diagnoses and revision guidance from self-generated attempts, yet existing reflection-based methods often combine it with reference information, rich task feedback, or persistent memory. We introduce ReTeach, a Reflective self-distillation framework that constructs its self-Teacher through multi-round reflection and retry using only self-generated attempts and outcome-level verification. Starting from an unsuccessful student rollout, the teacher alternates explicit reflection with renewed attempts until success or the retry budget is exhausted, without reference answers or solutions, external diagnostic feedback, or cross-example memory. Each failed retry informs subsequent reflection, while successful correction provides outcome-level evidence for the potential utility of the resulting teacher context. An outcome-aware selection and weighting strategy distinguishes initially correct, reflection-corrected, and unresolved examples, assigning separate weights to their category-normalized distillation losses. Through on-policy distillation, the student matches the teacher's context-conditioned token-level predictive distributions at prefixes of its own rollouts, transferring the benefits of iterative correction while retaining single-pass inference. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, science question answering, and tool use, ReTeach improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.39 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReTeach 是一个反思式自蒸馏框架：从学生失败的 rollout 出发，让自教师在只有结果级验证的条件下交替做显式反思与重试，直到成功或耗尽重试预算，全程不用参考答案、外部诊断反馈和跨样本记忆。在六个覆盖数学推理、科学问答与工具使用的基准上，平均准确率比 GRPO 高 1.39 个百分点。
Motivation: 自蒸馏的收益取决于自教师相对学生的优势来源，而参考答案或解法这类条件信息在很多任务中不可得；现有反思方法又常依赖参考信息、丰富任务反馈或持久记忆。
Method: 框架由反思 (reflection)、重试 (retry)、结果感知的选择与加权、以及 on-policy 蒸馏组成：失败 rollout 触发多轮反思与重试，成功纠正作为结果级证据；按初始正确、反思纠正、未解决三类分别赋权，对类别归一化的蒸馏损失加权；学生在自身 rollout 的前缀上匹配教师上下文条件的 token 级预测分布，推理时仍保持单次前向。
Result: 在六个基准（数学推理、科学问答、工具使用）上，ReTeach 的平均准确率比 GRPO 提高 1.39 个百分点。
Conclusion: 只靠自生成尝试加结果级验证的多轮反思与重试，就能造出有优势的自教师并把迭代纠正的收益经 on-policy 蒸馏传给学生，同时保留单次推理。

papers.title: AtomWorld-Mirror: Macro-Step World Modeling of Critical Evolution Backbones for Materials Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Atomistic simulation is a fundamental tool for studying long-term materials evolution, from diffusion and defect dynamics to interfacial reactions and fracture. Yet conventional simulators typically advance at microscopic resolution, spending substantial computation on low-impact local updates before reaching structurally consequential states, an evolutionary-resolution bottleneck that limits long-horizon simulation. We propose AtomWorld-Mirror, a time-aware macro-step world model for the critical evolution backbone of atomic systems. For Step-Wise atomistic simulation, AtomWorld-Mirror distills short micro-event segments into physically reachable transitions between key states, jointly predicting sparse structural edits and accumulated physical time through latent macro-step dynamics. Local reachability, inventory conservation, and continuous-time consistency constrain each transition. By amortizing local atomic physics into a reusable latent macro model and replacing explicit micro-event replay with macro-step inference, this formulation provides a path toward substantially faster prediction of long-term materials evolution while preserving structural validity and time semantics. Across five atomic systems, spanning Cu-rich RPV steel irradiation aging, Cu-Zr metallic glass, and Li$_3$N-based anti-perovskite solid electrolyte, macro-step inference delivers a speed up of $10^3$ to $10^4$ times over event-by-event simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AtomWorld-Mirror 是一个时间感知的原子尺度宏步世界模型，把短程微观事件蒸馏为关键状态之间物理可达的跃迁，同时预测稀疏结构编辑与累积物理时间。在五个原子体系（含 Cu-rich RPV 钢辐照老化、Cu-Zr 金属玻璃、Li3N 反钙钛矿固态电解质）上，宏步推理相对逐事件模拟提速 10^3 到 10^4 倍。
Motivation: 常规原子模拟始终以微观分辨率推进，把大量算力花在低影响的局部更新上，形成演化分辨率瓶颈，限制长时程材料演化的模拟效率。
Method: 对 Step-Wise 原子模拟，将短微观事件段蒸馏为关键状态间物理可达的跃迁，用潜在宏步动力学 (latent macro-step dynamics) 联合预测稀疏结构编辑与累积物理时间；每个跃迁受局部可达性、库存守恒 (inventory conservation) 与连续时间一致性三重约束，以宏步推理替代显式微观事件回放。
Result: 在五个原子体系上（Cu-rich RPV 钢辐照老化、Cu-Zr 金属玻璃、Li3N 基反钙钛矿固态电解质），宏步推理相对逐事件模拟提速 10^3 至 10^4 倍。
Conclusion: 把局部原子物理摊销进可复用的潜在宏模型、用宏步推理取代微观事件回放，可在保持结构有效性与时间语义的前提下大幅加速长时程材料演化预测。

papers.title: MSGAT: Multi-Head Spiking Graph Attention with Similarity-Space Fusion for Image-Text Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient computing paradigm through sparse event-driven computation, showing great potential for efficient multimodal learning. However, applying SNNs to high-level multimodal tasks, such as image-text retrieval (ITR), remains challenging, since sparse spike representations make it difficult to capture semantic structures required for cross-modal alignment. Existing spiking ITR methods rely on local alignment and additional soft-label supervision during training, while lacking awareness of structural and multi-granularity relationships. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-head Spiking Graph Attention Network (\textbf{MSGAT}) for structural modeling and equip it with dynamic attention heads to capture complementary relational patterns and enable spike-driven graph reasoning and aggregation. However, within a two-branch multi-granularity fusion framework, the fine-grained spike representations generated by MSGAT are sparse and discrete, whereas the global representations are continuous, making conventional feature-level fusion susceptible to interference across heterogeneous representations. Therefore, we introduce \textbf{Sim-Fuse}, a similarity-space fusion alignment strategy integrating coarse- and fine-grained matching relations while avoiding direct fusion of heterogeneous representations. Experiments on Flickr30K and MSCOCO show our method outperforms ANN methods under matched settings and existing SNN retrieval baselines. Moreover, with only two time steps, our SNN achieves comparable or superior performance to its ANN counterpart while reducing theoretical module-level energy by 55\%. The code is provided in the Supplementary Materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSGAT 用多头脉冲图注意力 (multi-head spiking graph attention) 做图像-文本检索的结构化建模，再用 Sim-Fuse 在相似度空间融合粗细粒度匹配关系，避免稀疏脉冲特征与连续全局特征直接拼接。在 Flickr30K 与 MSCOCO 上，仅 2 个时间步即达到或超过对应 ANN，理论模块级能耗降低 55%。
Motivation: 脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的稀疏离散表征难以捕捉跨模态对齐所需的语义结构，现有脉冲 ITR 方法依赖局部对齐与软标签监督，缺少结构与多粒度关系建模。
Method: 提出 MSGAT：多头动态注意力捕获互补关系模式，支持脉冲驱动的图推理与聚合；两分支多粒度框架中引入 Sim-Fuse 相似度空间融合策略，整合粗粒度与细粒度匹配关系，绕开异构表征的特征级直接融合。
Result: 在 Flickr30K 与 MSCOCO 上，匹配设定下优于 ANN 方法与已有 SNN 检索基线；仅用 2 个时间步达到或优于其 ANN 对应模型，理论模块级能耗降低 55%。
Conclusion: 相似度空间融合加图结构建模可让 SNN 在极少时间步下把图像-文本检索做到 ANN 水平，同时保住脉冲网络的能耗优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When to Intervene? State-Aware Sparse Manipulation in Federated Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated reinforcement learning (FRL) enables distributed agents to collaboratively train decision-making policies, but its decentralized training process also exposes global policy learning to Byzantine manipulation. Existing poisoning attacks primarily focus on how to construct malicious updates, while trajectory-level intervention timing remains largely implicit. In sequential decision making, however, where an intervention is applied can alter subsequent trajectories and learning signals. Through controlled experiments, we find that changing the selected trajectory states materially alters attack efficacy even when the malicious-update construction is fixed. We therefore identify when as a distinct attack dimension and introduce the Viability-constrained Behavioral Steering Attack (V-BSA), which uses local policy uncertainty to select sparse intervention states and applies envelope-constrained behavioral steering. Across discrete-action benchmarks, V-BSA achieves substantial degradation against robust aggregators and ensemble defenses with only a fraction of the interventions used by dense poisoning, while revealing task- and aggregation-dependent boundaries. Overall, our results highlight intervention timing as a distinct dimension of sequential robustness in FRL. The code is available at https://github.com/Yodeesy/V-BSA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦强化学习中，攻击的介入时机本身是一个独立维度：在恶意更新构造固定时，改变被干预的轨迹状态会实质改变攻击效果。据此提出 V-BSA，用局部策略不确定性挑选稀疏介入状态并施加包络约束的行为引导，在离散动作基准上以远少于稠密投毒的介入次数，对鲁棒聚合器与集成防御造成显著性能下降。
Motivation: 现有投毒攻击主要研究如何构造恶意更新，而序贯决策中轨迹级的介入时机是隐式的；在时序任务里介入位置会改变后续轨迹与学习信号，这一维度此前未被当作独立攻击面处理。
Method: 提出 Viability-constrained Behavioral Steering Attack (V-BSA)：以局部策略不确定性作为准则挑选稀疏的介入状态，并对被选状态施加包络约束 (envelope-constrained) 的行为引导；在离散动作基准上与鲁棒聚合器和集成防御对抗评估。
Result: 受控实验显示，在恶意更新构造固定的前提下，改变所选轨迹状态会实质改变攻击效能；V-BSA 在离散动作基准上仅用稠密投毒的一部分介入次数，即对鲁棒聚合器与集成防御造成显著退化，并揭示出随任务与聚合方式变化的防御边界。
Conclusion: 介入时机是联邦强化学习序贯鲁棒性的一个独立维度，稀疏、状态感知的介入即可高效破坏全局策略学习，防御评估必须把何时介入纳入考量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WARP-VLA: Wrist-Camera Adaptation for View-Robust Policy Execution in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) for robotic manipulation, their performance remains sensitive to changes in camera configuration. The problem becomes more evident in cross-setup deployment, as reproducing the exact camera pose used for training is nearly impossible. Unlike fixed external views, wrist views are more challenging because the camera moves with the robot, causing even small mounting variations to alter fine-grained geometric cues. To address this, we propose WARP-VLA, a camera-view robust VLA for diverse wrist camera configurations. WARP-VLA adopts a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture where individual experts learn view-specific feature transformations, and a router combines them based on implicit view information. This allows the policy to be deployed without requiring camera extrinsic parameters as additional input. Through experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, WARP-VLA improves the average success rate of pi-0.5 from 39.2% to 78.3% under wrist-view perturbations. The real-robot experiments further show that the feature-level adaptation learned in simulation successfully transfers to diverse deployment settings. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release our wrist viewpoint robustness benchmark and a plug-and-play implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WARP-VLA 用 Mixture-of-Experts 架构让各专家学习视角特定的特征变换、由 router 依据隐式视角信息加权融合，使 VLA 策略在不输入相机外参的情况下承受腕部相机安装差异。在 LIBERO 上腕部视角扰动时，pi-0.5 平均成功率从 39.2% 提到 78.3%，仿真学到的特征级适配可迁移到真实机器人部署。
Motivation: VLA 策略对相机配置敏感，跨部署场景几乎无法复现训练时的相机位姿；腕部相机随机械臂运动，微小安装偏差就会改变细粒度几何线索，导致策略失效。
Method: 提出 WARP-VLA：Mixture-of-Experts 架构，各 expert 学习视角特定的特征变换，router 根据隐式视角信息组合专家输出，因此部署时无需额外输入相机外参；在 LIBERO benchmark 上实验，并发布腕部视角鲁棒性 benchmark 与即插即用实现。

papers.title: Compactness and Consistency: A Conjoint Framework for Deep Graph Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Graph clustering is a fundamental task in data analysis, aiming at grouping nodes with similar characteristics in the graph into clusters. This problem has been widely explored using graph neural networks (GNNs) due to their ability to leverage node attributes and graph topology for effective cluster assignments. However, representations learned through GNNs typically struggle to capture global relationships between nodes via local message-passing mechanisms. Moreover, the redundancy and noise inherently present in graph data may easily result in node representations lacking compactness and robustness. To address these issues, we propose a conjoint framework CoCo, which captures compactness and consistency in the learned node representations for deep graph clustering. Technically, our CoCo leverages graph convolutional filters to learn robust node representations from both local and global views, and then encodes them into low-rank compact embeddings, thus effectively removing the redundancy and noise as well as uncovering the intrinsic underlying structure. To further enrich the node semantics, we develop a consistency learning strategy based on compact embeddings to facilitate knowledge transfer from the two perspectives. Our experimental results indicate that our CoCo outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts on various datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted by Proceedings of the Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026 Oral)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出深度图聚类框架 CoCo：用图卷积滤波器同时从局部与全局视角学鲁棒节点表示，再压成低秩紧凑嵌入以去冗余去噪，并在紧凑嵌入上做一致性学习以在两个视角间迁移知识。在多个数据集上超过现有最先进方法。
Motivation: GNN 的局部消息传递难以捕捉节点间的全局关系，且图数据自带的冗余与噪声使节点表示缺乏紧凑性与鲁棒性，深图聚类效果受限。
Method: CoCo 联合建模紧凑性与一致性：先用图卷积滤波器从局部和全局两个视角学习鲁棒节点表示，再编码为低秩紧凑嵌入以移除冗余噪声、暴露内在结构，最后基于紧凑嵌入设计一致性学习策略，在两个视角间迁移知识以丰富节点语义。
Result: 实验结果显示 CoCo 在多个数据集上优于最先进（state-of-the-art）的深图聚类方法。
Conclusion: 把全局关系建模、低秩紧凑嵌入与跨视角一致性学习放在一个框架里，是提升深图聚类表示质量的有效路径。

papers.title: The Operator Mismatch Problem: Deploying BEV Perception with Portable GPU Compute
papers.abstract_en: Modern autonomous driving systems rely on bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception models that fuse camera and LiDAR inputs to detect objects in 3D space. These models are accurate, but they cannot be deployed through standard inference runtimes. The reason is an operator mismatch between dense convolutions (which runtimes handle well), sparse 3D convolutions (which runtimes cannot represent), and geometric scatter operations (which runtimes have no vocabulary for). Today, every sparse convolution library is CUDA-only and PyTorch-coupled, locking BEV deployment to a single vendor's hardware and a single execution framework. We present BEVPIPE, a framework for deploying multimodal BEV perception pipelines using portable GPU compute APIs and integrating them with production inference runtimes. BEVPIPE partitions the model into runtime-managed dense subgraphs and three external operator extensions (voxelizer, sparse encoder, BEV projector), connected through a shared GPU memory space. BEVPIPE achieves a 19.5x end-to-end speedup over conventional deployments while retaining 98.5% of reference mAP. We also showcase that BEVPIPE is portable across different GPU backends.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEVPIPE 把 BEV 感知模型切成由推理运行时管理的稠密子图与三个外部算子扩展（voxelizer、sparse encoder、BEV projector），通过共享 GPU 内存空间衔接，用可移植 GPU API 打通 CUDA/PyTorch 之外的部署路径。端到端较常规部署提速 19.5 倍，同时保住参考 mAP 的 98.5%，并展示跨 GPU 后端的可移植性。
Motivation: BEV 感知依赖稀疏 3D 卷积与几何 scatter，标准推理运行时无法表示这些算子，而现有稀疏卷积库全部 CUDA-only 且绑定 PyTorch，把部署锁死在单一硬件厂商与单一执行框架上。
Method: BEVPIPE 将模型划分为运行时管理的稠密子图与三个外部算子扩展（voxelizer、sparse encoder、BEV projector），三者通过共享 GPU 内存空间连接，再与生产推理运行时集成；底层改用可移植 GPU compute API 而非 CUDA/PyTorch 专用实现。
Result: 端到端较常规部署获得 19.5 倍加速，同时保留参考 mAP 的 98.5%；并在不同 GPU 后端上展示可移植性。
Conclusion: 算子不匹配是 BEV 部署被单一厂商锁定的根因，把稀疏算子外置为运行时可衔接的扩展即可在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅提速并跨 GPU 后端迁移。

papers.title: Fed-GRPO: Reward-Signal-Driven Federated Group Relative Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities when fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), particularly through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, existing GRPO methods assume centralized access to training data, which may not hold in practice due to privacy or regulatory constraints. To this end, we propose Fed-GRPO, a federated GRPO training framework that addresses these privacy constraints by enabling collaborative reasoning training without sharing raw data, which leverages the reward statistics naturally produced during GRPO training as zero-cost signals to guide aggregation, local training, and communication. Fed-GRPO contains three reward-signal-driven mechanisms: (i) \emph{signal-weighted aggregation} that weights clients by their reward standard deviation, prioritizing clients with stronger learning signals; (ii) \emph{global reward calibration} that re-weights per-prompt objectives based on the local-global reward gap, steering each client toward its relative weaknesses; and (iii) \emph{adaptive sparse communication} that allocates bandwidth based on the informativeness of each client's update. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks demonstrate that Fed-GRPO achieves the best performance among all federated methods, clearly outperforms FedAvg and approaches centralized training performance, while losslessly reducing communication by $32\times$ and supporting up to $621\times$ compression under tight bandwidth budgets with only graceful accuracy degradation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/Fed-GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fed-GRPO 把 GRPO 训练中天然产生的奖励统计当作零成本信号，驱动联邦聚合、本地训练与通信三个环节，在不共享原始数据的前提下做协作式 LLM 推理训练。在数学推理任务上，它在所有联邦方法中性能最好、明显超过 FedAvg 并接近集中式训练，同时无损通信量降低 32×，在带宽紧张时最高支持 621× 压缩且精度仅温和下降。
Motivation: GRPO 等 RL 推理微调依赖集中访问全部训练数据，而隐私或监管约束使数据无法集中，联邦化 GRPO 又缺少利用奖励信息来调度聚合与通信的手段。
Method: 提出 Fed-GRPO，含三个奖励信号驱动机制：按各客户端奖励标准差加权的 signal-weighted aggregation，按本地-全局奖励差距重加权每 prompt 目标的 global reward reward calibration，以及按更新信息量分配带宽的 adaptive sparse communication；在数学推理任务上做联邦训练实验。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，Fed-GRPO 在所有联邦方法中性能最佳，明显优于 FedAvg 并接近集中式训练水平；通信量无损降低 32×，在紧带宽预算下最高支持 621× 压缩且仅有温和的精度下降。
Conclusion: GRPO 自带的奖励统计足以充当联邦训练的调度信号，可在不共享原始数据、不牺牲多少精度的前提下大幅压缩通信。

papers.title: Learning qBIC Resonances across Metasurface Families in Dielectric Fourier Space
papers.abstract_en: Bound states in the continuum (BIC) metasurfaces are typically described by geometry-specific parameters, hindering cross-geometry comparison, while ultranarrow qBIC features are easily diluted in full-spectrum learning. Here, 2015 samples from seven dielectric metasurface families are mapped to a shared reciprocal-lattice grid, where two frozen low-order Fourier channels capture resonance shifts with mean within-branch $R^2$ values of 0.871-0.999. Field-level analysis of two representative branches further confirms that these shifts are consistent with the Maxwell-Fourier perturbation picture. A five-channel K-space backbone models the broadband spectrum, while a local complex K-space expert parameterizes the qBIC resonance through a differentiable Fano layer. The expert reduces resonance-position mean absolute error (MAE) from 3.2 to 0.95 nm and the resonance-depth error by 14-fold on a geometry-blocked test set. The same coordinate supports spectrum-to-structure reconstruction.
papers.comment: 45 pages,5 main figures and 1 main table; includes Supplementary Information with 11 supplementary figures and 3 supplementary tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把七个介质超表面家族的 2015 个样本映射到共享倒格子网格，用两个冻结的低阶 Fourier 通道统一描述 qBIC 共振位移，并以五通道 K-space 主干加可微 Fano 层的局部复值专家参数化共振。在几何分块测试集上，专家把共振位置 MAE 从 3.2 nm 降到 0.95 nm，共振深度误差降低 14 倍，同一坐标还支持光谱到结构的反演。
Motivation: BIC 超表面通常依赖各自几何参数，跨几何家族无法比较；而超窄 qBIC 特征在全光谱学习中容易被稀释。
Method: 将七个介质超表面家族共 2015 个样本映射到共享倒格子 (reciprocal-lattice) 网格，用两个冻结的低阶 Fourier 通道刻画共振位移；五通道 K-space 主干建模宽带光谱，局部复值 K-space 专家通过可微 Fano layer 参数化 qBIC 共振，并对两个代表性分支做场层面分析以对照 Maxwell-Fourier 微扰图像。
Result: 两个冻结 Fourier 通道的分支内平均 R² 为 0.871–0.999；在几何分块 (geometry-blocked) 测试集上，专家将共振位置 MAE 从 3.2 nm 降至 0.95 nm，共振深度误差降低 14 倍；场层面分析确认位移与 Maxwell-Fourier 微扰图像一致。
Conclusion: 共享 Fourier 空间坐标加上专门的共振专家，可以在跨几何家族的尺度上同时统一描述 qBIC 位移、宽带光谱并支持光谱到结构的重建。

summary_sections.method: 将七个介质超表面家族共 2015 个样本映射到共享倒格子 (reciprocal-lattice) 网格，用两个冻结的低阶 Fourier 通道刻画共振位移；五通道 K-space 主干建模宽带光谱，局部复值 K-space 专家通过可微 Fano layer 参数化 qBIC 共振，并对两个代表性分支做场层面分析以对照 Maxwell-Fourier 微扰图像。
summary_sections.result: 两个冻结 Fourier 通道的分支内平均 R² 为 0.871–0.999；在几何分块 (geometry-blocked) 测试集上，专家将共振位置 MAE 从 3.2 nm 降至 0.95 nm，共振深度误差降低 14 倍；场层面分析确认位移与 Maxwell-Fourier 微扰图像一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 共享 Fourier 空间坐标加上专门的共振专家，可以在跨几何家族的尺度上同时统一描述 qBIC 位移、宽带光谱并支持光谱到结构的重建。

papers.title: Parametric Trajectory Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion and flow models require many sequential evaluations, making generation computationally expensive. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but poses a capacity allocation problem: a student must match the teacher's iterative generation with far less sequential computation. Existing trajectory methods ask the student to reproduce teacher transitions that are highly curved at high noise, which can exceed its capacity and degrade fine detail. We introduce Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD), which lets the student parameterize teacher trajectory segments as polynomials and learn from teacher guidance along its own predicted path. PTD is designed to let the learned curvature adapt to the backbone's predictive capacity, preserving motion and diversity. The curvature head is used only in training; inference keeps the original backbone architecture. On Wan2.1-14B, four-step PTD sets a new state of the art for trajectory distillation, significantly improving dynamic quality and naturalness over PDD, the best-performing trajectory-only method on this model, under the same training setting. On the 33B audio-video MiniMax-H3, LoRA-trained PTD significantly improves diversity and naturalness over the state-of-the-art LightX2V Turbo. Blinded human votes give PTD 55.1% and 63.4% preference shares against PDD and LightX2V Turbo. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/PTD/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PTD 让少步视频生成的学生模型用多项式参数化教师轨迹段，并沿自身预测路径获取教师引导，使学到的曲率随骨干的预测能力自适应。在 Wan2.1-14B 四步生成上超过轨迹类方法 PDD，在 MiniMax-H3 上超过 LightX2V Turbo，盲测人评偏好份额分别为 55.1% 与 63.4%。
Motivation: 少步蒸馏中学生必须用远少于教师的顺序计算复现迭代生成，而现有轨迹方法要求学生复现高噪声区高度弯曲的教师转移，超出其容量并损害细节。
Method: PTD 用多项式参数化教师轨迹段，学生沿自己预测的路径从教师获得引导，曲率头只在训练时使用、推理保留原骨干架构；在 Wan2.1-14B 上四步训练，在 33B 音视频 MiniMax-H3 上用 LoRA 训练。
Result: Wan2.1-14B 四步 PTD 在相同训练设定下显著改善动态质量与自然度，超过该模型上表现最好的纯轨迹方法 PDD；MiniMax-H3 上 LoRA 训练的 PTD 在多样性与自然度上显著超过 SOTA LightX2V Turbo；盲测人评偏好份额 PTD 对 PDD 为 55.1%，对 LightX2V Turbo 为 63.4%。
Conclusion: 把教师轨迹交给学生按自身容量参数化，可在不改推理架构的前提下提升少步视频生成的动态质量、自然度与多样性。

papers.title: Stop My Dancing! Understanding, Detecting and Attributing Motion-Aware Deepfake Videos
papers.abstract_en: Pose-guided diffusion models can now synthesize entire human figures in motion, spawning a new class of deepfakes: Motion Aware Deepfake (MAD) that have already reached hundreds of millions of viewers. To better understand this emerging threat, we construct the first MAD-specific benchmark and measurement framework, containing over 1.5 million frames that mix 1,363 real and 30,122 synthetic videos from six controllable generators, with realistic perturbations and open-world evaluation splits. Then, we dissect MAD and discover that, despite their global coherence, these videos betray faint yet reliable cues: because the model relies on limited input frames for motion synthesis, it must predict and simulate coherent movement at motion boundaries, thereby producing high-frequency artifacts along with model-specific spectral fingerprints. Based on the observations obtained from analysis on dataset, we propose MoDA, the first defense framework tailored to detect and attribute MAD videos. MoDA couples spatial semantics with steganalysis-rich frequency features via cross-domain alignment and multi-scale aggregation, achieving 94.8% in-distribution and 89.1% cross-dataset detection accuracy gains of 10% to 25% over prior work and 91.5% model attribution accuracy. MoDA achieves 81.94% accuracy on 200 clips produced by two unseen commercial MAD platforms, indicating promising zero-shot transfer, and 78.13% detection accuracy on 1,200 unseen MAD video clips (55k frames in total) collected from the open Internet. Under white-box, gray-box, and black-box adaptive attacks, MoDA maintains relatively stable detection and attribution performance while the accuracies of the baselines drop rapidly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对姿态引导扩散生成的 Motion Aware Deepfake (MAD)，提出检测与归因框架 MoDA：用跨域对齐耦合空间语义与隐写分析式频域特征，再做多尺度聚合。在自建 150 万帧基准上取得 94.8% 分布内、89.1% 跨数据集检测精度，较既有工作提升 10%–25%，模型归因 91.5%；对两个未见商业平台的 200 段视频零样本达 81.94%。
Motivation: 姿态引导扩散已能合成整段运动人体，催生触及数亿观众的 Motion Aware Deepfake (MAD)，但缺少 MAD 专用基准与检测手段，通用深伪检测器难以覆盖。
Method: 先构建首个 MAD 专用基准与测量框架（超 150 万帧，混合 1,363 段真实与 30,122 段合成视频，来自六个可控生成器，含真实扰动与开放世界划分）；分析发现运动边界处因输入帧有限而产生高频伪影与模型特异频谱指纹。据此提出 MoDA，通过跨域对齐 (cross-domain alignment) 与多尺度聚合耦合空间语义与隐写分析式频域特征。
Result: MoDA 分布内检测精度 94.8%，跨数据集 89.1%，较先前工作提升 10%–25%；模型归因精度 91.5%。在两个未见商业 MAD 平台产出的 200 段视频上 81.94%，在开放互联网收集的 1,200 段未见 MAD 视频（共 5.5 万帧）上 78.13%。白盒、灰盒、黑盒自适应攻击下 MoDA 检测与归因性能相对稳定，而基线精度迅速下降。
Conclusion: MAD 在运动边界留下可复用的高频与频谱线索，把空间语义与频域隐写特征对齐即可实现稳健检测、归因与跨平台零样本迁移。

papers.title: Beyond Resolution: Object-to-Image Ratio Mismatch in Instance Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Visual instance retrieval often fails when the same object appears at different apparent sizes in the query and gallery. We show that the dominant cause is usually not resolution loss but object-to-image (O2I) ratio mismatch: the object occupies different fractions of the two images. On a controlled benchmark of 3,021 Objaverse objects rendered at five camera distances, more than 80% of the cross-distance degradation is attributable to O2I mismatch rather than resolution for 9 of 12 pretrained backbones; multi-scale architectures cut the resolution-only effect to single digits yet remain equally susceptible. The failure is also asymmetric: tight queries retrieve more reliably against wide gallery images than the reverse. Guided by this analysis, query-side scale augmentation and an OWLv2 crop reranker reach state of the art on ILIAS 100M (29.2 mAP@1000 before reranking, 42.0 after) without training or modifying the precomputed gallery index, and a LoRA fine-tune matches the query-side gains at a single forward pass, showing that O2I robustness is learnable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉实例检索在查询与图库中同一物体表观尺寸不同时失效，主因不是分辨率损失而是物体占图比 (O2I ratio) 不匹配：在 3,021 个 Objaverse 物体、5 个相机距离的受控基准上，12 个预训练 backbone 中有 9 个超过 80% 的跨距离退化可归因于 O2I 不匹配。紧查询对宽图库检索更可靠，反向更差；用查询侧尺度增广加 OWLv2 crop 重排，在 ILIAS 100M 上达到 29.2 mAP@1000（重排前）与 42.0（重排后）的 SOTA，且不训练、不改动预计算图库索引。
Motivation: 同一物体在查询与图库中表观尺寸不同时实例检索会退化，此前常被归因于分辨率损失，导致改进方向（如多尺度架构）选错靶子。
Method: 先在受控基准上做归因分析：3,021 个 Objaverse 物体在 5 个相机距离渲染，对 12 个预训练 backbone 分解跨距离退化的来源；再据此提出查询侧尺度增广 (query-side scale augmentation) 与 OWLv2 crop 重排器，另用 LoRA 微调做对照，全程不改动预计算图库索引。
Result: 12 个 backbone 中 9 个超过 80% 的跨距离退化归因于 O2I 不匹配而非分辨率；多尺度架构把纯分辨率效应压到个位数百分比但仍同等易感；紧查询对宽图库的检索成功率高于反向。ILIAS 100M 上 mAP@1000 为 29.2（重排前）、42.0（重排后），达到 SOTA；LoRA 微调在单次前向传播下追平查询侧增广的收益。
Conclusion: 实例检索跨尺度失效的主因是 O2I 比例不匹配而非分辨率，因此鲁棒性应从查询侧（尺度增广、crop 重排或 LoRA 微调）获得，无需重建图库索引；O2I 鲁棒性是可学习的。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: PSI-SINDy: Post-Selection Inference for Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) is a data-driven framework for discovering governing dynamics from time-series data by identifying a sparse subset of candidate dynamical terms from a prespecified library. In this work, we develop a statistical inference framework for quantifying the reliability of dynamical terms selected by SINDy through hypothesis tests and confidence intervals. A key difficulty is that using the same noisy trajectory for both selecting dynamical terms and assessing their statistical significance can introduce selection bias. Post-selection inference provides a principled framework for addressing such bias, and we propose PSI-SINDy, a post-selection inference method tailored to SINDy. Direct application of existing post-selection inference techniques is challenging because SINDy involves measurement error in the candidate terms and shared noise between the response and design. To address these challenges, PSI-SINDy uses data thinning to decompose a single observed trajectory into four mutually independent views with distinct roles in selection and inference. This construction enables inference for selected dynamical terms while accounting not only for selection bias but also for measurement-error and shared noise effects. We establish the theoretical validity of PSI-SINDy under stated conditions and evaluate its performance through numerical experiments on simulated and experimental dynamical-system data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSI-SINDy 为 SINDy 选出的动力学项提供假设检验与置信区间，用 data thinning 把单条含噪轨迹拆成四个互相独立的视图，分别承担选择与推断，从而同时校正选择偏差、测量误差与响应-设计共享噪声。在给定条件下理论有效，并在模拟与实验动力系统数据的数值实验中检验性能。
Motivation: SINDy 用同一条含噪轨迹既选项又做显著性评估会引入选择偏差，且候选项含测量误差、响应与设计共享噪声，直接套用现有 post-selection inference 技术不可行。
Method: 提出 PSI-SINDy：用 data thinning 将单条观测轨迹分解为四个互相独立的视图，分别用于项选择与统计推断，据此对被选动力学项做假设检验和置信区间，并在给定条件下证明理论有效性。
Result: 在模拟与实验动力系统数据上做数值实验评估性能（摘要未列具体数值）；理论层面在所述条件下建立 PSI-SINDy 的有效性。
Conclusion: 把 data thinning 引入 SINDy 的后选择推断，可在含测量误差与共享噪声的设定下对选出的动力学项给出有统计保证的显著性与区间。

papers.title: BridgeGuard: Explicit Safety Drift for Diffusion-based Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based driving planners capture diverse behaviors but can generate unsafe trajectories under distribution shift. We propose BridgeGuard, a safety-constrained diffusion planning method that progressively strengthens a constraint term during denoising to drive intermediate trajectories toward a scene-dependent safety domain. Corrections operate in a low-dimensional curve space, promoting geometric coherence. A learned module, DistanceFieldNet, predicts a time-dependent distance field from bird's-eye-view features. Value and spatial-gradient supervision at queries sampled beyond expert trajectories teaches this field about both safe and unsafe regions. The learned field supplies the constraint term through safety injection while the pretrained perception backbone and planner remain frozen. We further establish sufficient conditions for terminal safety in an idealized continuous-time bridge. On Bench2Drive, BridgeGuard improves driving score/success rate from 87.99/74.99% to 90.88/76.36% for BridgeDrive and from 80.79/58.18% to 90.46/74.09% for $\text{DiffusionDrive}^{\text{geo}}$, demonstrating cross-model generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BridgeGuard 在扩散式自动驾驶规划的去噪过程中逐步加强约束项，把中间轨迹拉向场景相关的安全域，从而在分布偏移下压低不安全轨迹。在 Bench2Drive 上，BridgeDrive 的 driving score/success rate 从 87.99/74.99% 提到 90.88/76.36%，DiffusionDrive^geo 从 80.79/58.18% 提到 90.46/74.09%，显示跨模型泛化。
Motivation: 扩散式驾驶规划器能产生多样化行为，但在分布偏移下会生成不安全轨迹，需要在不重训感知与规划主干的前提下注入安全约束。
Method: 提出安全约束扩散规划：去噪中逐步增强约束项，把中间轨迹推向场景相关的安全域，修正发生在低维曲线空间以保持几何一致性；DistanceFieldNet 从 BEV 特征预测随时间变化的距离场，在专家轨迹之外采样的查询点上做数值与空间梯度监督，该场经 safety injection 提供约束项，感知主干与规划器保持冻结；并为理想连续时间 bridge 的终端安全给出充分条件。
Result: 在 Bench2Drive 上，BridgeDrive 的 driving score/success rate 由 87.99/74.99% 提升至 90.88/76.36%，DiffusionDrive^geo 由 80.79/58.18% 提升至 90.46/74.09%，体现跨模型泛化。
Conclusion: 在冻结主干的前提下用学习到的距离场做去噪期安全注入，可在 Bench2Drive 上同时提升两个扩散规划器的驾驶分与成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Local Language Model Agents for Reproducible Data Engineering: An Empirical Software Engineering Study of Mobility Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Context: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as software and data-engineering assistants, yet evidence about locally deployable open-weight agents remains limited. Existing evaluations often emphasize textual responses or isolated code generation rather than the validity of complete engineering artifacts. Objectives: We evaluate whether local LLM agents can produce correct and reproducible data-engineering artifacts, quantify the effect of a closed-loop workspace condition, and examine trade-offs in model scale, architecture, quantization, runtime, tool use, and failure. Methods: We introduce a benchmark of fifteen mobility-workflow tasks covering data discovery, connectors, transport-feed processing, semantic enrichment, feature engineering, validation, visualization, and reporting. Deterministic checkers assess generated scripts, tables, structured files, figures, and reports. Ten local configurations are evaluated in one-shot and closed-loop conditions, with five repetitions per model, mode, and task, yielding 1,500 scored attempts on a consumer-grade GPU. Results: Among models larger than two billion parameters, the workspace condition increases pass rates by 26.7-52.0 percentage points over one-shot generation. The strongest configuration reaches 85.3% artifact-level success, and a quantized 9-billion-parameter model reaches 69.3% with an approximately 6.5 GB memory footprint. Gains are largest when intermediate artifacts expose errors the agent can inspect and repair. Conclusion: Local open-weight agents can support a meaningful subset of software-intensive data-engineering work, but reliability depends on model capability, task verifiability, and deterministic validation. The benchmark provides a reproducible method for evaluating complete agent configurations before adoption in engineering workflows.
papers.comment: Preprint, under review. 26 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21397610
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 15 个 mobility 工作流数据工程任务的基准，用确定性检查器对脚本、表、结构化文件、图和报告打分，比较 10 种本地开源权重 LLM 配置在 one-shot 与闭环 workspace 两种条件下的表现。在大于 2B 参数的模型上，闭环条件比 one-shot 提升 26.7–52.0 个百分点；最强配置达到 85.3% 的 artifact 级成功率，量化后的 9B 模型在约 6.5 GB 显存下达到 69.3%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 评测多关注文本回答或孤立代码生成，缺少对完整工程产物正确性与可复现性的证据，本地可部署开源权重 agent 尤其缺乏系统评估。
Method: 构建 15 个 mobility 工作流任务（数据发现、连接器、transport-feed 处理、语义增强、特征工程、验证、可视化、报告），用确定性检查器评估生成的脚本、表、结构化文件、图与报告；在消费级 GPU 上评测 10 种本地配置，各含 one-shot 与闭环两种模式，每模型×模式×任务重复 5 次，共 1500 次打分尝试。
Result: 大于 2B 参数的模型中，workspace 条件比 one-shot 提升 26.7–52.0 个百分点通过率；最强配置 artifact 级成功率 85.3%；量化 9B 模型达 69.3%，显存占用约 6.5 GB；共 1500 次打分尝试。当中间产物暴露可被 agent 检查并修复的错误时，增益最大。
Conclusion: 本地开源权重 agent 可承担软件密集型数据工程的一个有意义子集，但可靠性取决于模型能力、任务可验证性与确定性验证；该基准为采用前评估完整 agent 配置提供了可复现方法。

papers.title: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Embodied coding agents can combine modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies, yet effective composition requires anticipating which policy family will succeed in the current physical state. We present RoboAware, which builds on coding agents' skill orchestration by learning only a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes. Inspired by the success of REPL, we propose the $P^5$ schema and formulate a hierarchical MDP based on it. $P^5$ organizes skills uniformly into five semantic stages, defining where responsibility can be compared. To address the lack of counterfactual branch outcomes in existing work, we introduce State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), which restores the same training state to generate and execute a code block from each admissible family, exposing outcomes that selected-branch experience leaves unobserved. Building on this, we propose Execution-Aware Learning (EAL), which combines Monte Carlo tree search with Q-learning to distill these outcomes into family-conditioned values. At deployment, the coordinator selects the policy family according to observable context, and the frozen coding agent generates the next local code block. Comprehensive single-episode evaluations on 100 tasks show that RoboAware reaches a 77.0% overall success rate, with SOTA averages of 90.0% on RoboSuite, 73.8% on diverse LIBERO-Pro task clusters, and 90.0% on challenging RoboTwin bimanual tasks, outperforming existing code-as-policy and VLA-harness baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboAware 只训练一个状态条件化的责任协调器 (responsibility coordinator)，用 State-Locked Counterfactual Branching 回到同一训练状态执行各可选策略族的代码块，暴露被选分支掩盖的反事实结果，再用 Execution-aware Learning（MCTS + Q-learning）蒸馏成族条件价值。100 个任务的单回合评测总成功率 77.0%，RoboSuite 90.0%、LIBERO-Pro 73.8%、RoboTwin 双臂 90.0%，优于 code-as-policy 与 VLA-harness 基线。
Motivation: 具身 coding agent 组合模块化技能与冻结端到端策略时，需要预判当前物理状态下哪个策略族会成功，但现有工作缺少反事实分支结果，被选分支之外的经验完全观测不到。
Method: 提出 P^5 schema 把技能统一到五个语义阶段并据此建立分层 MDP；State-Locked Counterfactual Branching 恢复同一训练状态、对每个可选策略族执行一个代码块以生成反事实结果；Execution-Aware Learning 结合 MCTS 与 Q-learning 把结果蒸馏为族条件价值，部署时由协调器按可观测上下文选族、冻结 coding agent 生成下一段局部代码。
Result: 100 个任务的 comprehensive single-episode 评测中总体成功率 77.0%；RoboSuite 平均 90.0%，LIBERO-Pro 多样任务簇平均 73.8%，RoboTwin 双臂任务 90.0%，在这些设置上超过现有 code-as-policy 与 VLA-harness 基线。
Conclusion: 只学一个状态条件化的责任协调器、用反事实分支补全未观测结果，就足以在冻结策略之上改进具身技能组合的成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conditional Residual Prediction: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion without a Bidirectional Teacher
papers.abstract_en: Causal video diffusion models generate video autoregressively, which suits streaming, interactive, and long-video generation. Under standard training, however, they often yield lower generation quality than bidirectional models of the same size. Many existing approaches address this gap by initializing from or distilling a pretrained bidirectional teacher. We instead train a causal model from an image-model initialization, with no bidirectional video model at any stage. Because this path requires neither a large bidirectional teacher nor a complex distillation pipeline, it is simpler and more scalable. On this path, we find that a causal model trained on ground-truth history becomes strongly dependent on it, so that at inference errors in its own generated history propagate forward. We hypothesize that much of this dependence is unnecessary, because the current input already determines much of what the history provides. We propose Conditional Residual Prediction (CRP), a simple recipe for reducing a model's reliance on a condition: the model first predicts the target without the condition, and the condition may only add a residual on top of this prediction. Applied to history, CRP makes the model predict each chunk from the present as far as it can and use the past only for what the present cannot supply. In controlled experiments, CRP nearly closes the 6.14-point gap to a bidirectional model trained under the same setup. Scaling this recipe, we train Optica, a 2B-parameter causal video model that autoregressively generates 5-second 480p videos and reaches 82.78 on VBench with only about 15M training videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Conditional Residual Prediction (CRP)：因果视频扩散模型先不看历史、仅凭当前输入预测目标，历史只能在其上叠加残差，从而削弱对真实历史的过度依赖、抑制自生成历史的误差前向传播。在同等设置的受控实验中，CRP 几乎抹平了与双向模型 6.14 分的差距；据此扩展训练出 2B 参数的 Optica，自回归生成 5 秒 480p 视频，仅用约 1500 万训练视频在 VBench 上达到 82.78。
Motivation: 因果视频扩散在同等规模下生成质量常低于双向模型，主流做法依赖大规模双向教师或蒸馏管线；而用真实历史训练的因果模型会过度依赖历史，推理时自身生成的误差会逐块向前传播。
Method: 从图像模型初始化直接训练因果视频模型，全程不用双向视频教师、不做蒸馏；核心是 CRP 训练配方——模型先在无历史条件下预测目标，条件（历史）只能追加残差，即先用当下能给的信息预测每个 chunk，历史只补当下补不上的部分。
Result: 受控实验中 CRP 几乎弥合了与同设置下训练的双向模型之间 6.14 分的差距；扩展该配方训练的 Optica（2B 参数因果视频模型）自回归生成 5 秒 480p 视频，仅用约 1500 万训练视频在 VBench 上取得 82.78。
Conclusion: 因果视频模型对历史的依赖大部分是多余的，用「先无条件预测、条件只加残差」的 CRP 即可在不引入双向教师的前提下把质量拉近双向模型，并可扩展到 2B 规模的长视频自回归生成。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Rare Gate Disagreements Can Limit Plasticity: When Gradient Flow Mispredicts Finite-Batch SGD
papers.abstract_en: Population gradient flow is a common tool for reasoning about how neural networks adapt, including after pretraining. We show that it can mispredict finite-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) qualitatively, and we trace the discrepancy to a specific mechanism. In a two-unit ReLU regression, a source task drives the two neurons toward positive proportionality and a target task rewards separating them. After source training for time $T$, gradient flow recovers on the target in time linear in $T$. Online SGD with batch size $b$ and step size $η$ in both phases instead fails with high probability throughout a horizon of order $e^{c/η}$ once $T \gtrsim \log(b/η)$, uniformly on an explicit set of initializations with Gaussian probability above one percent. For each fixed $T$, small-step SGD still recovers, so the failure requires the joint limit of small steps and long pretraining. At the target clone, the population instability is carried entirely by inputs on which the two ReLU gates disagree. For units at angle $δ$ these inputs form a wedge of probability $δ/π$, and weight decay shrinks the angle exponentially during pretraining. On every other input both units receive the same random linear update, which contracts their separation in conditional expectation. Bounding the cumulative probability of sampling the wedge along the exact online recursion, without a diffusion approximation, shows that recovery with fixed probability from an identical source-gradient-flow checkpoint, within $e^{c/η}$ updates, requires $Nb \gtrsim e^{λT}$ target samples and batch size $b \gtrsim ηe^{λT}$, where $N$ counts updates and $λ$ is the weight decay. In simulations, recovery is approximately a function of the disagreement budget $bδ/η$ and saturates in the horizon.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Tong Che leads the project
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明总体梯度流 (population gradient flow) 会定性误判有限批量 SGD 的可塑性：两单元 ReLU 回归中源任务把两神经元推向正比例、目标任务奖励分离，梯度流在 O(T) 时间内恢复，而在线 SGD 在 T ≳ log(b/η) 后以高概率在整个 e^{c/η} 时域内失败。失败机制是门不一致输入构成概率为 δ/π 的楔形区，weight decay 在预训练期使夹角 δ 指数收缩；要在 e^{c/η} 步内以固定概率恢复，需 Nb ≳ e^{λT} 个目标样本且 b ≳ ηe^{λT}。
Motivation: 用梯度流推理神经网络（含预训练后）适应性的常见做法可能在有限批量、小步长的 SGD 上定性失效，而现有分析未定位到导致该偏差的具体机制。
Method: 在两单元 ReLU 回归玩具模型中分解目标克隆处的总体不稳定性：指出其完全由两 ReLU 门不一致的输入（夹角 δ 对应概率 δ/π 的楔形区）承载，其余输入上两单元收到相同随机线性更新、条件期望下收缩分离；沿精确在线递推（非扩散近似）界定楔形区被采样的累积概率，导出样本量与批量的联合条件，并用模拟检验。
Result: 梯度流在目标上 O(T) 恢复；在线 SGD（批量 b、步长 η）在 T ≳ log(b/η) 时以高概率于 e^{c/η} 时域内失败，且对高斯概率超过 1% 的显式初始化集一致成立；固定 T 时小步长 SGD 仍可恢复。恢复需 Nb ≳ e^{λT} 且 b ≳ ηe^{λT}（λ 为 weight decay）。模拟中恢复近似是无量纲预算 bδ/η 的函数，并随时域饱和。
Conclusion: 梯度流对有限批量 SGD 的可塑性预测在小步长与长预训练的联合极限下失效，失败由门不一致楔形区的采样预算控制，因此可塑性判据必须用在线 SGD 的离散采样动力学而非总体梯度流给出。

papers.title: From Chain-of-Thought to Loops: Non-Autoregressive Latent Reasoning via Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning often improves language-model performance by giving models additional computation before answering. However, explicit CoT expresses this computation as a sequence of autoregressively generated tokens. Latent reasoning replaces these tokens with compact continuous states, but most autoregressive latent-reasoning methods retain a left-to-right dependency among latent vectors. We introduce LLoCoT: a looped latent-reasoning framework that replaces left-to-right latent generation with iterative refinement of a compact latent workspace. A shared transformer is reapplied for a small number of refinement iterations, jointly updating the latent slots based on the prompt and the evolving workspace state. Using the refined state, a probabilistic head predicts a distribution from which latent tokens are sampled in parallel and used to condition an autoregressive decoder for answer generation. Training uses continuous representations derived from explicit CoT together with a final-answer prediction loss and likelihood-based supervision of the latent states. Across HumanEval and MBPP, LLoCoT achieves the highest mean among the evaluated methods, performing on par in accuracy with Reasoning SFT, our explicit-CoT baseline, while outperforming the base model, answer-only SFT and NF-CoT. Relative to Reasoning SFT, LLoCoT reduces time to the first answer token by approximately $36\times$ and reasoning-phase latency by approximately $42\times$, while increasing end-to-end throughput by $9.2\%$. This design replaces serial thought generation with parallel latent-slot refinement while retaining probabilistic latent modeling and autoregressive answer decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLoCoT 把显式 CoT 的逐 token 自回归推理换成对紧凑 latent workspace 的循环迭代精化：共享 transformer 少次重用、联合更新 latent slots，再并行采样 latent token 去条件自回归解码器。在 HumanEval 与 MBPP 上其准确率与显式 CoT 基线 Reasoning SFT 持平且为所评方法最高均值，同时首 token 延迟约降 36×、推理阶段延迟约降 42×、端到端吞吐提升 9.2%。
Motivation: 显式 CoT 用自回归 token 序列表达额外计算，推理慢；已有 latent reasoning 多数仍保留 latent 向量间的从左到右依赖，无法摆脱串行生成。
Method: LLoCoT 用共享 transformer 对紧凑 latent workspace 做少量迭代精化，按 prompt 与演化中的 workspace 状态联合更新 latent slots；精化后由概率头给出分布并行采样 latent token，再条件自回归解码器生成答案。训练信号来自显式 CoT 导出的连续表示，加上最终答案预测损失与 latent 状态的似然监督。
Result: 在 HumanEval 与 MBPP 上，LLoCoT 取得所评方法中最高均值，准确率与显式 CoT 基线 Reasoning SFT 持平，并优于 base model、answer-only SFT 与 NF-CoT；相对 Reasoning SFT，首个答案 token 时间缩短约 36×，推理阶段延迟缩短约 42×，端到端吞吐提升 9.2%。
Conclusion: 串行的逐 token 思维生成可以被并行的 latent-slot 精化替代而不损失准确率，同时大幅压缩首 token 与推理阶段延迟；概率 latent 建模与自回归答案解码可以保留。

papers.title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis for Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Decoders
papers.abstract_en: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) pair a visual encoder with a large language model (LLM) and perform well on diverse image-text tasks, yet their reliability is often limited by decoder attention pathologies that suppress visual evidence and exacerbate hallucinations. In this paper, we revisit visual attention sinks and uncover a structured, layer-dependent behavior: across prompts, early and late decoder layers exhibit prompt-invariant attention collapse onto the same few image regions, which we term PIS (Prompt-Invariant Sinks), whereas mid layers become prompt-conditioned and drive vision-language alignment. This split suggests that treating sinks as a uniform effect is incomplete. Building on this insight, we propose SAGE (Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis), a lightweight intervention that steers decoder attention away from PIS and toward query-dependent regions of interest (ROIs) using token-aligned ROI masks derived from standard vision backbones such as CLIP, ViT, and DINOv3. Evaluated on diverse vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM VLM families, SAGE improves visual grounding, reduces hallucinations, and yields consistent gains across public downstream vision-language benchmarks, including fine-grained visual discrimination settings where localized evidence is crucial, when instantiated with backbone-derived ROI masks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 把视觉注意力 sink 拆成层相关结构：早晚层是与 prompt 无关的 PIS（Prompt-Invariant Sinks），中层才随 prompt 驱动视觉-语言对齐；据此用 CLIP/ViT/DINOv3 生成的 token 对齐 ROI mask 把解码器注意力从 PIS 引向查询相关区域。在多种 vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM 的 VLM 上提升 visual grounding、降低幻觉，并在细粒度视觉判别设定下取得一致增益。
Motivation: VLM 的可靠性常被解码器注意力病态限制：注意力塌缩到少数图像区域会压制视觉证据并加剧幻觉，而以往把 sink 当作整体统一效应处理，掩盖了层间差异。
Method: 先跨 prompt 分析视觉注意力 sink，识别早晚层的 prompt-invariant collapse（PIS）与中层的 prompt-conditioned 对齐；再提出轻量干预 SAGE，用标准视觉 backbone（CLIP、ViT、DINOv3）导出的 token 对齐 ROI mask，把解码器注意力从 PIS 转向查询相关 ROI。
Result: 在多种 vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM 的 VLM 家族上，SAGE 改善 visual grounding、减少幻觉，并在公开下游 vision-language benchmark 上取得一致增益；在用 backbone 导出 ROI mask 实例化时，细粒度视觉判别这类需要局部证据的设定同样有增益。
Conclusion: 把 sink 视为层相关而非均匀效应，才能有效引导解码器注意力；SAGE 这一轻量干预在多种 VLM 架构上稳定提升 grounding 并抑制幻觉。

papers.title: GROB: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Public-Trace Investigation of Candidate Agentic Activity
papers.abstract_en: We present GROB, a multi-agent architecture for investigating candidate autonomous-agent activity through public Internet traces when privileged telemetry is unavailable. The system performs controlled, read-only collection of public traces and preserves selected observations for later resolution. In a frozen September 2026 corpus, several collected traces became more informative as additional public evidence emerged. The strongest result concerns Census-labelled identifiers captured on 9 September. Public revision records later resolved these identifiers to specific Census requests from 16 - 17 June. Other results show weaker links between traces collected by GROB and evidence reconstructed or reported later. These links vary in strength, and only some can be tied to specific public records. The results show that sparse public traces can remain useful even before their significance is fully understood. Such evidence can support later reconstruction, but public traces alone do not establish organizational attribution. Execution identity presents a separate problem, as continuity of agent identity remains an active research question for autonomous language-model agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GROB 提出面向候选自主智能体活动的多智能体公共痕迹调查架构：在无特权遥测时只读采集公开网络痕迹并留存观测，待后续公开证据出现后再解析。在冻结的 2026 年 9 月语料中，9 月 9 日采集的 Census 标注标识符后来被公开修订记录解析为 6 月 16–17 日的具体 Census 请求；作者据此主张稀疏公开痕迹在意义未明时仍有后续价值，但仅凭公开痕迹无法确立组织归属。
Motivation: 调查候选自主智能体活动时往往拿不到特权遥测，只能依赖公开网络痕迹；而痕迹采集时其意义常不明确，需要一种能留存证据、待后续公开记录出现后再解析的调查架构。
Method: 多智能体架构 GROB 对公开痕迹做受控的只读采集 (controlled, read-only collection)，保留选定观测供后续解析；在冻结的 2026 年 9 月语料上运行，并把采集到的痕迹与后来重建或公开报道的证据做关联比对。
Result: 最强结果是 9 月 9 日采集的 Census 标注标识符，后被公开修订记录解析为 6 月 16–17 日的具体 Census 请求；其他结果中 GROB 采集痕迹与后续证据的关联较弱，强弱不一，且只有部分能对应到具体公开记录。
Conclusion: 稀疏公开痕迹在意义被完全理解之前就能保持可用并支撑后续重建，但公开痕迹本身不足以确立组织归属；智能体执行身份的连续性仍是自主语言模型智能体的开放研究问题。
