papers.title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
papers.abstract_en: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自改进 agent 的 verifier 本身作为进化对象：用小规模、基本确定性的 drawback detectors 合成可检查的打分表达式，出生时做门控，选择标准是对十项锚定参考集与无标签输出共识的一致性，而非 agent 自身得分。在 MBPP+ 上其 held-out 一致度比人工种子组合高 +0.21，且在每个种子上都成立，最终超过它所包含的裸 LLM judge。
Motivation: 开放式任务上不存在 ground truth，自改进循环只能靠手写 rubric 或与 agent 同源的 LLM judge 打分，容易 reward hacking 与共享盲点；而下游任务分数无法认证一个自进化 verifier。
Method: verifier 是对一组小而基本确定的 drawback detectors 的可检查表达式，detectors 从聚类失败中合成，出生时门控，选择依据是与十项锚定参考集的一致度加上对无标签输出的共识，绝不以 agent 得分为选择信号；Double Ratchet 把该 verifier 与生命周期管理的 skill loop 配对。
Result: MBPP+ 上 held-out 一致度较人工种子组合 +0.21，逐种子成立，并最终优于其内部的裸 LLM judge；移除锚定守卫后 verifier 塌缩为恒通过的空洞打分器，却仍能把 skill 训练得一样好；Double Ratchet 在代码生成、企业 text-to-SQL、无参考报告生成三类任务上保留了 ground truth 或 rubric 所带来提升的 88–110%；当进化出的 skill 钻报告 rubric 空子时，外层 judge 检出并用一个新增 detector 修复，而该 judge 在获得 task contract 之前本身是错的。
Conclusion: 下游任务分数不能认证自进化 verifier，充分性判断可以由进化 verifier 替代；锚定守卫只保证打分器不塌缩，不保证它能训好 skill，rubric 被钻空子时需要外层 judge 加新 detector 闭环修复。

summary_sections.conclusion: 下游任务分数不能认证自进化 verifier，充分性判断可以由进化 verifier 替代；锚定守卫只保证打分器不塌缩，不保证它能训好 skill，rubric 被钻空子时需要外层 judge 加新 detector 闭环修复。

papers.title: ProtoSemImage: Image-Valued Prototypes with Deformable Row Alignment for Interpretable Document Classification
papers.abstract_en: Prototypes in classification models are almost always vectors, and a vector has no readable form. This paper asks what happens when a prototype is an image. Documents give the question a natural form, because a document can be rendered as a multi-channel image in which every token becomes a pixel, so a class representative can take the same shape and the same channel semantics as the inputs it stands for. ProtoSemImage represents each class by one or more visual archetypes: prototype images in a four-channel HSV space whose channels carry named linguistic factors. A Skip-Gram objective learns that color space end to end through a four-dimensional bottleneck, discourse boundary rows become differentiable typed difference rows, and classification reduces to 2D visual template matching: a deformable row alignment between a document image and the archetype bank, in the spirit of dynamic time warping. Because the match is a spatial pattern comparison rather than a linear readout, the model reports where an input departs from its archetype and along which channel, and a generative head decodes each archetype back into text. The image representation works: it beats an otherwise identical model with vector prototypes in all three paired seeds, by between 4.3 and 11.8 points on a ten-class task. The distance-based matching does not. A diagnostic that keeps the representation fixed and swaps only the classifier recovers the sequence baselines, which locates a 20.6-point shortfall in the matching rather than in the color compression, and a benchmark built so that a pair of documents shares a bag of words and differs only in arrangement confirms the layout-preservation it was designed for. We report both directions, because for a representation whose whole purpose is inspect ability, the failure modes are as informative as the gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoSemImage 把文档渲染成多通道图像，用四通道 HSV 空间的原型图像（prototype image）代替向量原型，Skip-Gram 目标端到端学习色空间，分类退化为可变形行对齐的 2D 模板匹配。图像表示在十类任务上三个配对种子全部胜过同构向量原型，提升 4.3–11.8 分；但距离匹配本身失败，固定表示只换分类器即可追回序列基线，定位出 20.6 分的缺口来自匹配而非颜色压缩。
Motivation: 分类模型的原型几乎都是向量，向量没有可读形式，无法直接报告输入在何处偏离其类代表、偏离发生在哪个通道。
Method: 把文档渲染为每个 token 即一个像素的多通道图像，每类用一个或多个四通道 HSV 原型图像表示，通道承载命名的语言学因子；Skip-Gram 目标经四维瓶颈端到端学习该色空间，话语边界行变成可微的 typed difference rows；分类用文档图像与原型库之间的可变形行对齐（deformable row alignment，思路类似 dynamic time warping），另配生成头把原型解码回文本。
Result: 在十类任务上，图像原型相对同构向量原型在全部三个配对种子中胜出，提升幅度 4.3 到 11.8 分；保持表示固定、只替换分类器的诊断实验追回了序列基线，把 20.6 分的缺口定位在匹配而非颜色压缩；在刻意构造为词袋相同、仅排列不同的基准上，确认了该表示的布局保持能力。
Conclusion: 图像原型这一表示形式有效，而基于距离的匹配无效：20.6 分的短板出在匹配机制。作者主张对以可解释性为全部目的的表示，失败模式与增益同样需要报告。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feature Space Adaptation for Effortless Gaussian Process Flows
papers.abstract_en: Outside the linear-Gaussian regime, conditional sampling from Gaussian processes (GPs) is challenging. Recent methods such as FlowGP (Moss et al., (2026)) can condition on arbitrary non-linear and non-Gaussian statements, but at considerable cost: an expensive iterative and high-dimensional diffusion that requires hand-specified kernel hyperparameters. In this paper, we alleviate two significant drawbacks of FlowGP by (1) introducing kernel approximations that enable scaling to high-resolution domains and (2) proposing a way to obtain the marginal likelihood by measuring the work needed to steer the diffusion towards conditioning statements. We enable, for the first time, hyperparameter optimisation within FlowGP and demonstrate our approach on probabilistic downscaling from areal summary statistics, PDE solution inference on irregular domains, and recovery of sea level anomaly fields from non-Gaussian satellite observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 FlowGP 在非线性非高斯条件下采样昂贵且需手工指定核超参的问题，提出核近似使方法可扩展到高分辨率域，并用把 diffusion 引导到条件陈述所需的 work 度量来估计边缘似然，从而首次在 FlowGP 内做超参优化。演示任务为从面状汇总统计做概率降尺度、不规则域 PDE 解反演，以及从非高斯卫星观测恢复海面高度异常场。
Motivation: 线性高斯之外的 GP 条件采样困难；FlowGP 虽能条件于任意非线性非高斯陈述，但依赖昂贵的迭代高维 diffusion，且核超参需手工指定。
Method: 引入核近似以扩展到高分辨率域；通过度量把 diffusion 引导到条件陈述所需的 work 来获得边缘似然，进而首次在 FlowGP 中实现超参优化。
Result: 在三个任务上演示该方法：从面状汇总统计的概率降尺度、不规则域上的 PDE 解反演、以及从非高斯卫星观测恢复海面高度异常场 (sea level anomaly fields)。
Conclusion: 核近似加基于 work 的边缘似然估计可让 FlowGP 免于手工超参并扩展到高分辨率域，适用于非线性非高斯条件下的 GP 采样。

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Loops
papers.abstract_en: AI research progress can be viewed as the interaction between two processes: benchmark creation and method discovery. Historically, both were driven by human intelligence. However, recent advances in AI have accelerated automated method discovery, while automated benchmark creation has received comparatively less attention. To enable self-advancing systems, we propose Generative Adversarial Loop (GAL), a generator-discriminator framework alternating between two agentic searches: (1) a discriminator that generates adversarial data to expose weaknesses in current systems, and (2) a generator that discovers algorithms to overcome them. We apply this framework to approximation algorithms for efficient inference. Unlike existing auto research systems, which primarily focus on algorithm discovery, GAL introduces a discriminator agent that automates goalpost setting by continually searching for weaknesses in the current algorithm. We demonstrate adversarial data generation across four tasks: KV compression, sparse video generation, sparse attention, and context extension, where the discriminator identifies weaknesses in state of the art techniques. We further show that GAL enables autonomous improvement, with newly discovered algorithms improving not only on adversarially generated data, but also on established benchmarks. Specifically, GAL improves CompactorPress on KV compression with Qwen3-4B at 4x, raising performance on the discriminator dataset from 0.35 to 0.97, while also outperforming RULER-HARD (+0.77 pts). For context extension, GAL boosts Dual Chunk Attention from 0.20 to 0.90 on the discriminator dataset, while yielding gains on standard benchmarks(ScienceFiction (+6 pts) and PG19 32K (-0.33 PPL)). GAL thus provides a path toward autonomous goalpost setting and algorithmic improvement, where AI systems continually discover their own weaknesses and develop methods to overcome them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出生成式对抗闭环 (Generative Adversarial Loop, GAL)：判别器 agent 持续生成对抗数据暴露当前算法弱点，生成器 agent 据此发现新算法，两者交替实现自主设定目标。在 KV 压缩上把 CompactorPress（Qwen3-4B, 4x）在判别器数据集上的表现从 0.35 提到 0.97，并在 RULER-HARD 上超出 +0.77 pts；上下文扩展上把 Dual Chunk Attention 从 0.20 提到 0.90，ScienceFiction +6 pts、PG19 32K PPL 降 0.33。
Motivation: 现有自动化研究系统几乎只做算法发现，自动构造基准（goalpost）仍靠人，系统无法自己发现弱点并持续推进。
Method: GAL 采用生成器-判别器双 agent 框架交替做两轮 agentic search：判别器生成对抗数据定位当前系统弱点，生成器搜索克服弱点的算法；应用于高效推理的近似算法，覆盖 KV 压缩、稀疏视频生成、稀疏注意力、上下文扩展四类任务。
Result: 四类任务上判别器均识别出 SOTA 技术的弱点。KV 压缩：CompactorPress + Qwen3-4B 在 4x 下，判别器数据集 0.35 → 0.97，RULER-HARD +0.77 pts。上下文扩展：Dual Chunk Attention 判别器数据集 0.20 → 0.90，ScienceFiction +6 pts，PG19 32K PPL -0.33。
Conclusion: 新算法的收益不只落在对抗生成数据上，也迁移到既有基准，说明对抗式目标设定可驱动自主算法改进。

papers.title: SpikeSSL: A Universal Spike Inference Framework with Dynamics-Informed State-Space Layers
papers.abstract_en: Two-photon calcium imaging is a standard tool for recording large neural populations in vivo, yet inferring spikes accurately across the growing diversity of calcium indicators remains an open problem. Existing supervised methods achieve reasonable in-domain accuracy but generalize poorly to unseen indicators, because different indicators induce distinct fluorescence kinetics and signal statistics while existing architectures remain relatively simple generic temporal regressors without dynamics-matched inductive bias. We propose SpikeSSL, a universal spike inference framework whose temporal backbone is a bank of bidirectional IIR state-space layers broadly motivated by calcium dynamics. A multi-modal conditioning encoder maps indicator identity, sampling rate, and trace-level signal statistics into a global conditioning vector that modulates the backbone via Adaptive Layer Normalization, while a heteroscedastic variance head provides calibrated per-frame uncertainty. On a benchmark with five fixed evaluation splits built from 33 public ground-truth datasets, SpikeSSL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and zero-shot leave-one-indicator-out settings. We also develop a biophysical simulation pipeline capable of generating paired fluorescence-spike traces with systematically varied kinetic parameters, spike statistics, response nonlinearities, baseline drift, and noise. Using this pipeline, we synthesize approximately 11,000 simulated traces. Augmenting training with these data effectively closes the cross-indicator domain gap and improves zero-shot generalization. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/detimage123/SpikeSSL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpikeSSL 用动力学先验的双向 IIR 状态空间层做钙信号到脉冲的通用推断，配合指标身份/采样率/信号统计的多模态条件编码与异方差不确定性头，在 33 个公开真值数据集的五个固定划分上同时取得 in-domain 与零样本 leave-one-indicator-out 的 SOTA；再用生物物理仿真管线合成约 11,000 条配对荧光-脉冲轨迹做训练增广，有效弥合跨指标域差距。
Motivation: 不同钙指示剂的荧光动力学与信号统计各异，现有监督方法只在域内准确、遇到未见指标就退化，因为骨干只是缺乏动力学匹配归纳偏置的通用时序回归器。
Method: 骨干为一簇双向 IIR 状态空间层（由钙动力学启发）；多模态条件编码器把指标身份、采样率、轨迹级信号统计映射为全局条件向量，经 Adaptive Layer Normalization 调制骨干；异方差方差头给出逐帧校准不确定性。另建生物物理仿真管线，系统改变动力学参数、脉冲统计、响应非线性、基线漂移与噪声，合成约 11,000 条配对轨迹做增广。
Result: 在由 33 个公开真值数据集构成、含五个固定评估划分的 benchmark 上，SpikeSSL 在 in-domain 与零样本 leave-one-indicator-out 两种设置均达到 state-of-the-art；用仿真数据增广训练后跨指标域差距被有效弥合，零样本泛化提升。
Conclusion: 把钙动力学直接写进状态空间骨干并配合指标条件化与仿真增广，是让脉冲推断跨钙指示剂通用的关键路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Zatom-2: Multitask Pretraining on Atomistic Data for Generative Modeling across Domains
papers.abstract_en: Unified atomistic modeling has the potential to accelerate discovery in chemistry, materials science, and biology by bridging data-rich chemical domains and data-scarce biological contexts. However, existing generative approaches to atomistic modeling remain highly specialized to scientific disciplines (chemistry vs. biology) or do not leverage both high-volume organic (molecule) and inorganic (material) data for general-purpose pretraining. To this end, we introduce Zatom-2, an atomistic generative model pretrained on approximately five million structures from the OMol25 and OMat24 electronic structure datasets. Zatom-2 features a multiscale Transformer architecture coupled with conditional flow matching that supports force conditioning and foundational pretraining tasks such as generation, structure prediction, and prediction of molecular and material energies and forces. Empirically, Zatom-2 achieves better molecular distribution fidelity than Zatom-1 and achieves strong performance on existing molecule and material generation benchmarks. Zatom-2 demonstrates the ability to control sample generation across low- and high-force regimes, and enhances protein generation in a low-data setting through joint generative-predictive pretraining and transfer learning, increasing protein backbone designability in a length extrapolation setting from 67.8% without pretraining to 74.8% after finetuning on 2,000 protein domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zatom-2 是一个跨化学与生物领域的原子级生成模型，用约五百万个 OMol25 与 OMat24 电子结构数据做多任务预训练，采用多尺度 Transformer 加条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching)，支持力条件化以及生成、结构预测、能量与力预测等预训练任务。在长度外推设定下，联合生成-预测预训练加微调把蛋白质骨架 designability 从无预训练的 67.8% 提到 74.8%（微调仅用 2,000 个蛋白结构域）。
Motivation: 现有原子级生成模型要么局限于单一学科（化学或生物），要么没有同时利用高体量有机分子与无机材料数据做通用预训练，难以在数据丰富的化学域与数据稀缺的生物域之间迁移。
Method: Zatom-2 以约五百万个来自 OMol25 和 OMat24 电子结构数据集的结构做基础预训练；架构为多尺度 Transformer，配条件流匹配，支持力条件化 (force conditioning)，预训练任务涵盖生成、结构预测以及分子与材料的能量和力预测；生物域通过联合生成-预测预训练加迁移学习接入。
Result: 分子分布保真度优于 Zatom-1，并在已有分子与材料生成基准上取得强性能；可控制低力与高力区间 (low- and high-force regimes) 的样本生成；在长度外推设定下，蛋白质骨架 designability 从无预训练的 67.8% 提升到在 2,000 个蛋白结构域上微调后的 74.8%。

papers.title: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no instructions. Each game is a sequence of levels, and a strategy that clears one level can fail on the next, so every new level is in effect a new task. The agent records what it learns as Python scripts and text notes, while the harness keeps a complete log of every action and observation. Our contribution is a measurement protocol that traces each thought through these files, from the task where it forms to the task where it is corrected or abandoned, applied to seven evaluation runs with three backbones from two model families. Scripts written for one task are almost never called again in a later task (33 of 630 references cross a task boundary), because most scripts embed the state of the current level. Instead, the agent rewrites its knowledge into new scripts, keeping the general rules and dropping the level-specific details, and abandons 74% of the scripts it wrote before a boundary. The notes, which only the model reads, are never revised: the agent appends without removing earlier claims, and the contradictions that accumulate are settled against the log. Because the log preserves everything, the agent forgets selectively, not catastrophically. The most costly error is a hard-coded value carried into a task where it no longer holds. These findings come from the files the agent wrote, without access to the model, and constitute a white-box analysis of how a coding agent continually learns.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4FMAgents)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结基础模型加固定 harness 的设定下，让 coding agent 用 Python/shell 脚本无说明地玩 ARC-AGI-3，并提出一套追踪每个“thought”（写进文件的信念、规则或计划）从形成到被纠正或放弃的测量协议。跨任务边界后脚本几乎不再被调用（630 次引用中仅 33 次跨边界），agent 在边界前写的脚本有 74% 被放弃，靠重写而非复用实现选择性遗忘。
Motivation: agent 在跨任务序列中如何保留、改写或丢弃已有知识缺乏可观测的度量手段；固定 harness 下无状态、只留文件痕迹的设定让“遗忘是选择性还是灾难性”变成可直接追踪的问题。
Method: 测量协议把每个 thought 从形成它的任务追踪到被纠正或放弃的任务，依据 agent 写的脚本与文本笔记以及 harness 记录的完整动作/观测日志；在 7 次评估运行、来自 2 个模型家族的 3 个 backbone 上应用。
Result: 630 次脚本引用中仅 33 次跨任务边界；agent 放弃边界前所写脚本的 74%；笔记只被追加、从不修订，矛盾靠日志裁定；代价最高的错误是把硬编码值带进不再成立的新任务。
Conclusion: 因为日志保留一切，agent 的遗忘是选择性的而非灾难性的：保留通用规则、丢弃关卡细节，靠重写而非复用来跨任务迁移知识。

papers.title: Closed-loop evaluation of LLM agents for embedded software development
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as coding agents that edit files, run builds and tests, inspect execution results, and repair software iteratively. Embedded firmware is a demanding target because correctness depends on closed-loop behavior under sensing, timing, and safety constraints, not only on static source quality. Yet embedded-agent evaluation remains limited and often emphasizes one-shot synthesis or offline correctness. We present a benchmark for closed-loop evaluation of embedded coding agents. Each task provides a plain-text engineering description, constrained workspace, and visible build-and-runtime surface. The agent must translate requirements into implementation and self-verification steps, then iterate until the required device behavior is achieved. The suite contains five embedded-control tasks and four feedback scenarios: one-shot generation, realistic self-verification, CI-style red/green feedback, and oracle-style detailed feedback. The implementation targets simulated ESP32 firmware for reproducibility. We evaluate seven GPT-family and Qwen-family configurations across five tasks and four scenarios, with three repetitions per condition for 420 runs. gpt-5.4 has the highest pass rate among evaluated configurations but does not saturate the benchmark; qwen3.5-27B is the strongest observed local model; and smaller local models degrade sharply in pass rate and search efficiency. These results suggest that capable local embedded coding agents are emerging.
papers.comment: Published in Journal of Systems Architecture 179 (2026) 103937. 23 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/jgcarrasco/closed_loop_evaluation_agents_embedded
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向嵌入式固件的闭环 (closed-loop) 编码 agent 基准：5 个嵌入式控制任务 × 4 种反馈场景（一次性生成、真实自验证、CI 式红绿反馈、oracle 式详细反馈），在模拟 ESP32 固件上跑 7 个 GPT/Qwen 配置、每条件 3 次共 420 次运行。gpt-5.4 通过率最高但未饱和基准，qwen3.5-27B 是最强本地模型，更小的本地模型在通过率与搜索效率上急剧退化。
Motivation: 嵌入式 agent 评测多停留在一次性代码合成或离线正确性，而固件正确性取决于传感、时序与安全约束下的闭环行为，缺少可复现的运行时反馈评测面。
Method: 每个任务给出纯文本工程描述、受限工作区与可见的构建-运行时表面，agent 需把需求转成实现与自验证步骤并迭代到目标设备行为；目标为模拟 ESP32 固件以保证可复现，四种反馈场景分别提供无反馈、自验证、CI 红绿信号与 oracle 详细反馈。
Result: 在 5 任务 × 4 场景 × 7 个配置（GPT 与 Qwen 系列）× 每条件 3 次重复共 420 次运行中，gpt-5.4 通过率最高但未饱和基准；qwen3.5-27B 为观测到的最强本地模型；更小的本地模型通过率与搜索效率均急剧下降。
Conclusion: 闭环反馈下的嵌入式编码评测显示能用的本地嵌入式编码 agent 正在出现，但当前最强配置仍未把该基准做到饱和。

papers.title: Learning to Retrieve: Internalizing Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models aim to generate explorable, 3D-consistent scene videos conditioned on camera trajectories. Existing approaches often rely on external memory systems that explicitly retrieve previously observed content to mitigate scene drift during long-horizon generation. However, these auxiliary memory pathways operate outside the model's internal generative dynamics, preventing the model from intrinsically learning when and what historical information should be retrieved. We propose to internalize memory retrieval into the generation process, allowing retrieval to emerge as an intrinsic behavior of the video world model rather than relying on an external memory system. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)}, which repurposes the model's persistent internal state as a memory for historical context. A camera-conditioned retrieval gate selectively accesses relevant historical information from this state, determining \textit{what to retrieve}, while a retrieval trigger determines \textit{when to retrieve}. We further supervise the trigger with a 3D re-visibility signal, activating retrieval when previously observed content re-enters the current view while otherwise preserving the existing context. Together, these components enable the model to intrinsically acquire memory retrieval behavior and incorporate relevant historical observations into generation without a separate retrieval pathway. Across multiple base models and camera-revisit benchmarks, L2R improves long-term scene consistency while eliminating the need for an external memory bank or 3D conditions. https://jkhu29.github.io/l2r
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: L2R 把外部记忆检索内化进视频世界模型的生成过程：用模型持久内部状态当历史记忆，相机条件检索门决定取什么、检索触发器决定何时取，并用 3D 重见信号监督触发。在多个基座模型与相机重访基准上，L2R 提升长时程场景一致性，同时去掉外部记忆库与 3D 条件输入。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型靠外部记忆系统显式检索已观测内容来抑制长时程生成的场景漂移，但这条辅助通路在模型内部生成动力学之外，模型学不到何时、该检索什么历史信息。
Method: 提出 Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)：把模型持久内部状态复用为历史上下文记忆；相机条件检索门 (camera-conditioned retrieval gate) 选择性访问该状态中相关历史，检索触发器 (retrieval trigger) 决定触发时机；触发器由 3D 重见信号 (3D re-visibility signal) 监督，仅在先前观测内容重新进入视野时激活检索，其余时候保持现有上下文。
Result: 在多个基座模型与相机重访 (camera-revisit) 基准上，L2R 改善长时程场景一致性，并消除对外部记忆库 (external memory bank) 与 3D 条件的需要；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 记忆检索可以作为视频世界模型的内在行为被学出来，无需独立的外部检索通路，也不必依赖 3D 条件输入。

papers.title: MotiveMob: Motivation as Semantic Action for Closed-Loop Human Mobility Generation
papers.abstract_en: Human mobility generation, an important task in urban research, synthesizes trajectory data for urban planning and transportation management. Human mobility can be characterized as a "why-where-when" decision process: people form an intention to move and then determine where and when the corresponding activity will take place. Trajectory generation under user-level and temporal distribution shifts may benefit from explicitly modeling this decision structure. However, many existing human mobility generation methods either represent behavioral intent at a coarse granularity, such as a daily plan or a trajectory-level description, or directly predict future locations without explicitly reasoning about a possible motivation for each movement step. We introduce MotiveMob, a motivation-driven autoregressive framework for human mobility generation that first forms a hypothesis about why the next movement may occur and then jointly generates where and when it may occur. At each step, a motivation predictor conditions on the current mobility state, a long-term behavioral report, and the mobility history to infer a plausible motivation or determine whether the trajectory should terminate. Given the hypothesized motivation, a state predictor grounds it in a candidate next location and arrival time. The candidate then undergoes speed-feasibility and repetition checks before being fed back for the next decision. We evaluate MotiveMob under distribution shifts involving unseen users and unseen temporal periods, including seasonal changes and the substantial behavioral disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Experiments show that MotiveMob consistently achieves better distributional fidelity than competitive pretraining-based and prompting-based methods under user-level and temporal distribution shifts, demonstrating robust generalization to out-of-distribution mobility patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotiveMob 把人类移动生成建模为「为什么-哪里-何时」的闭环自回归过程：每步先由 motivation predictor 推断下一步移动的动机（或判定轨迹终止），再由 state predictor 把动机落到候选地点与到达时间，候选经速度可行性与重复性检查后回灌下一步。在未见用户与未见时段（含季节变化与 COVID-19 行为扰动）的分布偏移下，其分布保真度持续优于基于预训练与基于提示的竞争方法。
Motivation: 现有移动生成方法要么把行为意图压到日计划或轨迹级描述这种粗粒度，要么直接预测未来位置而不显式推理每步移动的动机，在用户级与时序分布偏移下泛化不足。
Method: 动机驱动的自回归框架：motivation predictor 以当前移动状态、长期行为报告 (long-term behavioral report) 与移动历史为条件推断合理动机或决定终止；state predictor 将动机落到候选下一地点与到达时间；候选通过 speed-feasibility 与 repetition 检查后反馈进入下一决策，形成闭环。
Result: 在涉及未见用户与未见时段（含季节变化与 COVID-19 大流行造成的显著行为扰动）的分布偏移评测中，MotiveMob 的分布保真度 (distributional fidelity) 持续优于有竞争力的基于预训练 (pretraining-based) 与基于提示 (prompting-based) 的方法。
Conclusion: 显式建模「先想为什么、再定哪里何时」的决策结构，能让移动生成在用户级与时序分布偏移下保持对 OOD 移动模式的稳健泛化。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DLC: A Metric-Guided Dynamic Loss Controller for Multi-Objective Training
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a metric-guided dynamic loss controller (DLC) for multi-objective image restoration. Conventional image restoration pipelines usually train with a fixed weighted combination of multiple losses, without changing the relative importance of fidelity, perceptual similarity, and no-reference quality during optimization. DLC is an architecture- and loss-term-agnostic training-time controller: it does not modify the restoration architecture or introduce new differentiable loss terms, but dynamically reweights the existing training losses. During training, DLC periodically evaluates the current model on a small fixed feedback subset and uses the resulting quality metrics to update the loss-weight vector through an LLM-based controller. Because DLC operates on existing loss terms rather than task-specific architectures, the same controller formulation can be instantiated across diverse image restoration training pipelines. We evaluate DLC on three restoration domains: low-light image enhancement, deraining, and real-world super-resolution, using both reference-based and no-reference quality metrics. Across these settings, DLC considers metric-dependent trade-offs during optimization and guides training toward balanced operating points across fidelity and perceptual quality. The results show that DLC can move models toward more favorable operating points across different restoration domains, supporting its role as a practical plug-in controller for multi-objective image restoration.

TL;DR: DLC 是一个与架构、损失项均无关的训练期控制器：在固定反馈子集上周期性评测当前模型，用质量指标经 LLM 控制器更新损失权重向量，从而在保真度与感知质量之间动态重加权。在低光增强、去雨、真实世界超分三个图像复原域上，DLC 把训练推向跨保真与感知指标更均衡的工作点，可作为即插即用的多目标复原控制器。
Motivation: 图像复原通常用固定权重的多损失组合训练，保真度、感知相似性与无参考质量三者的相对重要性在优化过程中不随状态调整，导致单一固定权重难以兼顾不同质量维度。
Method: DLC 不改动复原架构、不引入新的可微损失项，只对既有训练损失做动态重加权：训练中周期性在小规模固定反馈子集上评测当前模型，把所得质量指标交给 LLM-based controller 输出新的损失权重向量；同一控制器形式可套用到不同复原训练流程。
Result: 在三个复原域（low-light image enhancement、deraining、real-world super-resolution）上评测，同时使用 reference-based 与 no-reference 质量指标；结果显示 DLC 在优化中权衡指标依赖的取舍，把模型推向跨保真度与感知质量更有利、更均衡的工作点。
Conclusion: 只操作既有损失项而不触碰任务架构的控制器，足以在多个图像复原域上改善多目标权衡，因此可作为通用的即插即用训练期组件。

papers.title: EchoDiST: Self-distillation-based joint learning for diffusion-conditioned echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation
papers.abstract_en: Motion estimation in echocardiography is essential for quantitative assessment of cardiac function and myocardial mechanics, but remains challenging due to image artifacts, limited image information, speckle decorrelation, and the scarcity of ground-truth displacement fields. Anatomy-guided approaches can provide structural information, yet often rely on expert-labeled myocardial segmentations. We propose EchoDiST, a framework for unsupervised echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation that integrates self-distillation-based joint learning with a diffusion-conditioned motion estimation network. Here, unsupervised motion estimation refers to learning without ground-truth displacement fields. The self-distillation strategy jointly optimizes anatomical segmentation and myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical annotations. Diffusion-based conditioning is used during training with stochastic perturbations, while inference requires only a single deterministic forward pass without iterative reverse-diffusion sampling. EchoDiST was evaluated on three echocardiographic datasets, including two external test datasets under cross-view and cross-dataset settings. Compared with seven representative learning-based methods, EchoDiST consistently improved anatomical alignment, myocardial strain assessment, and motion-derived functional and cardiac-phase assessment. These gains were statistically significant across the evaluated tasks and datasets. Overall, EchoDiST provides an effective approach for reliable myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical supervision and supports downstream quantitative assessment of cardiac function.

TL;DR: EchoDiST 在无真实位移场标注的条件下做超声心动图心肌运动估计：自蒸馏联合优化解剖分割与运动估计，扩散条件在训练时以随机扰动注入，推理只需一次确定性前向。在三个超声心动图数据集（含两个跨视角、跨数据集外部测试集）上对比七种学习型方法，解剖对齐、心肌应变与运动导出的心功能/时相评估均一致提升且统计显著。
Motivation: 超声心肌运动估计受图像伪影、信息有限、散斑去相关和真实位移场稀缺制约；解剖引导方法又依赖专家标注的心肌分割，标注受限时难以训练。
Method: EchoDiST 把基于自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 的联合学习与扩散条件运动估计网络结合：在有限解剖标注下同时优化分割与心肌运动估计；训练阶段用带随机扰动的扩散条件，推理阶段只做一次确定性前向，不做迭代反向扩散采样。

papers.title: BioBigBird: A Sparse Attention Model for Long-Range Dependency Processing in Biomedical Text
papers.abstract_en: While domain-specific Large Language Models (LLMs) have encoded vast biomedical knowledge, their limited context windows often hinder a deep understanding of nuanced relationships within and across texts. To address this limitation, we introduce BioBigBird, a bidirectional language model pre-trained on extensive biomedical literature and clinical data, specifically designed to handle long-range dependencies. BioBigBird leverages a sparse attention mechanism to process sequences up to 4096 tokens, and its training incorporates a multi-stage process to mitigate noise from the large-scale pre-training corpus. We further enhance its performance by employing a multi-task learning (MTL) framework that jointly optimizes for Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction. Comprehensive evaluations on the BLURB benchmark reveal that our MTL-enhanced BioBigBird achieves highly competitive results against state-of-the-art models. Our work contributes an effective methodology for developing powerful, long-context language models for specialized domains, demonstrating the value of extended sequence processing for complex text analysis. Our models are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/bisectgroup/biobigbird.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BioBigBird 是面向生物医学文本的长上下文双向语言模型，用稀疏注意力 (sparse attention) 把可处理序列扩到 4096 token，配合多阶段预训练降噪，并以多任务学习 (MTL) 联合优化命名实体识别 (NER) 与关系抽取 (RE)。在 BLURB 基准上，MTL 增强版达到与 SOTA 模型高度竞争的结果。
Motivation: 领域 LLM 虽编码了大量生物医学知识，但上下文窗口受限，难以深入理解文本内部及跨文本的细微关系。
Method: 在大规模生物医学文献与临床数据上预训练双向语言模型，用稀疏注意力机制处理最长 4096 token 的序列；训练采用多阶段流程以抑制大规模预训练语料中的噪声，再用 MTL 框架联合优化 NER 与 RE。
Result: 在 BLURB 基准上，MTL 增强的 BioBigBird 取得与 SOTA 模型高度竞争的结果；模型可处理序列长度达 4096 token，并已在 Hugging Face 公开发布。
Conclusion: 稀疏注意力加多阶段降噪与多任务联合优化，是为专业领域构建长上下文语言模型的有效方法，扩展序列处理对复杂文本分析有价值。

papers.title: Why machines will still not rule the world
papers.abstract_en: In our book Why machines will never rule the world [13, 14] we argue that arti- ficial general intelligence is mathematically impossible. This is because the human beings and the processes which exhibit intelligence are complex systems whose be- haviour cannot be captured by the kinds of models that we can generate with or without computers. Proponents of contemporary machine intelligence respond with two lines of argument: a theoretical one, grounded in the universal approximation theorems for neural networks and the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle; and an em- pirical one, grounded in rapidly rising scores on standardized benchmarks. In this communication we examine and reject both responses. First, we show serious issues in the physicalist counter-argument based on the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle. Second, we review recent evidence to the effect that prominent benchmarks are compromised by training-data contamination, flawed test construction, and strate- gic optimization. Our central argument remains: That models required to perform cognitive behaviour in open-ended, thermodynamically complex and non-ergodic environments are not and will not become achievable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 AGI 在数学上不可能：智能主体是复杂系统，其行为无法被可生成的模型（无论是否借助计算机）刻画，因此在开放、热力学复杂且非遍历的环境中执行认知行为的模型现在不可实现、将来也不会实现。作者据此驳斥两条常见反驳——基于万有逼近定理与 Church-Turing-Deutsch 原理的理论论证，以及基于标准基准分数上升的经验论证——并指出基准分数被训练数据污染、测试构造缺陷与策略性优化所破坏。
Motivation: 机器智能的辩护者用理论（万有逼近定理、Church-Turing-Deutsch 原理）与经验（基准分数快速上升）两条路线回应「AGI 不可能」的主张，需要分别检验其物理主义基础与经验证据的可靠性。
Method: 先审查基于 Church-Turing-Deutsch 原理的物理主义反论证并指出其严重问题，再综述近期证据说明主流基准受训练数据污染、测试构造缺陷与策略性优化影响，两条线共同支撑原有论点。
Result: 给出两条反驳路线的定性结论：Church-Turing-Deutsch 反论证存在严重问题；基准分数的上升可由训练数据污染、测试构造缺陷与策略性优化解释。全文为论证性 communication，无实验数字。
Conclusion: 在开放、热力学复杂且非遍历环境中执行认知行为所需的模型不可实现，且不会随技术进步变得可实现，因此当代机器智能的理论与经验辩护都不成立。

papers.title: Policy Alignment: New Signals for Membership Auditing in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model by aligning its policy with a teacher model on trajectories generated by the student model itself. Through this process, the student policy moves toward the teacher on the prompts used for distillation. However, these prompts are often private and costly, creating a need for prompt-level membership auditing. Existing methods mainly rely on likelihood-based confidence signals or student policy drift between checkpoints, but they do not capture the teacher-induced direction of the student update. In this paper, we propose Policy Alignment Membership Auditing (PAMA), a new auditing framework tailored for OPD. Our key observation is that a member prompt directly contributes to the teacher-guided policy update, while a non-member prompt only experiences indirect effects through cross-prompt generalization. Based on this directional trace, PAMA measures whether the student update moves toward reducing the teacher loss on a candidate prompt. Specifically, we introduce Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG) to estimate the teacher-aligned update direction from model outputs, and further combine it with student drift and uncertainty alignment signals for reliable membership auditing. We evaluate PAMA on six datasets and three teacher-student model families. On MATH, the primary evaluation benchmark, PAMA achieves AUC values of 0.791--0.941, improving AUC by 14.6--20.6% over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 on-policy distillation (OPD) 的成员推断审计框架 PAMA：成员 prompt 会直接参与教师引导的策略更新，非成员只经跨 prompt 泛化受到间接影响，据此用 Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG) 度量学生更新是否在降低该 prompt 上的教师损失。在 MATH 主基准上 AUC 达 0.791–0.941，比 SOTA 基线提升 14.6–20.6%。
Motivation: OPD 用的蒸馏 prompt 往往私有且昂贵，需要 prompt 级成员审计；现有方法依赖似然置信度或检查点间学生策略漂移，捕捉不到教师诱导的更新方向。
Method: PAMA 从模型输出估计教师对齐更新方向 Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG)，再与学生漂移 (student drift) 和不确定性对齐信号组合做成员判定，在六个数据集、三组教师-学生模型族上评测。
Result: 在 MATH 主评测基准上 AUC 为 0.791–0.941，相对 SOTA 基线提升 14.6–20.6%；评测覆盖六个数据集与三组教师-学生模型族。
Conclusion: 教师引导更新的方向性轨迹是比置信度与策略漂移更有效的成员审计信号，PAMA 借此在 OPD 场景下取得更高的审计 AUC。

papers.title: Causal-fate dynamics of unrealized influence
papers.abstract_en: Many dynamical systems generate influences whose consequences are not fully exhausted in the realized trajectory at the moment they arise. Such consequences are often treated as absent, delayed or statically stored, leaving unclear how unrealized influence retains future relevance as the system evolves. Here we formulate causal-fate dynamics, in which generated influence may be realized, remain latent, or be transformed by subsequent dynamics, and give an exact finite-transport representation when the relevant maps are specified. A connectome-constrained Caenorhabditis elegans model first motivates the biological hypothesis that unresolved inter-neuronal influence may persist and contribute to later propagation; it does not establish such a mechanism in living animals. We next examine operational Internet routing, where a dynamically updated cross-observer history retains predictive information beyond the current local route state. We then use the representation to construct a Transformer architecture that explicitly transports and selectively realizes latent contextual influence while retaining language-modeling function. The three studies distinguish a model-motivated scientific hypothesis, an observational phenomenon compatible with future-relevant history and an executable construction for carrying unrealized influence through subsequent computation.

TL;DR: 提出 causal-fate dynamics：把系统产生的影响分为已实现、潜伏 (latent)、被后续动力学改写三类，并在映射给定时给出精确的有限传输 (finite-transport) 表示。三项研究分别给出 C. elegans 连接组约束模型的生物学假设、Internet 路由中跨观测者历史超出当前本地路由状态的预测信息，以及一个显式传输并选择性实现潜伏上下文影响、同时保留语言建模功能的 Transformer 构造。
Motivation: 许多动力系统产生的影响在出现时刻并未在已实现轨迹中耗尽，通常被当作不存在、延迟或静态存储，导致潜伏影响如何随系统演化保持未来相关性这一问题悬而未决。
Method: 先形式化 causal-fate dynamics 并在相关映射给定时导出精确的有限传输表示；再用连接组约束的 C. elegans 模型提出未解析神经元间影响可能持续并贡献于后续传播的假设；随后在运行中的 Internet 路由上构造动态更新的跨观测者历史；最后据此构建一个显式传输并选择性实现潜伏上下文影响、同时保留语言建模功能的 Transformer 架构。
Result: 三项研究分别达成：连接组约束 C. elegans 模型给出模型驱动的生物学假设（不构成活体动物中该机制的证明）；Internet 路由中动态更新的跨观测者历史保留了超出当前本地路由状态的预测信息；Transformer 构造可执行地在后续计算中携带未实现影响并保持语言建模功能。
Conclusion: 未实现影响可以被显式表示为可传输、可选择实现的对象，并在动力系统、观测历史与神经计算三种载体中保持未来相关性；作者明确区分了模型假设、观测现象与可执行构造三种证据强度。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Missing Modality-Aware Calibration for Trustworthy Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal brain tumor segmentation typically leverages multiple MRI modalities, yet incomplete modality acquisition is common in clinical practice due to protocol heterogeneity and scan failures. Although recent methods maintain segmentation accuracy under missing modality conditions, they frequently overlook prediction reliability, leading to miscalibrated confidence estimates that hinder clinical adoption. Existing calibration techniques are largely modality-agnostic or assume that prediction difficulty decreases monotonically as additional modalities become available. However, in brain tumor segmentation, prediction difficulty depends primarily on which modalities are absent rather than how many, leading to combination-specific and spatially heterogeneous calibration errors. To address this, we propose Missing Modality-Aware Local Temperature Scaling (MMA-LTS), a post-hoc voxel-wise confidence calibration method. It estimates a spatially adaptive temperature field conditioned on a modality-availability learnable token and a voxel-wise difficulty score. Experiments on BraTS 2020 and FeTS 2024 show that MMA-LTS improves calibration while preserving the segmentation accuracy of state-of-the-art models across diverse missing-modality scenarios, thereby enhancing trustworthiness toward clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMA-LTS 是针对缺失模态脑肿瘤分割的事后逐体素置信度校准方法：预测难度取决于缺哪几个模态而非缺几个，因此用模态可用性可学习 token 与逐体素难度分数回归一个空间自适应温度场。在 BraTS 2020 与 FeTS 2024 的多种缺失模态场景下，它在保持 SOTA 分割精度的同时改善校准。
Motivation: 临床中 MRI 协议异构与扫描失败常导致模态不全，现有方法虽能保住分割精度却忽略预测可靠性；而通用校准技术要么与模态无关，要么假设模态越多难度单调下降，无法刻画按模态组合、空间不均的校准误差。
Method: 提出 Missing Modality-Aware Local Temperature Scaling (MMA-LTS)，一种 post-hoc 逐体素置信度校准方法：以模态可用性可学习 token 和逐体素难度分数为条件，估计空间自适应温度场，对已有 SOTA 分割模型做后处理。
Result: 在 BraTS 2020 与 FeTS 2024 上、覆盖多种缺失模态场景的实验中，MMA-LTS 改善校准，同时保持 SOTA 模型的分割精度。
Conclusion: 缺失模态下的置信度校准必须按具体模态组合与空间位置分别处理，而非按缺失数量统一缩放；post-hoc 温度场校准可在不损失分割精度的前提下提升临床部署可信度。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Rewiring Semantics, Dynamics, and Control: A Simple yet Effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent framework for complex robotic manipulation, building on the strong semantic understanding of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, such VLM backbones offer insufficient physical dynamics priors, which limits the generalization capabilities of robot policies. Recent efforts therefore integrate video-generation World Models (WMs) into robot policies through various strategies, using predictive dynamics to facilitate action generation. Despite these advances, harnessing semantic understanding and dynamics prediction as complementary guidance for action generation remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce $\mathrm{ACT}^3$, a simple yet effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer that fuses semantic and dynamics information into control actions while preserving the distinct roles of context streams. Specifically, $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ enables the dedicated action expert to access VLM and WM representations through layerwise attention, with each backbone attending only within its own stream. This straightforward interaction design maintains independent forward propagation in the context streams while allowing both backbones to be updated through control supervision. Experiments on both simulated and real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks show that the proposed $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ yields results superior to its counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACT³ 是面向机器人操作的 Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer：让专用 action expert 通过逐层注意力 (layerwise attention) 读取 VLM 与视频生成 World Model 的表征，而两个 backbone 只在各自流内做注意力，保持前向独立并同时接受控制监督。在仿真与真实机器人操作基准上优于对照方法。
Motivation: VLA 模型依赖预训练 VLM 的语义理解，但缺少物理动力学先验，导致策略泛化受限；把视频 World Model 接入策略时，语义理解与动力学预测难以作为互补信号共同指导动作生成。
Method: ACT³ 采用三流结构：VLM 流、World Model 流与 action expert。action expert 通过 layerwise attention 访问两个 backbone 的表征，两个 backbone 各自只在本流内注意力，前向保持独立，且都能通过控制监督 (control supervision) 反向更新。
Result: 在仿真与真实机器人操作基准上，ACT³ 的结果优于其对照方法 (counterparts)；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 让 action expert 单向读取语义与动力学两个 backbone、同时保持上下文流前向独立并共享控制监督，是融合语义与预测动力学生成动作的有效设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Refinement as a Service: Algorithmic Predictor Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Prediction aggregation aims to combine information from multiple predictors into a more informative one. We study this question in the setting of calibrated predictors, where each prediction must equal the conditional expectation of the quantity being predicted given the predictor's signal. Given several calibrated input predictors and the feature distribution, but not the underlying Bayes probabilities, we ask when one can construct refined calibrated predictors that preserve the information in the original predictors and cannot be further refined using the available information. We formulate calibrated predictors as signaling schemes and define refinement through feature-independent garblings: a predictor refines another if its signal can simulate the other's signal. Constructibility is characterized through observable linear information: each signal corresponds to a vector over the feature space, and a new signal is constructible exactly when its vector lies in the linear span of the input signal vectors. Under this formulation, we establish a sharp algorithmic picture. For deterministic output predictors, bilateral refinement admits a polynomial-time algorithm based on a bipartite graph between the two input signal partitions, while refinement with an arbitrary number of input predictors is $\mathsf{NP}$-hard. In contrast, when randomized output predictors are allowed, we give a polynomial-time algorithm for any number of input predictors by decomposing constructible signal vectors into extreme rays of the associated polyhedral cone.
papers.comment: A more compact version of the paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把校准预测器的精炼 (refinement) 形式化为信号方案，用与特征无关的 garbling 定义偏序，并证明可构造性等价于新信号向量落在输入信号向量的线性张成中。确定性输出下，双边精炼有多项式时间算法（基于两输入信号划分间的二部图），任意多个输入预测器的精炼是 NP-hard；允许随机化输出后，任意输入个数都可用多面体锥极射线 (extreme rays) 分解在多项式时间内求解。
Motivation: 预测聚合要在不知道底层 Bayes 概率、只有若干校准预测器与特征分布的条件下，判断能否构造出既保留原信息又无法再被精炼的预测器；此前缺少可构造性的刻画与算法边界。
Method: 把校准预测器建模为信号方案，用特征无关的 garbling 定义精炼偏序；将每个信号对应为特征空间上的向量，把可构造性化为线性张成判定。确定性情形用二部图给出双边精炼的多项式算法，随机化情形把可构造信号向量分解为关联多面体锥的极射线。
Result: 可构造性有精确刻画：新信号向量当且仅当落在输入信号向量的线性张成中。复杂度上，确定性输出的双边精炼是多项式时间，确定性输出下任意多个输入预测器的精炼是 NP-hard，而允许随机化输出时任意输入个数都有多项式时间算法。
Conclusion: 随机化输出是把精炼问题从 NP-hard 拉回多项式时间的关键开关；校准预测器的精炼可完全由可观测的线性信息决定，无需底层 Bayes 概率。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Fresco++: Frequency-Guided and Canonical-Consistent Optimization for Fine-Grained Head Avatar Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We propose Fresco++, a unified optimization framework for fine-grained and view-consistent head avatar reconstruction. Head avatar optimization is typically driven by per-view image supervision, which can lead to premature fitting of unstable high-frequency details and inconsistent local appearance across viewpoints. Fresco++ addresses these challenges by regulating both the progression of visual detail and the formation of cross-view supervision during optimization. For frequency-aware optimization, a progressive curriculum first stabilizes low-frequency structures and then introduces high-frequency constraints to recover fine facial and hair details without amplifying spurious responses at early stages. For cross-view optimization, we introduce Canonical Group Consensus, which associates local observations through shared canonical surface regions and establishes correspondence across different viewpoints. Geometric and visibility-aware screening removes unreliable observations, while the remaining multi-view evidence is aggregated in feature space to form a consensus target for supervising the current rendering. This design enforces local consistency without relying on a specific image-space parameterization and avoids additional rendering of the auxiliary view. Together, the frequency curriculum and canonical consensus provide stable optimization from coarse structures to fine details while maintaining coherent appearance across viewpoints. Extensive experiments on NeRSemble demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and cross-view consistency, while evaluations across diverse avatar representations further confirm the generality and transferability of Fresco++.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fresco++ 用频率课程学习先稳定低频结构再引入高频约束，并以 Canonical Group Consensus 在共享 canonical 表面区域上聚合多视角证据，抑制早期伪高频与跨视角外观不一致。在 NeRSemble 上重建质量与跨视角一致性均有提升，且在多种 avatar 表征上验证了通用性。
Motivation: 头像重建通常只靠逐视角图像监督，容易过早拟合不稳定的高频细节，且不同视角的局部外观互相矛盾。
Method: 两条优化路径并行：频率感知课程先锁定低频结构、后期再加高频约束以恢复面部与头发细节；跨视角部分提出 Canonical Group Consensus，把局部观测关联到共享 canonical 表面区域建立跨视角对应，经几何与可见性筛选剔除不可靠观测，再在特征空间聚合为共识目标监督当前渲染，不依赖特定 image-space 参数化也无需额外渲染辅助视角。
Result: 在 NeRSemble 上实验显示重建质量与跨视角一致性改善；在多种 avatar 表征上的评测进一步确认 Fresco++ 的通用性与可迁移性。
Conclusion: 同时调控细节递进与跨视角监督的形成，可让头像优化从粗结构稳定过渡到精细细节并保持跨视角外观一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把情绪事件形式化为 Condition-Affect-Effect 三阶段认知链，据此构建 TRACE-Bench（646 段视频、3,746 个多模态问答）评测大模型在真实社交场景中的情绪识别、调节解码、因果推理与全链重建。人机对比显示模型存在显著差距，且情绪专用模型普遍落后于通用 MLLM；配套的结构化推理方法 TRACER 在全部五项任务上超过所有被评基线。
Motivation: 情感计算已从类别识别走向开放式分析，但情绪在认知上是受评价、调节与社会解释驱动的展开过程，现有计算模型缺少对这一过程的刻画，也缺少能测出该过程的评测。
Method: TRACE 用 Condition、Affect、Effect 三阶段形式化情绪事件，把可观测线索与内部立场、情绪表露调节等认知因素结合；TRACE-Bench 据此设计五项任务（grounded affect recognition、regulation decoding、cause reasoning、effect reasoning、full-chain reconstruction），共 3,746 个结构化问答对、646 段视频。TRACER 让每步推理都绑定显式前提——事实观察、认知评价与已确立的上游结论——构成可追溯的中间结论与目标结论图。
Result: TRACE-Bench 含 3,746 个结构化问答对、覆盖 646 段视频；人与模型的对照显示模型存在显著性能差距，情绪专用模型也普遍落后于通用 MLLM。TRACER 在全部五项任务上均超过所有被评模型基线。
Conclusion: 把情绪当作可追溯的认知链来推理，比直接输出情绪标签更能覆盖真实社交场景中的因果与调节结构；模型的典型失败是把表露行为当成真实感受，以及在长链生成中编造无据事件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MC-TRCM: Observation-Aware Recursive Fusion for Incomplete Mobile and Wearable Mental-Health Feature Views
papers.abstract_en: Public mobile and wearable mental-health datasets often provide summarized feature tables rather than synchronized raw sensor streams. In these releases, each anchor corresponds to a survey or label time and may combine phone or wearable summaries, prior symptom scores, demographics, clinical variables, and source-availability indicators. We propose the Modality-Conditioned Temporal Recursive Context Model (MC-TRCM), which preserves each feature source as a separate token and incorporates missingness as part of the input context. Observed sources are encoded with values and missingness summaries, absent sources use learned absence tokens, dataset and task embeddings condition fusion, and a recursive prediction head refines each output over validation-selected steps. We evaluated MC-TRCM on six predefined endpoints from DepreST-CAT and Prediction of Severity Change-Depression (PSYCHE-D) using participant-level splits and validation-only model selection. MC-TRCM achieved the lowest mean absolute error on DepreST-CAT Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) and Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) severity, improving over the best tabular reference by 0.181 and 0.217 scale points. Classification endpoints showed task-dependent behavior: MC-TRCM matched the best rounded GAD-7 category balanced accuracy, was numerically highest by 0.002 balanced-accuracy points on PSYCHE-D multiclass prediction, and remained close to the strongest references on PHQ-9 category and PSYCHE-D binary prediction. Ablations support Feature-wise Linear Modulation, absence tokens, missingness projections, and recursive refinement, while calibration and feature-source controls characterize endpoint behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/MC-TRCM.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICONIP 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/MC-TRCM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MC-TRCM 把手机/可穿戴心理健康数据的每个特征源保留为独立 token，并把缺失本身作为输入上下文（缺失源用学习到的 absence token），配合数据集与任务 embedding 条件化融合及递归预测头逐步细化输出。在 DepreST-CAT 与 PSYCHE-D 的六个预定义端点上，PHQ-9 与 GAD-7 严重程度的 MAE 相对最佳表格基线分别改善 0.181 与 0.217 分；分类端点表现依任务而异，PSYCHE-D 多分类 balanced accuracy 数值上最高但仅领先 0.002。
Motivation: 公开移动与可穿戴心理健康数据集通常只提供汇总特征表而非同步原始传感器流，各锚点混合手机/可穿戴摘要、既往症状评分、人口学与临床变量，且来源可用性参差，常规表格模型把缺失当作噪声而非上下文。
Method: Modality-Conditioned Temporal Recursive Context Model (MC-TRCM)：观测源用数值加缺失摘要编码，缺失源用学习到的 absence token，dataset 与 task embedding 条件化融合，递归预测头按验证集选定的步数迭代细化输出；消融覆盖 Feature-wise Linear Modulation、absence token、missingness projection 与递归细化，采用 participant-level 划分与仅用验证集做模型选择。
Result: 在 DepreST-CAT 与 PSYCHE-D 的六个端点上：DepreST-CAT 的 PHQ-9 与 GAD-7 严重程度 MAE 相对最佳表格参考分别改善 0.181 与 0.217 分；GAD-7 类别 balanced accuracy 与最佳参考打平（四舍五入后），PSYCHE-D 多分类 balanced accuracy 数值最高但仅高 0.002，PHQ-9 类别与 PSYCHE-D 二分类接近最强参考。
Conclusion: 把缺失模式显式建模为条件上下文并按模态条件化融合，可在心理健康严重程度回归端点上稳定降低 MAE；分类端点的收益依任务而定，需配合 calibration 与特征源控制来判读。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Distributional Fidelity: Causal-Penalized Diffusion for Synthetic Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tabular generators are commonly optimized for distributional fidelity, but statistical similarity alone does not guarantee preservation of causal effects. In this paper, we study whether causal fidelity can be improved directly within a fully generative tabular model. Causal Fidelity is defined with respect to a target estimand as the discrepancy between inferential distributions obtained from real and synthetic data, and theoretical results show that high statistical fidelity does not generally imply high causal fidelity. We then propose a causal-fidelity-aware training framework which adds a causal discrepancy penalty to the generative objective. The framework is instantiated with a causal-penalized TabDDPM and optimized using an on-policy score-function estimator. We further establish conditions under which causal regularization improves expected causal fidelity. Experiments across diverse treatment-effect simulations and two benchmark datasets evaluate the ability of our method to improve causal fidelity while preserving competitive statistical fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 合成表格数据只优化分布保真度并不保证因果效应被保留，论文把因果保真度定义为真实数据与合成数据在目标 estimand 上推断分布的差异，并证明高统计保真度一般不蕴含高因果保真度。在生成目标上加入因果差异惩罚，实例化为 causal-penalized TabDDPM 并用 on-policy score-function 估计器优化，可提升因果保真度同时保持有竞争力的统计保真度。
Motivation: 合成表格生成器普遍只按分布相似度训练，但统计相似不保证处理效应等因果推断结论在合成数据上可复现，导致下游因果分析失真。
Method: 提出因果保真度感知训练框架：在生成目标上加因果差异惩罚，实例化为 causal-penalized TabDDPM，用 on-policy score-function 估计器优化；并给出因果正则化改善期望因果保真度的成立条件。
Result: 在多种处理效应模拟与两个基准数据集上实验，检验该方法在保持有竞争力的统计保真度的同时提升因果保真度；理论结果表明高统计保真度一般不蕴含高因果保真度。
Conclusion: 因果保真度需作为独立于分布保真度的训练目标直接优化，加入因果惩罚并满足给定条件时可改善期望因果保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Physics-Constrained Implicit Profile Network for Continuous Reconstruction of Tropical Cyclone Near-Surface Wind Profiles
papers.abstract_en: Near the ocean surface, tropical cyclone winds change rapidly with height, but direct measurements are limited because aircraft dropsondes provide only sparse and irregular observations. Continuous wind profiles are important for understanding hurricane boundary-layer processes, improving storm-surge prediction, supporting offshore engineering, and assessing coastal hazards. In this study, we developed an artificial intelligence model that combines machine learning with physical principles to reconstruct continuous wind profiles from sparse observations. The model is designed to preserve the observed surface winds while generating realistic changes in wind speed and direction with height. Tests using more than two decades of NOAA hurricane observations show that the method accurately reproduces the vertical structure of tropical cyclone winds over a wide range of storm intensities. The framework can also extend satellite-derived surface wind measurements into three-dimensional near-surface wind fields, providing new opportunities for hurricane research, operational forecasting, and engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理约束隐式剖面网络 (physics-constrained implicit profile network)，从稀疏 dropsonde 观测重建热带气旋近地面连续风速风向剖面，并强制保留实测地面风。用 NOAA 二十多年飓风观测检验，能再现宽强度范围内的垂直结构，还可把卫星反演地面风外推成三维近地面风场。
Motivation: 海面附近风随高度变化剧烈，而飞机 dropsonde 观测稀疏且不规则，缺少连续剖面会限制飓风边界层过程理解、风暴潮预报与沿海灾害评估。
Method: 机器学习与物理原理结合的隐式剖面网络：以稀疏观测为条件生成随高度连续的风速与风向变化，约束条件是保留实测地面风并保证随高度的变化物理上合理；检验数据为 NOAA 二十多年的飓风观测。
Result: 在 NOAA 二十多年飓风观测上，方法在很宽的风暴强度范围内准确再现了热带气旋风的垂直结构；同一框架可把卫星反演的地面风外推为三维近地面风场。
Conclusion: 物理约束的隐式剖面重建能把稀疏 dropsonde 变成连续近地面风剖面，并可作为卫星地面风向三维风场扩展的通用框架，服务于飓风研究、业务预报与工程应用。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Learning from Hetero Density for Cryo-EM Protein Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing protein structures from cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) maps is essential for understanding macromolecular assemblies. Although learning-based methods have improved protein reconstruction, information from hetero components remains underused. Our analysis finds both false predictions and reference protein sites near hetero components; filtering nearby candidates can improve or impair chain construction. We introduce CryoCue, a framework that uses hetero information to guide protein reconstruction. An anchor-supervised detector learns hetero representations across five component classes. Multiscale hetero features guide backbone localization, while predicted hetero candidates condition structure refinement through their class, confidence, and frame-relative geometry. Experiments show that CryoCue improves backbone localization near hetero components and achieves more accurate protein structure reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CryoCue 用 cryo-EM 图中的异质组分 (hetero components) 引导蛋白骨架重建：锚点监督检测器学习五类组分表征，多尺度 hetero 特征引导 backbone 定位，预测出的组分候选以类别、置信度和相对坐标系几何 (frame-relative geometry) 条件化结构精修。实验显示它改善了 hetero 组分附近的 backbone 定位并得到更准确的蛋白结构重建。
Motivation: 学习型 cryo-EM 蛋白重建对 hetero 组分信息利用不足，而分析发现 hetero 组分附近既有错误预测也有参考蛋白位点，简单过滤邻近候选反而可能改善或损害链构建。
Method: CryoCue 包含锚点监督的 hetero 检测器（跨五个组分类别学习表征）、用于 backbone 定位的多尺度 hetero 特征，以及以候选的类别、置信度和 frame-relative geometry 为条件的结构精修模块。
Result: 实验表明 CryoCue 改善了 hetero 组分附近的 backbone 定位，并实现更准确的蛋白结构重建；组分检测覆盖五类 component。
Conclusion: hetero 组分信息应作为引导信号而非简单过滤规则参与蛋白重建，检测与精修联合条件化能提升结构准确性。

papers.title: GroundSight at GroundLM 2026 Shared Tasks: GoldenViewVQA
papers.abstract_en: GoldenViewVQA requires models to jointly answer driving-scene questions and identify the camera view containing the supporting visual evidence, making precise evidence localization as important as answer correctness. We present \textbf{CoVeR-VQA}, a training-free multi-stage verification and correction framework for grounded multi-view VQA. Starting from GPT-5.6 zero-shot predictions, CoVeR-VQA progressively applies view-specific verification with Gemini-3.6-Flash, prior-guided joint verification with Claude-Opus-5, and cross-split group-level verification that exploits semantically filtered question groups from shared multi-view scenes and validation-derived prior knowledge. On the official GoldenViewVQA test set, the four-stage CoVeR-VQA pipeline achieves 84.75\% Joint Accuracy, improving the GPT-5.6 zero-shot baseline by 13.56 percentage points, while reaching 94.92\% Answer Accuracy and 86.44\% View Accuracy. The final submitted run achieves 88.14\% Joint Accuracy after two additional evaluator-informed post-hoc corrections. papers.title: WAM-Cache: Staleness-Bounded KV Reuse for Efficient World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) enable generalist robot manipulation by conditioning an action expert on representations from a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). In closed-loop control, the video DiT runs at every chunk to encode the current observation into layerwise key-value (KV) pairs that the action expert queries. This prefill dominates the per-chunk computational cost, yet existing training-free accelerations leave it fully dense. We present WAM-Cache, a training-free framework that retains layerwise key-value representations across chunks and recomputes only a sparse refresh set of tokens. Crucially, we find that the intuitive heuristic of refreshing visually drifted tokens plateaus far below the dense baseline, even with an oracle predicting ground-truth KV drift. Downstream action accuracy is instead governed by where the action expert attends, not by what moved. WAM-Cache therefore selects the refresh set by uniting the action expert's cross-attention with visual latent surprise, complemented by a strict age bound that suppresses compounding error. On Fast-WAM, WAM-Cache cuts video DiT prefill FLOPs by 32-42% across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world experiments, while staying within 0.7-1.8 percentage points of the dense policy in simulation and 2.5 points on a real robot.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://dingkai0302.github.io/wam-cache/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAM-Cache 是面向 World Action Model 闭环控制的免训练 KV 复用框架：跨 chunk 保留视频 DiT 的逐层 key-value，只稀疏刷新一小部分 token，刷新集由 action expert 的 cross-attention 与 visual latent surprise 共同选定，并加严格 age bound 抑制误差累积。在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 与真实机器人上把视频 DiT prefill FLOPs 削减 32–42%，动作精度相对 dense policy 在仿真只低 0.7–1.8 个百分点、真机低 2.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 闭环控制中视频 DiT 每个 chunk 都要对当前观测做 prefill，主导单 chunk 计算开销；已有免训练加速手段仍让 prefill 完全 dense，而按视觉漂移刷新 token 的直觉启发式即使有 oracle 也远低于 dense 基线。
Method: 跨 chunk 保留视频 DiT 的逐层 KV 表示，只重算稀疏刷新集；刷新集由 action expert 的 cross-attention 与 visual latent surprise 联合选择，再加严格 age bound 限制陈旧 KV 的累积误差。整个框架免训练，作用于以预训练视频 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 表示为条件的 action expert。
Result: 在 Fast-WAM 上，RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 与真实实验中视频 DiT prefill FLOPs 降低 32–42%；仿真中动作精度距 dense policy 仅 0.7–1.8 个百分点，真机上差 2.5 个百分点。仅按视觉漂移刷新的启发式（含 oracle 预测真实 KV 漂移）表现远低于 dense 基线并早早平台化。
Conclusion: 下游动作精度由 action expert 关注的位置决定，而非哪些 token 视觉上移动了，因此刷新集应按 cross-attention 加 surprise 选取并配合 age bound，而不是按视觉漂移。

papers.title: Estimating great expectations under autoregressive language models with potentials
papers.abstract_en: Many applications of language models hinge not on individual samples but on the expectation of a test functional under the model. Estimating such expectations reliably can be computationally expensive. In this paper, we show how to make estimation more efficient by exploiting the next-token conditional probabilities which are available as a by-product of sampling. We do so through potentials: real-valued functions on prefixes that decompose the test functional additively. We construct an estimator whose variance depends on the chosen potential, and derive conditions under which a potential reduces this variance. We then develop practical potentials for several estimands and applications, and demonstrate substantial variance reductions across several estimands at comparable computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对自回归语言模型下测试泛函期望的蒙特卡洛估计，提出用前缀上的势函数 (potentials) 对泛函做加性分解，复用采样时已有的 next-token 条件概率构造方差更小的估计量。推导了势函数降低方差的条件，并为多个 estimand 构造实用势函数，在相近计算成本下取得显著方差下降。
Motivation: 许多语言模型应用关心的不是单个样本而是某测试泛函在模型下的期望，直接采样估计计算代价高；而 next-token 条件概率本就作为采样的副产品存在，此前未被用来降低期望估计的方差。
Method: 定义前缀上的实值势函数，使测试泛函可加性分解；利用采样过程中可得的 next-token 条件概率构造新估计量，其方差依赖于所选势函数，并推导势函数能降低方差的充分条件；再针对多个 estimand 与应用场景设计具体势函数。
Result: 在多个 estimand 上，所构造的势函数估计量在相近计算成本下实现了显著的方差下降 (substantial variance reductions)。
Conclusion: 把采样副产品中的条件概率编码进势函数，可以在不增加计算成本的前提下系统性降低语言模型期望估计的方差；方差是否下降取决于势函数是否满足推导出的条件。

papers.title: CoPoE: Multimodal Fusion via Decomposable Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts for Missing-Modality Alzheimer's Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis benefits from integrating heterogeneous clinical, imaging, genomic, and biomarker evidence, but clinical cohorts frequently suffer from irregular modality missingness. Existing fusion methods often synthesize absent inputs, risking the introduction of artificial surrogates, or pool available signals into uninterpretable latent spaces. We present CoPoE (Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts), a disease-coordinate framework that maps multimodal evidence into a structured latent space partitioned into four distinct biological and clinical axes: genetic Risk, molecular Pathology, Neurodegeneration, and clinical Stage (R/P/N/S). Each observed modality parameterizes a diagonal Gaussian expert over the full RPNS vector, and a masked Product-of-Experts architecture fuses only the available modalities. Consequently, absent modalities add no factor to the fusion path, allowing the network to preserve a robust, decomposable posterior for any non-empty modality subset without synthetic imputation in the RPNS path. Through extensive missing-modality experiments on the ADNI dataset, CoPoE achieves the best all-modality performance and the highest mean AUROC across all 15 observed-subset evaluations among standardized missing-modality fusion baselines under a shared non-PET ADNI embedding benchmark, while substantially improving raw-probability ECE, Brier score, and NLL. Furthermore, PET-supervised probing shows evidence enrichment within the pathology (P) block under full modalities, with tau-related signal retained even when direct fluid biospecimen inputs are withheld. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/CoPoE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoPoE 把多模态 AD 证据映射到由遗传风险、分子病理、神经退行、临床分期四轴构成的 RPNS 结构化潜空间，每个观测模态给出一个对角高斯 expert，用 masked Product-of-Experts 只融合现存模态，缺失模态不进入融合路径因而无需合成填补。在 ADNI 缺失模态实验中，它在全部 15 种观测子集评测上取得最高平均 AUROC，并显著改善 ECE、Brier score 与 NLL。
Motivation: 临床队列的模态缺失不规则，现有融合方法要么合成缺失输入引入人工替代物，要么把可用信号池化进不可解释的潜空间，导致诊断证据无法按生物学轴分解。
Method: CoPoE（Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts）将每种观测模态参数化为覆盖完整 RPNS 向量的对角高斯 expert，再用 masked Product-of-Experts 只对可用模态做乘积融合，缺失模态不贡献因子，从而对任意非空模态子集保持可分解后验；实验在 ADNI 上做缺失模态评测，与标准化缺失模态融合基线在共享的 non-PET ADNI embedding benchmark 上对比，并用 PET-supervised probing 检查病理块内的证据富集。
Result: 在 ADNI 上，CoPoE 取得全模态最佳性能，并在全部 15 种观测子集评测中获得最高平均 AUROC，同时显著改善 raw-probability ECE、Brier score 与 NLL；PET-supervised probing 显示全模态下病理 (P) 块内证据富集，即使直接的体液生物标志输入被扣留，tau 相关信号仍被保留。
Conclusion: 按生物学坐标组织的可分解后验加 masked Product-of-Experts，可以在不合成填补的前提下对任意非空模态子集做稳健且可解释的 AD 诊断融合。

papers.title: TypedBench: A Benchmark for Calibration, Framing Sensitivity, and Cost in System One Decision Models
papers.abstract_en: System One models output calibrated probabilities over typed answers such as categorical choices, ordinal levels, or binary outcomes, via a non-generative interface. Software can act on these probabilities through thresholds, cost-weighted choices, and escalation rules. Consequently, if these probabilities are miscalibrated or wording-sensitive, the software ma take unintended actions leaving human operators with no textual rationale to inspect. Current evaluations largely report accuracy and calibration on public classification datasets without a clear reference. We present TypedBench, a benchmark for typed decision models like Jev built from seven policy-labelled generators and nine evaluation suites. We report accuracy as median and range across paraphrases, and calibration error relative to the finite-sample noise floor of a matched, perfectly calibrated predictor. We assess probability quality through selective prediction, ordinal proper scoring rules, and realised cost under asymmetric cost matrices. We evaluate a hosted model, an open encoder, and a family of open decoders spanning 0.8B-9B parameters on identical items. The hosted model follows the stated policy but is wording-sensitive and systematically underconfident; under asymmetric costs, using its probabilities can be worse than taking its top answer. Decoders route exactly and are slow as options or questions are added. The decoder is least accurate on policy questions and degrades with more options. Overall, typed decision models must be evaluated jointly on policy adherence, wording robustness, probability quality, and induced decision outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TypedBench 把类型化决策模型的评测从单一准确率扩展到四条联合轴：政策遵循、措辞鲁棒性、概率质量与诱导决策结果。在七个政策标注生成器与九个评测套件上，托管模型遵循给定政策但对措辞敏感且系统性欠自信，在非对称成本下用其概率反而可能比直接取 top1 更差；开放解码器路由精确但随选项与问题增加变慢，且在政策类问题上准确率最低、随选项增多而下降。
Motivation: System One 模型输出可被软件按阈值、成本加权和升级规则直接执行的类型化概率，一旦概率失准或对措辞敏感就会触发非预期动作且无文本理由可查；现有评测只在公开分类数据集上报准确率与校准，缺少参照基准。
Method: 构建 TypedBench：由七个政策标注生成器 (policy-labelled generators) 与九个评测套件组成，对同一题目评测一个托管模型、一个开放 encoder 与参数量 0.8B–9B 的一族开放 decoder；指标包括跨改写的准确率中位数与区间、相对匹配的完美校准预测器有限样本噪声底的校准误差、selective prediction、序数 proper scoring rules，以及非对称成本矩阵下的 realised cost。
Result: 托管模型遵循所述政策但对措辞敏感并系统性欠自信，在非对称成本下使用其概率可能比取其 top answer 更差；开放 decoder 路由完全精确，但随选项与问题增多而变慢，在政策类问题上准确率最低并随选项数增加而退化。
Conclusion: 类型化决策模型必须在政策遵循、措辞鲁棒性、概率质量与诱导决策结果四条轴上联合评测，单看准确率与校准不足以判断其可部署性。

summary_sections.motivation: System One 模型输出可被软件按阈值、成本加权和升级规则直接执行的类型化概率，一旦概率失准或对措辞敏感就会触发非预期动作且无文本理由可查；现有评测只在公开分类数据集上报准确率与校准，缺少参照基准。

summary_sections.result: 托管模型遵循所述政策但对措辞敏感并系统性欠自信，在非对称成本下使用其概率可能比取其 top answer 更差；开放 decoder 路由完全精确，但随选项与问题增多而变慢，在政策类问题上准确率最低并随选项数增加而退化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 类型化决策模型必须在政策遵循、措辞鲁棒性、概率质量与诱导决策结果四条轴上联合评测，单看准确率与校准不足以判断其可部署性。

papers.title: Sequential Conditional Independence Testing with Machine Learning Models
papers.abstract_en: Conditional independence testing is a ubiquitous problem in scientific discovery. The widely employed model-X assumption shifts the modelling burden from the dependence of the output on the inputs to the dependencies within the inputs. Log-optimal e-variables have been studied in this setting, but it remains unclear how to incorporate machine learning models into their design. Other approaches test exchangeability directly, yielding an e-variable with lower power in theory but, surprisingly, higher power in practice. We explain this phenomenon by decomposing the error into null enlargement, approximation, and estimation error. The decomposition shows that GRO e-variable estimates can be beaten because of their worse approximation and estimation errors, and we explore intermediate null hypotheses between model-X conditional independence and exchangeability to reduce these errors. Moreover, the model-X assumption often only holds up to an estimation error, invalidating exact type-I error guarantees. We provide estimation error bounds that accommodate triple robustness results, achieving fast convergence rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在条件独立性检验中，直接检验 exchangeability 得到的 e-variable 理论功效更低但实践功效反而更高；论文把误差分解为 null enlargement、approximation 与 estimation 三部分来解释这一反直觉现象，并指出 model-X 假设常只在估计误差意义下成立，会破坏精确的 type-I error 保证。据此在 model-X 条件独立与 exchangeability 之间引入中间原假设以压低近似与估计误差，并给出兼容 triple robustness 的估计误差界与快速收敛速率。
Motivation: model-X 假设把建模负担从输出对输入的依赖转到输入内部依赖，但该假设常只在估计误差内成立，使精确 type-I error 保证失效；同时 log-optimal e-variable（GRO）如何纳入机器学习模型仍不清楚，且其理论更优却实践更弱。
Method: 在 model-X 框架下设计 log-optimal e-variable 并引入机器学习模型；把总误差分解为 null enlargement、approximation、estimation 三项来比较 GRO 与直接检验 exchangeability 的 e-variable；在两个极端之间构造中间原假设，并给出可容纳 triple robustness 的估计误差界。
Result: 误差分解显示 GRO e-variable 估计被超越的原因是其 approximation 与 estimation error 更差；直接检验 exchangeability 的 e-variable 理论功效更低但实际功效更高；所给估计误差界兼容 triple robustness 并达到快速收敛速率。
Conclusion: 条件独立检验的功效差异可由三部分误差分解解释，缩小近似与估计误差的中间原假设是改进方向，且 model-X 下的 type-I error 保证必须按估计误差界重新表述。

papers.title: RISR: Residual-Informed Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression combines structural search with numerical fitting, but aggregate fit scores do not describe how the remaining error varies across inputs. We introduce RISR, a residual-informed method that uses these error patterns to guide formula discovery and learn which corrections are worth fitting. A residual encoder compresses aligned inputs, targets, current predictions, and residuals into continuous tokens that condition a language model to propose formulas. For subsequent refinement, a dual-view relational encoder uses additive and regularized multiplicative residuals to predict the post-fit utility of candidate corrections. We evaluate RISR on scientific tasks from the LLM-SRBench. RISR achieves 63.57% and 38.50% ID accuracy at the 1% and 0.1% pointwise relative-error tolerances, respectively. The corresponding OOD accuracies are 56.07% and 38.24%. RISR outperforms the reported baselines using the same backbone. The results show that our residual-informed approach can improve numerical equation recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RISR 用残差模式而非整体拟合分数来引导符号回归：残差编码器把输入、目标、当前预测与残差压成连续 token 去条件化 LLM 提公式，双视图关系编码器再预测候选修正拟合后的效用。在 LLM-SRBench 上，1% 与 0.1% 逐点相对误差容差下 ID 准确率分别为 63.57% 与 38.50%，OOD 为 56.07% 与 38.24%，同 backbone 下超过已报告基线。
Motivation: 符号回归的结构搜索加数值拟合只看整体拟合分数，无法刻画剩余误差在输入上的分布，因而无法判断哪些修正值得再拟合。
Method: 残差编码器将对齐的输入、目标、当前预测与残差编码为连续 token，条件化语言模型提出公式；精修阶段用双视图关系编码器，以加性残差与正则化乘性残差预测候选修正的拟合后效用。
Result: 在 LLM-SRBench 科学任务上，1% 逐点相对误差容差下 ID 准确率 63.57%、OOD 56.07%；0.1% 容差下 ID 38.50%、OOD 38.24%；在相同 backbone 下优于已报告基线。
Conclusion: 把残差的空间分布信息注入公式提出与修正筛选，可以提升数值方程恢复的准确率，且在分布外设定下仍保持该优势。

papers.title: Environmental Feedback Modeling Matters: Rethinking Feedback Treatment in Agentic Hindsight Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is commonly used to train language agents in interactive environments, but cannot be directly applied when rewards are unavailable. Recent methods use environmental feedback as privileged context for hindsight self-distillation, but our analysis suggests that simply conditioning the teacher on feedback is insufficient, motivating us to rethink how environmental feedback is used in agentic self-distillation. Given that environmental feedback contains rich supervision for modeling how the environment responds to agent actions, we introduce \textit{agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling} (SELF), a framework that jointly optimizes environmental feedback modeling and hindsight self-distillation. SELF learns to predict environmental responses while distilling guidance from a feedback-conditioned self-teacher into the policy. Our analysis reveals a mutually reinforcing mechanism: environmental feedback modeling strengthens hindsight supervision and policy learning, while self-distillation enhances the model's ability to model environmental feedback. With Qwen3-8B, SELF outperforms SDPO and GRPO by 6.4 and 4.1 percentage points in $τ$-bench success rate, and by 10.71 and 3.57 percentage points in AppWorld task goal completion, respectively. These results show that SELF uses environmental feedback more effectively within agentic self-distillation, improving agent capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SELF 把环境反馈建模与 hindsight 自蒸馏联合优化：用反馈条件化的自教师蒸馏策略，同时训练模型预测环境对动作的响应，两者互相增强。在 Qwen3-8B 上，τ-bench 成功率比 SDPO 和 GRPO 分别高 6.4 和 4.1 个百分点，AppWorld 任务目标完成率分别高 10.71 和 3.57 个百分点。
Motivation: 无奖励的交互环境中无法直接做强化学习，现有方法把环境反馈当特权上下文喂给教师，但仅以反馈为条件不足以让反馈中的监督真正进入策略学习。
Method: SELF 框架联合优化环境反馈建模与 hindsight 自蒸馏：模型学习预测环境对 agent 动作的响应，同时从以反馈为条件的自教师 (self-teacher) 蒸馏指导到策略；分析给出双向增强机制。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，SELF 相比 SDPO 与 GRPO 在 τ-bench 成功率上分别高出 6.4 和 4.1 个百分点，在 AppWorld 任务目标完成率上分别高出 10.71 和 3.57 个百分点。
Conclusion: 环境反馈不应只作为教师的条件输入，而应作为显式建模目标与自蒸馏联合优化，才能更有效地提升 agent 能力。

papers.title: PlanWAM: Planning-Shaped Future Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: World models in end-to-end autonomous driving predict future scene evolution to provide foresight for trajectory planning. Existing methods mainly study how to predict the future and how to use it, but less often ask which future representation is actually most useful for planning. To this end, we propose PlanWAM, a Planning-Shaped World Action Model. The key idea is to let the planning task shape the future-state representation, so that it retains the information most useful for planning. A latent world model then predicts this planning-shaped future latent representation from historical observations and uses it for planning, enabling foresighted planning. Specifically, we first use a Temporal Register Pyramid to compress multi-frame historical information in a recency-aware manner, learning a compact history representation oriented toward future reasoning and planning. We then introduce a privileged future posterior branch that observes ground-truth future frames, and shape its future latent representation with trajectory-planning objectives to obtain a planning-shaped future latent representation. Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation trains a prior branch that depends only on history to predict this future latent representation. The predicted future latent representation serves as planning context and guides trajectory generation and selection. PlanWAM achieves 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest and reaches 38.7 HD-Score on closed-loop HUGSIM in a zero-shot setting, demonstrating leading planning performance across both open-loop and closed-loop evaluations. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that planning-shaped future representations provide an effective and deployable form of foresight for world-action models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlanWAM 让规划任务本身塑造未来状态表征：用 Temporal Register Pyramid 压缩历史帧，特权未来后验分支在真实未来帧上以轨迹规划目标塑形未来 latent，再由 Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation 训练只依赖历史的先验分支去预测它，作为规划上下文生成与筛选轨迹。在 NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest 上取得 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS，闭环 HUGSIM 零样本 38.7 HD-Score，说明规划塑形的未来表征是端到端自动驾驶中可用的预见形式。
Motivation: 现有世界模型研究多集中在如何预测未来、如何使用预测，却很少回答哪种未来表征对规划最有用；与天气或降水预报无关，属自动驾驶规划问题。
Method: 三段式：Temporal Register Pyramid 以近因感知方式压缩多帧历史，得到面向未来推理的紧凑历史表征；特权未来后验分支观测真实未来帧，用轨迹规划目标塑形其 latent；Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation 训练仅依赖历史的先验分支预测该 latent，预测结果作为规划上下文引导轨迹生成与选择。
Result: NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest 上 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS；闭环 HUGSIM 零样本设置下 38.7 HD-Score；作者称在开环与闭环评测中均达到领先规划性能。
Conclusion: 规划塑形的未来表征是 world-action model 一种有效且可部署的预见形式，端到端自动驾驶的未来预测应由规划目标而非通用重建目标来塑形。

papers.title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoKnow 把 AI 生成图像检测的持续适应形式化为取证知识演化：保留基础域学到的共享取证基座，为新生成器增量挂载隔离的残差专家，并用闭式更新的 Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) 按当前阶段生成图像与累积充分统计量检索专家，全程免回放。在每到达生成器仅 10 张生成图像的设定下，非基础 GenImage 生成器平均准确率 96.70%，Chameleon 上 94.48%（无需目标基准适配）；严格免回放协议下阶段平均准确率 96.32%、平均遗忘 4.32%。
Motivation: 检测器在固定生成器域上训练，新模型不断涌现时难以维护：回放历史生成图像成本高，而用有限当前域数据更新共享参数会覆盖先前的取证知识。
Method: 免回放框架 EvoKnow：保留基础域的共享取证基座，为互补的生成器相关证据增量添加隔离的残差专家；Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) 由当前阶段生成图像与累积充分统计量闭式更新，负责专家检索，形成持续学习流程。
Result: 每个到达生成器仅 10 张生成图像时，非基础 GenImage 生成器平均准确率 96.70%，Chameleon 上 94.48%（无目标基准适配）；严格免回放持续学习协议下阶段平均准确率 96.32%，平均遗忘 4.32%，达到 SOTA 持续学习性能，并展示跨生成器泛化、少样本扩展与长时程持续适应。
