papers.title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology report generation can automatically generate clinical descriptions from X-ray images, thereby significantly improving the efficiency of radiologists. This task is challenging because it requires medical knowledge to accurately identify diseases and describe them in a professional manner. However, existing methods often overlook the importance of enhancing medical knowledge in describing pivotal areas, a capability that requires models to effectively extract and aggregate knowledge at multiple levels of granularity. Accordingly, we herein propose a novel and compact Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer (\textbf{EMGKT}) method to address the above issues. First, we encode global knowledge embeddings using a medical vision-language model, which provides contextual medical knowledge. Moreover, we devise a novel Fine-Grained Knowledge Distillation (FGKD) training task which efficiently extract fine-grained knowledge. Specifically, the FGKD training task contains teacher embeddings and student embeddings. Teacher embeddings are encoded using extra priors; while student embeddings are learned from the teacher embeddings through knowledge distillation. During inference, the student embeddings are used to enhance fine-grained knowledge while the teacher embeddings are discarded, resulting in negligible computational costs and no need for extra priors. Finally, we further develop a mixture of disease diagnosis expert classifiers to enhance knowledge extraction. The classifiers are initialized using disease embeddings and are modeled as different experts to address various granularity features. Notably, \textbf{EMGKT} can be efficiently applied to most existing methods. Extensive experiments are conducted on two widely-used public datasets and various baselines, which demonstrates the effectiveness and transferability of \textbf{EMGKT}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EMGKT：用医学视觉-语言模型编码全局知识嵌入，配合 Fine-Grained Knowledge Distillation (FGKD) 训练任务与疾病诊断专家分类器混合体，把多粒度医学知识迁移到放射报告生成。推理时只保留学生嵌入、丢弃教师嵌入，额外计算开销可忽略且无需额外先验，在两个公开数据集与多种基线上验证有效性与可迁移性。
Motivation: 放射报告生成需要医学知识准确识别疾病并专业描述，但现有方法忽视在关键区域上增强医学知识，缺少跨多粒度提取与聚合知识的能力。
Method: EMGKT 三部分：用医学视觉-语言模型编码全局知识嵌入提供上下文医学知识；FGKD 训练任务含教师嵌入（由额外先验编码）与学生嵌入（经知识蒸馏从教师学习），推理时仅用学生嵌入并丢弃教师嵌入；再以疾病嵌入初始化的疾病诊断专家分类器混合体建模不同粒度特征。
Result: 在两个广泛使用的公开数据集与多种基线上进行大量实验，验证 EMGKT 的有效性与可迁移性；推理阶段丢弃教师嵌入，计算开销可忽略且无需额外先验。
Conclusion: EMGKT 可高效应用于大多数现有放射报告生成方法，以近乎零推理开销的方式增强多粒度医学知识提取。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: iCATS: Fast Video Generation via Interaction-Aware Sparse Attention and Timestep-Adaptive Sparsity
papers.abstract_en: Training-free sparse attention offers a practical acceleration solution to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) via reducing computations without fine-tuning. It typically involves estimating the importance of query-key regions and deriving sparse masks to compute only the important candidates, which inevitably introduces approximation errors that may degrade generation quality. To better balance the efficiency-quality trade-off, we propose iCATS, integrating improved importance estimation and sparse mask construction with an efficient hardware execution strategy. Specifically, for importance estimation, unlike previous works that perform independent clustering over query and key tokens based on feature similarity to estimate attention scores, iCATS demonstrates that clustering based on query-key dot-product interactions is more accurate and further reformulates this objective as a simple quadratic form for low-cost computation. For sparse mask construction, instead of using a fixed top-p rule, we observe that tolerance to sparse approximation errors varies across denoising timesteps and therefore introduce an SNR-guided sparsity schedule to adjust sparsity dynamically, leading to higher accuracy. Finally, for hardware execution, we devise a tail-merging strategy to reduce padding overhead caused by irregular cluster sizes, improving GPU kernel utilization. Extensive experiments show that iCATS achieves $2.03\times$ acceleration with 31.017 dB PSNR on HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B and $1.55\times$ acceleration with 29.301 dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V-14B, delivering a state-of-the-art efficiency-quality trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iCATS 是面向视频生成 Diffusion Transformer 的免训练稀疏注意力：用 query-key 点积交互的聚类（重写为二次型）替代独立特征聚类来估计重要性，用 SNR 引导的稀疏度调度替代固定 top-p，并以 tail-merging 消除不规则簇大小带来的 padding 开销。在 HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B 上实现 2.03× 加速、PSNR 31.017 dB，在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上 1.55× 加速、PSNR 29.301 dB。
Motivation: 免训练稀疏注意力通过只计算重要的 query-key 区域来加速 DiT，但重要性估计的近似误差会降低生成质量，且固定稀疏度规则与不规则簇大小带来的 padding 进一步拖累硬件效率。
Method: 三个组件：一是基于 query-key 点积交互做聚类来估计注意力分数，并把该目标重写为低成本的二次型；二是 SNR 引导的稀疏度调度，按去噪时间步动态调整稀疏度而非固定 top-p；三是 tail-merging 策略减少不规则簇大小导致的 padding，提升 GPU kernel 利用率。
Result: 在 HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B 上达到 2.03× 加速、31.017 dB PSNR；在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上达到 1.55× 加速、29.301 dB PSNR，作者称其效率-质量权衡为 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 按点积交互而非特征相似性估计重要性、并让稀疏度随去噪时间步的 SNR 变化，可以在免训练稀疏注意力里同时保住生成质量与硬件吞吐。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Characterizing Overconfident Failure in LLM-Based Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated code generation, but generated programs can appear syntactically plausible while still failing execution-based correctness checks. Existing validation methods, such as testing and program analysis, remain essential but are often incomplete, costly, or applied only after generation. Model-derived uncertainty is therefore a natural early reliability signal. This paper studies the dilemma of overconfidence in code LLMs where incorrect programs are often generated with token-level confidence comparable to correct programs. We study this dilemma across four open-source code models and three execution-based benchmarks. Our analysis begins by investigating whether existing uncertainty metrics provide reliable proxies for execution correctness in code generation. We then characterize overconfidence at both global and local token levels, asking whether incorrect programs remain indistinguishable from correct ones under confidence and entropy summaries, including selective generation and the limits of instruction tuning. Finally, we evaluate whether common mitigation strategies reduce this failure mode. Our study yields four findings. First, existing uncertainty signals provide only partial and model-dependent evidence of execution failure. Second, overconfidence persists at both program and token levels, and uncertainty-based selection does not consistently improve accepted-set accuracy. Third, instruction tuning can increase certainty on failing generations without consistently improving correctness discrimination. Fourth, common mitigation techniques improve specific aspects of reliability but do not reliably resolve overconfident failure. Our exploratory latent analysis suggests that hidden representations may encode correctness-related signals that output confidence does not expose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 代码 LLM 生成错误程序时的 token 级置信度与正确程序相当，跨 4 个开源代码模型与 3 个执行基准，基于不确定性的选择性生成不能稳定提升被接受集合的准确率，指令微调还会在失败生成上抬高置信度而不改善正确性区分，常见缓解手段也只是修补局部可靠性。
Motivation: 生成程序常看似语法合理却过不了执行检查，而测试与程序分析不完整、成本高或只在生成后才做，模型自带的不确定性本应是早期信号，但过度自信让这个信号失效。
Method: 在 4 个开源代码模型和 3 个执行基准上，先检验现有不确定性指标能否代理执行正确性，再在程序级与 token 级用置信度和熵摘要刻画过度自信，覆盖选择性生成与指令微调的影响，并评估常见缓解策略，最后做探索性隐表示分析。
Result: 四项发现：现有不确定性信号只提供部分且依赖模型的执行失败证据；过度自信在程序级与 token 级都持续存在，基于不确定性的选择未一致提升被接受集合的准确率；指令微调会提高失败生成上的确定性却不一致改善正确性区分；常见缓解技术改善可靠性特定方面但不能可靠解决过度自信失败。隐表示可能编码输出置信度未暴露的正确性信号。
Conclusion: 输出置信度不足以作为代码执行正确性的可靠早期信号，过度自信是跨模型与基准持续存在的失败模式，缓解手段只能局部改善；潜在表示中可能藏着可用的正确性线索。

papers.title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Voice agents are converging on a collaboration pattern: a full-duplex interaction model stays on the live channel as the entry to the conversation, while search, reasoning, and coding are handled through asynchronous delegation. A duplex model supports continuous listening and speaking, but complex reasoning and tool use may exceed its capabilities. A coding agent can plan and execute extended tasks, but its sequential interface is a poor fit for live conversation. Combining them requires a harness that coordinates task acceptance, progress, cancellation, replacement, and result delivery while keeping the conversation responsive. Existing harnesses often rely on coupled heuristics, making them difficult to improve systematically from evidence. We present DuplexAgent, a full-duplex collaboration system whose harness expresses this workflow as six editable modules, and Duplex-Harness-RSI, a closed loop that revises them from interaction traces. A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair. Reasoning LLMs and coding agents in the delegation pool also serve the improvement loop: the Exam Planner selects the next tests from observed weaknesses and the repair archive, and the Harness Editor proposes targeted module changes. The capabilities that serve the user thus also improve the system's coordination. Experiments on intelligence, agentic, and duplex benchmarks show that DuplexAgent combines continuous interaction with difficult reasoning and complex task execution, achieving stronger spoken-knowledge and executable-tool scores than the compared delegated systems while maintaining strong interruption response. A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuplexAgent-RSI 把全双工语音 agent 的协作 harness 拆成六个可编辑模块，并用 Duplex-Harness-RSI 闭环从交互轨迹中诊断失败、定向改写模块。在 intelligence、agentic、duplex 基准上，其 spoken-knowledge 与 executable-tool 得分高于被比较的委托式系统，同时保持较强的打断响应；harness 消融显示该带诊断与修复档案的模块化闭环优于初始 harness 和无诊断的反复编辑。
Motivation: 全双工对话模型与串行 coding agent 各有短板，拼接时的任务受理、进度、取消、替换与结果回传依赖耦合启发式，难以基于证据系统性改进。
Method: DuplexAgent 将协作流程表达为六个可编辑模块；Duplex-Harness-RSI 闭环用自动生成限时测试对话的 simulator 产出失败轨迹，定位需修复的模块，再由委托池中的 Exam Planner 依据弱点与 repair archive 选下一组测试、Harness Editor 提出定向模块改动。
Result: 在 intelligence、agentic、duplex 基准上，spoken-knowledge 与 executable-tool 得分高于被比较的委托系统，并保持强打断响应；harness 消融中，带诊断与 repair archive 的模块化闭环优于初始 harness 与缺少二者的重复编辑。
Conclusion: 服务用户的推理与编码能力可以同时充当系统自身协调能力的改进引擎，前提是 harness 模块化、可验证且改进闭环保留诊断与修复档案。

papers.title: Spatial-Frequency-Aware Implicit Neural Representation of Multidimensional Signals via MLP-KAN Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged as a compelling paradigm for modeling multidimensional signals by mapping continuous coordinates to signal values. However, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP)-based INRs inherently suffer from spectral bias, which favors low-frequency components and suppresses the reconstruction of essential high-frequency details. While existing techniques, such as Fourier feature mappings, mitigate this issue, they often rely on sensitive manual tuning and are prone to spectral artifacts. In this paper, we propose a spatial-frequency-aware INR framework that combines an MLP branch with a Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) branch for complementary frequency-oriented modeling. The MLP branch provides a low-frequency-oriented representation of smooth structures, whereas the KAN branch complements localized variations and fine details. To coordinate the two branches, we integrate the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT) into the output fusion stage. The outputs of the two branches are decomposed into wavelet coefficients, and the corresponding coefficients are additively fused before inverse wavelet reconstruction. A wavelet-domain band-separation regularization further penalizes high-frequency responses in the MLP branch and low-frequency responses in the KAN branch, thereby encouraging complementary frequency-oriented behavior. Experiments on 1D signals, 2D images, 3D volumes and signed distance functions, videos, and 4D light-fields demonstrate the applicability of the proposed representation across the evaluated signal modalities. Results demonstrate improved reconstruction fidelity across the evaluated signal modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出空间-频率感知的隐式神经表示 (INR) 框架：MLP 分支负责低频平滑结构，KAN 分支补高频细节，两支输出经 DWT/IDWT 在小波系数域加性融合，并用小波域频带分离正则惩罚 MLP 的高频响应与 KAN 的低频响应。在 1D 信号、2D 图像、3D 体积与 SDF、视频、4D 光场等模态上重建保真度均有提升。
Motivation: 基于 MLP 的 INR 存在谱偏置 (spectral bias)，偏向低频而压制高频细节；Fourier feature mapping 等补救手段依赖敏感的手工调参且易产生谱伪影。
Method: 并联 MLP 分支与 Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) 分支，分别建模低频平滑结构与局部变化细节；在输出融合阶段用 DWT 将两支输出分解为小波系数并逐系数加性融合，再经 IDWT 重建；加入小波域频带分离正则，惩罚 MLP 分支的高频响应与 KAN 分支的低频响应，强制两支互补。
Result: 在 1D 信号、2D 图像、3D 体积与 signed distance functions、视频、4D light-fields 上展示该表示的适用性，并在所评估的各信号模态上均提升重建保真度。
Conclusion: 把频率分工（MLP 低频、KAN 高频）与小波域融合、频带分离正则结合，可在多种信号模态上缓解 MLP-INR 的谱偏置并改善重建。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
papers.abstract_en: Presolve strongly affects mixed-integer programming (MIP) performance, yet learning-based methods only optimize parameter configurations and cannot express the non-commutative temporal dependencies among actions, whose default order is nearly unique on most domains, yet functionally necessary: artificially shuffling the order of the same sequence inflates the tail of the solve-time distribution by up to several-fold. We recast presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, moving the decision object to action sequences; we call this framework ORDO---Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve. Its payoff is cross-domain generalization: on multiple unseen domains it attains end-to-end zero-shot speedup---to our knowledge the first for presolve action sequences---varying by domain and not explained by corpus richness, the strongest domain reaching the largest speedup once racing is added. Deployment uses sequence racing, in which candidate sequences run concurrently and the winner is kept, enabled by an execution-and-observation facility, added by modifying the SCIP source, that injects sequences along the native path and records which actions actually execute and in which round.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORDO 把 MIP presolve 从参数配置调优重写为在统一原子动作空间上的自回归序列生成，直接决策动作序列而非单个参数。乱打乱同一序列的顺序会使求解时间分布尾部膨胀至数倍，说明动作的非交换时序依赖本身是功能性的；框架在多个未见域上取得端到端零-shot 加速，并靠 sequence racing 进一步放大，最强域在加入 racing 后拿到最大加速。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的 presolve 方法只优化参数配置，无法表达动作之间的非交换时序依赖，而默认动作顺序在多数域上近乎唯一却功能必需，打乱它会让求解时间尾部膨胀数倍。
Method: 将 presolve 规划重构为统一原子动作空间上的自回归序列生成，决策对象改为动作序列；部署时用 sequence racing 并发运行候选序列并保留胜者，配套通过修改 SCIP 源码加入执行与观测设施，沿原生路径注入序列并记录哪些动作实际执行、在第几轮执行。
Result: 在多个未见域上实现端到端 zero-shot 加速（据作者所知是 presolve 动作序列的首个此类结果），加速幅度随域而异且不能由语料丰富度解释；加入 racing 后最强域拿到最大加速。人工打乱同一序列顺序会使求解时间分布尾部膨胀至数倍。
Conclusion: 把 presolve 决策对象从参数换成动作序列，可获得跨域 zero-shot 泛化，且时序顺序本身是必须保留的功能性约束；racing 是把候选序列并发执行并择优的部署手段。

papers.title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous scientific discovery with LLMs requires generating and testing hypotheses adaptively as evidence accumulates while maintaining statistical validity. Existing anytime-valid methods can handle data-dependent hypotheses, but open-ended discovery poses a deeper challenge: the best discovered hypothesis may still be the best of a bad lot, with better explanations yet undiscovered, while even background knowledge such as physical laws may require revision in light of new findings. In response, we formalize the problem as Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory. We introduce abductive utility, a computable measure of discovery progress, and possibility frontier search, the first algorithm for AASD, which maintains anytime validity and achieves $\varepsilon$-optimal abductive utility asymptotically under suitable conditions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scientific-discovery tasks show strong performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把开放科学发现形式化为基于可能性理论 (possibility theory) 的 Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD)，提出可计算的 abductive utility 度量与 possibility frontier search 算法，在证据累积中自适应生成并检验假设，同时保持 anytime validity，并在适当条件下渐近达到 ε-optimal abductive utility。
Motivation: 现有 anytime-valid 方法能处理数据依赖的假设，但开放发现更难：当前最优假设可能只是坏集合里的最优，且背景知识（如物理定律）本身也可能需要被新证据修正。
Method: 用可能性理论形式化 AASD 问题，定义 abductive utility 作为可计算的发现进展度量，并提出 possibility frontier search 算法，在假设搜索中维持 anytime validity。
Result: 在合成与真实科学发现任务上实验，摘要称取得 strong performance，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 开放科学发现可以被形式化并用保持 anytime validity 的搜索算法处理，且在适当条件下 abductive utility 渐近达到 ε-optimal。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Memorization and Malign Generalization in Conditional Diffusion Models with Random Features
papers.abstract_en: Conditional diffusion models generate diverse, novel, and high-quality samples under prescribed conditions. However, theoretical understanding of their memorization and generalization remains limited, while recent works have characterized these behaviors primarily in unconditional settings. In this work, we analyze a random-feature conditional score model in the high-dimensional proportional limit, deriving asymptotic expressions for training and test losses. By decomposing the test loss, we show that in the overparameterized regime, increasing model width improves prediction of the condition-dependent mean while reducing within-condition prediction variance, a phenomenon we term "malign generalization." Furthermore, analyzing the training loss reveals that more informative conditions lead to memorization of training samples at smaller widths. These theoretical findings are supported by experiments with U-Net architectures on realistic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高维比例极限下分析随机特征条件扩散模型，推导训练与测试损失的渐近式：过参数化区间内增大模型宽度会改善条件均值预测、同时压低条件内预测方差，作者称之为「恶性泛化 (malign generalization)」；条件信息量越大，模型在越小的宽度上就开始记忆训练样本。
Motivation: 条件扩散模型的记忆与泛化行为缺乏理论刻画，已有工作主要在无条件设定下给出结论，无法说明条件信息量与模型宽度如何共同决定记忆和泛化。
Method: 在高维比例极限 (proportional limit) 下分析随机特征条件 score 模型，推导训练损失与测试损失的渐近表达式，并把测试损失分解为条件均值预测与条件内方差两部分；再用 U-Net 架构在真实感数据上做实验支持理论结论。
Result: 过参数化区间内，增大模型宽度提升对条件相关均值的预测并降低条件内预测方差（恶性泛化）；训练损失分析显示条件越有信息量，模型在越小的宽度上记忆训练样本；上述理论结论由 U-Net 架构实验支持。
Conclusion: 条件扩散模型的宽度与条件信息量共同决定记忆与泛化的走向：加宽在过参数化区间带来均值预测变好与条件内方差变小并存的恶性泛化，而更强的条件会把记忆发生的宽度阈值推低。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REMORY 用一个神经记忆网络在文本摘要之外补一段有界的 soft memory token，条件于摘要并接在其后，沿序列维度形成残差连接，让冻结 LLM 在只保留 5.2% 输入位置的情况下逼近用完整历史的续写。在 SummHay 上 source attribution 明显提升而 insight coverage 基本不变，接近 full-context joint score；Qwen3.8-27B 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 在长程 agent 基准上一致增益，BrowseComp 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上重复工具输出和工具错误显著减少。
Motivation: 长程 agent 只能把历史压进有限上下文窗口，但纯文本摘要不足以支撑后续所有决策，直接保留全历史又超出窗口预算。
Method: 提出 REMORY：一个神经记忆网络，输入历史与摘要，学习生成一段有界的 soft memory token，token 以摘要为条件并追加在摘要之后，作为序列维度上的残差连接；LLM 保持冻结，靠这些 token 帮它逼近使用完整历史时的续写。
Result: 在 SummHay 上，source attribution 提升且 insight coverage 几乎不变，仅用 5.2% 的输入位置就接近 full-context joint score。在长程 agent 基准上，Qwen3.8-27B 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 加入 residual memory 后均取得一致增益，且两者在 BrowseComp 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上的重复工具输出和工具错误大幅减少。
Conclusion: 在摘要旁挂一段有界软记忆 token，可以在极小的上下文开销下补回摘要丢失的信息，从而改善冻结 LLM 的长程 agent 行为并减少重复与出错的工具调用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Scene Text Hijacks the Scene: Uncovering, Exploiting, and Mitigating Rendered-Text Semantic Leakage in Image Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: The reliability and accountability of image generative models (IGMs) are essential for building responsible and trustworthy AI systems. Recent IGMs, such as Nano Banana and GPT-Image, now support complex instruction following, realistic image synthesis, and controllable scene-text rendering. As these capabilities expand, safety analysis must also account for new control channels introduced by complex prompts. In this work, we study rendered-text semantic leakage, a largely overlooked phenomenon in open-domain text rendering. Although rendered text is intended to serve as a local visual constraint that should be reproduced verbatim in the generated image, it also carries linguistic semantics that may be interpreted by the model as part of the input instruction. This makes rendered text a potential semantic control channel whose safety implications remain insufficiently understood. We systematically characterize this phenomenon by decoupling the main visual prompt from the rendered text and measuring their individual and compositional effects on generated images. We quantify semantic leakage and rendering fidelity, and further analyze how leakage emerges from intermediate model evidence. We then show that harmful semantics embedded in scene text can persist through LLM-based prompt enhancement pipelines and steer non-text image regions, even when the main visual prompt remains benign. Finally, we propose a preliminary mitigation approach that reduces unsafe semantic transfer from rendered text to non-text regions while preserving the intended text-rendering behavior on FLUX-2-dev. Our findings reveal rendered text as a dual-use carrier of visible data and latent semantics, exposing a text-centric cross-modal attack surface in modern IGMs.
papers.comment: To appear in the 2027 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图像生成模型把场景文字同时当作可见内容和隐含指令：场景文字中的有害语义会穿透 LLM 提示增强管线，进而操控非文字区域的生成结果。作者提出初步缓解方法，在 FLUX-2-dev 上降低从渲染文字到非文字区域的不安全语义转移，同时保住原本的文字渲染行为。
Motivation: Nano Banana、GPT-Image 等模型支持复杂指令跟随与可控场景文字渲染，但渲染文字作为语义控制通道带来的安全影响缺乏刻画，主视觉提示良性时仍可能被文字劫持。
Method: 将主视觉提示与渲染文字解耦，分别测量二者单独及组合对生成图像的影响；量化语义泄漏 (semantic leakage) 与渲染保真度，并分析泄漏如何从模型中间证据中产生；再提出初步缓解方法并在 FLUX-2-dev 上验证。
Result: 场景文字中的有害语义可穿透 LLM 提示增强管线并操控非文字图像区域，即使主视觉提示保持良性；缓解方法在 FLUX-2-dev 上减少不安全语义转移且保留文字渲染行为。
Conclusion: 渲染文字是可见数据与潜在语义的双用途载体，构成现代图像生成模型中以文字为中心的跨模态攻击面；缓解手段目前仍是初步方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DynaTE: Accelerating Diffusion LLMs via Dynamic Token Execution
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs by enabling bidirectional parallel refinement, alleviating the sequential decoding bottleneck of AR generation. However, their parallel iterative refinement mismatches AR accelerators optimized for sequential decoding and their discrete token generation differs from DiT accelerators designed for continuous denoising. Recent dLLM accelerators have explored workload-specific optimizations to reduce vocabulary processing overhead and redundant computation across denoising iterations. However, these approaches retain all tokens in parallel execution, despite varying token refinement utility and execution requirements. This paper presents DynaTE, a hardware--software co-design architecture that dynamically adapts accelerator execution to evolving token states during dLLM decoding. DynaTE first enables adaptive token execution by skipping low-utility token computation, while a dimension-reconfigurable PE array maintains high utilization under varying active-token patterns. Second, DynaTE exploits dynamic token dependencies through FLDD to refine a small number of locally dependent tokens within the current iteration, reducing the overall number of denoising iterations, while a Merge--Split--Merge dataflow hides the resulting serial overhead. Third, a streaming vocabulary engine interleaves multiple token streams from the LM head to accommodate irregular output variations caused by selective token computation and uneven vocabulary-selection demands. Evaluated on two representative dLLMs, DynaTE achieves 2.05--2.78$\times$ speedup and 2.99--3.93$\times$ higher energy efficiency over state-of-the-art dLLM accelerators, while delivering 2.55$\times$ speedup and 6.07$\times$ higher energy efficiency over Jetson AGX Orin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynaTE 是面向 diffusion LLM (dLLM) 解码的软硬件协同设计加速架构：按 token 状态动态跳过低效用 token 的计算，用 FLDD 只精炼当前迭代中少量局部依赖 token 以减少去噪迭代次数，并以流式词表引擎消化选择性计算带来的不规则输出。在两类代表性 dLLM 上，相对最先进的 dLLM 加速器提速 2.05–2.78×、能效提升 2.99–3.93×，相对 Jetson AGX Orin 提速 2.55×、能效提升 6.07×。
Motivation: dLLM 的并行迭代精炼与为顺序解码优化的 AR 加速器不匹配，其离散 token 生成也不同于面向连续去噪的 DiT 加速器；现有 dLLM 加速器仍让全部 token 参与并行执行，忽略了各 token 精炼效用与执行需求的差异。
Method: 三个组件：自适应 token 执行跳过低效用 token 计算，配合维度可重构 PE 阵列在活跃 token 数变化时维持利用率；FLDD 利用动态 token 依赖，只在当前迭代内精炼少量局部依赖 token，由 Merge–Split–Merge 数据流掩盖由此引入的串行开销；流式词表引擎从 LM head 交织多路 token 流，适配选择性计算与不均衡词表选择带来的不规则输出。
Result: 在两类代表性 dLLM 上，相对最先进的 dLLM 加速器实现 2.05–2.78× 加速与 2.99–3.93× 能效提升；相对 Jetson AGX Orin 实现 2.55× 加速与 6.07× 能效提升。
Conclusion: 按 token 状态动态调整执行粒度并利用 token 间依赖减少去噪迭代，是 dLLM 推理加速的有效路径，其收益体现在相对现有 dLLM 加速器与 GPU 平台的双重加速与能效优势上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Being-M0.7 是一个人形机器人潜在世界-动作模型：先用超过 10,000 小时的混合模态人类数据（纯视频、纯动作、成对视频-动作）联合预测未来潜在视觉状态与人体运动，再经机器人 mid-training 适配视角与动力学，最后由动作专家用 gated cross-attention 把冻结先验的视觉预测表征、当前图像与本体感觉合成可执行全身指令。在 SIMPLE 基准上取得所比较基线中最高的总体成功率，并在真实 Unitree G1 loco-manipulation 任务上与最强基线持平。
Motivation: 人形 loco-manipulation 需要同时协调运动与操作并预判场景演化，但机器人演示数据稀缺；人类视频与动作数据集规模大却多为单模态、且人体动作不能直接当作可执行的机器人动作。
Method: 三阶段流程：预训练用 10,000+ 小时人类数据的 video-only、motion-only、paired video-motion 三路流联合预测未来潜在视觉状态与运动，使视觉表征编码未来运动学；robot mid-training 把该粗粒度先验适配到机器人视角与身体动力学；action post-training 中动作专家经 gated cross-attention 融合冻结适配先验的视觉预测表征、当前图像与 proprioception，输出全身动作。
Result: 在 SIMPLE 上取得所比较基线中最高的总体成功率（aggregate success rate），在真实 Unitree G1 loco-manipulation 任务上与最强基线表现持平；语料规模超过 10,000 小时原始人类中心数据。
Conclusion: 从混合模态人类数据学到的视觉-运动先验可以迁移到人形机器人全身控制，且机器人演示稀缺时仍能在 SIMPLE 与真机任务上达到或超过专门基线。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在 SIMPLE 上取得所比较基线中最高的总体成功率（aggregate success rate），在真实 Unitree G1 loco-manipulation 任务上与最强基线表现持平；语料规模超过 10,000 小时原始人类中心数据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 从混合模态人类数据学到的视觉-运动先验可以迁移到人形机器人全身控制，且机器人演示稀缺时仍能在 SIMPLE 与真机任务上达到或超过专门基线。

papers.title: How to post-train on a surrogate: Envelope sampling mitigates reward hacking
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly post-trained against LLM judges and other cheap surrogates because the true reward, such as human preference, is too expensive to query at scale. This practice often leads to reward hacking, where reinforcement learning against a miscalibrated surrogate leads to undesirable side effects. In this work, we study a setting in which a small number $n$ of model outputs are annotated with ground-truth labels (e.g., from expert review) and used to recalibrate the LLM judge before optimizing against it. Prior approaches to judge recalibration are costly or heuristic, and it is known that on-policy sampling fails when the surrogate is miscalibrated on a rare set of outputs. In this work, we propose envelope sampling, a theoretically-grounded method for judge recalibration that seeks to minimize an upper bound on the regret of the post-trained model under the assumption that the human reward and re-calibrated reward lie in an $L^2$ ball around the judge. We give practical algorithms to sample from the envelope by rejection or by fine-tuning against a modified reward, and experiments on clinical note generation and on a controlled sycophancy task show that recalibrating on envelope samples mitigates reward hacking where recalibrating on base-model samples does not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对用 LLM judge 等廉价代理奖励做后训练时的 reward hacking，提出 envelope sampling：用少量 n 条带真值标签的输出重校准 judge，并在人类奖励与重校准奖励位于 judge 周围 L2 球的假设下最小化后训练模型 regret 的上界。临床病历生成与受控 sycophancy 任务上，在 envelope 样本上重校准能缓解 reward hacking，而在 base-model 样本上重校准做不到。
Motivation: 真实奖励（如人类偏好）查询成本过高，实践中改用 LLM judge 等代理优化，代理失准会让强化学习产生不良副作用；已有 judge 重校准方法昂贵或启发式，on-policy 采样在代理对少数输出失准时失效。
Method: envelope sampling：取 n 条模型输出标注真值标签（如专家评审）重校准 judge，假设人类奖励与重校准奖励落在 judge 的 L2 球内，最小化后训练模型 regret 的上界；给出两种从 envelope 采样的实用算法——拒绝采样，或针对修改后的奖励做微调。
Result: 在临床病历生成 (clinical note generation) 与受控 sycophancy 任务上，基于 envelope 样本的重校准缓解了 reward hacking，而基于 base-model 样本的重校准没有；方法带 regret 上界的理论保证，采样规模为 n 条带真值标注的输出。
Conclusion: 当代理奖励失准时，按 L2 球包络设计采样再重校准，比在 base-model 样本上重校准更能抑制 reward hacking；on-policy 采样在代理对稀有输出失准的场景下不可靠。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Phonological Interference in Multilingual Speech Models
papers.abstract_en: Phoneme-level models transcribe or generate speech as a sequence of phonemes, the smallest sound units that distinguish words. These models enable fine-grained pronunciation control and understanding, yet often fail on input that does not match any single training language, such as speech alternating between two languages, known as code-switching, or low-resource languages absent from training. We identify a systematic failure mode behind this, phonological interference: models assume the input is in a single language and impose its phonology, overriding local phoneme-level decisions that conflict with the assumed language. We measure interference by how often a model retains phonemes that one language has but the other lacks. On code-switched input, two phone recognizers (speech-to-phoneme models) and a phoneme-conditioned text-to-speech model lose 32% to 79% of these phonemes, but lose far fewer of the phonemes both languages share. On unseen languages, we find that phone recognizers impose the phonology of the training language they assign to the speech, and the more confident the assignment, the more they lose phonemes the unseen language has but the assigned language lacks. We probe the models' language estimate from their internal activations, and trace interference to a low dimensional subspace. On monolingual speech, steering this subspace toward another language makes the model lose the phonemes that only the original language uses and produce phonemes that only the target language has. We introduce windowed language estimation (WLE), an inference time repair that replaces the model's language estimate in this subspace with one computed from a short window around each position. On code-switched input, WLE removes 34% to 69% of the interference in all three models, and in the recognizers it leaves monolingual performance essentially unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 音素级语音模型默认输入属于单一语言并强加该语言音系，覆盖与之冲突的局部音素判断，形成系统性的音素干扰 (phonological interference)。在 code-switching 输入上，两个 phone recognizer 与一个 phoneme 条件 TTS 丢失 32%–79% 仅某一方语言才有的音素，而双方共有的音素丢失少得多；推理期的 windowed language estimation (WLE) 用短窗重估替换子空间内的语言估计，在三个模型上消除 34%–69% 的干扰，且识别器的单语性能基本不变。
Motivation: 音素级模型在输入不匹配任何单一训练语言时会失败，典型场景是 code-switching 与训练中缺席的低资源语言；作者把这一失败归因于模型强加单一语言音系的系统性干扰，需要可度量、可修复的机制解释。
Method: 定义干扰度量：统计模型保留某语言有而另一语言没有的音素的频率；在两个 speech-to-phoneme 识别器与一个 phoneme 条件 TTS 上测 code-switching 与未见语言；从内部激活探测语言估计并定位到一个低维子空间，用单语语音做子空间转向 (steering) 因果验证；提出推理期修复 WLE，用每个位置附近短窗计算的语言估计替换子空间中的估计。
Result: code-switching 输入上三个模型丢失 32%–79% 仅一方语言才有的音素，双方共有的音素丢失少得多；未见语言上识别器施加其所指派训练语言的音系，指派越自信丢失越多；单语语音上把子空间转向另一语言会使模型丢失原语言独有音素并产出目标语言独有音素；WLE 在三个模型上消除 34%–69% 的干扰，识别器单语性能基本不变。
Conclusion: 音素干扰由内部低维子空间中的单一语言估计驱动，因此在推理期按短窗替换该估计即可大幅修复 code-switching 表现而不损害单语性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
papers.abstract_en: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores. Despite progress in retrieval, deduplication, and lifecycle management, the formation stage, the moment a fact is first written to storage has received almost no principled attention. We identify this as the binding constraint on memory quality in production systems. Critical contextual signals, such as the distinction between a permanent user attribute and a transient situation, exist only in the original utterance and are irreversibly lost the moment extraction produces a subject-relation-object triple. No downstream process can recover them. We propose Gated Memory, a lightweight, modular formation framework that interposes two decision checkpoints between conversation and storage: an admission gate that evaluates every candidate fact against the full utterance context before extraction runs, and a conditional enrichment stage that grounds admitted facts through an entity scope taxonomy with privacy constraints. The gate evaluates only the current exchange while using prior turns as read-only reference context, and produces a structured formation record. Admitted content is decomposed into atomic facts, each categorized, tagged with provenance (directly stated versus inferred), scoped to its condition of applicability, and grounded in resolved time and place, subject to a constraint that no entity absent from the context may be asserted. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark with atypical emotional density in utterance data, Gated Memory achieves an overall +2.6% relative improvement in LLM-judge accuracy over a strong baseline with identical retrieval and generation, establishing formation quality as a measurable constraint on memory performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gated Memory 在对话与存储之间插入两道检查点：抽取前用 admission gate 对照完整话语上下文评估候选事实，再经条件化 enrichment 做实体范围分类与隐私约束。在 LoCoMo-10 上，检索与生成完全相同的条件下，LLM-judge 准确率相对强基线整体提升 +2.6%。
Motivation: 长期记忆系统只优化检索、去重与生命周期，事实首次写入的 formation 阶段无人处理；永久属性与临时情境的区分只存在于原始话语中，一旦抽成 subject-relation-object 三元组就不可逆丢失。
Method: admission gate 只评估当前轮、把先前轮次当只读参考上下文，输出结构化 formation record；被接纳内容拆成原子事实，逐条分类、标注 provenance（直接陈述 vs 推断）、限定适用条件与解析时间地点，并约束不得断言上下文中不存在的实体；enrichment 阶段用 entity scope taxonomy 加隐私约束做 grounding。
Result: 在 LoCoMo-10 基准（话语数据带非典型情绪密度）上，检索与生成保持一致时，Gated Memory 的 LLM-judge 准确率相对强基线整体 +2.6%。
Conclusion: formation quality 是记忆性能的可测约束：把上下文信号在抽取前保住，比事后检索优化更能决定最终记忆质量。

papers.title: TaReD: Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Agents combine reasoning with tools to interact with external systems and complete real-world tasks. Early agents typically interleave reasoning and actions along a single execution chain. On complex tasks, this chain becomes unreliable because growing histories obscure intermediate dependencies and allow early planning errors to propagate. Recursively decomposing a complex task into smaller subtasks offers a natural solution, yet effective decomposition must account for the system's capabilities so that each subtask can be executed by the available tools. In realistic systems, however, tool libraries can be too large to expose in full. Injecting every tool description consumes substantial context while making relevant tools harder to retrieve and useful task boundaries harder to identify. We propose tool-aware recursive decomposition, which organizes tools by functional relationships into a hierarchy of capabilities. During execution, the agent discovers tools on demand and uses the hierarchy to recursively decompose a complex task into a subtask tree whose levels are aligned with the capabilities required at each stage. Experiments on complex real-world tasks show that the proposed method improves end-to-end task success rate by up to 40 percentage points over the compared baselines. The implementation of TaReD is available on GitHub: https://github.com/WeiXiang-Mao/TaReD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaReD 把工具库按功能关系组织成能力层级，让 agent 在执行中按需发现工具，并沿该层级把复杂任务递归分解成与各阶段所需能力对齐的子任务树。在复杂真实任务上，端到端任务成功率较对比基线最多提升 40 个百分点。
Motivation: 单链式推理-行动在复杂任务上会因历史变长而丢失中间依赖、让早期规划错误一路传播；而把全部工具描述塞进上下文既耗 context 又让相关工具更难检索、任务边界更难识别。
Method: 提出 tool-aware recursive decomposition (TaReD)：先按功能关系把工具库组织成能力层级，执行时按需发现工具，再用该层级把任务递归分解为子任务树，使树的每一层对应当前阶段所需能力。
Result: 在复杂真实任务的实验中，端到端任务成功率较所对比的基线最多提高 40 个百分点；实现已在 GitHub 开源。
Conclusion: 把工具组织成能力层级并据此做递归分解，是让长程 agent 在工具库过大、无法全量暴露时仍能可靠完成复杂任务的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Regularized Small Area Estimation with Graph Laplacian Benchmarking priors
papers.abstract_en: Small area estimation (SAE) often requires both borrowing information across areas and benchmarking estimates to reliable aggregates. We develop a Bayesian framework that addresses these two objectives jointly through a new family of Benchmarking priors. The priors are induced by a benchmark-constrained regularization problem. The resulting family includes a Benchmarking Prior that incorporates the benchmarking restrictions without additional regularization across areas, and Single and Multi-View Laplacian Benchmarking Priors that introduce regularization through graph Laplacians constructed from area similarities based on external covariate information. For posterior computation under these degenerate priors, we develop tailored MCMC algorithms based on a reduced parameterization of the constraint space. We assess the proposed models using a data-based simulation and apply the framework to estimate Average Household Size (AHS) at the municipality level in Colombia in 2025. In this application, graph-based regularization improves model performance, with the Multi-View models generally producing more precise municipality-level estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在小域估计 (SAE) 中把跨域借力与向可靠总量的 benchmarking 约束放进同一个贝叶斯框架：由 benchmark 约束的正则化问题导出 Benchmarking priors 族，含无额外跨域正则的 Benchmarking Prior，以及用外部协变量构建图拉普拉斯的 Single-View 与 Multi-View Laplacian Benchmarking Priors。哥伦比亚 2025 年市镇级平均家庭规模 (AHS) 应用中，图正则提升模型表现，Multi-View 模型给出的市镇级估计普遍更精确。
Motivation: 小域估计既要跨域借力又要让估计与可靠总量对齐，这两个目标通常分开处理；退化先验下的后验计算也是障碍。
Method: 先验由 benchmark 约束的正则化问题诱导，形成 Benchmarking Prior（只加约束、不加跨域正则）与 Single-/Multi-View Laplacian Benchmarking Priors（用外部协变量定义的区域相似度构造图拉普拉斯作正则）；针对退化先验，用约束空间的降维参数化设计专门的 MCMC 算法；评估用基于数据的模拟，并应用到哥伦比亚 2025 年市镇级 AHS 估计。
Result: 在哥伦比亚 2025 年市镇级 Average Household Size 应用中，基于图的正则化改善模型表现，Multi-View 模型总体给出更精确的市镇级估计；另用基于数据的模拟评估所提模型。
Conclusion: 把 benchmarking 约束与图拉普拉斯正则统一进先验构造，可在满足总量约束的同时提高小域估计精度，Multi-View 版本在该应用中精度最好。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: LR-V2X: Loss-Resilient Collaborative Perception under Low-Bandwidth Communication
papers.abstract_en: Given the inherent unpredictability of packet loss in vehicular wireless communications, V2X collaborative perception can yield practical benefits only if agents can achieve reliable collaboration under lossy and low-bandwidth communication conditions. Existing dense BEV feature fusion methods depend on redundant BEV feature exchange, which is infeasible in low-bandwidth scenarios, while compact-communication methods aggressively compress messages but can hardly recover the missing feature content after packet loss. In this paper, we present LR-V2X, a loss-resilient, latent-space reconstruction framework that converts corrupted received latents (even under severe 90% packet loss) into a spatial prior and then reconstructs the missing BEV information from this informative prior and using ego context as condition. Notably, the model can be trained under complete communication conditions and can be directly applied to lossy conditions at test time, eliminating the need for training under numerous lossy conditions. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and V2XREAL show that LR-V2X delivers the strongest robustness under severe packet loss and preserves reliable collaboration as communication quality degrades. And it reduces communication overhead by $64\times$ compared to dense BEV feature fusion baselines. Code will be released at https://github.com/sidiangongyuan/LR-V2X.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LR-V2X 针对 V2X 协同感知中车载无线链路的丢包问题，提出损失鲁棒的隐空间重建框架：把受损的接收 latent（即使 90% 丢包）转成空间先验，再以自车上下文为条件重建缺失的 BEV 信息。模型只需在完整通信条件下训练，测试时可直接用于丢包场景，在 DAIR-V2X 与 V2XREAL 上表现出最强的严重丢包鲁棒性，并比稠密 BEV 特征融合基线降低 64 倍通信开销。
Motivation: 车载无线通信丢包不可预测，稠密 BEV 特征融合依赖冗余特征交换、在低带宽下不可行；紧凑通信方法激进压缩消息后，丢包造成的特征缺失几乎无法恢复。
Method: LR-V2X 是损失鲁棒的隐空间重建框架：先将受损的接收 latent 转换为空间先验 (spatial prior)，再以该先验为输入、自车上下文 (ego context) 为条件重建缺失的 BEV 信息；训练仅在完整通信条件下进行，无需覆盖大量丢包条件。
Result: 在 DAIR-V2X 与 V2XREAL 上，LR-V2X 在严重丢包（可达 90% packet loss）下表现出最强鲁棒性，并在通信质量下降时保持可靠协同；相比稠密 BEV 特征融合基线，通信开销降低 64 倍。
Conclusion: 在完整通信条件下训练、靠隐空间重建补回丢包内容，即可让 V2X 协同感知在低带宽、高丢包链路上保持可用，无需为每种丢包条件重新训练。

papers.title: Q-Capsule: A Localized Capsule-Based Quantum Neural Architecture for Barren Plateau Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Variational quantum algorithms are often limited by barren plateaus: gradients vanish as circuit size and depth increase, making quantum neural networks difficult to train. We propose Q-Capsule, a localized capsule-based quantum neural architecture that mitigates this problem through register partitioning, local readout, sparse inter-capsule coupling, trainable data re-uploading, and Quantum Fisher Information Matrix (QFIM)-guided adaptive depth growth. By restricting the dominant support of each observable to a small capsule and controlling inter-capsule entanglement, Q-Capsule preserves useful gradient signals while retaining communication between local quantum representations. As the register width increases, Q-Capsule consistently maintains stable gradient variance, whereas globally entangling baselines exhibit exponential suppression with a log-gradient-variance slope near -ln 2 per qubit. Q-Capsule also produces more structured optimization landscapes, higher parameter efficiency, improved robustness to depolarizing noise, and lower measurement requirements. Its adaptive policy achieves 98.1% accuracy on binary classification and 97.7% on four-class classification, while using approximately 73% fewer two-qubit gates than the fixed-deep model on the multiclass task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-Capsule 用寄存器分块 (register partitioning)、局部读出、稀疏胶囊间耦合、数据重上传与 QFIM 引导的自适应深度增长，把每个可观测量的支撑限制在小胶囊内，从而在寄存器变宽时保持稳定的梯度方差，而全局纠缠基线的 log 梯度方差斜率接近每 qubit -ln 2。自适应策略在二分类上达 98.1%、四分类 97.7% 准确率，多分类任务上比固定深度模型少用约 73% 的双比特门。
Motivation: 变分量子算法随线路规模与深度增大出现贫瘠高原 (barren plateau)，梯度指数消失导致量子神经网络难以训练，全局纠缠基线在寄存器加宽时梯度方差按每 qubit 约 -ln 2 斜率被压制。
Method: Q-Capsule 架构包含寄存器分块、局部读出、稀疏 inter-capsule coupling、可训练的数据重上传 (data re-uploading)，以及由 Quantum Fisher Information Matrix (QFIM) 引导的自适应深度增长策略；通过限制每个可观测量的主导支撑在单个胶囊内并控制胶囊间纠缠来保留梯度信号。
Result: 随寄存器宽度增加，Q-Capsule 保持稳定梯度方差，而全局纠缠基线呈指数压制、log 梯度方差斜率接近每 qubit -ln 2；自适应策略二分类准确率 98.1%、四分类 97.7%，多分类任务上比固定深度模型少约 73% 双比特门；另报告更结构化的优化景观、更高参数效率、对去极化噪声 (depolarizing noise) 更强的鲁棒性与更低的测量需求。
Conclusion: 把可观测量支撑局部化并用 QFIM 控制胶囊间纠缠与深度，可以在扩展 qubit 规模时避开贫瘠高原，同时保持分类精度并降低门与测量开销。

papers.title: Residual spectral instabilities in representation learning
papers.abstract_en: Learned representations can lose latent degrees of freedom successively, suggesting a cascade of transitions whose underlying stability principle remains unclear. Here we formulate dimension-wise posterior collapse in variational autoencoder (VAE) as a fluctuation theory around partially collapsed states. Interpreting the negative evidence lower bound as an effective free energy, its quadratic expansion defines a Gaussian theory whose Hessian acts as a mass matrix for latent fluctuations. We show that the collapsed directions form an invariant fluctuation sector and derive its exact mass spectrum in terms of a conditional residual operator. A local reactivation direction lowers the free energy when the decoder variance falls below the residual spectral upper edge, with equality marking marginality. The criterion recovers principal component thresholds in the linear Gaussian VAE limit. Viewed in reverse along continuously connected branches, the reactivation boundary provides a local criterion for successive collapse. Numerical continuation experiments show successive loss of latent dimensions near these spectral marginalities. These results support a spectral cascade interpretation governed by residual information left unexplained by the surviving representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 VAE 的逐维后验坍缩 (dimension-wise posterior collapse) 写成部分坍缩态附近的涨落理论：负 ELBO 视为有效自由能，其二次展开给出以 Hessian 为质量矩阵的高斯理论，坍缩方向构成不变涨落扇区。当解码器方差低于条件残余算子 (conditional residual operator) 的谱上边缘时出现降低自由能的再激活方向，等号处为边际点；数值延拓实验显示潜变量维度确实在这些谱边际附近逐次丢失。
Motivation: 学到的表示会逐次丢失潜自由度，像级联式的转变，但决定这种级联的稳定性原理尚不清楚，缺少可判定的局部判据。
Method: 把 VAE 的负 ELBO 解释为有效自由能并做二次展开，得到以 Hessian 为质量矩阵的高斯涨落理论；证明坍缩方向构成不变涨落扇区，并用条件残余算子写出其精确质量谱；在潜维连续分支上反向考察再激活边界，作为逐次坍缩的局部判据，并在极限情形对照线性高斯 VAE 的主成分阈值。
Result: 再激活判据在解码器方差低于残余谱上边缘时触发，等号对应边际性；在线性高斯 VAE 极限下该判据复现主成分阈值；数值延拓实验显示潜维度在这些谱边际附近逐次丢失。
Conclusion: 逐次后验坍缩可由残余表示未解释的残余信息所支配的谱级联来刻画，谱边际即局部再激活/坍缩判据。

papers.title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Mechanistic World Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are being increasingly deployed as autonomous scientists, designing experiments and inferring mechanistic world models with minimal human oversight. Yet identifiability is often overlooked: when a plateau is reached, the agent needs to know whether it is not yet capable enough or the model simply is not identifiable from the data, in which case no amount of further experimentation of the same kind can help. We propose the Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent (LLM-IDEA) for closed-loop discovery with an identifiability engine that returns a three-way plateau verdict: capability limit, resolvable within the design class, or certified exhausted. On ODEBench, 60 of the 62 systems with free constants are identifiable at round 0; the RC circuit is certified exhausted for every experiment that protocol can run, and a harvesting model is resolvable by one added initial condition. The identifiability engine reproduces known verdicts on Lotka-Volterra, Van der Pol, Lorenz, and a pharmacokinetic model, where it recommends the intravenous arm pharmacologists use, and it ranks the depth scorer of our own benchmark last among four observation designs. On the DiscoverPhysics benchmark, it finds two public worlds whose explanation rubric rewards a distinction no legal experiment can make, and every model there with accurate trajectories failed the explanation grade (15 of 15, against 5 of 9 in identifiable worlds, p = 0.012). On the Alien Universe, a two-body testbed we propose in which a force law switches between a provably non-identifiable and an identifiable protocol, LLM-IDEA on the identifiable protocol reaches discovery depth at least three on 8/8 seeds versus 1/8 without it. An autonomous discovery agent can thus compute, rather than guess, whether a plateau calls for more search, a better experiment of the same kind, or a different kind of experiment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM-IDEA 为自主科学发现 agent 加装可辨识性引擎 (identifiability engine)，在平台期给出三选一判定：能力不足、当前设计类内可解、或已认证穷尽。在 ODEBench 上 62 个含自由常数系统中 60 个 round 0 即可辨识，RC 电路被认证穷尽，harvesting 模型补一个初始条件即可解；在自建 Alien Universe 两体测试台上，可辨识协议下 8/8 个 seed 达到 discovery depth ≥3，对照仅 1/8。
Motivation: LLM agent 做自主实验时常把平台期误判为搜索不足，而若模型在该数据下本就不可辨识，同类实验再做也无法区分参数，浪费实验预算。
Method: 闭环发现流程中嵌入 identifiability engine，对平台期输出三分类判定（capability limit / resolvable within design class / certified exhausted），并据此推荐改换实验设计；在 ODEBench、DiscoverPhysics 及自建的 Alien Universe 两体测试台（力律在可证不可辨识与可辨识协议间切换）上检验。
Result: ODEBench 62 个含自由常数系统中 60 个 round 0 可辨识；RC 电路对该协议可跑的每个实验均被认证穷尽，harvesting 模型补一个初始条件即解。引擎在 Lotka-Volterra、Van der Pol、Lorenz 与药代动力学模型上复现已知判定，并把自建 benchmark 的 depth scorer 在四种观测设计中排最后。DiscoverPhysics 上两个公开世界的解释评分标准奖励任何合法实验都无法区分的差异，其中轨迹精确的模型全部未过解释评分（15/15，可辨识世界为 5/9，p = 0.012）。Alien Universe 可辨识协议下 LLM-IDEA 8/8 seed 达到 discovery depth ≥3，无此引擎仅 1/8。
Conclusion: 平台期该继续搜索、补同类实验还是换实验类型，可以由可辨识性引擎计算得出而非靠猜；解释评分不通过可能源于世界本身不可辨识，而非轨迹拟合不足。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System for Mimicking Human-like Car Following Behavior
papers.abstract_en: This study presents the Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System (NeMeFIS), a hierarchical machine learning architecture that asymmetrically models acceleration and deceleration in car following behavior by integrating five human memory types procedural, working, episodic, semantic, and declarative. By linking external variables to memory functions via metaheuristics and validating them through factor and p-value analyses, NeMeFIS uncovers latent cognitive influences across Arterial, Collector, and Rural Highway corridors for different types of vehicles. Results from 54 different trained models emphasize cognitive thresholds shaped by driver perception limits and cognitive load. The trained NeMeFIS models outperform traditional statistical and conventional machine learning models in replicating realistic driving behavior, including comparisons with Linear Regression, ANFIS, and LSTM architectures. Fuzzy rule analysis reveals that declarative memory demands the highest rule, especially during deceleration, indicating complex braking decisions. Procedural memory drives acceleration, while semantic and declarative memory guide deceleration. Risk perception also emerges as a key factor, particularly on urban roads. Validated on both heterogeneous and homogeneous datasets, NeMeFIS offers a robust framework for modeling driver cognition. The findings support psychotherapeutic applications and the development of adaptive, human-like decision systems in Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) to enhance traffic safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeMeFIS 用分层机器学习把五类人类记忆（procedural、working、episodic、semantic、declarative）不对称地映射到跟车中的加速与减速行为，并用 metaheuristics 将外部变量连到记忆函数、再做 factor 与 p-value 检验。54 个训练模型显示认知阈值受驾驶人感知极限与认知负荷塑造，declarative memory 在减速时规则需求最高、procedural memory 主导加速。
Motivation: 跟车行为建模需要刻画驾驶人内部认知差异（记忆类型、风险感知、认知负荷），传统统计与常规机器学习模型难以复现这种异质、非对称的加速/减速决策。
Method: 提出分层架构 NeMeFIS，通过 metaheuristics 把外部变量关联到五类记忆函数，并以 factor analysis 和 p-value 分析验证；用 fuzzy rule 分析解释各记忆类型对加减速的贡献，并在异质与同质数据集上训练，与 Linear Regression、ANFIS、LSTM 对比。
Result: 共训练 54 个模型，覆盖 Arterial、Collector、Rural Highway 走廊与不同车型；NeMeFIS 在复现真实驾驶行为上优于 Linear Regression、ANFIS 与 LSTM；fuzzy rule 分析显示减速时 declarative memory 规则需求最高，加速由 procedural memory 驱动，semantic 与 declarative memory 引导减速，风险感知在城市道路尤为关键。

papers.title: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities but suffer from substantial computational overhead, as vision tokens dominate the input sequence. This motivates vision token compression as a key direction to alleviate the burden. However, with the emergence of hybrid architectures incorporating linear attention (\eg, Qwen3.5), prior methods designed for softmax attention struggle to generalize. Our analysis reveals that both attention- and similarity-based approaches suffer notable performance degradation, underscoring the urgent need for compression methods tailored to this regime. To this end, we propose \textbf{V-CoLA}, an efficient training-free token compression framework specifically designed for linear attention. V-CoLA introduces a novel \textit{uniqueness-aware importance criterion} for identifying critical vision tokens, coupled with an \textit{adaptive token merging strategy} that performs compression. All components are optimized at the implementation level to remain compatible with the chunk-wise parallelism of linear attention, ensuring strong practical value. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of V-CoLA: it achieves 99.5\% of the original performance with only 50.0\% of vision tokens, and over 88.0\% with as few as 12.5\%, while delivering a 1.86$\times$ to 6.15$\times$ prefill speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-CoLA 是面向线性注意力 (linear attention) 混合架构 VLM 的免训练视觉 token 压缩框架：用唯一性感知重要性准则 (uniqueness-aware importance criterion) 挑关键视觉 token，再用自适应 token 合并执行压缩，实现层面按线性注意力的 chunk-wise 并行设计。保留 50.0% 视觉 token 时达到原模型 99.5% 性能，仅留 12.5% 时仍超 88.0%，prefill 加速 1.86× 至 6.15×。
Motivation: VLM 输入序列被视觉 token 主导，计算开销大；而 Qwen3.5 一类线性注意力混合架构出现后，为 softmax 注意力设计的压缩方法明显退化，注意力式与相似度式方案都出现显著性能下降。
Method: 提出免训练 (training-free) 框架 V-CoLA：以唯一性感知重要性准则识别关键视觉 token，配合自适应 token 合并策略完成压缩；所有组件在实现层优化，以兼容线性注意力的 chunk-wise 并行。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上，保留 50.0% 视觉 token 达到原模型 99.5% 性能，保留 12.5% 仍超过 88.0%，并带来 1.86× 至 6.15× 的 prefill 加速；作者同时指出注意力式与相似度式既有方法在此架构下有明显性能退化。
Conclusion: 线性注意力 VLM 的视觉 token 压缩需要按该架构专门设计，V-CoLA 在大幅削减 token 数与加速 prefill 的同时基本保住原有性能。

papers.title: Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables effective capability transfer between language models, yet the mechanisms underlying its failures are not fully understood. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning, OPD with larger-scale teachers exhibits early loss plateaus, with an average final loss reduction of 25.1% after 200 updates, compared with 96.2% for self-RL teachers, obtained by further reinforcement learning (RL) training of the initial student. To understand this difference, we analyze OPD as an idealized continuous-time dynamical system in the small-learning-rate limit. Our training-log diagnostics associate these plateaus with an early decline in a gradient-based learning-signal proxy while substantial loss remains; these measurements do not establish why the underlying gradient weakens. We further prove a local recovery guarantee for teachers sufficiently close to the initial student in a shared parameterization under regularity conditions, offering a conditional explanation for the success of self-RL teachers in our experiments. Across runs with and without loss plateaus, we observe small relative parameter changes (0.025-0.098%) and high similarity between the student's representations before and after OPD (linear CKA $>0.98$ across layers). These observations suggest that limited representation adaptation may contribute to learning-signal collapse, a hypothesis that remains to be tested. Code is available at https://github.com/leizhao7/opd-learning-signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在代码生成与数学推理上，用大规模教师做 on-policy distillation (OPD) 会出现早期 loss 平台：200 次更新后平均最终 loss 仅降 25.1%，而由初始学生继续 RL 得到的 self-RL 教师降 96.2%。训练日志诊断把平台与梯度型学习信号代理的早期衰减关联起来；同时 OPD 期间相对参数变化仅 0.025–0.098%、各层 linear CKA > 0.98，提示表征适应不足可能是学习信号塌缩的原因。
Motivation: OPD 在语言模型间迁移能力有效，但其失败机制不清楚：大规模教师下 loss 早早停滞，而 self-RL 教师却能持续下降，需要解释这一差异从何而来。
Method: 把 OPD 在小学习率极限下建模为理想化连续时间动力系统；用训练日志中的梯度型学习信号代理做诊断，并在共享参数化下对足够接近初始学生的教师证明正则条件下的局部恢复保证 (local recovery guarantee)；用参数相对变化与 linear CKA 度量表征漂移。
Result: 代码生成与数学推理上，大规模教师 OPD 200 次更新后平均最终 loss 降幅 25.1%，self-RL 教师为 96.2%；有无 loss 平台的运行中相对参数变化均很小 (0.025–0.098%)，学生 OPD 前后各层表征 linear CKA > 0.98。
Conclusion: self-RL 教师的成功可由教师接近初始学生时的局部恢复保证作条件性解释；表征适应受限可能促成学习信号塌缩，但作者明确指出这只是待检验的假设，且日志诊断并未确立梯度为何变弱。

papers.title: Read What Matters: Query-Adaptive Quantization for KV Caches
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache entries are stored before their future queries are known, but each decoding query needs precision in different places. We study this mismatch using separate budgets for retained bits and bits fetched per query. ReadKV stores each key and value in a progressive code whose prefixes support different reconstruction precisions. For each query, it allocates key-channel prefixes using the query, computes attention from the reconstructed keys, and then allocates value-token prefixes using that attention. Stored entries remain unchanged. Each stage optimizes a calibrated distortion objective under a fixed budget; we prove exact allocation under diminishing refinement gains and relate these objectives to attention-output error. We also exhibit a finite-dimensional attention family where query-dependent access strictly outperforms every query-independent reader at the same read budget, even with unrestricted competing encoders and decoders. Across six base models, reading four bits on average from an eight-bit cache increases C4 perplexity by at most 0.66%, using about one quarter of the logical reads and half the retained capacity of a 16-bit cache. It is consistently more accurate than storing and fully reading four bits at the same payload-read budget. Retaining more bits than each query fetches is aimed at long-context decoding, where the cache bytes moved per step, rather than the weights, dominate cost. Long-context question answering and retrieval on two instruction-tuned models provide additional quality evidence. On the tested 8K-token, batch-one, single-layer workload on an NVIDIA A10G, a restricted eight-bit ReadKV reader with a two-bit mean payload-read budget has 39% lower latency than the tested TurboQuant codec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReadKV 把 KV cache 每个 key/value 存成前缀可分级重建的渐进码 (progressive code)，解码时按查询自适应读取：先用 query 分配 key-channel 前缀并算注意力，再按该注意力分配 value-token 前缀，存储条目本身不变。六个基模型上平均只从 8-bit cache 读 4 bit，C4 perplexity 最多上升 0.66%，逻辑读次数约为 16-bit cache 的四分之一、保留容量为其一半；在相同 payload-read 预算下比固定 4-bit 存取更准，8K/batch-1/单层 A10G 上比 TurboQuant 延迟低 39%。
Motivation: KV cache 条目在写入时还不知道未来查询是什么，而每个解码查询只在部分位置需要精度，固定精度的存取方案在保留位数与每查询读取位数两个预算上都浪费。
Method: ReadKV 用渐进码存储 key/value，前缀支持不同重建精度；每步解码先由 query 分配 key-channel 前缀、由重建 key 计算注意力，再由该注意力分配 value-token 前缀，两阶段都在固定预算下优化校准失真目标。作者证明在收益递减 (diminishing refinement gains) 下的精确分配，并把目标与 attention 输出误差关联；还构造了一个有限维 attention 族，证明查询相关读取在相同读预算下严格优于任何查询无关读取器（对手编码器/解码器不受限）。
Result: 六个基模型上，从 8-bit cache 平均读 4 bit 使 C4 perplexity 最多增加 0.66%，逻辑读取量约为 16-bit cache 的四分之一、保留容量为其一半；在相同 payload-read 预算下比存取均为 4-bit 更准。两个指令微调模型上的长上下文 QA 与检索提供额外质量证据；在 NVIDIA A10G 的 8K-token、batch-one、单层负载上，受限 8-bit 读取器配 2-bit 平均 payload-read 预算比 TurboQuant codec 延迟低 39%。
Conclusion: 保留位数可以高于每查询读取位数，让读取随查询自适应是长上下文解码下更省的取舍：成本由每步搬运的 cache 字节而非权重主导，查询相关访问在理论上严格优于查询无关读取器。

papers.title: TAP3D: Thermal-Assisted 3D Human Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Human body point clouds are a versatile representation for AI-enabled human sensing. However, existing methods using LiDAR, radar, and depth cameras suffer from inherent drawbacks in high cost, sparse reconstruction, and privacy concerns, etc. In this paper, we exploit low-cost thermal arrays and present TAP3D, the first system to reconstruct 3D human point clouds from body heat signatures, offering significant advantages in cost, density, human sensitivity, and privacy. To overcome major challenges in depth estimation, thermal interference, and multi-person separation, we propose a novel physics-informed design, which integrates a forward thermal physics model with two distinct modules: multi-primitive estimation for self-supervised joint recovery of depth and other thermal properties, and geometric perspective fusion for suppressing interference and disentangling multiple people. We implement TAP3D using a single commodity thermal array sensor and build a large-scale dataset (160K samples, 8 environments, 11 users) for evaluation. TAP3D achieves remarkable accuracy for dense point cloud generation, enabling downstream tasks like fall detection (91.46%), indoor tracking (21.86 cm MAE), and human mesh recovery (4.87 cm error). By transforming body heat into point clouds for the first time, TAP3D pioneers a new paradigm for privacy-first, fully passive human sensing for many applications. TAP3D is open-sourced at https://github.com/aiot-lab/TAP3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAP3D 用单个低成本热阵列传感器从人体热辐射重建稠密 3D 点云，通过前向热物理模型加多基元估计（自监督联合恢复深度与热属性）和几何透视融合（抑制热干扰、分离多人）解决深度估计难题。在自建 160K 样本、8 环境、11 用户数据集上，跌倒检测 91.46%、室内跟踪 MAE 21.86 cm、人体网格恢复误差 4.87 cm。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR、雷达、深度相机做人体点云成本高、重建稀疏且有隐私顾虑，需要低成本、被动、隐私友好的替代方案。
Method: 提出 TAP3D：前向热物理模型 + 多基元估计（自监督联合恢复深度与其他热属性）+ 几何透视融合（抑制热干扰并解耦多人），用单个商用热阵列传感器实现。

papers.title: Attributing HOW, Not Just WHICH: Counterfactual Response Trajectories for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image generation, yet tracing their outputs to individual training examples remains challenging. Existing attribution methods often compress factor-specific effects into scalar responses, making distinct internal changes indistinguishable. This is particularly limiting for diffusion models, where semantic factors emerge through evolving representation dynamics during denoising. We therefore reformulate diffusion data attribution as attributing factor-induced internal response trajectories. In this paper, we propose a novel Concept Attribution method through Dynamic Trajectories(CADT). We argue that attribution should therefore ask not only \emph{which} examples matter, but also \emph{how} their influence unfolds during generation. Specifically, we construct matched counterfactual pairs at identical noisy states to isolate factor-specific representation displacements, and model their directional and magnitude evolution across denoising as dynamic attribution signatures. For each training example and generated query, CADT extracts stage-wise feature vectors and integrates them along the denoising process to form a trajectory descriptor. Applying the same construction across the training set yields a bank of factor-specific trajectory descriptors. The covariance statistics of this bank are then used to construct . CADT uses this covariance-aware positive-semidefinite kernel to calibrate the query and training representations, and compares the calibrated query trajectory with each training trajectory to produce the final training-sample attribution scores. Experiments on multiple public datasets show consistent improvements over existing diffusion attribution baselines across hierarchical, compositional, and style attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADT 把扩散模型的数据归因从「哪些训练样本重要」改成「影响如何随去噪过程展开」：在相同噪声状态下构造匹配反事实对以隔离单因子的表征位移，把各阶段特征沿去噪过程积分成轨迹描述子，再用轨迹库的协方差统计构造正半定核来校准查询与训练表征并给出归因分数。在多个公开数据集上，该方法在层级、组合与风格三类归因任务上相对已有扩散归因基线一致提升。
Motivation: 现有扩散数据归因把因子效应压成标量响应，无法区分不同的内部变化，而语义因子是在去噪过程中逐步涌现的，标量形式天然丢失了这一时间维度。
Method: CADT 在相同噪声状态上构造匹配反事实对以分离因子特异的表征位移，并将其方向与幅度随去噪的演化建模为动态归因签名；对每个训练样本与生成查询抽取分阶段特征向量并沿去噪过程积分成轨迹描述子，对整个训练集同样构造得到因子特异轨迹描述子库，用该库的协方差统计构造协方差感知的正半定核 (covariance-aware PSD kernel) 校准查询与训练表征，再比较校准后的查询轨迹与各训练轨迹得到最终训练样本归因分数。
Result: 在多个公开数据集上，CADT 在层级 (hierarchical)、组合 (compositional) 与风格 (style) 三类归因任务中相对已有扩散归因基线取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 数据归因应同时回答「哪些样本重要」与「其影响在生成过程中如何展开」，把归因对象换成去噪轨迹并用协方差感知核做校准，可以在多类归因设定下稳定优于标量式归因。

papers.title: Breaking the Group Size Barrier: Parameter-Efficient Group Dance Generation with Chain-of-Dancers
papers.abstract_en: Group dance generation aims to synthesize coordinated multi-dancer choreography from music, with broad applications in animation and interactive content creation. This task requires modeling dense inter-person dependencies to ensure spatial coordination, while naturally preserving individual dancer identities. Existing approaches model all dancers jointly with end-to-end transformers, which tie the architecture to a fixed group size and entangle per-dancer identities across frames. We propose ChainDance, a scalable framework that reformulates group dance generation as a Chain-of-Dancers: a sequential decomposition over per-dancer conditional distributions, allowing a single model to scale across variable group sizes without retraining and naturally preserving per-dancer identity. Built on a frozen single-dancer diffusion backbone, ChainDance introduces two lightweight modules: a Role-Aware Text Encoder (RATE) for per-dancer semantic conditioning, and a Group-Aware Motion Encoder (GAME) that aggregates previously generated dancers via a distance-weighted graph convolutional network, and incorporates a training-free noise optimization procedure at inference time to enforce global spatial coherence. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChainDance achieves state-of-the-art motion quality and group coordination while structurally preserving per-dancer identity, with $3$-$4\times$ fewer parameters and requiring $3$-$6\times$ less training time compared to prior approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChainDance 把群舞生成改写为 Chain-of-Dancers：按舞者逐个条件分解生成，单模型无需重训即可适配可变人数并保留个体身份。在 AIOZ-GDance 上达到 SOTA 的动作质量与群体协调性，参数量比既有方法少 3–4 倍、训练时间少 3–6 倍。
Motivation: 现有端到端 Transformer 把所有舞者联合建模，架构被固定人数绑死，且跨帧纠缠个体身份，无法扩展到可变规模的群舞。
Method: 基于冻结的单人扩散骨干，加两个轻量模块：Role-Aware Text Encoder (RATE) 做逐舞者语义条件，Group-Aware Motion Encoder (GAME) 用距离加权图卷积聚合已生成舞者，并在推理时用免训练噪声优化强制全局空间一致性。
Result: 在 AIOZ-GDance 上达到 SOTA 的动作质量与群体协调性，同时结构性保留逐舞者身份；参数量比既有方法少 3–4 倍，训练时间少 3–6 倍。
Conclusion: 把群舞生成拆成逐舞者的条件序列，可在不重训的前提下跨可变人数扩展，并同时降低参数与训练成本。

papers.title: Low-Cost Sensor Calibration for Indoor Air Quality Monitoring: A Dataset, Evaluation Scenarios, and a Lightweight Model
papers.abstract_en: Low-cost sensors enable scalable indoor air quality monitoring but require calibration because of nonlinear distortions, noise, and temporal drift. The conventional strict pairwise calibration setting requires a co-located reference sensor at each deployment location and does not account for spatial and temporal heterogeneity. To address these limitations, we introduce a six-month dataset comprising multivariate indoor air-quality measurements from low-cost and reference sensors with contextual metadata collected at five locations. Using this dataset, we define four evaluation scenarios. The reference-efficient and location-transfer scenarios evaluate spatial generalization, whereas the long-term drift and event-conditioned scenarios assess robustness to gradual and abrupt distribution shifts. Based on these scenarios, we derive design requirements and propose a lightweight temporal model that combines input-window compression with residual temporal and feature fusion. Experiments show strong calibration performance across all four scenarios with low edge-inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对低成本室内空气质量传感器的非线性失真、噪声与时漂，提出一个轻量时序校准模型，把输入窗口压缩与残差时序、特征融合结合，在四个评测场景下都取得强校准性能且边缘推理开销低。
Motivation: 传统严格成对校准要求每个部署点都配同址参考传感器，且不处理空间与时间异质性，限制了低成本传感器的大规模部署。
Method: 构建为期六个月、覆盖五个地点的多变量低成本/参考传感器数据集并附带上下文元数据，据此定义四个评测场景（reference-efficient、location-transfer 考察空间泛化，long-term drift、event-conditioned 考察渐变与突变分布偏移），从中推导设计需求，提出结合输入窗口压缩与残差时序、特征融合的轻量时序模型。
Result: 在全部四个场景下实验均显示强校准性能，同时保持低边缘推理开销；数据集规模为六个月、五个地点的多变量测量。
Conclusion: 放宽成对校准约束、以场景化评测驱动的轻量时序模型可在空间迁移与分布偏移下同时兼顾校准精度和边缘部署成本。

papers.title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
papers.abstract_en: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniVer-V 把短视频核查中的证据选择准则从主题相关性改为证据充分性 (evidential sufficiency)，用两层框架分离 claim-video 一致性与需外部佐证的事实判定，再由充分性驱动的贪心搜索逐条加入证据直到阈值，池子耗尽则输出 insufficient 而非强行给结论。Claude Sonnet 4 上 Macro-F1 0.510、平均只用 4.5 个证据单元（全量的 16%），与全证据基线 0.518/27.7 单元统计上不可区分。
Motivation: 短视频事实核查要么把全部证据喂给验证器引入噪声，要么按主题相关性选证据，把“相关”与“充分”混为一谈，导致冗余且无法识别证据不足的情形。
Method: 构建 MiniVer-V 基准：195 条短视频、三分类判定标注（supported/refuted/insufficient）、5,510 个多模态证据单元（视觉关键帧、语音转写、网络检索外部来源）。其上提出两层验证框架，第一层用内部证据评估 claim-video 一致性，第二层判定事实结论并额外要求外部佐证；顶层用充分性驱动的贪心搜索累积证据至充分性阈值，候选池耗尽则输出 insufficient。
Result: Claude Sonnet 4 上 Macro-F1 0.510，平均使用 4.5 个证据单元（占全量证据集 16%），与全证据基线 0.518/27.7 单元统计上不可区分；相比同一搜索去掉 abstention 的版本，对 insufficient 案例的识别显著提升。该效率结果在 GPT-5.5 上复现，仅在开源 Qwen2.5-72B 验证器上部分成立。消融显示外部证据对事实判定不可或缺，内部视频证据则把判定锚定在 claim-video 一致性上。
Conclusion: 证据高效的短视频核查是可行的，且当证据确实不足时必须显式 abstention，而不是强行给出判定。

papers.title: Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?
papers.abstract_en: Small vision-language models may be able to read external evidence yet struggle to obtain it. We introduce Harness Compilation (HC), an offline procedure that adapts the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness. A large teacher uses student execution traces to revise reusable content and control, while a separate validation set selects the deployed harness. Deployment requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls. Across seven visual question-answering settings with students of at most 9B parameters, HC improves scores over bare students by 9.9-23.9 points, averaged over three independent builds per setting. Interventions on five runtime decision types (invocation, selection, argument generation, evidence integration and abstention) show why this allocation matters: requesting evidence and generating open queries can be costly, whereas bounded choices and reading supplied text can remain useful student work. Fact cards benefit all ten evaluated students, but decision policies transfer unevenly. Recompilation for a new student model helps when the transferred interface no longer fits the student. With 100 practice items, HC exceeds answer-only LoRA on three tasks. Larger training budgets can match or surpass a fixed harness, while combining the two improves SlideVQA beyond either alone. These findings support allocating work from measured student behavior rather than uniformly removing decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Harness Compilation (HC) 是一种离线重分配小 VLM 与其外部 harness 分工的编译流程：大 teacher 依据学生执行轨迹改写可复用的内容与控制，独立验证集选出部署用 harness，部署时无需权重更新或 teacher 调用。在 7 个 VQA 设定（学生 ≤9B）上比裸学生高 9.9–23.9 分；五类运行时决策的干预表明请求证据与生成开放查询对学生代价高，而有界选择与读取给定文本仍适合学生做。
Motivation: 小 VLM 能读外部证据却难以自行获取，harness 中哪些决策该留给学生、哪些该固化缺少依据，均匀移除决策或固定 harness 都可能不合适。
Method: HC 离线进行：大 teacher 用学生执行轨迹 (execution traces) 改写可复用内容与控制，独立验证集选择部署 harness；对 invocation、selection、argument generation、evidence integration、abstention 五类运行时决策做干预实验；每个设定做三次独立构建。
Result: 7 个 VQA 设定、学生至多 9B 参数，HC 比裸学生提高 9.9–23.9 分（三次独立构建平均）；fact cards 对全部 10 个被评学生均有益，但决策策略迁移不均；100 个练习样本时 HC 在三个任务上超过 answer-only LoRA；更大训练预算可匹配或超过固定 harness，二者结合在 SlideVQA 上超过任一单独方案。
Conclusion: harness 决策应按实测学生行为分配，而非一律移除；换学生模型后原接口不再匹配时需要重新编译，且组合固定 harness 与更大训练预算在 SlideVQA 上最优。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SteerCast: Retrieval-Based Latent Steering for Decoder-Only Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting aims to predict future values from historical observations and auxiliary features. We propose \textbf{SteerCast}, a retrieval-based latent steering method that improves decoder-only forecaster at inference time, without updating its parameters. SteerCast constructs a database from the training set by storing a representation of each history window together with a \emph{steering vector} computed in the forecaster's latent space, defined as the difference between representations induced by the ground-truth continuation and by the model's own prediction. At test time, SteerCast retrieves nearest neighbors for a query history, aggregates their steering vectors, and injects the resulting signal into the forecaster's hidden states at every step of autoregressive generation, guiding predictions toward trajectories consistent with similar training cases. Experiments across diverse multivariate benchmarks and multiple horizons show that SteerCast consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the fine-tuned backbone and retrieval-based baselines, while requiring no additional training beyond the original fine-tuning and using only the training set as a retrieval corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SteerCast 在推理期为 decoder-only 时序预报器注入检索到的隐空间转向信号：用训练集每个历史窗口的真实延续与模型自身预测在隐空间的表示差构造 steering vector，测试时检索近邻并聚合，逐步注入自回归生成的 hidden states。在多个多变量基准与多个预报长度上，其预报精度一致优于微调后的骨干与检索类基线，且不需额外训练。
Motivation: decoder-only 时序预报器的误差在自回归生成中累积，微调骨干难以在推理期利用训练集中相似历史的延续轨迹，检索类方法又缺少在隐空间直接纠偏的手段。
Method: 从训练集构建检索库：每个历史窗口存一份表示，加上一个 steering vector，即真实延续与模型自身预测在预报器隐空间所诱导表示之差。测试时对查询历史检索最近邻，聚合其 steering vector，并在自回归生成的每一步把该信号注入 hidden states，把预测引向与相似训练案例一致的轨迹；除原始微调外无需额外训练，检索语料只用训练集。
Result: 在多个多变量基准 (multivariate benchmarks) 和多个预报长度上，SteerCast 的预报精度一致高于微调后的骨干以及检索类基线，且不引入原始微调之外的训练。
Conclusion: 推理期的检索式隐空间转向可以在不更新参数、不扩充训练的前提下稳定提升 decoder-only 时序预报精度，检索语料仅需训练集。

papers.title: Multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Sequential Recommendation via Collaborative Filtering Paths
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for sequential recommendation through their ability to reason over complex multimodal data. However, existing approaches either rely solely on the target user's own interaction history, neglecting collaborative signals from neighboring users, or incur substantial computational overhead through repeated MLLM inference over long interaction histories. To address these challenges, we propose MGRASRec, a multimodal graph retrieval-augmented framework for sequential recommendation. MGRASRec injects collaborative filtering signals conditioned on the candidate item directly into the MLLM prompt by retrieving structured paths from a user-item interaction graph, extended via multimodal similarity to increase coverage beyond exact co-interaction overlap. This retrieval also surfaces the history items most relevant to the candidate at no additional cost, removing the need for recurrent summarization and keeping inference to a single forward pass per candidate. All components are unified into an augmented prompt for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an MLLM. Extensive evaluations across three publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of MGRASRec, achieving the best performance on all metrics with particularly strong gains in ranking quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGRASRec 把用户-物品交互图上的协同过滤路径按候选物品检索出来，再用多模态相似度扩展覆盖，直接注入 MLLM prompt，使每个候选只需一次前向推理。在三个公开数据集上取得全部指标最优，排序质量提升尤其明显。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 序列推荐要么只用目标用户自身交互历史、丢掉邻居用户的协同信号，要么对长交互历史反复调用 MLLM，计算开销大。
Method: 从用户-物品交互图中按候选物品检索结构化路径注入 MLLM prompt，并用多模态相似度扩展路径以超出精确共交互重叠的覆盖；检索同时筛出与候选最相关的历史物品，省去反复摘要，全部组件合成一个增强 prompt 做参数高效微调 (parameter-efficient fine-tuning)。
Result: 在三个公开可用数据集上的广泛评测中，MGRASRec 在所有指标上取得最佳性能，排序质量 (ranking quality) 提升尤其突出。
Conclusion: 把协同信号按候选条件化地注入 prompt，可以在保持单次前向推理的同时提升序列推荐效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Lower Reconstruction Loss Hurts: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) relies heavily on reconstruction loss minimization to preserve model quality at low precision. We show that the weights favored by minimizing this loss need not yield better model performance on new tasks. In fact, we find that lower reconstruction loss can even degrade model performance on the same calibration data. Our analysis further shows that weights with lower reconstruction loss on calibration data can have higher loss than other weights when the distribution of input activations changes. Motivated by these observations and our analysis, we propose Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ), a post-hoc refinement process that minimizes worst-case reconstruction loss over a constrained set of input activation distributions. DRQ refines the integer codes representing quantized weights within the existing quantization grid, keeping quantization parameters and inference operators unchanged. Extensive experiments show that DRQ improves models quantized by six representative PTQ methods, including AWQ, GPTQ, and ParoQuant, and delivers gains across both dense and mixture-of-experts large language models. These results establish DRQ as a general post-hoc refinement framework for weight-only PTQ, achieving better downstream performance without adding inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低比特 weight-only PTQ 中，校准集上更低的 reconstruction loss 并不保证更好的下游表现，甚至在同一批校准数据上也会让模型性能下降，因为输入激活分布一变，原本低 loss 的权重反而比其他权重 loss 更高。据此提出 DRQ：在既有量化网格内对整数码做后处理 refinement，最小化受约束输入激活分布集合上的最坏情况 reconstruction loss，量化参数与推理算子不变、不增加推理开销。
Motivation: PTQ 靠最小化 reconstruction loss 保住低精度下的模型质量，但该 loss 在分布偏移下会选出实际表现更差的权重，校准集上的优化目标与新任务表现脱节。
Method: 提出 Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ)，一个 post-hoc refinement 过程：在受约束的输入激活分布集合上最小化最坏情况 reconstruction loss，只在既有量化网格内修改表示量化权重的整数码，量化参数与推理算子保持不变。
Result: 在六个代表性 PTQ 方法（含 AWQ、GPTQ、ParoQuant）量化后的模型上均有改进，dense 与 mixture-of-experts 大语言模型都取得增益，且不引入推理开销。
Conclusion: reconstruction loss 本身是不可靠的代理目标，用分布鲁棒的最坏情况 loss 做后处理 refinement 即可跨方法、跨架构提升下游表现，且零推理开销。
Relevance: 0
