papers.title: Do LLMs Learn from Rewards in Context? : Rethinking the role of reward in In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly improve at inference time by accumulating experience in context rather than by updating parameters. This process is often described as in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL). Whether in-context learning (ICL) can actually play the role of RL, however, has not been tested. We study this question in its simplest form, direct ICRL, where the model conditions directly on raw trajectory-reward pairs, and ask whether the reward acts as a learning signal. Through controlled experiments on four benchmarks across six models, we find that the reward is read, but its effect is small: flipping, randomizing, or removing the reward leaves the improvement curve almost unchanged, and this holds even under meta-prompts that explicitly instruct the model to explore, exploit, or reason over rewards. Trajectories drive improvement, but not through their semantic content: shuffled or corrupted trajectories work as well as real ones. These patterns closely mirror those known in ICL, suggesting that direct ICRL is better understood as a special case of ICL than as inference-time RL. This reframing has implications for agent memory design: ICL factors such as input distribution and demonstrations may matter more than RL elements such as reward shaping and exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 direct ICRL 设定下，LLM 读到了 reward 但几乎不靠它学习：翻转、随机化或删除 reward，四个基准、六个模型上的改进曲线几乎不变，即使 meta-prompt 明确要求探索、利用或对 reward 推理也一样。轨迹驱动改进但不靠语义内容，打乱或损坏的轨迹与真实轨迹同样有效，因此 direct ICRL 更应视为 ICL 的特例而非推理时 RL。
Motivation: LLM agent 靠上下文累积经验而非更新参数来改进，这一过程常被称为 in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL)，但 in-context learning 是否真能承担 RL 的角色从未被检验。
Method: 研究最简形式的 direct ICRL：让模型直接以原始 trajectory-reward 对为条件，通过受控实验检验 reward 是否构成学习信号，具体操作包括翻转、随机化、删除 reward，以及打乱或损坏轨迹，并加入明确指示探索、利用或对 reward 推理的 meta-prompt。
Result: 在四个基准、六个模型上，reward 被读取但影响很小：翻转、随机化或删除 reward 后改进曲线几乎不变，meta-prompt 显式要求探索、利用或对 reward 推理时结论不变；轨迹驱动改进但与其语义内容无关，打乱或损坏的轨迹与真实轨迹效果相同。
Conclusion: direct ICRL 更适合被理解为 ICL 的特例而非推理时 RL；对 agent memory 设计而言，输入分布与 demonstrations 这类 ICL 因素可能比 reward shaping 与探索这类 RL 元素更重要。

papers.title: A Unified Score Matching Paradigm for Video Anomaly Detection and Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a fundamental and safety-critical task in computer vision. Recent generative approaches detect anomalies from a distributional perspective, but remain limited by local anomaly modes. Meanwhile, video anomaly anticipation (VAA), as a proactive extension beyond post-hoc detection, introduces additional challenges. In particular, the contrastive inference paradigm in VAD, which relies on ground-truth frames, is not applicable to VAA, hindering its development. To address these challenges, we propose a unified score-driven framework, termed Uni-DSM, based on denoising score matching (DSM), which models anomaly patterns through likelihood estimation and score functions over the learned data distribution. Within this unified framework, we adopt a shared noise-conditioned score transformer backbone with scene-dependent embeddings and motion-aware weighting for distribution-level modeling. Instead of introducing separate architectures, Uni-DSM unifies VAD and VAA through different inference and supervision paradigms built upon the same score-based formulation. For VAD, we instantiate an autoregressive denoising score matching (ADSM) mechanism, which progressively accumulates anomalous evidence via autoregressive denoising, enabling enhanced perception of local modes beyond visual cues. For VAA, we extend the same architecture by incorporating a lightweight auxiliary decoder and a novel self-distilled denoising score matching (SDSM) mechanism. By constructing supervision from output discrepancies instead of relying on unavailable future ground truth, our method achieves efficient training suitable or early anomaly anticipation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both VAD and VAA while maintaining high efficiency, establishing a unified and scalable pipeline from anomaly detection to anticipation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的 score-driven 框架 Uni-DSM，用 denoising score matching (DSM) 在同一 score-based 公式下同时做视频异常检测 (VAD) 与异常预判 (VAA)：检测端用自回归去噪 (ADSM) 逐步累积异常证据，预判端加轻量辅助解码器与自蒸馏 SDSM，用输出差异构造监督以摆脱对未来真值帧的依赖。在多个 benchmark 上 VAD 与 VAA 均达到 state-of-the-art 并保持高效率。
Motivation: 生成式 VAD 受限于局部异常模式，且依赖真值帧的对比推理范式无法迁移到 VAA，阻碍了从事后检测到提前预判的扩展。
Method: 共享一个 noise-conditioned score transformer 主干，配 scene-dependent embedding 与 motion-aware weighting 做分布级建模；VAD 实例化为 autoregressive denoising score matching (ADSM)，VAA 在同一架构上加轻量辅助解码器与 self-distilled denoising score matching (SDSM)，监督来自输出差异而非未来真值。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 数据集上，VAD 与 VAA 两个任务均取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时保持高训练与推理效率；VAA 通过 SDSM 实现适合早期异常预判的高效训练。
Conclusion: 检测与预判不必各建架构：同一 score-based 公式配不同推理与监督范式即可覆盖从 VAD 到 VAA 的完整管线，且可扩展。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: SP-DocReader: Difference-Aware Self-Play for Precise Document OCR
papers.abstract_en: Accurate page transcription remains difficult for vision language models under limited input and training budgets. We present SP-DocReader, a self-play framework for optical character recognition (OCR) that targets residual errors after supervised fine-tuning. Reading Discrepancy Masking aligns reference and generated model tokens through a longest common subsequence, then scores unmatched positions with their full conditioning prefixes. Focused Fidelity Loss adds direct negative log-likelihood supervision at unmatched ground-truth positions. Only the OCR module is trained, while the backbone remains frozen. We derive the combined gradient to distinguish relative score optimization from direct supervision. Compared with SFT-2, SP-DR-3 reduces Vary-600K character error rate on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it reduces character error rate by approximately 54 percent and improves DocVQA Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS) by 3.7 points. These results show the value of focusing self-play training on the discrepancies that remain after supervised fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SP-DocReader 是面向 OCR 的自博弈 (self-play) 框架，用 Reading Discrepancy Masking 经最长公共子序列对齐参考与生成 token，只在未匹配位置上按完整前缀打分，并用 Focused Fidelity Loss 在这些 ground-truth 位置加直接 NLL 监督，仅训练 OCR 模块、骨干冻结。相比 SFT-2，SP-DR-3 在两个骨干上都降低 Vary-600K 字符错误率：Qwen3-VL-4B 上 CER 约降 54%，DocVQA ANLS 提升 3.7 点。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在有限输入与训练预算下页面转写仍不准，监督微调 (SFT) 之后还残留一批错误，而常规训练没有针对这些残差做监督。
Method: Reading Discrepancy Masking 用最长公共子序列 (LCS) 对齐参考与生成的模型 token，对未匹配位置用其完整条件前缀打分；Focused Fidelity Loss 在未匹配的 ground-truth 位置上加直接负对数似然 (NLL) 监督，并推导合并梯度以区分相对分数优化与直接监督。只有 OCR 模块参与训练，骨干保持冻结。
Result: 与 SFT-2 相比，SP-DR-3 在两个骨干上均降低 Vary-600K 字符错误率 (CER)；在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上 CER 约下降 54%，DocVQA 的 Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS) 提升 3.7 点。
Conclusion: 把自博弈训练的监督集中在监督微调后仍残留的差异位置上，能进一步压低 OCR 字符错误率并提升文档问答的 ANLS。

papers.title: Ranking Prior Alignment for Credit Risk Modeling: When Do External Priors Matter?
papers.abstract_en: Cold-start credit scoring -- deploying models with scarce labeled data, weak features, or minimal capacity -- is a recurring problem in financial machine learning. When a new lending product launches, labeled default data is scarce, feature pipelines are immature, and models must be deployed with minimal capacity to avoid overfitting. Standard defenses operate on the same limited data; what is needed is a source of external regularization grounded in domain knowledge. We propose Ranking Prior Alignment, a model-agnostic framework that distills external ranking priors (from domain experts, teacher models, or LLMs) into any scoring model via a temperature-scaled KL divergence loss. The framework unifies neural (MIL attention) and tree-based (XGBoost custom objective) architectures through a single formulation: L = L_task + gamma(t) * KL(P_agent || P_model), where gamma(t) follows an exponential decay schedule. The method requires no external model at inference, and its tree-based instantiation tolerates annotation noise up to eta = 0.5. On an industrial dataset of over 1.5M merchants, MIL alignment achieves 7/7 positive evaluation cells at 3K bags (1 ID + 3 OOT + 3 degradation metrics; peak Delta AUC = +0.020 on OOT-1), and XGBoost ablation achieves 9/9 positive metrics at 300 bags. Cross-dataset validation on public Amex shows 5/5 positive folds (avg Delta AUC = +0.041). Four model families (MIL, XGBoost, LightGBM, Logistic Regression) and four teacher architectures show that the framework is both model-agnostic and prior-source-independent. We further observe that alignment gains exhibit an inverse-scaling pattern: benefits grow as data abundance N, model capacity C, and feature quality Q decrease, helping practitioners decide when to invest in prior annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Ranking Prior Alignment：把外部排序先验（专家、教师模型或 LLM）经温度缩放 KL 散度蒸馏进任意打分模型，损失为 L = L_task + gamma(t)·KL(P_agent‖P_model)，gamma(t) 按指数衰减。在 150 万商户工业数据上 3K bags 时 MIL 对齐 7/7 评估单元为正、OOT-1 峰值 ΔAUC +0.020，XGBoost 消融 9/9 指标为正，公开 Amex 上 5/5 折为正、平均 ΔAUC +0.041；收益随数据量 N、模型容量 C、特征质量 Q 下降而增大。
Motivation: 冷启动信用评分中标签稀缺、特征管线不成熟、模型须以极小容量部署以防过拟合，而标准正则手段只能作用于这批有限数据，缺少基于领域知识的外部正则来源。
Method: Ranking Prior Alignment 框架：以温度缩放的 KL 散度把外部排序先验蒸馏进打分模型，损失 L = L_task + gamma(t)·KL(P_agent || P_model)，gamma(t) 走指数衰减调度；同一公式统一神经（MIL attention）与树模型（XGBoost custom objective）两类实例化，推理阶段不需要外部模型，树模型版本可容忍 eta = 0.5 的标注噪声。
Result: 工业数据集（超过 1.5M merchants）上，MIL 对齐在 3K bags（1 ID + 3 OOT + 3 退化指标）取得 7/7 正评估单元，OOT-1 峰值 ΔAUC = +0.020；XGBoost 消融在 300 bags 取得 9/9 正指标；公开 Amex 跨数据集验证 5/5 折为正，平均 ΔAUC = +0.041。四类模型（MIL、XGBoost、LightGBM、Logistic Regression）与四种教师架构显示框架模型无关且先验来源无关；对齐收益呈 inverse-scaling：N、C、Q 越低收益越大。
Conclusion: 外部排序先验作为正则在冷启动、低容量、弱特征条件下最划算，收益随数据与容量充裕而衰减，因此是否投入先验标注应按 N、C、Q 的丰度决定。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 Ranking Prior Alignment：把外部排序先验（专家、教师模型或 LLM）经温度缩放 KL 散度蒸馏进任意打分模型，损失为 L = L_task + gamma(t)·KL(P_agent‖P_model)，gamma(t) 按指数衰减。在 150 万商户工业数据上 3K bags 时 MIL 对齐 7/7 评估单元为正、OOT-1 峰值 ΔAUC +0.020，XGBoost 消融 9/9 指标为正，公开 Amex 上 5/5 折为正、平均 ΔAUC +0.041；收益随数据量 N、模型容量 C、特征质量 Q 下降而增大。
summary_sections.motivation: 冷启动信用评分中标签稀缺、特征管线不成熟、模型须以极小容量部署以防过拟合，而标准正则手段只能作用于这批有限数据，缺少基于领域知识的外部正则来源。
summary_sections.method: Ranking Prior Alignment 框架：以温度缩放的 KL 散度把外部排序先验蒸馏进打分模型，损失 L = L_task + gamma(t)·KL(P_agent || P_model)，gamma(t) 走指数衰减调度；同一公式统一神经（MIL attention）与树模型（XGBoost custom objective）两类实例化，推理阶段不需要外部模型，树模型版本可容忍 eta = 0.5 的标注噪声。

papers.title: Tight Bounds for Equivalence Testing with Non-Adaptive Conditional Samples
papers.abstract_en: We study distribution testing with access to non-adaptive conditional samples. Specifically, we give tight bounds for equivalence testing, determining whether two unknown distributions are equal to or $\varepsilon$-far from each other in total variation distance. Our algorithm and lower bound show that $\tilde Θ\left(\frac{\log n}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ queries are necessary and sufficient for this problem. These results demonstrate that the complexity of uniformity, identity, and equivalence testing with non-adaptive conditional samples are all $\tilde Θ(\log n)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非自适应条件采样 (non-adaptive conditional samples) 模型下给出分布等价性检验的紧界：判定两个未知分布相等或在总变差距离上相距 ε 所需查询数为 Θ̃(log n / ε²)，算法与下界匹配。由此均匀性、同一性与等价性检验在该模型下的复杂度均为 Θ̃(log n)。
Motivation: 非自适应条件采样模型下，等价性检验（判定两分布相等还是 ε-远离）此前缺少紧的查询复杂度刻画，而它与均匀性、同一性检验同属该模型的基础问题。
Method: 针对非自适应条件采样给出等价性检验的算法与匹配下界，判定标准为两未知分布是否在总变差距离上相等或 ε-远离；复杂度以分布支撑规模 n 与精度 ε 表述。
Result: 查询复杂度紧界为 Θ̃(log n / ε²)，算法与下界匹配；均匀性、同一性、等价性检验在非自适应条件采样下的复杂度同为 Θ̃(log n)。
Conclusion: 非自适应条件采样下等价性检验的复杂度被完全刻画，且与均匀性、同一性检验同阶，说明该模型中这三类检验难度一致。

papers.title: Improving Image-Based Nutrition Estimation Through Multimodal Food-Item Verification and Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Single-image nutrition estimation can fail silently when visible foods are missed. Even when a food is correctly identified, its proposed region may not support portion estimation. We propose a framework that uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to inventory visible foods and separately verify food identity and whether each proposed 2D region supports portion estimation. One whole-image review uses these verification results to identify unresolved gaps and omitted foods, triggering at most one targeted recovery pass. Recovered regions are re-verified without access to the recovery prompt, then reconciled into a final item set for nutrition estimation. The framework requires no task-specific fine-tuning. Matched evaluation on common valid-output samples shows that item-level grounding improves mass accuracy across all tested settings and energy accuracy relative to an adapted retrieval baseline, with item-identity precision and recall also improving, while post-recovery visual coverage is assessed separately at inference time without ground-truth annotations.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 单图营养估计会因漏掉可见食物或框选区域不支持份量估计而静默失败；框架用 MLLM 分别核验食物身份与 2D 区域是否支撑份量估计，再由一次全图复审触发至多一次定向恢复，恢复区域在不看恢复提示的条件下重新核验后合并成最终条目集。在共同有效输出样本的配对评测中，条目级 grounding 在所有测试设置上都提升质量精度，并相对改造后的检索基线提升能量精度，条目身份的精确率与召回率同时改善。
Motivation: 单图营养估计在可见食物被漏检时会静默出错；即使食物识别正确，其提出的 2D 区域也可能不足以支撑份量估计，导致质量与能量估计偏差。
Method: 用多模态大模型 (MLLM) 清点可见食物，并分别核验食物身份与每个提出的 2D 区域是否支持份量估计；一次全图复审依据核验结果找出未解决的缺口与遗漏食物，触发至多一次定向恢复；恢复区域在不接触恢复提示的条件下重新核验，再合并为最终条目集做营养估计。全程无需任务特定微调。
Result: 在共同有效输出样本上的配对评测中，条目级 grounding 在所有测试设置上均提升质量 (mass) 精度，并相对改造后的检索基线 (adapted retrieval baseline) 提升能量 (energy) 精度；条目身份精确率与召回率同时提高。恢复后的视觉覆盖度在推理时单独评估，不使用真值标注。
Conclusion: 把身份核验与区域核验拆开、再用一次全图复审驱动至多一次恢复，可以在不微调的前提下减少漏检与无效区域，从而同时改善质量、能量与条目身份的估计。

papers.title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActiveMedAgent 把临床从便宜到昂贵的序贯检查逻辑搬进多模态医疗 AI：冻结的 VLM 上维护候选诊断概率分布，按每步诊断效用减成本给采集动作打分，再离线训练轻量 MLP 控制器决定继续取证还是下诊断。在三个常用基准上，轨迹策略学习稳定超过无引导采集与全模态基线，并出现信息过载效应——175 例中它用更少通道给出正确诊断而全模态基线失败。
Motivation: 多模态医疗诊断通常一次性喂入全部模态，既抬高检查成本，又让模型被冗余证据淹没；临床上医生只在新增证据有望消除不确定性时才升级检查，这一序贯成本逻辑在现有 AI 系统中缺失。
Method: 给定冻结的、经 API 调用的 vision-language model，框架维护候选诊断上的概率分布，用每步诊断效用减去采集成本为每条动作打分；随后离线训练一个轻量 MLP 控制器，在这些打分轨迹上学习何时请求额外证据、何时直接提交诊断。
Result: 在三个常用基准上，基于轨迹的策略学习 consistently 优于无引导采集 (unguided acquisition) 和全模态 (full-modality) 基线；并识别出信息过载效应：在 175 例中，该 agent 用更少通道给出正确诊断，而全模态基线失败。
Conclusion: 学会省略什么与学会采集什么同样重要：带成本感知的序贯取证策略在多模态医疗诊断中比一次性全模态输入更有效。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Accelerating Non-Smooth and Heavy-Tailed Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Anchored Langevin dynamics (ALD) is useful for non-smooth sampling where the density of the target distribution is possibly non-differentiable and heavy-tailed; reflected anchored Langevin dynamics (RALD) can sample possibly non-differentiable target density on a constrained domain. In this paper, we propose and study non-reversible anchored Langevin dynamics (NALD) for sampling possibly non-differentiable and heavy-tailed target density in the Euclidean space and the non-reversible reflected anchored Langevin dynamics (NRALD) for sampling possibly non-differentiable target density in the constrained space. Our construction adds a circulation drift generated by a possibly state-dependent divergence-free skew-symmetric matrix field and a stream potential. It preserves the target distribution without requiring derivatives of target density, admits a random-time-change representation, and applies both on the whole Euclidean space and on bounded domains with normal reflection. By breaking reversibility, we show that NALD and NRALD can converge to their target distributions faster than their reversible counterparts via finite-time non-asymptotic convergence analysis, a large deviations analysis and asymptotic variance reduction. Numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在锚定 Langevin 动力学 (ALD/RALD) 基础上加入由可能依赖状态的无散度反对称矩阵场与 stream potential 生成的 circulation drift，提出非可逆版本 NALD（欧氏空间）与 NRALD（有界域法向反射），在不需要目标密度导数的前提下保持目标分布不变。有限时间非渐近收敛分析、大偏差分析与渐近方差约简三条路线都表明其收敛快于可逆对应版本，数值实验显示算法更高效。
Motivation: 非光滑、重尾目标分布的采样无法使用依赖梯度的标准 Langevin 方法，而可逆的 ALD/RALD 收敛速度受可逆性限制。
Method: 构造 NALD 与 NRALD：在动力学中加入由可能状态依赖的无散度反对称 (skew-symmetric) 矩阵场与 stream potential 产生的 circulation drift；保持目标分布、具有 random-time-change 表示，分别适用于欧氏空间与带法向反射的有界域。
Result: 通过有限时间非渐近收敛分析、大偏差分析与渐近方差约简证明 NALD/NRALD 比可逆对应版本收敛更快；数值实验证明所提算法的效率。
Conclusion: 打破可逆性是在不使用目标密度导数的条件下加速非光滑与重尾采样的有效途径，且同一构造可覆盖无约束与反射边界两种设置。

papers.title: IntrinSync: Joint Intrinsic Decomposition and Reciprocal Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Inverse rendering decomposes an image into intrinsic properties such as appearance, illumination, geometry, and material, yet these properties are inherently interdependent. A reliable decomposition should produce intrinsic maps that are not only individually plausible, but also mutually compatible in explaining the image. However, existing methods either model intrinsic channels in isolation or treat inverse and forward rendering as separate processes, leaving the interdependence underexploited. In this paper, we introduce IntrinSync, a unified framework that captures this interdependence through joint-channel modeling and reciprocal inverse-forward rendering. At the channel level, we jointly decompose an input RGB into albedo, shading, surface normal, roughness, and metallic maps through a 1-to-N mapping, enabling information exchange across channels throughout generation. At the process level, we establish inverse-forward reciprocity through a dual cycle-consistent objective that aligns corresponding predictions across a closed loop. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive intrinsic estimation and forward rendering performance, improving coherence and physical consistency. Beyond decomposition, IntrinSync provides a physically grounded interface for image editing, allowing intrinsic properties to be explicitly manipulated and rendered back into RGB images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IntrinSync 把逆渲染的多个本征通道放进一个统一框架：用 1-to-N 映射联合分解 RGB 为 albedo、shading、surface normal、roughness、metallic，并以双 cycle-consistent 目标让逆渲染与正向渲染在闭环上互相对齐。在三个数据集上取得有竞争力的本征估计与正向渲染表现，通道一致性与物理一致性得到提升，并可作为图像编辑的物理接口把本征属性改回 RGB。
Motivation: 本征属性（外观、光照、几何、材质）相互耦合，但现有方法要么逐通道独立建模，要么把逆渲染与正向渲染割裂成两个过程，通道间与过程间的依赖关系没有被利用起来。
Method: 通道层面用 1-to-N 映射从单张 RGB 联合生成 albedo、shading、surface normal、roughness、metallic 五张图，生成过程中跨通道交换信息；过程层面建立逆-正向渲染的互易性，用双 cycle-consistent 目标在闭环上对齐对应预测。
Result: 在三个数据集上的实验显示该方法在本征估计与正向渲染两方面均取得有竞争力的表现，改善了分解结果的 coherence 与物理一致性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把通道联合建模与逆-正向闭环对齐放进同一框架，可以同时提升本征分解的相互兼容性与正向渲染质量，并让本征属性成为可显式编辑再渲染回 RGB 的物理接口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge tracing (KT) models need many logged learners, so a new course or platform starts without a usable model. In LLM-based KT the LLM generates the answer, which we call System-Two; it is either fine-tuned on the target data or reasons and votes over ten samples, which is slow and gives coarse probabilities. We ask whether an off-the-shelf System-One LLM, which returns a probability for a typed question directly in a single pass, can perform KT when few or no learners are logged. On seven datasets, Jev without any data from the target platform reaches a mean AUC of .706, above the best of 28 deep KT models trained on 8 learners (.689) and above System-Two Thinking-KT on all seven datasets (.650) at about 1/100 of its API cost. Adding examples and a similar-learner statistic from the logged learners (JevKT) raises this to .722; JevKT stays significantly ahead of deep KT up to 16 learners and ahead on average up to 64, and supervised KT catches up between 64 and 128 learners. Among the readers we tested, the gain is specific to Jev, since three other LLMs queried with the byte-identical typed request through the official System-One adapter fall below it on all seven datasets, and reader swaps and contamination checks find no evidence that the input format or memorised data explain the gain. For new learners the advantage holds from their first interactions, whereas on unseen items with all learners logged, deep KT remains ahead.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 7 figures. Code and result summaries: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/jevkt-coldstart
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在零样本或极少登录学习者场景下，直接对输入题目给出作答概率的 System-One LLM（Jev）即可完成知识追踪 (knowledge tracing)：七个数据集上零目标平台数据的平均 AUC 达 .706，超过用 8 名学习者训练的 28 个深度 KT 模型中最好的 .689，也超过 System-Two Thinking-KT 的 .650，API 成本约为后者的 1/100。加入示例与相似学习者统计量 (JevKT) 后升至 .722，优势在新学习者从第一次交互起就成立，但对未见题目且学习者数据齐全时深度 KT 仍领先。
Motivation: KT 模型依赖大量登录学习者，新课程或新平台冷启动时没有可用模型；现有 LLM-based KT 走 System-Two 路线（微调或十次采样投票），既慢又只能给出粗糙概率。
Method: 对比 System-One 与 System-Two 两条路径：System-One 用现成 LLM 通过统一 typed request 与官方 adapter 单次前向直接返回题目作答概率（Jev）；System-Two 为微调或对十个样本推理投票的 Thinking-KT。JevKT 在 Jev 基础上加入登录学习者的示例与相似学习者统计量；另用三个 LLM 以字节完全相同的请求做 reader swap，并做污染检查。
Result: 七个数据集上，Jev 零目标平台数据平均 AUC .706，高于 8 名学习者训练的 28 个深度 KT 模型最优 .689，也高于 Thinking-KT 的 .650（七个数据集全部领先），API 成本约为其 1/100。JevKT 提升至 .722，显著领先深度 KT 至 16 名学习者，平均领先至 64 名，监督式 KT 在 64–128 名之间追平。另三个 LLM 以字节相同请求经 System-One adapter 查询，在七个数据集上全部低于 Jev；reader swap 与污染检查未发现输入格式或记忆数据可解释该增益。

papers.title: QUILT: Rethinking Sparse-Attention Prefill through Shared Query Execution
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context attention, but existing kernels typically process queries independently, repeatedly loading and dequantizing KV entries shared across queries. We observe substantial overlap in the KV entries selected by neighboring queries, creating opportunities for cross-query reuse. We present QUILT, a workload-aware sparse-attention execution mechanism that jointly processes neighboring queries and reuses shared KV entries to reduce redundant memory traffic and computation. QUILT introduces Shift-and-Compare Set Decomposition (SCSD), which transforms irregular set operations into regular data-parallel primitives suitable for modern accelerators, and pipelines SCSD with attention computation to hide its overhead. Cascaded sharing captures reuse hierarchically at multiple granularities. A tile-aware execution strategy balances sharing granularity with hardware tile utilization and selectively removes low-importance query-specific tails to eliminate underutilized tiles. We evaluate QUILT on LongBench using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-3.2 under both tensor and sequence parallelism. Compared with the state-of-the-art sparse-attention kernel, QUILT reduces average kernel latency by up to 55.1% and processed KV data by up to 55.9%, while reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency by up to 36.8% with negligible accuracy degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QUILT 把相邻 query 合并执行以复用共享 KV 条目，用 Shift-and-Compare Set Decomposition (SCSD) 把不规则集合运算转成数据并行原语并与注意力计算流水化，再配合分层共享与 tile 感知执行。在 LongBench 上用 GLM-5.3 与 DeepSeek-3.2 评测，相比 SOTA 稀疏注意力 kernel 平均 kernel 延迟最多降 55.1%、处理 KV 数据量最多降 55.9%、TTFT 最多降 36.8%，精度损失可忽略。
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力 kernel 逐 query 独立处理，反复加载并反量化相邻 query 本就共享的 KV 条目，产生冗余内存流量与计算。
Method: QUILT 联合处理相邻 query 复用共享 KV：SCSD 将不规则集合操作转为适配现代加速器的数据并行原语并与注意力计算流水化以隐藏开销；Cascaded sharing 在多个粒度上分层捕获复用；tile 感知执行平衡共享粒度与硬件 tile 利用率，并选择性剔除低重要性的 query 特有 tail 以消除欠利用 tile。
Result: 在 LongBench 上以 GLM-5.3 和 DeepSeek-3.2、tensor parallelism 与 sequence parallelism 两种并行方式评测：相比 SOTA 稀疏注意力 kernel，平均 kernel 延迟最多降低 55.1%，处理 KV 数据量最多减少 55.9%，TTFT 延迟最多降低 36.8%，精度下降可忽略。
Conclusion: 稀疏注意力的性能瓶颈主要来自跨 query 的重复 KV 访问，按共享结构重排执行可在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅压低长上下文 prefill 延迟与 KV 数据处理量。

papers.title: Machine Learning Optimization for Enhanced OS Fingerprinting
papers.abstract_en: Operating System (OS) Fingerprinting is a technique that can be used to identify a network's operating systems by evaluating network traffic in the form of TCP/IP packets. This research will explore the effectiveness of passively identifying operating systems on the CIC-IDS2017 dataset, a collection of over 47 gigabytes of pcap files with their corresponding operating systems. This research also proposes a new command line interface, OsirisML, which uses nPrint to preprocess the data into tabular data and XGBoost to apply ML to the data to generate, retrain, and test ML models. When packets are split randomly between training and testing, OsirisML models reach an accuracy of 97.66% on a down-sampled subset of the Friday capture and 84.69% on the entire capture. On the entire Monday capture, which contains no attacks, OsirisML reaches an accuracy of 73.83% and an F-1 score of 79.38%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OsirisML 用 nPrint 把 TCP/IP 包转成表格特征、再用 XGBoost 做被动操作系统指纹识别，在 CIC-IDS2017 上随机划分训练/测试时 Friday 降采样子集准确率 97.66%、整个 Friday 抓包 84.69%，无攻击的 Monday 抓包准确率 73.83%、F1 79.38%。
Motivation: 被动识别网络操作系统依赖手工特征与专用工具链，缺少一条从 pcap 到可复训模型的命令行流水线；CIC-IDS2017 超 47 GB pcap 提供了带操作系统标签的检验数据。
Method: 提出命令行工具 OsirisML：用 nPrint 将 pcap 预处理为表格数据，用 XGBoost 生成、重训与测试 ML 模型；实验在 CIC-IDS2017 的 Friday（含降采样子集）与 Monday 抓包上按随机划分训练/测试。
Result: 随机划分下 Friday 降采样子集准确率 97.66%，整个 Friday 抓包 84.69%；无攻击的 Monday 抓包准确率 73.83%、F1 79.38%；数据为超 47 GB 的 pcap。
Conclusion: nPrint 加 XGBoost 的命令行流水线可在 CIC-IDS2017 上做被动 OS 指纹识别，且在含攻击的 Friday 与无攻击的 Monday 抓包上表现差异明显。

papers.title: SFT-as-Context Mitigates Forgetting in Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) equips large language models (LLMs) with specialized capabilities, but often comes at the cost of forgetting the general capabilities of their parent models (i.e., the pretrained models before fine-tuning). This trade-off is especially limiting for queries that require both specialized and general capabilities. We introduce SFT-as-context, a training-free method in which the parent model uses the SFT model's response as context to answer the query. This allows the parent model to acquire fine-tuned capabilities from the SFT response through in-context learning while preserving its own general capabilities. Across 19 parent-SFT model pairs and 11 benchmarks, SFT-as-context remains close to the SFT models on fine-tuned capabilities, with gaps of only 2.2 and 2.1 percentage points on AIME 2024 and LiveCodeBench and 2.0 macro MAE on NutriBench-English, while staying within 2.2 percentage points of the parent models on general capabilities on average. Remarkably, it can solve queries requiring both fine-tuned and general capabilities, even when neither the parent nor SFT model succeeds alone. This approach also extends beyond parent-SFT pairs: responses from a small open-source SFT model can improve a strong closed-source LLM, outperforming either model alone. Furthermore, we use a Bayesian framework to derive theoretical guarantees that bound the error of SFT-as-context relative to the SFT model on fine-tuned capabilities and to the parent model on general capabilities. In addition, we visualize the attention weights and find that the parent model attends more to useful SFT responses and less to irrelevant ones, suggesting that selective attention helps the parent model use the SFT response through in-context learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 SFT-as-context：让父模型把 SFT 模型的回答当作上下文，通过 in-context learning 获得微调能力，同时保住自身通用能力。在 19 组父模型-SFT 模型配对、11 个基准上，微调能力与 SFT 模型的差距仅 AIME 2024 2.2 个百分点、LiveCodeBench 2.1 个百分点、NutriBench-English 2.0 macro MAE，通用能力平均与父模型相差不超过 2.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 监督微调 (SFT) 让 LLM 获得专门能力，却常以遗忘父模型通用能力为代价，而同时需要两类能力的查询最受这一取舍限制。
Method: 免训练方法 SFT-as-context：父模型把 SFT 模型的回答作为上下文，经 in-context learning 吸收微调能力；另用 Bayesian framework 推导误差上界，并可视化 attention weights 检查父模型如何取用 SFT 回答。
Result: 在 19 组父模型-SFT 模型配对与 11 个基准上，微调能力与 SFT 模型的差距为 AIME 2024 2.2 个百分点、LiveCodeBench 2.1 个百分点、NutriBench-English 2.0 macro MAE；通用能力平均与父模型差距在 2.2 个百分点以内。可解出父模型与 SFT 模型单独都失败的查询；小开源 SFT 模型的回答能提升强闭源 LLM，超过两者单独表现。attention 权重显示父模型更多关注有用 SFT 回答、更少关注无关回答。
Conclusion: 把 SFT 输出当作上下文而非改权重，可以同时贴近 SFT 的专门能力与父模型的通用能力，并有 Bayesian 框架给出的误差界支撑；选择性 attention 是其通过 in-context learning 起作用的机制。

papers.title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark and Type-Aware Evaluation for AI-Generated Game Commentary
papers.abstract_en: Game commentary is an open-ended generation task requiring multimodal perception, strategic reasoning, and contextual knowledge. Existing AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) studies remain fragmented across games, modalities, and evaluation protocols, while overlap-based or holistic evaluators fail to capture the functional heterogeneity of commentary. We introduce \textsc{GameCommBench}, a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports, with commentary aligned to heterogeneous game contexts and annotated by commentary type. We further propose Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE), a structured framework for evaluating different types of commentary. We then validate TACE for reliability and human agreement, and use it to benchmark representative AI commentators. Results reveal non-uniform capability profiles, with live observation and strategic analysis emerging as major bottlenecks. Together, \textsc{GameCommBench} and TACE provide a diagnostic foundation for comparable and interpretable AI-GGC evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Balancing Reference Guidance and Free Generation in Trajectory Rollouts for Reasoning RL
papers.abstract_en: A verified reference solution provides a correct trajectory for training a reasoning model. Alternatively, a prefix of the reference can guide the model in generating a trajectory of its own. How much reference guidance should we provide? We study this question through prefix continuation, where the model continues from a reference prefix and keeps the resulting trajectory if it passes verification, falling back to the reference otherwise. Since both procedures produce correct trajectories, we compare their distributions with the ideal distribution, the model's own distribution conditioned on successful verification. For one continuation, we derive the KL divergence in closed form, which, up to a bounded term, decreases with the product of the probability of generating a different correct trajectory and the reference surprisal, the negative log probability of the reference suffix given the prefix. Since a longer prefix tends to raise the former but lowers the latter, continuation success alone does not determine the preferred amount of guidance. From this analysis, we learn a prefix selector shared across training questions from continuation outcomes, without estimating success probabilities or additional generation. The resulting Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) constructs correct trajectories within a fixed generation budget, and we apply it to all-failure groups in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ARG achieves the highest aggregate pass@12 among the evaluated methods with competitive average sampled accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在用参考解训练推理模型时，前缀续写 (prefix continuation) 的参考引导长度并非越长越好：闭式 KL 显示其与理想分布的差距（在有界项之外）随「生成另一条正确轨迹的概率 × 参考后缀 surprisal」的乘积下降，而更长前缀同时抬高前者、压低后者。据此提出 Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG)，从续写结果中跨题目学习一个共享的前缀选择器，无需估计成功概率或额外生成，并用于 GRPO 的全失败组。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B、五个数学推理基准上，ARG 取得被评估方法中最高的聚合 pass@12，平均采样准确率具竞争力。
Motivation: 参考解既能整条用于训练，也能截前缀引导模型自行续写，但该给多少引导缺乏判据：续写成功率本身不足以决定最优前缀长度，因为更长前缀同时改变两个方向相反的量。
Method: 以 prefix continuation 为对象（模型从参考前缀续写，通过验证则保留，否则回退到参考），把两种做法的分布与理想分布（模型自身在验证成功条件下的分布）比较；对单次续写闭式推导 KL 散度，得到「另一条正确轨迹的概率 × 参考 surprisal」的乘积形式。再从续写结果中跨训练题学习共享的前缀选择器，不估计成功概率、不做额外生成，构造固定生成预算内的正确轨迹，并施加到 GRPO 的全失败组。
Result: 闭式 KL（去掉有界项后）随生成另一条不同正确轨迹的概率与参考 surprisal（给定前缀下参考后缀的负对数概率）之积递减；长前缀提高前者、降低后者，故续写成功与否不能单独决定引导量。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B、五个数学推理基准上，ARG 的聚合 pass@12 在被评估方法中最高，平均采样准确率具竞争力。
Conclusion: 参考引导的最优长度由「多样性收益 × 参考 surprisal」的权衡决定，可用一个跨题共享、只依赖续写结果的前缀选择器来实现，并在 GRPO 全失败组上以固定生成预算换取更高的聚合 pass@12。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Interfaces Speak: Data-Aware Generative UI Harness for Active Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Most human-agent interaction today remains text-based. Natural language can impose cognitive overload, ambiguity, information chaos, and slow input for complex tasks; ephemeral generative UIs can present structured information and guide users toward task completion. We propose GenUI-Harness, a multi-agent harness pairing a Tool Agent for information retrieval and task execution with a GUI Coder Agent that identifies ambiguities and generates front-end code for structured interfaces. Training the coder with reinforcement learning is challenging: verifiable rewards for interactive UI generation require costly execution, while LLM-as-a-Judge rewards are prone to reward hacking. We address the first challenge with Dynamic UX, a lightweight package for dynamic interaction and reward collection in a single sandbox, and the second with Reward Auditor, a meta-reward mechanism that monitors reward distributions and distills diagnostic patterns into a shared rubric and scoring specification. We introduce UI-TAU Bench, a benchmark for active human-agent interaction through generated UI code, built on 10 real-world domain databases constructed from public data sources and based on Tau-Bench tool-use settings, with Lite (300 tasks) and Full (1,000 tasks) splits. GenUI-Harness achieves an average Pass@3 gain of 4.48 percentage points over smolagents on Lite. Training with GenUI-Harness improves a 4B backbone from 9.33% to 58.00% Pass@3, outperforming larger frontier models such as Claude Opus 5 (46.67%). GenUI-Harness also remains robust on ambiguous and non-ambiguous queries. In a reviewer survey comparing communication channels, generated UIs reduce average dialogue rounds from 3.4 to 1.2. These results show that data-aware generative interfaces can support effective task completion and reduce dialogue rounds in evaluated database-backed workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GenUI-Harness：Tool Agent 负责检索与执行，GUI Coder Agent 识别歧义并生成结构化前端界面代码，用 Dynamic UX 在单一沙箱内同时做动态交互与奖励收集，用 Reward Auditor 监控奖励分布并蒸馏诊断模式到共享 rubric，缓解 UI 生成 RL 中执行成本高与 LLM-as-a-Judge 奖励被 hack 的问题。在自建 UI-TAU Bench 上，4B backbone 的 Pass@3 从 9.33% 提到 58.00%，超过 Claude Opus 5 的 46.67%；生成 UI 把平均对话轮次从 3.4 降到 1.2。
Motivation: 复杂任务的人机交互仍以文本为主，自然语言带来认知过载、歧义、信息混乱与输入缓慢；而交互式 UI 生成的可验证奖励需要昂贵执行，LLM-as-a-Judge 奖励又易被 reward hacking。
Method: GenUI-Harness 由 Tool Agent（信息检索与任务执行）与 GUI Coder Agent（识别歧义、生成结构化界面的前端代码）配对；训练侧用 Dynamic UX 在单一沙箱内完成动态交互与奖励收集，用 Reward Auditor 这一 meta-reward 机制监控奖励分布并把诊断模式蒸馏为共享 rubric 与评分规范。评测基于 Tau-Bench 工具使用设定，构建 UI-TAU Bench，含 10 个由公开数据源构建的真实领域数据库，分 Lite（300 任务）与 Full（1,000 任务）两个 split。
Result: GenUI-Harness 在 Lite 上平均 Pass@3 比 smolagents 高 4.48 个百分点；用它训练的 4B backbone Pass@3 从 9.33% 升到 58.00%，超过 Claude Opus 5 的 46.67%；在歧义与非歧义查询上均保持稳健。评审人对通信渠道的对比调研中，生成 UI 把平均对话轮次从 3.4 降到 1.2。
Conclusion: 数据感知的生成式界面在被评测的数据库支撑工作流中既能支撑任务完成，又能压缩对话轮次；可验证交互奖励的关键是把执行与奖励收集收进单一沙箱，并用 meta-reward 审计防 reward hacking。

papers.title: OpenProblemBench: Benchmarking AI on Open Problems in the Foundational Theoretical Sciences
papers.abstract_en: The next frontier for artificial general intelligence is tackling unresolved scientific problems, calling for benchmarks that assess progress beyond established knowledge. We introduce OpenProblemBench, a benchmark of 82 unresolved problems drawn from the mathematics and theoretical physics literature. Each problem supplies the research context, assumptions, and prior progress needed to investigate the question. We select problems whose proposed solutions admit comparatively clear checks of their decisive mathematical or computational claims. Four evaluator models independently assess the correctness, completeness, and degree of progress of each submission without reference solutions. Across seven evaluated configurations, GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest mean judged solve rate of 14.0%, compared with 5.5-6.7% for the evaluated full-size open models and 2.4-3.7% for Flash models. Case comparisons connect stronger outcomes to changes in problem representation, general arguments that extend beyond finite evidence, and proofs of the steps needed to complete a solution. By grounding evaluation in questions arising from the research literature, OpenProblemBench provides a setting for investigating the capabilities and limitations of AI as a contributor to foundational theoretical science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenProblemBench 收录 82 个数学与理论物理中尚未解决的问题，每个附带研究背景、假设与已有进展，由四个 evaluator 模型在无参考答案下独立评判解答的正确性、完整性与推进程度。七种受测配置中 GPT-6-Astra 平均判分解题率 14.0%，全尺寸开源模型为 5.5–6.7%，Flash 级模型为 2.4–3.7%。
Motivation: 现有 AI 基准多考察已确立知识，无法衡量模型作为科学发现者处理文献中真正未解问题的能力。
Method: 从数学与理论物理文献筛选 82 个未解问题，要求其候选解的关键数学或计算论断可被相对清晰地检验；每个问题提供研究语境、假设与先前进展，四个 evaluator 模型在没有参考答案的情况下独立评判提交的正确性、完整性与推进程度。
Result: 七种受测配置下 GPT-6-Astra 平均判分解题率 14.0%，受测全尺寸开源模型为 5.5–6.7%，Flash 模型为 2.4–3.7%；案例对比把更强表现归因于问题表述方式的改变、能超出有限证据的一般性论证，以及对完成解答所需步骤的证明。
Conclusion: 以文献中真实未解问题为锚的评测可区分 AI 在基础理论科学中的实际推进能力，当前最强模型的判分解题率仍仅为 14.0%。

papers.title: MCL: Meta Convolution Layer
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic convolution enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by adapting kernels to input content, but it expresses the effective kernel as a linear mixture of a small number of basis kernels, which limits expressivity and complicates optimization as the mixture size grows. In this work, we revisit dynamic convolution from a functional perspective and propose the Meta Convolution Layer (MCL), which directly models the convolutional kernel as an input-conditioned function W(x) realized via a high-order polynomial expansion. Leveraging nested residual blocks inspired by deep polynomial networks, MCL implements a structured polynomial meta-network that generates a single input-adaptive kernel, thereby decoupling representational power from the explicit number of mixture kernels and alleviating training instability. MCL is a plug-in addition with standard convolutions and can be seamlessly integrated into both CNN and transformer backbones. Experimental evaluation shows that adding MCL improves the Top-1 accuracy of Resnet- 18, Resnet-50 and ResNet-101 by 6.61%, 3.42% and 3.05% on the ImageNet dataset. Moreover, the proposed method significantly boosts the accuracy of Resnet and Wide-Resnet variants on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets. Additionally, the proposed method outperforms previous methods on fine-grained visual classification tasks using Swin and ViT backbones. These results demonstrate that high-order polynomial kernel generation is a powerful and scalable alternative to linear mixture based dynamic convolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MCL 把动态卷积的核从少量基核的线性混合改成输入条件的高阶多项式函数 W(x)，用嵌套残差块生成单个自适应核，使表达能力与混合核数量解耦。加入 MCL 后 ResNet-18/50/101 在 ImageNet 上 Top-1 分别提升 6.61%、3.42%、3.05%。
Motivation: 动态卷积用少量基核的线性混合表达有效核，混合数一大就限制表达能力并让优化变难、训练不稳。
Method: 从函数视角重写动态卷积，用高阶多项式展开直接建模输入条件核 W(x)；以受深度多项式网络启发的嵌套残差块实现结构化多项式元网络，生成单个输入自适应核。MCL 作为即插即用模块与标准卷积并用，可接入 CNN 与 transformer backbone。
Result: ImageNet 上加入 MCL 使 ResNet-18、ResNet-50、ResNet-101 的 Top-1 accuracy 分别提升 6.61%、3.42%、3.05%；在 CIFAR-10 与 CIFAR-100 上显著提升 ResNet 与 Wide-ResNet 变体精度；在细粒度视觉分类任务上以 Swin 与 ViT 为 backbone 超越先前方法。
Conclusion: 高阶多项式核生成是线性混合式动态卷积的有力且可扩展的替代，能把表达能力与显式混合核数量解耦并缓解训练不稳定。

papers.title: Dynamics as Code: On Model Compression via Dynamic System
papers.abstract_en: The escalating size of pretrained neural networks has rendered model compression a prerequisite for deployment under stringent memory and compute constraints. With the irrational winding as an example, earlier work introduced a dynamic system (DS) paradigm that reconceptualizes compression as compact weight representation: high-dimensional parameters are encoded by the index of a trajectory produced by a dynamic system, from which the vector is recovered during decompression. This mechanism is fundamentally distinct from pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and low-rank decomposition. Along this direction, we prove that under a Diophantine condition, a finite trajectory of \(M = O(ε^{-(d+ν)})\) states in the irrational winding constitutes an \(ε\)-net over the \(d\)-dimensional weight space, thereby linking state resolution, decompression error, and compression ratio in a predictable manner. Furthermore, we propose a generalized DS-based model compression framework by unifying four DS families---space-filling curves (Hilbert, Peano, Morton/Z-order, Snake), chaotic systems (Lorenz), congruential and pseudo-random generators (LCG, PCG), and low-discrepancy sequences (Halton). Also, we introduce the KD-tree and coordinate-template acceleration to scale to large models as well as outlier identification to control the error. Experiments on ResNet-18 and Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B validate that DS-based compression achieves competitive compression ratios without post-hoc retraining, with controllable decompression error and flexible state-space design, establishing it as a principled and practical compression approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把模型压缩重述为动态系统 (DS) 轨迹索引的紧凑权重表示：高维参数由动力系统轨迹的索引编码，解压时再恢复向量，与剪枝、量化、蒸馏、低秩分解正交。理论上证明在 Diophantine 条件下 irrational winding 的 M = O(ε^{-(d+ν)}) 个状态构成 d 维权重空间的 ε-net，把状态分辨率、解压误差与压缩率连成可预测关系；在 ResNet-18 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B 上验证其压缩率具有竞争力，且无需事后重训练。
Motivation: 预训练网络规模膨胀，部署受内存与算力约束，需要压缩；已有剪枝、量化、蒸馏、低秩分解之外，缺少把压缩视为紧凑权重表示、并能定量刻画解压误差的范式。
Method: 统一四类动态系统族——space-filling curves（Hilbert、Peano、Morton/Z-order、Snake）、混沌系统（Lorenz）、同余与伪随机发生器（LCG、PCG）、低差异序列（Halton）——构成广义 DS 压缩框架；用 KD-tree 与 coordinate-template 加速扩展到大模型，并引入 outlier identification 控制误差；理论部分在 Diophantine 条件下证明 irrational winding 有限轨迹的 ε-net 性质。
Result: 理论给出 M = O(ε^{-(d+ν)}) 个状态即构成 d 维权重空间的 ε-net，链接状态分辨率、解压误差与压缩率；实验在 ResNet-18 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B 上取得有竞争力的压缩率，解压误差可控、状态空间设计灵活，且无需事后重训练 (post-hoc retraining)。
Conclusion: 动态系统轨迹索引可作为一种有原则且实用的压缩途径：在 Diophantine 条件下压缩率与解压误差可预测，并能通过状态空间设计与 outlier 控制在大模型上落地。

papers.title: DiscoVL: Unveiling Disentangled C ross-Modal Representation Learning via Orthogonal Adversarial Regularization for V ision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained vision-language models excel across varied perception tasks, but adapting them to novel downstream settings without sacrificing generalization remains non-trivial. Existing parameter-efficient prompt learning method often yields inconsistent representations and fails to account for semantic distribution shifts. In this work, we present DiscoVL, a disentangled cross-modal representation learning framework that couples orthogonal adversarial regularization with structured cross-modal alignment for vision-language models. To address the insufficient cross-modal interaction, our DiscoVL designs a multi-branch low-rank residual aligner that decomposes representations into subspaces and enables bidirectional cross-modal feedback between visual and textual streams at each layer. Furthermore, while conventional triplet constraints overfit features to class centroids, we design an orthogonal regularization for adversarial triplet loss, which prevents centroid collapse and substantially boosts generalization. Evaluations on 15 benchmarks demonstrate that DiscoVL delivers consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods for base-to-novel generalization, cross-dataset evaluation, and few-shot learning
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiscoVL 用多分支低秩残差对齐器把视觉与文本表征分解到子空间、逐层做双向跨模态反馈，并对 adversarial triplet loss 施加正交正则以避免类中心坍缩。在 15 个 benchmark 上，base-to-novel 泛化、跨数据集评测与 few-shot 学习均一致优于现有 prompt learning 方法。
Motivation: 参数高效 prompt learning 在下游适配时表征不一致、且未处理语义分布偏移，导致新类与跨数据集场景下泛化受损。
Method: DiscoVL 框架包含多分支低秩残差对齐器 (multi-branch low-rank residual aligner)，逐层分解表征子空间并让视觉与文本流双向反馈；同时把 triplet 约束改为带正交正则的 adversarial triplet loss，抑制特征向类中心过拟合。
Result: 在 15 个 benchmark 上，DiscoVL 在 base-to-novel generalization、cross-dataset evaluation 与 few-shot learning 三类设定中一致优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 跨模态子空间分解加正交对抗正则能同时保住 prompt learning 的参数效率与对语义分布偏移的泛化能力。

papers.title: False Claims, Credible Images: A Red-Teaming Benchmark for Commercial Image Generators
papers.abstract_en: Image-generation models can now produce text-rich, natural-looking visual artifacts that are hard to distinguish from real-world evidence, such as news reports and textbook pages. Yet, the same capability introduces a new risk: these models can just as easily fabricate visual misinformation. Even commercial models (e.g., GPT-Image-2) readily produce it. Curiously, we find that these models can recognize a claim as false when asked, yet still render that very claim as credible visual evidence. This discrepancy points to a blind spot in current alignment: safeguards judge what an image shows, not what it asserts; however, existing red-teaming benchmarks target conventional harmful content, such as violent or explicit imagery, and say little about where the alignment boundaries lie for visual misinformation, especially in commercial models. To fill this gap, we introduce EpiReal-Bench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating visual misinformation risks in commercial image generators, comprising 10k false-claim prompts and 10k corresponding generated images that span 10 real-world claim categories and 10 credible visual formats. We further introduce EpiReal-Attack, a skill-guided black-box optimization framework that uses Pareto-based selection and multimodal feedback to identify commands that bypass alignment safeguards while preserving visual realism, textual legibility, and semantic fidelity. Experiments on four commercial models reveal that more than 70% of false-claim prompts elicit images that faithfully depict the corresponding misinformation, and EpiReal-Attack pushes this rate to 95%. Most worryingly, these models are only a click away, and their outputs are cheap to spread yet hard to disbelieve, leaving this dimension of alignment largely unguarded.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 19 figures, 6 tables. Project website: https://github.com/Ye-ze-yu/EpiReal-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EpiReal-Bench：首个针对商用图像生成器视觉虚假信息风险的红队基准，含 10k 条虚假论断提示与对应 10k 张生成图，覆盖 10 类真实论断与 10 种可信视觉格式。在四个商用模型上，超过 70% 的虚假论断提示生成了忠实呈现该虚假信息的图像，其黑盒优化攻击 EpiReal-Attack 将该比例推到 95%。
Motivation: 商用图像模型能识别某论断为假却仍把它渲染成可信图像证据，而现有红队基准只针对暴力、露骨等传统有害内容，无法界定视觉虚假信息的对齐边界。
Method: 构建 EpiReal-Bench（10k 虚假论断提示 + 10k 生成图，10 类论断 × 10 种视觉格式），并提出 EpiReal-Attack：基于技能引导的黑盒优化框架，用 Pareto 选择与多模态反馈搜索能绕过对齐防护、同时保持视觉真实感、文字可读性与语义保真度的指令。
Result: 在四个商用模型上，超过 70% 的虚假论断提示生成了忠实呈现对应虚假信息的图像；EpiReal-Attack 将这一比例提升至 95%。
Conclusion: 商用图像生成器的对齐只判断图像展示了什么、不判断它断言了什么，视觉虚假信息这一维度基本无人看守，且生成成本低、传播快、难以被质疑。

papers.title: Lapras: Latent Reasoning for Time Series Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) offer a promising path toward time series understanding by reasoning over temporal signals and producing natural language answers and explanations. A common approach is Chain-of-Thought (CoT), which generates step-by-step rationales linking relevant signal patterns to final answers. Although these models learn from reference CoT traces during post-training, generating faithful descriptions of input time series at inference remains challenging. Expressing high-dimensional, continuous temporal representations in discrete language tokens may cause the model to neglect task-relevant patterns or describe them inaccurately. Because later reasoning steps build on these descriptions, early errors propagate, leading to incorrect answers with plausible explanations that are inconsistent with the input signal. We propose Lapras (Latent Post-trained Reasoning Across Series), a post-training framework that equips TSLMs with latent reasoning. A model trained with Lapras reasons through a sequence of continuous thoughts in the joint time series-language space, producing text only for the final answer. It learns this through teacher-student self-distillation, where a teacher trained on CoT reference traces reasons explicitly through text. The student aligns its hidden states with the teacher's at the answer stage, transferring the teacher's reasoning ability into its latent computation. We evaluate Lapras across four TSLM backbones on five time series question answering benchmarks. Lapras improves average F1 by up to 10.79% over explicit CoT while generating 23.9x fewer tokens. Lapras's continuous thoughts can also be decoded into readable reasoning traces via standard language decoding, preserving textual explanations. Together, these results highlight Lapras as a promising post-training paradigm for efficient, effective, and interpretable TSLM reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lapras 是面向时间序列语言模型 (TSLM) 的后训练框架：学生模型在时间序列-语言联合空间中以连续隐式思维推理，只在最终答案处输出文本，通过 teacher-student 自蒸馏对齐答案阶段的隐状态来继承 CoT 教师的推理能力。在四个 TSLM backbone、五个时间序列问答基准上，平均 F1 较显式 CoT 最多提升 10.79%，同时生成 token 少 23.9 倍，且连续思维可解码回可读推理轨迹。
Motivation: 显式 CoT 要把高维连续时间序列表达成离散语言 token，早期描述失真会沿推理链传播，导致答案错误却给出看似合理的解释，且逐步文本生成代价高。
Method: Lapras (Latent Post-trained Reasoning Across Series)：教师模型在 CoT 参考轨迹上后训练并显式文本推理，学生在时间序列-语言联合空间中产生连续思维序列、仅在答案阶段输出文本；训练用 teacher-student 自蒸馏，把学生答案阶段的隐状态与教师对齐，从而把教师推理能力转移到隐计算中。
Result: 在四个 TSLM backbone、五个时间序列问答 (QA) 基准上，Lapras 平均 F1 较显式 CoT 最多提升 10.79%，生成 token 数少 23.9 倍；其连续思维可通过标准语言解码还原为可读推理轨迹并保留文本解释。
Conclusion: 把 CoT 的推理从离散 token 移到连续隐空间，可以在时间序列问答上同时换取更高 F1、更低 token 开销与可解码的可解释性，作者据此把 Lapras 定位为 TSLM 的高效后训练范式。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Cova-PINN: Cross-Domain Conservation Physics-Informed Neural Network for Fluid-Solid Conjugate Heat Transfer in Complex Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Multi-domain physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) flexibly model medium-specific representations to solve fluid--solid conjugate heat transfer (CHT). However, standard multi-domain PINNs enforce governing equations and interface conditions on separately sampled domain supports, which can yield plausible temperature fields but inaccurate end-to-end energy transfer and outlet temperatures. We propose Cova-PINN, a multi-domain PINN framework that aligns conservation support with thermal interaction paths in complex geometries. Cova-PINN jointly optimizes cross-domain composite control-volume balances at the local scale and paired-wall closure at the global exchanger scale. We evaluate Cova-PINN on four triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) heat exchangers and a geometrically distinct DualMS design against CHT-specific, optimization-oriented, and complex-geometry PINN baselines under a common protocol. Relative to the closest baseline, MUSA-PINN-CHT, Cova-PINN reduces average outlet-temperature and device-level closure errors across the four TPMS topologies by $37.7\%$ and $60.2\%$, respectively, while also improving full-field and heat-duty accuracy, with consistent gains on DualMS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cova-PINN 把多域 PINN 的守恒约束对齐到复杂几何中的实际热交换路径：局部尺度联合优化跨域复合控制体 (control-volume) 平衡，全局换热器尺度加 paired-wall closure。在四个 TPMS 换热器与一个 DualMS 设计上，相对最接近基线 MUSA-PINN-CHT，平均出口温度误差降 37.7%、器件级闭合误差降 60.2%，全场与热负荷精度同步改善。
Motivation: 标准多域 PINN 在各自采样的域支撑上分别施加控制方程与界面条件，可能给出看似合理的温度场，但端到端能量传递与出口温度不准，无法满足换热器设计所需的守恒一致性。
Method: Cova-PINN 为流固共轭传热 (CHT) 构造多域 PINN 框架，联合优化局部尺度的跨域复合控制体平衡与全局换热器尺度的 paired-wall closure；在统一协议下与 CHT 专用、面向优化及复杂几何的 PINN 基线对比，测试对象为四个三重周期极小曲面 (TPMS) 换热器与几何不同的 DualMS 设计。
Result: 相对最接近基线 MUSA-PINN-CHT，Cova-PINN 在四个 TPMS 拓扑上平均出口温度误差降低 37.7%、器件级闭合误差降低 60.2%，同时改善全场精度与热负荷 (heat-duty) 精度，在 DualMS 上增益一致。
Conclusion: 把守恒支撑与热交换路径对齐，可在复杂几何的流固 CHT 中同时改善端到端能量闭合与出口温度精度，且跨 TPMS 拓扑与 DualMS 泛化。

papers.title: TKCAM: Text and Keyframe to Camera Trajectory Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-quality and controllable camera motion is essential for AI-assisted cinematography, video synthesis, and 3D scene understanding. We introduce TKCAM, a Text- and Keyframe-conditioned CAMera-motion synthesis framework based on generative masked modeling. We represent camera dynamics using a 12-dimensional kinematic feature comprising position, velocity, and a continuous rotation representation and discretize them into hierarchical motion tokens via a Residual Vector Quantizer (RVQ). A two-stage masked transformer architecture then learns to reconstruct and refine these tokens, utilizing explicit self- and cross-attention modules for multimodal conditioning. A central feature of our framework is sparse visual keyframe conditioning: users can provide free-form text prompts together with RGB observations at selected timestamps, which provide temporally localized visual guidance for generating coherent in-between trajectories. Furthermore, to advance evaluation standards, we curate RealEstate10K-Cap, a large-scale text-camera dataset, and establish a cross-domain benchmark with a Universal CLaTr Evaluator. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TKCAM surpasses recent state-of-the-art baselines on Fréchet distance (FID), text-motion matching scores, and retrieval metrics (R@K), while additional analyses evaluate temporal smoothness and cross-domain generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/linearalgebrayhz/TKCAM.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 7 figures. Paper accepted to NeurIPS2026 (submission number 15461)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TKCAM 把相机运动表示为含位置、速度与连续旋转的 12 维运动特征，用 RVQ 离散成分层 motion token，再由两阶段 masked transformer 通过自注意力与交叉注意力重建并细化，支持文本加稀疏关键帧条件生成中间轨迹。在自建 RealEstate10K-Cap 与 Universal CLaTr Evaluator 跨域基准上，FID、文本-运动匹配分与 R@K 均超过近期 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: AI 辅助摄影、视频合成与 3D 场景理解需要高质量可控的相机运动，但现有生成方式在文本与关键帧联合条件下的轨迹连贯性与评测标准不足。
Method: 用 12 维运动特征（位置、速度、连续旋转）经 Residual Vector Quantizer 离散为分层 motion token，两阶段 masked transformer 以显式 self-/cross-attention 做多模态条件重建与细化；条件为自由文本加选定时间戳的 RGB 关键帧，并构建 RealEstate10K-Cap 文本-相机数据集与 Universal CLaTr Evaluator 跨域基准。
Result: 在 Fréchet distance (FID)、text-motion matching scores 与检索指标 R@K 上超过近期 SOTA 基线；附加分析评估时间平滑性与跨域泛化。
Conclusion: 文本加稀疏关键帧的 masked 生成式相机运动合成能产生连贯的中间轨迹，并推动相机运动评测走向跨域基准。

papers.title: Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation for Thin Curvilinear Structures
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of thin curvilinear structures is vital for various real-world applications, from vessel analysis to road extraction. Yet their intricate geometry makes even minor pixel-wise errors enough to break the global topology, and this structural fragility turns severe domain shifts into catastrophic failures. The difficulty is most acute under cross-modality gaps, where the imaging process itself differs fundamentally between source and target. While test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical source-free remedy, existing methods adapt feature statistics and confidence, neither of which constrains connectivity, and thus degrade under such extreme gaps. To address this, we propose Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation (SGP-TTA). Progressive Batch Normalization (ProgBN) shifts normalization from frozen source statistics toward current target estimates under a sample-count schedule, so that the source-target balance follows the stage of adaptation rather than a fixed coefficient. Consensus Skeleton Recall (CSR) then derives a structural target from geometrically aligned multi-view predictions and updates only the BN affine parameters to preserve connected structures. Extensive experiments show that SGP-TTA consistently outperforms existing TTA methods in topological connectivity, with the largest margins under cross-modality shift. The project page is available at https://boa-jang.github.io/SGP-TTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation (SGP-TTA)，用 Progressive Batch Normalization 按样本计数调度把归一化从冻结源统计逐步推向目标域估计，再用 Consensus Skeleton Recall 从几何对齐的多视图预测中导出骨架结构目标、只更新 BN 仿射参数以保住连通性。在跨模态域偏移下，该方法在拓扑连通性上稳定优于现有 TTA 方法，且优势在跨模态场景最大。
Motivation: 细长曲线结构（血管、道路）的几何复杂使微小像素误差即可破坏全局拓扑，跨模态域偏移会把这种结构脆弱放大为灾难性失败；现有 TTA 只适配特征统计与置信度，都不约束连通性。
Method: SGP-TTA 含两个组件：Progressive Batch Normalization (ProgBN) 按样本计数调度把归一化从冻结源统计连续过渡到当前目标估计，使源-目标配比随适配阶段而非固定系数变化；Consensus Skeleton Recall (CSR) 从几何对齐的多视图预测中合成结构目标，仅更新 BN 仿射参数以保留连通结构。
Result: 在跨模态域偏移下，SGP-TTA 在拓扑连通性指标上持续优于现有 TTA 方法，且跨模态偏移下差距最大；实验覆盖血管分析与道路提取等细长曲线结构分割任务。
Conclusion: 把结构先验（骨架连通性）直接写进 TTA 的归一化参数更新，比只适配特征统计与置信度更能扛住跨模态域偏移。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Continuous Ground-Truth Construction and a Recovery Policy for Air--Water Robotic Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Visual tracking across the air-water interface is challenged by splashes, bubbles, refraction, reflections, and abrupt appearance changes that can temporarily invalidate observations. This setting poses two coupled difficulties: first, for evaluation, image-only annotation cannot reliably describe the target's physical location during visual blindness; second, for online tracking, corrupted observations can contaminate motion estimates and appearance templates. We address the first difficulty with a construction pipeline that synchronizes camera frames with motion-capture poses, projects known target geometry, corrects underwater projection with a medium-gated residual, and subjects the annotations to manual review. This yields an evaluation-only cross-medium test set of 22,346 frames. We further introduce a Cross-Medium Recovery Policy (CMRP) centered on confidence-triggered template selection. It supplies MixFormerV2 with the fixed initial template, a window-best pre-trigger template, and a trigger-frame Kalman-guided image crop, together with their associated weights, without retraining the visual backbone. In the accuracy evaluation, CMRP achieves 49.90 Macro Success AUC, 2.95 points above MixFormerV2 Official. On selected cross-medium transition and occlusion-recovery intervals, CMRP increases MixFormerV2 tracking coverage from 47.91\% to 50.43\% relative to Official updating, while mean loss-to-recovery latency over successfully recovered videos decreases from 55.3 to 49.3 frames.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对跨空-水界面视觉跟踪中水花、气泡、折射导致的观测失效，先用相机帧与动捕位姿同步、几何投影加介质门控残差校正构建连续真值，得到 22,346 帧评测集；再提出 CMRP，用置信度触发的模板选择给 MixFormerV2 供初始模板、触发前窗口最优模板与 Kalman 引导裁剪。Macro Success AUC 达 49.90，比 MixFormerV2 Official 高 2.95 点，遮挡恢复延迟从 55.3 帧降到 49.3 帧。
Motivation: 跨介质跟踪中视觉盲区期间纯图像标注无法描述目标真实位置，且被污染的观测会污染运动估计与外观模板，评测与在线跟踪两个环节同时失效。
Method: 真值构建管线同步相机帧与 motion-capture 位姿，投影已知目标几何，并用 medium-gated residual 校正水下投影，再经人工审核；CMRP 以置信度触发的模板选择为核心，向 MixFormerV2 提供固定初始模板、触发前窗口最优模板与触发帧 Kalman 引导图像裁剪及其权重，不重训视觉主干。
Result: 构建出仅用于评测的跨介质测试集，含 22,346 帧。CMRP 取得 49.90 Macro Success AUC，比 MixFormerV2 Official 高 2.95 点；在选定的跨介质过渡与遮挡恢复片段上，跟踪覆盖率从 47.91% 提到 50.43%，成功恢复视频的平均丢失到恢复延迟从 55.3 帧降到 49.3 帧。
Conclusion: 跨介质跟踪的评测真值与在线恢复策略可以分开解决：连续真值让盲区可标注，置信度触发的模板重选在不重训主干的前提下同时提高覆盖率并缩短恢复延迟。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Peer Review
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of scientific publishing has strained peer review, particularly in machine learning, raising concerns about declining review quality and increasing reviewer workload. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as automated review assistants, yet their evaluation has focused largely on imitating human-written reviews rather than supporting the core functions of peer review. Here, we introduce a verification-centric perspective on LLM-assisted peer review, emphasizing error detection as a critical and resource-intensive task. We present a scalable benchmark that evaluates review systems' ability to identify logical contradictions, constructed through synthetic insertion of errors into conference papers, yielding unambiguous evaluation targets and enabling systematic comparison. We further propose a Multi-Layered Review (MLR) framework that prioritizes detailed manuscript comprehension before review generation, aligning more closely with human reviewing practices while improving token efficiency. Across evaluations, our approach demonstrates strong alignment with human review scores, achieves high error detection performance, and provides complementary perspectives on reviewer focus. These improvements can be attributed to both the choice of the underlying LLM and the design of our system. At the same time, we corroborate persistent vulnerabilities to adversarial manipulation, underscoring the need for robustness in automated review systems. Our findings highlight the importance of rigorous, error-focused evaluation to guide responsible deployment of LLM-based tools in peer review and other critical scientific workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以验证为核心的 LLM 同行评审框架：先做多层稿件理解再生成评审（Multi-Layered Review, MLR），并用向会议论文合成插入错误的方式构造逻辑矛盾检测基准。评测显示该方法与人类评审分数高度对齐、错误检测性能高且更省 token，但对对抗操纵仍存在持续脆弱性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评审评测多停留在模仿人类撰写的评审文本，而错误检测才是同行评审中资源密集的核心功能，缺少可系统比较的评测目标。
Method: 提出 Multi-Layered Review (MLR) 框架，把详细的稿件理解置于评审生成之前，以贴近人类评审流程并提升 token 效率；配套构建一个可扩展基准，通过对会议论文合成插入错误来构造逻辑矛盾检测目标。
Result: 在评测中该方法与人类评审分数表现出强对齐，取得高的错误检测性能，并在评审关注点上提供互补视角；同时验证出对对抗操纵的持续脆弱性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为评审系统应以严格、以错误为中心的评测来引导负责任的部署，且性能提升同时来自底层 LLM 的选择与系统设计；对抗脆弱性说明鲁棒性仍是必需项。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为评审系统应以严格、以错误为中心的评测来引导负责任的部署，且性能提升同时来自底层 LLM 的选择与系统设计；对抗脆弱性说明鲁棒性仍是必需项。

papers.title: Contrast Enhancement or Noise Reduction? On Improving Cervical Cancer Classification
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Cervical cancer is one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. Deep learning has shown promising performance in medical image classification. The influence of image preprocessing algorithms on classification performance remains insufficiently investigated in the literature. This research aims to evaluate the impact of image preprocessing algorithms on the performance of CNNs for Pap smear image classification. Methods: Three CNN architectures (ResNet-34, MobileNet-V2, and DenseNet-121) were trained and evaluated using the SIPaKMeD dataset. Two preprocessing algorithms were applied: the PMD filter for noise reduction and CLAHE for contrast enhancement. The model performance was assessed using a confusion matrix. Results: Preprocessing improved the classification performance of all models. CLAHE significantly increased the accuracy of ResNet-34 from 76.73% to 84.16% and DenseNet-121 from 76.73% to 84.16%. The PMD filter yielded limited improvement and slightly reduced the MobileNet-V2 performance. Novelty: This research provides a systematic comparison of contrast enhancement and noise reduction techniques across CNN architectures. This research demonstrates that contrast enhancement is more effective than noise reduction in improving CNN performance. The research provides new pipelines for improving cervical cancer classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SIPaKMeD 巴氏涂片数据集上，CLAHE 对比度增强把 ResNet-34 与 DenseNet-121 的分类准确率都从 76.73% 提到 84.16%，而 PMD 降噪仅带来有限改善、还让 MobileNet-V2 略有下降。结论是对比度增强比降噪更能提升 CNN 对宫颈癌细胞图像的分类性能。
Motivation: 图像预处理算法如何影响 CNN 分类性能在文献中研究不足，缺少在同一批模型上对对比度增强与降噪的系统对比。
Method: 在 SIPaKMeD 数据集上训练并评估 ResNet-34、MobileNet-V2、DenseNet-121 三种 CNN，分别施加 PMD 滤波（降噪）与 CLAHE（对比度增强）两种预处理，用混淆矩阵评估分类表现。
Result: 预处理提升了所有模型的分类性能：CLAHE 使 ResNet-34 准确率从 76.73% 升至 84.16%，DenseNet-121 同样从 76.73% 升至 84.16%；PMD 滤波改善有限，并使 MobileNet-V2 性能略有下降。
Conclusion: 对宫颈癌巴氏涂片图像分类，对比度增强比降噪更有效，CLAHE 是更值得采用的预处理步骤。

papers.title: DaCe-DT: Data-Centric Offline Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Prompts and Trajectory Correction for Heterogeneous Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Offline multi-task reinforcement learning (Offline MTRL) heavily depends on the quality and distribution of pre-collected data. However, existing methods mainly focus on algorithmic optimization, with less emphasis on data-level improvements to enhance learning ability and generalization performance. This paper, from a data perspective, reveals three key bottlenecks that limit Offline MTRL performance:(i) ineffective utilization of prompts length under diverse task complexities, and (ii) semantic irrelevance of randomly sampled prompt segments, (iii) misleading supervision induced by fragmented and discontinuous trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose DaCe-DT, a robust offline MTRL framework designed to be insensitive to heterogeneous task complexities and data quality, featuring length-gated prompt masking (LGPM), retrieval-augmented prompt construction (RAPC), and value-adaptive return calibration (VARC). Together, these mechanisms enable DaCe-DT to deliver data-centric prompt adaptation and trajectory refinement, resulting in robust multi-task generalization and stable policy learning amid heterogeneous offline data and tasks. Experimental results on Meta-World show that DaCe-DT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average improvement of 11.73% on optimal datasets and an improvement of 13.34% on suboptimal datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in learning stably from imperfect data and improving overall multi-task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DaCe-DT 是面向离线多任务强化学习 (Offline MTRL) 的数据中心框架，用长度门控 prompt 掩码 (LGPM)、检索增强 prompt 构建 (RAPC) 与价值自适应回报校准 (VARC) 分别应对 prompt 长度利用低效、随机 prompt 段语义无关、以及碎片化轨迹带来的误导性监督。在 Meta-World 上平均超越现有最优方法 11.73%（最优数据集）与 13.34%（次优数据集）。
Motivation: 离线多任务 RL 高度依赖预采集数据的质量与分布，但现有方法偏重算法优化而忽视数据层面改进；prompt 长度在异构任务复杂度下利用低效、随机采样的 prompt 段语义无关、碎片不连续轨迹产生误导监督，共同限制性能与泛化。
Method: 提出 DaCe-DT 框架，含三个组件：长度门控 prompt 掩码 (LGPM) 按任务复杂度调节 prompt 长度利用，检索增强 prompt 构建 (RAPC) 替换语义无关的随机 prompt 段，价值自适应回报校准 (VARC) 修正碎片化轨迹的误导监督，实现 prompt 自适应与轨迹精修。
Result: 在 Meta-World 上，DaCe-DT 一致优于现有最优方法：最优数据集 (optimal datasets) 平均提升 11.73%，次优数据集 (suboptimal datasets) 平均提升 13.34%。
Conclusion: 从数据层面（prompt 适配与轨迹修正）而非纯算法优化入手，可在异构离线数据与任务下实现稳定的多任务策略学习与鲁棒泛化，尤其擅长从不完美数据中学习。

papers.title: A General $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt{T γ_T})$ Lower Bound for Kernel Bandits
papers.abstract_en: The kernel bandit problem consists of sequentially optimizing an unknown function with noisy feedback, where the function has bounded norm in a given Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). A central quantity in the regret analysis of kernel bandits is the maximum information gain $γ_T$. In particular, the best existing upper bounds scale as $\sqrt{Tγ_T}$ up to log factors, and nearly-matching lower bounds have been derived for specific kernels such as squared exponential and Matérn. However, lower bounds for general kernels are lacking, thus making it unclear in what generality the upper bounds are near-optimal. In this paper, we establish a general $Ω(\sqrt{Tγ_T/\log T})$ minimax regret lower bound for non-constant continuous kernels on compact domains, establishing near-optimality (within log factors) in a very general sense. We show that the log factor appearing in this bound is unavoidable in general, but that it can be removed under certain conditions. Among other things, our findings imply that the minimax-optimal scaling is exactly $Θ(\sqrt{Tγ_T})$ (i.e., within constant factors) for the Matérn-$ν$ kernel with $ν\in (0,2)$, $γ$-exponential kernel with $γ\in (0,2)$, and certain piecewise-polynomial kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RKHS kernel bandit 中给出一般性的 minimax regret 下界 Ω(√(Tγ_T/log T))，适用于紧致域上的非常数连续核，说明既有 √(Tγ_T) 上界在相差 log 因子意义下普遍近似最优。该 log 因子在一般情形不可去，但在 Matérn-ν（ν∈(0,2)）、γ-exponential（γ∈(0,2)）及部分分段多项式核下可去掉，使最优标度恰为 Θ(√(Tγ_T))。
Motivation: kernel bandit 的既有上界为 √(Tγ_T)（差 log 因子），下界只对 squared exponential、Matérn 等具体核给出；一般核缺少下界，无法判断上界在多大范围内近似最优。
Method: 针对紧致域上非常数连续核建立一般 minimax regret 下界 Ω(√(Tγ_T/log T))，并对可去掉 log 因子的核类给出条件，从而覆盖 Matérn-ν、γ-exponential 与部分分段多项式核。
Result: 一般下界为 Ω(√(Tγ_T/log T))；log 因子在一般情形不可去、在特定条件下可去；Matérn-ν（ν∈(0,2)）、γ-exponential（γ∈(0,2)）与某些分段多项式核的 minimax 标度恰为 Θ(√(Tγ_T))（常数因子内）。
Conclusion: kernel bandit 的 √(Tγ_T) 上界在很一般的核类上近似最优（差 log 因子），且对若干常用核该 log 因子可消去，标度精确。

papers.title: Stability-Plasticity Balance via Singular-Vector Selection in LLM Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific continual adaptation of LLMs risks catastrophic forgetting, creating a fundamental tension between acquiring new capabilities and preserving those learned during pretraining. PEFT mitigates this problem by restricting the number of trainable parameters, but existing methods lack a principled unit for deciding where plasticity should be allocated and stability should be preserved. We identify the singular-vector channel as a natural unit for managing this trade-off. Each channel represents an input-output transformation, which can be updated to acquire new knowledge or fixed to preserve pretrained capabilities. Based on this perspective, we introduce SVC, a parameter-efficient continual-learning method that selectively updates Singular-Vector Channels. Before fine-tuning, SVC uses domain-specific data to estimate each channel's adaptation benefit and a fixed public general-domain corpus only as a history activation proxy for estimating forgetting cost. It then adaptively selects trainable channels based on these scores via knee-based cost screening, Pareto-front filtering, and Otsu thresholding. Experimental results across four LLM families and eight downstream tasks show that SVC better preserves pretrained capabilities while achieving strong downstream performance relative to existing PEFT baselines. Further analysis of channel scoring and selection demonstrates that selective plasticity at the singular-vector-channel level enables effective continual LLM adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SVC：把奇异向量通道 (singular-vector channel) 作为可塑性/稳定性分配的基本单元，用领域数据估计各通道的适应收益、用固定公共通用语料作为历史激活代理估计遗忘代价，再经 knee-based cost screening、Pareto-front filtering 与 Otsu 阈值自适应挑选可训练通道。在四个 LLM 家族、八个下游任务上，SVC 相对现有 PEFT 基线更好地保留预训练能力同时保持强下游表现。
Motivation: LLM 领域专属持续适应会灾难性遗忘；PEFT 虽限制可训练参数量，但缺少一个有原则的单元来决定可塑性该投向何处、稳定性该在何处保留。
Method: SVC 先在微调前用领域数据估计每个奇异向量通道的适应收益，用固定公共通用领域语料仅作历史激活代理来估计遗忘代价，随后通过 knee-based cost screening、Pareto-front filtering 与 Otsu thresholding 自适应选择可训练通道，其余通道固定以保留预训练能力。
Result: 在四个 LLM 家族与八个下游任务上，SVC 相对现有 PEFT 基线更好地保留预训练能力并取得强下游表现；对通道打分与选择的进一步分析显示，奇异向量通道层面的选择性可塑性可实现有效的持续 LLM 适应。
Conclusion: 奇异向量通道是管理稳定性—可塑性权衡的自然单元，按通道选择性更新即可在持续适应中同时守住预训练能力与下游性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Optimally Pacing Budget Spending and Learning
papers.abstract_en: We establish near-optimal regret bounds for budget-constrained online learning against arbitrary classes of budget-pacing experts in the adversarial setting. In particular, given any class of $F$ experts and a candidate budget pacing schedule, we provide a full-information algorithm which obtains regret $O(D \sqrt{\log F}+ \sqrt{T\log F})$ against all experts whose cumulative spending stays within distance $D$ of this schedule, matching lower bounds established by Braverman et al. (2025). We additionally show that our technique extends to various problems in online resource allocation, where the learner gets to see the rewards and costs of the current options available to them, and establish $O(D\sqrt{\log F})$ regret bounds when fractional allocation is allowed. This is the first algorithm we are aware of which can achieve $o(\sqrt{T})$ guarantees for such tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对抗设定下给出预算受限在线学习的近最优 regret 算法：对任意 F 个预算匀速花费 (budget-pacing) 专家类，全信息算法对所有累计花费与给定 pacing schedule 距离不超过 D 的专家取得 O(D√logF + √(T logF)) 的 regret，匹配 Braverman et al. (2025) 的下界；允许分数分配时 regret 进一步降到 O(D√logF)，是首个对此类在线资源分配任务给出 o(√T) 保证的算法。
Motivation: 预算受限在线学习中，对手可任意设定花费节奏，此前缺少对整类 budget-pacing 专家同时有效的近最优 regret 保证，尤其在允许分数分配的在线资源分配场景下无法突破 √T 量级。
Method: 全信息设定下的算法，针对候选 pacing schedule，对累计花费落在其 D-邻域内的专家类给出 regret 界；技术可推广到学习者可见当前选项奖励与成本的在线资源分配问题，并在允许分数分配时给出 O(D√logF) 界。
Result: 对任意 F 专家类与候选 pacing schedule，regret 为 O(D√logF + √(T logF))，匹配 Braverman et al. (2025) 的下界；推广到在线资源分配且允许分数分配时为 O(D√logF)；这是已知首个对此类任务给出 o(√T) 保证的算法。
Conclusion: 预算匀速花费约束下的在线学习可以做到近最优 regret，且在分数分配的在线资源分配中把 regret 压到 √T 以下。

papers.title: No Distillation Needed: Single-Pass Real-Time Talking Heads via Acausal Noise Shaping
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven facial animation underpins real-time avatars, telepresence, and embodied virtual agents. And it must run online: each frame emitted from audio observed up to the current time, at interactive rates. Recent progress is dominated by diffusion models, which need many network evaluations per sample and are therefore a poor fit for streaming. We argue the cost is unnecessary in this domain. Audio-conditioned facial motion occupies a comparatively low-dimensional manifold, a regime where a single-pass GAN suffices. The obstacle is not capacity but stochastic structure. We show that a causal, time-invariant generator driven by i.i.d. noise cannot suppress its output spectrum over a band without collapsing its per-step innovation. We proposed FaceGAN, which dissolved the limitation by shaping the noise pathway acausally. Because the driving noise is synthetic, its future can be sampled now, so the audio-to-expression path stays causal, and the model supports fully causal operation. FaceGAN emits expression and head pose in a single forward pass per frame and matches or outperforms state-of-art approaches in generation quality. Being feed-forward with bounded attention windows, it generates indefinitely without drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaceGAN 用单次前向的 GAN 替代扩散模型做音频驱动人脸动画：因果时不变生成器无法在压低输出频带的同时保持每步创新，作者改为非因果地整形噪声通路——合成噪声的未来可提前采样，音频到表情的路径仍保持因果。每帧一次前向即输出表情与头部姿态，生成质量匹配或超过现有方法，且因注意力窗口有界可无限生成而不漂移。
Motivation: 实时语音驱动数字人要求每帧只用当前时刻之前的音频在线生成，而主流扩散模型每样本需多次网络评估，不适合流式场景；障碍不是模型容量而是随机结构。
Method: 提出 FaceGAN：单次前向的 GAN，通过非因果噪声整形 (acausal noise shaping) 绕开因果时不变生成器的谱抑制—创新塌缩限制；合成噪声可提前采样未来，使音频到表情通路保持因果、支持完全因果运行，注意力窗口有界。
Result: 每帧单次前向输出表情与头部姿态，生成质量匹配或优于 state-of-the-art 方法；可无限时长生成而不产生漂移（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
Conclusion: 音频条件下的面部运动属于低维流形，单次前向的 GAN 足以胜任，扩散模型的多次采样开销在该域是不必要的。

papers.title: Diffusion Meta-Prompting and Steering for Generalizable Foundation Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Prompt learning is a popular method for adapting foundation models, but learned prompts are typically task-specific and fail to generalize to new classes, domains, or compositions of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP) model , a framework that models the distribution of learned prompts using diffusion models. Given a repository of previously learned prompts, DMP is trained and sampled without access to the original task examples or task losses, and synthesizes new prompts conditioned on natural language task descriptions. To improve the sampling stability, we introduce a test-time steering strategy for DMP, which uses the best training-selected prompt in the repository as a latent anchor during diffusion sampling, without retraining the DMP or accessing test classes. DMP improves generalization across classification, retrieval and text-to-image generation tasks, supports concept composition and negative prompting without explicit training. It reduces storage and inference costs by over 90% compared to prompt retrieval methods. For composite classification, DMP achieves upto 2.0% average gain over prior meta-learning methods across 55 pairs of datasets with gains as high as 8.5% on specific pairs such as Eurosat and Flowers. DMP also enhances cross-task generalization with ~2-9% improvement for hierarchical classification task. We further provide a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected task loss of prompts sampled from a DMP. Code is available: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://deepaksridhar.github.io/dmp.github.io/. Code: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP)，用 diffusion 模型建模已学 prompt 的分布，在不接触原始任务样本与任务损失的条件下按自然语言任务描述合成新 prompt，并用仓库中最优 prompt 作 latent anchor 做测试时 steering 提升采样稳定性。复合分类上较先前 meta-learning 方法在 55 对数据集上平均提升至多 2.0%（Eurosat、Flowers 等特定对高达 8.5%），层次分类跨任务泛化提升约 2–9%，存储与推理成本较 prompt 检索方法降低 90% 以上。
Motivation: prompt learning 学到的 prompt 通常是任务专用的，遇到新类别、新域或任务组合就失效；已有 prompt 检索方法还要为每个任务保存 prompt，存储与推理开销大。
Method: DMP 用 diffusion 模型拟合 prompt 仓库的分布，训练与采样均不访问原始任务样本或任务损失，仅以自然语言任务描述为条件合成 prompt；测试时 steering 把训练阶段选出的最优 prompt 作为 diffusion 采样过程中的 latent anchor，不重训模型也不访问测试类别。另给出一个界定 DMP 采样 prompt 期望任务损失的理论保证。
Result: 存储与推理成本较 prompt 检索方法降低 90% 以上；复合分类在 55 对数据集上较先前 meta-learning 方法平均提升至多 2.0%，Eurosat、Flowers 等特定数据对最高 8.5%；层次分类任务跨任务泛化提升约 2–9%；在分类、检索与文生图任务上均改善泛化，并在无显式训练下支持概念组合与 negative prompting。
Conclusion: 把 prompt 当作可由 diffusion 生成的分布而非逐任务存储的参数，可以在不接触原任务数据的前提下泛化到新类别、新域与任务组合，并大幅压缩 prompt 检索方案的存储与推理开销。

papers.title: CityDeploy-Bench: Benchmarking Physics-Grounded Spatial Set Planning for Multi-Transmitter Network Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Automating city-scale wireless deployment remains challenging under complex urban propagation and network-wide interference. We introduce \textbf{CityDeploy-Bench}, a benchmark that reframes multi-transmitter deployment as \emph{physics-grounded spatial set planning} under a unified ray-tracing verifier. The benchmark separates utility representation from planning dynamics, enabling controlled comparison between direct scalar rewards, relational models, and higher-order interaction structures across diverse planners. Our experiments reveal a clear transition in planning behavior as physical coupling grows. Deployment quality becomes increasingly dependent on whether the learned utility captures collective transmitter interactions, whereas stronger search alone cannot compensate for missing relational structure. This establishes multi-transmitter deployment as a coordination problem over physically interacting sets rather than a collection of independent spatial decisions. We release CityDeploy-Data and the benchmark framework as a reproducible testbed for research linking decision learning with physically grounded wireless network design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CityDeploy-Bench 把城市多基站部署重构为统一 ray-tracing 验证器下的物理约束空间集合规划 (physics-grounded spatial set planning)，把效用表示与规划动力学解耦，以对比直接标量奖励、关系模型与高阶交互结构。实验显示随物理耦合增强，部署质量越来越取决于学到的效用是否刻画发射机间的集体交互，单纯加强搜索无法弥补缺失的关系结构。
Motivation: 城市尺度无线部署受复杂 urban 传播与全网干扰影响，把多发射机决策当作彼此独立的空间选择会失效，需要可复现的基准来区分效用表示与搜索强度各自的贡献。
Method: 以统一 ray-tracing 验证器为物理判据，将多发射机部署建模为空间集合规划；分离效用表示与规划动力学，在多种 planner 上对比直接标量奖励、关系模型与高阶交互结构三类效用。
Result: 实验揭示规划行为随物理耦合增强出现清晰转变：部署质量日益依赖学到的效用是否捕捉发射机的集体交互，而更强的搜索无法补偿缺失的关系结构；并发布 CityDeploy-Data 与基准框架作为可复现 testbed。
Conclusion: 多发射机部署应被视为物理交互集合上的协调问题，而非独立空间决策的集合；决策学习与物理约束的无线网络设计可借该 testbed 复现研究。
Relevance: 1
