papers.title: Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly connected to high-value resources, including external APIs, GPUs and servers, and workflows such as deployment and approval. Existing agent security research mainly focuses on attacks against information and agent behavior, while high-value resources have received less attention as attack targets themselves. To our knowledge, we are the first to identify and systematically study agent resource hijacking, in which attackers induce agents to use high-value resources for their own goals without directly obtaining those resources or their credentials. We introduce ResourceHijackBench, an executable benchmark and automated case-generation pipeline that covers six categories of high-value resources. It contains 300 attack scenarios and 900 attack prompts, and each case runs in an isolated local environment that records actual resource use. Resource hijacking remains effective across four model backends, with average attack success rates of 70.0% to 89.6%, and it also appears across two agent harnesses, with average ASRs of 84.1% on OpenClaw and 72.3% on Codex. In paired comparisons, resource hijacking achieves ASRs 62.4 to 84.0 percentage points higher than direct resource acquisition across the four model backends. Real-world experiments also demonstrate the practical effectiveness of resource hijacking. Among the three existing defenses we evaluate, the lowest average ASR is still 55.1%. We further propose ResGate, a pre-execution resource authorization defense that combines model-based resource-use extraction with deterministic policy enforcement based on trusted requester identity metadata, reducing the average ASR on OpenClaw to 23.6%. These results show that preventing direct access alone is not enough to protect resources that agents can still use on an attacker's behalf, and that explicit resource authorization can help reduce this risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出并系统研究 LLM agent 的资源劫持 (resource hijacking)：攻击者不直接获取资源或凭证，而是诱导 agent 替自己使用高价值资源。ResourceHijackBench 含 300 个攻击场景、900 条攻击提示，四类模型后端上平均攻击成功率 70.0%–89.6%，比直接获取资源高 62.4–84.0 个百分点；提出的执行前授权防御 ResGate 把 OpenClaw 上平均 ASR 降到 23.6%。
Motivation: 现有 agent 安全研究主要针对信息窃取与行为操纵，高价值资源（外部 API、GPU 与服务器、部署与审批工作流）本身作为攻击目标被忽视；只防直接访问挡不住 agent 替攻击者使用资源。
Method: 构建可执行基准 ResourceHijackBench 与自动化用例生成流水线，覆盖六类高价值资源，每个用例在隔离本地环境中运行并记录真实资源使用；评估四个模型后端与 OpenClaw、Codex 两种 agent harness，比较三种已有防御，并提出 ResGate——基于模型的资源使用抽取加依赖可信请求方身份元数据的确定性策略执行。
Result: 四模型后端平均 ASR 70.0%–89.6%；OpenClaw 与 Codex 平均 ASR 分别为 84.1% 与 72.3%；配对比较中资源劫持比直接获取资源的 ASR 高 62.4 至 84.0 个百分点；真实环境实验同样显示其实际有效；三种已有防御中最低平均 ASR 仍达 55.1%；ResGate 将 OpenClaw 平均 ASR 降至 23.6%。
Conclusion: 只阻止直接访问不足以保护 agent 可替攻击者使用的资源，必须加入显式的资源授权；ResGate 把执行前授权作为可行的缓解路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Multi-Armed Bandits and Linear Bandits: Lower Bounds and Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: We study quantum multi-armed bandits (QMAB) and quantum linear bandits (QLB), where the learner queries each arm or action through a quantum reward oracle or its inverse. Prior work gives algorithms over horizon $T$ with regret $O(K\log T)$ for QMAB with $K$ arms and $O(d^2\operatorname{polylog} T)$ for $d$-dimensional QLB. This leaves open the optimal dependence on $K$ and $T$ and whether the dependence on $d$ can be further improved. In this work, we prove the first tight minimax regret bound of $Θ(K\log(1+T/K))$ for QMAB and the first lower bound of $Ω(d\log(1+T/d))$ for finite-action QLB, ruling out regret independent of $T$. Our lower bounds rely on a high-confidence single-arm quantum testing lower bound for distinguishing a fixed reward mean from an interval of alternatives. A bandit-to-testing reduction then lifts it to the QMAB lower bound, while a linear embedding gives the finite-action QLB lower bound. The matching QMAB upper bound is obtained using a tail bound for the Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) estimator. For finite-action QLB, we propose a phased elimination algorithm that combines a low-bias low-variance quantum mean estimator with a small-support $G$-optimal design through a query allocation matched to the design weights. When the action set has size $\operatorname{poly}(d)$, its regret is nearly linear in $d$ and matches our lower bound up to polylogarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明量子多臂老虎机 (QMAB) 的 minimax regret 紧界为 Θ(K log(1+T/K))，并给出有限动作量子线性老虎机 (QLB) 的首个下界 Ω(d log(1+T/d))，排除与 T 无关的 regret。上界用 Quantum Monte Carlo 估计量的尾界与分阶段消除算法达成，后者在动作集大小为 poly(d) 时 regret 近似线性于 d，与下界只差 polylog 因子。
Motivation: 已有 QMAB 算法 regret 为 O(K log T)、QLB 为 O(d² polylog T)，K、T 的最优依赖以及 d 的依赖能否改进均未解决；QLB 是否存在与 T 无关的 regret 也未知。
Method: 下界分三步：高置信度单臂量子检验下界（区分固定均值与备择区间），bandit-to-testing 归约提升到 QMAB，线性嵌入得到有限动作 QLB 下界。上界方面，QMAB 匹配界用 Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) 估计量的尾界；QLB 提出分阶段消除 (phased elimination) 算法，把低偏差低方差量子均值估计量与小支撑 G-optimal design 结合，按设计权重分配查询。
Result: QMAB 首个紧 minimax 界 Θ(K log(1+T/K))；有限动作 QLB 首个下界 Ω(d log(1+T/d))，排除与 T 无关的 regret。当动作集大小为 poly(d) 时，QLB 算法 regret 近似线性于 d，与下界仅差 polylog 因子；此前上界分别为 O(K log T) 与 O(d² polylog T)。
Conclusion: QMAB 的 K 与 T 依赖已收紧到最优，QLB 的 d 依赖可从 d² 降到近线性，且任何有限动作 QLB 算法的 regret 必须随 T 增长。

papers.title: Robust and Efficient Noisy-Label Time-Series Classification via Dynamic Time Warping Based Granular Ball Computing
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW)-based Nearest-Neighbor (NN) classifiers are effective for time-series classification but are vulnerable to mislabeled training samples and require numerous DTW computations during inference. We propose DTW-based Granular Ball Computing (DTW-GBC), which organizes temporally similar training samples into granular balls and performs classification at the granule level. We further develop two granular-ball construction strategies for DTW-GBC. Experiments on four benchmark datasets with symmetric label noise show that the two DTW-GBC variants generally mitigate the performance degradation caused by label noise while requiring substantially fewer comparisons than DTW-based 1-NN during inference. These findings suggest that DTW-GBC provides a favorable balance between classification robustness and inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于动态时间规整 (DTW) 的粒球计算分类器 DTW-GBC，把时间上相似的训练样本聚成粒球并改在粒级做最近邻分类，同时给出两种粒球构建策略。在四个基准数据集加对称标签噪声的实验中，两个变体普遍缓解了标签噪声导致的性能下降，且推理所需比较次数远少于 DTW 1-NN。
Motivation: 基于 DTW 的最近邻分类器对错标训练样本敏感，且推理阶段需要大量 DTW 计算，鲁棒性与效率难以兼顾。
Method: DTW-GBC 用 DTW 距离把时间序列训练样本组织成粒球 (granular ball)，分类在粒级而非样本级进行；另提出两种粒球构建策略，在四个基准数据集上注入对称标签噪声做实验，与 DTW 1-NN 比较推理比较次数。
Result: 在四个基准数据集的对称标签噪声实验中，两个 DTW-GBC 变体普遍减轻标签噪声造成的性能退化，推理时的比较次数比 DTW 1-NN 少得多；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: DTW-GBC 在分类鲁棒性与推理效率之间给出有利折中，代价是把逐样本 DTW 匹配换成粒级匹配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conversational versus Dashboard Explainable AI for UAV Intrusion Detection: An Empirical Study of Operator Trust and Reliance
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) have demonstrated superior performance in securing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks. However, the 'black-box' nature of these models, combined with the high dimensionality of multimodal cyber-physical data, poses significant interpretability challenges. Static visualization dashboards may struggle to present complex relationships among multimodal cyber-physical features in a form that is easy for operators to inspect and interpret. To address this, we propose a Conversational XAI interface powered by Large Language Models (LLM) to facilitate on-demand investigation. In a controlled experiment with participants, we systematically evaluated the impact of this conversational interface versus a traditional XAI Dashboard on operator understanding, trust, and reliance during post-incident auditing tasks. Our results suggest that the conversational interface was perceived as more useful than the dashboard, potentially because it helped participants access and synthesize relevant information more easily. However, this benefit was accompanied by a lower level of appropriate self-reliance, indicating a potential risk of over-reliance. One possible interpretation is that the natural-language responses made the AI advice easier to accept, which may have reduced participants' tendency to verify the underlying evidence when the IDS was incorrect. These findings point to a potential trade-off in human-AI collaboration for UAV intrusion auditing: interaction mechanisms that improve perceived usability may also increase the risk of inappropriate reliance. We conclude by discussing design implications for future XAI systems that balance seamless interaction with cognitive forcing functions to foster appropriate reliance.
papers.comment: We have discovered a critical error in our experimental data that invalidates the main conclusions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 UAV 入侵检测 (IDS) 事后审计任务的受控实验中，LLM 驱动的对话式 XAI 界面比传统 XAI Dashboard 被参与者评为更有用，但同时降低了恰当的自我依赖 (appropriate self-reliance)，带来过度依赖风险。作者归因于自然语言回答让 AI 建议更易被接受、从而削弱了对底层证据的核验。注意 arXiv comment 声明实验数据存在致命错误、推翻主要结论。
Motivation: ML-based IDS 的黑箱性质叠加多模态网络-物理数据的高维性，使静态可视化 Dashboard 难以让操作员理解特征间复杂关系，且对话式交互是否改善理解与信任尚无受控证据。
Method: 提出由 LLM 驱动的 Conversational XAI 界面支持按需调查；在受控实验中让参与者完成事后审计 (post-incident auditing) 任务，对比对话式界面与传统 XAI Dashboard 对操作员理解、信任与依赖 (reliance) 的影响。
Result: 对话式界面被评为比 Dashboard 更有用，可能因其更易获取与综合相关信息；但恰当自我依赖水平更低，存在过度依赖风险。arXiv comment 声明实验数据存在致命错误并使主要结论失效。
Conclusion: 提升可用性的交互机制可能同时抬高不当依赖风险，未来 XAI 设计需在无缝交互与 cognitive forcing functions 之间权衡以培养恰当依赖。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ASV3D: Adapting Diffusion-Based Single-View 3D Reconstruction with Extra Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction of 3D objects from a single image is a fundamental research topic in computer vision. The key challenge is the lack of information from critical viewpoints to complete 3D structures. Using an additional view may help to resolve the issue. However, there is no mechanism that can integrate the extra view into the diffusion-based single-view 3D reconstruction principle. We address this challenge by proposing ASV3D, a framework for adapting diffusion-based single-view 3D object reconstruction to test-time data with support from one additional image. We introduce two adaptation strategies: (i) a zero-shot adaptation scheme that leverages the auxiliary image to improve the reconstruction quality of an object without retraining, and (ii) an optimised adaptation scheme that further enhances visual fidelity and cross-view consistency via contrastive learning. We apply our ASV3D to improve two state-of-the-art diffusion-based single-view 3D reconstruction pipelines on both benchmark and real-world datasets. Results demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reconstruction accuracy and robustness under unconstrained multi-view inputs, outperforming the baselines in both quantitative metrics and human preference. We publish our code and the real-world object dataset on our project page at https://github.com/YNhuHuynh/ASV3D/tree/main.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASV3D 把一张额外视角图像接入扩散式单视图 3D 重建，提出零样本适配（不重训直接用辅助图提升重建质量）与借助对比学习的优化适配（进一步提升视觉保真与跨视图一致性）两条策略。在 benchmark 与真实数据集上改进两个 SOTA 扩散式单视图重建管线，结果在定量指标与人类偏好上均一致优于基线。
Motivation: 单视图 3D 重建缺少关键视角信息，难以补全三维结构；已有扩散式单视图重建原理中没有机制能整合额外视角。
Method: 提出 ASV3D 框架，含两种适配策略：(i) 零样本适配，用辅助图像在不重训的情况下提升重建质量；(ii) 优化适配，通过对比学习 (contrastive learning) 进一步增强视觉保真与跨视图一致性。将两者应用于改进两个基于扩散的单视图 3D 重建管线，并在 benchmark 与真实数据集上测试。
Result: 在 benchmark 与真实世界数据集上，ASV3D 改进的两个扩散式单视图 3D 重建管线在无约束多视图输入下重建精度与鲁棒性一致提升，在定量指标与人类偏好上均超过基线；代码与真实物体数据集已在项目页发布。
Conclusion: 在测试时用一张额外图像适配扩散式单视图重建，无需重训即可稳定提升重建精度与鲁棒性，且定量指标与人类偏好一致。

papers.title: Capacity Confounds and Coverage Guarantees in Adaptive Sub-model Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sub-model federated learning lets resource-constrained clients train width-reduced versions of a global model, but existing methods allocate capacity by device resources alone. A natural next step, allocating capacity by each client's data heterogeneity as estimated from the updates the server already observes, is suggested by recent methods that size sub-models from training-derived signals. We ask whether that step is possible, using HAS-FL, an adaptive capacity-allocation framework, as a test case. First, validated against ground-truth label-distribution divergence on reproducible partitions, update-divergence estimates of client heterogeneity are dominated by capacity rather than data: on both image benchmarks and every seed, the estimates correlate strongly and negatively with device capacity, and once capacity is controlled for their association with data heterogeneity is near zero or negative. Any method estimating client statistics from sub-model updates is exposed to this previously undocumented confound. Second, adaptive allocation has a hidden failure mode: when every client is capped below full width, the uncovered parameters stay at random initialization and progressively corrupt the global model. A simple coverage guarantee removes the failure and explains why uniform allocation collapses. Third, a matched-budget control settles what adaptivity contributes: random allocation to the same average budget matches the adaptive policy to within seed-to-seed variation on both image benchmarks, and on the naturally partitioned text benchmark the adaptive policy is the weakest of the three strategies while consuming the most capacity. Sub-model training admits constrained clients at quadratically reduced cost but gives up substantial accuracy relative to full-model training, and what protects that accuracy is parameter coverage rather than allocation intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在子模型联邦学习 (sub-model FL) 中，用服务器已见的更新散度估计客户端异质性并据此分配容量是被混淆的：估计值主要由设备容量而非数据分布驱动，与容量强负相关，控制容量后与真实标签分布散度的关联接近零甚至为负。当所有客户端都被截断在全宽度以下时，未覆盖参数停留在随机初始化并逐步污染全局模型，加一个参数覆盖保证即可消除该失效；而同预算随机分配与自适应策略在两个图像基准上差距落在种子间波动内，自然划分的文本基准上自适应策略反而最差且耗容量最多。
Motivation: 子模型联邦学习按设备资源分配宽度，进一步按数据异质性自适应分配看似顺理成章，但该做法依赖从子模型更新中估计客户端统计量，这一路径此前未被记录的容量混淆所破坏，且自适应分配存在隐藏失效模式。
Method: 以 HAS-FL 自适应容量分配框架为测试案例：在可复现划分上用真实标签分布散度作 ground truth，检验更新散度估计与设备容量、与数据异质性的相关；再诊断全客户端截断时未覆盖参数的行为并给出覆盖保证；最后用同平均预算的随机分配作 matched-budget 对照，在两个图像基准与一个自然划分文本基准上比较三种策略。
Result: 更新散度估计在两个图像基准、每个种子上都与设备容量强负相关，控制容量后与数据异质性的关联接近零或为负；同预算随机分配与自适应策略的差距在种子间波动范围内（两个图像基准）；文本基准上自适应策略在三者中最弱且消耗容量最多；子模型训练成本按二次级降低但相对全模型训练牺牲大量精度。
Conclusion: 保护子模型联邦学习精度的是参数覆盖而非分配策略的智能程度；任何从子模型更新估计客户端统计量的方法都暴露在容量混淆之下，均匀分配的崩溃可由覆盖保证解释。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Solver-Aware Decompositions for Programming-by-Example: When Dividing Requires Knowing how to Conquer
papers.abstract_en: Decomposition-based Programming-by-example (PBE) scales performance by splitting tasks into subtasks that a learned synthesizer solves: a decomposer predicts intermediate subgoals, and a synthesizer generates programs conditioned on them. Execution-decomposition approaches such as ExeDec train the decomposer to imitate ground-truth (GT) subgoals, implicitly treating decomposition quality as intrinsic to the task. We challenge this assumption: for bounded solvers with fixed inductive biases, GT decompositions reflect the annotator's factorization choices - not the solver's search dynamics. A decomposer trained to match GT decompositions may therefore propose subgoals that are logically valid yet intractable for the solver. We propose Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD), a training framework that retains supervised training on GT subgoals as a structural scaffold, while additionally optimizing the decomposer online with policy gradients against a frozen learned synthesizer. Each sampled subgoal is rewarded by the synthesizer's cross-entropy loss on the target program - a continuous signal of subtask difficulty that encourages decompositions the solver can act on. Our experiments reveal an accuracy paradox: higher agreement with GT decompositions does not improve synthesis success - even though the synthesizer was trained on the very same GT data the decomposer is optimized to mimic. SAD instead learns decompositions that trade GT alignment for solver tractability, yielding consistent gains in synthesis and end-to-end task accuracy across two PBE domains and under zero-shot transfer to an external list-processing benchmark. Moreover, SAD solves tasks that a GT decomposition oracle fails - empirical evidence, under an identical synthesizer and search procedure, that GT decompositions are not universally optimal for bounded solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD)：在模仿 GT 子目标的监督训练之外，用冻结的 synthesizer 对 decomposer 做 policy gradient 在线优化，奖励取 synthesizer 在目标程序上的 cross-entropy 损失。发现与 GT 分解的一致度提高并不提升合成成功率；SAD 用求解器可处理性换取 GT 对齐，在两个 PBE 域及向外部列表处理基准的 zero-shot 迁移上一致提升合成与端到端准确率，并解出 GT 分解 oracle 失败的任务。
Motivation: 执行分解方法（如 ExeDec）把分解质量当作任务固有属性、让 decomposer 模仿 GT 子目标，但对有界求解器而言 GT 分解反映的是标注者的因子化选择而非求解器的搜索动力学，可能提出逻辑有效却对求解器不可行的子目标。
Method: SAD 训练框架保留对 GT 子目标的监督训练作为结构骨架，同时用 policy gradients 针对冻结的 learned synthesizer 在线优化 decomposer；每个采样子目标的奖励是 synthesizer 在目标程序上的 cross-entropy 损失，作为子任务难度的连续信号。
Result: 实验揭示 accuracy paradox：与 GT 分解的一致度更高并不提升合成成功率，尽管 synthesizer 正是在 decomposer 所模仿的同一份 GT 数据上训练的。SAD 在两个 PBE 域上一致提升合成与端到端任务准确率，并在向外部列表处理基准的 zero-shot 迁移中同样取得增益；在相同 synthesizer 与搜索过程下，SAD 解出了 GT 分解 oracle 失败的任务。
Conclusion: 对有界求解器而言 GT 分解并非普遍最优，分解训练应以求解器可处理性为目标而非最大化 GT 对齐。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PixVL: Self-Supervised Training of Pixel-Level MLLMs via a Unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies develop pixel-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that support both Region Segmentation and Region Understanding, extending multimodal interaction from whole images to specific objects and regions. However, these methods face two fundamental challenges. First, the scarcity of high-quality mask--text pairs leaves abundant mask annotations without corresponding language supervision. Second, discrepancies in supervision formats and learning-signal densities induce optimization interference between Region Segmentation and Region Understanding. To address these challenges, we propose PixVL, a self-supervised post-training framework that introduces a unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle, enabling pixel-level MLLMs to generate and self-verify regional descriptions and learn from unlabeled data. We found that direct cycle based solely on geometric reconstruction is unreliable because re-segmentation IoU does not faithfully reflect the semantic quality and referring sufficiency. PixVL therefore introduces confuser-aware semantic verification, which uses the model's confidence when it correctly chooses the target among highly similar candidate regions, and assigns zero reward to an incorrect choice. Meanwhile, PixVL performs cross-view verification using temporally separated video frames or geometrically transformed image views, preventing cyclic learning from collapsing to positional and shape shortcuts. Finally, a quality-coupled bidirectional learning strategy uses the highest-reward description to guide Text-to-Mask learning. This strategy transforms Region Understanding and Region Segmentation from competing tasks into mutual generators and verifiers. Experiments demonstrate that PixVL improves both region understanding task and segmentation task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixVL 是面向像素级 MLLM 的自监督后训练框架，用统一的 Mask–Text Consistency Cycle 让模型自产区域描述并自验证，从无标注数据中学习。纯几何重建的循环不可靠（重分割 IoU 不反映语义质量），因此加入 confuser-aware 语义验证（选对高相似候选区域给奖励、选错给零奖励）、跨视角验证（时间分离的视频帧或几何变换视图）以及用最高奖励描述驱动 Text-to-Mask 的质量耦合双向学习。实验显示区域理解与分割两项任务同时提升。
Motivation: 高质量 mask–text 对稀缺，大量掩码标注没有语言监督；同时 Region Segmentation 与 Region Understanding 的监督格式和信号密度不同，造成优化干扰。
Method: PixVL 提出 Mask–Text Consistency Cycle：模型生成区域描述并自我验证，从无标注数据学习。三个关键组件——confuser-aware 语义验证（用模型在高相似候选区域中选对目标的置信度作奖励，选错给零奖励）、跨视角验证（用时间分离的视频帧或几何变换后的图像视图，防止循环退化为位置与形状捷径）、质量耦合双向学习（取最高奖励的描述去指导 Text-to-Mask），把两项任务从竞争关系变成互为生成器与验证器。
Result: 实验表明 PixVL 同时提升区域理解任务与分割任务；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 仅靠几何重建（重分割 IoU）的循环学习不可靠，必须叠加语义与跨视角验证，才能让 Region Understanding 与 Region Segmentation 互相增益而非互相干扰。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: PixVL 是面向像素级 MLLM 的自监督后训练框架，用统一的 Mask–Text Consistency Cycle 让模型自产区域描述并自验证，从无标注数据中学习。纯几何重建的循环不可靠（重分割 IoU 不反映语义质量），因此加入 confuser-aware 语义验证（选对高相似候选区域给奖励、选错给零奖励）、跨视角验证（时间分离的视频帧或几何变换视图）以及用最高奖励描述驱动 Text-to-Mask 的质量耦合双向学习。实验显示区域理解与分割两项任务同时提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 高质量 mask–text 对稀缺，大量掩码标注没有语言监督；同时 Region Segmentation 与 Region Understanding 的监督格式和信号密度不同，造成优化干扰。
summary_sections.method: PixVL 提出 Mask–Text Consistency Cycle：模型生成区域描述并自我验证，从无标注数据学习。三个关键组件——confuser-aware 语义验证（用模型在高相似候选区域中选对目标的置信度作奖励，选错给零奖励）、跨视角验证（用时间分离的视频帧或几何变换后的图像视图，防止循环退化为位置与形状捷径）、质量耦合双向学习（取最高奖励的描述去指导 Text-to-Mask），把两项任务从竞争关系变成互为生成器与验证器。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明 PixVL 同时提升区域理解任务与分割任务；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 仅靠几何重建（重分割 IoU）的循环学习不可靠，必须叠加语义与跨视角验证，才能让 Region Understanding 与 Region Segmentation 互相增益而非互相干扰。

papers.title: Beyond Component Testing: Validating Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems act through multi-step trajectories that combine planning, tool use, memory, interaction, and adaptation. This behavior stretches validation practice beyond component testing and one-shot input-output evaluation, because acceptable system behavior now depends on how decisions unfold over time and under changing environmental conditions. This systematic mapping study synthesizes 262 papers spanning agent evaluation, software assurance, cyber-physical systems, runtime monitoring, and regulatory guidance in order to characterize the validation problem for agentic systems. The review is organized around a five-dimension taxonomy covering behavioral, safety, temporal, regulatory, and multi-agent concerns, and uses that taxonomy to map current approaches and identify dense and sparse pairings of approaches and dimensions. The resulting map shows that the literature concentrates on behavioral evaluation (105 of 262 papers) and is thinnest on temporal validity (14 papers); regulatory work rests mainly on assurance cases and regulatory analysis, largely from IEEE-indexed venues, and multi-agent work mainly on benchmarks. Three cross-domain case studies (medical care, industrial operations, smart-mobility systems) provide operational illustrations of how the five taxonomy dimensions recur in safety-critical settings, motivated by the failure patterns documented in the reviewed literature. The paper concludes with a lifecycle-oriented research agenda centered on bounded-autonomy specifications, adversarial trajectory generation, runtime monitoring, and audit-ready evidence structures. The central claim is that trustworthy deployment of agentic AI depends on validating trajectories in context rather than assessing isolated components alone.
papers.comment: 61 pages, 3 figures, revised version, submitted to Artificial Intelligence Review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 agentic AI 系统验证的系统性映射研究 (systematic mapping study)，综述 262 篇文献并按行为、安全、时序、监管、多智能体五个维度建立分类法，指出文献集中在行为评估（262 篇中 105 篇）、时序有效性最薄弱（仅 14 篇），主张可信部署必须验证轨迹在具体情境中的展开，而非孤立评估组件。
Motivation: Agentic 系统通过多步轨迹（规划、工具使用、记忆、交互、适应）行动，可接受性取决于决策随时间与环境变化的展开方式，传统的组件测试与单次输入输出评估已不足以覆盖这种行为。
Method: 系统性映射研究，综合 agent 评估、软件保障、信息物理系统、运行时监控与监管指引五个领域的 262 篇论文；以五维分类法（行为、安全、时序、监管、多智能体）映射现有方法并识别方法与维度的密集/稀疏配对；辅以医疗护理、工业运维、智慧出行三个跨领域案例研究作操作性说明。
Result: 行为评估最密集，占 262 篇中的 105 篇；时序有效性最稀疏，仅 14 篇；监管研究主要依托 assurance cases 与监管分析且多来自 IEEE 期刊，多智能体研究主要依托 benchmarks。
Conclusion: agentic AI 的可信部署取决于在具体情境中验证轨迹，而非孤立评估组件；作者给出以 bounded-autonomy 规范、对抗性轨迹生成、运行时监控与可审计证据结构为核心的研究议程。

papers.title: GLM-RAG: Graph Language Models for Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs requires retrievers that can effectively capture both graph structure and semantic information. Recent approaches have explored graph neural network (GNN)-based retrievers to model graph topology in multi-hop reasoning tasks. In parallel, graph language models (GLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates graph reasoning and the semantic capabilities of language models. In this work, we introduce a GLM-based retriever and investigate the comparative strengths of GLM-based, GNN-based, and traditional vector-search-based retrievers in single- and multi-hop RAG settings, and with a particular focus on transferability to unseen domains. Our findings suggest that finetuned GLM retrievers generalize better out of domain, achieving SOTA on two multi-hop benchmarks. On in-domain multi-hop QA datasets they remain comparable to prior work, with promising scaling as parameters and subgraph coverage increase. GNN-based retrievers achieve higher graph coverage with an efficient training setup, whereas the vector-search baseline excels at single-hop datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 graph language model (GLM) 的知识图谱检索器，与 GNN 检索器和向量检索基线在单跳与多跳 RAG 上对比，重点考察跨域可迁移性。微调后的 GLM 检索器域外泛化更好，在两个多跳基准上达到 SOTA；域内多跳 QA 与已有工作相当，且随参数量与子图覆盖增加呈可喜的扩展趋势。
Motivation: 知识图谱上的 RAG 需要同时捕捉图结构与语义信息，现有 GNN 检索器建模拓扑但语义能力有限，向量检索则缺乏图结构建模，跨域迁移是薄弱环节。
Method: 引入 GLM-based retriever，与 GNN-based 及传统向量检索 (vector-search) 检索器在单跳和多跳 RAG 设定下做对比研究，重点评估向未见域的迁移能力，并考察参数量与子图覆盖 (subgraph coverage) 的扩展效应。
Result: 微调 GLM 检索器域外泛化更好，在两个多跳基准上达到 SOTA；域内多跳 QA 数据集上与已有工作相当，随参数量与子图覆盖增加有可喜的扩展性；GNN 检索器以高效训练取得更高图覆盖，向量检索基线在单跳数据集上表现最佳。
Conclusion: GLM 检索器的优势主要在跨域迁移与多跳推理，而单跳任务上向量检索仍占优，GNN 检索器则在图覆盖与训练效率上更划算。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: How Much Does Message Passing Matter? A Drop-In Study of GNN Layers for Neural Network Graph Regression
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used as regressors, for example to predict the accuracy of a neural architecture. Yet new message-passing (MP) layers are developed and benchmarked almost exclusively on classification tasks, and regression pipelines typically adopt a single MP layer without ablation. We ask how much the choice of MP layer matters for graph-level regression. Holding the architecture, loss and training recipe of four existing GNN regressors fixed, we substitute ten MP configurations spanning convolutional, isomorphism-based and attention-based designs. We evaluate them on eleven datasets of neural-network graphs that range from under ten to over a thousand nodes per graph and from a few hundred to over four hundred thousand samples, measuring rank correlation, prediction error, top-$k$ retrieval, latency and memory. MP choice changes results substantially, and we find that the best choice depends on graph size, training-set size and regression objective. Classical layers such as GEN, $k$-GNN and PNA match or exceed attention-based layers on small architecture graphs at lower cost, while GATv2 performs well on datasets with few large graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在神经网络架构图回归任务上，固定四个 GNN 回归器的架构、损失与训练配方，只替换十种 message-passing (MP) 层配置，MP 选择会显著改变结果，且最优选择取决于图规模、训练集规模与回归目标。小规模架构图上 GEN、k-GNN、PNA 等经典层以更低成本匹配或超过注意力层，而 GATv2 在少量大图的数据集上表现好。
Motivation: 新的 MP 层几乎只在分类任务上开发和基准测试，而 GNN 作为回归器（如预测神经网络架构精度）被广泛使用时通常不加消融地固定采用单一 MP 层，缺少该场景下的选型依据。
Method: 在四个已有 GNN 回归器上固定架构、损失与训练配方，替换十种 MP 配置（涵盖卷积式、同构类与注意力式设计），在十一个神经网络图数据集上评测，图规模从每图不足十节点到上千节点、样本量从数百到四十余万，指标包括秩相关、预测误差、top-k 检索、延迟与显存。
Result: MP 层选择显著改变回归结果；最优层随图规模、训练集规模与回归目标变化。小架构图上 GEN、k-GNN、PNA 以更低成本匹配或超过注意力层；GATv2 在少量大图的数据集上表现好。
Conclusion: 图级回归中 MP 层不是可以照搬分类结论的无关超参，应按图规模、训练集规模和回归目标做选型。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Deconstructing Off-Policy Ratios: Entropy-Normalized Trust Regions for Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) accelerates large language model (LLM) post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but the resulting stale, off-policy data destabilizes optimization and can cause policy collapse. Existing methods gate tokens by ratio magnitude alone, applying one threshold at every position. We show that the ratio's natural scale is set by token entropy, so deviations from mid-trajectory weight updates stay within this scale and carry genuine exploration. We further identify an overlooked low-entropy regime that breaks this scaling, where a near-zero probability amplifies train--inference mismatch into noise far beyond what the local entropy admits. A magnitude threshold admits this noise and discards the exploration. We therefore propose the Entropy-Normalized Trust Region (ENTR). Across long-horizon agentic tasks and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ENTR outperforms existing asynchronous methods. It improves avg@1 on BrowseComp-Plus by $6.9\%$ over the strongest baseline, trains stably up to $30$ policy versions of staleness, and matches synchronous GRPO at a $2.6\times$ speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ENTR（Entropy-Normalized Trust Region）：token 的 off-policy ratio 天然尺度由词元熵决定，按熵归一化而非统一幅度阈值来门控，从而保留真正探索、剔除低熵区被 train–inference mismatch 放大的噪声。在长程 agentic 任务与数学推理基准上，BrowseComp-Plus avg@1 比最强基线高 6.9%，可稳定训练到 30 个 policy version 的 staleness，并以 2.6× 加速匹配同步 GRPO。
Motivation: 异步 RL 把 rollout 生成与策略优化重叠，但陈旧的 off-policy 数据会破坏优化甚至导致 policy collapse；现有方法只按 ratio 幅度、用单一阈值门控所有位置，既放过了低熵区的噪声，又丢掉了真正的探索。
Method: ENTR 先论证 ratio 的自然尺度由 token entropy 设定，再识别破坏该标度的低熵区（近零概率把 train–inference mismatch 放大成远超局部熵的噪声），据此按熵归一化构造 trust region 来门控 token，替代统一幅度阈值。
Result: 在长程 agentic 任务与数学推理基准上优于现有异步方法：BrowseComp-Plus avg@1 比最强基线提升 6.9%；可稳定训练至 30 个 policy version 的 staleness；以 2.6× 加速匹配同步 GRPO。
Conclusion: 按 token 熵归一化 off-policy ratio 的信任域，可以在容忍高 staleness 的同时保持稳定与探索，使异步训练达到同步 GRPO 的质量而快 2.6×。

papers.title: Scaling Native Multimodal Pre-Training From Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities, their reliance on text-only pre-training restricts the perception of the multimodal physical world. Native multimodal pre-training avoids this limitation by training models from scratch on multimodal inputs, thereby achieving deep cross-modal integration and mitigating optimization asymmetries inherent to traditional late-fusion architectures. Despite these advantages, the scaling properties of this paradigm remain incompletely characterized. To address this gap, we investigate the optimal model size and token count for training a Transformer-based vision-language model under a fixed computational budget. Our study demonstrates that minimal objective loss adheres to a predictable compute law, whereas compute-optimal model sizes and token counts scale as power laws. Notably, language and multimodal objectives manifest distinct allocation trends. The language allocation exponents lie in a similar range across the different data mixtures. The multimodal model-allocation exponent decreases modestly with the multimodal token ratio, indicating a relative shift toward token allocation. Additionally, our scaling analysis yields a budget-compensation rule. Specifically, an additional multimodal-token budget can offset the text-efficiency penalty caused by incorporating visual information into native multimodal pre-training under a fixed compute budget. Downstream evaluations further reveal that native multimodal pre-training is associated with improved spatial reasoning and multimodal few-shot learning. Generally, this empirical research establishes the essential groundwork for predictably scaling multimodal foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定算力预算下从零做原生多模态预训练 (native multimodal pre-training)，最小目标损失服从可预测的 compute law，而 compute-optimal 的模型规模与 token 数服从幂律；语言与多模态目标的分配指数不同，多模态分配指数随多模态 token 占比上升而小幅下降，即相对向 token 分配倾斜。作者据此给出预算补偿规则：额外的多模态 token 预算可以抵消在固定算力下引入视觉信息带来的文本效率损失。
Motivation: 纯文本预训练限制了模型对多模态物理世界的感知，而原生多模态从零预训练虽有跨模态深度融合的优势，其 scaling 性质此前刻画不完整，缺少固定算力下模型规模与 token 数的最优分配规律。
Method: 在固定计算预算下研究 Transformer 架构视觉-语言模型的最优模型规模与 token 数，拟合最小目标损失的 compute law 与 compute-optimal 规模/数据的幂律，并分别考察语言目标与多模态目标在不同数据混合、不同多模态 token 占比下的分配指数，再做下游评测。
Result: 最小目标损失服从可预测的 compute law；compute-optimal 模型规模与 token 数服从幂律。语言分配指数在不同数据混合下处于相近区间，多模态分配指数随多模态 token 占比 modest 下降。额外多模态 token 预算可抵消固定算力下引入视觉带来的文本效率惩罚。下游评测显示原生多模态预训练与更好的空间推理和多模态 few-shot 学习相关。
Conclusion: 原生多模态预训练的规模与数据分配可按幂律和预算补偿规则预测，多模态 token 占比越高越应把预算偏向 token 而非模型规模；该实证分析为可预测地扩展多模态基础模型奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Twoblock clustering trees with coskewness-based dimension reduction: recovering piecewise multivariate linear regimes
papers.abstract_en: The twoblock clustering tree (\tbtree) is introduced as a highly interpretable regression tree for multivariate responses. Twoblock trees are deterministic decision trees that have local multivariate linear models as their leaves and use dense or sparse twoblock dimension reduction as local leaf models and in the impurity. The resulting models are both computationally efficient and can be highly interpretable. The estimator's primary aim is an interpretable, regime-aligned piecewise-linear description of the data, with predictive competitiveness retained as a constraint through a split/leaf decoupling. Beyond proposing the decision tree estimator itself, this paper also introduces an estimator for the twoblock dimension reduced space based on maximizing coskewness, which facilitates identification of non-normal clusters in the data. The tree inherently produces a set of local linear models and is therefore apt to recover piecewise linear regimes, which is illustrated in a simulation. However, two real-world data examples illustrate that twoblock trees are also capable of modeling more complexly nonlinear dependencies and can perform on par with black-box modeling techniques, such as random forests. At each point, both the twoblock models that generate the splits, as well as the ones in the leaves, can be inspected and interpreted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 twoblock clustering tree (\tbtree)：确定性回归树，叶子是多元响应的局部线性模型，分裂与叶子都用 twoblock 降维，降维方向由最大化 coskewness 估计以识别非正态簇。分裂/叶子解耦把可解释性放在首位、预测竞争力作为约束；模拟中可恢复分段线性 regime，两个真实数据示例上与 random forest 等黑箱方法表现相当。
Motivation: 多元响应回归需要既能给出可解释、与 regime 对齐的分段线性描述，又不牺牲预测能力的树模型；同时数据中的非正态簇需要能被识别的降维方向。
Method: 构建确定性决策树 \tbtree：叶子为多元线性模型，分裂准则与叶子模型共用 dense 或 sparse twoblock 降维；用最大化 coskewness 的估计器求降维子空间以捕捉非正态结构；通过 split/leaf 解耦把预测竞争力作为约束保留。
Result: 模拟示例说明 twoblock tree 能恢复分段线性 regime；两个真实数据示例显示它可建模更复杂的非线性依赖，并与 random forest 这类黑箱建模技术表现相当 (on par)；分裂与叶子处的 twoblock 模型均可被检查与解释。
Conclusion: 以 coskewness 驱动的 twoblock 降维做分裂与叶子，可得到既可解释、又在预测上不输黑箱方法的分段线性多元回归树。

papers.title: OPERA: Object Perception Enhances Single-view 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Single-view 3D reconstruction is a challenging task in computer vision due to information missing from the single input image. Generative model-based approaches can produce plausible 3D objects from a single image, thanks to data-driven priors learnt from rich and large-scale datasets. However, plausible generation does not guarantee fidelity to the geometry and appearance of the particular input object. Inspired by object perception in human vision, we propose OPERA, a framework that guides multi-view diffusion sampling with pretrained perception models through lightweight alignment modules. These modules are trained independently while both the generative and perception models remain frozen, allowing multiple signals to be combined at inference without joint fusion training. We evaluate OPERA on two single-view 3D reconstruction baselines using subsets of Google Scanned Objects and OmniObject3D. On the primary baseline, combined guidance reduces mean Chamfer Distance by 30.4\% and 24.8\%, respectively, relative to unguided reconstruction. We also compare our method with recent image-to-3D models. We provide in-depth analyses of the design choices and their effects across datasets and backbones. Our project page is at https://opera-3d.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPERA 用预训练感知模型通过轻量对齐模块引导多视图扩散采样，把单视图 3D 重建从「生成合理物体」拉回到忠于输入物体的几何与外观。对齐模块独立训练、生成与感知模型均冻结，推理时可组合多信号而无需联合融合训练；在 Google Scanned Objects 与 OmniObject3D 子集上，主基线的组合引导使平均 Chamfer Distance 相对无引导分别下降 30.4% 与 24.8%。
Motivation: 生成式单视图 3D 重建靠大规模数据先验能产出合理物体，但不保证忠于输入物体的几何与外观，单图信息缺失使这一保真问题无解。
Method: 受人类视觉物体感知启发，用预训练感知模型经轻量对齐模块引导多视图扩散采样；对齐模块独立训练，生成模型与感知模型保持冻结，推理时组合多信号而无需联合融合训练。
Result: 在 Google Scanned Objects 与 OmniObject3D 子集上评测两个单视图 3D 重建基线：主基线上组合引导使平均 Chamfer Distance 相对无引导重建分别下降 30.4% 与 24.8%；并与近期 image-to-3D 模型做了比较，给出跨数据集与跨 backbone 的设计选择分析。
Conclusion: 冻结生成与感知模型、只训对齐模块的感知引导，可在不联合训练的前提下显著降低单视图 3D 重建的几何误差。

papers.title: DORS: Dynamic Attention Routing for Diffusion-based Object Removal in Dense Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Object removal aims to eliminate target objects specified by a mask while preserving visual consistency with the surrounding regions. Existing methods typically rely on contextual information from surrounding regions. However, in dense scenes where the surrounding regions contain instances visually similar to the removal target, such reliance often leads to semantic interference, resulting in incomplete removal. This problem arises from erroneous information propagation in the attention space, where masked queries tend to align with such instances due to global similarity matching in self-attention. To address this challenge, we propose a Diffusion-based Object Removal framework for dense Scenes, dubbed DORS, built upon a Dynamic Attention Routing mechanism comprising two complementary components: Instance-Filtered Attention (IFA), which suppresses misleading semantic information from similar instances through dynamically constructed mask-guided attention constraints, and Context-Guided Routing (CGR), which dynamically routes complementary scene information to maintain visual consistency. We further introduce DOR-Bench, a benchmark tailored for object removal in dense scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DORS outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly in reducing incomplete removal and duplicate artifacts. The code will be available at https://github.com/httang1224/DORS.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, to appear in ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DORS 用动态注意力路由 (Dynamic Attention Routing) 解决密集场景中扩散模型移除目标物体时被外观相似实例干扰、导致移除不完整的问题：Instance-Filtered Attention 用掩码引导的注意力约束压制相似实例的误导语义，Context-Guided Routing 动态引导场景上下文以保持视觉一致。作者另建 DOR-Bench 密集场景物体移除基准，实验显示 DORS 超过现有最先进方法，尤其减少移除不完整与重复伪影。
Motivation: 密集场景中待移除目标周围常有外观相似实例，现有方法依赖周边上下文会引发语义干扰，根因是自注意力中掩码查询因全局相似度匹配而错误对齐到这些实例，造成移除不完整。
Method: 构建基于扩散的 DORS 框架，核心是 Dynamic Attention Routing：Instance-Filtered Attention 通过动态构造的掩码引导注意力约束抑制相似实例的误导信息；Context-Guided Routing 动态路由互补场景信息以维持视觉一致性。同时提出面向密集场景物体移除的基准 DOR-Bench。
Result: 大量实验表明 DORS 优于最先进方法，尤其在减少移除不完整 (incomplete removal) 与重复伪影 (duplicate artifacts) 方面；代码发布于 github.com/httang1224/DORS。
Conclusion: 在密集场景中，把注意力空间里的相似实例干扰显式约束掉并主动路由场景上下文，是比单纯依赖周边区域更有效的物体移除路径；DOR-Bench 为该设定提供专用评测。

papers.title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in itself, and whether it is appropriate given the user's context. It also operates at the granularity of action categories rather than individual instances, producing routine interruptions that erode autonomy and train users to wave through the most consequential alerts. We reframe the problem as a per-instance three-way routing decision over {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE} and instantiate it with Safety Sentry, a lightweight guard model whose inference reduces to a single decoding call. A single decoding-time threshold lets one fixed checkpoint be re-positioned across deployments of differing risk tolerance without retraining. Safety Sentry outperforms a broad set of open-weight and frontier closed-source baselines on overall accuracy and safety-related recall, while controlling both directional error rates simultaneously.Code and data are available at https://github.com/safesentry/SAFETY-SENTRY
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 的二元安全守卫重构为逐实例三路路由 {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE}，由轻量守卫模型 Safety Sentry 用单次解码调用完成推理；单个解码时阈值可在不重训的前提下把同一 checkpoint 重新定位到不同风险容忍度的部署。在总体准确率与安全相关召回上优于一组开源与闭源前沿基线，同时控制两个方向的错误率。
Motivation: 二元守卫把「动作本身是否有害」与「在用户上下文下是否恰当」混为一谈，且按动作类别而非逐实例判定，造成例行打断、削弱用户自主性，反而让人对最关键的告警习惯性放行。
Method: 将安全判定重构为逐实例的三路路由 {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE}，由轻量守卫模型 Safety Sentry 实现，推理归结为一次解码调用；用单个解码时阈值在同一 checkpoint 上调节风险容忍度，无需重训。
Result: 在总体准确率 (overall accuracy) 与安全相关召回 (safety-related recall) 上优于广泛的开源权重与闭源前沿基线，同时把两个方向的错误率一起控制住；代码与数据发布于 github.com/safesentry/SAFETY-SENTRY。
Conclusion: 安全守卫应做逐实例的三路决策而非类别级二元判定，且风险容忍度应由解码时阈值而非重训来调节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Introducing Human-Centeredness in AI-Assisted Lexicography
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a human-centered artificial intelligence (HCAI) framework for AI-assisted lexicography. While generative AI offers significant opportunities to enhance lexicographic work, it also raises concerns regarding the future role of lexicographers and the preservation of linguistic and cultural diversity. Drawing on HCAI principles and previous applications in other language professions, the paper identifies four interrelated dimensions through which AI integration in lexicography can be understood and critically examined: the augmented lexicographer, the sociotechnical context of AI integration, bias, and the design of AI-powered lexicographic tools. The framework argues that AI should augment rather than replace lexicographers, combining automation with meaningful human control. It further emphasizes the importance of preserving professional agency, mitigating AI-generated biases, and designing tools around the needs of lexicographers. By doing so, the paper provides a foundation for future research and the beneficial integration of AI into lexicographic workflows.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the XXII EURALEX International Congress 2026. Austrian Academy of Sciences, Vienna (2026), pp. 203-216
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 AI 辅助词典编纂 (AI-assisted lexicography) 的以人为中心 AI (HCAI) 框架，从四个相互关联的维度审视生成式 AI 进入词典学：被增强的词典编纂者、AI 融合的社会技术情境、偏见、以及 AI 驱动词典工具的设计。核心主张是 AI 应当增强而非取代词典编纂者，把自动化与有意义的人类控制结合起来。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 给词典编纂带来机会，同时也引发对词典编纂者职业未来以及语言文化多样性能否保存的担忧，缺少一个可用来系统批判审视 AI 融合的分析框架。
Method: 以 HCAI 原则为基础，借鉴其他语言类职业中已有的应用经验，归纳出四个维度：被增强的词典编纂者、AI 融合的社会技术情境、偏见、AI 词典工具设计；并据此论证自动化须与有意义的人类控制结合。
Result: 提出一个含四个相互关联维度的 HCAI 框架，主张 AI 应增强而非取代词典编纂者，强调维护职业主体性、缓解 AI 生成偏见、围绕词典编纂者需求设计工具；为概念性框架论文，摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: AI 进入词典学工作流的前提是保留词典编纂者的控制权与职业主体性，并在工具设计阶段就围绕其需求与偏见缓解来安排。

papers.title: Beyond Euclidean Clipping: Overcoming Exploration Collapse in LLM RL via Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. However, RL algorithms with PPO-Clip are inherently limited by exploration collapse. Subsequent works remain primarily heuristic and fail to identify the essential cause of PPO-Clip's failure. This work reveals the fundamental flaw of PPO-Clip: it implicitly measures policy discrepancy using Euclidean metric, which is theoretically inconsistent with the intrinsic geometry on the policy Riemannian manifold. This geometric mismatch results in overly conservative updates in low-probability regions while aggressive in high-probability regions, ultimately collapsing exploration. To correct this geometric flaw, we propose Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization (RIPO), which guarantees isometric policy updates on the Riemannian manifold, effectively balancing exploration and exploitation. We further show that RIPO achieves a favorable bias-variance trade-off, which stabilizes optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RIPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across seven competition-level benchmarks (up to 60% improvement over GRPO on AIME24).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIPO 指出 PPO-Clip 用欧氏度量衡量策略差异，与策略 Riemannian 流形的内在几何不一致，导致低概率区更新过保守、高概率区过激进，最终使探索坍缩。提出的 Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization (RIPO) 保证流形上的等距策略更新并取得有利的偏差-方差权衡，在 7 个竞赛级基准上显著超过现有 LLM RL 算法，AIME24 上较 GRPO 最高提升 60%。
Motivation: PPO-Clip 类 LLM 强化学习算法存在探索坍缩，后续工作多为启发式修补，未指出其失败的根本原因。
Method: RIPO 将策略差异的度量从欧氏度量改为策略 Riemannian 流形上的等距更新，使探索与利用平衡，并给出有利的 bias-variance 权衡以稳定优化。
Result: 在 7 个竞赛级基准 (competition-level benchmarks) 上显著超过现有 LLM RL 算法，AIME24 上较 GRPO 最高提升 60%。
Conclusion: PPO-Clip 的探索坍缩源于欧氏度量与策略流形几何的不匹配，改用等距策略更新可同时改善探索与优化稳定性。

papers.title: System-Prompt Conditioning and Hidden-State Geometry in Four Open-Weight Models: Corrections and What Survives
papers.abstract_en: Versions 1 and 2 of this preprint reported that an identity-specifying system prompt leaves a geometric fingerprint in the final-layer hidden-state trajectories of four open-weight language models, and that instruction tuning moves this fingerprint from the direction to the magnitude of the hidden-state vector. An audit of their code and data found the following. The curvature statistic described as Ollivier-Ricci curvature on Euclidean k-NN graphs was a non-standard Forman-type edge statistic on graphs built from temporal and cosine k-NN edges. Its released test permuted pooled edges instead of trajectories, and the published p-values came from unreleased code. The quantity reported as the norm of the first generated state is the state at the last prompt position, from which the first output token is predicted. The generic control prompt was matched to the identity prompt in characters, not in tokens. This version corrects the methods, withdraws the regime-specific claims (one model per regime) and the direction-to-magnitude claim, and re-analyzes the data with added controls. What survives is narrower. Centroid distance, maximum mean discrepancy and a linear probe separate every pair of prompt conditions in every model, while the curvature statistic exceeds its split-half noise floor in only four of twelve comparisons. In Gemma-4-E4B-it this state has a lower norm under the identity prompt than under a token-length-matched generic prompt (138.1 vs. 216.5; Cohen's d = -5.45; n = 20). Its direction also separates the conditions, and the effect fits the state's role in planning the output: the identity prompt instructs a pause before every answer, and the model opens 98 of 100 responses with a pause marker. When the first token is fixed, the norm ordering reverses. The base model continues the prompt template instead of answering. A redesigned follow-up study is in preparation.
papers.comment: v3: substantial correction, replaces v1-v2. The curvature reported as Ollivier-Ricci was a Forman-type statistic on temporal plus cosine k-NN graphs, tested at edge level. The regime-specific and direction-to-magnitude claims are withdrawn. Added: simple-baseline, split-half, trajectory-level and token-length-matched controls. 14 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇对四开放权重语言模型系统提示几何指纹预印本的自我更正：原报告的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率实为时间+余弦 k-NN 图上的 Forman 型边统计量，置换检验错在池化边而非轨迹，方向转幅度的说法被撤回。重分析后存活的结论收窄为质心距离、MMD 与线性探针可在每个模型中区分全部提示条件，而曲率统计量仅 12 组比较中 4 组超过 split-half 噪声底。
Motivation: v1-v2 声称身份提示在末层隐状态轨迹留下几何指纹且指令微调把指纹从方向移到幅度，但代码与数据审计发现统计量命名错误、置换单位错误、p 值来自未发布代码，原结论不可靠。
Method: 更正版本修正方法描述，撤回 regime-specific（每 regime 仅一个模型）与方向转幅度结论，重新分析数据并新增四类对照：简单基线、split-half、轨迹级置换、token 长度匹配的通用提示。
Result: 质心距离、最大均值差异 (MMD) 与线性探针在每个模型中区分每一对提示条件；曲率统计量仅 12 组比较中 4 组超过 split-half 噪声底。Gemma-4-E4B-it 在身份提示下首状态范数低于 token 长度匹配的通用提示（138.1 vs 216.5，Cohen's d = -5.45，n = 20），方向同样可分；身份提示要求每次回答前停顿，模型 100 次回答中 98 次以停顿标记开头；固定首 token 后范数排序反转，base 模型续写提示模板而非作答。
Conclusion: 存活的证据只支持提示条件在隐状态几何上可分这一窄结论，曲率与方向转幅度的强主张不成立；作者正在准备重新设计的后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Group Invariant Spectral Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Spectral embedding methods are widely used for dimensionality reduction and clustering of high-dimensional datasets with intrinsic low-dimensional structures. Although many datasets of practical interest exhibit invariance under symmetries such as rotations, standard spectral embedding methods do not account for this, treating symmetry-related data points as unrelated. Our approach to this problem is to incorporate the symmetries directly into the affinity kernels used for spectral embedding. We analyze the case of a Riemannian data manifold $M$ with symmetries given by a compact Lie group~$G$ and prove that, under suitable conditions, graph Laplacians constructed from three types of invariant kernels converge pointwise to explicit second-order differential operators on the quotient space $M/G$. Our analysis implies improved convergence rates, as the effective dimension drops according to the dimension of the group. We validate our approach on datasets with $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ or $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ symmetry, and show that $G$-invariant spectral embedding recovers the intrinsic geometry of the data, in contrast to standard spectral embedding, which fails to do so even in the limit of infinite data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把数据的对称性（紧李群 G）直接写进谱嵌入的 affinity kernel，使图拉普拉斯在商空间 M/G 上收敛到显式二阶微分算子，有效维数按群维数下降，从而改善收敛速率。在含 SO(2) 或 SO(3) 对称的数据集上，G-不变谱嵌入能恢复数据的内在几何，而标准谱嵌入即使在无限数据极限下也失败。
Motivation: 许多高维数据具有旋转等对称性，但标准谱嵌入把对称相关的点当作互不相关处理，浪费了对称结构，导致无法恢复内在几何。
Method: 将对称性并入谱嵌入的 affinity kernel，构造三类 G-不变核；在具有紧李群 G 对称的黎曼数据流形 M 上，证明相应图拉普拉斯逐点收敛到商空间 M/G 上的显式二阶微分算子。
Result: 理论上证明三类不变核的图拉普拉斯在适当条件下逐点收敛到 M/G 上的显式二阶微分算子，并推出更优的收敛速率（有效维数按群维数降低）；在 SO(2) 与 SO(3) 对称数据集上验证，G-不变谱嵌入恢复内在几何，标准谱嵌入即使在无限数据极限下也失败。
Conclusion: 把已知对称性编码进谱嵌入的核，可在商空间上恢复数据内在几何并提升收敛速率，而忽略对称性的标准方法在数据量趋于无穷时仍无法做到。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Directly Optimizing Mean Demographic Parity for Nonlinear Regression
papers.abstract_en: We focus on regression settings where the fairness goal is to equalize average predictions across values of a sensitive attribute, a criterion known as mean demographic parity. Directly optimizing this criterion is difficult because it depends on a conditional mean that is unknown and changes during training. Common dependence penalties and adversarial methods do not estimate this conditional mean; instead, they push predictions toward full independence. This stronger constraint can reduce accuracy even when average predictions are already equal. Existing conditional-mean methods are limited to linear predictors or low-dimensional sensitive attributes. We enable direct optimization of mean demographic parity using DPVar, a fairness measure defined as the variance of the conditional mean prediction. Because the conditional mean must be estimated as the predictor changes, optimizing DPVar leads to a functional bilevel problem. We develop two solvers: FBO, which uses a closed-form hypergradient, and an iterative-differentiation (ITD) solver that differentiates through updates of the conditional-mean estimator. Unlike previous conditional-mean methods, our approach applies to nonlinear predictors and high-dimensional continuous sensitive attributes. Across a semi-synthetic benchmark built from 21 tabular regression datasets and Communities & Crime data, FBO and ITD recover competitive or better accuracy-DPVar trade-offs than existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DPVar（条件均值预测的方差）作为 mean demographic parity 的直接目标，并把它写成泛函双层优化，用闭式超梯度求解器 FBO 与迭代微分求解器 ITD 直接优化。在由 21 个表格回归数据集与 Communities & Crime 构成的半合成基准上，FBO 与 ITD 得到竞争力或更优的 accuracy-DPVar 权衡，且适用于非线性预测器与高维连续敏感属性。
Motivation: mean demographic parity 依赖未知且随训练变化的条件均值，直接优化困难；常用依赖惩罚与对抗方法推向更强的完全独立约束，在平均预测已相等时仍会损失精度，而现有条件均值方法局限于线性预测器或低维敏感属性。
Method: 定义公平性度量 DPVar 为条件均值预测的方差，将其优化表述为泛函双层问题 (functional bilevel problem)；求解器 FBO 使用闭式超梯度 (closed-form hypergradient)，ITD 则对条件均值估计器的更新过程做迭代微分 (iterative differentiation)。
Result: 在由 21 个表格回归数据集构建的半合成基准与 Communities & Crime 数据上，FBO 与 ITD 恢复出相对现有方法竞争力或更优的 accuracy-DPVar 权衡。
Conclusion: mean demographic parity 可以通过条件均值方差被直接优化，且该框架突破了既有条件均值方法只支持线性预测器或低维敏感属性的限制，覆盖非线性预测器与高维连续敏感属性。

papers.title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
papers.abstract_en: Decision-time planning with action-conditioned world models has become a popular paradigm for embodied control. However, the standard planning cost judges a candidate solely by how close its predicted terminal state lies to the goal, leaving the realizability of the intermediate transitions unchecked--a predicted trajectory can look convincing while the environment rollout drifts away from it. In this paper, we propose ACID, a decision-time planning framework that introduces cycle action consistency: the action inferred backward from a predicted transition by an inverse dynamics model should recover the one that was conditioned on. We fold this per-step residual into the planning cost via a scale-invariant adaptive weight. Across four action-conditioned world models and eight tasks encompassing object manipulation and articulated control in simulation, visual navigation, and real-robot manipulation, ACID consistently improves planning and matches the baseline's accuracy with substantially less planning compute.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 标准规划代价只看预测终态与目标的接近程度，不检查中间转移是否可实现：预测轨迹看起来合理，实际环境 rollout 却会偏离它。
Method: 提出 ACID：以逆动力学模型从预测转移反推动作，与生成该转移的条件动作比对，得到逐步 cycle action consistency 残差；用尺度不变的自适应权重把该残差折入决策时规划代价。
Result: 在 4 个动作条件世界模型、8 个任务（仿真物体操作与铰接控制、视觉导航、真机操作）上一致改善规划，并以 substantially less planning compute 达到基线精度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把逆动力学一致性作为可实现性约束加入规划代价，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下降低决策时规划的算力开销。

papers.title: Koopman operator theory: fundamentals, control, and applications
papers.abstract_en: The Koopman operator has gained considerable attention due to its ability to provide a global linear representation of highly complex dynamical systems. The operator describes nonlinear dynamics in a linear way through the lens of real- or complex-valued observable functions. Data-driven techniques, like extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD), kernel EDMD, and machine-learning methods, can be used to generate finite-dimensional approximations accompanied by finite-data error bounds. In this tutorial paper, we provide a concise introduction into Koopman operator theory and its use in systems and control. A particular focus is put on data-driven surrogate models, their extension to systems with inputs, and controller design using Koopman operator theory. Moreover, we demonstrate the key techniques, i.e., EDMD and Koopman MPC. To this end, we provide simulation studies including source code on GitHub to enable the interested reader to experience the Koopman operator in systems and control step by step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 Koopman 算子理论教程，讲如何用实值或复值可观测函数把非线性动力系统写成全局线性表示，并用 EDMD、kernel EDMD 与机器学习方法得到带有限数据误差界的有限维近似。重点落在带输入系统的数据驱动代理模型与基于 Koopman 的 MPC 控制器设计，并附 GitHub 源码的逐步仿真演示。
Motivation: 非线性动力系统的全局线性表示长期缺失，控制设计（尤其 MPC）只能依赖局部线性化或直接处理非线性模型，数据驱动近似又缺少误差保证。
Method: 教程给出 Koopman 算子理论基础，用 EDMD 与 kernel EDMD 及机器学习方法构造有限维近似并给出有限数据误差界；扩展到带输入系统，再做 Koopman MPC 控制器设计，配 GitHub 源码的仿真研究。
Result: 提出并演示 EDMD 与 Koopman MPC 两项关键技术，配套含源码的仿真研究供读者逐步复现；摘要给出的是教程性内容组织而非基准对比数字。
Conclusion: Koopman 算子可作为非线性系统数据驱动建模与控制的统一框架，教程目标是让读者在系统与控制场景中逐步上手。

papers.title: Reward Observability and the Limits of Offline Checkpoint Selection in RSSM World Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the closed-loop properties of a recurrent state-space model (RSSM) world model trained on human demonstrations in Gymnasium's LunarLander-v3. We use the trained world model for zero-shot CEM model-predictive control (MPC) and for actor-critic (A2C) training in imagination. Scored on 100 held-out episodes, the selected model-based A2C policy (trained on world-model checkpoint 280) reaches a mean return of +189.5, matching the best model-free A2C checkpoint (+183.7; 600- and 1000-step episode caps respectively) with ~65x fewer real training transitions. We also compare world-model MPC with a behaviour-cloning (BC) policy trained on the successful demonstrations. The BC policy matches MPC's mean return only under stochastic action selection, and on the same 20 episodes it has one catastrophic episode where MPC has none. We then introduce the Reward Observability Fraction (ROF), the Euclidean fraction of the reward gradient in the observable subspace of the linearized latent dynamics, and show that the next H observations carry Fisher information about every direction in this subspace and none about directions orthogonal to it. ROF itself however depends on how the latent is scaled: rescaling it changes ROF but not the model, so raw levels are not comparable across models. Forcing the reward head onto the posterior-corrected latent z raises ROF, and the rise survives a coordinate-invariant check on the pair of runs we tested. Finally, we test whether ROF or other offline metrics can predict the closed-loop collapse of MPC. Collapse varies between training runs with identical data and configuration. ROF does not predict it, none of the 108 offline summaries we screened passes a permutation test, and the best candidate fails on new runs. Predicting collapse offline from the model and logged data alone remains open.
papers.comment: Preprint, 22 pages (17 main text + 5 pages appendix), 4 figures, 9 tables. Video: https://youtu.be/BlRAI2hdKDs , Code: https://github.com/nsmoly/LunarLander_RSSM and https://github.com/jonstraveladventures/rof-reproduction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LunarLander-v3 上用人类演示训练 RSSM 世界模型，提出 Reward Observability Fraction (ROF)——奖励梯度在可线性化潜变量动力学可观测子空间中的欧氏占比——并检验它能否离线预测 MPC 闭环崩溃。ROF 本身随潜变量缩放而变、跨模型不可比；把奖励头强制到 posterior-corrected latent z 上会抬高 ROF。筛选的 108 个离线摘要指标无一通过 permutation test，ROF 也不预测崩溃，仅凭模型与日志数据离线预测闭环崩溃仍是开放问题。
Motivation: 世界模型的离线指标与闭环表现之间缺少可靠对应：MPC 在相同数据与配置的不同训练 run 间会随机崩溃，而部署前只能拿到模型与日志数据，无法在线试跑。
Method: 在 Gymnasium LunarLander-v3 的人类演示上训练 RSSM 世界模型，用于 zero-shot CEM 模型预测控制 (MPC) 与 imagination 中的 A2C 训练；定义 ROF 为奖励梯度在可观测子空间的欧氏占比，并用 Fisher 信息论证 H 步观测只携带该子空间方向的信息；把奖励头改接到 posterior-corrected latent z；对 108 个离线摘要指标做 permutation test。
Result: 100 个 held-out episodes 上，选定的 model-based A2C 策略（世界模型 checkpoint 280）平均回报 +189.5，与最佳 model-free A2C checkpoint 的 +183.7 相当（episode 上限分别为 600 与 1000 步），真实训练 transition 少约 65 倍。BC 策略仅在随机动作选择下才追平 MPC 的平均回报，且在同样 20 个 episode 中有 1 次灾难性失败而 MPC 为 0 次。108 个离线摘要指标无一通过 permutation test，最佳候选在新 run 上失效。
Conclusion: ROF 及同类离线指标目前无法预测 MPC 闭环崩溃，从模型与日志数据离线判定世界模型可用性仍是开放问题；但世界模型 A2C 可用约 65 倍更少的真实交互匹配 model-free A2C 的回报。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Stratified Multi-View Aggregation for Score Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Score distillation turns a pretrained 2D diffusion model into a 3D generator, but the per-step gradient is estimated from a single random view: this one-sample estimate has high variance (different views of the same partial scene disagree) and is blind to global shape consistency. Existing multi-view approaches address this by retraining the diffusion prior on multi-view data; this improves consistency but conflates the sampling contribution with the quality of the retrained prior. We instead isolate the sampling axis, leaving the prior frozen. We introduce Multi-View Aggregated Score Distillation (MV-SDI), a training-free sampler that replaces the single-view per-step gradient with an average over K views at a fixed UNet-call budget. Averaging K views lowers the per-step gradient variance toward 1/K of its single-view value. Drawing the K views as antithetic antipodal pairs adds no further variance reduction (measured antipodal correlation rho approximately 0) but stratifies angular coverage (every step covers both hemispheres) removing the same-hemisphere clustering of independent sampling. At a fixed 10,000-UNet-call budget on the 43-prompt SDI benchmark, K=2 halves the optimization steps and raises CLIP R-Precision from 74.8% to 83.8% and CLIP score from 0.297 to 0.312 over the single-view SDI baseline, with consistent gains on HPSv2 and ImageReward and a 0.0% divergence rate. K=4 gives a fourfold step reduction at R-Precision 86.9% and CLIP 0.307. The gains concentrate on hard prompts where single-view distillation collapses, at a measured cost in CLIP-IQA. MV-SDI is drop-in for gradient-based score-distillation pipelines, including Score Distillation via Inversion and plain SDS, and requires no retraining and no multi-view data. Code is available at: https://github.com/marianlupascu/MV-SDI
papers.comment: 31 pages, 17 figures. Submitted to EUROGRAPHICS 2027 (Computer Graphics Forum)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MV-SDI 把 score distillation 的单视角单样本梯度换成固定 UNet 调用预算下的 K 视角平均，先验保持冻结、无需重训。K 视角平均把每步梯度方差压到单视角的 1/K；对跖对偶采样不额外降方差（实测 rho≈0），但让每步覆盖两个半球，消除同半球聚集。在 43-prompt SDI 基准、10,000 次 UNet 调用预算下，K=2 使优化步数减半，CLIP R-Precision 从 74.8% 升到 83.8%，CLIP score 从 0.297 升到 0.312，发散率 0.0%。
Motivation: Score distillation 每步梯度只从一个随机视角估计，方差高且对全局形状一致性盲视；现有多视角方法靠在多视角数据上重训扩散先验，把采样贡献与重训先验的质量混在一起，无法单独回答采样轴的收益。
Method: 提出 Multi-View Aggregated Score Distillation (MV-SDI)，一个 training-free 采样器：冻结先验，用固定 UNet 调用预算下 K 个视角的梯度平均替代单视角梯度；视角按对跖对偶 (antithetic antipodal) 成对抽取以做角度分层。可直接接入 Score Distillation via Inversion 与 plain SDS 等基于梯度的 distillation 流程，无需重训、无需多视角数据。
Result: 在 43-prompt SDI 基准、固定 10,000 次 UNet 调用预算下，K=2 使优化步数减半，CLIP R-Precision 从 74.8% 提到 83.8%，CLIP score 从 0.297 提到 0.312，HPSv2 与 ImageReward 上收益一致，发散率 0.0%；K=4 步数降为四分之一，R-Precision 86.9%、CLIP 0.307。收益集中在单视角 distillation 会崩溃的难 prompt 上，代价是 CLIP-IQA 下降；实测对跖相关 rho 约为 0。
Conclusion: 在冻结先验的前提下，视角聚合本身就能同时降方差、减步数并抬高文本对齐质量，无需重训先验或多视角数据；代价是图像质量指标 CLIP-IQA 有损失，收益主要来自难 prompt。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A samplewise backpropagation method for neural networks driven by fractional Brownian motion
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a fractional stochastic neural network with residual dynamics driven by fractional Brownian motion. By introducing a discrete stochastic maximum principle for the network, we construct the corresponding adjoint recursion. For deterministic network parameters, we prove mean square convergence of projected samplewise stochastic gradient descent. Numerical experiments include a closed form convergence test, noisy regression with uncertainty quantification, long memory time series generation and image classification under structured perturbations. The results identify settings in which fractional drivers improve long memory recovery or robustness relative to Brownian and deterministic baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由分数布朗运动 (fractional Brownian motion) 驱动残差动力学的分数阶随机神经网络，并用离散随机最大值原理构造伴随递归 (adjoint recursion)，据此给出逐样本随机梯度下降 (samplewise SGD) 的均方收敛证明。数值实验覆盖闭式收敛检验、含不确定性量化的含噪回归、长时间序列生成与结构扰动下的图像分类，结果显示在部分设定中分数驱动相对 Brownian 与确定性基线改善长记忆恢复或鲁棒性。
Motivation: 标准随机梯度方法以 Brownian 驱动，缺少长记忆结构，且网络的随机最优控制缺少对应的离散伴随与收敛刻画。
Method: 构建由分数布朗运动驱动残差动力学的分数阶随机神经网络；引入离散随机最大值原理并导出伴随递归；在确定性网络参数条件下证明投影式 samplewise SGD 的均方收敛。
Result: 数值实验含四类：闭式收敛检验、带不确定性量化的含噪回归、长时间序列生成、结构扰动下的图像分类；结果指出在部分设定中分数驱动相对 Brownian 与确定性基线改善长记忆恢复或鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 分数布朗驱动可作为随机神经网络的长记忆与鲁棒性来源，其 samplewise SGD 在确定性参数下有均方收敛保证。

summary_sections.method: 构建由分数布朗运动驱动残差动力学的分数阶随机神经网络；引入离散随机最大值原理并导出伴随递归；在确定性网络参数条件下证明投影式 samplewise SGD 的均方收敛。
summary_sections.result: 数值实验含四类：闭式收敛检验、带不确定性量化的含噪回归、长时间序列生成、结构扰动下的图像分类；结果指出在部分设定中分数驱动相对 Brownian 与确定性基线改善长记忆恢复或鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分数布朗驱动可作为随机神经网络的长记忆与鲁棒性来源，其 samplewise SGD 在确定性参数下有均方收敛保证。

papers.title: What Transfers from Text to Vision? Capability Scaling Laws and Transfer Dynamics for VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Choosing the right large language model (LLM) backbone is the most consequential decision when building a vision-language model (VLM), yet it remains fundamentally unprincipled: compute-based scaling laws fail to generalize across model families, and no framework exists for directly predicting VLM performance before training begins. We propose the Capability-Driven Multimodal Scaling Law, the first cross-family framework that predicts VLM benchmark accuracy from directly observable textual capability. Given a low-dimensional capability score $S$ extracted from LLM textual benchmarks via PCA, we model VLM performance as a function of $S$, with a per-backbone transfer rate and an absorption rate that quantifies data-scaling efficiency. To fit and validate the framework, we train over 150 VLMs on 34 LLMs spanning 7 model families under a strictly controlled recipe. Evaluations on more than 200 textual and 50 multimodal benchmarks show that the law accurately extrapolates transfer rate from models up to 8B parameters to 72B-scale backbones, predicts full VLM training trajectories with high fidelity, and generalizes to entirely held-out model families. Beyond the scaling law, our analysis surfaces actionable insights: certain textual benchmarks negatively correlate with multimodal performance, exposing latent benchmark-gaming behavior; base LLMs outperform instruction-tuned counterparts as VLM backbones due to higher absorption rates and lower data-scaling decay; and different model families occupy distinct positions in the transfer--absorption space. The framework turns backbone selection from costly empirical sweeps into a principled, quantitative decision. Code and data are available at https://github.com/wangq-dev/CDMScaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出能力驱动多模态缩放律 (Capability-Driven Multimodal Scaling Law)：用 PCA 从 LLM 文本基准提取低维能力分数 S，配合每骨干的迁移率与吸收率预测 VLM 基准准确率。在 34 个 LLM、7 个模型家族上训练 150+ 个 VLM 后，该律可把 8B 以下模型的迁移率外推到 72B 骨干，并外推到完全留出的模型家族；文本基准与多模态性能负相关暴露 benchmark-gaming，base LLM 因吸收率更高、数据缩放衰减更低而优于 instruction-tuned 骨干。
Motivation: 选 LLM 骨干是构建 VLM 最关键却最无原则的决定：基于算力的缩放律跨模型家族不泛化，且没有框架能在训练开始前直接预测 VLM 性能。
Method: 从 LLM 文本基准分数经 PCA 提取低维能力分数 S，把 VLM 性能建模为 S 的函数，含每骨干的迁移率 (transfer rate) 与刻画数据缩放效率的吸收率 (absorption rate)；在严格受控配方下用 34 个 LLM、7 个模型家族训练 150 多个 VLM 来拟合与验证。
Result: 评测覆盖 200 多个文本基准与 50 多个多模态基准：迁移率可从 8B 以下参数模型外推到 72B 级骨干，能高保真预测完整 VLM 训练轨迹，并泛化到完全留出的模型家族；分析发现部分文本基准与多模态性能负相关，base LLM 作为骨干优于 instruction-tuned 版本（吸收率更高、数据缩放衰减更低），不同模型家族在迁移—吸收空间占据不同位置。
Conclusion: VLM 骨干选择可由可直接观测的文本能力分数定量预测，从昂贵的经验扫掠变成有原则的量化决策；部分文本基准的负相关说明存在潜在的 benchmark-gaming 行为。

papers.title: The Red Queen Gödel Machine: Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving agents are state-of-the-art on agentic coding benchmarks, yet their search methods assume a stationary evaluation criterion. This ignores a central feature of evolution: species adapt as their environments change with them. We introduce the Red Queen Gödel Machine (RQGM), an evolutionary framework for recursive self-improvement under non-stationary utilities. This allows learned evaluators to improve alongside the agents they guide. On DeepSWE, the RQGM improves over its fixed-evaluator baseline by adding a complementary agent-as-a-judge code-review signal: a co-evolved reviewer grades coder patches to guide search. At low reasoning effort, the RQGM coder passes 82.1% of held-out tasks against the baseline's 75.0%, and nearly matches the GPT-6 Astra model at high effort. In scientific paper writing and reviewing, and Olympiad-level proof writing and grading, co-evolved evaluators provide an evaluation criterion. Anchored to human IMO grades, a co-evolved grader writes its own milestone rubric and exceeds static baselines at a 3x lower search cost, driving the prover to the best mean score. Since the RQGM can modify the search objective across epochs, it can regularize the search. For example, the RQGM reduces self-preference bias via an additional adversarial objective to discover reviewers equally stringent on AI and human work. Guided by these calibrated reviewers, co-evolved writers reach 1.78x-1.86x higher acceptance rates than the baseline under an agent-as-a-judge panel. The RQGM enables self-improving systems where agents and evaluators recursively bootstrap each other beyond static evaluation.
papers.comment: 9 pages main text + 31 pages appendix (40 pages total, incl. references); Preliminary preprint; work in progress. Keywords: self-improving agents, learned evaluation, multi-agent systems, auto-mated scientific discovery, controlled utility evolution, co-evolutionary search, autoresearch
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Red Queen Gödel Machine (RQGM)：在非平稳效用下让智能体与评价器共同演化，评价器（agent-as-a-judge 代码评审、论文评审、证明评分）随被引导的智能体一起改进。DeepSWE 上低推理预算时 coder 通过率 82.1% 对基线 75.0%，并以 3 倍低搜索成本超过静态评分基线。
Motivation: 自我改进智能体在 agentic coding 基准上已达 SOTA，但其搜索方法假设评价标准静止，忽略了演化中环境与物种共同变化这一核心特征。
Method: RQGM 是面向非平稳效用的演化式递归自我改进框架：共演化的 reviewer 对 coder patch 打分以引导搜索；评价目标可跨 epoch 修改，从而正则化搜索，并加入对抗目标抑制 self-preference bias，使评审对 AI 与人类工作同等严格。
Result: DeepSWE 上低推理预算时 RQGM coder 通过 82.1% 的 held-out 任务，基线 75.0%，并接近高预算下的 GPT-6 Astra；锚定人类 IMO 分数的共演 grader 自写 milestone rubric，以 3 倍低搜索成本超过静态基线并取得最高平均分；在 agent-as-a-judge 评审团下，共演 writer 的接收率比基线高 1.78x–1.86x。
Conclusion: 评价标准本身应作为搜索的一部分被共同演化：智能体与评价器可互相递归自举，超越静态评价，并借此通过对抗目标校准评审偏差。

papers.title: Minimax PAC Bounds for Learning in Exogenous Contextual MDPs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a PAC framework in which the learner can access sampling oracles both before and at decision time. Sample complexity is measured by a pair $(n,m)$, where $n$ is the learning budget spent before a query is known and $m$ is the additional sampling budget per query. We demonstrate its relevance in discounted Markov decision processes with exogenous i.i.d.\ contexts revealed before acting. Contexts may affect both rewards and transitions but remain uncontrolled by the agent. The learner can sample the unknown context distribution and the transition kernel. We study policy evaluation (PE), best-value estimation (BVE), and best-policy extraction (BPE). When rewards and transitions are known, a variance-reduced algorithm solves all three tasks with sample complexity $\bigl(\widetilde O((1-γ)^{-3}\varepsilon^{-2}),0\bigr)$, which is minimax optimal up to logarithmic factors. Let $\mathcal{X}$ be the controlled state space. When transitions are also unknown, we give a PE algorithm with complexity $\bigl(\widetilde O(|\mathcal X|(1-γ)^{-3}\varepsilon^{-2}), \widetilde O((1-γ)^{-2}\varepsilon^{-2})\bigr)$ and matching lower bounds at this budget pair. For BVE and BPE, we give an algorithm with a common offline budget $\widetilde O(|\mathcal X|^2|\mathcal A|(1-γ)^{-4}\varepsilon^{-2})$ and respective query costs $\widetilde O(|\mathcal A|(1-γ)^{-2}\varepsilon^{-2})$ and $\widetilde O(|\mathcal A|(1-γ)^{-3}\varepsilon^{-2})$. Importantly, all bounds are independent of the context-space cardinality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带外生 i.i.d. 上下文的 MDP 中提出双预算 PAC 框架：学习前总预算 n 与每次查询时的追加采样预算 m 分开计量，上下文在行动前揭示且不可控。已知奖励与转移时方差缩减算法以 (Õ((1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2}), 0) 解决 PE/BVE/BPE 且 minimax 最优；转移未知时 PE 达到 (Õ(|X|(1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2}), Õ((1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2})) 并有匹配下界，全部界与上下文空间基数无关。
Motivation: 标准 PAC 分析只给单一学习预算，无法刻画决策时还能按查询追加采样的场景；外生上下文 MDP 中上下文影响奖励与转移却不可控，需要区分离线预算与在线查询开销并给出 minimax 判定。
Method: 定义以 (n,m) 计量的 PAC 框架，学习者可在学习前与查询时访问上下文分布与转移核的采样 oracle；针对策略评估 (PE)、最优值估计 (BVE)、最优策略提取 (BPE) 分别设计方差缩减算法，并配以下界证明。
Result: 已知奖励与转移：三任务复杂度 (Õ((1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2}), 0)，除对数因子外 minimax 最优。转移未知：PE 为 (Õ(|X|(1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2}), Õ((1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2})) 且该预算对有匹配下界；BVE 与 BPE 共用离线预算 Õ(|X|^2|A|(1-γ)^{-4}ε^{-2})，查询开销分别为 Õ(|A|(1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2}) 与 Õ(|A|(1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2})。所有界均不依赖上下文空间基数。
Conclusion: 把决策时追加采样单列为预算 m，可在不付出上下文空间基数代价的前提下对 exogenous contextual MDP 的三类任务给出 minimax 紧的样本复杂度刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Conjugate Aggregation: Identifiable Unsupervised Multi-Sensor Regression under Heterogeneous Sensor Bias
papers.abstract_en: We study regression-based data fusion under uncertainty, where multiple noisy and biased measurement sources are available but ground-truth labels are absent during training. This setting arises in sensor networks, simulation ensembles, and scientific monitoring systems where supervision is costly or infeasible. We propose the Neural Conjugate Aggregation Model (NCAM), a hierarchical Bayesian framework that combines neural networks with conjugate Gaussian inference for unsupervised multi-source fusion. NCAM learns source-specific bias and reliability conditioned on contextual covariates, yielding an analytically tractable posterior over a latent target variable with decomposed epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. Structural non-identifiability is resolved through sensor anchoring and variance regularization, enabling stable and interpretable posterior aggregation. To complement Bayesian uncertainty with finite-sample guarantees, we integrate locally adaptive Monte Carlo conformal prediction, producing heteroscedastic prediction intervals with coverage guarantees under exchangeability assumptions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world air-quality datasets demonstrate improved predictive accuracy and well-calibrated uncertainty compared to unsupervised baselines, including mean aggregation, probabilistic PCA, and Kalman filtering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NCAM（Neural Conjugate Aggregation Model）：分层贝叶斯框架把神经网络与共轭高斯推断结合，在无真值标签下做多传感器回归融合，学习随协变量变化的源偏差与可靠性，得到可解析的潜变量后验并分解认知/偶然不确定性。用传感器锚定与方差正则解决结构不可辨识，再叠加局部自适应 Monte Carlo conformal prediction 给出异方差预测区间；在合成与真实空气质量数据上，相对均值聚合、probabilistic PCA、Kalman filtering 等无监督基线，预测精度与不确定性校准均有提升。
Motivation: 传感器网络、模拟集合与科学监测中，多源观测带噪声和偏差但训练期没有真值标签，监督成本高或不可行；直接融合会把源偏差当成信号，且结构不可辨识使后验不稳定。
Method: NCAM 用分层贝叶斯结构结合神经网络与共轭高斯推断，按上下文协变量学习各源的偏差与可靠性，输出解析可得的潜变量后验并分解 epistemic 与 aleatoric 不确定性；以 sensor anchoring 和 variance regularization 消解结构不可辨识；再集成 locally adaptive Monte Carlo conformal prediction，在 exchangeability 假设下给出带覆盖保证的异方差预测区间。
Result: 在合成数据集与真实空气质量数据集上，NCAM 相对无监督基线（mean aggregation、probabilistic PCA、Kalman filtering）取得更高的预测精度与更好的不确定性校准。
Conclusion: 共轭高斯推断加神经网络的无监督融合，配合锚定与方差正则，可在无真值标签时给出可辨识、可解释且校准良好的多传感器后验；区间覆盖保证建立在 exchangeability 假设上。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Learning from Own Solutions: Self-Conditioned Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in training LLMs for reasoning tasks, but representative methods such as GRPO assign uniform credit across all tokens, wasting gradient on routine tokens while under-crediting pivotal reasoning steps. Existing token-level credit assignment methods require resources beyond the model's own rollouts. GRPO variants rely on process reward models or ground-truth answers. Knowledge distillation assigns credit through per-token divergence but requires external teachers (On-Policy Distillation) or privileged information (On-Policy Self Distillation). However, these dependencies limit applicability in the pure RLVR setting. We observe that conditioning the model on its own verified trajectories induces a measurable per-token KL divergence between the original and conditioned distributions, and prove that distilling from a self-teacher constructed by verified trajectories leads to infeasible weighted-average solutions when multiple verified trajectories exist. We propose SC-GRPO (Self-Conditioned GRPO), which uses KL divergence mentioned before as a multiplicative weight on GRPO gradients. Across five benchmarks spanning math, code, and agentic tasks, SC-GRPO consistently outperforms 8.1% over GRPO and 5.9% over DAPO with stronger OOD performance. Moreover, SC-GRPO achieves higher performance than OPD.

Motivation: GRPO 对所有 token 均匀分配 credit，把梯度浪费在常规 token 上、低估关键推理步；现有 token 级方法要么依赖 process reward model 或标准答案，要么依赖外部教师与特权信息，无法用于纯 RLVR。

papers.title: S4oP: Operator-level Pruning of Structured State Space Models for Resource-Constrained Devices
papers.abstract_en: Structured State Space Models (SSMs), including the S4 and S4D architectures, have recently emerged as powerful alternatives to attention-based models for capturing long-range dependencies in sequential data. Despite their strong empirical performance, deploying these models in time- and resource-constrained settings remains challenging due to their computational and memory demands. In this paper, we propose a novel incremental, operator-level pruning approach for S4- and S4D-based models that significantly reduces inference cost while preserving predictive performance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically investigate structured operator pruning for SSMs. Our method progressively prunes model operators by interleaving structured masking with fine-tuning, while jointly monitoring accuracy and inference latency. We implement this approach within a unified training and evaluation framework that enables systematic exploration of efficiency-accuracy trade-offs. Experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that pruning up to 70% of the model operators preserves the performance of the original models in most cases, while substantially reducing inference latency. These results demonstrate that structured operator pruning is an effective and previously unexplored strategy for improving the efficiency of SSMs and facilitate their deployment in practical, resource-constrained scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S4oP 对 S4/S4D 结构化状态空间模型做算子级增量剪枝：把结构化掩码与微调交替进行，同时监控精度与推理延迟。在多个基准数据集上剪掉最多 70% 的模型算子，多数情况下保持原模型性能并显著降低推理延迟。
Motivation: S4、S4D 等 SSM 在长程依赖上表现强，但计算与内存开销使其难以部署到时间与资源受限的设备；此前缺少对 SSM 结构化算子剪枝的系统研究。
Method: 提出增量式算子级剪枝：交替执行结构化掩码与微调，逐步剪掉模型算子，并在过程中同时监控精度与推理延迟；实现于一个统一的训练与评估框架，用于系统探索效率-精度权衡，面向 S4 与 S4D 模型。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，剪枝至多 70% 的模型算子在多数情况下保持原模型性能，同时显著降低推理延迟。
Conclusion: 结构化算子剪枝是提升 SSM 效率的有效且此前未被探索的策略，可促进 SSM 在资源受限场景的实际部署。

papers.title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a trade-off between efficient action generation and explicit deliberation. Directly decoding actions from vision-language backbone representations enables low-latency control, whereas textual reasoning, pixel-level subgoals, or world-model evaluation of decoded actions can improve planning but incur substantial latency and computational cost. We propose PearlVLA, a VLA framework that progressively refines a VLM-derived latent plan using feedback from the predicted consequence of each intermediate plan. PearlVLA uses a frozen latent world model (LaWM) pretrained on action-free video. At each refinement round, the current plan produces a continuous latent action code, and the LaWM predicts the corresponding latent visual subgoal. A future-guided plan refiner uses this subgoal to update the plan, so each revision reshapes the next LaWM query. After K rounds, the refined plan is passed once to the host policy's action interface to produce an action chunk. We further introduce Causal Refinement-Grouped Process-Reward RL to optimize latent refinement by comparing rewards from the longer-horizon imagined futures of plan edits made at the same refinement state. Experiments on the LIBERO and RoboCasa benchmarks show that PearlVLA performs competitively against strong existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PearlVLA 在 VLA 的隐空间里做多轮动作计划精修：冻结的隐世界模型 (LaWM) 由无动作视频预训练，把当前计划解码成连续隐动作码并预测隐视觉子目标，future-guided plan refiner 据此更新计划，K 轮后一次性交给宿主策略的动作接口输出动作块。在 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa 上与强基线方法表现相当 (competitive)。
Motivation: VLA 模型在低延迟动作生成与显式推理之间存在取舍：直接从视觉-语言骨干表征解码动作延迟低，而文本推理、像素级子目标或世界模型评估虽能改善规划却带来显著延迟与算力开销。
Method: 用冻结的隐世界模型 (LaWM，action-free video 预训练) 在每轮精修中由当前计划生成连续隐动作码并预测隐视觉子目标，future-guided plan refiner 用该子目标更新计划，每次修订重塑下一次 LaWM 查询；K 轮后计划单次通过宿主策略动作接口生成动作块。训练用 Causal Refinement-Grouped Process-Reward RL，通过比较同一精修状态下不同计划编辑所对应的更长时程想象未来奖励来优化隐空间精修。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa 基准上，PearlVLA 与现有强方法表现相当 (performs competitively)。
Conclusion: 隐空间内的多轮计划精修加因果分组过程奖励 RL，可以在不引入逐轮文本推理或像素级子目标开销的前提下达到与强 VLA 方法相当的规划水平。
