papers.title: Analyzing and Improving Fine-grained Preference Optimization in Medical LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: Preference optimization is increasingly used to post-train medical large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet it operates at a much coarser granularity than the one that defines clinical correctness. Whether one response is clinically better than another usually comes down to a few decisive phrases, such as an anatomical laterality or a lesion attribute, and to whether each is supported by the image region the question concerns. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and its variants, by contrast, reduce the comparison to a single response-level scalar, an objective structurally unable to represent which tokens carry clinical meaning. We show that this mismatch is costly: of the objectives we compare, response-level DPO places the least reward on the phrases that decide clinical correctness, and substituting supervised references for preferred responses opens a stylistic gap that the model exploits as a reward-hacking shortcut, raising preference accuracy but not clinical accuracy. To capture the full feedback in a clinical comparison, we propose Fine-grained Regularized Medical Preference Optimization (FiRe-MPO). Preference pairs are built by minimally editing the model's own generations, so that preferred and rejected responses differ only on clinically decisive spans, and each is paired with a lesion-corrupted image withholding the supporting visual evidence. Because span-localized rewards are sparse, we stabilize optimization with a bidirectional token-wise KL regularizer. Across medical visual question answering and report generation, FiRe-MPO outperforms DPO, RRPO, and competing fine-grained objectives on two popular LVLMs, one medical and one general-purpose, while strengthening visual grounding and placing more reward on the medical phrases than the alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 医疗 LVLM 的偏好优化把临床正确性压缩成单个 response 级标量，无法定位决定诊断的少数关键短语。FiRe-MPO 用最小编辑构造偏好对（仅在临床决定性 span 上不同），并为每条配一张抹掉支撑证据的病变损坏图像，再用双向 token 级 KL 正则稳定稀疏的 span 局部奖励。在医学 VQA 与报告生成上，它在两个 LVLM（一个医疗、一个通用）上超过 DPO、RRPO 及其他细粒度目标，同时增强视觉接地并给医学短语更高奖励。
Motivation: DPO 及其变体把整段回答压成一个标量，无法表示哪些 token 承载临床含义；用监督参考替代偏好回答还会留下风格缝隙，被模型当作 reward-hacking 捷径，抬高偏好准确率却不抬高临床准确率。
Method: 提出 Fine-grained Regularized Medical Preference Optimization (FiRe-MPO)：偏好对由对模型自身生成做最小编辑得到，使 preferred 与 rejected 只在临床决定性 span 上不同；每条回答配一张抹掉支撑视觉证据的病变损坏图像；因 span 局部奖励稀疏，用双向 token 级 KL 正则器稳定优化。
Result: 在医学 VQA 与报告生成两个任务、两个 LVLM（一个医疗、一个通用）上，FiRe-MPO 优于 DPO、RRPO 及竞争性细粒度目标，同时强化视觉接地，并比其他方法把更多奖励放在医学短语上；对比中 response-level DPO 给决定临床正确性的短语的奖励最低。
Conclusion: 临床正确性由少数决定性短语及其图像区域支撑，因此偏好优化必须在 span 粒度上对齐奖励；response 级标量目标结构上无法做到，且会诱发 reward-hacking。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Pretrained self-supervised speech models can recognize unseen consonants
papers.abstract_en: Modern pretrained self-supervised automatic speech recognition models are trained on large-scale audio data to encode speech into contextualized representations. However, their training data are heavily skewed toward high-resource languages with little data from low-resource languages, raising concerns about the potential underrepresentation of typologically uncommon speech sounds such as click consonants primarily found in Khoisan languages. This leads to our central research question: Can these models recognize click consonants as accurately as other speech sounds? To address this question, we fine-tune and compare pretrained self-supervised speech models (Wav2Vec2 and HuBERT) on data from two click-rich Khoisan languages (G|ui and West !Xoon). Our results reveal that the fine-tuned models consistently recognize clicks more accurately than non-clicks, suggesting that self-supervision enables generalization across human speech sounds including rare phonemes.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, presented at Interspeech 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对预训练自监督语音模型训练数据偏向高资源语言、Khoisan 语言的搭嘴音 (click consonants) 可能被低估的问题，微调并比较 Wav2Vec2 与 HuBERT 在两种搭嘴音丰富的 Khoisan 语言 G|ui 和 West !Xoon 上的识别表现。微调后的模型对搭嘴音的识别一致地比非搭嘴音更准确，说明自监督表征能泛化到包括稀有音素在内的人类语音。
Motivation: 自监督语音模型的训练语料严重偏向高资源语言，低资源语言数据稀少，导致类型学上罕见的语音（如主要见于 Khoisan 语言的搭嘴音）可能被系统性低估，其识别能力尚无明确答案。
Method: 微调并对比两个预训练自监督语音模型 Wav2Vec2 与 HuBERT，训练数据取自两种搭嘴音丰富的 Khoisan 语言 G|ui 与 West !Xoon，比较模型对搭嘴音与非搭嘴音的识别准确度。
Result: 微调后的 Wav2Vec2 与 HuBERT 在 G|ui 和 West !Xoon 上一致地把搭嘴音识别得比非搭嘴音更准确。
Conclusion: 自监督学习使语音模型能够跨人类语音泛化，包括搭嘴音这类稀有音素，训练数据的高资源偏向并未妨碍其识别。

papers.title: Right Family, Wrong Skill: Evaluating Risk Exposure in Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: A skill can match a task's topic while conflicting with its resource, procedure, or output requirements. We study this as same-capability risk-exposure retrieval and introduce SameCapRisk-Bench: 890 units and 1,314 query cases across five mechanisms and twelve conflict types. Each unit pairs a skill that meets a query requirement with a same-capability skill that violates it, with evidence for that distinction. The evaluation tests source-task requirements and two kinds of paired queries that reverse which skill fits: changing the requested evidence role or exact output interface while holding the skills fixed. To capture both retrieval success and conflicting exposure, Recall tracks helpful hits, harmful sibling rate (HSR) tracks exposure of the conflicting sibling, and CleanHit requires a helpful hit without that exposure. Four public skill retrievers expose conflicting siblings at HSR@3 of 0.737-0.881 on source-task contracts, compared with 0.099-0.12 on controlled source-role queries. Across the fixed mixture of 1,235 held-out queries, their Recall@3 is 0.903-0.944 and HSR@3 is 0.344-0.393. The conflicting sibling ranks first on 24.8-29.2% of source-task queries for these four retrievers. We also examine what the reranker receives: truncating long skills can remove the passages where the two skills' contracts differ. With the same BGE top-20 candidates, increasing the reranker's input budget from 512 to 4,096 tokens reduces source-task sibling-first errors by 8.27 pp, with an uncertain CleanHit gain.

papers.title: GRASP: Geometry-aware Residual Alignment for Scalable Pretraining Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Scalable data attribution methods typically assign isolated utility scores to individual training examples. This prevalent additive assumption fundamentally fails to capture critical subset dynamics, including data redundancy and complementary coverage. In this work, we reframe attribution as subset-level counterfactual utility prediction and introduce GRASP, an interaction-aware surrogate. Grounded in a theoretical smoothness lower bound, GRASP explicitly models subset interactions through a quadratic geometric penalty. To achieve pretraining-scale efficiency without relying on hidden oracle tuning, we couple low-dimensional feature sketches with a strictly finite lower-confidence bound selection protocol. Extensive subset-retraining evaluations demonstrate that GRASP decisively outperforms existing scalable baselines. It more than doubles the task-level rank correlation for counterfactual subset fidelity while reducing upfront artifact construction costs by nearly an order of magnitude. Downstream diagnostics further show that this scoring mechanism transfers to language model curation and cross-domain vision selection, establishing a robust foundation for optimizing massive pretraining corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRASP 把预训练数据归因从逐样本加性打分重构为子集级反事实效用预测，用二次几何罚项显式建模子集内冗余与互补交互，并以低维特征草图加严格有限的下置信界 (LCB) 选择协议实现预训练规模的效率。在子集重训评测中，其反事实子集保真度的任务级 rank correlation 比现有可扩展基线翻倍以上，前置 artifact 构建成本降低近一个数量级。
Motivation: 可扩展数据归因普遍假设单条训练样本的效用可加，无法刻画子集冗余与互补覆盖等交互效应，导致选出的子集在反事实重训下失真。
Method: 将归因重构为子集级反事实效用预测，基于一条 smoothness 下界理论，用二次几何罚项 (quadratic geometric penalty) 显式建模子集交互；配合低维特征草图 (feature sketches) 与严格有限的下置信界选择协议，避免隐藏的 oracle 调参，并在子集重训评测中检验。
Result: 在子集重训评测中，GRASP 在反事实子集保真度上的任务级 rank correlation 比现有可扩展基线高出一倍以上，同时前置 artifact 构建成本降低近一个数量级；下游诊断显示该打分机制可迁移到语言模型数据筛选与跨领域视觉选择。
Conclusion: 把归因做成带几何交互项的子集级反事实预测，可以在可扩展成本下更忠实地预测子集重训效用，并作为大规模预训练语料优化的基础。

papers.title: Learning Implicit Bias in Generative Spaces for Accelerating Protein Dynamics Emulation
papers.abstract_en: Generative emulators of protein dynamics produce plausible trajectories at a fraction of the cost of molecular dynamics, but they inherit their training distribution and tend to revisit known states rather than reach rare ones under long-horizon extrapolation. Inspired by classical enhanced sampling, we introduce an implicit, history-dependent bias in the generative space of a pretrained emulator. Specifically, a history-aware score estimator augments the frozen emulator with a distance-weighted bias that steers reverse-time sampling away from previously generated structures, regularized by an environment-support term. To preserve structural validity at long horizons, a score-based refinement step re-projects drifted samples onto the data manifold using the frozen emulator. Our experiments demonstrate that the method (i) raises diversity by $35\%$ on DynamicPDB-80; (ii) on $12$ zero-shot Fast-Folding proteins, the learned bias alone reaches the unbiased emulator's coverage up to ${\sim}15\times$ faster, and pairing it with refinement reaches the coverage up to ${\sim}37\times$ faster while covering ${\sim}3\times$ as many low-energy states. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预训练蛋白质动力学生成模拟器上加入隐式、依赖历史的偏置：history-aware score estimator 给冻结模拟器加一个距离加权偏置，把反向采样推离已生成结构，再用基于分数的 refinement 把漂移样本重投影回数据流形。DynamicPDB-80 上多样性提升 35%；12 个 zero-shot Fast-Folding 蛋白上，单靠学到的偏置约 15 倍速达到无偏模拟器的覆盖，配合 refinement 约 37 倍速且覆盖约 3 倍多的低能态。
Motivation: 生成式蛋白质动力学模拟器成本远低于分子动力学，但受训练分布束缚，长时外推时反复回到已知状态而难以到达稀有态。
Method: 借鉴经典增强采样，在预训练生成模拟器的生成空间中注入依赖历史的隐式偏置：history-aware score estimator 附加距离加权偏置使反向采样远离已生成结构，并用 environment-support 项正则；再用基于分数的 refinement 步骤借助冻结模拟器把漂移样本重投影回数据流形，以维持长时结构有效性。
Result: 在 DynamicPDB-80 上多样性提升 35%；在 12 个 zero-shot Fast-Folding 蛋白上，仅学到的偏置达到无偏模拟器覆盖的速度最高约 15 倍，偏置加 refinement 最高约 37 倍，同时覆盖约 3 倍多的低能态。
Conclusion: 在冻结生成模拟器外挂历史依赖偏置加流形重投影，可以在不重训的前提下加速到达稀有态并保持结构有效，代码将发布。

papers.title: Generative Spatiotemporal Intent Sequence Recommendation via Implicit Reasoning in Amap
papers.abstract_en: Real-world user behavior rarely consists of isolated actions; instead, it often forms intent flows governed by spatiotemporal dependencies. To provide integrated service recommendations, we focus on the task of Generative Spatiotemporal Intent Sequence Recommendation (GSISR), which aims to generate intent sequences that are logically coherent and physically executable within complex spatiotemporal contexts. While LLMs offer strong reasoning potential for GSISR, direct industrial deployment is limited by high inference latency and context-mismatched or physically infeasible plans. To address these challenges, we propose a generative framework, GPlan, that internalizes LLM reasoning into lightweight models through two components. First, to enable reasoning under strict latency constraints, we introduce Progressive Implicit CoT Distillation, which compresses explicit reasoning processes into reserved latent tokens, allowing small models to inherit complex planning logic without generating long reasoning text. Second, to address the disconnect between general knowledge and real-world constraints, we design Spatiotemporal Counterfactual DPO. By aligning the model with counterfactual context-plan pairs, we improve sensitivity to spatiotemporal context and reduce context-mismatched plans. Offline experiments and online A/B testing demonstrate that our approach improves sequence coherence and context responsiveness. Our implementation and the anonymized GSISR dataset are available at https://github.com/alibaba/GPlan.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), pp. 1119-1127, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GPlan，把 LLM 的显式推理蒸馏进轻量模型来做时空意图序列推荐 (GSISR)：用 Progressive Implicit CoT Distillation 把长推理压进保留的 latent token，再用 Spatiotemporal Counterfactual DPO 对齐反事实上下文-计划对。离线实验与线上 A/B 显示序列一致性与上下文响应性提升，实现与匿名 GSISR 数据集已在 GitHub 开源。
Motivation: 真实用户行为是受时空依赖约束的意图流，需要生成逻辑连贯且物理可执行的意图序列；直接用 LLM 做此事受高推理延迟以及上下文不匹配、物理不可行计划的限制。
Method: GPlan 框架含两部分：一是 Progressive Implicit CoT Distillation，把显式推理过程压缩进保留的 latent token，让小模型继承规划逻辑而不生成长推理文本；二是 Spatiotemporal Counterfactual DPO，用反事实上下文-计划对做对齐，提高模型对时空上下文的敏感度。
Result: 离线实验与线上 A/B 测试表明该方法提升了意图序列的连贯性与上下文响应性；实现与匿名 GSISR 数据集发布于 github.com/alibaba/GPlan。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的规划推理内化到轻量模型并配合反事实对齐，可以在严格延迟约束下给出更连贯、更贴合时空上下文的意图序列推荐。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MemTrace: Tracing and Attributing Errors in Large Language Model Memory Systems
papers.abstract_en: Memory is essential for enabling large language models to support long-horizon reasoning, yet existing memory systems remain unreliable and difficult to debug. Tracing memory's dynamic evolution is crucial to understand how information is synthesized, propagated, or corrupted over time. In this work, we study the new problem of error tracing and attribution in LLM memory systems. We propose a novel framework that transforms memory pipelines into executable memory evolution graphs, enabling fine-grained tracing of operational information flow. We then construct MemTraceBench, a benchmark collected from representative memory systems such as Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS, to systematically study memory failure modes. We further introduce an automatic attribution method that iteratively traces operation subgraphs to pinpoint the root cause of any failed case. Our analysis reveals that memory failures are systematic, stemming from operation-level issues like information loss and retrieval misalignment. Crucially, we leverage these fine-grained attribution signals to guide downstream prompt optimization, establishing a closed-loop system that automatically corrects faults and boosts end-task performance by up to 7.62 percentage points. Code has ben released at https://github.com/zjunlp/MemTrace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemTrace 把 LLM 记忆流水线转成可执行的记忆演化图 (memory evolution graph)，对失败案例逐层追踪操作子图定位根因，并把细粒度归因信号回灌到下游 prompt 优化形成闭环，端到端任务性能最多提升 7.62 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 记忆系统支撑长程推理但难以调试，记忆如何被合成、传播或损坏缺乏可追踪手段，失败原因停留在黑箱层面。
Method: 提出 MemTrace 框架：将记忆流水线形式化为可执行的记忆演化图以追踪操作级信息流；构建 MemTraceBench，样本来自 Long-Context、RAG、Mem0、EverMemOS 等代表性记忆系统；再用自动归因方法迭代追踪操作子图定位失败根因，并以归因信号指导 prompt 优化。
Result: 分析显示记忆失败是系统性的，源于信息丢失、检索错位等操作级问题；归因信号驱动的 prompt 优化使端到端任务性能最多提升 7.62 个百分点。
Conclusion: 记忆故障可归因到具体操作节点，且这种细粒度归因足以支撑自动纠错闭环来提升下游任务表现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Efficient and Scalable Provenance Tracking for LLM-Generated Code Snippets
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) for code completion and generation are increasingly used in software development, yet they may reproduce training examples verbatim and without authorship attribution, raising legal and ethical concerns around plagiarism and license compliance. Classical fingerprint-based plagiarism detectors, such as Winnowing, remain highly effective, yet the inspection requires comparing fragments of code to the entire training set, and their linear-time search makes them impractical for the billion-scale corpora used to train modern code LLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SourceTracker, a 300M-parameter encoder tailored for code retrieval, together with a hybrid two-stage provenance-tracking pipeline HybridSourceTracker (HST). HST first narrows down a small set of candidate snippets via vector search, then re-ranks those candidates using Winnowing on exact fingerprints. We train and evaluate our system on a 10M-snippet subset of the TheStackV2 dataset, with both verbatim and adapted snippets that emulate realistic identifier renaming. On an in vitro 100k-snippet search space with adapted queries, our hybrid approach reaches a mean reciprocal rank on par with Winnowing for 30-token fragments. Then, starting from windows >= 60 tokens, it consistently overperforms by up to 5.4% while preserving logarithmic-time query complexity. In a complementary evaluation using an LLM-based judge, we find that many retrieved snippets not labeled as ground truth are still highly similar to the expected sources, particularly with longer context windows, and thus remain useful for end users. Overall, our results demonstrate that integrating vector search with fingerprinting enables scalable, high precision provenance tracking for code produced by LLMs, provided that their training data is made accessible...
papers.comment: Article accepted at The Journal of Systems & Software
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SourceTracker（300M 参数代码检索编码器）与两阶段混合溯源管线 HybridSourceTracker (HST)：先用向量检索缩小候选，再用 Winnowing 精确指纹重排。在 TheStackV2 10M 片段子集上，100k 检索空间的改写查询中，30-token 片段 MRR 与 Winnowing 持平，≥60-token 窗口起持续高出至多 5.4%，且查询复杂度保持对数时间。
Motivation: LLM 代码生成可能逐字复现训练样本且无作者归属，带来抄袭与许可证合规风险；Winnowing 等指纹检测器虽有效，但需与整个训练集比对，线性时间搜索在十亿级代码语料上不可行。
Method: 训练 300M 参数的代码检索编码器 SourceTracker，并组装 HST 两阶段管线：向量检索先筛出少量候选片段，再用 Winnowing 精确指纹重排。训练与评估基于 TheStackV2 的 10M 片段子集，含逐字片段与模拟标识符改写的片段。
Result: 在 in vitro 100k 片段检索空间的改写查询上，HST 的 MRR 在 30-token 片段与 Winnowing 持平；从 ≥60-token 窗口起持续领先至多 5.4%，同时保持对数时间查询复杂度。LLM judge 补充评测显示，许多未标为 ground truth 的检索结果与期望来源高度相似，且上下文窗口越长越明显。
Conclusion: 向量搜索与指纹识别结合可在训练数据可获取的前提下，为 LLM 生成代码做高精度、可扩展的溯源追踪；更长上下文窗口下未命中标签的检索结果对终端用户仍有实用价值。

papers.title: A Two-Scan Deep Learning Model for Predicting Dementia in Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.abstract_en: Predicting which people with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) will develop dementia matters for starting treatment early, yet computational work on structural brain imaging has relied almost entirely on a single scan. We propose TAFNet, a temporal attention fusion network that combines a baseline and a follow-up T1-weighted scan. A pretrained Siamese encoder represents each scan, and a fusion module combines the two through anatomical difference, cross-temporal attention and joint context, mixed by a learned per-patient gate. We evaluate it on paired scans from participants with MCI in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, taken up to two years apart, with a dementia diagnosis within three years of the first scan as the outcome. The evaluation is designed to hold up under scrutiny: conversion is defined from recorded diagnoses, the pretraining pool shares no participants with the evaluation cohort, a held-out test partition is kept apart from model development, and uncertainty is estimated by resampling participants. TAFNet discriminates converters from non-converters well on the held-out partition. It outperforms conventional single-scan networks and a model that subtracts the two scans; both differences are significant in cross-validation and have the same direction on the smaller held-out partition. With everything else held fixed, adding the follow-up scan gives a significant gain in cross-validation. Against a recurrent CNN-LSTM baseline built on the same encoder, TAFNet performs comparably, with neither model consistently ahead. Operating points chosen on validation data, in place of the default threshold, give high sensitivity at a clinically reasonable specificity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAFNet 用时间注意力融合 MCI 患者的基线与随访两次 T1 结构像，预测首次扫描后三年内是否转为痴呆。在 ADNI 配对扫描上，它在交叉验证中显著优于单扫描网络与两扫描相减模型，且固定其他条件时加入随访扫描带来显著增益；与同编码器的 CNN-LSTM 基线则表现相当。
Motivation: 结构脑影像的 MCI 转痴呆预测几乎只用单次扫描，无法利用两年间隔内的纵向解剖变化，而早期干预需要在首次扫描后三年内识别会转化的患者。
Method: TAFNet 由预训练 Siamese 编码器分别表示基线与随访 T1 扫描，融合模块通过解剖差异、跨时间注意力 (cross-temporal attention) 与联合上下文三条通路组合两次扫描，再由按患者学习的门控 (per-patient gate) 加权。结局定义为首次扫描后三年内有记录的痴呆诊断；预训练池与评估队列无参与者重叠，留出测试集独立于模型开发，不确定性用参与者重采样估计。
Result: 在 ADNI 中间隔最长两年的配对扫描上，TAFNet 在留出划分上能较好区分转化者与非转化者；交叉验证中显著优于常规单扫描网络与两扫描相减模型，且在更小的留出划分上方向一致。固定其他条件时加入随访扫描在交叉验证中带来显著增益。与基于同一编码器的 recurrent CNN-LSTM 基线相比表现相当，两者无一致领先；在验证集上选取的操作点以临床可接受的特异度换取高敏感度。
Conclusion: 纵向双扫描融合比单扫描或简单相减更能预测 MCI 转化，但相对同编码器的循环网络没有一致优势，实际部署应改用验证集调定的操作点而非默认阈值。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: EgoBench: An Interactive Egocentric Multimodal Benchmark for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents increasingly operate in open, real-world environments, they require a deep synergy of multimodal perception, tool invocation with multi-hop reasoning, and dynamic interaction with users. However, existing benchmarks fail to jointly evaluate these capabilities due to challenges in designing strictly coupled multi-capability tasks, simulating natural and task-constrained user feedback, and ensuring objective evaluation of dynamic interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce EgoBench, the first interactive multimodal benchmark for tool-using agents. EgoBench comprises 1,590 egocentric-video-grounded tasks covering five daily scenarios, along with a user-agent-tool interactive environment for evaluation. We implement a three-stage synergistic pipeline through which each task is designed to enforce the joint application of visual perception and tool-augmented multi-hop reasoning. We additionally develop a multi-agent simulated user to evaluate agents' interaction capabilities, which generates high-fidelity, task-aligned responses to agents. Furthermore, we establish a deterministic joint validation framework that guarantees objective assessment through process-based and result-based equivalence. Benchmarking eight video-MLLM agents on EgoBench reveals a severe performance ceiling: the best-performing model achieves only a 34.95% average Joint Success Rate across the three interaction modes. Finally, we conduct a multi-dimensional error analysis to disentangle failure modes, exposing capability bottlenecks for advancing future AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoBench 是首个面向工具使用智能体的交互式多模态基准，用 1,590 个以第一人称视频为锚点的任务，把视觉感知、工具增强多跳推理与用户交互绑在同一任务上评测。八个 video-MLLM 智能体在三种交互模式下的最佳模型平均 Joint Success Rate 仅 34.95%，暴露出明显能力天花板。
Motivation: 现有基准无法联合评测多模态感知、多跳工具调用与动态用户交互：严格耦合的多能力任务难以设计，受任务约束的自然用户反馈难以模拟，动态交互也难以客观评分。
Method: 三阶段协同流水线设计任务，强制视觉感知与工具增强多跳推理联合使用；以多智能体模拟用户生成高保真、任务对齐的回复；用确定性联合验证框架，通过基于过程与基于结果的等价性保证客观评测。
Result: 共 1,590 个第一人称视频任务，覆盖五类日常场景；对八个 video-MLLM 智能体基准测试，最佳模型在三种交互模式下平均 Joint Success Rate 仅 34.95%；另做多维误差分析以拆解失败模式。
Conclusion: 当前 video-MLLM 智能体在感知、工具推理与用户交互的联合任务上存在严重性能天花板，误差分析指出推进下一代智能体所需的能力瓶颈。

papers.title: Trust Region Q Adjoint Matching
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy reinforcement learning of pretrained flow policies remains challenging due to the instability of optimization arising from the multi-step sampling process. Recently, Q-learning with Adjoint Matching (QAM) addressed this by recasting policy improvement as a stochastic optimal control (SOC) problem guided by a learned critic. However, QAM inherits a fundamental fragility of critic-guided improvement, since small critic errors can be exponentially amplified and often lead to performance collapse. This paper introduces Trust Region Q Adjoint Matching (TRQAM), a stable off-policy fine-tuning algorithm that adaptively controls the path-space KL between the fine-tuned and pretrained policies through projected dual descent. Specifically, we adapt a trust-region parameter $λ$ inside the sampling process of the flow policy and prove that $λ$ exactly weights the path-space KL in the SOC objective. As a result, our method can tightly control the deviation from the pretrained policy within a prescribed KL budget, achieving stable off-policy RL. Through experiments on 50 OGBench tasks, TRQAM consistently outperforms prior methods in both offline RL and offline-to-online RL. In particular, TRQAM achieves an overall success rate of 68% in offline RL, substantially improving over the strongest baseline at 46%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRQAM 在 flow policy 的多步采样内嵌入信任域参数 λ，并证明 λ 精确加权随机最优控制 (SOC) 目标中的 path-space KL，从而用 projected dual descent 把微调策略对预训练策略的偏离压在给定 KL 预算内。在 50 个 OGBench 任务上，offline RL 总成功率 68%，最强基线为 46%。
Motivation: QAM 用学到的 critic 把策略改进重写为 SOC 问题，但 critic 的小误差会被指数放大并导致性能崩溃，预训练 flow policy 的 off-policy 微调因此不稳定。
Method: 在 flow policy 的采样过程中引入信任域参数 λ，证明其在 SOC 目标中精确加权 path-space KL；用 projected dual descent 自适应控制该 KL，使微调策略保持在预设 KL 预算内，实现稳定的 off-policy RL。
Result: 在 50 个 OGBench 任务上，TRQAM 在 offline RL 与 offline-to-online RL 中均一致优于先前方法；offline RL 总成功率 68%，最强基线 46%。
Conclusion: 把信任域约束直接放进采样过程并显式控制 path-space KL，可以抑制 critic 引导改进的误差放大，使预训练 flow policy 的 off-policy 微调稳定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WorldCraft: From Camera Navigation to Object Manipulation in Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent video world models enable interactive camera navigation but provide limited control over individual objects. We study persistent object-state control in autoregressive video world models, where an object-trajectory action must remain effective across viewpoint changes, generation chunks, and intervals of temporary invisibility. This setting introduces an action-memory conflict because autoregressive memory records the last observed object state, whereas an intervening action may update that state off-screen. We present WorldCraft, the first camera-navigable autoregressive video world model to jointly compose camera navigation and object-trajectory control. Given a user-selected object and a 2D motion path, Normalized World Trajectory (NWT) anchors the path in a normalized world coordinate system and projects it into each camera view, producing a consistent object-action signal throughout the autoregressive rollout. Trajectory-Anchored State Persistence (TASP) combines persistent NWT guidance with selective memory refresh to maintain action-updated object states through off-screen intervals and re-entry. A pathway-selective LoRA introduces object control while retaining the pretrained camera controller. WorldCraft achieves accurate composable camera-object control and preserves camera fidelity. We further find that it maintains action-updated object states across extended intervals of complete target invisibility without off-screen trajectory supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldCraft 是首个可相机导航的自回归视频世界模型，能把相机运动与物体轨迹控制联合起来：Normalized World Trajectory (NWT) 把 2D 路径锚定到归一化世界坐标并投影到每个相机视角，Trajectory-Anchored State Persistence (TASP) 用持久引导加选择性记忆刷新维持离屏期间被动作更新的物体状态。结果是相机-物体控制可组合且相机保真度得以保留，并在长时间完全不可见区间内维持动作更新后的物体状态，无需离屏轨迹监督。
Motivation: 现有可交互相机导航的视频世界模型对单个物体的控制很有限；自回归记忆只记录最后观测到的物体状态，而中途的动作可能在屏外更新该状态，形成 action-memory conflict。
Method: NWT 将用户选定物体的 2D 运动路径锚定到归一化世界坐标系并投影到各相机视角，产生贯穿自回归 rollout 的一致物体动作信号；TASP 结合持久 NWT 引导与选择性记忆刷新，跨离屏区间与重新入屏维持动作更新后的状态；再用 pathway-selective LoRA 注入物体控制，同时保留预训练的相机控制器。
Result: 实现准确的可组合相机-物体控制并保持相机保真度；在长时间完全目标不可见的区间内维持动作更新后的物体状态，且无需离屏轨迹监督。
Conclusion: 把物体动作表示为世界坐标下的持久轨迹并配合选择性记忆刷新，可在自回归视频世界模型中同时保住相机控制与跨视角、跨不可见区间的物体状态。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: WorldCraft 是首个可相机导航的自回归视频世界模型，能把相机运动与物体轨迹控制联合起来：Normalized World Trajectory (NWT) 把 2D 路径锚定到归一化世界坐标并投影到每个相机视角，Trajectory-Anchored State Persistence (TASP) 用持久引导加选择性记忆刷新维持离屏期间被动作更新的物体状态。结果是相机-物体控制可组合且相机保真度得以保留，并在长时间完全不可见区间内维持动作更新后的物体状态，无需离屏轨迹监督。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有可交互相机导航的视频世界模型对单个物体的控制很有限；自回归记忆只记录最后观测到的物体状态，而中途的动作可能在屏外更新该状态，形成 action-memory conflict。
summary_sections.method: NWT 将用户选定物体的 2D 运动路径锚定到归一化世界坐标系并投影到各相机视角，产生贯穿自回归 rollout 的一致物体动作信号；TASP 结合持久 NWT 引导与选择性记忆刷新，跨离屏区间与重新入屏维持动作更新后的状态；再用 pathway-selective LoRA 注入物体控制，同时保留预训练的相机控制器。
summary_sections.result: 实现准确的可组合相机-物体控制并保持相机保真度；在长时间完全目标不可见的区间内维持动作更新后的物体状态，且无需离屏轨迹监督。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把物体动作表示为世界坐标下的持久轨迹并配合选择性记忆刷新，可在自回归视频世界模型中同时保住相机控制与跨视角、跨不可见区间的物体状态。

papers.title: ROAR: Retrieval Opportunity-Aware Refinement for Zero-Shot Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval augmentation provides time series forecasters with historical continuations, yet even candidates that outperform the base forecast may fail to improve the final prediction. We propose ROAR, a Retrieval Opportunity-Aware Refinement framework for zero-shot time series forecasting. To better exploit these improvement opportunities, its training objective allocates additional emphasis across queries based on base-forecast difficulty and the relative improvement offered by retrieved candidates. Using this objective, ROAR first learns to aggregate aligned historical candidates and uses a learned gate to control their correction strength against a fixed base forecaster. It then jointly calibrates the forecasting module and gate to coordinate their contributions, while anchoring the combined prediction to the first-stage refined output. We derive exact decompositions of refinement gains and the opportunity-weighted training loss, and characterize additional gains from joint calibration under a local linearization. Experiments on seven benchmarks show that ROAR achieves the lowest average MSE among the compared methods. Further evaluations demonstrate average forecasting improvements across multiple backbone families and retrieval-augmented forecasters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROAR 针对零样本时间序列预报中的检索增强，指出检索到的候选即使优于基础预报也未必改善最终预测，提出按基础预报难度与候选相对改进幅度加权的训练目标。该目标先聚合对齐的历史候选并用学习到的门控控制其对固定基础预报器的修正强度，再联合校准预报模块与门控。在七个基准上 ROAR 取得所比较方法中最低的平均 MSE，并在多个 backbone 家族与检索增强预报器上带来平均提升。
Motivation: 检索增强为时间序列预报器提供历史延续，但优于基础预报的候选仍可能无法改善最终预测，改进机会未被显式利用。
Method: ROAR 的训练目标按基础预报难度与检索候选的相对改进幅度分配权重；第一阶段学习聚合对齐的历史候选并用学习门控控制其对固定基础预报器的修正强度，第二阶段联合校准预报模块与门控并把组合预测锚定到第一阶段精炼输出；并推导精炼增益与机会加权损失的精确分解，以及局部线性化下联合校准的额外增益。
Result: 在七个基准上 ROAR 取得所比较方法中最低的平均 MSE；后续评测显示其在多个 backbone 家族与检索增强预报器上带来平均预报改进。
Conclusion: 把检索候选的改进机会显式纳入训练权重并配合门控与联合校准，可以在零样本时间序列预报中稳定把候选优势转化为最终预测改进。

papers.title: Concomitant DAG Learning: On the Roles of Noise Adaptivity, Sparsity, and Non-negativity
papers.abstract_en: Directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) constitute a central modeling tool to enable principled reasoning about cause-effect interactions in complex systems. However, since the causal structure underlying a group of variables is often unknown and interventions may be infeasible or ethically challenging to implement, there is a need to address the task of inferring DAGs from observational data. However, most classical structure identification approaches face two key obstacles: the combinatorial challenge of enforcing acyclicity, which severely limits scalability, and identifiability challenges arising from latent confounding or heterogeneous noise. This tutorial offers an overview of recent signal processing and optimization advances that address these issues by recasting DAG structure learning as a continuous, score-based estimation problem over adjacency matrices. We begin with a didactic introduction to structural equation models and the formulation of causal graph recovery, followed by a historical survey of score-based methods ranging from early combinatorial search schemes and greedy heuristics to modern continuous frameworks that leverage smooth characterizations of acyclicity. Building on this foundation, we describe concomitant DAG estimation methods that jointly infer sparse causal structure and exogenous noise levels, improving robustness under heteroscedasticity and distribution shifts by rendering the estimator noise adaptive. All in all, the tutorial introduces readers to challenges and opportunities for signal processing research at the crossroads of causal inference, high-dimensional statistics, and scalable graph learning, while outlining emerging directions including online, nonlinear, and neural causal discovery.
papers.comment: Submitted to the IEEE Signal Processing Magazine Special Issue: From Signals to Causes: Methodological Advances in Causal Inference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇把 DAG 结构学习重写为邻接矩阵上的连续、基于 score 的估计问题的教程综述，并重点介绍 concomitant DAG estimation：同时推断稀疏因果结构与外生噪声水平，使估计器对异方差和分布偏移具有噪声自适应性。核心主张是用平滑的无环性刻画替代组合搜索，从而绕开无环约束的组合爆炸与潜在混杂/异质噪声带来的可辨识性障碍。
Motivation: 从观测数据推断因果结构时，无环约束的组合搜索严重限制可扩展性，而潜在混杂与异质噪声又带来可辨识性困难；干预往往不可行或不合伦理，因此需要从纯观测数据出发的可扩展方法。
Method: 教程先给出结构方程模型 (SEM) 与因果图恢复的形式化，再梳理从组合搜索、贪心启发式到利用平滑无环性刻画的现代连续框架的 score-based 方法谱系；核心是 concomitant DAG 估计，把稀疏邻接矩阵与外生噪声水平放进同一个连续优化问题联合求解，使估计量噪声自适应。
Result: 教程综述性质，摘要给出的结论是定性的：concomitant 联合估计在异方差与分布偏移下提升鲁棒性，平滑无环性刻画缓解了组合可扩展性障碍；摘要未含实验数值。
Conclusion: 把因果图恢复写成带噪声自适应的连续 score 估计问题，是信号处理视角下兼顾稀疏性、可扩展性与异方差鲁棒性的路径；教程同时把在线、非线性与神经因果发现列为新兴方向。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MARGIN: Runtime Confidence Calibration for Multi-Agent Foundation Model Coordination
papers.abstract_en: When a coordinator compares answers from heterogeneous foundation models, self-reported confidence may have different meanings across responders and changing workloads. This paper presents MARGIN (Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation), a runtime calibration method that learns model-specific confidence corrections from observed answer outcomes without retraining the models or requiring a held-out calibration set. MARGIN tracks recent accuracy and stated confidence within confidence bands, uses their ratio to correct reported confidence, and blends sparse-band corrections toward a model-level estimate. The corrected scores weight candidate answers in a collective decision. Evaluation covers code generation, question answering, and mathematics, using an 18-model pool and a nine-model subset for distribution-shift experiments. On BigCodeBench, model-mean confidence is negatively related to accuracy; among correct/incorrect response pairs, choosing the more confident responder performs below chance. Against five online calibration baselines receiving identical feedback and retaining their learned state across each transition, MARGIN achieves lower post-shift expected calibration error than all five in two code-generation transitions and than four in a question-answering transition; the remaining question-answering comparison is inconclusive. In separate code-generation coordination experiments, calibration improves the ranking of correct responses and increases answer-selection accuracy by 4.3 and 14.0 percentage points on two of three benchmarks relative to uncalibrated confidence weighting. These results support model-specific runtime calibration for coordination under changing workloads when correctness feedback is available for the participating responders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARGIN 在多智能体协调中按模型分别做运行时置信度校准：在置信度分箱内用近期准确率与自报置信度之比修正分数，并向模型级估计回退，修正后的分数用于加权候选答案。在分布漂移后其 ECE 低于五个在线校准基线中的全部（两次代码生成迁移）与四个（一次问答迁移），代码生成协调中答案选择准确率相对未校准加权提升 4.3 与 14.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 异构基础模型的自报置信度在不同响应者与变化工作负载下含义不一致，协调者据此加权会选错答案；现有校准通常需要重训或留出校准集，难以在运行时应对分布漂移。
Method: MARGIN (Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation) 不重训模型、不需要留出校准集：在置信度分箱内跟踪近期准确率与自报置信度，用二者比值修正报告置信度，稀疏分箱的修正向模型级估计混合，修正分数用于集体决策中候选答案加权；评测覆盖代码生成、问答、数学，用 18 模型池与 9 模型子集做分布漂移实验。
Result: BigCodeBench 上模型平均置信度与准确率负相关；在正确/错误回答对中，选更自信一方的表现低于随机。相对五个获得相同反馈并跨迁移保留状态的在线校准基线，MARGIN 在两次代码生成迁移中漂移后 ECE 全部更低，在一次问答迁移中低于其中四个，剩余一次问答比较无结论。代码生成协调实验中，校准改善正确回答的排序，并在三个基准中的两个上使答案选择准确率相对未校准置信度加权提升 4.3 与 14.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 在有正确性反馈的条件下，按模型区分的运行时校准比统一或未校准的置信度加权更适合变化工作负载下的多智能体协调。

papers.title: World-Ego Modeling for Embodied Video Generation in Long-Horizon Navigation-Manipulation Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Embodied video world models typically capture both scene evolution and the robot's behavior, which we refer to as the \emph{world} and the \emph{ego}, respectively. The world and the ego exhibit different underlying dynamics: world prediction relies primarily on visual history and emphasizes scene stability, whereas ego prediction relies more strongly on the current instruction and emphasizes accurate instruction following. Modeling both components within a single generation stream can entangle these different dependencies, making it difficult to specialize the prediction of either component. Consequently, it becomes difficult to simultaneously maintain scene consistency and accurate instruction following, particularly in long-horizon navigation-manipulation tasks. In this paper, we propose to decompose an embodied video into the world and the ego and disentangle their generation processes. Specifically, we define the world as the background and currently unmanipulated objects, and the ego as the robot and currently manipulated objects. Based on this definition, we develop the \emph{World-Ego Model} (WEM), which combines a vision-language state predictor using role-conditioned attention (RCA) and asymmetric query budgets with a semantic-routed mixture-of-experts (SR-MoE) diffusion generator. To enable rigorous evaluation, we further construct HTEWorld, a dataset and benchmark for long-horizon embodied video generation with hybrid navigation-manipulation tasks, providing 125K training video clips comprising over 4.5M frames with fine-grained instructions, together with 300 multi-turn evaluation trajectories covering over 2K instructions. Extensive experiments show that WEM achieves state-of-the-art performance on HTEWorld while remaining competitive on existing manipulation-oriented evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把具身视频拆成 world（背景与未被操作物体）与 ego（机器人与当前被操作物体）两条解耦生成流，提出 World-Ego Model (WEM)：角色条件注意力 (RCA) 加非对称 query 预算的视觉-语言状态预测器，配合语义路由混合专家 (SR-MoE) 扩散生成器。在自建 HTEWorld 长时程导航-操作基准上达到 SOTA，同时在既有操作类评测上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 单一生成流里 world 与 ego 依赖不同（前者靠视觉历史、重场景稳定，后者靠当前指令、重指令跟随），纠缠后难以各自专门化，长时程导航-操作任务中场景一致性与指令准确性难以同时维持。
Method: 先按定义把具身视频分解为 world 与 ego 并解耦生成过程；WEM 由带角色条件注意力 (RCA) 与非对称 query 预算的视觉-语言状态预测器，以及语义路由 mixture-of-experts (SR-MoE) 扩散生成器组成；并构建 HTEWorld 数据集与基准用于长时程混合导航-操作视频生成评测。
Result: HTEWorld 含 125K 训练视频片段、超过 4.5M 帧与细粒度指令，另有 300 条多轮评测轨迹覆盖 2K 以上指令；WEM 在 HTEWorld 上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并在既有面向操作的评测上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把场景演化与机器人行为分成两条解耦生成流，是同时维持长时程导航-操作中场景一致性与指令跟随的有效路径，HTEWorld 提供了该任务的训练与评测基准。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把场景演化与机器人行为分成两条解耦生成流，是同时维持长时程导航-操作中场景一致性与指令跟随的有效路径，HTEWorld 提供了该任务的训练与评测基准。

papers.title: AnchorFlow: Learning Anchor Placement for Faithful and Editable SVG Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Raster-to-SVG reconstruction requires faithful geometry and a compact control structure for editing. A central challenge is deciding where to place anchors: raster appearance alone does not determine how a contour should be divided into Bézier segments. We present AnchorFlow, which learns anchor placement from designer-authored SVGs to reconstruct accurate curves with sparse controls. Our key idea is a sparse anchor field that jointly encodes contour geometry and reference segment junctions, including those along smooth contours. An anchor decoder predicts explicit anchor proposals from features learned under field supervision. These proposals guide boundary-constrained fitting and local refinement to recover cubic Bézier paths. On clean single-path inputs, AnchorFlow achieves 99.52% mean IoU while using 56.6% fewer anchors on average than AdaVec, with lower boundary error and closer agreement with source-SVG anchor layouts. Under boundary perturbations, it maintains high fidelity with limited anchor growth. Integrated into a component-based pipeline, the same path module also produces compact, faithful full-image reconstructions. On four local-editing tasks, our outputs require less median active time and fewer actions than AdaVec and LIVE while retaining high target-shape accuracy.
papers.comment: 22 pages, including supplementary material. Revised version of the same work; title, method description, and experimental evaluation updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorFlow 从设计师手写的 SVG 中学习锚点放置，用稀疏锚点场联合编码轮廓几何与参考分段接点，再由锚点解码器给出显式锚点提案，驱动边界约束拟合与局部细化重建三次 Bézier 路径。在干净单路径输入上 mean IoU 达 99.52%，平均锚点数比 AdaVec 少 56.6%，边界误差更低且锚点布局更接近源 SVG。
Motivation: 栅格转 SVG 中锚点放置无法由栅格外观唯一决定：同一条轮廓如何切成 Bézier 段缺少客观依据，导致重建要么控制点冗余、要么几何失真，编辑困难。
Method: 核心是稀疏锚点场 (sparse anchor field)，在场监督下同时编码轮廓几何与参考分段接点（含平滑段上的接点）；锚点解码器从该特征预测显式锚点提案，再做边界约束拟合与局部细化恢复三次 Bézier 路径，并作为路径模块嵌入组件级全图重建管线。
Result: 干净单路径输入上 mean IoU 99.52%，平均锚点数比 AdaVec 少 56.6%，边界误差更低、锚点布局更贴近源 SVG；边界扰动下保持高保真且锚点数增长有限；在四个局部编辑任务上，相比 AdaVec 与 LIVE 所需中位活动时间更短、操作次数更少，同时保持较高的目标形状准确率。
Conclusion: 把锚点放置当作可从设计师 SVG 中学习的预测问题，可以在更少控制点下同时拿到几何保真与可编辑性，且同一路径模块可复用于全图重建与局部编辑流程。

papers.title: Token by Token, Compromised: Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Unified Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified autoregressive models (UAMs) are transformer models that generate text as well as image tokens within a single autoregressive pass. Shared parameters and a multimodal vocabulary simplify the training pipeline and facilitate flexible multimodal generation, yet might introduce new vulnerabilities. In particular, we are the first to show that this unified architecture enables multimodal backdoor attacks, where a trigger can propagate malicious effects across multiple output modalities. Specifically, we present the Token by Token Backdoor Attack (ToBAC), the first backdoor attack targeting UAMs, exploring both data-based and model-based poisoning strategies. We demonstrate that inconspicuous characters or even common words can be transformed into triggers that elicit harmful behavior in autoregressive image generation. ToBAC can jointly manipulate visual outputs and accompanying text, increasing the perceived authenticity of fabricated content. With model access, ToBAC enables attacks on the Liquid model in which a subtle word (e.g., "cool") induces modality-aligned brand promotion or ideological influence in 55% of generations. Without model access, ToBAC can be induced through data poisoning, achieving an average success rate of 63.1% against JanusPro. Our code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/ToBAC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToBAC 是首个针对统一自回归模型 (UAM) 的多模态后门攻击：触发器可跨文本与图像两种输出模态传播恶意效果，一个不起眼的词（如 "cool"）在 Liquid 模型上诱导模态对齐的品牌推广或意识形态影响，占生成结果的 55%；无模型访问时仅靠数据投毒对 JanusPro 平均攻击成功率 63.1%。
Motivation: 统一自回归模型共享参数与多模态词表、单一自回归通路生成文本和图像，简化训练却可能引入新漏洞；此前无人证明这种架构本身使触发器能跨输出模态传播。
Method: 提出 Token by Token Backdoor Attack (ToBAC)，含数据投毒与模型访问两类投毒策略；把不起眼的字符乃至常见词改造成触发器，同时操纵视觉输出与伴随文本。
Result: 有模型访问时在 Liquid 模型上，微妙单词 "cool" 在 55% 的生成中引发模态对齐的品牌推广或意识形态影响；无模型访问时通过数据投毒对 JanusPro 平均攻击成功率 63.1%。
Conclusion: 统一架构本身使后门效果可跨模态传播，且数据投毒在无模型访问条件下即可达到六成以上成功率，ToBAC 代码已开源。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision Language Models via Geometric Logic Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made striking progress, yet their spatial reasoning remains fragile. Models that answer an original input correctly can still fail under valid transformations with predictable answer mappings, revealing a gap between instance-level correctness and robust spatial reasoning. To address this, we propose Spatial Alignment via Geometric Evolution (SAGE), a self-evolving framework that improves robust spatial reasoning through geometric and linguistic duality operations. SAGE incorporates duality consistency into GRPO training, encouraging models to produce coherent answers across original and transformed inputs. SAGE co-evolves duality generation and solution, allowing the model to continually expose and address its own reasoning weaknesses. A dynamic operation pool identifies challenging operations and retires mastered ones, keeping training focused on informative duality signals. SAGE is model-agnostic, data-efficient compared to prior post-training methods, and can be applied as a lightweight adaptation stage to any existing VLM. Experiments on video and spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines and enhanced generalization to unseen data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 用几何与语言对偶变换 (duality operations) 自我生成带可预测答案映射的对抗输入，并把原图与变换后输入的答案一致性作为 GRPO 训练的对偶一致性约束，使 VLM 的空间推理在合法变换下不再答对原题却答错变体。动态操作池保留难掌握、退休已掌握的变换，让训练持续聚焦有信息量的对偶信号；在视频与空间推理基准上相对强基线一致提升，并对未见数据泛化更好。
Motivation: VLM 的空间推理脆弱：同一模型能答对原始输入，却在带可预测答案映射的合法变换下失败，说明实例级正确不等于稳健的空间推理。
Method: 提出 SAGE (Spatial Alignment via Geometric Evolution)：用几何与语言对偶变换生成原题的配对变体，把对偶一致性 (duality consistency) 并入 GRPO 训练，要求模型在原输入与变换输入上给出一致答案；对偶生成与解题共同演化，动态操作池识别难操作并退休已掌握操作。框架 model-agnostic，可作为轻量适配阶段接到任意现有 VLM。
Result: 在视频与空间推理基准上相对强基线取得一致改进，并对未见数据表现出更强泛化；相较既有后训练方法更省数据。
Conclusion: 把对偶一致性作为训练信号并让数据生成与解题共同演化，可以让 VLM 的空间推理从答对单题提升为在合法变换下保持稳健，且作为轻量后训练阶段适用于任意 VLM。

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Robustness, Interpretability and Expressiveness of EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) have been evaluated predominantly on clean, in-distribution accuracy, demonstrating modest gains over supervised baselines and weak frozen representations. This study examines whether these conclusions hold beyond clean accuracy by evaluating six EEG-FMs and a supervised baseline across ten datasets along three layers of analysis: (i) Robustness: we apply test-time perturbations including additive noise, random and region-based channel dropout and region-specific noise injection. Our analyses show that no single model dominates all failure modes. The most noise-robust model is among the most fragile under channel dropout and much of the dropout fragility disappears when channels are removed rather than zero-padded. (ii) Interpretability: using attribution methods in EEG-FMs, we show that models broadly concentrate relevance on task-appropriate brain regions consistent with known neurophysiology. (iii) Expressiveness: we demonstrate that the poor head-only performance previously attributed to low-quality pre-trained representations is largely explained by the pooling strategy and that EEG-FMs possess sufficient representational capacity when their token-level embeddings are preserved. Furthermore, with block-wise probing and attention analysis we show that late blocks are repurposed during fine-tuning, while early blocks already hold task-related information. Our results show that conclusions about EEG-FMs depend on evaluation choices and we recommend that future evaluation of EEG-FMs should report robustness per perturbation type, produce attribution maps and examine multiple pooling strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个 EEG 基础模型 (EEG-FM) 与一个监督基线在十个数据集上做三层评测，结论是 EEG-FM 的优劣排序取决于评测选择而非单一精度：抗噪最强的模型在通道 dropout 下反而最脆弱，且 dropout 脆弱性在直接删通道而非置零填充时大幅消失。作者建议评测必须按扰动类型分别报告鲁棒性、给出 attribution 图并检查多种 pooling 策略。
Motivation: EEG-FM 现有评测几乎只看干净、同分布精度，得到的“相对监督基线增益有限、冻结表征弱”这类结论可能只是评测口径的产物，无法说明模型在真实伪迹下的行为与表征能力。
Method: 评测六个 EEG-FM 加一个监督基线，覆盖十个数据集，分三层：测试时扰动（加性噪声、随机与按脑区的通道 dropout、按脑区的噪声注入）测鲁棒性；用 attribution 方法看相关性是否落在符合神经生理的任务脑区；用 block-wise probing 与 attention 分析，以及对比 head-only 与保留 token-level embedding 的多种 pooling 策略，测表征表达力。
Result: 没有任何单一模型在全部失效模式上占优；抗噪最好的模型在通道 dropout 下属于最脆弱之列，而当通道被直接移除而非置零填充时，大部分 dropout 脆弱性消失。Attribution 显示模型相关性大体集中在与已知神经生理一致的任务脑区。此前归因于预训练表征质量差的 head-only 低分，很大程度由 pooling 策略解释；保留 token-level embedding 时 EEG-FM 表征容量足够，且微调时后段 block 被重用、前段 block 已含任务相关信息。
Conclusion: 关于 EEG-FM 的结论高度依赖评测选择，因此未来评测应按扰动类型分别报告鲁棒性、产出 attribution 图并检验多种 pooling 策略，而不是只报干净精度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ReAlign: Generalizable Image Forgery Detection via Reasoning-Aligned Representation
papers.abstract_en: The rise of AI-generated images (AIGIs) poses growing challenges for digital authenticity, prompting the need for efficient, generalizable image forgery detection systems. Existing methods, whether non-LLM-based or LLM-based, exhibit distinct advantages and limitations. While non-LLM-based models offer efficient low-level artifact detection, they often lack semantic understanding. Conversely, LLM-based methods provide strong semantic reasoning and explainability but are computationally intensive and less sensitive to subtle visual artifacts. Moreover, the true contribution of explanatory reasoning texts to forgery detection performance remains unclear. In this work, we investigate the intrinsic value and potential of LLM-generated reasoning texts, considering it a source of generalization and semantic-error sensitivity. Based on these findings, we propose ReAlign, a novel framework that distills high-quality reasoning texts generated by a GRPO-optimized LLM into a lightweight AIGI detector via contrastive learning. ReAlign effectively inherits the generalization ability and semantic sensitivity capability of reasoning textual representations, while remaining efficient and lightweight for deployment. Moreover, ReAlign adopts a tailored joint optimization strategy that integrates contrastive loss for image-text alignment and classification loss for accurate forgery discrimination. Experimental results on AIGCDetectBenchmark, AIGI-Holmes, and our newly constructed UltraSynth-10k demonstrate that ReAlign consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art detectors in both accuracy and generalization, particularly when facing complex, high-fidelity forgeries from modern generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReAlign 把 GRPO 优化过的 LLM 生成的高质量推理文本，通过对比学习蒸馏进轻量 AIGI 检测器，并用图像-文本对齐损失与分类损失联合优化。在 AIGCDetectBenchmark、AIGI-Holmes 与自建 UltraSynth-10k 上，其准确率与泛化能力一致超过现有 SOTA 检测器，尤其面对现代生成模型的高保真伪造时，同时保留语义推理能力与部署效率。
Motivation: AI 生成图像 (AIGI) 泛滥需要可泛化的伪造检测；非 LLM 方法只抓低层伪影、缺语义理解，LLM 方法语义推理强但算力开销大、对细微视觉伪影不敏感，且解释性推理文本对检测性能的真实贡献尚不清楚。
Method: 先考察 LLM 生成推理文本作为泛化与语义错误敏感性来源的内在价值，再提出 ReAlign：用对比学习把 GRPO 优化的 LLM 产出的高质量推理文本蒸馏进轻量 AIGI 检测器，采用联合优化策略——图像-文本对齐的对比损失 + 伪造判别的分类损失。

papers.title: Road Maps as Free Geometric Priors: Weather-Invariant Drone Geo-Localization with GeoFuse
papers.abstract_en: Drone-view geo-localization aims to match a query drone image, often captured under adverse weather conditions (e.g., rain, snow, fog), against a gallery of geo-tagged satellite images. Weather-induced degradations in the drone view, such as noise, reduced visibility, and partial occlusions, severely exacerbate the intrinsic cross-view domain gap. While prior methods predominantly rely on weather-specific architectures or data augmentations, they have largely overlooked road map data, a readily available modality that provides strong, inherently weather-invariant geometric layout cues (e.g., road networks and building footprints) at negligible additional cost. We introduce GeoFuse, a cross-modal fusion framework that integrates precisely aligned road map tiles with satellite imagery to yield more discriminative and weather-resilient representations. We first augment the existing University-1652 and DenseUAV benchmarks with geo-aligned road maps, supplying structural priors robust to meteorological variations. Building on this, we propose a flexible fusion module that combines satellite and road map features via token-level and channel-level interactions, with a lightweight dynamic gating mechanism that adaptively weights modality contributions per instance. Finally, we employ class-level cross-view contrastive learning to promote robust alignment between weather-degraded drone features and the fused satellite-roadmap representations. Extensive experiments under diverse weather conditions show that GeoFuse consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving +3.46% and +23.18% Recall@1 accuracy on the University-1652 and DenseUAV benchmarks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoFuse 把对齐的道路地图 tile 与卫星图做跨模态融合，为无人机视角地理定位提供天气不变的几何先验，在雨雪雾退化的无人机图像上仍能保持判别性。在 University-1652 与 DenseUAV 上，Recall@1 分别比现有最优方法高 +3.46% 与 +23.18%。
Motivation: 雨、雪、雾造成的噪声、能见度下降与部分遮挡会放大无人机视角与卫星图之间的跨视角域差；现有方法多依赖天气专用架构或数据增强，忽略了几乎零成本、天然天气不变的道路地图几何线索。
Method: 先为 University-1652 与 DenseUAV 基准补充地理对齐的道路地图；融合模块通过 token 级与 channel 级交互结合卫星与地图特征，并用轻量动态门控按实例加权各模态贡献；最后用类别级跨视角对比学习对齐退化无人机特征与融合后的卫星-地图表示。
Result: 在多样天气条件下，GeoFuse 的 Recall@1 相比现有最优方法在 University-1652 上提升 +3.46%，在 DenseUAV 上提升 +23.18%。
Conclusion: 道路地图作为免费的几何先验，经 token/channel 融合与动态门控即可显著提升恶劣天气下的跨视角无人机地理定位精度。

papers.title: FactorizedHMR: A Hybrid Framework for Video Human Mesh Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Human Mesh Recovery (HMR) is fundamentally ambiguous: under occlusion or weak depth cues, multiple 3D bodies can explain the same image evidence. This ambiguity is not uniform across the body, as torso pose and root structure are often relatively well constrained, whereas distal articulations such as the arms and legs are more uncertain. Building on this observation, we propose FactorizedHMR, a two-stage framework that treats these two regimes differently. A deterministic regression module first recovers a stable torso-root anchor, and a probabilistic flow-matching module then completes the remaining non-torso articulation. To make this completion reliable, we combine a composite target representation with geometry-aware supervision and feature-aware classifier-free guidance, preserving the torso-root anchor while improving single-reference recovery of ambiguity-prone articulation. We also introduce a synthetic data pipeline that provides the paired image-camera-motion supervision under diverse viewpoints. Across camera-space and world-space benchmarks, FactorizedHMR remains competitive with strong baselines, with the clearest gains in occlusion-heavy recovery and drift-sensitive world-space metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactorizedHMR 把视频人体网格恢复 (Human Mesh Recovery) 的歧义按身体部位拆开处理：先用确定性回归模块固定相对受约束的躯干-根部锚点，再用概率 flow-matching 模块补全歧义大的四肢等非躯干关节，并配合复合目标表示、几何感知监督与 feature-aware classifier-free guidance。在相机空间与世界空间基准上与强基线持平，最明显的优势出现在重度遮挡恢复与对漂移敏感的世界空间指标上。
Motivation: 遮挡或深度线索弱时多个 3D 人体都能解释同一图像证据，且这种歧义在身体上分布不均：躯干姿态与根部结构相对受约束，手臂腿等远端关节不确定性高，单一模型难以同时处理两种体制。
Method: 两阶段框架：确定性回归模块先输出稳定的 torso-root anchor，概率 flow-matching 模块在此锚点条件下补全非躯干关节；监督上组合复合目标表示、几何感知损失与 feature-aware classifier-free guidance，在保留锚点的同时改善歧义关节的单参考恢复。另提出合成数据管线，提供配对的 image-camera-motion 监督并覆盖多样视角。
Result: 在相机空间与世界空间基准上，FactorizedHMR 与强基线保持竞争力，最清晰的增益出现在重度遮挡 (occlusion-heavy) 的恢复以及对漂移敏感的世界空间指标上。
Conclusion: 把人体网格恢复的歧义按躯干锚点与远端关节分而治之，配合合成配对监督，可在遮挡与漂移敏感场景下取得相对强基线的优势。

papers.title: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models
papers.abstract_en: Model merging combines task experts into one model and avoids joint training, retraining, or deploying many expert models, but the merged model often still underperforms task experts. We study this performance gap through feature drift, the difference between features produced by the merged model and by the expert on the same input. Our theory decomposes this drift into upstream propagation and local mismatch, tracks how it propagates and combines through later layers in forward order, and links final feature drift to output drift. This view motivates FeatCal, which uses a small calibration set to calibrate the merged model weights layer by layer in forward order, reducing feature drift while staying close to merged weights and preserving the benefits of model merging. FeatCal uses an efficient closed-form solution to update model weights, with no gradient descent, iterative optimization, or extra modules. On the main CLIP and GLUE benchmarks, FeatCal beats Surgery and ProbSurgery, the closest post-merging calibration baselines: 85.5% vs. 77.0%/78.8% on CLIP-ViT-B/32 Task Arithmetic (TA) and 85.2% vs. 83.7%/82.2% on FLAN-T5-base GLUE. On CLIP-ViT-B/32, 8 examples per task reach 82.9%, and 256 examples per task take 53 seconds, about 4x faster than both baselines, showing better sample efficiency and lower calibration cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FeatCal 用理论把合并模型与专家模型之间的特征漂移 (feature drift) 分解为上游传播与局部失配，据此按前向顺序逐层用闭式解校准合并权重，无需梯度下降或额外模块。在 CLIP-ViT-B/32 Task Arithmetic 上达到 85.5%，高于 Surgery 77.0% 与 ProbSurgery 78.8%；每任务 8 例即 82.9%，256 例校准仅 53 秒、约快 4 倍。
Motivation: 模型合并 (model merging) 免去联合训练却常落后于各任务专家，此前缺少对合并后性能差距的机理解释与低成本的后合并校准手段。
Method: 先从理论上把特征漂移分解为上游传播与局部失配，逐层前向追踪其传播并关联到输出漂移；再用小校准集按前向顺序逐层校准合并模型权重，以闭式解更新，保持接近合并权重，不用梯度下降、迭代优化或额外模块。
Result: CLIP-ViT-B/32 Task Arithmetic 上 85.5% vs. Surgery 77.0% / ProbSurgery 78.8%；FLAN-T5-base GLUE 上 85.2% vs. 83.7% / 82.2%；CLIP-ViT-B/32 每任务 8 例达 82.9%，每任务 256 例耗时 53 秒，约为两个基线的 4 倍速。
Conclusion: 合并模型的性能差距主要来自可逐层校正的特征漂移，闭式逐层校准能以更少样本和更低成本恢复大部分专家性能，同时保留模型合并免联合训练的收益。

papers.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced document understanding, yet current Doc-VQA evaluations score only the final answer and leave the supporting evidence unchecked. This answer-only approach masks a critical failure mode: a model can land on the correct answer while grounding it in the wrong passage---a critical risk in high-stakes domains like law, finance, and medicine, where every conclusion must be traceable to a specific source region. To address this, we introduce CiteVQA, a benchmark that requires models to return \textit{element-level} bounding-box citations alongside each answer, evaluating both jointly. CiteVQA comprises 1,897 questions across 711 PDFs spanning seven domains and two languages, averaging 40.6 pages per document. To ensure fidelity and scalability, the ground-truth citations are generated by an automated pipeline---which identifies crucial evidence via masking ablation and enforces multi-stage quality control. At the core of our evaluation is Strict Attributed Accuracy (SAA), which credits a prediction only when the answer and the cited region are both correct. Auditing 20 MLLMs reveals a pervasive Attribution Hallucination: models frequently produce the right answer while citing the wrong region. The strongest system (Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview) achieves an SAA of only 76.0, and the strongest open-source MLLM reaches just 22.5. Ultimately, towards trustworthy document intelligence, CiteVQA exposes a reliability gap that answer-only evaluations overlook, providing the instrumentation needed to close it. Our repository is available at https://github.com/opendatalab/CiteVQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CiteVQA 要求 Doc-VQA 模型在给出答案的同时返回元素级 bounding-box 引用，并用 Strict Attributed Accuracy (SAA) 只在答案与引用区域都正确时计分。审计 20 个 MLLM 普遍出现 Attribution Hallucination：答案对但引用错区域；最强系统 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 的 SAA 仅 76.0，最强开源模型仅 22.5。
Motivation: 现有 Doc-VQA 只判最终答案、不查支撑证据，掩盖了答案正确却落在错误段落的失败模式；在法律、金融、医疗等高风险领域，结论必须可追溯到具体来源区域。
Method: CiteVQA 含 1,897 个问题、711 份 PDF，覆盖七个领域与两种语言，文档平均 40.6 页；真值引用由自动化流水线生成，用 masking ablation 识别关键证据并施加多阶段质量控制；核心指标 SAA 要求答案与被引用区域同时正确。
Result: 对 20 个 MLLM 的审计显示普遍的 Attribution Hallucination（答案正确但引用错误区域）；Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 的 SAA 为 76.0，最强开源 MLLM 的 SAA 为 22.5。
Conclusion: 只看答案的评测会漏掉可靠性缺口，答案与证据引用必须联合评测才能逼近可信文档智能。

papers.title: Inference-Time Machine Unlearning via Gated Activation Redirection
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) memorize vast amounts of training data, raising concerns regarding privacy, copyright infringement, and safety. Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of a targeted forget set while preserving model performance, ideally approximating a model retrained from scratch without it. Once an LLM is in use, every new request to make it forget specific content demands updating its weights. However, unlearning through parameter updates is expensive, hard to audit, and can be undone by quantization. We show that unlearning can be enforced entirely at inference time, without training, gradients, or weight changes. We introduce Inference-Time Unlearning via Gated Activation Redirection (GUARD-IT), a training- and gradient-free method that unlearns via input-dependent activation steering at inference time. GUARD-IT stores the content to be forgotten as a small library of activation directions, and during inference, it routes each query through a similarity gate that activates only for relevant directions and applies them as a norm-preserving rotation of the residual stream, while unrelated queries pass through the unmodified model. The same design carries across three model families and nine checkpoints from 0.8B to 8B parameters, and new forget requests are absorbed by one offline pass of forward passes. On TOFU, against 16 gradient-based and inference-time baselines, and on MUSE and WMDP, GUARD-IT forgets without breaking the model, and on TOFU it is the only method that suppresses memorization in every Llama configuration without collapsing: it keeps utility and fluent generation in every configuration, moves the model's output distribution closest to a model that never saw the forgotten data on the forget01 split, survives 4- and 8-bit quantization and ten sequential forget requests, and holds under jailbreak attacks.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Expected Batch Optimal Transport Plans and Consequences for Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Solving optimal transport (OT) on random minibatches is a common surrogate for exact OT in large-scale learning. In flow matching (FM), this surrogate is used to obtain OT-like couplings that can straighten probability paths and reduce numerical integration cost. Yet, the population-level coupling induced by repeated minibatch OT remains only partially understood. We formalize this coupling as the expected batch OT plan $\overlineπ_{k}$, obtained by averaging empirical OT plans over independent minibatches of size $k$. We then establish its large-batch consistency and, in the semidiscrete case relevant to generative modeling, derive rates for both the transport-cost bias and the convergence of $\overlineπ_{k}$ to the OT plan. For FM, this yields a population coupling whose induced velocity field is regular enough to define a unique flow from the source to the discrete target. We finally quantify how OT batch size interacts with numerical integration in a tractable two-atom model and in synthetic and image experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把随机 minibatch 上重复求解 OT 所诱导的总体耦合形式化为 expected batch OT plan（对独立 minibatch 经验 OT plan 取平均），证明其大批次一致性，并在与生成建模相关的 semidiscrete 情形给出 transport-cost bias 与收敛速率。对 flow matching，该总体耦合诱导的速度场足够正则，可定义从源到离散目标的唯一流；OT batch size 与数值积分的相互作用在 two-atom 模型及合成、图像实验中被量化。
Motivation: 大规模学习中用随机 minibatch OT 代替精确 OT 是常见做法，但重复 minibatch OT 诱导的 population-level coupling 长期只被部分理解，其一致性、偏差与对 flow matching 速度场正则性的影响缺乏刻画。
Method: 将 expected batch OT plan 定义为对独立 minibatch（大小 k）经验 OT plan 的平均；证明其大批次一致性，并在 semidiscrete 情形推导 transport-cost bias 与 $ ar\pi_k$ 收敛到 OT plan 的速率；再分析该耦合诱导的速度场正则性，并在 two-atom 模型与合成、图像实验中量化 OT batch size 与数值积分的交互。
Result: 得到大批次一致性结论，以及 semidiscrete 情形下 transport-cost bias 和 $ ar\pi_k$ 收敛到 OT plan 的速率；证明 FM 中该总体耦合诱导的速度场足够正则，从而源到离散目标存在唯一流；并在 two-atom 可解模型与合成、图像实验中量化 OT batch size 与数值积分成本的相互作用。
Conclusion: minibatch OT 的总体耦合可被严格刻画并具有一致性与收敛速率，其诱导速度场正则到足以支撑 flow matching 的唯一流，batch size 与积分误差应一起考虑。

papers.title: Keeping Score: Adaptive, Tuning-Free Loss Weighting for Score-Augmented Neural Ratio Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Neural likelihood surrogates (e.g., Neural Ratio Estimation) for stochastic process models are commonly trained via probabilistic classification on simulated data, which forces a tradeoff between surrogate quality and training costs. For structured models where the exact score $\nabla_θ\log p(x \mid θ)$ is available, this information can be incorporated into training by augmenting the cross-entropy loss with a score-matching term. However, the optimal weighting of the two losses is not known a priori, and selecting it by hand requires expensive tuning that undercuts the computational savings. We propose an adaptive, tuning-free algorithm that sets the score loss weights during training based on loss gradients, adding minimal overhead to standard classifier training. We evaluate our approach on case studies involving network dynamics and spatial processes, demonstrating that it improves surrogate quality at a drastically lower computational cost than generating more training data. Notably, in some cases, our approach achieves downstream inference performance equivalent to a 10x increase in training data with less than a 1.1x increase in training time.
papers.comment: 8 pages of main text, 17 pages of appendices, 14 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自适应、免调参的损失加权算法，在神经比值估计 (NRE) 训练中根据损失梯度动态设定 score-matching 项权重，无需手工调权。在网络动力学与空间过程案例中，该方法以不到 1.1 倍训练时间达到等价于 10 倍训练数据的下游推断性能。
Motivation: 用模拟数据分类训练的神经似然代理 (NRE) 面临代理质量与训练成本的权衡；引入精确 score 项可改善质量，但两项损失的最优权重事先未知，手工调参的开销抵消了计算节省。
Method: 对可获得精确 score ∇_θ log p(x|θ) 的结构化随机过程模型，在交叉熵损失上加入 score-matching 项，并提出一种在训练中依据损失梯度自适应设定 score 损失权重的免调参算法，对标准分类器训练只增加极少开销。
Result: 在网络动力学与空间过程案例研究中，该方法提升代理质量，且计算成本远低于生成更多训练数据；在部分情形下，以不到 1.1 倍训练时间达到等价于 10 倍训练数据的下游推断性能。
Conclusion: 利用可得的精确 score 信息并自适应加权，可以在几乎不增加训练时间的前提下显著提升 NRE 代理质量与下游推断性能，比扩充模拟数据更划算。

papers.title: MedMemoryBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Personalized Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: The large-scale deployment of personalized healthcare agents demands memory mechanisms that are exceptionally precise, safe, and capable of long-term clinical tracking. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on daily open-domain conversations, failing to capture the high-stakes complexity of real-world medical applications. Motivated by the stringent production requirements of an industry-leading health management agent serving tens of millions of active users, we introduce MedMemoryBench. We develop a human-agent collaborative pipeline to synthesize highly realistic, long-horizon medical trajectories based on clinically grounded, synthetic patient archetypes. This process yields a massive, expertly validated dataset comprising approximately 2,000 sessions and 16,000 interaction turns. Crucially, MedMemoryBench departs from traditional static evaluations by pioneering an "evaluate-while-constructing" streaming assessment protocol, which precisely mirrors dynamic memory accumulation in production environments. Furthermore, we formalize and systematically investigate the critical phenomenon of memory saturation, where sustained information influx actively degrades retrieval and reasoning robustness. Comprehensive benchmarking reveals severe bottlenecks in mainstream architectures, particularly concerning complex medical reasoning and noise resilience. By exposing these fundamental flaws, MedMemoryBench establishes a vital foundation for developing robust, production-ready medical agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedMemoryBench 是面向个性化医疗智能体记忆的基准，用人工-智能协作流水线基于临床合成患者原型生成长程医疗轨迹，并首创边构建边评估 (evaluate-while-constructing) 的流式评测协议以模拟生产环境中的动态记忆累积。数据集约 2,000 个 session、16,000 个交互轮次，经专家验证；系统考察 memory saturation 现象，发现主流架构在复杂医疗推理与噪声鲁棒性上存在严重瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆基准集中在日常开放域对话，无法覆盖真实医疗场景的高风险复杂度与长期临床追踪需求，而生产级健康管理智能体（服务数千万活跃用户）对记忆的精确性与安全性要求极高。
Method: 构建人工-智能协作流水线，基于临床依据的合成患者原型合成高真实度长程医疗轨迹，产出经专家验证的数据集；采用边构建边评估的流式评测协议，替代传统静态评测，并形式化并系统研究 memory saturation（持续信息流入导致检索与推理鲁棒性退化）。
Result: 数据集规模约 2,000 个 session、16,000 个交互轮次；对主流架构的综合评测显示其在复杂医疗推理与噪声鲁棒性上存在严重瓶颈。
Conclusion: 医疗智能体的记忆在持续信息流入下会饱和并损害检索与推理，现有主流架构不足以支撑生产级医疗部署，该基准为构建稳健可上线的医疗智能体提供评测基础。

papers.title: Remember to Forget: Gated Adaptive Positional Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Rotary Positional Encoding (RoPE) is widely used in modern large language models. However, when sequences are extended beyond the range seen during training, rotary phases can enter out-of-distribution regimes, leading to spurious long-range alignments, diffuse attention, and degraded retrieval. Existing remedies only partially address these failures, as they often trade local positional resolution for long-context stability. We propose GAPE (Gated Adaptive Positional Encoding), a drop-in augmentation for positional encodings that introduces a content-aware bias directly into the attention logits while preserving the rotary geometry. GAPE decouples distance-based suppression from token importance through a query-dependent gate that contracts irrelevant context and a key-dependent gate that preserves salient distant tokens. We show that weakly protected distant context is exponentially attenuated as a function of the query gate, while selected keys can remain accessible through landmark protection. We further show that GAPE can be implemented within standard scaled dot-product attention. Empirically, GAPE improves long-context robustness across controlled retrieval and language-modeling experiments, extrapolating up to 8x the training length. We further retrofit GAPE into a pretrained 7B model, maintaining performance on standard benchmarks and improving performance at the longest evaluated context. These results support adaptive context suppression as a complement to positional representation for long-context generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAPE 在 RoPE 注意力 logit 上加内容感知偏置，用 query 门压缩无关上下文、key 门保留远处显著 token，在保持旋转几何的同时把距离抑制与 token 重要性解耦。受弱保护的远距离上下文随 query 门指数衰减，被选中的 key 经 landmark protection 保持可达；实验中可外推到训练长度的 8 倍，并可改装进预训练 7B 模型。
Motivation: 序列超出训练长度时旋转相位进入分布外区间，产生虚假远距离对齐、注意力弥散与检索退化；现有补救常以牺牲局部位置分辨率为代价换取长上下文稳定性。
Method: GAPE 作为位置编码的即插即用增强：在注意力 logit 中注入内容感知偏置，query 依赖门收缩无关上下文、key 依赖门保留显著远距离 token，且可嵌入标准 scaled dot-product attention；同时给出弱保护上下文随 query 门指数衰减与 landmark protection 的理论刻画，并改装进预训练 7B 模型。
Result: 在受控检索与语言建模实验中提升长上下文鲁棒性，外推至训练长度的 8 倍；改装到预训练 7B 模型后在标准 benchmark 上保持性能，并在最长评估上下文处提升表现。
Conclusion: 自适应上下文抑制可作为位置表示的补充，用于长上下文泛化，且不必牺牲旋转编码的几何结构。

papers.title: ERASE: Eliminating Redundant Visual Tokens via Adaptive Two-Stage Token Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable large language models (LLMs) to process high-resolution images, significantly improving real-world multimodal understanding. However, this capability introduces a large number of vision tokens, incurring substantial computational overhead. To mitigate this issue, various vision token compression methods have been proposed. Existing methods often estimate different sources of visual redundancy using learned representations or fixed pruning schedules. We propose ERASE, an adaptive two-stage framework that separates image-level redundancy removal from instruction-dependent token pruning. Stage 1 derives image-dependent token retention from lightweight raw-image statistics, while Stage 2 progressively removes instruction-irrelevant tokens across decoder layers. Experiments demonstrate substantial token reduction while preserving accuracy: on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, ERASE retains 95.70% of the original model's accuracy at 25% token retention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tuna-Luna/ERASE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ERASE 把 VLM 的视觉 token 压缩拆成两级：先用轻量原始图像统计做图像级冗余剔除，再按指令在解码器各层逐步删掉与指令无关的 token。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，保留 25% token 时仍保住原模型 95.70% 的准确率。
Motivation: 高分辨率图像给 VLM 带来大量 vision token，计算开销显著；现有压缩方法用学习表征或固定剪枝日程估计冗余，无法同时区分图像级与指令级冗余。
Method: 两阶段自适应框架：Stage 1 从轻量原始图像统计导出图像相关的 token 保留率，Stage 2 在解码器各层逐层移除与指令无关的 token，代码已开源。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，25% token 保留率下达到原模型 95.70% 的准确率，同时实现大幅 token 削减。
Conclusion: 把图像级冗余与指令级冗余分开处理，可以在只保留四分之一 token 的情况下基本保住 VLM 精度。

papers.title: DCVD: Dual-Channel Cross-Modal Fusion for Joint Vulnerability Detection and Localization
papers.abstract_en: Software vulnerability detection plays a critical role in ensuring system security, where real-world auditing requires not only determining whether a function is vulnerable but also pinpointing the specific lines responsible. However, existing approaches either rely on a single information source -- sequential, structural, or semantic -- failing to jointly exploit the complementary strengths across modalities, or treat statement-level localization merely as a byproduct of function-level detection without explicit line-level supervision. To address these limitations, we propose DCVD (Dual-Channel Cross-Modal Vulnerability Detection), a unified framework that performs joint function-level detection and statement-level localization. DCVD extracts control-dependency and semantic features through two parallel branches and integrates them via contrastive alignment coupled with bidirectional cross-attention, effectively bridging the cross-modal representation gap. It further introduces explicit supervision signals at both the function and statement levels, enabling collaborative optimization across the two granularities. Extensive experiments on a large-scale real-world vulnerability benchmark demonstrate that DCVD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both function-level detection and statement-level localization. Our code is available at https://github.com/vinsontang1/DCVD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCVD 把函数级漏洞检测与语句级定位放进同一框架：双分支分别提取控制依赖特征与语义特征，用对比对齐加双向跨注意力融合，并在函数与语句两个粒度上施加显式监督。在大规模真实漏洞基准上，函数级检测与语句级定位均持续优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有方法要么只用单一信息源（序列、结构或语义）无法互补，要么把语句级定位当作函数级检测的副产品、缺少显式行级监督，难以满足真实审计中既要判断函数是否有漏洞、又要定位到具体行的需求。
Method: DCVD 采用双通道结构：一条分支提取控制依赖特征，另一条提取语义特征，通过对比对齐 (contrastive alignment) 与双向跨注意力 (bidirectional cross-attention) 融合以弥合跨模态表示差距；同时在函数级与语句级引入显式监督信号，使两个粒度协同优化。
Result: 在大规模真实漏洞基准 (large-scale real-world vulnerability benchmark) 上，DCVD 在函数级检测与语句级定位两项任务上均持续优于最先进方法；代码已开源至 github.com/vinsontang1/DCVD。
Conclusion: 联合建模并显式监督函数级与语句级两个粒度，配合跨模态融合，是同时做好漏洞判定与行级定位的有效路径。

papers.title: Transfer Learning of Multiobjective Indirect Low-Thrust Trajectories Using Diffusion Models and Markov Chain Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Preliminary low-thrust spacecraft mission design is a global search problem characterized by a complex solution landscape, multiple objectives, and numerous local minima. During this phase, mission parameters are often not yet fully defined, requiring new solutions to be generated at a high cadence across varying parameter values. When combined with the indirect approach to optimal control, diffusion models can accelerate this search by learning distributions that represent high-quality initial costates. However, generating training data remains expensive, and opportunities exist to better exploit past data. We propose a transfer-learning framework that combines homotopy in a mission parameter with Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to generate training data more efficiently. The approach reformulates a multiobjective optimization problem as sampling from an unnormalized target distribution in costate space. We compare three MCMC algorithms on a planar multi-revolution transfer in the circular restricted three-body problem, with homotopy in the system mass parameter. The results show that gradient-based MCMC variants achieve the best trade-off between sample quality and computational cost. For the test transfer, the proposed framework generates 40 % more feasible solutions and achieves a higher-quality Pareto front than a state-of-the-art indirect approach based on adjoint control transformations and gradient-based optimization. Finally, the MCMC-generated samples are used to fine-tune a diffusion model conditioned on the mass parameter, enabling it to learn a global representation of the underlying solution distribution and efficiently generate new solutions. These findings establish the transfer-learning framework as a practical method for efficiently solving indirect trajectory optimization problems with varying parameters.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把低推力间接轨迹优化的多目标问题改写为在 costate 空间对未归一化目标分布采样，用任务参数的同伦 (homotopy) 加 MCMC 高效生成训练数据，再微调以质量参数为条件的 diffusion model。在圆型限制性三体问题的平面多圈转移上，梯度型 MCMC 在样本质量与计算开销之间折中最好；相对基于伴随控制变换与梯度优化的 SOTA 间接方法，该框架多生成 40% 可行解并得到更高质量的 Pareto front。
Motivation: 低推力任务初步设计是多目标、多局部极小的全局搜索，参数尚未定型时需要高频生成新解；间接法初始 costate 难寻，而 diffusion model 的训练数据生成本身昂贵，历史数据也未被充分利用。
Method: 将多目标优化重构为 costate 空间中对未归一化目标分布的采样问题，用任务参数同伦结合 MCMC 生成训练数据；在 CR3BP 平面多圈转移上比较三种 MCMC 算法（系统质量参数同伦），最后用 MCMC 样本微调以质量参数为条件的 diffusion model。
Result: 梯度型 MCMC 变体在样本质量与计算成本之间取得最佳折中；在测试转移上，该框架比基于伴随控制变换与梯度优化的 SOTA 间接方法多生成 40% 可行解，并得到更高质量的 Pareto front。
Conclusion: 同伦加 MCMC 的迁移学习框架可作为求解参数变化的间接轨迹优化问题的实用方法，其生成的样本足以让条件 diffusion model 学到解分布的全局表示并快速产出新解。

papers.title: Can MLLMs Reason About Visual Persuasion? Evaluating the Efficacy and Faithfulness of Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Persuasive visuals play a central role in advertising, public communication, and online media, making it increasingly important to understand whether an image is persuasive and why. However, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have limited ability to reason about visual persuasion. Our analysis reveals that models often rely on a shortcut---selectively citing easily recognizable visual elements and treating their mere presence as evidence of persuasiveness---rather than reasoning over the diverse visual cues in an image to determine how and why they contribute to persuasiveness. To address this limitation, we propose (1) a fine-tuning approach that trains models on rationales reflecting diverse perspectives on visual persuasiveness, and (2) an evaluation framework that measures the faithfulness of models' rationales through three complementary metrics. Fine-tuning on multi-perspective rationales improves persuasiveness prediction and reasoning effectiveness. However, our evaluation framework reveals a discrepancy between prediction performance and rationale faithfulness, showing that higher prediction performance does not necessarily correspond to more faithful reasoning. These findings highlight the need to evaluate effectiveness and faithfulness separately and inform future directions for improving both the training and evaluation of visual persuasion reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLLM 在视觉说服 (visual persuasion) 推理上走捷径：只挑易识别的视觉元素、把其存在本身当作说服力证据。用多视角 rationale 微调能提升说服力预测与推理效果，但新评估框架的三项 faithfulness 指标显示预测性能更高并不等于 rationale 更忠实，因此效果与忠实度必须分开评。
Motivation: MLLM 缺乏对图像说服力如何与为何成立的推理能力，倾向把可识别视觉元素的存在直接当作证据，导致预测分数与推理忠实度脱节。
Method: 提出两部分：一是基于多视角视觉说服 rationale 的微调方法；二是含三项互补指标的评估框架，用于度量模型 rationale 的 faithfulness。
Result: 多视角 rationale 微调提升说服力预测与推理效果；评估框架揭示预测性能与 rationale 忠实度之间存在落差，即更高的预测表现不必然对应更忠实的推理。
Conclusion: 视觉说服推理的 effectiveness 与 faithfulness 应当分开评估，训练与评测两条线都需要同时改进。

papers.title: The Minimax Rate of Perturbed Second-Order Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Second-order calibration error quantifies how closely a higher-order predictor's epistemic-uncertainty estimate matches the conditional variance of the label probability on its level sets. We characterize the minimax rate of estimating the second-order calibration error for binary classification in the regime where a small perturbation is applied to the classifier outputs. Our procedure is simple: add independent bandwidth-$h$ sech noise to the score coordinates, then regress $Y^{(1)}$ and $Y^{(1)}Y^{(2)}$ on the perturbed score using low-degree polynomials. Crucially, the sech perturbation makes the calibration functions analytic in a suitable strip. The resulting estimator has error $O_h(\log^{3/2}n/\sqrt n)$, with explicit constants. In the same setting, a matching $Ω(1/\sqrt{n})$ lower bound establishes minimax optimality up to logarithmic factors. As a corollary, we give a finite-sample guarantee for perturbed second-order Platt scaling, yielding a post-hoc procedure that recalibrates both the mean prediction and the epistemic-variance estimate of the perturbed higher-order predictor. Along the way, we give an explicit two-moment formulation of second-order calibration error and relate it quantitatively to the bucketed formulation of Ahdritz et al. [2025]. Our experiments confirm the predicted rate and the quality of the recalibrated uncertainties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出二分类下扰动二阶校准误差 (perturbed second-order calibration error) 的 minimax 估计速率：对分类器分数加带宽 h 的独立 sech 噪声，再用低次多项式回归 Y^(1) 与 Y^(1)Y^(2)，估计误差为 O_h(log^{3/2}n/√n)，并配 Ω(1/√n) 下界，说明在对数因子内 minimax 最优。作为推论得到有限样本保证的扰动二阶 Platt scaling，同时重校准均值预测与认知不确定性估计。
Motivation: 高阶预测器给出的认知不确定性估计是否匹配标签概率在其水平集上的条件方差，缺少可估计性与速率层面的刻画；直接估计二阶校准误差在非解析设定下难以得到 minimax 结论。
Method: 对分数坐标加独立带宽 h 的 sech 噪声，使校准函数在某个带状区域内解析；随后用低次多项式把 Y^(1) 与 Y^(1)Y^(2) 回归到扰动后的分数上，得到显式常数的估计量。另给出二阶校准误差的显式两矩 (two-moment) 表述，并与 Ahdritz et al. [2025] 的分桶 (bucketed) 表述做定量关联。
Result: 估计误差上界 O_h(log^{3/2}n/√n)，常数显式；同设定下 Ω(1/√n) 的匹配下界，故 minimax 最优至多差对数因子。推论给出扰动二阶 Platt scaling 的有限样本保证。实验验证了预测的速率与重校准后不确定性的质量。
Conclusion: sech 扰动带来的解析性使二阶校准误差可被低次多项式回归高效估计，且该速率在对数因子内不可改进；相应的后处理流程可同时重校准均值与认知方差。
