papers.title: APEX: Assumption-free Projection-based Embedding eXamination Metric for Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: As generative models achieve unprecedented visual quality, the gold standard for image evaluation remains traditional feature-distribution metrics (e.g., FID). However, these metrics are provably hindered by the closed-vocabulary bottleneck of outdated features and the assumptive bias of rigid parametric formulations. Recent alternatives exploit modern backbones to solve the feature bottleneck, yet continue to suffer from parametric limitations. To close this gap, we introduce APEX (Assumption-free Projection-based Embedding eXamination), a novel evaluation framework leveraging the Sliced Wasserstein Distance as a mathematically grounded, assumption-free similarity measure. APEX inherits effective scalability to high-dimensional spaces, as we prove with theoretical and empirical evidences. Moreover, APEX is embedding-agnostic and uses two open-vocabulary foundation models, CLIP and DINOv2, as feature extractors. Benchmarking APEX against established baselines reveals superior robustness to visual degradations. Additionally, we show that APEX metrics exhibit intra- and cross-dataset stability, ensuring highly stable evaluations on out-of-domain datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APEX 用 Sliced Wasserstein Distance 替代 FID 这类参数化分布距离，配合 CLIP 与 DINOv2 两个开放词表基础模型做特征提取，构成无假设的图像质量评估框架。作者证明其在高维空间可扩展，并在基准测试中对视觉退化更鲁棒、跨数据集评估更稳定。
Motivation: FID 等传统特征分布指标受限于过时特征的封闭词表瓶颈与刚性参数化公式的假设偏差，现代 backbone 的替代方案仍受参数化限制。

papers.title: SAM 3D Animal: Promptable Animal 3D Reconstruction from Images in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: 3D animal reconstruction in the wild remains challenging due to large species variation, frequent occlusions, and the prevalence of multi-animal scenes, while existing methods predominantly focus on single-animal settings. We present SAM 3D Animal, the first promptable framework for multi-animal 3D reconstruction from a single image. Built on the SMAL+ parametric animal model, our method jointly reconstructs multiple instances and supports flexible prompts in the form of keypoints and masks which enable more reliable disambiguation in crowded and occluded scenes. To train such a model, we further introduce Herd3D, a multi-animal 3D dataset containing over 5K images, designed to increase diversity in species, interactions, and occlusion patterns. Experiments on the Animal3D, APTv2, and Animal Kingdom datasets show that our framework achieves state-of-the-art results over both existing model-based and model-free methods, demonstrating a scalable and effective solution for prompt-driven animal 3D reconstruction in the wild.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAM 3D Animal 是首个可提示 (promptable) 的单图多动物 3D 重建框架，基于 SMAL+ 参数化动物模型联合重建多个实例，用 keypoints 与 masks 提示在拥挤遮挡场景中消歧。配套发布含 5K+ 图像的 Herd3D 多动物数据集，在 Animal3D、APTv2、Animal Kingdom 上取得超越现有 model-based 与 model-free 方法的 SOTA 结果。
Motivation: 野外 3D 动物重建受物种差异大、频繁遮挡、多动物场景普遍困扰，而现有方法基本只处理单动物设定。
Method: 以 SMAL+ 参数化动物模型为基底，联合重建多实例，支持 keypoints 与 masks 两类灵活提示做遮挡与拥挤场景消歧；训练数据为新提出的 Herd3D，含 5K+ 图像，覆盖物种、个体交互与遮挡模式的多样性。
Result: Herd3D 数据集含超过 5K 图像；在 Animal3D、APTv2、Animal Kingdom 三个数据集上，相对既有 model-based 与 model-free 方法均达到 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: 提示驱动的参数化模型路线可扩展到野外多动物 3D 重建，是该设定下比单动物方法更有效的方案。

papers.title: LiteGUI: Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-Solution Guided Distillation and Dual-Level Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present LiteGUI, a new framework for building lightweight GUI agents. GUI interaction poses unique challenges due to the long-horizon nature of complex tasks and the existence of multiple valid interaction paths, which are difficult for lightweight GUI agents to handle effectively. To address these challenges, LiteGUI introduces a two-stage post-training framework operating on logged GUI states. First, we propose Guided On-Policy Distillation, which provides training-time privileged teacher guidance at each GUI state by selecting the most-matched valid action from human-verified multi-solution action annotations, while leaving the student's on-policy rollout unchanged. Second, we develop Multi-Solution Dual-Level GRPO, which combines action-level supervision with history-conditioned, per-state planning-quality supervision while accounting for multiple valid actions at each logged GUI state. Together, these stages support multi-step GUI tasks without requiring the student to reproduce fixed demonstration trajectories. We further develop a scalable data generation pipeline and a corresponding multi-solution dataset, Lite-Dataset, to support the training and evaluation of GUI agents, addressing a gap in the existing literature. Extensive experiments across multiple GUI benchmarks demonstrate that LiteGUI substantially improves the performance of lightweight GUI agents over existing training paradigms, including SFT, on-policy distillation and GRPO, and achieves competitive or superior performance compared with substantially larger models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiteGUI 是面向轻量 GUI agent 的两阶段后训练框架：先用 Guided On-Policy Distillation 在每个 logged GUI 状态上从人工核验的多解动作标注中挑最匹配动作做特权教师引导，再用 Multi-Solution Dual-Level GRPO 同时施加动作级与历史条件下的逐状态规划质量监督。学生不必复现固定示范轨迹，在多个 GUI benchmark 上显著优于 SFT、on-policy distillation 与 GRPO，并与大得多的模型相当或更优。
Motivation: 复杂 GUI 任务时程长且每个状态存在多条有效交互路径，轻量 agent 难以处理；现有训练范式要求复现固定示范轨迹，且缺少配套的多解数据集。
Method: 两阶段后训练，作用于 logged GUI 状态：第一阶段 Guided On-Policy Distillation 在每个状态提供训练期特权教师引导（从 human-verified 多解动作标注中选最匹配有效动作），不改动 student 的 on-policy rollout；第二阶段 Multi-Solution Dual-Level GRPO 把动作级监督与历史条件的 per-state 规划质量监督结合，并容忍每个状态的多个有效动作。另配套可扩展数据生成管线与 Lite-Dataset。
Result: 在多个 GUI benchmark 上，LiteGUI 相比 SFT、on-policy distillation 和 GRPO 等既有训练范式显著提升轻量 GUI agent 表现，并相对规模大得多的模型达到相当或更优性能。
Conclusion: 多解标注加双层强化学习的后训练可以让轻量 GUI agent 学会多步任务，而不必绑定单一示范轨迹；配套的 Lite-Dataset 补上了该方向的数据缺口。

papers.title: Beyond Fixed Benchmarks and Worst-Case Attacks: Dynamic Boundary Evaluation for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) today rests on fixed benchmarks that apply the same set of items to any model, producing ceiling and floor effects that mask capability gaps. We argue that the most informative evaluation signal lies at the boundary, where the per-prompt pass probability is near $0.5$ under random-sampling decoding strategy, and propose Dynamic Boundary Evaluation (DBE), which actively locates each model's boundary and places it on a globally comparable difficulty scale. DBE delivers three artifacts: (i) a calibrated item bank covering safety, capability, and truthfulness, with per-item difficulty labels validated across $9$ reference LLMs; (ii) Skill-Guided Boundary Search (SGBS), a search algorithm that finds boundary items for a given target LLM using only API-level query access; and (iii) an evaluation protocol that places a new LLM on a unified ability scale and grows the evaluation set adaptively when the target falls outside the bank's coverage. We instantiate DBE on four categories spanning safety (harmful request refusal, over-refusal), capability (constrained instruction following), and truthfulness (multi-turn sycophancy resistance). The resulting evaluation covers a broader model spectrum without saturation while remaining compatible with existing datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dynamic Boundary Evaluation (DBE)，把 LLM 评测从固定题集转向主动搜索每道题通过概率接近 0.5 的边界题，并把模型放到统一难度标尺上。该边界信号在 9 个参考 LLM 上校准题库难度标签，覆盖安全、能力、真实性四类任务，避免天花板/地板效应导致的能力区分失效。
Motivation: 固定基准对所有模型用同一套题，产生天花板与地板效应，掩盖模型间真实能力差距。
Method: DBE 产出三件套：跨 9 个参考 LLM 校准的题库（安全、能力、真实性，含逐题难度标签）；仅用 API 查询访问的 Skill-Guided Boundary Search (SGBS) 搜索目标模型的边界题；把新 LLM 放到统一能力标尺、并在题库覆盖不足时自适应扩充评测集的协议。
Result: 在四类任务上实例化 DBE：有害请求拒答、过度拒答、受约束指令遵循、多轮谄媚抵抗 (multi-turn sycophancy resistance)；评测覆盖更宽的模型谱且无饱和，同时与既有数据集兼容。
Conclusion: 评测信息集中在通过概率约 0.5 的边界处，主动定位边界并放到全局可比难度标尺上，比固定题集更能区分模型能力。

papers.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width. Specifically, the framework identifies compact backbones via Neural Architecture Search (AutoFormer), reduces information processing via token merging (ToMe), and accelerates per-operation execution via fp16 mixed-precision inference. In our study, we analyze accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on ImageNet-1K under aggressive compression. We then apply the selected configaturions to a real-world in-house 3D X-ray semiconductor defect classification dataset for IC chip packaging inspection. Results show that the proposed multi-axis framework achieves more than $10\times$ improvement in throughput along with over $10\times$ reductions in parameter count, FLOPs, and energy consumption, while maintaining the required accuracy on the downstream industrial task. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the earliest works to jointly optimize architecture, token, and bit-width dimensions in ViTs and the first such resource-efficient, deployment-focused study tailored to semiconductor manufacturing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出同时优化架构、token、bit-width 三个轴的 ViT 部署框架：用 AutoFormer 做 NAS 找紧凑 backbone，用 ToMe 合并 token，再上 fp16 混合精度推理。在 ImageNet-1K 上分析激进压缩下的精度-效率权衡，再把选定配置迁移到内部 3D X-ray 半导体缺陷分类数据集，吞吐提升 10 倍以上，参数量、FLOPs 与能耗各降 10 倍以上，同时保住下游任务所需精度。
Motivation: ViT 在资源受限工业环境部署受高算力、高显存、高能耗制约；已有 NAS、token 压缩、低精度推理各自单独研究，只压单一轴限制了整体部署收益。
Method: 三轴联合框架：Neural Architecture Search 用 AutoFormer 搜紧凑 backbone，token merging 用 ToMe 减少信息处理量，per-operation 执行用 fp16 混合精度推理；先在 ImageNet-1K 上分析精度-效率权衡，再把选出的配置应用到内部 3D X-ray 半导体缺陷分类数据集（IC 封装检测）。
Result: 在下游工业任务上吞吐提升超过 10 倍，参数量、FLOPs、能耗各下降超过 10 倍，同时保持所需精度；精度-效率权衡分析在 ImageNet-1K 激进压缩设定下进行。
Conclusion: 架构、token、bit-width 三轴联合优化能在保住工业任务精度的前提下同时拿到数量级的吞吐与资源收益，且是面向半导体制造的最早一批部署导向研究之一。

papers.title: CMGL: Confidence-guided Multi-omics Graph Learning for Cancer Subtype Classification
papers.abstract_en: Motivation: Multi-omics integration can improve cancer subtyping, but modality informativeness and noise vary across cancer types and patients. Most graph methods for multi-omics data learn modality contributions within the downstream classification objective, leaving predictive reliability for each patient implicit. As a result, uninformative modalities can weaken the fused representation, while unreliable omics can introduce noisy patient relationships into graph propagation. To address these two problems, we propose CMGL, which produces a separate reliability estimate before fusion and uses consensus patient neighborhoods for graph classification. Results: CMGL estimates modality confidence for each patient through evidential deep learning, fixes these values during fusion across omics, and performs classification on an independently specified consistency graph. On four MLOmics cancer-subtype tasks and the 32-class pan-cancer task, CMGL consistently improves over the strongest baseline, surpassing it by 4.03% in average accuracy on the four single-cancer tasks. Its representations recover the PAM50 intrinsic subtypes of breast invasive carcinoma (BRCA), and the model trained on BRCA transfers without fine tuning to kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC), stratifying patients into prognostically distinct groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CMGL 在融合前用 evidential deep learning 为每位患者单独估计各组学模态的置信度并固定，再在独立指定的一致性图 (consistency graph) 上做分类，避免不可靠组学把噪声关系带进图传播。在四个 MLOmics 癌症亚型任务上平均准确率比最强基线高 4.03%，其表征可恢复 BRCA 的 PAM50 亚型，且在 BRCA 上训练的模型零微调迁移到 KIRC 仍能分出预后不同的患者组。
Motivation: 多组学融合中各模态的信息量与噪声随癌种和患者变化，而现有图方法只在下游分类目标里隐式学模态权重，导致无信息模态削弱融合表征、不可靠组学向图传播注入噪声患者关系。
Method: CMGL 先用 evidential deep learning 对每位患者估计各组学模态的置信度，融合时把这些置信度固定，再在一个独立指定的一致性患者邻域图上做图分类；评测覆盖四个 MLOmics 单癌种亚型任务与 32 类泛癌任务。
Result: 在四个 MLOmics 单癌种任务上平均准确率超过最强基线 4.03%，并在 32 类泛癌任务上一致优于最强基线；表征恢复了 BRCA 的 PAM50 内在亚型，BRCA 上训练的模型零微调迁移到 KIRC 后可把患者分为预后显著不同的组。
Conclusion: 把模态可靠性作为融合前的独立估计并配合一致性图，能在多组学癌症亚型分类中稳定超过最强基线，并让学到的表征跨癌种迁移且保留预后信息。

papers.title: LearnPruner: Rethinking Attention-based Token Pruning in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding and reasoning, but they also impose significant computational burdens due to long visual sequence inputs. Recent works address this issue by pruning unimportant visual tokens, achieving substantial computational reduction while maintaining model performance. The core of token pruning lies in determining token importance, with current approaches primarily relying on attention scores from vision encoders or Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we analyze the effectiveness of attention mechanisms in both vision encoders and LLMs. We find that vision encoders suffer from attention sink, leading to poor focus on informative foreground regions, while in LLMs, although prior studies have identified attention bias toward token positions, text-to-vision attention demonstrates resistance to this bias and enables effective pruning guidance in middle layers. Based on these observations, we propose LearnPruner, a two-stage token pruning framework that first removes redundant vision tokens via a learnable pruning module after the vision encoder, then retains only task-relevant tokens in the LLM's middle layer. Experimental results show that our LearnPruner can preserve approximately 95% of the original performance while using only 5.5% of vision tokens, and achieve 3.2$\times$ inference acceleration, demonstrating a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

TL;DR: LearnPruner 指出视觉编码器的 attention sink 使注意力无法聚焦前景，而 LLM 中层的 text-to-vision 注意力对位置偏置有抵抗力，可作为剪枝依据；据此做两阶段剪枝：视觉编码器后用可学习模块删冗余 token，再在 LLM 中层只保留任务相关 token。仅用 5.5% 视觉 token 保住约 95% 原始性能，推理加速 3.2×。
Motivation: VLM 的长视觉序列带来沉重计算开销，现有 token 剪枝依赖视觉编码器或 LLM 的注意力分数判定重要性，但编码器注意力存在 attention sink、难以聚焦前景信息区域。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段在视觉编码器之后接一个可学习的剪枝模块 (learnable pruning module) 删除冗余视觉 token；第二阶段在 LLM 的中间层依据 text-to-vision 注意力只保留任务相关 token。
Result: 仅使用 5.5% 的视觉 token 即保留约 95% 的原始性能，推理加速 3.2×，在精度-效率权衡上优于对照方法。
Conclusion: 视觉编码器注意力不适合直接指导剪枝，而 LLM 中层的 text-to-vision 注意力可用；两阶段剪枝能在极少 token 下维持性能并显著提速。

papers.title: SparKV: Overhead-Aware KV Cache Loading for Efficient On-Device LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Efficient inference for on-device Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging due to limited hardware resources and the high cost of the prefill stage, which processes the full input context to construct Key-Value (KV) caches. We present SparKV, an adaptive KV loading framework that combines cloud-based KV streaming with on-device computation. SparKV models the cost of individual KV chunks and decides whether each chunk should be streamed or computed locally, while overlapping the two execution paths to reduce latency. To handle fluctuations in wireless connectivity and edge resource availability, SparKV further refines offline-generated schedules at runtime to rebalance communication and computation costs. Experiments across diverse datasets, LLMs, and edge devices show that SparKV reduces Time-to-First-Token by 1.3$x-5.1x with negligible impact on response quality, while lowering per-request energy consumption by 1.5x to 3.3x, demonstrating its robustness and practicality for real-world on-device deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparKV 面向端侧 LLM 推理，为每个 KV chunk 建模成本并决定走云端流式传输还是本地 prefill 计算，两条路径重叠执行，且在运行时按无线连接与边缘资源波动重排离线调度。跨多种数据集、模型与边缘设备的实验中，Time-to-First-Token 降低 1.3x–5.1x，单请求能耗降低 1.5x–3.3x，响应质量影响可忽略。
Motivation: 端侧 LLM 受硬件资源限制，prefill 需处理全部输入上下文来构造 KV cache，成本高；无线连接与边缘资源又会波动，固定调度无法兼顾通信与计算开销。
Method: SparKV 是自适应 KV 加载框架：对单个 KV chunk 建模成本，决定流式传输或本地计算，并重叠两条执行路径以降延迟；运行时再细化离线生成的调度，重新平衡通信与计算开销。
Result: 在多样数据集、LLM 与边缘设备上，Time-to-First-Token 降低 1.3x–5.1x，响应质量影响可忽略；每请求能耗降低 1.5x–3.3x。
Conclusion: 按 chunk 粒度做云端流式与本地计算的取舍并随运行时资源重排，可在真实端侧部署中同时压低首 token 延迟与能耗而不明显牺牲质量。

papers.title: Learning to Emulate Chaos: Adversarial Optimal Transport Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Chaos arises in many complex dynamical systems, from weather to power grids, but is difficult to accurately model with data-driven methods such as machine learning emulators. While emulators are promising tools for accelerating simulations and solving inverse problems, they still struggle to learn chaotic dynamics, where sensitivity to initial conditions renders exact long-term forecasts infeasible, especially given noisy data. Recent work instead trains emulators to match the statistical properties of chaotic attractors, but these approaches often rely on handcrafted summary statistics or large, diverse multi-environment datasets. In this work, we propose a family of adversarial optimal transport objectives that can jointly learn high-quality summary statistics and a physically consistent emulator from a single noisy trajectory. We theoretically analyze and experimentally validate a Sinkhorn divergence formulation (2-Wasserstein) and a WGAN-style dual formulation (1-Wasserstein) of our approach. Numerical experiments across a variety of chaotic systems, including ones with high-dimensional spatiotemporal chaos, show that emulators trained using our proposed objectives have significantly improved long-term statistical fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一族对抗最优传输正则化目标，让混沌系统模拟器 (emulator) 从单条含噪轨迹同时学到高质量摘要统计量与物理一致的动力学，摆脱对手工统计量和多环境大数据集的依赖。理论上分析并实验验证了 Sinkhorn divergence（2-Wasserstein）与 WGAN 式对偶（1-Wasserstein）两种形式；在包括高维时空混沌在内的多类混沌系统上，所训模拟器的长期统计保真度显著提升。
Motivation: 数据驱动模拟器难以学到混沌动力学：对初值的敏感性使精确长期预报不可行，尤其在含噪数据下；现有匹配混沌吸引子统计特性的方法又依赖手工摘要统计量或庞大、多样的多环境数据集。
Method: 构造对抗最优传输目标族，联合学习摘要统计量与物理一致的模拟器，仅用单条含噪轨迹；理论上分析并实验验证两种形式——Sinkhorn divergence（2-Wasserstein）与 WGAN 式对偶形式（1-Wasserstein）。
Result: 在多类混沌系统（含高维时空混沌系统）的数值实验中，用所提目标训练的模拟器长期统计保真度显著提升；摘要给出理论分析与实验验证两条路径，未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 对抗最优传输正则化可让混沌模拟器仅凭单条含噪轨迹匹配吸引子统计特性，不必依赖手工统计量或多环境数据集；Sinkhorn 与 WGAN 对偶两种形式均被理论与实验支持。

papers.title: IAD-Unify: Task-Specific Interfaces for Industrial Anomaly Understanding, Segmentation, and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Industrial anomaly inspection requires complementary capabilities: explaining an observed defect, localizing its pixels, and synthesizing a controlled edit. We present IAD-Unify, a unified architecture connecting a multimodal language model (MLLM), dense visual expert, and diffusion editor through task-specific token interfaces. A multi-reference DINOv2 pathway forms a dense anomaly field and compresses its 1,369 cells into 81 structured evidence tokens. Qwen3.5 consumes these tokens for grounded answers and, with 32 task tokens, converts them into a semantic residual over the dense mask. A separate 256-query interface resamples Qwen states into Stable Diffusion's complete cross-attention context, while the editor retains its source latent and hard-mask inputs. The task pathways share one Qwen adaptation without forcing every task through the same visual bottleneck; in particular, evidence tokens are excluded from the generation pathway. Staged optimization initializes dense evidence, aligns it with language, calibrates segmentation, and then pretrains and specializes the diffusion editor while preserving earlier capabilities. We also construct Anomaly Evidence over 54,501 deduplicated industrial images. Its quality-controlled Anomaly Evidence Compiler and Industrial Edit-Pair Compiler produce family-disjoint, validated supervision through independent geometry, semantic-grounding, and edit-consistency checks. This design provides one fixed shared parameter set for understanding, segmentation, and localized generation without conflating their inputs, supervision, or outputs. The resulting model reaches 73.02% MMAD Macro$_7$, the highest listed public segmentation AP average (57.10%) with one reference, and the lowest Controlled masked DINO distance (0.3765), with complementary strengths across reasoning, pixel ranking, and semantic edit fidelity.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 11 figures. Revised title, author list, methodology, and experiments; supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IAD-Unify 用任务专属 token 接口把 MLLM、稠密视觉专家与 diffusion 编辑器接到同一套共享参数上，分别做工业异常的解释、分割与受控编辑。DINOv2 多参考通路把 1,369 个 cell 压成 81 个 evidence token 供 Qwen3.5 使用，且这些 token 被排除在生成通路之外。模型在 MMAD Macro7 上达 73.02%，单参考分割 AP 平均 57.10%，Controlled masked DINO 距离 0.3765 为最低。
Motivation: 工业异常检测需要解释缺陷、定位像素、生成受控编辑三类互补能力，但把它们塞进同一视觉瓶颈会混淆各自的输入、监督与输出。
Method: 多参考 DINOv2 通路构成稠密异常场并压缩为 81 个结构化 evidence token；Qwen3.5 消费这些 token 生成 grounded 回答，并用 32 个 task token 转成语义残差叠加到稠密 mask；另一套 256-query 接口把 Qwen 状态重采样为 Stable Diffusion 的完整 cross-attention 上下文，编辑器保留源 latent 与硬 mask 输入。分阶段优化依次初始化稠密证据、与语言对齐、校准分割，再预训练并专化 diffusion 编辑器。同时构建含 54,501 张去重工业图像的 Anomaly Evidence 数据集，其 Anomaly Evidence Compiler 与 Industrial Edit-Pair Compiler 经几何、语义 grounding、编辑一致性独立检查产出 family-disjoint 监督。
Result: MMAD Macro7 达 73.02%；单参考下取得所列最高的公开分割 AP 平均 57.10%；Controlled masked DINO 距离 0.3765 为最低。三项能力在推理、像素排序与语义编辑保真度上呈互补优势。
Conclusion: 一套固定共享参数即可同时支撑异常理解、分割与局部生成，前提是用任务专属接口隔离各任务的输入、监督与输出，而不让 evidence token 混入生成通路。

papers.title: Virtual Smart Metering in District Heating Networks via Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent operation of thermal energy networks aims to improve energy efficiency, reliability, and operational flexibility through data-driven control, predictive optimization, and early fault detection. Achieving these goals relies on sufficient observability, requiring continuous and well-distributed monitoring of thermal and hydraulic states. However, district heating systems are typically sparsely instrumented and frequently affected by sensor faults, limiting monitoring. Virtual sensing offers a cost-effective means to enhance observability, yet its development and validation remain limited in practice. Existing data-driven methods generally assume dense synchronized data, while analytical models rely on simplified hydraulic and thermal assumptions that may not adequately capture the behavior of heterogeneous network topologies. Consequently, modeling the coupled nonlinear dependencies between pressure, flow, and temperature under realistic operating conditions remains challenging. In addition, the lack of publicly available benchmark datasets hinders systematic comparison of virtual sensing approaches. To address these challenges, we propose a heterogeneous spatial-temporal graph neural network (HSTGNN) for constructing virtual smart heat meters. The model incorporates the functional relationships inherent in district heating networks and employs dedicated branches to learn graph structures and temporal dynamics for flow, temperature, and pressure measurements, thereby enabling the joint modeling of cross-variable and spatial correlations. To support further research, we introduce a controlled laboratory dataset collected at the Aalborg Smart Water Infrastructure Laboratory, providing synchronized high-resolution measurements representative of real operating conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly outperforms existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对区域供热网络测点稀疏、传感器易故障导致可观测性不足，提出异构时空图神经网络 (HSTGNN) 构建虚拟智能热表：为流量、温度、压力各设专用分支分别学习图结构与时间动态，联合建模跨变量与空间相关性。在 Aalborg Smart Water Infrastructure Laboratory 受控实验室数据集上，该方法显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 区域供热系统测点稀疏且常有传感器故障，数据驱动方法假设稠密同步数据、解析模型依赖简化水热假设，难以刻画压力-流量-温度的耦合非线性，且缺乏公开基准数据集。
Method: 提出 HSTGNN，把供热网络的物理功能关系嵌入模型，为流量、温度、压力测量设置专用分支分别学习图结构与时间动态，联合建模跨变量与空间相关；同时发布 Aalborg Smart Water Infrastructure Laboratory 的受控实验室数据集，含代表真实工况的同步高分辨率测量。

papers.title: ReCodeAgent: A Multi-agent Workflow for Language-Agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-Scale Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Most repository-level code translation and validation techniques have been evaluated on a single source-target programming language (PL) pair, owing to the complex engineering effort required to adapt new PL pairs. Programming agents can enable PL-agnosticism in repository-level code translation and validation: they can synthesize code across many PLs and autonomously use existing tools specific to each PL's analysis. However, state-of-the-art has yet to offer a fully autonomous agentic approach for repository-level code translation and validation of large-scale programs. This paper proposes ReCodeAgent, an autonomous multi-agent approach for language-agnostic repository-level code translation and validation. Users only need to provide the project in the source PL and specify the target PL for ReCodeAgent to automatically translate and validate the entire repository. ReCodeAgent is the first technique to achieve high translation success rates across many PLs. We compare the effectiveness of ReCodeAgent with four alternative neuro-symbolic and agentic approaches to translate 118 real-world projects, with 1,975 LoC and 43 translation units for each project, on average. The projects cover 6 PLs and 4 PL pairs. Our results demonstrate that ReCodeAgent consistently outperforms prior techniques on translation correctness, improving test pass rate by 60.8% on ground-truth tests, with an average cost of $15.3. We also perform process-centric analysis of ReCodeAgent trajectories to confirm its procedural efficiency. Finally, we investigate how the design choices (a multi-agent vs. single-agent architecture) influence ReCodeAgent performance: on average, the test pass rate drops by 40.4%, and trajectories become 28% longer and persistently inefficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCodeAgent 是面向大规模仓库级代码翻译与验证的自主多智能体工作流，用户只给源语言项目和目标语言，它自行完成整仓翻译并调用各语言的分析工具做验证。在 118 个真实项目、6 种语言 4 个语言对上对比四种神经符号与 agentic 方案，ground-truth 测试通过率提升 60.8%，平均成本 $15.3；去掉多智能体架构后通过率平均下降 40.4%、轨迹变长 28%。
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码翻译与验证技术几乎都只在单一源-目标语言对上评测，适配新语言对的工程代价高，缺少面向大规模程序的全自动 agentic 方案。
Method: ReCodeAgent 以多智能体架构自动完成整仓翻译与验证：用户仅提供源 PL 项目并指定目标 PL，各智能体自行合成目标语言代码并调用该语言专属的分析与测试工具；论文同时对比四种神经符号与 agentic 方案，并做轨迹级过程分析与多智能体对单智能体的消融。
Result: 在 118 个真实项目（平均每项目 1,975 LoC、43 个翻译单元，覆盖 6 种 PL、4 个 PL 对）上，ground-truth 测试通过率相对先前技术提升 60.8%，平均成本 $15.3；消融显示改为单智能体后测试通过率平均下降 40.4%，轨迹平均变长 28% 且持续低效。
Conclusion: 多智能体分工加各语言专属工具调用是让仓库级翻译跨多个语言对同时保持高成功率的关键设计，单智能体会显著损害通过率与过程效率。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Reinvent Foundational Algorithms?
papers.abstract_en: LLMs have shown strong potential to advance scientific discovery. Whether they possess the capacity for foundational innovation, however, remains an open question. In this work, we focus on a prerequisite for foundational innovation: \textit{can LLMs reinvent foundational algorithms in computer science?} We use LLM unlearning methods to suppress direct recall of the target algorithm and let the model reason with the remaining knowledge to recover it. Although unlearning does not guarantee full knowledge removal, LLMs fail to recover nearly half of the target algorithms. Notably, even suppressing the mention of the algorithm's name during decoding without unlearning makes the models' recovery rate drop dramatically (19--39\%), suggesting their overreliance on memorized knowledge. We observe that recoverable algorithms tend to be simple in structure or core ideas, whereas the others are less straightforward. We also introduce a generative verifier that sustains models' reasoning strength, helping to avoid the ``thought collapse'' phenomenon. Taken together, by treating the unlearned model's recovery rate as an approximate upper bound, our empirical results suggest that current LLM systems still have limited ability to make foundational algorithm innovation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Algo-Reinvention/algo-reinvention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 遗忘 (unlearning) 压制对目标算法的直接记忆，再让模型靠剩余知识重新推导，检验 LLM 能否「重新发明」计算机科学基础算法。结果是负面的：即使遗忘不保证完全移除知识，模型仍无法恢复近一半目标算法；仅在解码时禁止提及算法名（不做遗忘），恢复率就骤降到 19–39%，说明模型严重依赖记忆而非推理。可恢复的算法往往结构或核心思想简单。
Motivation: LLM 在科学发现上展现出潜力，但能否完成「基础性创新」这一层次的推理仍是开放问题；需要一个可操作的实验来区分模型是在记忆还是在重新推导。
Method: 用 LLM unlearning 方法压制对目标算法的直接回忆，再让被遗忘的模型推理以恢复该算法；对照组只在解码阶段禁止提及算法名。另引入一个 generative verifier 来维持模型的推理强度，避免出现 thought collapse 现象。
Result: 即使 unlearning 不保证完全移除知识，LLM 仍无法恢复近一半的目标算法；仅在解码时抑制算法名提及（不做 unlearning），恢复率即降至 19–39%。可恢复的算法倾向于结构或核心思想简单，其余则不那么直接。
Conclusion: 把遗忘后模型的恢复率当作近似上界，实证结果表明当前 LLM 系统在基础算法创新方面能力仍然有限；其表现高度依赖记忆而非真正的推导。

papers.title: Dynamic Free-Rider Detection in Cross-Silo Federated Learning via Simulated Attack Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train a global model by aggregating local updates without sharing private data. In this work, we focus on cross-silo FL, where each client typically represents an independent organization. However, cross-silo FL can face the challenge of free-riders, clients who submit fake model parameters without performing actual training to obtain the global model without contributing. Chen et al. proposed a free-rider detection method based on the weight evolving frequency (WEF) of model parameters. This detection approach is practical because it requires neither a proxy dataset nor pre-training. Nevertheless, it struggles to detect ``dynamic'' free-riders who behave honestly in early rounds and later switch to free-riding, particularly under global-model-mimicking attacks such as the delta weight attack and our newly proposed adaptive WEF-camouflage attack. In this paper, we propose a novel detection method S2-WEF that simulates the WEF patterns of potential global-model-mimicking attacks on the server side using previously broadcast global models, and identifies clients whose submitted WEF patterns resemble the simulated ones. To handle a variety of free-rider attack strategies, S2-WEF further combines this simulation-based similarity score with a deviation score computed from mutual comparisons among submitted WEFs, and separates benign and free-rider clients by two-dimensional clustering and per-score classification. This method enables dynamic detection of clients that transition into free-riders during training without proxy datasets or pre-training. We conduct extensive experiments across four datasets and five attack types, demonstrating that S2-WEF provides robust dynamic free-rider detection across diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 cross-silo 联邦学习中，针对前期诚实、后期转为搭便车的 dynamic free-rider，提出 S2-WEF：在服务器端用已广播的全局模型模拟各类全局模型模仿攻击的 weight evolving frequency (WEF) 模式，再把模拟相似度分数与提交 WEF 之间的互比较偏差分数结合，经二维聚类和逐分数分类区分良性与搭便车客户端。在四个数据集、五种攻击类型上实验，S2-WEF 在多种设置下实现稳健的动态搭便车检测，且不需要 proxy dataset 或 pre-training。
Motivation: Chen et al. 的 WEF 检测虽无需 proxy dataset 和 pre-training，但难以识别前期诚实、后期转为搭便车的 dynamic free-rider，尤其在 delta weight attack 和新提出的 adaptive WEF-camouflage attack 这类全局模型模仿攻击下失效。
Method: S2-WEF 在服务器端用历史广播的全局模型模拟潜在全局模型模仿攻击的 WEF 模式，计算提交 WEF 与模拟模式的相似度分数；同时用提交 WEF 之间的互比较计算偏差分数；两者经二维聚类与逐分数分类划分良性与搭便车客户端，实现训练中途的动态检测，全程无需 proxy dataset 或 pre-training。
Result: 在四个数据集、五种攻击类型上进行实验，S2-WEF 在多样设置下均提供稳健的 dynamic free-rider detection；检测对象包括 delta weight attack 与作者新提出的 adaptive WEF-camouflage attack。
Conclusion: 用服务器端攻击模式模拟加互比较偏差的双分数聚类，可以在不依赖 proxy dataset 和 pre-training 的前提下识别中途转为搭便车的客户端，覆盖多种全局模型模仿攻击策略。

papers.title: Transmission Neural Networks: Inhibitory and Excitatory Connections
papers.abstract_en: This paper extends the Transmission Neural Network model proposed by Gao and Caines in [1]-[3] to incorporate inhibitory connections and neurotransmitter populations. The extended network model contains binary neuronal states, transmission dynamics, and inhibitory and excitatory connections. Under technical assumptions, we establish the characterization of the firing probabilities of neurons, and show that such a characterization considering inhibitions can be equivalently represented by a neural network where each neuron has a continuous state of dimension 2. Moreover, we incorporated neurotransmitter populations into the modeling and establish the limit network model when the number of neurotransmitters at all synaptic connections go to infinity. Finally, sufficient conditions for stability and contraction properties of the limit network model are established.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Transmission Neural Network 扩展到含抑制性与兴奋性连接及神经递质群体的模型：二值神经元状态加传输动力学，其带抑制的发放概率刻画可等价化为每个神经元二维连续状态的网络。当所有突触连接的神经递质数趋于无穷时得到极限网络模型，并给出该极限模型稳定性与收缩性的充分条件。
Motivation: 原 Transmission Neural Network 只处理兴奋性连接，缺少抑制机制与神经递质的群体描述，无法刻画抑制对发放概率的影响及其在大量递质下的极限行为。
Method: 在二值神经元状态与传输动力学上引入抑制性和兴奋性连接以及神经递质群体；在技术假设下推导神经元发放概率的刻画，并证明该刻画等价于每个神经元取二维连续状态的神经网络；再对所有突触连接的神经递质数取无穷极限，导出极限网络模型。
Result: 得到带抑制的发放概率刻画及其二维连续状态的等价神经网络表示；建立神经递质数趋于无穷时的极限网络模型，并给出该极限模型稳定性与收缩性的充分条件。
Conclusion: 抑制与兴奋连接可被吸收进二维连续状态的等价网络描述，而大量神经递质下的极限模型在给定充分条件下具备稳定性与收缩性。

papers.title: AI Appeals Processor: A Deep Learning Approach to Automated Classification of Citizen Appeals in Government Services
papers.abstract_en: Government agencies must register, classify and route every citizen appeal within statutory time limits, and much of this work is still done by hand. We describe AI Appeals Processor, a classification and routing component deployed in a CPU-only government environment, and report what its evaluation and deployment taught us. On 10,000 real Russian-language appeals from a cross-domain dataset, we compare Bag-of-Words and TF-IDF with SVM, fastText, Word2Vec+LSTM and multilingual BERT on a three-way appeal-type task. On a held-out test set of 1,500 appeals, BERT reaches 82% accuracy and Word2Vec+LSTM 78%, against 67% for individual operators measured on an expert-adjudicated gold standard. We deployed the LSTM: in a workflow where an operator verifies every prediction, its lower training cost made frequent retraining on operator-verified labels practical, while the four-point accuracy gap did not change the operator's task. End-to-end handling time fell by 53-56% across four appeal-length bands (unweighted mean 22.5 to 10.25 minutes); model inference takes under two seconds of this. Most residual errors trace to the label taxonomy rather than the model: the statutory definitions of complaints and applications overlap, and many appeals carry two intents. A post-deployment audit of production classifications, made after several retraining cycles by operators who saw the assigned category, judged more than 95% correct; we explain why this figure is not comparable with the test-set result.

papers.title: Task-Centric Personalized Federated Fine-Tuning of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising technique for training language models on distributed and private datasets of diverse tasks. However, aggregating models trained on heterogeneous tasks often degrades the overall performance of individual clients. To address this issue, Personalized FL (pFL) aims to create models tailored for each client's data distribution. Although these approaches improve local performance, they usually lack robustness in two aspects: (i) generalization: when clients must make predictions on unseen tasks, or face changes in their data distributions, and (ii) intra-client tasks interference: when a single client's data contains multiple distributions that may interfere with each other during local training. To tackle these two challenges, we propose FedRouter, a clustering-based pFL that builds specialized models for each task rather than for each client. FedRouter uses adapters to personalize models by employing two clustering mechanisms to associate adapters with specific tasks. A local clustering that associate adapters with task data samples and a global one that associates similar adapters from different clients to construct task-centric personalized models. Additionally, we propose an evaluation router mechanism that routes test samples to the best adapter based on the created clusters. Experiments comparing our method with existing approaches across a multitask dataset, FedRouter demonstrate strong resilience in these challenging scenarios performing up to 6.1% relatively better under tasks interference and up to 136% relative improvement under generalization evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedRouter 把个性化联邦微调的对象从客户端改为任务：用 adapter 加局部/全局两层聚类，为每个任务而非每个客户端构建专用模型，测试样本再由 evaluation router 按聚类路由到最合适的 adapter。在多任务数据集上，任务干扰场景相对提升最高 6.1%，泛化评估相对提升最高 136%。
Motivation: 联邦聚合异构任务的模型会拉低单个客户端表现；现有个性化 FL 只按客户端定制，在未见任务或分布漂移时泛化差，且单客户端内多任务数据会相互干扰。
Method: 提出基于聚类的 pFL 方法 FedRouter：用 adapter 做个性化，局部聚类把 adapter 关联到任务数据样本，全局聚类把不同客户端的相似 adapter 合成任务中心的个性化模型；再加一个 evaluation router，按聚类把测试样本路由到最佳 adapter。
Result: 在多任务数据集上与现有方法对比：任务干扰 (task interference) 场景下相对提升最高 6.1%，泛化 (generalization) 评估下相对提升最高 136%。
Conclusion: 按任务而非按客户端做个性化联邦微调，配合测试时路由，能在任务干扰与未见任务两种场景下同时保住局部性能与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HyVIC: A Metric-Driven Spatio-Spectral Hyperspectral Image Compression Architecture Based on Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of hyperspectral data archives in remote sensing (RS) necessitates effective compression methods for storage and transmission. Recent advances in learning-based hyperspectral image (HSI) compression have significantly enhanced both reconstruction fidelity and compression efficiency. However, existing methods typically adapt variational image compression models designed for natural images, without adequately accounting for the distinct spatio-spectral redundancies inherent in HSIs. In particular, they lack explicit architectural designs to balance spatial and spectral feature learning, limiting their ability to effectively leverage the unique characteristics of hyperspectral data in RS. To address this issue, in this paper, we aim to study the effects of spatio-spectral feature learning on the rate-distortion (RD) performance of variational HSI compression as a first time in RS. To this end, we propose to use configurable spatial and spectral feature learning blocks within variational HSI compression. To achieve this, we introduce spatio-spectral variational hyperspectral image compression architecture (HyVIC), a configurable variational autoencoder (VAE) for HSI compression. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that the trade-off between spatial and spectral feature learning is crucial for the reconstruction fidelity. Motivated by this, we also present a metric-driven strategy to systematically select the hyperparameters of the proposed model. In detail, HyVIC achieves high spatial and spectral reconstruction fidelity across a wide range of compression ratios (CRs) and improves the state of the art by up to 4.66dB in terms of BD-PSNR. Our code and pre-trained model weights are publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/hyvic .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyVIC 是面向高光谱图像 (HSI) 的可配置变分自编码器压缩架构，把空间与光谱特征学习块做成可调模块，首次在遥感中系统研究时空-光谱权衡对率失真 (RD) 性能的影响。在两个基准数据集上，该权衡对重建保真度至关重要，HyVIC 在宽压缩比 (CR) 范围内 BD-PSNR 最高比现有方法提升 4.66dB，并给出一套指标驱动的超参选择策略。
Motivation: 现有学习型 HSI 压缩直接套用为自然图像设计的变分压缩模型，没有显式处理 HSI 独有的空间-光谱冗余，缺少平衡空间与光谱特征学习的架构设计，限制了对高光谱数据特性的利用。
Method: 提出 HyVIC：在变分 HSI 压缩中嵌入可配置的空间特征学习块与光谱特征学习块，构成可配置的 VAE 架构；在此基础上给出指标驱动 (metric-driven) 的超参数系统选择策略，并在两个基准数据集上做实验。
Result: 在两个基准数据集上，空间与光谱特征学习的权衡对重建保真度至关重要；HyVIC 在很宽的压缩比 (CR) 范围内同时保持高的空间与光谱重建保真度，BD-PSNR 相对现有最优方法最高提升 4.66dB。
Conclusion: 空间与光谱特征学习的平衡是变分 HSI 压缩率失真性能的关键杠杆，用指标驱动策略可系统选出该权衡的超参数；代码与预训练权重已公开。

papers.title: Identification of Bivariate Causal Directionality Based on Anticipated Asymmetric Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Identification of causal directionality in bivariate numerical data is a fundamental research problem with important practical implications. This paper presents two alternative methods to identify direction of causation by considering conditional distributions: (1) Anticipated Asymmetric Geometries (AAG) and (2) Monotonicity Index (MI). The AAG method compares the actual conditional distributions to anticipated ones along two variables. Different comparison metrics, such as Pearson correlation, cosine distance, Hellinger distance, Jaccard index, Jeffreys divergence, K-L divergence, K-S distance, MAE, MSE, mutual information, and Wasserstein distance have been evaluated. Anticipated distributions have been projected as normal based on dual response statistics: mean and standard deviation. The MI method compares the calculated monotonicity indexes of the gradients of conditional distributions along two axes and exhibits count of gradient sign changes. Both methods assume stochastic properties of the bivariate data and exploit anticipated unimodality of conditional distributions of the effect. The proposed methods are straightforward and include only a limited number of hyperparameters that affect the accuracy of the identification. For a given set of hyperparameters, both the AAG and MI methods provide a unique, deterministic solution. To address sensitivity to hyperparameters, tuning has been done by utilizing a full factorial Design of Experiment. It turns out that the AAG method outperforms MI, achieving top weighted accuracies of 82.7% with simple tuning and 84.4% with size-adaptive tuning, compared with 81.6% for GRCI or 82.0% for CAREFL-H on the 99 pairs of the Tubingen real-world cause-effect examples. To evaluate the decisiveness of the identification method, a decision tree was fitted on the input data's symmetrical bivariate statistics to detect misclassified cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在二元数值数据上判定因果方向，提出两种基于条件分布的方法：Anticipated Asymmetric Geometries (AAG) 比较实际与预期条件分布，Monotonicity Index (MI) 比较两轴条件分布梯度的单调性。在 Tübingen 99 对真实因果样例上，AAG 加权准确率 82.7%（简单调参）与 84.4%（尺寸自适应调参），高于 GRCI 的 81.6% 与 CAREFL-H 的 82.0%。
Motivation: 二元数据的因果方向判定是基础问题，已有方法对超参数敏感且缺少确定性解；需要超参数少、结果唯一的方法在真实因果样例上与 GRCI、CAREFL-H 竞争。
Method: AAG 沿两个变量比较实际条件分布与基于均值和标准差投影为正态的预期分布，评估了 Pearson correlation、cosine distance、Hellinger distance、Jaccard index、Jeffreys divergence、K-L divergence、K-S distance、MAE、MSE、mutual information、Wasserstein distance 等指标；MI 比较两轴条件分布梯度的单调性指数并统计梯度符号变化次数。两法均假设数据随机性与效应条件分布的预期单峰性，超参数用全因子 Design of Experiment 调优；另在输入数据的对称二元统计量上拟合决策树以识别误判案例。
Result: 在 Tübingen 99 对真实因果样例上，AAG 加权准确率 82.7%（简单调参）、84.4%（尺寸自适应调参），MI 与之相比更低；对照 GRCI 81.6%、CAREFL-H 82.0%。对给定超参数集合，AAG 与 MI 均给出唯一确定性解。
Conclusion: AAG 优于 MI，且以少量超参数在 Tübingen 基准上达到与或超过 GRCI、CAREFL-H 的准确率；决策树分析用于定位被误判的因果对。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Decidable By Construction: Design-Time Verification for Truly Fearless Systems
papers.abstract_en: Concurrency, parallelism and distributed execution become truly fearless when the compiler tracks wait-for edges, proves multi-threaded work is sound and preserves distributed boundary contracts. In this design, our Composer compiler preserves proofs while lowering Clef directly to native CPU, GPU, NPU and FPGA code, without translation through C or vendor APIs. Our Program Semantic Graph retains the values, relationships and premises that justify BAREWire's unboxed boundary contracts. And C & C++ interfacing is an explicit marshaling boundary, with proofs tied to actual arguments, conversions and returned values. Four verification tiers connect an account of our design. Tier 1 supplies structural inference, founded on principal dimensional types. Tier 2 generates and checks local arithmetic, representation, and computational integrity at the node level. Tier 3 instantiates reusable domain and system lemmas, including distributed proofs supported by Iris, Actris and Aneris. Tiers 1-3 require no developer annotations, with a quotation based lemma library design to extend coverage as use cases expand. Tier 4 admits computational and probabilistic relational proofs, with project annotations identifying the required relations. We extend the same library direction toward recognizing relational constructions from hypergraph structure. A formal composition rule connects arithmetic, ownership, protocol and realization evidence. Our worked distributed reduction preserves one specified result across concurrent workers, reordered arrivals and boundary mappings. Its probabilistic extension carries worker and conversion error with an explicit failure budget. With recent work by Urschel, we show bounds supply a relevant source of reusable proof terms. These constructions make verification a core engineering discipline for truly fearless programs and systems across a variety of hardware targets.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 0 figures, 4 tables. Major revision: expanded four-tier verification. Added exact and probabilistic distributed examples
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Composer 编译器与 Program Semantic Graph，在编译期追踪 wait-for 边并保留证明，把 Clef 直接降到 CPU/GPU/NPU/FPGA 原生代码而不经 C 或厂商 API。四层验证中 Tier 1–3 无需开发者注解，Tier 4 用项目注解引入计算与概率关系证明；分布式归约例子在并发 worker、乱序到达与边界映射下保持同一指定结果，其概率扩展带显式失败预算。
Motivation: 并发、并行与分布式执行的正确性证明常在编译 lowering、跨语言边界和分布式协议处丢失，开发者被迫依赖注解与人工审查。
Method: Composer 编译器在 lowering 过程中保留证明，Program Semantic Graph 记录支撑 BAREWire unboxed 边界契约的值、关系与前提，C/C++ 互操作作为显式 marshaling 边界并把证明绑定到实参、转换与返回值。四层验证：Tier 1 基于 principal dimensional types 的结构推断，Tier 2 节点级算术/表示/计算完整性检查，Tier 3 复用领域与系统引理（分布式证明由 Iris、Actris、Aneris 支持，Tier 1–3 无需注解），Tier 4 允许计算与概率关系证明并需项目注解；另有连接算术、所有权、协议与实现证据的形式化组合规则。
Result: 给出分布式归约的 worked example：在并发 worker、乱序到达与边界映射下保持一个指定结果；其概率扩展携带 worker 与转换误差并给出显式失败预算。arXiv comment 记为 33 页、0 图、4 表，含扩展的四层验证与精确/概率分布式例子。

papers.title: ExecVLA: Following Fine-Grained Execution Constraints in Vision-Language-Action Models with Bi-Level Action Representation
papers.abstract_en: We study fine-grained execution-constraint following in vision-language-action (VLA) models. Given an invariant task goal, the policy must follow instruction-specified execution constraints, including interaction targets, motion patterns, spatial relations, and terminal configurations. This setting exposes a limitation of goal-oriented VLAs: trajectories that complete the same task are not interchangeable when the instruction specifies how the task must be executed. We propose ExecVLA, a framework that separates a goal-oriented component from an execution-specific component through a bi-level action representation and supervised bi-level reasoning tokens. We further introduce explicit goal-invariance and execution-predictability objectives so that the goal-level representation remains stable across executions of the same goal, while the execution-level representation retains the constraints that distinguish those executions. We construct execution-constraint-following datasets in simulation and on a Realman-75 robot, with goal and fine-grained reasoning annotations. Experiments on LIBERO and the real robot show improved goal completion and, more importantly, substantially more reliable adherence to instruction-specified execution constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExecVLA 用双层动作表示 (bi-level action representation) 把 VLA 策略拆成目标层与执行层，并用监督式双层推理 token 加目标不变性、执行可预测性目标约束两层表征。在 LIBERO 仿真与 Realman-75 实体机器人上，任务完成度提升，且对指令指定执行约束（交互目标、运动模式、空间关系、终止构型）的遵循可靠性显著提高。
Motivation: 目标导向 VLA 把同一任务的不同轨迹视为可互换，但指令一旦规定了执行方式，这些轨迹并不等价，导致细粒度执行约束被忽略。
Method: 双层动作表示分离目标层与执行层，配合监督式双层推理 token；加入显式目标不变性目标（同一目标不同执行下目标层表征保持稳定）与执行可预测性目标（执行层保留区分这些执行的约束）；在仿真与 Realman-75 机器人上构建带目标与细粒度推理标注的执行约束跟随数据集。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与 Realman-75 实体机器人实验中，任务完成度改善，且对指令指定执行约束的遵循可靠性大幅提升。
Conclusion: 把目标与执行解耦成两层表征并分别施加不变性与可预测性约束，能让 VLA 在完成任务的同时可靠遵循指令规定的执行方式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PhysMoDPO: Physically-Plausible Humanoid Motion with Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in text-conditioned human motion generation has been largely driven by diffusion models trained on large-scale human motion data. Building on this progress, recent methods attempt to transfer such models for character animation and real robot control by applying a Whole-Body Controller (WBC) that converts diffusion-generated motions into executable trajectories. While WBC trajectories become compliant with physics, they may expose substantial deviations from original motion. To address this issue, we here propose PhysMoDPO, a Direct Preference Optimization framework. Unlike prior work that relies on hand-crafted physics-aware heuristics such as foot-sliding penalties, we integrate WBC into our training pipeline and optimize diffusion model such that the output of WBC becomes compliant both with physics and original text instructions. To train PhysMoDPO we deploy physics-based and task-specific rewards and use them to assign preference to synthesized trajectories. Our extensive experiments on text-to-motion and spatial control tasks demonstrate consistent improvements of PhysMoDPO in both physical realism and task-related metrics on simulated robots. Moreover, we demonstrate that PhysMoDPO results in significant improvements when applied to zero-shot motion transfer in simulation and for real-world deployment on a G1 humanoid robot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysMoDPO 把 Whole-Body Controller (WBC) 直接嵌入扩散式文本生成人体动作模型的训练管线，用 DPO 以物理与任务奖励构造偏好对，使 WBC 输出同时符合物理规律和原始文本指令。在文本到动作、空间控制任务以及仿真到实机的零样本迁移上，物理真实性和任务指标一致提升，并在 G1 人形机器人上完成真实部署。
Motivation: 扩散生成动作经 WBC 转成可执行轨迹后虽符合物理，却可能大幅偏离原始动作；现有补救依赖手工设计的物理启发式惩罚（如 foot-sliding penalty），无法同时保证物理合规与指令一致。
Method: 提出 PhysMoDPO：将 WBC 纳入训练管线，对扩散模型做 Direct Preference Optimization，用物理奖励与任务专属奖励为合成轨迹打分并构造偏好对，使 WBC 输出在物理与文本指令两方面同时合规，替代手工物理惩罚。
Result: 在文本到动作与空间控制任务的仿真实验中，物理真实性和任务相关指标均一致改善；在仿真中的零样本动作迁移以及 G1 人形机器人真实部署上也取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 把控制器放进训练环、以奖励驱动的偏好优化取代手工物理惩罚，可以让生成动作在保持指令一致的同时获得物理可执行性，并可迁移到真实人形机器人。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Altered Thoughts, Altered Actions: Reasoning Chain as Control Surface for a Vision-Language-Action Policy
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action policies map camera images and natural-language instructions to a robot's motor actions. Some of these policies are designed to reason in text before acting, generating a reasoning chain and decoding actions conditioned on that chain. The works introducing this design offer the reasoning chain as an oversight interface: text a person can read and edit to correct the policy. What an edited reasoning chain does to the policy's motor actions, whether it repairs them or corrupts them, has so far been measured only in part. We measure both directions, repair and corruption, with our deterministic entity swap applied to the instruction the policy receives and to the reasoning chain it generates. A forty-task observed backdrop across all four LIBERO simulation suites reveals that the cost of corrupting the reasoning chain concentrates where language alone determines the goal. There, on LIBERO-Goal, we run the counterfactual intervention with DeepThinkVLA, chosen because its reasoning chain is exposed as plain text. The policy receives a corrupted instruction, but its reasoning chain is replaced by the one it generates when that instruction is clean. This counterfactually correct reasoning chain recovers 47.8 pp of the lost success, our pre-registered confirmatory test. Had the chain merely restated what the camera image already determines, the replacement could have changed nothing. Instead, all 10 tasks move in the predicted direction, though success falls short of the clean runs by 38.0 pp, a gap we had predicted at 5-15 pp. The reasoning chain is therefore a working control surface: text written into it moves the robot, repairing behaviour when the text is right and corrupting it when the text is wrong. Whether to expose such a control surface is a deployment tradeoff, and part of it can now be measured.
papers.comment: Accepted at the VLM4RWD workshop, NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 VLA 策略 DeepThinkVLA 上做确定性实体替换干预，证明推理链是可操作的控制面：把被污染指令下生成的推理链换成干净指令下的推理链，在 LIBERO-Goal 上挽回 47.8 个百分点的成功率损失，10 个任务全部朝预测方向移动，但仍比干净运行低 38.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 先推理后行动的 VLA 策略把推理链当作人类可读可编辑的监督接口，但编辑推理链究竟修复还是破坏机器人动作，此前只被部分测量。
Method: 对指令与策略生成的推理链同时施加确定性实体替换 (entity swap)，覆盖 LIBERO 四个仿真套件共 40 个任务；在 LIBERO-Goal 上对 DeepThinkVLA 做反事实干预：给策略被污染的指令，却把它换成干净指令下生成的推理链，作为预注册验证性检验。
Result: 反事实替换挽回 47.8 pp 的成功率损失（预注册确认检验）；10 个任务全部朝预测方向移动，但成功仍比干净运行低 38.0 pp，而作者事前预测的差距为 5–15 pp；污染推理链的代价集中在语言单独决定目标的场景。
Conclusion: 推理链是真正起作用的控制面：写进去的文本会驱动机器人，文本正确时修复行为、错误时破坏行为；是否暴露这一控制面是部署权衡，且其中一部分现在可以量化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Sample Copying: Structural Memorization in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generalize well in practice. Paradoxically, an optimal diffusion model fully memorizes the training data and therefore fails to generalize, raising the question of what induces generalization in a real diffusion model. We show that diffusion models progressively overfit the denoising training objective, creating a generalization gap between validation and training performance at intermediate noise levels. In a fully analytic 2D toy model with a controlled denoising error, we trace this gap to the interaction between model error and the density of the data distribution's support. The optimal denoising flow field localizes sharply around individual training points, whereas model error suppresses exact recall of training points, yielding a smooth, generalizing flow field. Finally, we examine how training-time overfitting manifests along inference trajectories. We find that predictions made from intermediate trajectory states occupy a distinct feature-space regime from predictions made from noised training and validation images. As training progresses and model size increases, these predictions develop greater relative affinity to the training data, despite the absolute similarity to the validation data not decreasing. Together, these findings show that the denoising objective and inference trajectories express structural memorization differently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型在去噪目标上会随训练逐步过拟合，于中等噪声层产生训练-验证泛化间隙；在可控去噪误差的解析 2D 玩具模型中，该间隙源于模型误差与数据分布支撑密度的相互作用——最优去噪流场在单个训练点附近急剧局部化，而模型误差抑制了对训练点的精确复现，反而得到平滑、可泛化的流场。推理轨迹中间状态的预测随训练加深与模型变大对训练数据相对亲和度上升，但对验证数据的绝对相似度并不下降，说明去噪目标与推理轨迹以不同方式表达结构性记忆 (structural memorization)。
Motivation: 最优扩散模型应完全记住训练数据因而不泛化，但实践中泛化良好；需要解释是什么诱导了真实扩散模型的泛化，以及训练时过拟合如何沿推理轨迹显现。
Method: 在带可控去噪误差的全解析 2D 玩具模型中，把验证与训练性能的泛化间隙追溯到模型误差与数据分布支撑密度的交互；再考察推理轨迹中间状态的预测在特征空间中的分布，与加噪训练图和验证图的预测作对比。
Result: 扩散模型在中等噪声层逐步过拟合去噪目标，产生验证与训练性能的泛化间隙；最优去噪流场在单个训练点附近急剧局部化，模型误差抑制对训练点的精确复现而给出平滑可泛化的流场；随训练推进与模型增大，中间轨迹状态的预测对训练数据相对亲和度更高，而对验证数据的绝对相似度不下降。
Conclusion: 去噪目标与推理轨迹以两种不同方式表达结构性记忆：模型误差通过抹平对单个训练点的精确复现而诱导泛化，训练时过拟合则表现为轨迹预测对训练数据的相对亲和度上升而非对验证数据相似度下降。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Jailbreak Scaling Laws for Large Language Models: Polynomial-Exponential Crossover
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks can reliably steer safety-aligned large language models toward unsafe behavior. Empirically, we find that adversarial prompt-injection attacks can amplify attack success rate from the slow polynomial growth observed without injection to exponential growth with the number of inference-time samples. We first identify a minimal statistical mechanism for these two regimes by giving a small set of assumptions on the distribution of safe generation across contexts under which both scaling laws follow. To explain this phenomenon further, we propose a theoretical generative model of proxy language in terms of a spin-glass system operating in a replica-symmetry-breaking regime, where generations are drawn from the associated Gibbs measure and a subset of low-energy, size-biased clusters is designated unsafe. We analytically show how this model naturally realizes the minimal assumptions. Short injected prompts correspond to a weak magnetic field aligned towards unsafe cluster centers and yield a power-law scaling of attack success rate with the number of inference-time samples, while long injected prompts, i.e., strong magnetic field, yield exponential scaling. We observe qualitatively consistent behavior across a broad range of large language models, spanning parameter scales from 3B to 70B. In particular, the main trends remain stable across multiple attack methods, such as GCG and AutoDAN, as well as across benchmark datasets such as AdvBench and HarmBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对抗性 prompt 注入把 LLM 攻击成功率随推理采样数的增长从无注入时的慢多项式切换为指数律；作者用最小统计假设加自旋玻璃 (spin-glass) 破缺 replica 对称模型解释该交叉，短注入对应弱磁场给出幂律、长注入对应强磁场给出指数律，趋势在 3B–70B 参数、GCG/AutoDAN 与 AdvBench/HarmBench 上定性一致。
Motivation: 安全对齐 LLM 在对抗攻击下会稳定产生不安全行为，但攻击成功率随推理时采样数的增长为何存在多项式与指数两种 regime，缺少可推导的机制解释。
Method: 先给出关于安全生成在不同上下文下分布的一小组假设，从中推出两种 scaling law；再提出把代理语言建模为处于 replica-symmetry-breaking 区的自旋玻璃系统，生成由 Gibbs 测度抽取、低能 size-biased 簇被指定为 unsafe，并解析证明该模型自然实现上述假设。
Result: 无注入时攻击成功率随推理采样数呈慢多项式增长，注入后转为指数增长；短注入（弱磁场）对应幂律 scaling，长注入（强磁场）对应指数 scaling；在参数规模 3B 到 70B 的广泛 LLM 上、跨 GCG 与 AutoDAN 等攻击方法及 AdvBench 与 HarmBench 等基准，主趋势定性一致。
Conclusion: 多项式到指数的 crossover 可由一个最小统计机制加自旋玻璃生成模型统一解释，且该定性行为在多种模型规模、攻击方法与基准上稳定成立。

papers.title: Agentic Critical Training
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning (IL) teaches language-model agents to reproduce expert actions but not to distinguish them from plausible mistakes. Self-reflection methods expose models to alternatives yet use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to imitate fixed rationales and actions. We introduce Agentic Critical Training (ACT), which uses reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to train models to judge actions directly. At each expert-trajectory state, ACT pairs an expert action with an alternative sampled from the initial policy and randomizes their order. The model generates its own reasoning but is rewarded only for selecting the expert action. ACT reuses demonstrations, requires no reference rationales, and allows pair reuse across model sizes. ACT is a warm-up before IL, optionally followed by RL; inference requires no candidate comparison. Across Qwen3-8B and Olmo-3-7B-Instruct on ALFWorld-ID, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, ACT yields average gains of 5.85 points over IL and 4.12 points over IL$\to$RL without ACT, while also improving ALFWorld-OOD. With Olmo on ScienceWorld, the full pipeline gains 15.36 points over CoT prompting and 9.23 points over IL$\to$RL without ACT. Both ACT$\to$IL and the full pipeline outperform supervised reflection baselines. Controls with fixed pairs or matched training durations show that the gains stem from the ACT objective rather than additional data or training. Without reasoning-specific post-training, the standalone ACT checkpoint achieves the highest mean among evaluated models on MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond, showing that action comparison complements generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACT 用带可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 直接训练语言模型判断动作对错：在专家轨迹每个状态上把专家动作与初始策略采样的替代动作配对并随机打乱顺序，模型自生成推理、只因选中专家动作获得奖励。在 Qwen3-8B 与 Olmo-3-7B-Instruct 上，ACT 相对模仿学习 (IL) 平均提升 5.85 分，相对 IL→RL 提升 4.12 分，且在无推理后训练时 MATH-500 与 GPQA-Diamond 上取得最高均值。
Motivation: 模仿学习只教语言模型复现专家动作，无法区分专家动作与看似合理的错误动作；自反思方法虽暴露替代方案，却仍用 SFT 去模仿固定 rationale 与动作。
Method: ACT 在每个专家轨迹状态上配对专家动作与初始策略采样的替代动作并随机化顺序，模型自生成推理、奖励仅取决于是否选中专家动作；ACT 作为 IL 前的 warm-up，之后可选接 RL，推理时无需候选比较，配对可跨模型规模复用。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 与 Olmo-3-7B-Instruct 上，ALFWorld-ID、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个环境中 ACT 相对 IL 平均提升 5.85 分，相对 IL→RL（无 ACT）提升 4.12 分，并同时改善 ALFWorld-OOD；Olmo 在 ScienceWorld 上完整流程相对 CoT prompting 提升 15.36 分、相对 IL→RL 提升 9.23 分；ACT→IL 与完整流程均优于监督式反思基线；固定配对或匹配训练时长的对照显示增益来自 ACT 目标而非额外数据或训练量；无推理后训练的 ACT 单独 checkpoint 在 MATH-500 与 GPQA-Diamond 上取得被评估模型的最高均值。
Conclusion: 动作比较训练能补足生成式训练，作为 IL 前的 warm-up 可稳定带来跨环境增益，且不依赖参考 rationale、配对可跨模型规模复用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: \$OneMillion-Bench: How Far are Language Agents from Human Experts?
papers.abstract_en: As language models (LMs) evolve from chat assistants to long-horizon agents capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use, existing benchmarks remain largely confined to structured or exam-style tasks that fall short of real-world professional demands. To this end, we introduce \$OneMillion-Bench (\$OMB), a benchmark of 400 expert-curated tasks spanning Law, Finance, Industry, Healthcare, and Natural Science, built to evaluate agents across economically consequential scenarios. Unlike prior work, the benchmark requires retrieving authoritative sources, resolving conflicting evidence, applying domain-specific rules, and making constraint decisions, where correctness depends as much on the reasoning process as the final answer. We adopt a rubric-based evaluation protocol scoring factual accuracy, logical coherence, practical feasibility, and professional compliance, focusing on expert-level problems to ensure meaningful differentiation across agents. Together, \$OMB provides a unified testbed for assessing agentic reliability, professional depth, and an indicator of practical readiness in domain-intensive scenarios.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track); the data and code is available at https://github.com/humanlaya/OneMillion-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: $OneMillion-Bench (OMB) 是一个由专家构建的 400 题基准，覆盖 Law、Finance、Industry、Healthcare、Natural Science 五个领域，要求语言智能体检索权威来源、消解冲突证据、套用领域规则并做约束决策。采用 rubric 式评分协议，从事实准确性、逻辑连贯性、实践可行性、职业合规四个维度打分，用专家级问题拉开不同 agent 的区分度。
Motivation: 现有语言 agent 基准多为结构化或考试式任务，无法反映真实职业场景中检索权威来源、处理冲突证据与约束决策的需求，也缺少对推理过程本身的评价。
Method: 构建 400 个专家策划任务，覆盖 Law、Finance、Industry、Healthcare、Natural Science；评测协议为 rubric-based evaluation，按 factual accuracy、logical coherence、practical feasibility、professional compliance 四项打分，正确性同时取决于推理过程与最终答案。
Result: 提出 OMB 基准：400 个专家策划任务、5 个领域、四维 rubric 评分协议，定位为评估 agentic reliability 与职业深度的统一测试场，并作为领域密集型场景实用就绪度 (practical readiness) 的指标。
Conclusion: 作者主张语言 agent 要接近人类专家，必须在检索权威来源、消解冲突证据、按领域规则做约束决策这类经济后果明确的任务上被同时考核过程与答案，OMB 即为此类测试床。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Predicting Cellular Responses to Gene Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is fundamental to functional genomics and therapeutic discovery. Recent deep learning models have shown promise in single-cell perturbation response prediction, but they typically generate each response in isolation, without explicitly leveraging related perturbations. We introduce PT-RAG (Perturbation-aware Two-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a plug-in retrieval-and-conditioning module for generative cellular perturbation response. PT-RAG augments an existing perturbation-response backbone with learned access to related perturbation contexts. The key challenge is that relevance is not fixed in this setting: functionally related genes may elicit different effects across cell types. PT-RAG addresses this with a two-stage retrieval mechanism: GenePT-based semantic retrieval first identifies K candidate perturbations, after which a differentiable Gumbel-Softmax selector adaptively selects retrieved contexts conditioned on the control cell state, the query perturbation, and each candidate perturbation. We evaluate PT-RAG on two backbones, a STATE-style generator used as a frozen random reservoir and a fully trained scGPT, across cross-cell-type and cross-perturbation generalization tasks. PT-RAG consistently improves distributional similarity and often overall predictive quality; for example, on scGPT cross-cell-type results, the 2-Wasserstein distance drops by 5.9% relative to scGPT alone. The code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/PT-RAG_NIPS.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 main track. 34 pages, 11 figures, 18 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PT-RAG 作为即插即用的检索-条件化模块，为单细胞扰动响应生成模型补上相关扰动上下文：先用 GenePT 语义检索取 K 个候选扰动，再由可微 Gumbel-Softmax 选择器按控制细胞状态、查询扰动与候选扰动自适应筛选。在 scGPT 跨细胞类型任务上，2-Wasserstein 距离相对 scGPT 单独使用下降 5.9%。
Motivation: 现有深度学习单细胞扰动响应预测模型逐个孤立生成响应，不显式利用相关扰动信息；而功能相关的基因在不同细胞类型中可能产生不同效应，固定相关性假设不成立。
Method: PT-RAG（Perturbation-aware Two-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation）分两阶段：GenePT 语义检索先给出 K 个候选扰动，随后可微 Gumbel-Softmax 选择器以控制细胞状态、查询扰动和候选扰动为条件自适应挑选上下文，注入既有生成骨干。评测覆盖两个骨干——作为冻结随机储层的 STATE 式生成器与全量训练的 scGPT，任务含跨细胞类型与跨扰动泛化。
Result: 在两个骨干上的跨细胞类型与跨扰动泛化任务中，PT-RAG 一致改善分布相似性，并常提升整体预测质量；scGPT 跨细胞类型设定下 2-Wasserstein 距离相对 scGPT 单独使用降低 5.9%。
Conclusion: 把相关扰动作为检索上下文条件化注入，可在不改动骨干训练的前提下提升单细胞扰动响应预测，且相关性需按细胞状态动态判定而非固定。

papers.title: mAVE: A Watermark for Joint Audio-Visual Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking joint audio-visual generation supports vendor copyright protection and content provenance. However, independently valid audio and video watermarks do not establish a shared generation session. An adversary can splice watermarked modalities from different sessions, causing the pair to be mistaken for the vendor's original joint output. We introduce mAVE (Manifold Audio-Visual Entanglement), a training-free watermarking framework that strengthens vendor attribution through session binding in native joint audio-visual diffusion transformers. mAVE separates public record retrieval from secret session authentication: a fixed public index locates the server record, while a randomized payload binds audio bits to a session-keyed video grid through a cryptographic digest. One prompt-conditioned joint inversion supports provider-assisted verification of both modalities against a session record, without modifying generator weights or training auxiliary watermark networks. Our analysis establishes implementation-matched distribution preservation and a full-initialization routing/clipping budget, alongside adaptive session-pool security and stable local-perturbation bounds. Experiments on LTX-2 and MOVA show comparable generation quality. mAVE achieves 99.8\% true-positive rate and 0\% observed false-positive rate in the evaluated swap test, and retains 99.2\% true-positive rate under FrameAvg temporal averaging. Same-prompt and similarity-selected swaps further test session authentication beyond perceptual compatibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: mAVE 是面向联合音视频生成模型的免训练水印框架，用公开索引定位服务器记录、随机化 payload 经密码学摘要把音频比特绑定到会话密钥化的视频网格，从而防止跨会话拼接被误判为厂商原始输出。在 LTX-2 与 MOVA 上生成质量相当，交换测试中 TPR 99.8%、观测 FPR 0%，FrameAvg 时间平均下仍保持 99.2% TPR。
Motivation: 音频与视频各自独立有效的水印无法证明二者来自同一次生成会话，攻击者可把不同会话的水印模态拼接，使这对内容被误认为厂商的原始联合输出。
Method: mAVE（Manifold Audio-Visual Entanglement）在原生联合音视频 diffusion transformer 中免训练注入水印：固定公开索引检索服务器记录，随机化 payload 经密码学摘要把音频比特绑定到 session-keyed 视频网格；单次 prompt 条件的联合反演支持双模态对会话记录的提供方辅助验证，不改动生成器权重也不训练辅助水印网络。分析给出实现匹配的分布保持性、全初始化路由/裁剪预算，以及自适应会话池安全性与局部扰动稳定界。
Result: 在 LTX-2 与 MOVA 上生成质量与原模型相当；交换测试中 TPR 99.8%、观测 FPR 0%；FrameAvg 时间平均下 TPR 保持 99.2%；另用同 prompt 与相似度选择的交换进一步检验超越感知兼容性的会话认证。

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Models as Image Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) classification performance depends critically on evaluation protocol and ground truth quality. Studies comparing MLLMs with supervised and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) report conflicting conclusions, and we show these conflicts stem from protocols that either inflate or underestimate performance. Across the most common evaluation protocols, we identify and fix key issues: model outputs that fall outside the provided class list and are discarded, inflated results from weak multiple-choice distractors, and open-world setting that underperforms only due to poor output mapping. We additionally quantify the impact of commonly overlooked design choices - batch size, image ordering, and text encoder selection - showing they substantially affect accuracy. Evaluating on ReGT, our multilabel reannotation of 625 ImageNet-1k classes, reveals that MLLMs benefit most from corrected labels (up to +10.8%), substantially narrowing the perceived gap with supervised models. Much of the reported MLLM underperformance on classification is thus an artifact of noisy ground truth and flawed evaluation protocol rather than genuine model deficiency. Models less reliant on supervised training signals prove most sensitive to annotation quality. Finally, we show that MLLMs can assist human annotators: in a controlled case study, annotators confirmed or integrated MLLM predictions in approximately 50% of difficult cases, demonstrating their potential for large-scale dataset curation. This work is part of the Aiming for Perfect ImageNet-1k project, see https://klarajanouskova.github.io/ImageNet/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLLM 在图像分类上的“落后于监督模型”主要是评测协议与标注噪声造成的假象：修正输出映射、弱干扰项、以及 625 个 ImageNet-1k 类的多标签重标注 (ReGT) 后，MLLM 准确率最多提升 +10.8%，与监督模型的差距大幅收窄。作者据此建议：比较 MLLM 与监督/VLM 分类性能时先修协议与真值，且对依赖监督信号少的模型要格外核查标注质量。
Motivation: 已有 MLLM 与监督模型、VLM 的分类对比结论互相矛盾，因为协议会虚高或低估性能，而 ImageNet-1k 真值本身含噪，导致模型缺陷与评测缺陷无法区分。
Method: 逐一修复常见评测协议问题：丢弃类别表外输出、弱 multiple-choice 干扰项造成的虚高、open-world 设定下因输出映射差导致的低分；并量化 batch size、图像顺序、text encoder 选择等设计选择的影响。提出 ReGT——对 625 个 ImageNet-1k 类的多标签重标注 (multilabel reannotation)，并做一个人工标注者与 MLLM 预测协作的受控案例研究。
Result: 在 ReGT 上评测，MLLM 因标签修正获得最多 +10.8% 的准确率提升，与监督模型的感知差距显著收窄；batch size、图像顺序、text encoder 选择被显示会实质影响准确率；受控案例研究中，标注者在约 50% 的困难样本上确认或采纳了 MLLM 预测。
Conclusion: MLLM 在分类上的大部分落后是噪声真值与有缺陷评测协议的产物，而非真实模型缺陷；对监督训练信号依赖越弱的模型对标注质量越敏感，MLLM 可用于大规模数据集的人工标注辅助。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 3BASiL: An Algorithmic Framework for Sparse plus Low-Rank Compression of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Sparse plus Low-Rank $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ decomposition of Large Language Models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising direction in model compression, aiming to decompose pre-trained model weights into a sum of sparse and low-rank matrices $(\mathbf{W} \approx \mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$. Despite recent progress, existing methods often suffer from substantial performance degradation compared to dense models. In this work, we introduce 3BASiL-TM, an efficient one-shot post-training method for $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ decomposition of LLMs that addresses this gap. Our approach first introduces a novel 3-Block Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) method, termed 3BASiL, to minimize the layer-wise reconstruction error with convergence guarantees. We then design an efficient transformer-matching (TM) refinement step that jointly optimizes the sparse and low-rank components across transformer layers. This step minimizes a novel memory-efficient loss that aligns outputs at the transformer level. Notably, the TM procedure is universal as it can enhance any $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ decomposition, including pure sparsity. Our numerical experiments show that 3BASiL-TM reduces the WikiText2 perplexity gap relative to dense LLaMA-8B model by over 30% under a (2:4 Sparse + 64 LR) configuration, compared to prior methods. Moreover, our method achieves over 2.5x faster compression runtime on an A100 GPU compared to SOTA $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ method. Our code is available at https://github.com/mazumder-lab/3BASiL.
papers.comment: The Thirty-ninth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3BASiL-TM 是一次性的 LLM 后训练压缩框架：用带收敛保证的 3-Block ADMM 做逐层 (S+LR) 分解，再用跨 transformer 层联合优化稀疏与低秩分量的 transformer-matching (TM) 精修。在 (2:4 Sparse + 64 LR) 配置下，相对 dense LLaMA-8B 的 WikiText2 perplexity 差距比既有方法缩小超过 30%，A100 上压缩耗时比 SOTA (S+LR) 方法快 2.5 倍以上。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 的稀疏加低秩 (S+LR) 分解方法相对 dense 模型性能损失明显，且逐层独立优化无法利用 transformer 层间输出的联合对齐。
Method: 3BASiL：三块交替方向乘子法 (3-Block ADMM) 最小化逐层重构误差并带收敛保证；随后 TM 精修步在 transformer 层级上联合优化稀疏与低秩分量，用一个显存高效的层级输出对齐损失，该步可叠加到任意 (S+LR) 分解（含纯稀疏）上。
Result: 在 (2:4 Sparse + 64 LR) 配置下，相对 dense LLaMA-8B 的 WikiText2 perplexity 差距较既有方法缩小超过 30%；在 A100 GPU 上压缩运行时间比 SOTA (S+LR) 方法快 2.5 倍以上。
Conclusion: 逐层 ADMM 加跨层 transformer-matching 精修能把 (S+LR) 压缩的精度损失和耗时同时压下来，且 TM 精修可作为通用插件用于任意稀疏加低秩分解。

papers.title: V-ECE: Estimating General Expected Calibration Errors
papers.abstract_en: In probabilistic classification, calibration error (CE) measures the average divergence of predicted probabilities $f(X)$ from $\mathbb{P}(Y|f(X))$, the true class distribution for that predicted probability. While being a useful diagnostic tool, it is hard to estimate: popular binning-based estimators are often inconsistent and scale poorly beyond two classes. Recent work rewrites the CE as the excess risk of a model compared to the best recalibration of its own predictions, measured with a proper loss. However, this only works for Bregman-divergence-based calibration errors like the squared error, excluding the more popular $L_1$-distance-based CE. We show that using prediction-dependent proper scores can alleviate this restriction, allowing us to estimate CEs with general convex divergences, including $L_p$ distances with closed-form losses in the binary and multiclass settings. To estimate the excess risk, we introduce a more accurate recalibrator that fits a residual to temperature scaling with gradient boosting. The resulting variational estimator, V-ECE, needs no bins or clusters and lower-bounds the true calibration error in expectation. On a benchmark of semi-synthetic tasks built from real classifiers, with known true CE, V-ECE is among the most accurate binary estimators for every calibration error and significantly outperforms all multiclass estimators. Our results are accompanied by additional theory on $L_p$ CE, estimator bias, and over- or under-confidence estimation.
papers.comment: Re-worked version with a new metric benchmark and new mathematical results on the bias of the estimator
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-ECE 用预测依赖的 proper score 把校准误差 (CE) 改写成相对最优重校准的 excess risk，从而支持任意凸散度（含闭式损失的 L_p 距离），并用梯度提升拟合温度缩放的残差作为重校准器。该估计器不需要分箱或聚类，且在期望意义下给出真实 CE 的下界；在基于真实分类器、真值 CE 已知的半合成基准上，它在二分类中对每种 CE 都属最准确之列，并显著优于全部多分类估计器。
Motivation: 分箱式 CE 估计器常不一致且在多分类下难以扩展；已有的 excess-risk 改写只适用于 Bregman 散度（如平方误差），无法覆盖更常用的基于 L_1 距离的 CE。
Method: V-ECE：用预测依赖的 proper score 将 CE 表为相对最佳重校准的 excess risk，配合一般凸散度（二分类与多分类均有闭式 L_p 损失）；重校准器在温度缩放之上用 gradient boosting 拟合残差；估计无需 bins 或 clusters，期望意义下下界真实 CE。
Result: 在由真实分类器构建、真值 CE 已知的半合成任务基准上，V-ECE 对每种校准误差都是最准确的二分类估计器之一，并显著优于所有多分类估计器；配套给出关于 L_p CE、估计器偏差以及过/欠自信估计的理论结果。
Conclusion: 预测依赖的 proper score 解除了 excess-risk CE 估计对 Bregman 散度的限制，使 L_1 等更常用距离可被一致地估计；V-ECE 以无分箱方式给出 CE 的期望下界。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling with Diffusion Language Models via Reward-Guided Stitching
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning with large language models often benefits from generating multiple chains-of-thought, but existing aggregation strategies are typically trajectory-level (e.g., selecting the best trace or voting on the final answer), discarding useful intermediate work from partial or "nearly correct" attempts. We propose Stitching Noisy Diffusion Thoughts, a self-consistency framework that turns cheap diffusion-sampled reasoning into a reusable pool of step-level candidates. Given a problem, we (i) sample many diverse, low-cost reasoning trajectories using a masked diffusion language model, (ii) score every intermediate step with an off-the-shelf process reward model (PRM), and (iii) stitch these highest-quality steps across trajectories into a composite rationale. This rationale is then used to recompute only the final answer. This modular pipeline separates exploration (diffusion) from evaluation and solution synthesis, avoiding monolithic unified hybrids while preserving broad search. Across math reasoning benchmarks, we find that step-level recombination is most beneficial on harder problems, and ablations highlight the importance of the final solver in converting stitched but imperfect rationales into accurate answers. Using low-confidence diffusion sampling with parallel, independent rollouts, our training-free framework improves average accuracy by up to 23.8% across six math and coding tasks. At the same time, it achieves up to a 1.8x latency reduction relative to both traditional diffusion models (e.g., Dream, LLaDA) and unified architectures (e.g., TiDAR). The code is available https://github.com/roymiles/diffusion-stitching
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Stitching Noisy Diffusion Thoughts：用掩码扩散语言模型低成本采样多条推理轨迹，按 process reward model (PRM) 给每一步打分，再把各轨迹中最优的中间步骤拼成复合 rationale，只重算最终答案。训练无关框架在六个数学与编码任务上平均准确率最多提升 23.8%，相对 Dream、LLaDA 与 TiDAR 延迟最多降低 1.8 倍。
Motivation: 现有推理聚合策略停留在轨迹级（选最优链或对最终答案投票），丢弃“接近正确”尝试中有用的中间步骤，探索与求解耦合在单一模型里也限制了搜索广度。
Method: 三段式流水线：掩码扩散语言模型并行独立 rollout 采样多样低成本轨迹；用现成 PRM 为每个中间步骤打分；跨轨迹拼接高质量步骤生成 composite rationale，再由最终 solver 据此重算答案。探索（diffusion）与评估、求解分离，训练无关。
Result: 在六个数学与编码任务上平均准确率最多提升 23.8%；相对传统扩散模型（Dream、LLaDA）与统一架构（TiDAR）延迟最多降低 1.8 倍。步级重组在更难的问题上收益最大，消融显示最终 solver 对把拼接但不完美的 rationale 转成正确答案至关重要。
Conclusion: 把推理聚合从轨迹级下沉到步级、并把探索与求解解耦，能在不训练的前提下同时提高准确率与降低延迟；收益依赖最终 solver 的转换能力，且在难题上更明显。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在六个数学与编码任务上平均准确率最多提升 23.8%；相对传统扩散模型（Dream、LLaDA）与统一架构（TiDAR）延迟最多降低 1.8 倍。步级重组在更难的问题上收益最大，消融显示最终 solver 对把拼接但不完美的 rationale 转成正确答案至关重要。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把推理聚合从轨迹级下沉到步级、并把探索与求解解耦，能在不训练的前提下同时提高准确率与降低延迟；收益依赖最终 solver 的转换能力，且在难题上更明显。

papers.title: PaReGTA: A Temporally Aware LLM-Based Patient Representation Framework for EHR Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Temporal information in structured electronic health records (EHRs) is often lost in sparse one-hot or count-based representations, while sequence models can be costly and data-hungry. We propose PaReGTA, an LLM-based encoding framework that (i) converts longitudinal EHR events into visit-level templated text with explicit temporal cues, (ii) learns domain-adapted visit embeddings via lightweight contrastive fine-tuning of a sentence-embedding model, and (iii) aggregates visit embeddings into a fixed-dimensional patient representation using hybrid temporal pooling that captures both recency and globally informative visits. The resulting fixed-dimensional patient representations can be used with conventional downstream machine-learning models. To examine factor-level sensitivity, we use PaReGTA-RSS (Representation Shift Score), a prespecified factor-removal analysis that recomputes patient representations after removing clinically defined factor groups and quantifies the resulting change in the fitted logit of a fixed logistic-regression model. We evaluated PaReGTA in a cohort of 39,088 patients with migraine from the All of Us Research Program (AoU) on a retrospective patient-level classification task with an EHR-derived target. In an exploratory comparison on the fixed held-out test cohort of 7,818 patients, PaReGTA-Gap + LightGBM, used as a post hoc analytical reference, had the highest reported AUC, accuracy, and F1 values among the evaluated sparse, BERT-based EHR, and recurrent approaches in this cohort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaReGTA 把纵向 EHR 事件转成带显式时间线索的就诊级模板文本，用轻量对比微调得到就诊嵌入，再经混合时间池化（hybrid temporal pooling）聚合成固定维患者表示，供常规下游模型使用。在 All of Us 的 39,088 名偏头痛患者回顾性分类任务中，固定留出测试集 7,818 人上，PaReGTA-Gap + LightGBM 的 AUC、accuracy、F1 在所评稀疏、BERT 类 EHR 与循环方法中最高。
Motivation: 结构化 EHR 的稀疏 one-hot 或计数表示丢失时间信息，而序列模型训练成本高、数据需求大，需要一种保留就诊时序且下游易用的固定维患者表示。
Method: 三步流水线：将纵向事件转为带时间线索的就诊级模板文本；对句嵌入模型做轻量对比微调得到领域化就诊嵌入；用混合时间池化聚合为固定维患者表示。另用 PaReGTA-RSS（Representation Shift Score）做预设的因子移除分析，删除临床定义的因子组后重算表示，并量化固定 logistic 回归拟合 logit 的变化。
Result: 在 All of Us Research Program 的 39,088 名偏头痛患者回顾性患者级分类任务（EHR 派生目标）上，固定留出测试集 7,818 人中，PaReGTA-Gap + LightGBM 作为事后分析参考，其 AUC、accuracy、F1 在所评估的稀疏、BERT 类 EHR 与循环方法中最高。
Conclusion: 带显式时间线索的模板化文本加混合时间池化可产出可直接接常规下游模型的固定维患者表示，并在该偏头痛队列的探索性比较中取得最高报告指标。
Relevance: 4
