papers.title: Curating Always-Loaded Context for LLM Agents: A Capacitated Assortment Model with Censored Feedback
papers.abstract_en: At the start of every session, LLM agents load a fixed context file, such as $\texttt{AGENTS.md}$. Each loaded token in the file is charged again in every later round of the session, and these files can degrade performance as they grow in size. However, in practice, human or automated curators usually grow these files by appending. We formulate context curation as a capacitated assortment problem. Instructions consume tokens under a finite attention capacity; adding an instruction never raises the compliance of the others, while retained instructions incur a per-session setup cost. We prove an upper bound on the optimal file size, regardless of the number of available candidate instructions, and that appending every instruction with positive standalone value can be arbitrarily worse in net value than selecting an optimal subset. A token budget also limits the loss when the token price is underestimated. We then examine what can be learned from past sessions and how this information can guide decisions to add or remove instructions. Feedback is inherently censored: the benefits and harms of loaded instructions are observable, whereas missing instructions generate feedback only when their absence causes harm. In this setting, we show that deleting instructions ignored by agents can inevitably remove helpful ones. We characterize how much evidence should be collected before adding an instruction. Besides, we bound regret when human reviewers can inspect only a limited number of edits per period. Empirical experiments further show that irrelevant rules drawn from real context files reduce language-model compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 的常驻上下文文件（如 AGENTS.md）建模为带容量的 assortment 问题：指令占用有限注意力容量，每条保留指令产生每次会话的固定成本，追加所有正独立价值的指令在净价值上可任意差于最优子集。在删失反馈下，删除被 agent 忽略的指令必然误删有用指令；实测中来自真实上下文文件的无关规则会降低模型遵从度。
Motivation: 上下文文件靠不断追加增长，每个 token 在会话后续每一轮都被重复计费，文件变大会拖累表现；而缺失指令只有在其缺席造成伤害时才产生反馈，反馈天然删失。
Method: 将上下文策展形式化为 capacitated assortment 问题：有限注意力容量下指令消耗 token，新增指令不提升其他指令的遵从度，保留指令有会话级 setup cost；在此模型上证明最优文件大小上界、追加策略的任意差界、token 预算对 token 价格低估的损失界，以及在人工审阅者每期只能检查有限条编辑时的 regret 界，并刻画新增一条指令前应收集多少证据。
Result: 证明最优文件大小存在与候选指令数无关的上界；追加所有正独立价值指令的净价值可任意差于最优子集；token 预算限制 token 价格被低估时的损失；删除被忽略的指令必然删掉有用指令；给出新增指令的证据量刻画与有限审阅预算下的 regret 界；实验显示来自真实上下文文件的无关规则降低语言模型 compliance。
Conclusion: 常驻上下文不应靠追加生长，而应在容量约束下选最优子集；删失反馈使基于忽略的删除不安全，且证据量与审阅预算共同决定何时该加指令。

papers.title: How Narrative Wrapping Affects LLM Refusal: A Cross-Language Benchmark and Defense
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned language models often refuse a harmful request stated directly but answer the same request inside a role-play or narrative wrapper. We measure this vulnerability across languages and registers: attack success on Qwen3-1.7B is already 89.4% in English and 93.0% in modern Chinese, and reaches 95.7% in Classical Chinese. We build GUISE, a benchmark for systematically studying this vulnerability. It includes parallel requests in English, modern Chinese, and Classical Chinese, matched harmful and benign pairs, wrapper types held out for evaluation, and a stricter criterion that counts warn-then-answer responses as attack successes. Representation analysis shows that language and register move harmful-request representations only slightly away from the model's refusal direction, whereas narrative wrappers move them much farther away. We propose AXIS, which combines preference optimisation with a rotation objective that aligns harmful-request representations with the refusal direction and a commitment objective that trains the model to refuse completely rather than produce a warn-then-answer response. Across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B and GLM-4-9B, AXIS achieves the highest combined safety and usability score among the compared methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 叙事包装 (narrative wrapper) 让安全对齐 LLM 对同一有害请求直接拒绝却照答：Qwen3-1.7B 上攻击成功率英语 89.4%、现代汉语 93.0%、文言文 95.7%。表示分析显示语言与语域只把有害请求表示轻微推离拒绝方向，叙事包装则推得远得多；据此提出 AXIS，用偏好优化加旋转目标把表示对齐拒绝方向，再加承诺目标杜绝“先警告后作答”。
Motivation: 安全对齐模型对直接陈述的有害请求会拒绝，但把同一请求放进角色扮演或叙事包装就照答，且该漏洞跨语言、跨语域普遍存在，此前缺少系统度量它的基准。
Method: 构建 GUISE 基准：英语、现代汉语、文言文的平行有害请求，配对的有害/ benign 样本，留出 wrapper 类型用于评测，并采用更严判据把“先警告后作答”计为攻击成功。提出 AXIS，结合偏好优化 (preference optimisation)、把有害请求表示旋转对齐拒绝方向的 rotation objective，以及训练模型完全拒绝而非 warn-then-answer 的 commitment objective。
Result: Qwen3-1.7B 上攻击成功率英语 89.4%、现代汉语 93.0%、文言文 95.7%。表示分析中语言与语域仅使有害请求表示轻微偏离拒绝方向，叙事包装使其偏离大得多。在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、GLM-4-9B 上，AXIS 的安全与可用性综合分在所比方法中最高。
Conclusion: 叙事包装而非语言或语域是绕过拒绝的主要杠杆，因此防御要直接把有害请求表示对齐拒绝方向并训练无条件拒绝，AXIS 在三个模型上取得最高的安全-可用性综合分。

summary_sections.motivation: 安全对齐模型对直接陈述的有害请求会拒绝，但把同一请求放进角色扮演或叙事包装就照答，且该漏洞跨语言、跨语域普遍存在，此前缺少系统度量它的基准。

papers.title: Reconstruction of Multiscale Plasma Dynamics Across Operating Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing spatially resolved plasma dynamics from few sensors is essential for diagnostics, reduced-order modelling and control, yet remains difficult because the sparse measurements incompletely constrain multiscale, regime-dependent degrees of freedom. The Shallow Recurrent Decoder (SHRED) partially addresses spatial sparsity by using measurement histories; however, its fully connected decoder provides no explicit mechanism for resolving spatial structure across scales or explicit parametric dependency. We introduce the Recurrent Multiscale Affine-modulated Inference Network (ReMAIN), which preserves SHRED's recurrent temporal encoding but replaces its decoder with a U-Net whose feature hierarchy is conditioned by the recurrent state through feature-wise linear modulation. The temporal representation supplies both a dense prior and scale-specific modulation throughout the U-Net. A parametric extension jointly embeds the operating condition and sensor history, enabling reconstruction to adapt as the governing dynamics change with operating regime. ReMAIN is first benchmarked against SHRED on six one-dimensional nonlinear PDEs representing diverse dynamics. Across all benchmarks, it reduces reconstruction errors on unseen trajectories and more faithfully resolves sharp transitions, localized extrema and fine-scale variations. The parameter-conditioned model is then demonstrated on a collisionless $E \times B$ plasma subject to perpendicular axial electric and radial magnetic fields, with the electric-field strength serving as the operating parameter. ReMAIN reconstructs the high-dimensional, multiscale plasma state and recovers its regime-dependent spatiotemporal dynamics at electric-field strengths withheld from training. Together, ReMAIN improves sparse-sensor full-state reconstruction and, through parameter conditioning, generalizes across plasma operating regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ReMAIN：保留 SHRED 的循环时间编码，把全连接解码器换成由循环状态经 feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) 调制的 U-Net，并可把工况参数与传感器历史一起嵌入。在六个一维非线性 PDE 基准上，对未见轨迹的重建误差全面低于 SHRED，更忠实分辨尖锐间断、局地极值与细尺度变化；在无碰撞 E×B 等离子体上，电场强度作为工况参数，可在训练未见的电场强度下恢复按工况分化的多尺度时空状态。
Motivation: 稀疏传感器重建难在观测不完全约束多尺度、随工况变化的自由度；SHRED 虽用测量历史缓解空间稀疏，但全连接解码器既无跨尺度空间结构的显式机制，也无显式参数依赖。
Method: ReMAIN 沿用 SHRED 的循环时间编码器，解码器替换为 U-Net，其特征层级由循环状态经 feature-wise linear modulation 调制，时间表征同时提供稠密先验与逐尺度调制；参数化扩展把工况条件与传感器历史联合嵌入。先在六个表征多样动力学的一维非线性 PDE 上与 SHRED 对比，再在受垂直轴向电场与径向磁场的无碰撞 E×B 等离子体上演示，电场强度作为工况参数。
Result: 在全部六个一维非线性 PDE 基准上，ReMAIN 对未见轨迹的重建误差均低于 SHRED，并更忠实分辨尖锐间断、局地极值与细尺度变化；在 E×B 等离子体上，于训练中未保留（withheld）的电场强度处重建高维多尺度等离子体状态，恢复其工况依赖的时空动力学。
Conclusion: 稀疏传感器全态重建可通过多尺度、参数调制的解码器改进，并借参数条件化跨等离子体工况泛化；该框架面向诊断、降阶建模与控制。

papers.title: Low-rank tensor structure of precipitation and its application to satellite-reference merging
papers.abstract_en: The intermittent and variable nature of precipitation makes its accurate estimation over extended domains difficult, yet its spatiotemporal structure suggests that a low-rank representation may be possible. This work represents daily precipitation over the contiguous United States (CONUS) as spatiotemporal tensors and applies CANDECOMP/PARAFAC factorization, showing that preserving the native spatial and temporal modes yields more accurate reconstruction than factorizing independent daily fields or unfolded space--time matrices. Building on this finding, this work presents TMerge, a tensor-based framework that integrates satellite precipitation with sparse reference observations through shared low-rank spatial and temporal factors. TMerge was applied to correct the IMERG Final Run product with climate prediction center reference observations over CONUS. During 2019-2022, TMerge increased correlation from 0.53 to 0.85 and reduced root-mean-square error and mean absolute error by 48.2% and 29.3%, respectively. TMerge consistently outperformed linear bias correction, quantile mapping, and neural networks across seasons, precipitation-intensity regimes, and regions. Improvements were spatially coherent and largest in coastal regions where IMERG errors were greatest. These results demonstrate that low-rank tensor structure parsimoniously approximates the dominant spatiotemporal variability of precipitation and provides a practical mechanism for improving satellite estimates under limited reference observations over extended domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把美国本土 (CONUS) 日降水组织成时空张量并做 CANDECOMP/PARAFAC 分解，保留原生空间与时间模态的低秩表示比逐日独立分解或时空矩阵展开重建更准。基于此提出 TMerge，用共享低秩时空因子把 IMERG Final Run 与 CPC 稀疏参考观测融合，2019–2022 年相关系数从 0.53 升到 0.85，RMSE 与 MAE 分别下降 48.2% 和 29.3%。
Motivation: 降水在大范围上间断多变，卫星产品在参考观测稀疏的长域上估计困难，但其时空结构可能允许低秩表示，用少量参考观测即可校正。
Method: 将 CONUS 日降水表示为时空张量，用 CANDECOMP/PARAFAC 分解并比较保留原生时空模态、逐日独立分解与时空矩阵展开三种方式；再提出 TMerge，通过共享的低秩空间与时间因子融合卫星降水与稀疏参考观测，用于校正 IMERG Final Run，参考为 CPC 观测。
Result: 2019–2022 年 CONUS 上，TMerge 使 IMERG 与 CPC 参考的相关系数由 0.53 提高到 0.85，RMSE 下降 48.2%，MAE 下降 29.3%；在各季节、降水强度区间与区域上均优于线性偏差订正、分位数映射与神经网络，改进空间上连贯且在 IMERG 误差最大的沿海地区最显著。
Conclusion: 低秩张量结构能简约地逼近降水主导的时空变率，在参考观测有限的大范围区域为改进卫星降水估计提供了实用机制。

papers.title: F$^3$NO: Frequency-Decomposed Finite-Time Flow-map Neural Operators with Cross-Scale Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators enable fast PDE forecasting, but repeated predictions accumulate errors and fine-scale structures remain difficult to resolve. We introduce a frequency-decomposed finite-time flow-map neural operator (F$^3$NO) that leverages updated low-frequency features to guide nonlinear refinement of high-frequency information. Within each layer, this cross-scale conditioning connects global spectral processing with local detail refinement. The model directly predicts states at specified future times and adjusts the contributions of the two branches according to the prediction interval. For longer trajectories, it combines parallel predictions within short temporal segments with recursive propagation between segments. Experiments on five PDE benchmarks demonstrate improved forecasting accuracy over autoregressive and direct-prediction baselines. Ablations show that frequency-decomposed refinement can improve accuracy with fewer parameters, while the benefits of segmentation depend on spatial resolution and dynamical regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: F$^3$NO 把频率分解与有限时间 flow-map 结合：每层用更新后的低频特征引导高频信息的非线性细化，两分支权重随预测时间间隔调整，长轨迹用短时段并行预测加时段间递归传播。在五个 PDE 基准上，其预报精度优于自回归与直接预测基线，且频率分解细化用更少参数即可提升精度。
Motivation: 神经算子做 PDE 快速预报时反复迭代会累积误差，且细尺度结构难以分辨；纯自回归长轨迹滚动与纯直接预测各有一端短板。
Method: F$^3$NO 在每层内做频率分解：低频分支做全局谱处理并输出更新后的低频特征，作为 cross-scale conditioning 引导高频分支的局部细节细化，两分支贡献按预测时间间隔调节；模型直接输出指定未来时刻状态，长轨迹则在短时段内并行预测、时段之间递归传播。
Result: 在五个 PDE 基准上，预报精度高于自回归与直接预测基线；消融显示频率分解细化能以更少参数提升精度，而分段（segmentation）的收益取决于空间分辨率与动力学 regime。
Conclusion: 用低频引导高频的跨尺度细化是提升神经算子精度与参数效率的有效路径，但分段长轨迹策略并非普适，需按分辨率和动力学状态取舍。

papers.title: Invariant-Measure Reasoners: Stable Representations for Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning models repeatedly update a latent state using the same recurrent block. As the recurrent depth increases, the sequence of latent states may converge to a compact subset of the state space without necessarily converging to a fixed point. Existing models typically predict by applying a prediction head to a single latent state. However, the latent state can continue to change even after many updates, potentially making predictions unstable across recurrent depths. To address this instability, we introduce invariant-measure reasoners (ImR), a framework that uses an invariant measure as a stable representation. This measure describes the long-run distribution of latent states on the compact subset and is invariant under updates by the recurrent block. ImR predicts from the expectation of the prediction head's output under this measure. We use ImR in two ways: fine-tuning only the prediction head of existing models and training models from scratch. Both approaches reduce prediction instability and improve accuracy in many settings on maze and Sudoku tasks. In some settings, models trained with ImR exhibit non-fixed-point behavior more frequently than existing models yet achieve high accuracy even with such behavior, unlike existing models. These results suggest that ImR can leverage otherwise destabilizing dynamics for latent reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImR 把潜变量推理中随递归深度漂移的单点状态换成其不变测度 (invariant measure) 的期望来预测：递归块迭代后潜状态收敛到紧子集而非不动点，用该子集上的长期分布期望做预测头输入。在 maze 与 Sudoku 任务上，两种用法（只微调已有模型的预测头、从头训练）都降低预测不稳定性并在多数设置中提高准确率；部分设置中 ImR 模型出现非不动点行为的频率更高却仍保持高准确率。
Motivation: 潜推理模型用同一递归块反复更新潜状态，递归深度加大时状态可能收敛到紧子集而非固定点，而现有模型只对单个潜状态接预测头，导致预测随递归深度变化而不稳定。
Method: 提出 invariant-measure reasoners (ImR)：以递归块下的不变测度刻画潜状态在紧子集上的长期分布，预测取预测头输出在该测度下的期望。两种使用方式——只微调已有模型的预测头，以及从头训练模型。
Result: 在 maze 和 Sudoku 任务上，两种 ImR 用法都降低预测不稳定性并在许多设置中提高准确率；部分设置中 ImR 训练的模型比现有模型更频繁地表现出非不动点行为，却仍达到高准确率。
Conclusion: ImR 能把原本导致不稳定的递归动力学转化为可用信号，说明潜推理不必依赖不动点收敛也能保持预测稳定与准确。

papers.title: Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Image retrieval methods often rely on a single global semantic descriptor extracted from an image, e.g., the [CLS] token in vision transformers. However, trying to squeeze all the semantic information of an image into a single descriptor can hurt downstream retrieval performance, especially for fine-grained retrieval tasks. In this work, we augment the semantic tokens in the newer visual transformers, the global [CLS] token and the four register tokens, with a carefully selected collection of spatial tokens, aiming to capture the spatial region representation that characterizes the contents captured in each of the semantic tokens. We leverage the DINOv2-reg model, which includes register tokens that emergently learn object and part-based representations. For each "cue" token ([CLS] and each register token), we find a "buddy" image patch token and extract an N x N patch region to produce a set of localized ROI tokens. Our approach automatically captures important regions of interest without any external bounding boxes or saliency modules, purely by matching semantic tokens with their spatial representation regions. Furthermore, we incorporate these tokens into a multi-vector retrieval framework inspired by ColBERT, enabling fine-grained matching via a per-token alignment mechanism while avoiding the large storage cost of keeping all patch embeddings. Through extensive experiments, we find that (1) register tokens encode useful fine-grained details that can complement the [CLS] token; (2) automatically pooled ROI tokens further improve fine-grained discrimination; and (3) multi-vector retrieval with a small set of tokens improves over a DINOv2-reg single-vector baseline while remaining tractable for large-scale search. The code is available at https://github.com/IdhcbIan/Augmenting_CLS_with_ROI_tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DINOv2-reg 上把 [CLS] 与四个 register token 各自匹配到一个“buddy” patch，抽出 N×N 的 ROI token 补成语义 token 集合，再接入 ColBERT 式多向量检索做逐 token 对齐。结果是 register token 携带可补足 [CLS] 的细粒度信息，自动池化的 ROI token 进一步提升细粒度区分度，少量 token 的多向量检索优于 DINOv2-reg 单向量基线且仍可支撑大规模检索。
Motivation: 细粒度图像检索把整图语义压进单个全局描述符（如 ViT 的 [CLS] token），会丢掉区分相似类别所需的局部区域信息，而补外部框或显著性模块又增加依赖。
Method: 利用 DINOv2-reg 的 register token（ emergently 学到物体与部件表示），对每个 cue token（[CLS] 及各 register）找对应 buddy patch token 并截取 N×N patch 区域生成局部 ROI token；随后把这些 token 放入受 ColBERT 启发的多向量检索框架，用逐 token 对齐机制做细粒度匹配，避免保存全部 patch embedding 的存储开销。
Result: 实验给出三条定性结论：register token 编码了可补足 [CLS] 的细粒度细节；自动池化的 ROI token 进一步改善细粒度区分；少量 token 的多向量检索在效果上超过 DINOv2-reg 单向量基线，同时对大规模搜索仍保持可行。
Conclusion: 无需外部 bounding box 或显著性模块，仅靠语义 token 与其空间区域的自动匹配即可补足全局描述符，且少量 ROI token 的多向量检索能在精度与存储之间取得可行折中。

papers.title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Omni-Diffusion-Distill 把统一多模态扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 的图像生成与多模态理解一起蒸馏到单个少步学生：先用回放教师轨迹让学生跳步，再在其自身 rollout 的中间态上精修，并用 pairwise collision penalty 抑制并行文本解码的重复、用 entropy-matched guidance 防止图像生成的熵坍缩。图像生成从 128 步降到 8 步、理解从 512 步降到 64 步，分别带来 18.2 倍与 21.2 倍墙钟加速，同时保住生成与理解性能。
Motivation: 统一多模态 dLLM 每次推理要几十到上百次前向，成本高；现有少步蒸馏方法只覆盖图像生成或文本生成之一，如何把完全离散的多模态 dLLM 压成单个学生且同时保住生成与理解并不清楚。
Method: 两阶段统一蒸馏，全部在离散 token 空间对齐图像与文本、生成与理解：第一阶段学生通过回放缓存的教师轨迹学习跳过解码步，第二阶段在学生自身 rollout 的中间态上精修。另加 pairwise collision penalty 缓解并行文本解码下的重复，entropy-matched guidance 防止拟合被锐化的教师分布导致图像生成熵坍缩。
Result: 图像生成 128 → 8 步、多模态理解 512 → 64 步，墙钟加速 18.2 倍与 21.2 倍。该步数预算下文生图 GenEval 0.828、DPG-Bench 83.0；多模态理解 GPT judge 在 MM-Vet 20.0、COCO captioning 57.2，后者为同教师同步数下教师 28.4 的两倍。
Conclusion: 在离散 token 空间把生成与理解的蒸馏对齐，配合针对重复与熵坍缩的两项修正，可以在大幅压缩步数的同时取得解码效率与生成、理解性能的最优权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation: On the Equivalence of Distribution Matching Distillation and Drifting Models
papers.abstract_en: Researchers are exploring effective one-step generative model continuously, and, Drifting Models (Deng et al., 2026), demonstrate great potential in one-step generation recently. There are works that reveal the connection between Diffusion & Flow Style Generative Models (DFSGMs) (Ho et al., 2020; Song et al., 2020a;b; Lipman et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022) and Drifting Models (Li & Zhu, 2026; Lai et al., 2026; Turan et al., 2026). But no one has yet established a precise correspondence between the Drifting Model and the widely used distillation method- Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD/DMD2) (Yin et al., 2024b;a) to the best of our knowledge, even though their optimization objective formulas are virtually identical. In this paper, we prove that by converting the velocity-field / noise-field from the pre-trained DFSGMs into the attraction force field in Drifting Models and estimating the repulsion force field from the generative distribution, training the Drifting Model is naturally equivalent to the Distribution Matching Distillation. With this equivalent concept, we propose an improved method based on DMD from the Drifting Model's perspective- Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明把预训练扩散/流模型 (DFSGMs) 的速度场或噪声场转成 Drifting Model 的吸引力场、并从生成分布估计排斥力场后，训练 Drifting Model 与 Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD/DMD2) 的优化目标在数学上等价。基于该等价视角提出改进方法 Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD)。
Motivation: Drifting Models 在一步生成上表现突出，已有工作揭示其与 DFSGMs 的联系，但 Drifting Model 与被广泛使用的 DMD/DMD2 之间缺少精确对应，尽管两者的目标函数几乎相同。
Method: 先建立等价性证明：将预训练 DFSGMs 的 velocity-field / noise-field 转换为 Drifting Model 的 attraction force field，再从生成分布估计 repulsion force field，使 Drifting Model 训练等价于 DMD。随后从 Drifting Model 视角改造 DMD，提出 Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD)。
Result: 给出 Drifting Model 训练与 DMD 优化目标等价的理论证明，并在此基础上提出 MBDMD；摘要中的贡献为理论对应关系与所提方法本身。
Conclusion: Drifting Model 与 Distribution Matching Distillation 并非两条独立路线，而是同一优化目标的两种表述，因此可从 Drifting Model 的力场分解出发改进 DMD。

papers.title: Fluid-Gen-Zero: Grounding Pretrained Video Generators in Physics without Training
papers.abstract_en: We present Fluid-Gen-Zero, a training-free framework for physics-aware fluid-object interaction video generation that decouples physical reasoning from appearance synthesis. Our key insight is to delegate motion dynamics to a physics simulator while preserving the appearance modeling capacity of pretrained video generators. We bridge these two domains through a two-level agentic workflow: generation-time planning, where a vision-language model (VLM) agent interprets intent and the simulation rollout to organize generation clips, and latent-space guidance, which injects simulation signals into denoising through region-aware latent wrapping. This plug-and-play design is compatible with current video foundation models. We further introduce a benchmark for fluid-object interaction video generation. Across Tora (CogVideoX-based), VACE and WanMove (Wan-based), Fluid-Gen-Zero consistently improves simulation alignment, reducing object trajectory error by 26.7%-81.5% and fluid fEPE (fluid flow endpoint error) by 67.9%-84.0%, while largely preserving perceptual quality. In a human preference study, raters favor Fluid-Gen-Zero in 55.1%-74.4% of same-backbone comparisons across three backbones, and in 90.4%-94.2% of comparisons against simulation-based methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fluid-Gen-Zero 是免训练框架，把流体-物体交互视频的运动交给物理仿真器，外观留给预训练视频生成器，用两级 agentic 工作流（生成时规划 + 潜空间 region-aware latent wrapping）把仿真信号注入去噪。在 Tora、VACE、WanMove 三个骨干上，物体轨迹误差降 26.7%-81.5%，流体 fEPE 降 67.9%-84.0%，人类偏好在同骨干对比中占 55.1%-74.4%。
Motivation: 预训练视频生成器外观强但物理运动不可控，纯仿真又缺外观真实感；两者需要免训练的桥接方式，且缺少流体-物体交互的专用评测基准。
Method: 两级 agentic 工作流：生成时规划阶段由 VLM agent 解读用户意图与仿真 rollout 来组织生成片段；潜空间引导阶段用 region-aware latent wrapping 把仿真信号注入去噪过程，整体即插即用、无需训练，兼容现有视频基础模型，并配套提出流体-物体交互视频生成基准。
Result: 在 Tora（CogVideoX-based）、VACE 与 WanMove（Wan-based）上，物体轨迹误差降低 26.7%-81.5%，流体 fEPE（fluid flow endpoint error）降低 67.9%-84.0%，同时基本保持感知质量；人类偏好研究中，评分者在三个骨干的同骨干对比里有 55.1%-74.4% 选择 Fluid-Gen-Zero，对基于仿真的方法则为 90.4%-94.2%。
Conclusion: 把运动动力学外包给物理仿真器、只用潜空间引导接管外观生成，可在不训练的前提下同时提升仿真对齐与人类偏好；代码与数据将在接收后发布。

papers.title: Probabilistic Sensing, Deterministic Authority: Admitting Model-Produced Observations into Sufficiency-Checked Governance Contracts
papers.abstract_en: When a field that an authority contract needs exists only in unstructured evidence, a model can sense it. We admit the model's output only as an observation record with a score. An admission policy, with thresholds fitted on a held-out split at a declared false-positive ceiling, maps each score to true, false or unknown. Unknown denies. A deterministic, sufficiency-checked contract decides. The probability that sensing changes the verdict is bounded by the sum, over the contract's sensed fields, of the admitted-wrong and unknown rates. This is an instantiation of union-bound reasoning, indexed by the contract. Minimising the estimated bound is a valid cost model for choosing among sufficient contracts. In a registered study on two constructed domains with two sensor families (36,000 model calls), no cell refuted the bound. Deny-to-allow changes from sensing appeared for the first time in this programme: 13 of 21,000 test verdicts, all from 3 contradictory records; each flip in a cell with a registered bound lay under it. Sensing-aware selection picked the lower-exposure contract in 4 of 4 registered tests. Both sensors' scores were informative but not calibrated. Correctness is relative to the declared loss model, candidate representation and reachable states; all domains are constructed.
papers.comment: 23 pages. Sixth paper of the SARC series. Preregistered; external reviews and an independent reproduction are committed in the repository. Code, caches and checkers: https://github.com/besanson/gigo-jev-probe (tag v1.0.1), archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23224016
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把模型对非结构化证据的感知输出只当作带分数的观测记录，由阈值化的准入策略映射为 true/false/unknown（unknown 即拒绝），再交给确定性且经充分性检查的合同裁决；感知改变裁决的概率被合同各感知字段的 admitted-wrong 与 unknown 率之和（union bound）界定。在两个构造域、两类传感器、36,000 次模型调用的注册研究中没有单元推翻该界：21,000 条测试裁决里出现 13 次 deny-to-allow 翻转，全部来自 3 条矛盾记录，且每个有注册界的单元翻转率都在界之下。
Motivation: 权威合同需要的字段只存在于非结构化证据中时，直接采信模型输出会把概率性感知混入确定性裁决；需要一种可界定翻转风险的准入机制。
Method: 模型输出仅作为带分数的观测记录进入；在留出集上按声明的假阳性上限拟合准入阈值，把分数映射为 true/false/unknown，unknown 一律拒绝；确定性合同做充分性检查后裁决，并以各感知字段 admitted-wrong 与 unknown 率之和作为感知改变裁决概率的 union bound，最小化该估计界作为在充分合同间选择的成本模型。
Result: 注册研究覆盖两个构造域、两类传感器、36,000 次模型调用，无单元推翻所注册的界；21,000 条测试裁决中 13 次 deny-to-allow 翻转，全部源自 3 条矛盾记录，每个带注册界的单元翻转均在界之下；感知感知的合同选择在 4/4 注册测试中选中低暴露合同；两类传感器分数有信息量但未校准。
Conclusion: 以 union bound 按合同索引地约束感知翻转风险是可行的成本模型，能在充分合同间选出暴露更低者；正确性相对于声明的损失模型、候选表示与可达状态成立，且所有域均为构造域。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 模型输出仅作为带分数的观测记录进入；在留出集上按声明的假阳性上限拟合准入阈值，把分数映射为 true/false/unknown，unknown 一律拒绝；确定性合同做充分性检查后裁决，并以各感知字段 admitted-wrong 与 unknown 率之和作为感知改变裁决概率的 union bound，最小化该估计界作为在充分合同间选择的成本模型。
summary_sections.result: 注册研究覆盖两个构造域、两类传感器、36,000 次模型调用，无单元推翻所注册的界；21,000 条测试裁决中 13 次 deny-to-allow 翻转，全部源自 3 条矛盾记录，每个带注册界的单元翻转均在界之下；感知感知的合同选择在 4/4 注册测试中选中低暴露合同；两类传感器分数有信息量但未校准。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以 union bound 按合同索引地约束感知翻转风险是可行的成本模型，能在充分合同间选出暴露更低者；正确性相对于声明的损失模型、候选表示与可达状态成立，且所有域均为构造域。

papers.title: Optimizing Large Language Models with Chained LMOs
papers.abstract_en: Muon has motivated a growing family of optimizers that compose multiple matrix normalizations, but these methods remain fragmented and lack a unified perspective. We introduce chained linear minimization oracles (chained LMOs), which cast these methods as compositions of LMOs. Despite their empirical success, many chains fall outside the standard LMO framework and can diverge on smooth convex objectives. To explain why composition can nevertheless help, we turn to linear associative memory and show that chaining can improve over Muon under anisotropic embeddings. Empirically, we propose TensorChain, a novel optimizer within the framework that stacks compatible weight matrices across different layers and normalizes the 3d tensor across its axes. In Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B pretraining, TensorChain outperforms all chained baselines in average token efficiency, with average token savings of 9.6% over Muon at matched validation loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Muon 一族多矩阵归一化优化器统一成链式线性最小化预言机 (chained LMOs)，指出许多链在光滑凸目标上会发散，但在线性联想记忆视角下各向异性嵌入 (anisotropic embeddings) 中链式组合可优于 Muon。据此提出 TensorChain：跨层堆叠权重矩阵并对所得 3d 张量按各轴归一化，在 Qwen3 0.6B 与 1.7B 预训练中平均 token 效率超过全部链式基线，同等验证损失下相对 Muon 平均节省 9.6% token。
Motivation: 由 Muon 衍生的多矩阵归一化优化器各自为政、缺少统一视角，且经验成功与标准 LMO 理论脱节——许多链已落在标准 LMO 框架之外，甚至在光滑凸目标上发散。
Method: 提出 chained LMOs 框架，把现有方法写成 LMO 的复合；用线性联想记忆解释为何复合仍可能有效，给出各向异性嵌入下链式优于 Muon 的分析；框架内提出 TensorChain，跨不同层堆叠相容权重矩阵并沿各轴归一化该 3d 张量。
Result: 在 Qwen3 0.6B 和 1.7B 预训练中，TensorChain 的平均 token 效率超过所有链式基线，同等验证损失下相对 Muon 平均节省 9.6% token。
Conclusion: 多矩阵归一化优化器可用 chained LMO 统一刻画，且在各向异性嵌入下链式组合确能超过 Muon；TensorChain 是该框架下按张量轴归一化即可见效的实例。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value of a target policy from logged data, but limited behavior-policy coverage can force high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation. Counterfactual annotations can add evidence about unobserved actions, yet practical sources, including domain experts and large language models (LLMs), may be costly, biased, or noisy. We study budgeted acquisition of such annotations for contextual-bandit OPE. Given source-specific costs and error profiles, we formulate an integer allocation problem over context-action pairs and annotation sources to minimize the component of estimator variance that depends on the annotation plan. We characterize when annotations are valuable through a first-annotation threshold and local annotation-value regimes. For the coupled multi-source problem, we develop a majorization-minimization algorithm with dynamic-programming subroutines that monotonically improves the objective. Experiments in synthetic clinical and LLM-annotated education bandits show that our allocation method reduces fixed-profile mean squared error (MSE) by 20.58% and 10.77%, respectively, relative to no annotation.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Lygist/Budgeted-Multi-Source-Counterfactual-Annotation-for-Off-Policy-Evaluation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对上下文老虎机 (contextual bandit) 的离策略评估 (OPE) 中行为策略覆盖不足导致高方差重加权或奖励模型外推问题，提出预算化多源反事实标注分配方法：把上下文-动作对与标注源的分配写成整数规划，最小化估计量方差中依赖标注方案的部分。基于一阶标注阈值与局部标注价值刻画，用带动态规划子程序的 majorization-minimization 算法单调改进目标；在合成临床与 LLM 标注教育老虎机上，相对不标注分别降低固定画像 MSE 20.58% 与 10.77%。
Motivation: 行为策略覆盖有限时，OPE 只能靠高方差重加权或奖励模型外推；反事实标注能补充未观测动作的证据，但专家与 LLM 等来源有成本、偏差与噪声，需要在预算下决定标哪里、用哪个源。
Method: 在给定各标注源成本与误差画像下，构造关于上下文-动作对与标注源的整数分配问题，目标是最小化估计量方差中依赖标注计划的分量；用一阶标注阈值 (first-annotation threshold) 与局部标注价值刻画标注何时有价值；耦合多源问题用带动态规划子程序的 majorization-minimization 算法求解，目标单调改进。
Result: 在合成临床老虎机与 LLM 标注的教育老虎机上，该分配方法相对不作任何标注分别降低固定画像 MSE 20.58% 与 10.77%。
Conclusion: 反事实标注的价值可由阈值与局部价值刻画并按预算最优分配，majorization-minimization 加动态规划能在多源耦合设定下单调降低 OPE 的方差分量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transferability of Learned States in Neural PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Assessing useful reuse in neural PDE solvers is challenging: final accuracy can reflect source learning and target-time computation. Our reuse contract separates solution accuracy, learning contribution, and numerical utility through paired state comparisons, matched target information and budgets, and cost accounting. A literature audit extracts 18 version-specific protocol records from 12 papers, documenting retained states, target-time resources, and reported controls. For a fixed linear system and residual tolerance, we construct two initial guesses with identical solution-error, energy-error, and residual norms, reaching the same solution with different conjugate-gradient (CG) iteration counts. Across 240 source-training trajectories, two linear PDE families, Fourier neural operators and convolutional networks, a fixed predictor's benefit reverses across correction algorithms. Among pairs with both relative prediction errors less than or equal to 5 percent on 64 in-distribution tasks (63 by 63 interior grids), reductions in all three norms accompany more CG iterations, at mean taskwise rates of 23.5 percent and 23.9 percent in two libraries. Work-based selection saves 2.50-3.33 CG iterations on held-out in-distribution tasks; matched adaptation demonstrates finite-budget pretraining value. Independent batches confirm a 0.73 percent complete online saving for one physics-trained Fourier neural operator against zero-initialized Poisson-preconditioned CG. Reuse requires matched state comparisons and downstream computational evidence.
papers.comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出神经 PDE 求解器的复用契约 (reuse contract)，用配对状态比较、匹配的目标信息与预算、以及成本核算，把解精度、学习贡献与数值效用三者分开。核心发现是同一固定预测器的收益会随校正算法反转：在 64 个同分布任务上两个初猜的相对预测误差都 ≤5% 时，三个范数（solution-error、energy-error、residual）全部下降反而伴随更多 CG 迭代，平均任务级增幅 23.5% 与 23.9%（两个库）。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器的最终精度混杂了源域学习与目标时刻计算两部分，无法判断预训练状态是否真的被复用，文献中也缺少统一的对照协议。
Method: 复用契约通过配对状态比较、匹配的目标信息与预算、成本核算来分离三项贡献；文献审计从 12 篇论文提取 18 条版本相关协议记录。构造在解误差、能量误差、残差范数上完全相同但 CG 迭代数不同的两个初猜，跨 240 条源训练轨迹、两类线性 PDE、Fourier neural operator 与卷积网络进行配对比较。
Result: 64 个同分布任务（63×63 内部网格）上，两初猜相对预测误差均 ≤5% 时三范数下降对应 CG 迭代增加，两个库平均任务级速率 23.5% 与 23.9%；基于做功的选择 (work-based selection) 在留出同分布任务上节省 2.50–3.33 次 CG 迭代；独立批次确认一个 physics-trained Fourier neural operator 相对零初始化 Poisson-preconditioned CG 节省 0.73% 的完整在线开销。
Conclusion: 复用必须同时给出配对状态比较与下游计算证据：范数更小不等于更省算力，收益随校正算法反转，只有匹配预算下的做功核算才能证明预训练状态的有限预算价值。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: When Citations Mislead? A Claim-Level Benchmark for Legal Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used in legal research and drafting, but they can still produce claims that sound convincing without being supported by the cited source. We introduce PARCEL, a benchmark for checking whether a legal claim is supported by the underlying authority. Using recent New York State Court of Appeals decisions, we build a dataset of 3,396 parenthetical-style claims labeled as Supported, Refuted, or Not Found. We cast this task as a three-way natural language inference problem and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLMs in a zero-shot setting. Although the strongest models reach up to 0.97 accuracy, the results also show an important weakness: models still incorrectly mark unsupported claims as supported, even when the full opinion text is provided. Across models, missing support is harder to detect than direct contradiction, and fabricated but plausible citations cause the largest drop in performance. Overall, PARCEL provides a practical benchmark for testing claim-level groundedness in legal RAG systems.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published in the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), Singapore. Dataset: https://github.com/mmikaildemir/PARCEL
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), June 08-12, 2026, Singapore. ACM, New York, NY, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PARCEL 把法律主张是否有判例支撑做成三分类 NLI 任务，用纽约州上诉法院近期判决构建 3,396 条 parenthetical 式主张（Supported/Refuted/Not Found），零样本评测多个 SOTA LLM。最强模型准确率达 0.97，但即使给出判决全文，模型仍会把无支撑主张判为 Supported；缺失支撑比直接矛盾更难识别，伪造但看似合理的引用造成最大性能下降。
Motivation: LLM 用于法律检索与起草时会产出听上去可信、却不受所引权威支撑的主张，现有评测缺少针对单条主张与其引用来源是否对齐的细粒度检验。
Method: 从近期 New York State Court of Appeals 判决构建 3,396 条 parenthetical 式主张数据集，标注 Supported、Refuted、Not Found 三类；将任务表述为三分类自然语言推理 (NLI)，在 zero-shot 设定下评测多个 SOTA LLM，并提供完整 opinion 文本作为上下文。
Result: 最强模型准确率最高达 0.97；即便提供完整 opinion 文本，模型仍会把无支撑主张误判为 Supported。跨模型比较中，缺失支撑 (Not Found) 比直接矛盾 (Refuted) 更难检测，伪造但看似合理的引用造成最大幅度的性能下降。
Conclusion: PARCEL 表明当前 LLM 在法律 RAG 的主张级 groundedness 上仍不可靠，尤其是面对貌似合理的伪造引用时；该基准可用于检验法律 RAG 系统的引用支撑能力。

papers.title: ASPIRE: Saddle-Point Discovery through Set Prediction and Physical Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Predicting thermally activated diffusion and defect evolution with event-driven models requires identifying atomic rearrangement mechanisms and their activation barriers. Discovering the associated saddle points is a major computational bottleneck: multiple rearrangements may originate from one metastable state, while costly local searches can fail or repeatedly converge to the same saddle. To address this challenge, we introduce ASPIRE (Atomistic Saddle-Point Inference with Refinement for Events), a framework that predicts a set of saddle candidates from a single initial atomic environment and refines them through Dimer searches on the original interatomic potential. The framework's equivariant set predictor, Ev-Quiformer, integrates (i) geometry-conditioned scalar-vector event slots for generating multiple saddle-point proposals and (ii) a decoder that maps each slot to a full atomic displacement field by combining atom, slot, and anchor-relative vectors with invariant coefficients. We also contribute two datasets: (i) BCCFE4VACAV-4000, comprising 4,000 four-vacancy body-centered cubic iron configurations and 65,450 reference events grouped by initial state for set supervision and post-refinement evaluation; and (ii) BCCFE-1TO4VAC, comprising 5,372 configurations with one to four vacancies each. Theoretically, we establish conditions for proposal equivariance. Experimentally, ASPIRE achieves 77.20% reference-event coverage on this benchmark, compared with 75.73% for a conventional Dimer baseline, while requiring approximately half as many Dimer force evaluations. In a timing evaluation on 50 configurations, ASPIRE reduces wall time per configuration from 478.8 s to 176.3 s under the stated hardware settings.

papers.title: Spectrally Targeted Muon
papers.abstract_en: The Muon optimizer orthogonalizes each update matrix, setting all of its singular values to one, and has proven highly effective for training large language models. It remains unclear, however, whether this success comes from amplifying small singular directions that gradient descent neglects or from suppressing large, degenerate directions that disrupt training. We introduce Spectrally Targeted Muon, which orthogonalizes only the singular values above or below a threshold $τ$, so that varying $τ$ interpolates between normalized SGD and Muon. It isolates the relevant singular subspaces with projections computed by Newton-Schulz iteration on a shifted Gram matrix, so no SVD is needed. We evaluate these variants on the CIFAR-10 and NanoGPT speedruns, tracking the effective rank of gradient, update, and weight matrices and a new metric, the alignment of updates with the tangent space of the weight matrix's isospectral manifold. We find three things. First, the small singular values of the momentum are not noise. Orthogonalizing everything except the few largest singular values of each matrix nearly matches Muon while touching only a small fraction of the momentum, whereas orthogonalizing only the top falls well short even though it holds almost all of it. On language models every momentum singular value is far below one, so targeted orthogonalization can only amplify, and Muon wins by making directions that are too small to train on at their raw scale trainable. Second, shrinking the largest singular values is what keeps the parameter spectrum flat; this is cheap, and it is not what drives the loss. Third, AdamW differs from Muon mainly in how slowly it builds structure, which explains its slower start and why warmup helps AdamW but only hurts Muon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spectrally Targeted Muon 只对超过或低于阈值 τ 的奇异值做正交化，τ 在归一化 SGD 与 Muon 之间连续插值，且用移位 Gram 矩阵上的 Newton-Schulz 迭代求子空间投影、无需 SVD。在 CIFAR-10 与 NanoGPT speedrun 上追踪梯度/更新/权重矩阵的有效秩与更新同权重等谱流形切空间的对齐度后，作者判定 Muon 的优势来自把过小的动量奇异方向放大到可训练尺度，而不是压制大而退化的方向。
Motivation: Muon 把更新矩阵所有奇异值置 1 后对大模型训练极有效，但其收益究竟来自放大梯度下降忽略的小奇异方向，还是压制破坏训练的大退化方向，一直没有判据。
Method: 提出 Spectrally Targeted Muon：只正交化高于或低于阈值 τ 的奇异值，τ 变化即在归一化 SGD 与 Muon 间插值；用移位 Gram 矩阵上的 Newton-Schulz 迭代做投影以隔离相关奇异子空间，避免 SVD。在 CIFAR-10 与 NanoGPT speedrun 上评测这些变体，跟踪梯度、更新、权重矩阵的有效秩，并引入新指标：更新与权重矩阵等谱流形 (isospectral manifold) 切空间的对齐度。
Result: 动量的小奇异值不是噪声：只正交化除每矩阵少数最大奇异值之外的全部奇异值，几乎追平 Muon 且只改动小部分动量；只正交化最大的那些则明显落后，尽管保留了几乎全部动量。语言模型上每个动量奇异值都远小于 1，定向正交化只能起放大作用，Muon 的胜因是让原始尺度下过小的方向变得可训练。收缩最大奇异值使参数谱保持平坦且代价低，但不是 loss 的驱动因素；AdamW 与 Muon 的差别主要在结构建立速度，解释了 AdamW 起步慢、warmup 对 AdamW 有益而对 Muon 有害。
Conclusion: Muon 的有效性来自放大而非压制：把过小的动量奇异方向提升到可训练尺度才是 loss 收益的来源，压平大奇异值只是廉价的副产品；warmup 应按优化器的结构建立速度区别对待。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: iAm.md: Robot Skill Self-Assessment through Agentic Introspection for Unknown Open-Vocabulary Domains
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI based on Large Language Model generalization capabilities offers a wide range of potential applications, including planning for embodied tasks. For example, embodied agents based on Foundation models can generate plausible plans in autonomous robotics scenarios. Due to limited context windows or hallucinatory phenomena in the next-token prediction formulation, behaviors may be generated without establishing whether the deployed robot and the observed environment actually support the requested operation, in what we call a "grounding failure". Thanks to the recent improvements in reasoning capabilities of foundation models, autonomous robot behavior generation problem can be formulated as a code generation problem. We present iAm.md, a Markdown standard and generation framework, that allows anchoring this process in complementary forms of deployment evidence. Through open-vocabulary semantic mapping, we combine local vision-language detections and object segmentation and refer them to persistent object records in this intermediate standardized representation, allowing agentic introspection. We then study this new technique on a simulated TIAGo, on navigation-and-manipulation tasks, showing how this standardized representation jointly supports skill self-assessment and executable task generalization.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 13th Italian Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (AIRO 2026). Project page: https://yurimachine.github.io/iAm.md/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 iAm.md：一个 Markdown 标准与生成框架，把开放词汇语义映射得到的视觉-语言检测与物体分割结果写入持久物体记录，让基于 LLM 的机器人在生成行为前先做技能自省，判断部署端与环境是否真的支持该操作。在模拟 TIAGo 的导航与操作任务上，该标准化表示同时支撑技能自评估与可执行的任务泛化。
Motivation: 基础模型因上下文窗口受限与 next-token 预测的幻觉，会生成机器人与环境并不支持的行为，即 grounding failure；具身规划缺少可核对的部署证据。
Method: 把行为生成形式化为代码生成问题，用 iAm.md 这一 Markdown 标准与生成框架锚定部署证据：开放词汇语义映射结合局部 vision-language 检测与物体分割，将结果挂到持久物体记录这一中间标准化表示上，供 agentic introspection 使用。
Result: 在模拟 TIAGo 上的 navigation-and-manipulation 任务中考察该表示，显示它同时支持 skill self-assessment 与 executable task generalization；论文为 7 页、2 图、1 表。
Conclusion: 用标准化的持久物体记录作为中间表示，可让具身智能体在生成行为前自省技能可用性，从而缓解 grounding failure 并支持任务泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cross-Provider Review as a Runtime Contract for Coding Agents: A Controlled Pilot and Fault-Injection Study
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents increasingly share a workstation while drawing on separate providers and subscription allowances. A second agent can inspect a completed answer, but the call spends another pool and may provide no substantive finding. We describe an advisory cross-provider review contract: distinct resource pools, bounded execution, restricted reviewer capabilities, complete input delivery, usable semantic output, explicit failure states and durable per-attempt evidence. In a controlled, agent-authored pilot of 20 paired development turns, eight had a material reviewer finding (95% exact interval 19.1-63.9%). A boundary-condition scan across both reviewer backends reproduced a previously discovered false success on partial input: four truncation levels passed historically and failed after repair. The scan also found and repaired cancellation during process reaping. In real CLI probes, Claude had no writing tools; Codex attempted writes in five of five read-only trials, each write tool failed, and no disposable repository changed. These tests cover specified paths and versions, not field reliability. A preregistered shadow study of metadata-only review allocation accrued 25 formal observations before an exact-runtime regression found a third defect: a reviewer exiting nonzero with a well-formed verdict was counted as complete. Exit status was not recorded per attempt, so exposure cannot be resolved retrospectively. The 25 formal and two pending records remain an audit cohort; the measurement-valid cohort restarted at zero and collection has begun. No gate result is reported.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Project page: https://openterminalagent.surge.sh/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为共享工作站、分属不同供应商的编码智能体提出一种咨询式跨供应商审查契约 (advisory cross-provider review contract)：限定资源池、受限审查者能力、完整输入交付与逐次尝试的持久证据。20 组配对开发轮次中 8 轮审查者给出实质性发现（95% 精确区间 19.1–63.9%）；边界扫描复现并修复了部分输入下的 false success 与进程回收期取消两个缺陷，CLI 探针中 Codex 在 5/5 只读试验中尝试写入但写工具全部失败、无临时仓库被改动。
Motivation: 多个编码智能体共用工作站、各自消耗不同供应商的订阅额度，第二次审查调用既烧额度又可能一无所获；需要一个可审计的契约来界定审查何时算成功、失败状态如何留证。
Method: 定义跨供应商审查契约的要素：独立资源池、有界执行、受限审查者能力、完整输入交付、可用语义输出、显式失败状态与逐次尝试的持久证据；用 agent 自撰的 20 组配对开发轮次做受控试点，并对两个审查者后端做边界条件扫描、真实 CLI 探针，以及一项预注册的仅元数据审查分配 shadow study。
Result: 20 组配对轮次中 8 组有实质性审查者发现，95% 精确区间 19.1–63.9%；边界扫描中四种截断级别历史上通过、修复后失败，复现了部分输入的 false success，并发现并修复了进程回收期间的取消缺陷；真实 CLI 探针中 Claude 无写工具，Codex 在 5/5 只读试验中尝试写入、写工具全部失败且无临时仓库被改动；shadow study 累积 25 条正式观测后由精确运行时回归发现第三个缺陷（审查者以非零码退出但给出格式正确的 verdict 被计为完成），因未逐次记录退出状态，暴露无法回溯分辨，25 条正式加 2 条待定记录保留为审计队列，测量有效队列归零重启。
Conclusion: 跨供应商审查必须把失败状态与逐次退出码作为契约的一部分，否则缺陷会被计成完成、暴露无法回溯；作者明确这些测试只覆盖指定路径与版本，不代表现场可靠性，且不报告任何 gate 结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
papers.abstract_en: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .

papers.title: GPU-Accelerated Computation of Persistent Homology for Topological Analysis of Image Data
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, persistent homology has seen rapid adoption in deep learning, yet its computation remains a major bottleneck in network training. This paper introduces TopoGPU, a GPU streaming pipeline that computes persistence diagrams of cubical complexes induced by 2D and 3D images. TopoGPU streams the input image chunk by chunk, processing each chunk with massively parallel GPU kernels on a grid of GPU blocks; the resulting boundary relations are accumulated in host memory, where the CPU performs the boundary matrix reduction. TopoGPU introduces a stratification-aware discrete Morse matching that provably preserves persistent homology under streaming, together with a parallel topological sorting algorithm and a parallel V-path parity algorithm for deriving Morse boundaries on the GPU. TopoGPU outperforms Cubical Ripser, a state-of-the-art method for persistent homology computation, on every benchmark evaluated, achieving an average end-to-end speedup of 53.24x and a maximum of 198.01x. We further integrate TopoGPU into a topology-preserving deep network, demonstrating that it substantially reduces the cost of persistent homology computation during network training. TopoGPU is open source, with pre-built binaries, Google Colab notebooks, and Docker images available at the project's GitHub page: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Includes supplementary material (8 pages) after the main paper. Code: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoGPU 用 GPU 流式管线计算 2D/3D 图像诱导的 cubical complex 持续同调：图像分块进 GPU kernel 累积边界关系，CPU 做边界矩阵约化，并提出在流式下可证明保持持续同调的分层感知离散 Morse 匹配。在全部评测基准上快于 Cubical Ripser，端到端平均加速 53.24 倍、最高 198.01 倍，并集成进保拓扑深度网络以降低训练中的持续同调开销。
Motivation: 持续同调在深度学习中被广泛采用，但其计算是网络训练的主要瓶颈，尤其对 2D/3D 图像数据。
Method: GPU 流式管线 TopoGPU：输入图像按 chunk 流式送入 GPU block 网格上的大规模并行 kernel，边界关系在主机内存累积、由 CPU 执行边界矩阵约化；核心算法为分层感知离散 Morse 匹配（provably preserves persistent homology under streaming），配并行拓扑排序与并行 V-path parity 算法在 GPU 上导出 Morse 边界。
Result: 在每个评测基准上均超过 Cubical Ripser，端到端平均加速 53.24x、最高 198.01x；集成进保拓扑深度网络后大幅降低训练期间的持续同调计算开销。
Conclusion: 把流式分块与离散 Morse 约化搬到 GPU，可以在不改变持续同调结果的前提下把图像拓扑计算从训练瓶颈变成可用开销；代码、预编译二进制、Colab 与 Docker 开源。

papers.title: TRACE: A Governance Framework for Measuring Explainability Debt in Production AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Production AI systems deployed in high-stakes domains accumulate a governance liability that existing monitoring frameworks fail to detect: the progressive inability to explain individual decisions when regulators, auditors, or affected individuals demand accountability. We introduce TRACE (Transparency, Risk, Accountability, Compliance, and Explainability), a seven-instrument governance framework for measuring, tracking, and remediating Explainability Debt in production AI systems. The foundational instrument, the Explainability Debt Score (EDS), quantifies the proportion of production decisions falling below a governance-defined explainability confidence threshold at any point in time. Complementary instruments include DART (Debt Accumulation Rate Tracker for breach forecasting), SHIV (Scenario Health and Integrity Validator for daily governance), FDE (Feature Drift Evaluator for causal attribution), HVE (Human Validation Engine), AIDE (Audit Intervention Decision Engine), and ZERO (Zero Explainability Risk Optimiser for remediation). Through a twelve-month longitudinal case study of a production fraud detection system processing 50,000 daily financial transactions, achieving 98.46% accuracy and ROC-AUC of 0.9990, we demonstrate that an EDS of 0.23 on audit day was statistically predictable six months in advance using DART trajectory analysis (beta = 0.008/week, R-squared = 0.94, 95% CI: [0.006, 0.010]), and that 78% of Explainability Debt was concentrated in the highest-regulatory-risk decision category (transactions above $10,000), a risk asymmetry completely invisible to system-level metrics. TRACE provides the first quantitative operational architecture for EU AI Act Article 13 compliance in production AI deployment, establishing a new subdiscipline of explanation governance distinct from explanation generation.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Keynote presented at ICIDS 2026 (Manipal University Jaipur) and IEEE Al-Khwarizmi 2026. IEEE Senior Member #101994709. U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/159,545 (USPTO Confirmation #9430) covers aspects of the TRACE/EDS framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 提出七件套治理框架量化生产 AI 的 Explainability Debt：核心指标 EDS 统计低于治理阈值的决策占比，DART 用轨迹外推提前预警债务。在处理每日 5 万笔交易的欺诈检测系统 12 个月纵向案例中，审计日 EDS 0.23 可提前六个月预测（beta=0.008/周，R²=0.94），且 78% 债务集中在 1 万美元以上高监管风险类别，而系统级准确率指标完全看不到这种不对称。
Motivation: 高风险生产 AI 积累一种现有监控框架检测不到的治理负债：监管者或受影响个体要求解释时，系统逐步无法解释单个决策。
Method: TRACE 含七个工具：EDS（Explainability Debt Score，低于治理定义的可解释性置信阈值的决策占比）、DART（债务累积率追踪，用于违约预测）、SHIV（场景健康与完整性校验）、FDE（特征漂移归因）、HVE（人工验证）、AIDE（审计干预决策）、ZERO（零可解释性风险优化器）。评估为 12 个月纵向案例研究，对象是每日处理 5 万笔金融交易的生产欺诈检测系统。
Result: 该欺诈检测系统准确率 98.46%、ROC-AUC 0.9990；审计日 EDS 为 0.23，用 DART 轨迹分析可提前六个月统计预测（beta = 0.008/周，R² = 0.94，95% CI [0.006, 0.010]）；78% 的 Explainability Debt 集中在最高监管风险决策类别（1 万美元以上交易），系统级指标完全看不到这一风险不对称。
Conclusion: 作者主张 TRACE 是面向 EU AI Act 第 13 条合规的首个定量运维架构，并由此确立区别于 explanation generation 的 explanation governance 新子领域。

papers.title: Learning How to Search for Plans with Exponentially Less Space
papers.abstract_en: Heuristic search for a plan can store exponentially many states, even when its heuristic is almost perfect. We instead learn search control, one specification per domain, written as an indexical policy: a generalized policy with registers that hold objects and modes that sequence its rules. We add the choose rule, which loads an object into a register and marks a backtracking point, where one candidate suffices; every other rule must work for all of its outcomes and needs no search. Our main result is that structural termination, which rules out infinite executions, also bounds every execution by a polynomial in the number of objects. A depth-first procedure then finds a plan in polynomial space, however large the state space, with no list of visited states. The cost is time, exponential only in the choice depth, the number of real choices along an execution. Any class that such a policy solves therefore lies in NP, and in P at constant choice depth. We learn these policies with a language model in a counterexample-guided loop that certifies termination, verifies the training tasks, and keeps the choice depth small. With the learned policies, the procedure solves 1,709 of 1,890 test tasks of the IPC 2023 Learning Track and the Autoscale Agile suite, more than LAMA, BFWS, and Levitron, and most of them within one second and 100 MiB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用语言模型学出 indexical policy（带寄存器的广义策略）作为搜索控制，配合新增的 choose 规则与深度优先过程，把规划搜索的空间从指数级压到多项式级：时间代价只随 choice depth 指数增长，因此该策略类落在 NP、固定 choice depth 时落在 P。在 IPC 2023 Learning Track 与 Autoscale Agile 上解出 1,890 个测试任务中的 1,709 个，超过 LAMA、BFWS 与 Levitron，多数在 1 秒、100 MiB 内完成。
Motivation: 启发式规划搜索即使启发式近乎完美，仍可能在内存中保存指数多个状态；作者要换掉这条以空间换完备性的路线。
Method: 每个领域学一份以 indexical policy 表达的搜索控制：寄存器存对象、mode 编排规则；新增 choose 规则把对象装入寄存器并标记回溯点（只需一个候选），其余规则须对其全部结果成立因而无需搜索。用语言模型在 counterexample-guided 循环中学习策略，循环负责认证 termination、验证训练任务并压低 choice depth；执行端是不记录已访问状态的深度优先过程。
Result: structural termination 排除无限执行的同时把每次执行限制在对象数的多项式内，深度优先过程因此在多项式空间内找到计划；时间仅随 choice depth 指数增长，固定 choice depth 时属 P，一般属 NP。学到的策略在 IPC 2023 Learning Track 与 Autoscale Agile 共 1,890 个测试任务上解出 1,709 个，多于 LAMA、BFWS、Levitron，多数在 1 秒与 100 MiB 内完成。
Conclusion: 搜索控制可以学出来并给出可证明的终止与空间界：代价从空间转到只依赖 choice depth 的时间，使所解类落入 NP、固定 choice depth 时落入 P。

papers.title: SPD-MetaFormer is what you need for small-data brain decoding
papers.abstract_en: Brain signal decoding is challenging because neural recordings are noisy and vary across individuals, while labeled data are often limited. Recent attention-based models on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold have nevertheless achieved strong performance using covariance and connectivity representations, yet the contribution of learned token weighting remains unclear. We examine two representative architectures, MAtt (based on log-Euclidean geometry) and GBWAtt (based on generalized Bures--Wasserstein geometry), and find that their learned attention weights remain close to uniform after training. We relate this behavior to bounded similarity parameterizations that, under the original softmax scaling, limit attention-weight contrast. Moreover, replacing learned weights with uniform weights, throughout training and evaluation, has little effect on mean predictive performance while preserving each model's original aggregation geometry. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SPD-MetaFormer, an attention-free architecture built on uniformly weighted Fréchet aggregation under log-Euclidean geometry. Its backbone uses a geodesic residual to update a summary token and a shared spectral feedforward map to transform all tokens, followed by a learned weighted readout. Token states remain SPD-valued until tangent-space classification. Across three EEG benchmarks, SPD-MetaFormer achieves competitive results relative to published Euclidean and manifold baselines. Separate matched reproductions test learned versus uniform weighting within MAtt and GBWAtt. These results suggest that, in the short-sequence and limited-data regimes studied, carefully designed SPD architectures can provide a simpler and effective alternative to adaptive manifold attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SPD 流形上的脑解码中，MAtt 与 GBWAtt 训练后的注意力权重仍接近均匀，换成均匀权重几乎不改变平均预测性能。据此提出无注意力的 SPD-MetaFormer：均匀加权 Fréchet 聚合 + 测地残差更新 summary token + 共享谱前馈，在三个 EEG benchmark 上取得与已发表欧氏及流形基线相当的结果。
Motivation: 神经记录噪声大、个体差异大且标注有限，SPD 流形注意力模型表现好，但学到的 token 加权到底贡献了什么并不清楚。
Method: 先分析 MAtt（log-Euclidean 几何）与 GBWAtt（generalized Bures--Wasserstein 几何），把权重接近均匀归因于有界相似度参数化在原 softmax 缩放下的对比度受限；再提出 SPD-MetaFormer：log-Euclidean 下均匀加权 Fréchet 聚合，测地残差 (geodesic residual) 更新 summary token，共享谱前馈 (shared spectral feedforward) 变换所有 token，最后用可学习加权 readout，token 状态保持 SPD 值直到切空间分类；并做 MAtt/GBWAtt 内学习权重 vs 均匀权重的配对复现。
Result: 在 MAtt 与 GBWAtt 中，训练后注意力权重接近均匀；训练与评估全程替换为均匀权重对平均预测性能影响很小，同时保留原聚合几何。SPD-MetaFormer 在三个 EEG benchmark 上相对已发表的欧氏与流形基线取得有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: 在所研究的短序列、小数据 regime 下，精心设计的 SPD 架构可以用均匀加权聚合替代自适应流形注意力，作为更简单且有效的选择。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 在 SPD 流形上的脑解码中，MAtt 与 GBWAtt 训练后的注意力权重仍接近均匀，换成均匀权重几乎不改变平均预测性能。据此提出无注意力的 SPD-MetaFormer：均匀加权 Fréchet 聚合 + 测地残差更新 summary token + 共享谱前馈，在三个 EEG benchmark 上取得与已发表欧氏及流形基线相当的结果。
summary_sections.motivation: 神经记录噪声大、个体差异大且标注有限，SPD 流形注意力模型表现好，但学到的 token 加权到底贡献了什么并不清楚。
summary_sections.method: 先分析 MAtt（log-Euclidean 几何）与 GBWAtt（generalized Bures--Wasserstein 几何），把权重接近均匀归因于有界相似度参数化在原 softmax 缩放下的对比度受限；再提出 SPD-MetaFormer：log-Euclidean 下均匀加权 Fréchet 聚合，测地残差 (geodesic residual) 更新 summary token，共享谱前馈 (shared spectral feedforward) 变换所有 token，最后用可学习加权 readout，token 状态保持 SPD 值直到切空间分类；并做 MAtt/GBWAtt 内学习权重 vs 均匀权重的配对复现。

papers.title: RH-Detect: A Unified Benchmark for Reward Hacking Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reward hacking, where a model exploits an evaluation signal without completing the intended task, threatens the reliability of deployed language model systems. Existing datasets use different labels, response formats, and metadata conventions, making detector results difficult to compare. We present RH-Detect, a benchmark that combines reward-hacking-relevant subsets from eleven public datasets, comprising 92,761 rows and six behavior categories, into a common schema. On 5,021 open-ended evaluation units, each comprising a task prompt and a free-form model continuation, including multi-turn tool-use trajectories, we evaluate six off-the-shelf language models from five families as reward hacking detectors without additional training. The best model achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.962, with accuracy above 93%. For the four strongest models, however, accuracy on the two multi-turn tool-use datasets, MALT and TRACE, is 10.7-15.9 percentage points lower than on the other sources at a common decision threshold, highlighting a key gap for deployment-time monitoring. We find that different input formats have different effects across models. Removing thinking raises Qwen3.5-4B AUROC from 0.779 to 0.849, but lowers Qwen Flash from 0.977 to 0.950. We also evaluate the benchmark as a training dataset for detectors. Holding out each source in turn, single-token SFT improves average AUROC on five of six held-out sources. A GRPO follow-up on that failure case yields a slight improvement in detection performance. Our results show that a single pooled score can conceal variation across data sources, detector inputs, and training procedures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RH-Detect 把 11 个公开数据集的 reward hacking 相关子集统一成同一 schema（92,761 行、六类行为），在 5,021 个开放式评估单元上免训练评测六个模型作为检测器。最佳模型 pooled AUROC 0.962、准确率超 93%，但多轮工具使用数据集 MALT 与 TRACE 上准确率低 10.7–15.9 个百分点，说明单一 pooled 分数会掩盖数据源与输入格式带来的差异。
Motivation: 现有 reward hacking 数据集在标签、响应格式与元数据约定上互不一致，检测器结果难以横向比较；部署期监控又在多轮工具使用场景上存在明显缺口。
Method: 汇总 11 个公开数据集的相关子集为统一 schema，构成 92,761 行、六类行为的数据集；在 5,021 个开放式评估单元（任务 prompt + 自由续写，含多轮工具轨迹）上，免训练评测来自五个家族的六个现成语言模型作为检测器，并把该基准用作检测器训练数据：逐源留出做 single-token SFT，再对失败案例做 GRPO。
Result: 最佳模型 pooled AUROC 0.962、准确率高于 93%；四个最强模型在 MALT 与 TRACE 两个多轮工具使用数据集上的准确率比其他来源低 10.7–15.9 个百分点（同一决策阈值）。去掉 thinking 使 Qwen3.5-4B AUROC 从 0.779 升到 0.849，却让 Qwen Flash 从 0.977 降到 0.950。逐源留出的 single-token SFT 在六个留出源中的五个上提升平均 AUROC，对失败案例的 GRPO 追加训练带来轻微检测性能改善。
Conclusion: 单一 pooled 分数会掩盖数据源、检测器输入格式与训练流程之间的差异，部署期监控应按数据源与输入格式分别核查，尤其关注多轮工具使用轨迹。

papers.title: AI4Fire: Evaluating Large Language Models on Wildfire Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are entering wildfire management, where overstated evaluations can cost property and lives. How do they perform on wildfire tasks, with and without grounding? Bare means a model receives the task input alone. Grounded means it also receives one task-specific addition: for smoke detection, a smoke-free reference frame from the same camera. AI4Fire runs six core models bare and grounded on five wildfire tasks, zero-shot; a sweep adds 29 more. Our literature search on fire tasks found 138 works; none combines this roster, task coverage, and paired bare and grounded runs. We report three findings. (1) Grounding helped most where the addition carried the answer: a read-only SQL tool lifted every core model's database accuracy from at most 16 to at least 88 percent. (2) Simple rules were hard to beat: no core model outperformed repeating today's staffing count, and two open-weight models mostly copied the median of similar earlier fire-days, a worse forecast. (3) Public releases carry hazards: a fire-danger column separates the holdout perfectly, and 67 aerial fire frames carry smoldering or fire-free labels read from a clipped thermal maximum. We release prompts, responses, scores, code, and the survey record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI4Fire 用 bare 与 grounded 两种输入设置，零样本评测六个核心 LLM 在五项野火任务上的表现，并给出 29 个模型的扩展扫描。grounding 只在附加信息本身携带答案时起效：只读 SQL 工具把每个核心模型的数据库准确率从至多 16% 抬到至少 88%，而简单规则难以被击败——没有核心模型胜过复述当日值班人数，两个开源模型主要照抄相似历史火情日的中位数，预报反而更差。
Motivation: LLM 正进入野火管理，夸大的评测可能造成财产与生命损失，但现有工作缺少统一的模型阵容、任务覆盖与配对 bare/grounded 对照。
Method: 对六个核心模型在五项野火任务上做 zero-shot 的 bare（仅任务输入）与 grounded（附加一项任务特定信息，如烟雾检测的同机位无烟参考帧）配对评测，另做 29 个模型的扩展扫描；配套文献检索覆盖 138 篇火情相关工作，并公开 prompts、responses、scores、代码与检索记录。
Result: 只读 SQL 工具把全部核心模型的数据库准确率从至多 16% 提升到至少 88%；无任何核心模型胜过复述当日值班人数的规则；两个开源权重模型主要输出相似早期火情日的中位数，属于更差的预报；一个 fire-danger 列在 holdout 上完全可分，67 张空中火情帧带有从截断热红外最大值读出的闷燃或无火标签。
Conclusion: grounding 的收益取决于附加信息是否直接携带答案，而野火任务上简单规则仍是强基线；公开数据集本身带有会误导评测的标签与列泄漏。

papers.title: GHARP: Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior
papers.abstract_en: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject's geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. This separation offers a favorable trade-off with respect to fidelity, quality and runtime: the identity stage can be expensive while the animation stage runs a lightweight network, optimized for mobile devices. Our method performs animation in a semantically structured latent space of a pretrained reconstruction model, where expression changes remain spatially contained, making residual prediction efficient. This reconstruction prior provides a consistent spatial layout, allowing fusion of multiple input views into a compact, fixed-size canonical Gaussian representation. While this two-stage design improves the runtime-quality trade-off, it still inherits a problem common to all expression-driven avatar methods: expression codes describe only the face and thus omit body pose and clothing position, making these regions underspecified in the input. The animation network faces an ill-posed mapping and resorts to averaging over conflicting body appearances, producing blur and temporal flicker. We address this with a body alignment network that learns to align the person's body in the target image with the input reference images, removing the ambiguity from the training signal. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quality on the Ava-256 benchmark while running up to 13x faster on an A100 GPU with 8x fewer Gaussians.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages (14 main + references + 15 pages supplementary), 14 figures, 17 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GHARP 把表情驱动的 3D 人头实时动画拆成离线身份阶段与在线动画阶段，在预训练重建模型的语义结构化 latent 空间中预测表情残差，并用身体对齐网络消除身体外观欠定导致的模糊与闪烁。在 Ava-256 上达到 state-of-the-art 质量，同时在 A100 上最高快 13 倍、Gaussians 数量少 8 倍。
Motivation: 表情驱动 avatar 的 expression code 只描述面部，身体姿态与衣物位置在输入中欠定，动画网络面对病态映射只能对冲突外观取平均，产生模糊和时间闪烁；同时实时运行与保真度难以兼顾。
Method: 两阶段解耦：离线身份阶段用预训练重建模型的语义结构化 latent 空间融合多视角输入，得到固定尺寸的规范 Gaussian 表示；在线动画阶段在该先验上预测空间受限的表情相关残差，用面向移动端优化的轻量网络，并加入身体对齐网络，把目标图像中的身体与输入参考图对齐以消除训练信号歧义。
Result: 在 Ava-256 benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art 质量，在 A100 GPU 上最高快 13 倍，且 Gaussians 数量少 8 倍。
Conclusion: 把昂贵的身份重建与轻量的表情残差预测分开，并用重建先验提供一致空间布局，可以在保持质量的同时大幅降低实时动画开销；身体对齐网络用于消除身体外观欠定带来的模糊与闪烁。

papers.title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning environments are now a primary lever for improving large language model (LLM) capabilities in post-training, yet most agentic benchmarks remain static: the world moves only when the agent acts, the reward is a terminal verdict, and the pass bar is set arbitrarily. We introduce StoreBench, a live-commerce environment in which an agent runs a mid-size online apparel store on a production-grade commerce backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment under uncertainty. Customers order around the clock, suppliers reprice and fail, and market shocks arrive with partial or no warning. The agent acts through the same 29 merchant tools a human operator would use, under a windowed operation budget that makes simulated time a function of actions taken, so model latency cannot influence simulated time. Pass thresholds are calibrated against scripted anchor policies, the reward is hardened against a catalogue of reward hacks, and every episode replays identically given a sequence of actions. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs on 11 scenarios of 30 to 45 days and a full simulated year, over three world seeds at matched reasoning effort. No model matches the scripted smart-triage policy on average: the best, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, passes 49% of task-seed cells against the heuristic's 97%. Human experts working through the same tools and budgets outscore every model (mean composite 0.708 vs. 0.700). Over a full simulated year under the Claude Code harness, most models show dramatic performance improvement. In a GRPO post-training run, Qwen3.5-27B trained on only five disjoint tasks raises its mean composite on the held-out evaluation tasks from 0.136 to 0.373. We release five example training-split tasks, ten sample trajectories, and the scoring and verification tooling; the full environment and evaluation suite are withheld to keep the benchmark uncontaminated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StoreBench 是一个直播电商 RL 环境：LLM agent 用 29 个商家工具运营一家中型服装网店，面对全天候订单、供应商重新定价与断供、突发市场冲击做长周期经营决策。七个前沿模型在 11 个场景（30–45 天及一个完整模拟年）、3 个世界种子上无一追平脚本化 smart-triage 策略：最强的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 任务-种子格通过率 49%，启发式为 97%；GRPO 后训练让 Qwen3.5-27B 在留出任务上平均综合分从 0.136 升到 0.373。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 基准大多是静态的：世界只在 agent 行动时才变化，奖励是终局裁决，及格线任意设定，无法衡量长周期规划与不确定性下的经济判断。
Method: 环境跑在生产级电商后端上，agent 通过人类运营者使用的 29 个商家工具行动；采用窗口化操作预算使模拟时间成为行动数的函数，模型延迟不影响模拟时间。及格阈值用脚本化锚点策略校准，奖励针对已知 reward hack 目录加固，同一行动序列下每个 episode 可完全复现；后训练用 GRPO。
Result: 七个前沿模型在 11 个场景、3 个世界种子、匹配推理强度下评测：无模型平均追平脚本化 smart-triage 策略，最佳 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 通过 49% 的任务-种子格，启发式为 97%。用相同工具与预算的人类专家得分高于所有模型（平均综合分 0.708 vs 0.700）。在 Claude Code harness 下跑完整模拟年，多数模型表现大幅提升。GRPO 后训练中 Qwen3.5-27B 仅用五个互不相交的任务训练，留出评测任务平均综合分从 0.136 升至 0.373。发布五个训练切分示例任务、十条示例轨迹及打分与验证工具。
Conclusion: 在长周期、含冲击的直播电商经营上，前沿 LLM 仍明显落后于简单脚本策略与人类专家，但少量任务的 GRPO 后训练能大幅抬高留出任务成绩；完整环境与评测套件暂不公开以防污染。

summary_sections.method: 环境跑在生产级电商后端上，agent 通过人类运营者使用的 29 个商家工具行动；采用窗口化操作预算使模拟时间成为行动数的函数，模型延迟不影响模拟时间。及格阈值用脚本化锚点策略校准，奖励针对已知 reward hack 目录加固，同一行动序列下每个 episode 可完全复现；后训练用 GRPO。
summary_sections.result: 七个前沿模型在 11 个场景、3 个世界种子、匹配推理强度下评测：无模型平均追平脚本化 smart-triage 策略，最佳 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 通过 49% 的任务-种子格，启发式为 97%。用相同工具与预算的人类专家得分高于所有模型（平均综合分 0.708 vs 0.700）。在 Claude Code harness 下跑完整模拟年，多数模型表现大幅提升。GRPO 后训练中 Qwen3.5-27B 仅用五个互不相交的任务训练，留出评测任务平均综合分从 0.136 升至 0.373。发布五个训练切分示例任务、十条示例轨迹及打分与验证工具。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在长周期、含冲击的直播电商经营上，前沿 LLM 仍明显落后于简单脚本策略与人类专家，但少量任务的 GRPO 后训练能大幅抬高留出任务成绩；完整环境与评测套件暂不公开以防污染。

papers.title: Higher-Order Morphology Priors for Quadruped Reinforcement Learning Under Actuator Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Actuator degradation turns quadruped locomotion into a coordination problem requiring joints to compensate for lost actuation. Prior work suggests that morphology-aware graph policies improve learning and generalization under body perturbations. We ask whether these benefits can be strengthened by explicitly modeling higher-order mechanical structure. We represent the Unitree Go1 as a cell complex with limb- and body-level rank-2 cells and apply Hodge-based message passing. Under degradation training, the node-edge-face Hodge actor achieves the highest return on unseen actuator degradations, with higher survival and lower velocity-tracking error. These results support higher-order morphology as a useful inductive bias for whole-body compensation under actuator degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Unitree Go1 四足机器人表示为带肢体级与躯干级 rank-2 cell 的 cell complex，用基于 Hodge 分解的消息传递 (Hodge-based message passing) 构造 node-edge-face 策略，在执行器退化训练下让关节互相补偿失失的驱动力。该 Hodge actor 在未见过的执行器退化上取得最高回报，同时存活率更高、速度跟踪误差更低。
Motivation: 执行器退化使四足运动变成需要关节互相补偿的协调问题；已有 morphology-aware 图策略在身体扰动下有收益，但尚未显式建模高阶机械结构能否进一步强化这一收益。
Method: 将 Unitree Go1 建模为 cell complex，节点、边、面分别对应肢体级与躯干级 rank-2 cell，在其上施加 Hodge-based message passing 得到 node-edge-face actor；训练在执行器退化 (degradation training) 条件下进行，评估针对未见过的退化情形。
Result: 在未见过的执行器退化上，node-edge-face Hodge actor 取得最高回报 (highest return)，并伴随更高的存活率 (survival) 与更低的速度跟踪误差 (velocity-tracking error)。
Conclusion: 高阶形态 (higher-order morphology) 可作为执行器退化下全身补偿的有效归纳偏置，支持显式建模高阶机械结构以强化 morphology-aware 策略的收益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking the Tradeoff Between Temporal Encoding and Nonlinear Computation in Spiking Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spiking language models face a tradeoff between representing continuous semantic features over short temporal windows and retaining costly nonlinear attention operations. We introduce Spora, which jointly designs spike encodings and attention operators. Binary temporal weights let $T$ spikes represent compositional values with up to $T$ bits of capacity, compared with $O(\log_2 T)$ bits for spike-count readout. Unipolar Binary Spiking (UBS) uses thresholds and spike-triggered residual decay to produce non-negative integer codes; Bipolar Binary Spiking (BBS) separates sign and magnitude and learns a scale for signed activations. These representations support accumulation-and-shift dot products and integer-exponent mappings in attention. With four time steps, Spora achieves 76.6 average GLUE score and 44.1 CoLA MCC, improving over SpikeLM by 1.2 and 6.2 points, respectively. Extending BBS to six steps raises these scores to 78.2 and 47.4. Conditional-decay analysis, matched-budget activation-quantization comparisons, event-workload statistics, and fixed-point evaluation further characterize the connection between encoding fidelity and computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spora 联合设计脉冲编码与注意力算子，用二值时间权重让 T 个脉冲携带至多 T 比特容量（对比 spike-count 读出的 O(log2 T) 比特），从而在短时间窗内表达连续语义。4 个时间步下 GLUE 平均 76.6、CoLA MCC 44.1，较 SpikeLM 分别高 1.2 与 6.2 点；扩到 6 步升至 78.2 与 47.4。
Motivation: 脉冲语言模型在短时间窗内表达连续语义特征与保留昂贵的非线性 attention 之间存在权衡：时间步少了编码容量不够，多了计算开销上升。
Method: 提出 Spora 联合设计 spike 编码与 attention 算子。Unipolar Binary Spiking (UBS) 用阈值与 spike-triggered residual decay 产生非负整数码；Bipolar Binary Spiking (BBS) 分离符号与幅值并为带符号激活学习一个 scale。这些表示支撑 accumulation-and-shift 点积与整数指数映射的 attention。
Result: 4 个时间步下 Spora GLUE 平均 76.6、CoLA MCC 44.1，较 SpikeLM 分别高 1.2 与 6.2 点；BBS 扩到 6 步后升至 78.2 与 47.4。另用 conditional-decay 分析、等预算激活量化对比、event-workload 统计与定点评估刻画编码保真度与计算成本的关系。
Conclusion: 把编码容量（二值时间权重的 T 比特）与 attention 算子一起设计，可以在更少时间步下同时保住语义表示质量并降低脉冲计算成本。

papers.title: World-Model Policy Arbiter for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) has produced a diverse set of goal-reaching algorithms, yet no single algorithm performs best across environments, goals, and even different phases of the same task. Rather than deploying only the best-performing policy, we ask whether a set of frozen goal-conditioned policies can be used collectively as a portfolio, deciding at every state which policy should act. Choosing a policy at each state is not straightforward. The policies' own value functions cannot be compared directly: they may use different scales, and some policies have no value function. We need to judge each policy by the states it is likely to reach, even though we can execute only one policy at a time. We also need to avoid switching so often that control becomes unstable. To address these challenges, we introduce World-Model Policy Arbiter (WMPA), a test-time framework that, given a set of frozen policies as input, rolls out each frozen policy in a learned state-space world model, evaluates the imagined futures with a shared goal-conditioned value function, and executes the highest-scoring policy for a short commitment interval before the next round of arbitration (policy selection). WMPA assumes access to a bank of frozen goal-conditioned policies and requires neither policy retraining nor privileged task-specific knowledge. Under the official OGBench evaluation protocol on 18 state-based datasets spanning maze navigation as well as cube, scene, and puzzle manipulation, WMPA improves the macro-average success rate from the 44% achieved by the best policy selected per dataset to 58%, with statistically significant gains on 12 datasets. These gains include +33 percentage points on cube-double-play and +36 percentage points on scene-play.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://junwei0102.github.io/wmpa-webpage/ Code: https://github.com/junwei0102/World-Model-Policy-Arbiter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WMPA 在测试时把一组冻结的目标条件策略当作组合，用学到的 state-space world model 对每个策略做短程 rollout，再用共享的目标条件价值函数给想象未来打分，按短承诺区间轮换执行得分最高的策略。在 OGBench 官方协议、18 个 state-based 数据集上，宏平均成功率从按数据集选最优策略的 44% 提到 58%，其中 12 个数据集增益统计显著，cube-double-play +33 个百分点、scene-play +36 个百分点。
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习 (GCRL) 没有单一算法在所有环境、目标乃至同一任务的不同阶段都最优；各策略价值函数尺度不一甚至缺失，无法直接比较，而逐状态频繁切换又会让控制不稳定。
Method: WMPA 是测试时框架：输入一组冻结的目标条件策略，在学到的 state-space world model 中分别 rollout 每个策略，用共享的目标条件价值函数评估想象未来，执行得分最高者并保持一个短承诺区间后再重新仲裁。不需要策略重训，也不需要特权的任务特定知识。
Result: 在 OGBench 官方评估协议的 18 个 state-based 数据集（maze 导航与 cube、scene、puzzle 操作）上，宏平均成功率由按数据集选最优策略的 44% 提升至 58%，12 个数据集上增益统计显著；cube-double-play 提升 33 个百分点，scene-play 提升 36 个百分点。
Conclusion: 冻结策略组合加 world-model 想象与共享价值打分的测试时仲裁，比部署单一最优策略更能跨环境与任务阶段取长补短，且无需重训策略。

papers.title: Coefficient Calibration as Selection Pressure in Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: In memetic symbolic regression, candidate structures are compared after coefficient calibration, so the calibration protocol itself contributes to evolutionary selection. Standard centralized calibration evaluates each structure at its pooled-sample optimum, ignoring how stable this calibration is under covariate shifts, and can thus favor structures whose fit relies on sample-specific coefficients. We propose Dirichlet-Sinkhorn Constant Averaging (DSCA), a calibration strategy that partitions the optimization data into equally sized subsets with different covariate distributions, calibrates each candidate independently on every partition, and evaluates it at the mean of the resulting parameters. We show that the excess loss of DSCA relative to centralized calibration vanishes at the population level for correctly specified, identifiable expressions, whereas under misspecification it persists when partition-specific calibrations do not aggregate to the pooled optimum. On synthetic benchmarks and ten real-world datasets, DSCA improves functional recovery and the accuracy-complexity trade-off over centralized Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno and Levenberg-Marquardt calibration, under selection by negative log-likelihood and by the Akaike and Bayesian information criteria. Mechanism analyses associate the DSCA excess loss with the generalization gap and show that the effect is not reproduced by repeated centralized fitting. These results indicate that controlled heterogeneous calibration provides a complementary source of selection pressure in symbolic-regression search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 memetic 符号回归中，把系数校准本身当作选择压力：DSCA (Dirichlet-Sinkhorn Constant Averaging) 按协变量分布把优化数据切成等量子集，每个候选结构在各子集上独立校准后取参数均值来评估。对正确设定且可辨识的表达式，DSCA 相对集中式校准的 excess loss 在总体层面消失；在合成基准与十个真实数据集上，它在负对数似然、AIC、BIC 三种选择准则下都改善了函数恢复与精度-复杂度权衡。
Motivation: 集中式校准在 pooled-sample 最优点上比较结构，忽略校准在协变量偏移下的稳定性，容易偏爱那些系数依赖样本特异性的表达式。
Method: DSCA 用 Dirichlet-Sinkhorn 方式把优化数据划分为协变量分布不同、规模相等的子集，对每个候选结构在每个子集上独立校准，再以所得参数的均值作为评估点；选择准则为负对数似然、AIC 与 BIC，对照为集中式 BFGS 与 Levenberg-Marquardt 校准。
Result: 理论上，对正确设定且可辨识的表达式 DSCA 相对集中式校准的 excess loss 在总体层面消失，而误设情形下当各子集校准无法聚合到 pooled 最优点时该损失持续存在。实验上，在合成基准与十个真实数据集上，DSCA 在负对数似然、AIC、BIC 选择下均改善函数恢复与精度-复杂度权衡；机制分析把 DSCA 的 excess loss 与 generalization gap 关联起来，且重复集中式拟合无法复现该效应。
Conclusion: 受控的异质化校准为符号回归搜索提供了一种互补的选择压力来源，其收益来自校准在协变量偏移下的稳定性而非单纯的重复拟合。

papers.title: Speedbumps: Rejection Attacks on Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding is a popular technique for increasing the speed and reducing the costs of large language model (LLM) inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model forward pass. The resulting benefit depends on the ability of the drafter to approximate the target model's distribution. In this work, we study Speculative Rejection Attacks (SRAs), a novel class of attacks that cause draft and target models to disagree more often, resulting in fewer draft tokens being accepted per draft cycle. This leads to more target model forward passes needed per generated token, slowing down inference and increasing costs for the victim. We introduce two attacks which append an adversarial suffix to attacker-controlled content to degrade speculative decoding on a victim's prompts. Both attacks optimise the expected length of the accepted speculative prefix, estimating per-depth acceptance from the target's probability of the drafted proposals (Speedbump-P) or from the overlap between the draft and target distributions (Speedbump-D). In some cases, attacks degrade speculative decoding to the point of being slower than autoregressive decoding. The degradation reduces the output quality - regularisation restores output quality but gives up most of the degradation, trading effectiveness for stealthiness. Additionally, the suffixes remain effective under sampling, and transfer across drafters (Speedbump-P) or across target models sharing a drafter (Speedbump-D). These findings identify the draft-target interaction of speculative decoding as a realistic attack surface through which adversarial inputs can inflate inference costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对投机解码 (speculative decoding) 提出 Speculative Rejection Attack：在攻击者可控内容后附加对抗后缀，使 draft 与 target 模型更频繁不一致、每轮被接受的 draft token 变少，从而增加 target 前向次数、拖慢受害者的推理并抬高成本，个别情形下甚至比自回归解码更慢。
Motivation: 投机解码的加速收益依赖 drafter 对 target 分布的近似程度，而 draft-target 交互本身是一个可被对抗输入利用的现实攻击面，会直接推高 LLM 推理成本。
Method: 提出两类攻击 Speedbump-P 与 Speedbump-D，均在攻击者可控内容后附加对抗后缀，并以最小化被接受投机前缀的期望长度为目标：Speedbump-P 按 target 对 draft 提议的概率逐深度估计接受率，Speedbump-D 按 draft 与 target 分布的重叠度估计。
Result: 攻击在部分情形下把投机解码拖到比自回归解码还慢；加入正则化可恢复输出质量但放弃大部分降速效果，即以有效性换隐蔽性；后缀在采样下仍然有效，且 Speedbump-P 可跨 drafter 迁移、Speedbump-D 可跨共享同一 drafter 的 target 模型迁移。
Conclusion: 投机解码的 draft-target 交互是可被对抗后缀放大的真实攻击面，攻击者能借此抬高受害者推理成本，而隐蔽性与降速效果之间存在直接取舍。
Relevance: 1
