papers.title: Whose Ground Truth? Embracing Ambiguity in Human-Centered AI
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems increasingly interact with people and make decisions about them, understanding human interpretations becomes an important part of developing human-centered AI. Conventional machine learning and AI systems are largely developed under the assumption that a single definitive ground truth exists, with variability in human annotations often resolved through aggregation or treated as noise. However, for many human-centered tasks, human interpretation is inherently ambiguous, and multiple interpretations of the same input may be simultaneously reasonable and valid. Reducing such ambiguity to a single target risks overlooking meaningful information about the diversity of human perception, judgment, and experience. In this position paper, we call for a shift towards modeling the interpretation space of plausible human judgments, while distinguishing meaningful ambiguity from annotation noise. We argue that this perspective should guide how AI systems are represented, learned, evaluated, deployed, and governed, supporting more human-centered AI that better reflects the diversity of human interpretation.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，主张放弃「单一 ground truth」假设，转而对同一输入的多个合理人类判断构成的解释空间 (interpretation space) 建模，并区分有意义的歧义与标注噪声。作者主张这一视角应贯穿 AI 系统的表示、学习、评估、部署与治理，而非用聚合把人类判断差异压成单一目标。
Motivation: 常规 ML 假设存在唯一确定的 ground truth，人类标注的差异被聚合消解或当作噪声；但在以人为中心的任务中，同一输入的多种解释可同时合理有效，压成单一目标会丢掉关于人类感知、判断与经验多样性的信息。
Method: 作为立场论文提出概念转向：建模「合理人类判断的解释空间」，并给出区分有意义歧义与标注噪声的判据；进一步论证该视角应指导 AI 系统如何被表示、学习、评估、部署与治理。
Result: 论文为立场性论述，核心主张是把人类解释的多样性作为建模对象而非噪声，并据此重新设计 AI 的表示、学习、评估、部署与治理环节；摘要未含实验、数据集或指标数字。
Conclusion: 以人为中心的 AI 应当显式反映人类解释的多样性，把歧义当作信号建模，而不是在训练前用聚合将其消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Many Repeated Pairwise Comparisons Are Needed for Ranking under Heterogeneity?
papers.abstract_en: We study ranking models by population-average utility from pairwise comparisons when preferences vary across users and tasks. Prior work shows that a single comparison per user can be insufficient to identify the alternative with the highest average utility, even with arbitrarily many users (Golz et al., 2025). We investigate how many repeated comparisons within each user-task context are necessary and sufficient for ranking recovery. Under a heterogeneous Bradley-Terry model with fixed inverse temperature, we start with a naive MLE-based algorithm that requires $Ω(1/Δ^2)$ repeated comparisons per context to ensure ranking recovery. We then present two MLE-based variants and a randomized Russian Roulette-style algorithm that recover the ranking using $O(\log(1/Δ))$ repeated comparisons per context, and we prove that this logarithmic dependence is optimal. Despite this worst-case requirement, our Russian Roulette algorithm uses only $O(1)$ comparisons per context in expectation. Synthetic experiments and semi-synthetic experiments based on Arena data compare the four algorithms in settings with varying levels of preference heterogeneity and under varying context distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在偏好随用户与任务异质的 Bradley-Terry 模型下，单次比较无法识别平均效用最高的选项；朴素 MLE 每个上下文需 Ω(1/Δ²) 次重复比较才能恢复排序，而两个 MLE 变体与随机 Russian Roulette 式算法只需 O(log(1/Δ)) 次，且该对数依赖被证明最优，Russian Roulette 期望上每上下文仅用 O(1) 次比较。
Motivation: Golz et al. (2025) 表明即便用户数量任意大，每个用户只做一次比较也无法识别平均效用最高的选项，因此需要确定每个用户-任务上下文内重复比较的必要与充分数量。
Method: 在固定逆温度的异质 Bradley-Terry 模型下提出四种基于 MLE 的算法：朴素 MLE 算法、两个 MLE 变体，以及随机化的 Russian Roulette 式算法；对排序恢复的重复比较复杂度给出上下界证明，并用合成实验与基于 Arena 数据的半合成实验比较四种算法在不同偏好异质度与上下文分布下的表现。
Result: 朴素 MLE 算法需每上下文 Ω(1/Δ²) 次重复比较；两个 MLE 变体与 Russian Roulette 算法用 O(log(1/Δ)) 次即可恢复排序，并证明该对数依赖最优；Russian Roulette 期望上每上下文仅需 O(1) 次比较。
Conclusion: 排序恢复对重复比较的最坏情形需求是对数级且不可再降，但随机化算法在期望上可把每上下文开销降到常数次。

papers.title: Calibrating Ambiguity Set via Diagnostic Transport for Distributionally Robust Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) protects decisions against distributional uncertainty by optimizing over an ambiguity set, but poorly aligned set geometry can require large radii and yield overly conservative decisions. We introduce diagnostic-transport DRO (DT-DRO), which uses held-out calibration data to adapt the ambiguity-set geometry to observed predictive errors. DT-DRO uses the conditional probability integral transform cumulative distribution function to diagnose systematic probability misallocation and translates this information into an outcome-level transport that jointly adjusts the ambiguity-set center and ground cost. The resulting formulation admits a computationally tractable dual reformulation. Theoretically, we derive valid ambiguity radii and decision-risk guarantees that tighten as estimation and approximation errors vanish, and show that DT-DRO can eliminate the nonvanishing robustness floor caused by model misspecification. Synthetic experiments and a power-outage application demonstrate improved decision quality, particularly under structural and tail misspecification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DT-DRO 用留出校准数据诊断预测误差中的系统性概率错配，通过条件概率积分变换 (cpit) CDF 把诊断结果转成对歧义集中心与 ground cost 的联合调整，从而在不加大半径的情况下收紧几何。理论上给出有效歧义半径与决策风险保证，并证明可消除模型误设导致的不消失鲁棒性下界；合成实验与停电应用显示在结构与尾部误设下决策质量更优。
Motivation: DRO 的歧义集几何与真实误差不对齐时，需要很大半径才能覆盖，导致决策过度保守；模型误设还会留下不消失的鲁棒性下界。
Method: DT-DRO 用留出校准数据计算条件概率积分变换 CDF，诊断概率质量的系统性错配，再把它转成 outcome-level transport，同时调整歧义集中心与 ground cost；所得问题有可计算的对偶重构。
Result: 推导出有效歧义半径与决策风险保证，且在估计与逼近误差消失时保证收紧；证明 DT-DRO 可消除模型误设造成的不消失鲁棒性下界。合成实验与停电 (power-outage) 应用显示决策质量改善，尤其在结构误设与尾部误设情形下。
Conclusion: 按观测到的预测误差去校准歧义集几何，比单纯加大半径更能压掉保守性与误设带来的鲁棒性下界。

papers.title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
papers.abstract_en: Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 74.51 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 78.19 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NavGPT-3 用 OS 式运行时把长时程 RL 训练的语言模型推理与低延迟动作策略 NavGPT VLA 接起来，推理、动作、监控作为带独立上下文与权限的线程由运行时调度，靠中断和线程切换应对突发事件。NavGPT VLA 在 19.28M 样本上训练、用 codec allocation 按场景变化分配视觉 token，8B 版本在 R2R-CE 达 74.51 SR、RxR-CE 78.19 SR；完整 harness 在 R2R-CE 取得 81.51 SR 的 SOTA，RxR-CE 成功率 90.43 对人类 90.4、nDTW 78.47 对 77.7，每回合 1 分 22 秒（人类约 3 分钟），最小反应时间从每次语言模型决策 3–19 秒降到每个动作策略步 0.5–1 秒（1–2 Hz）。
Motivation: 长时程 agentic RL 让语言模型能推理与多步追目标，但物理交互需要稠密低延迟的动作策略，两者的接口如何设计使机器人能对突发现实事件快速反应，是具身智能的缺口。

papers.title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
papers.abstract_en: Planning is increasingly important for long-horizon agents, where successful execution requires coordinating subgoals, tool use, and intermediate outcomes over many steps. Yet assumptions made during planning may be invalidated by the environment, tools may return unexpected results, or actions may fail. Effective agents must therefore not only generate plans, but also revise them. Such revisions often affect only part of a plan, leaving the preceding and subsequent structure intact. Rather than regenerate the entire plan and risk unnecessary changes, repair can regenerate the affected region conditioned on the preserved prefix and suffix. We introduce Plan-and-Patch, a plan-and-act framework in which a diffusion language model (dLLM) generates a structured, program-like plan through parallel unmasking and repairs it by filling in selected regions while keeping the surrounding steps fixed. We compare DreamReasoner-8B and Qwen3-8B as diffusion and autoregressive (AR) planners. On Natural Plan without task-specific training, diffusion (53.7%) achieves nearly twice the plan repair success rate of AR (27.0%). After task-specific training on agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and TextCraft, the planners achieve similar observed success in plan generation, while diffusion reduces mean plan-generation latency by 39-46% relative to AR. Our results show that Plan-and-Patch provides a framework for faster plan generation and effective plan repair in long-horizon agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Plan-and-Patch 用 diffusion 语言模型 (dLLM) 以并行 unmasking 生成程序式计划，再只重填受影响区域、保留前后缀来修复计划。在 Natural Plan 无需任务训练时，diffusion 的计划修复成功率 53.7%，接近 AR 规划器 27.0% 的两倍；在 ALFWorld 与 TextCraft 上做任务训练后，计划生成成功率相当，但 diffusion 把平均生成延迟降低 39–46%。
Motivation: 长程 agent 的计划常被环境推翻、工具返回意外结果或动作失败，需要局部修订；整段重生成会破坏本可保留的前后结构，且 AR 规划器生成慢、修复成功率低。
Method: plan-and-act 框架：dLLM 通过 parallel unmasking 生成结构化、程序式计划，修复时在保留的 prefix 与 suffix 条件下只填充选定区域；对比 DreamReasoner-8B（diffusion）与 Qwen3-8B（autoregressive）两种规划器，评测 Natural Plan（无任务特定训练）以及 ALFWorld、TextCraft（任务特定训练）。
Result: Natural Plan 无任务特定训练下，diffusion 计划修复成功率 53.7%，AR 为 27.0%，接近两倍；在 ALFWorld 与 TextCraft 上任务训练后两者计划生成的观测成功率相近，diffusion 相对 AR 把平均计划生成延迟降低 39–46%。
Conclusion: Plan-and-Patch 把局部区域修复而非整段重生成作为长程 agent 的计划维护方式，diffusion 规划器在修复成功率与生成延迟上占优，而生成成功率与 AR 相当。

papers.title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution, VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VICO 把 VLM 的 RLVR 后训练从静态语料改成与环境共同进化：训练一个 Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) 编辑可验证的图像侧结构（scene graph、chart table、受保护区域掩码）并重渲染，用 pass-rate 奖励把难度对准 actor 当前能力。在九个多模态基准上，VICO-8B 相对基座模型在域外任务最高提升 +5.0%，比最强的 self-evolution 与 text-editing 共进化基线分别高 +4.3% 和 +8.4%。
Motivation: RLVR 后训练假设训练环境固定，actor 变强后任务脱离其学习前沿：大量任务变 trivial、另一些仍不可解，学习信号随之塌缩。
Method: actor 与 EnvRewriter 联合训练：EnvRewriter 编辑可验证的图像侧结构（scene graph、chart tables、protected region masks）并重渲染出标签有效的样本，用基于 pass-rate 的奖励按 actor 当前能力校准难度，全程无需额外人工标注。
Result: 在九个覆盖数学推理与视觉落地理解的多模态基准上，VICO-8B 相对基座模型在域外任务上最高 +5.0%；比最强 self-evolution 共进化基线高 +4.3%，比 text-editing 共进化基线高 +8.4%；与 chart 专用 RLVR 方法相比性能相当而标注样本少 16–160 倍。
Conclusion: 把监督来源从人工标注语料换成图像编辑共进化，可以在远少标注样本的条件下持续对齐任务难度与模型能力，是静态语料 RLVR 之外的可扩展路径。

papers.title: MemoWM: How World Models Change What Agents Need to Remember
papers.abstract_en: Long-term agents face growing storage demands as they accumulate experience. World models capture reusable regularities that can reduce the information stored for each experience. We formulate the problem of memory allocation conditioned on a world model and introduce MemoWM, a framework that uses shared predictions to compress retained information and reconstruct omitted content. Its task-aware allocation rule balances the expected impact of reconstruction errors against storage cost, retaining information with downstream value beyond the predictive prior. Across five long-term agent-memory benchmarks, MemoWM achieves 42.42\% average answer accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.62 percentage points, while reducing average experience-specific storage by 53.9\% relative to MIRIX, the most storage-efficient baseline. Further analysis shows that stronger world models reduce per-experience storage at comparable task quality. Accounting for model parameters reveals a trade-off between shared model capacity and recurring storage costs, with the capacity that minimizes total storage increasing as more interactions are retained. Our code is available at https://github.com/Feld-maxiu/MemoWM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemoWM 把世界模型作为条件，用共享预测压缩智能体经验记忆：任务感知的分配规则权衡重建误差的预期影响与存储成本，只保留超出预测先验的下游价值信息。在五个长期智能体记忆基准上平均答案准确率 42.42%，比最强基线高 2.62 个百分点，同时相对 MIRIX 把经验专属存储降低 53.9%。
Motivation: 长期智能体累积经验导致存储需求持续增长，而世界模型已能捕获可复用规律，但缺少在给定世界模型下如何分配记忆存储的形式化问题与分配规则。
Method: 提出 MemoWM 框架：以世界模型为条件做记忆分配，用共享预测压缩保留信息并重建被省略内容；任务感知分配规则在重建误差的预期影响与存储成本之间权衡，只保留相对预测先验仍有下游价值的信息。
Result: 在五个长期智能体记忆基准上平均答案准确率 42.42%，超出最强基线 2.62 个百分点；相对最存储高效的基线 MIRIX，平均经验专属存储降低 53.9%。分析显示更强的世界模型在任务质量相当的情况下降低每经验存储；计入模型参数后，使总存储最小的共享模型容量随保留交互数增加而增大。
Conclusion: 世界模型改变了智能体需要记住什么：把可预测部分交给共享先验、只存例外，可在保持任务质量的同时大幅削减每经验存储，且共享容量与重复存储成本之间存在随交互规模移动的权衡。

papers.title: NEMORA: Neural Equivariant Multipole Operators for Long-Range Atomistic Learning
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant graph neural networks have emerged as foundational architectures for machine-learned interatomic potentials, approaching quantum-chemical accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost. These models describe local atomic environments accurately, but finite spatial cutoffs truncate long-range information flow, and stacking message-passing layers can lead to over-smoothing and over-squashing. Existing long-range extensions either prescribe a fixed analytical propagation kernel, restrict long-range communication to scalars or degree-preserving channels, are only approximately equivariant, or incur super-linear computational cost. Combining learnable long-range equivariant transport with multiscale many-body expressivity and efficient scaling for larger systems remains a central challenge. We introduce Neural Equivariant Multipole Operators (NEMORA), a neural equivariant extension of the Fast Multipole Method (FMM) for learning long-range tensorial representations. NEMORA generalizes the FMM's analytical multipole expansion and translation operators to learned equivariant counterparts on an adaptive spatial hierarchy. Its operators couple angular degrees and form many-body interactions across length scales, retaining the FMM's hierarchical organization and analytical radial factors as physical inductive biases while learning data-dependent long-range couplings. NEMORA evaluates in linear time and memory complexity, allowing it to treat larger systems than other long-range methods reaching hundreds of thousands of atoms, and it augments both symmetry-constrained and unconstrained short-range backbones. On non-local benchmarks, it reduces force and energy errors relative to the short-range backbones by over an order of magnitude and up to three orders of magnitude, respectively, which is better than or competitive with existing long-range extensions in accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NEMORA 把 Fast Multipole Method (FMM) 的多极展开与平移算子改写为可学习的等变算子，作用在自适应空间层级上，为等变图神经网络势函数补上长程张量表示。它保持线性时间与内存复杂度，可处理数十万原子体系；在 non-local benchmark 上相对短程 backbone 力误差降低一个数量级以上、能量误差最多降低三个数量级。
Motivation: 等变图神经网络势函数受有限截断半径限制，堆叠消息传递层又会过平滑与过压缩；现有长程扩展要么固定解析传播核、要么只在标量通道通信、要么仅近似等变、要么超线性开销，难以同时兼顾长程多体表达与大体系可扩展性。
Method: NEMORA 将 FMM 的解析多极展开与平移算子推广为学习得到的等变对应物，部署在自适应空间层级 (adaptive spatial hierarchy) 上；其算子耦合角动量自由度、跨尺度形成多体相互作用，同时保留 FMM 的层级组织与解析径向因子作为物理归纳偏置，并可叠加在 symmetry-constrained 与 unconstrained 两类短程 backbone 上。
Result: 复杂度为线性时间与内存，可处理数十万原子 (hundreds of thousands of atoms)，规模超过其他长程方法；在 non-local benchmarks 上，相对短程 backbone 力误差降低一个数量级以上 (over an order of magnitude)，能量误差最多降低三个数量级 (up to three orders of magnitude)，精度优于或不劣于已有长程扩展。
Conclusion: 把 FMM 的解析多极结构与可学习等变长程耦合结合，可以在保持线性开销的同时把机器学习原子间势的长程精度提升一到三个数量级，并扩展到数十万原子体系。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: NEMORA 把 Fast Multipole Method (FMM) 的多极展开与平移算子改写为可学习的等变算子，作用在自适应空间层级上，为等变图神经网络势函数补上长程张量表示。它保持线性时间与内存复杂度，可处理数十万原子体系；在 non-local benchmark 上相对短程 backbone 力误差降低一个数量级以上、能量误差最多降低三个数量级。
summary_sections.motivation: 等变图神经网络势函数受有限截断半径限制，堆叠消息传递层又会过平滑与过压缩；现有长程扩展要么固定解析传播核、要么只在标量通道通信、要么仅近似等变、要么超线性开销，难以同时兼顾长程多体表达与大体系可扩展性。
summary_sections.method: NEMORA 将 FMM 的解析多极展开与平移算子推广为学习得到的等变对应物，部署在自适应空间层级 (adaptive spatial hierarchy) 上；其算子耦合角动量自由度、跨尺度形成多体相互作用，同时保留 FMM 的层级组织与解析径向因子作为物理归纳偏置，并可叠加在 symmetry-constrained 与 unconstrained 两类短程 backbone 上。
summary_sections.result: 复杂度为线性时间与内存，可处理数十万原子 (hundreds of thousands of atoms)，规模超过其他长程方法；在 non-local benchmarks 上，相对短程 backbone 力误差降低一个数量级以上 (over an order of magnitude)，能量误差最多降低三个数量级 (up to three orders of magnitude)，精度优于或不劣于已有长程扩展。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 FMM 的解析多极结构与可学习等变长程耦合结合，可以在保持线性开销的同时把机器学习原子间势的长程精度提升一到三个数量级，并扩展到数十万原子体系。

papers.title: AI-Mediated Self: How HCI Defines and Relates to the Self
papers.abstract_en: How might AI alter how we understand and experience the self? This scoping review analyzes 102 papers to examine how the self is defined in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI), how AI-self relationships are conceptualized, and what risks emerge when AI becomes entangled with selfhood. Our synthesis makes three contributions. First, we define AI-mediated self as a conceptual umbrella that connects dispersed work across education, workplace, health, and creative practices. Second, we consolidate six framings of the self with four domains of ethical risk-agency/autonomy, identity/authorship, relational capacity, and meaning-making-into a conceptual map that provides a reusable vocabulary across contexts. Third, we introduce the Inclusion of AI-Self framework, which situates AI-self relationships along a spectrum of proximity. Together, these contributions position selfhood as a central design space in HCI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 HCI 领域 102 篇论文做 scoping review，提出 AI-mediated self 作为统摄教育、职场、健康与创作场景的概念伞，整合六种自我框架与四类伦理风险（能动性/自主、身份/作者性、关系能力、意义建构），并给出按亲疏谱系定位 AI-自我关系的 Inclusion of AI-Self 框架。结论是自我性 (selfhood) 应被当作 HCI 的核心设计空间。
Motivation: HCI 中关于自我的讨论分散在教育、职场、健康、创作等场景，缺乏统一定义与可迁移的伦理风险词汇，AI 与自我纠缠时的风险难以跨情境讨论。
Method: scoping review，分析 102 篇 HCI 论文；综合出概念伞 AI-mediated self、六种自我框架与四类伦理风险的映射，并提出 Inclusion of AI-Self 亲疏谱系框架。
Result: 分析 102 篇论文，产出三项贡献：AI-mediated self 概念伞、六种自我框架与四类伦理风险（agency/autonomy、identity/authorship、relational capacity、meaning-making）合并的概念地图、以及 Inclusion of AI-Self 谱系框架。
Conclusion: 自我性应被置于 HCI 的核心设计空间，AI-自我关系可沿统一的亲疏谱系与共享伦理词汇跨情境刻画。

papers.title: Strategic Investment Decision Making for Value Creation in Energy Transition: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
authors: Sergey Alyaev (3) ((1) Department of Energy and Petroleum Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The global challenge of climate change has driven significant steps to reduce CO2 emissions, guided by international agreements like the Paris Agreement of 2015. Acting too slowly could result in future losses and reputational damage, while moving too quickly could jeopardize shareholder value due to the marginal profitability or potential losses due to technology immaturity of many renewable projects. To navigate this complex transition, energy companies must adopt Sequential Decision Making (SDM) strategies to maximize value creation from decision flexibility under uncertainties. To support this, we developed a custom simulation environment to model the dynamic energy landscape up to 2050. Building on this, we designed a multi-criteria SDM framework that explores various decision strategies related to different portfolios for allocating funds across three sectors: oil & gas, renewables, and CO2 reduction. It aims to maximize value during the transition while accounting for uncertainties in productions, energy prices, and costs. This framework has three objectives: maximizing profit, minimizing CO2 social costs, and enhancing competitive advantage in the renewable energy sector. This research evaluates the use of Reinforcement Learning (RL) to identify optimal investment policies within the defined SDM framework. The agent's sequential decisions shape a virtual dynamic environment by influencing key variables such as oil and gas production, renewable energy output, CO2 emissions, and revenues. Through repeated interaction, the RL algorithm explores the state space and learns an optimal policy under uncertainty. We benchmark the RL strategy against a set of manually defined baseline policies and find it consistently outperforms them in adaptability and long-term value creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为能源转型投资构建到 2050 年的自定义仿真环境与多准则序贯决策 (SDM) 框架，用强化学习在油气、可再生能源、CO2 减排三个板块间学习资金配置策略。RL 策略在适应性与长期价值创造上持续优于一组人工设定的基线策略。
Motivation: 气候转型下行动过慢会带来未来损失与声誉损害，过快又可能因可再生能源项目技术不成熟而损害股东价值；能源公司需要在产量、能源价格与成本不确定性下做序贯决策以保留灵活性价值。
Method: 自建建模能源格局动态至 2050 年的仿真环境，在其上设计多准则 SDM 框架，决策为油气、可再生能源、CO2 减排三板块的资金配置；目标为最大化利润、最小化 CO2 社会成本、提升可再生能源板块竞争优势。RL 智能体通过与环境反复交互探索状态空间，决策影响油气产量、可再生能源产出、CO2 排放与收入等关键变量，学习不确定性下的最优策略。
Result: RL 策略与一组人工定义的基线策略对比，在适应性与长期价值创造上持续胜出；智能体的序贯决策通过影响油气产量、可再生能源产出、CO2 排放与收入来塑造虚拟动态环境。
Conclusion: 在该 SDM 框架内，RL 能学到兼顾利润、CO2 社会成本与竞争优势的不确定性下投资策略，且比人工基线更能适应转型动态并创造长期价值。

papers.title: CPU-Auth: Device Fingerprinting for Authentication via DVFS Side-Channel
papers.abstract_en: Lack of effective authentication has resulted in numerous security and privacy breaches, including unauthorized access to protected information, identity theft, and fraud. One approach to mitigating such attacks is Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), in which users must provide multiple pieces of information for authentication. Some secondary authentication factors include SMS text verification codes, biometrics, and tokens. Each contains at least one notable flaw: SMS is notoriously insecure; biometrics rely upon access to sensitive personal data; and tokens require dependence on third-party providers (e.g. OAuth providers). This work explores CPU-Auth, a novel authentication mechanism based on unique variations in the physical characteristics of the CPU of a computing device. By measuring the behavior of the Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) governor remotely from within a browser, unique properties of the CPU can be leveraged to establish a hardware-based device fingerprint for use in CPU-Auth. The performance of CPU-Auth is evaluated on over 50,000 data traces using distance-based and deep learning methods. CPU-Auth is part of a larger research project, and the results provided in this report reflect only the contributions made to the project by members of this group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CPU-Auth 用浏览器远程测量 DVFS 调速器行为，把 CPU 物理差异变成硬件设备指纹做认证；在 50,000 余条数据轨迹上用距离法与深度学习评估其区分性能。
Motivation: 现有二次认证因子各有硬伤：SMS 不安全、生物特征依赖敏感个人数据、token 依赖第三方 OAuth 提供商，需要不依赖这些要素的认证手段。
Method: 在浏览器内远程观测 Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) governor 的行为，提取 CPU 物理特性形成的唯一属性，构建硬件级设备指纹；用距离基 (distance-based) 与深度学习两类方法评估。
Result: 在超过 50,000 条数据轨迹上，用距离基方法与深度学习方法评估 CPU-Auth 的认证性能。
Conclusion: CPU 的 DVFS 行为差异可作为浏览器侧可采集的硬件指纹用于设备认证，是 MFA 的一种补充路径。

papers.title: What can linear attention learn from nonlinear teachers in-context?
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention is a tractable model for understanding the mechanisms governing in-context learning in transformers. For linear regression tasks, recent asymptotic analyses have characterised its learning and generalisation behaviour. We extend this theory to nonlinear single-index targets, $y=f(x^\top w)+\varepsilon $. Our main result establishes a nonlinearity-noise equivalence: linear attention extracts only the linear Hermite component of $f$, while the remaining nonlinear structure contributes to the generalisation error as effective noise. This reduction allows results from the corresponding linear theory to be transferred to nonlinear tasks. We illustrate its implications for finite pretraining data and for the transition from task memorisation to task generalisation as task diversity increases. These results identify a limitation of the reduced linear-attention model and provide a tractable starting point for studying nonlinear in-context learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性注意力的 in-context learning 理论中引入非线性 single-index 目标 y=f(x^T w)+ε，证明非线性-噪声等价：线性注意力只提取 f 的线性 Hermite 分量，其余非线性结构以有效噪声形式进入泛化误差。由此可把线性回归的渐近理论直接迁移到非线性任务，并刻画有限预训练数据与任务多样性增大时从任务记忆到任务泛化的转变。
Motivation: 现有线性注意力 in-context learning 的渐近分析只覆盖线性回归目标，非线性目标下学习与泛化行为缺少可处理的理论刻画。
Method: 把目标设为 single-index 形式 y=f(x^T w)+ε，对 f 做 Hermite 分解，证明线性注意力只利用其线性 Hermite 分量，剩余非线性结构折算为泛化误差中的有效噪声，从而把对应线性理论的结果迁移过来。
Result: 主结果是非线性-噪声等价定理：非线性结构对泛化误差的贡献等价于有效噪声；该约化用于说明有限预训练数据的影响，以及任务多样性增加时从任务记忆到任务泛化的转变。
Conclusion: 线性注意力模型在非线性任务上只能捕获目标的线性 Hermite 成分，这是该约化模型的固有限制，同时也给出研究非线性 in-context learning 的可处理起点。

papers.title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DOGS 把 logo 的 prompt 优化从改写文本改为在结构化设计空间中采样：从真实 logo 语料挖掘带类型、带共现权重的设计文法图，用 GFlowNet 按终端奖励（可识别性、美观度、相对语料的原创性）成比例生成设计图，槽位只取封闭设计词表并在解析时剔除侵权与有害 token。在两个开源渲染器、九个基线上，生成的 logo 可识别性与美观度更高、多样性显著更大、商标侵权倾向大幅降低。
Motivation: T2I 的 prompt 优化几乎都被当成文本改写，一行 brief 留下大量未指定的设计决策；线性 token 序列无法表达这些关系先验，还给受保护商标被复现留下不受控通道。
Method: 从大规模真实 logo 语料挖掘带类型、记录经验共现的设计文法图；GFlowNet 采样器按结合 recognizability、aesthetics 与 corpus-relative originality 的终端奖励成比例生成设计图；每个槽位只从封闭设计词表取值，解析阶段移除诱发侵权或有害的 token，原创性奖励额外惩罚与现有 logo 的邻近度。
Result: 在两个开源渲染器上、对比九个基线，DOGS 生成的 logo 在可识别性与美观度上更好，多样性显著更大，商标侵权倾向远更低。
Conclusion: 把结构化设计决策显式建模并把原创性写进奖励，可以在构造上同时提升 logo 质量、多样性并抑制商标侵权，而不必依赖语言空间改写。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把结构化设计决策显式建模并把原创性写进奖励，可以在构造上同时提升 logo 质量、多样性并抑制商标侵权，而不必依赖语言空间改写。

papers.title: MESSENGER: Memory-Enhanced Sequential Scene Flow Estimation via Autoregressive Next-Frame Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Scene flow can capture low-level 3D motion displacements in dynamic scenarios. Early pairwise estimators relying on instantaneous two-frame motion lack long-term temporal correlation and also struggle with poor extrapolation ability in future prediction. Although some recent methods attempt to explore multi-frame scene flow estimation in a sequence-to-sequence manner, they typically suffer from heavy computational overhead with increasing input frames and long-horizon prediction degradation due to ineffective motion propagation. To address these problems, we propose a novel memory-enhanced sequential scene flow pipeline, called MESSENGER. To sufficiently mine long-term temporal dependencies naturally within consecutive sequences, a memory buffer is designed by explicitly storing multiple history flow estimates and latent states. For each input frame, the temporally stored flows and states are correlated and retrieved to predict the current initialized flow in a next-frame forecasting manner. Furthermore, we develop an uncertainty-aware reweighting module to filter unreliable retrievals and mitigate accumulated errors. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of our MESSENGER, reducing EPE3D by 71.6% on nuScenes and 67.7% on Argoverse 2 in long-horizon future extrapolation. This superiority can be attributed to our designed autoregressive forecasting paradigm, which naturally forces the network to progressively learn the next-frame distribution based on history observations. Code will be released at https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code will be released at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MESSENGER 用记忆缓冲区存储历史光流估计与隐状态，按 next-frame forecasting 方式检索并初始化当前帧光流，再用不确定性感知重加权过滤不可靠检索以抑制误差累积。在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 的长时程外推上达到 SOTA，EPE3D 分别降低 71.6% 与 67.7%。
Motivation: 两帧成对估计器缺少长期时间相关性、外推能力差；已有序列到序列多帧方法随输入帧数增加计算开销大，且运动传播失效导致长时程预测退化。
Method: 提出记忆增强的序列化场景光流管线 MESSENGER：memory buffer 显式存储多帧历史光流估计与 latent states，对每帧检索相关历史来以自回归 next-frame forecasting 方式预测当前初始化光流；另加 uncertainty-aware reweighting 模块过滤不可靠检索、缓解累积误差。
Result: 在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上取得 SOTA：长时程未来外推中 EPE3D 分别降低 71.6%（nuScenes）与 67.7%（Argoverse 2）。
Conclusion: 自回归预测范式能迫使网络基于历史观测逐步学习下一帧分布，从而在长时程外推上优于成对与既有序列建模方法。

papers.title: Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise conversation analytics asks many questions of millions of interactions. Each question can require reconstructing what people mean and identifying which information matters, repeating costly interpretive work across the same transcripts. We propose a simple principle: clarify the text, then focus the reader. Statement normalization transforms dialogue into short, speaker-attributed statements with source references and semantic tags. The statements make meaning more explicit; the tags support selecting evidence for a particular question. Downstream models can use the full representation or a relevant subset, depending on what helps them make the decision. In an offer-suppression task on customer-service calls, normalization improves a supervised classifier without selection, while weaker prompted readers benefit from both normalization and selection. A small model can learn the normalization contract, while lightweight encoders handle tagging and downstream decisions. Sharing this preparation across questions supports an inference pipeline built entirely from small models, making analytics over millions of conversations substantially less expensive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 statement normalization：把企业客服对话改写成带说话人归属、来源引用和语义标签的短陈述，使同一份转写可被多个下游问题复用。在客服通话的 offer-suppression 任务上，归一化能提升有监督分类器，而较弱的 prompted reader 需要归一化与标签选择两者配合；整条流水线可全用小模型搭建，大幅降低百万级对话分析成本。
Motivation: 企业对话分析中每个问题都要在同一批转写上重复做「还原说话人意图、挑出相关信息」的解释性工作，成本随问题数量线性累积。
Method: Statement normalization 将对话转成短小、带说话人归属、来源引用与语义标签的陈述；标签用于为特定问题挑选证据，下游模型可使用完整表示或相关子集。归一化由小模型学习，标签与下游决策交给轻量 encoder。
Result: 在客服通话的 offer-suppression 任务上：归一化在不做选择时即可提升有监督分类器；较弱的 prompted reader 则同时受益于归一化与选择。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把文本准备（澄清 + 聚焦）在问题之间共享，可以用全小模型的推理流水线支撑百万级对话分析，显著压低成本。

papers.title: BRANCH: Bypassing Multi-Scanner AI Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) as core reasoning engines, making them targets for prompt injection and jailbreaks. Guardrails monitor and validate model inputs and outputs, yet their isolated, task-focused detection leaves gaps in their classification making them susceptible to bypasses. In response, guardrail systems formed by multiple scanners have emerged that collaboratively detect different types of malicious instructions, whereby shared latent representations across classification boundaries render established bypassing techniques ineffective. We propose BRANCH, a bypassing methodology designed for multi-scanner guardrail systems. Our method leverages a branching tree search approach that dynamically applies adversarial perturbation against individual scanners, with subsequent perturbation optimization and technique selection based on overall improvement across all guardrail system scanners, effectively decoupling bypass evaluation from attack signal optimization. Our findings demonstrate that BRANCH achieves 100% attack success rate across 6 guardrail systems in 120 scenarios with 72% fewer queries and 4.5x reduced wallclock time compared to established techniques, while preserving semantic meaning within the bypass. We also show how bypasses generated by BRANCH transfer to 29 unseen guardrails, including 8 commercial black-box guardrails, improving attack success in some cases up to 100% with no additional optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BRANCH 用分支树搜索对多扫描器 AI 护栏的各个 scanner 分别施加对抗扰动，再按跨全部 scanner 的整体改进选择扰动优化与技术，把绕过评估与攻击信号优化解耦。在 6 个护栏系统、120 个场景上攻击成功率达 100%，查询数比既有技术少 72%、墙钟时间降低 4.5 倍，并保持绕过文本的语义。
Motivation: 单扫描器护栏的孤立、任务聚焦式检测在分类边界上留有缺口，而多扫描器护栏共享跨边界的隐表示，使既有越狱与注入技术失效，需要针对这类系统的新绕过方法。
Method: 提出 BRANCH：以 branching tree search 对每个 scanner 单独施加对抗扰动，随后依据护栏系统全部 scanner 上的整体改进做扰动优化与 technique selection，从而将 bypass evaluation 与 attack signal optimization 解耦；攻击在保持语义含义的前提下生成。
Result: 在 6 个 guardrail systems、120 个场景上攻击成功率达 100%，相比既有技术查询数减少 72%、墙钟时间降低 4.5 倍；生成的绕过样本可迁移到 29 个未见过的 guardrails（含 8 个商业黑盒护栏），部分情形在无额外优化下成功率提升至 100%。
Conclusion: 多扫描器护栏的共享隐表示不足以阻止协同式分支扰动搜索：BRANCH 在保持语义的同时以更少查询和更短时间全数绕过所测护栏，并可零优化迁移到黑盒护栏。

papers.title: Conversational Task Disambiguation over Tabular Data: Leakage-Aware Formulation, Benchmark Suite, and Training
papers.abstract_en: Conversational task disambiguation over tabular data uses dialogue to resolve missing information about a user's intended task before producing a solution over tables or databases. Existing evaluation and training lack a leakage-aware foundation. Task success mixes the agent's disambiguation and solution-generation capabilities and can also reflect oracle leakage, that is, information that a user simulator reveals beyond what a real user would. Existing datasets also lack a shared representation of ambiguities and access boundaries. We introduce the notion of an ambiguous verifiable task, which formalizes ambiguities and resolutions, decomposing the agent into an asking policy and a solution policy, and the environment into an oracle and verifier. This framework provides baselines and metrics for evaluating task disambiguation separately from solution generation, formal definitions of oracle leakage, judge-free leakage diagnostics, and a training objective for the asking policy. We instantiate the framework in text-to-SQL with AmbiTab, a benchmark suite that unifies six ambiguous datasets under a common representation specifying what the agent, oracle, and verifier may access. We evaluate clarification strategies and oracle leakage, and train an asking policy with reinforcement learning. The trained asker improves our disambiguation metrics on all six datasets and task success on five, and our leakage diagnostics measure how training affects oracle leakage.
papers.comment: 39 pages (9 main, 30 appendix), 12 figures (5 main, 7 appendix)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出「歧义可验证任务」(ambiguous verifiable task) 形式化框架，把对话式表格任务消歧拆成 asking policy 与 solution policy、环境拆成 oracle 与 verifier，从而把消歧能力与解题能力分开度量并形式化 oracle leakage。在 text-to-SQL 基准套件 AmbiTab（统一六个歧义数据集）上，用强化学习训练的 asking policy 在全部六个数据集上提升消歧指标、在五个上提升任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有对话式表格任务消歧的评测与训练缺少 leakage-aware 基础：任务成功率把 agent 的消歧与解题能力混在一起，还会被 user simulator 泄露超出真实用户会给出的信息（oracle leakage）所抬高，数据集也缺少对歧义与访问边界的统一表示。
Method: 形式化「歧义可验证任务」，将 agent 分解为 asking policy 与 solution policy、环境分解为 oracle 与 verifier；据此给出分离评测消歧与解题的基线与指标、oracle leakage 的形式定义、judge-free 泄漏诊断，以及 asking policy 的训练目标。在 text-to-SQL 上实例化为 AmbiTab，统一六个歧义数据集并明确 agent、oracle、verifier 各自可访问的信息，再用强化学习训练 asking policy。
Result: 在 AmbiTab 的六个歧义数据集上，强化学习训练的 asking policy 在全部六个数据集上改进消歧指标，在其中五个上提升任务成功率；其泄漏诊断度量了训练如何影响 oracle leakage。
Conclusion: 把消歧与解题在形式上分开、并显式定义 oracle leakage，可以在不依赖 judge 的情况下分别度量与训练 asking policy；训练确实改变泄漏程度。

papers.title: Deep Learning vs. Statistical Models for Multi-Horizon Price Forecasting of Second-Hand Electronics: A Systematic Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting resale prices of used electronics is critical for subscription-based platforms where pricing errors translate directly into risk. Unlike structured financial markets, second-hand electronics exhibit high volatility, sparse listing histories, and non-normal price dynamics - yet no systematic time-series benchmark exists for this domain. This paper presents the first multi-horizon benchmark of statistical and deep learning forecasting models for used electronics price prediction. We use a large-scale dataset of daily price listings from Polish online marketplaces (January 2022 to March 2025, 100+ smartphone and laptop models) and evaluate eleven models across six horizons from 1 to 365 days, covering classical methods (ARIMA, ETS, Theta), recurrent and convolutional networks (LSTM, TCN), and modern deep architectures (N-BEATS, N-HiTS, TFT, PatchTST, Informer). Three complementary evaluation protocols assess trajectory fitness, one-shot endpoint accuracy, and cross-horizon transfer. N-BEATS achieves the lowest MAPE beyond 30 days, reaching 8.51% at 365 days versus 14.94% for the best statistical baseline - a 43% reduction. At short horizons (1-7 days), all models converge near 0.72% MAPE and the naive baseline remains competitive. A single N-BEATS model trained at 365 days generalizes to all shorter horizons, eliminating the need for horizon-specific models. N-BEATS and N-HiTS also demonstrate superior hyperparameter stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个二手电子产品（手机/笔记本）多时效转售价格预测基准：在波兰二手市场 2022-01 至 2025-03 的日度挂牌数据（100+ 型号）上比较 11 个模型、6 个时效（1–365 天）。N-BEATS 在 30 天以上时效 MAPE 最低，365 天达 8.51%，对比最优统计基线 14.94% 降低 43%；1–7 天所有模型收敛到约 0.72% MAPE，朴素基线仍有竞争力。
Motivation: 订阅制平台的二手电子定价误差直接转化为风险，但该领域价格波动大、挂牌历史稀疏、非正态，此前没有系统的时间序列预测基准。
Method: 数据为波兰在线市场日度挂牌价（2022 年 1 月至 2025 年 3 月，100+ 手机与笔记本型号）；比较 11 个模型：ARIMA、ETS、Theta，LSTM、TCN，N-BEATS、N-HiTS、TFT、PatchTST、Informer；6 个时效 1–365 天；三套评估协议分别衡量轨迹拟合、单点端点精度与跨时效迁移。
Result: N-BEATS 在 30 天以上时效 MAPE 最低，365 天为 8.51%，最优统计基线为 14.94%，相对降低 43%；1–7 天所有模型 MAPE 收敛到约 0.72%，朴素基线仍具竞争力；单个在 365 天训练的 N-BEATS 可泛化到所有更短时效，无需按时效分别建模；N-BEATS 与 N-HiTS 表现出更优的超参数稳定性。
Conclusion: 深度模型（尤其 N-BEATS）在中长时效显著优于统计方法，而短时效问题本身过于简单；用单一长时效模型覆盖全部时效即可，不必按时效维护多个模型。

summary_sections.result: N-BEATS 在 30 天以上时效 MAPE 最低，365 天为 8.51%，最优统计基线为 14.94%，相对降低 43%；1–7 天所有模型 MAPE 收敛到约 0.72%，朴素基线仍具竞争力；单个在 365 天训练的 N-BEATS 可泛化到所有更短时效，无需按时效分别建模；N-BEATS 与 N-HiTS 表现出更优的超参数稳定性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 深度模型（尤其 N-BEATS）在中长时效显著优于统计方法，而短时效问题本身过于简单；用单一长时效模型覆盖全部时效即可，不必按时效维护多个模型。

papers.title: LinSlot: Exploiting Linear Representation hypothesis for unsupervised attribute discovery from slot based object representation
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the problem of learning disentangled representations of objects and their attributes from raw, unstructured image data. Slot-based methods have shown considerable success in unsupervised learning of object representations from images. Block-slot attention-based methods extend this framework to attribute representations by assuming a uniform factorization of object representations into attributes, which may be suboptimal and consequently limit the quality of the learned representations. We therefore investigate a framework for jointly discovering object and attribute representations. Our key contribution is leveraging the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which postulates that composable concepts can be represented as linearly additive subspaces in slot representations. Based on this insight, we propose a probabilistic model connecting images, slots (objects), and blocks (attributes). We present an architecture that leverages block attention to connect attribute representations to slots and incorporates LRH in both object and attribute representation spaces. This architecture effectively optimizes the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) of the proposed graphical model. Our experiments demonstrate (i) effective discovery of disentangled object and attribute representations, (ii) empirical evidence for LRH in slot space, and (iii) the ability to perform image editing owing to the disentangled and interpretable nature of the learned representations. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improvements in DCI scores over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LinSlot 用线性表示假设 (Linear Representation Hypothesis, LRH) 联合发现图像中的物体与属性解耦表示：把 slot 视为物体、block 视为属性，构建连接图像-slot-block 的概率图模型并优化其 ELBO，在 block attention 中同时对物体空间和属性空间施加 LRH。在多个数据集上 DCI 分数优于现有方法，并支持基于解耦表示的图像编辑。
Motivation: Slot 注意力能无监督学物体表示，但 block-slot attention 假设物体表示均匀切分成属性，这种均匀因子化可能次优，限制学到的表示质量。
Method: 提出连接图像、slots（物体）与 blocks（属性）的概率图模型；架构用 block attention 把属性表示挂到 slot 上，并在物体与属性两个表示空间都引入 LRH（可组合概念对应线性可加子空间），整体按 ELBO 优化。
Result: 在多个数据集上 DCI 分数相对 state-of-the-art 方法有提升；实验给出物体与属性解耦表示的有效发现、slot 空间中 LRH 的经验证据，以及可进行图像编辑的能力。
Conclusion: 把 LRH 作为先验引入 slot/block 表示空间，可以替代均匀属性因子化，得到更解耦、可解释且可用于图像编辑的物体-属性表示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Seeing Through the Glare: A Multi-Source Benchmark and Ocular-Adaptive Pixel MeanFlow for Eyeglass Reflection Removal
papers.abstract_en: Eyeglass reflection removal is important across smartphone imaging, video conferencing, and other face-centric visual applications. The task is challenging because reflections range from mild photometric contamination to severe ocular occlusion, requiring selective correction and plausible reconstruction without altering identity or natural appearance. Existing datasets cover limited reflection conditions, constraining generalization to complex real-world scenes and systematic evaluation. We introduce \textbf{OcuBench}, a multi-source benchmark comprising 10,280 controllable synthetic pairs, 732 real-input pseudo-pairs, and 458 independent real-world test images, supporting both paired evaluation and assessment beyond generated supervision. We further propose \textbf{OcuFlow}, an ocular-adaptive pixel MeanFlow (pMF) framework for efficient, detail-preserving restoration. It combines geometry-adaptive representation with one-step pMF to focus reconstruction on reflection-obscured ocular regions, together with native-resolution frequency-preserving synthesis to retain reliable observed details. Experiments across diverse reflection conditions demonstrate that OcuFlow achieves consistent advantages in reflection removal quality, ocular fidelity, and efficiency. In a blind user study, it receives $67.32\%$ of selections, $6.2\times$ the next-best share. Both the code and dataset will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出眼镜反光去除基准 OcuBench（10,280 对可控合成、732 对真实输入伪配对、458 张独立真实测试图）与眼部自适应像素 MeanFlow 框架 OcuFlow，把重建集中在被反光遮挡的眼周区域并保持原分辨率细节。盲测用户研究中 OcuFlow 获 67.32% 选择，是次优方法份额的 6.2 倍。
Motivation: 现有数据集覆盖的反光条件有限，难以泛化到复杂真实场景，也无法系统评估从轻度光污染到严重眼部遮挡的选择性修复。
Method: OcuFlow 结合几何自适应表征与 one-step 像素 MeanFlow (pMF)，把重建算力集中在反光遮挡的眼部区域，并用原分辨率的频率保持合成保留可靠观测细节；评测同时支持配对评估与超越生成监督的检验。
Result: OcuBench 含 10,280 对可控合成样本、732 对真实输入伪配对、458 张独立真实测试图；实验显示 OcuFlow 在反光去除质量、眼部保真与效率上一致占优；盲测用户研究中获 67.32% 选择，为次优方法的 6.2 倍。
Conclusion: 把修复算力按反光遮挡区域自适应分配并配合 one-step pMF，可在不改动身份与自然外观的前提下同时提升去除质量、眼部保真和效率；代码与数据集将发布。

papers.title: On linearity or non-linearity in machine learning for quantum chaotic dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Accurately simulating chaotic quantum many-body dynamics remains a major computational challenge for classical methods, due to the rapid buildup and spatial spreading of entanglement during the evolution. This raises the question of whether machine learning can provide an effective alternative for predicting quantum dynamics. We address this question by formulating quantum dynamics as a time-series forecasting problem, using a few-qubit PXP chain, realizable with Rydberg-atom arrays, as a benchmark. By varying the initial state, the system spans dynamical regimes ranging from ergodic behavior to quantum many-body scarring, providing a controlled setting for testing forecasting models across qualitatively different dynamics. We compare two contrasting architectures: an expressive nonlinear Transformer and DLinear, a simple linear forecasting model. The Transformer accurately predicts dynamics in the more ergodic regime, but its performance progressively deteriorates as the initial state approaches the scarred limit. In contrast, DLinear remains accurate across the entire family of initial states, with its main deviations consisting of small high-frequency oscillations that have little effect on the overall prediction error. Remarkably, these results show that observables generated by complex quantum many-body dynamics can be forecast with high accuracy through a simple linear mapping from past to future observations. This reveals that the complexity of the underlying quantum evolution need not translate into an equally complex forecasting problem.
papers.comment: Francesco Perciavalle and Agostino Gallo contributed equally to this work. 11 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把混沌量子多体动力学写成时间序列预报问题，用可由 Rydberg 原子阵列实现的少比特 PXP 链作基准，比较非线性 Transformer 与线性模型 DLinear。Transformer 在遍历 (ergodic) 区预报准确、随初态逼近量子多体疤痕 (many-body scarring) 而逐步变差；DLinear 在整族初态上保持准确，偏差仅为对整体误差影响很小的高频振荡。结论是底层量子演化复杂并不意味着预报问题也必须复杂，线性映射即可高精度预测。
Motivation: 纠缠快速建立与空间扩散使经典方法难以模拟混沌量子多体演化，需要检验机器学习能否作为预测量子动力学的有效替代，以及模型复杂度是否必要。
Method: 将量子动力学表述为时间序列预报任务，以少比特 PXP 链为基准，通过改变初态覆盖从遍历行为到量子多体疤痕的不同动力学区；对比两种架构：表达力强的非线性 Transformer 与简单线性预报模型 DLinear。
Result: Transformer 在更偏遍历的区准确预测动力学，随初态逼近疤痕极限性能逐步恶化；DLinear 在整族初态上均保持准确，其主要偏差是小幅高频振荡，对整体预测误差影响很小。
Conclusion: 复杂量子多体动力学生成的观测量可由从过去到未来观测的简单线性映射高精度预报，底层量子演化的复杂性不必转化为同样复杂的预报问题。

papers.title: Learning infinite context windows in recurrent architectures via spatial neural computing
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) offer linear-time scaling with sequence length while requiring only constant memory, yet they struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to vanishing gradients and limited receptive fields. To address these limitations, we introduce a second-order recurrent model in which the standard neuron-to-neuron communication is replaced by a spatially evolving field governed by (discretized) partial differential equations. Drawing inspiration from the role of cortical waves in brain computation, this mechanism allows structured spatiotemporal patterns to serve as an implicit, high-capacity memory. We show that the resulting model is equivalent to a structured infinite-order RNN in which the current state depends explicitly on its entire history of past states, yielding an effectively unbounded receptive field with a fixed number of parameters. We further derive constructive conditions to ensure marginal stability, constraining the gradient spectrum on the unit circle and thereby eliminating vanishing and exploding gradients. Empirically, the proposed architecture outperforms other recurrent models on long-horizon benchmarks while using substantially fewer parameters, demonstrating that spatial dynamics can effectively bridge the gap between efficient inference and long-term memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用空间演化场（由离散化 PDE 支配）替代神经元间通信的二阶循环架构，使当前状态显式依赖全部历史状态，从而在固定参数量下获得 effectively unbounded receptive field。推导保证 marginal stability 的构造性条件，把梯度谱约束在单位圆上以消除梯度消失与爆炸；在长时程基准上以显著更少参数优于其他循环模型。
Motivation: RNN 虽然线性时间、常数内存，但梯度消失与有限感受野使其难以捕捉长程依赖；现有改进往往以参数量或推理效率为代价。
Method: 用受皮层波 (cortical waves) 启发的空间场 PDE 取代 neuron-to-neuron 通信，构成二阶循环模型；证明其等价于结构化的 infinite-order RNN（当前状态显式依赖全部历史状态），并推导将梯度谱约束在单位圆上的 marginal stability 构造性条件。
Result: 在长时程基准 (long-horizon benchmarks) 上优于其他循环模型，同时使用显著更少的参数；理论上以固定参数量实现 effectively unbounded receptive field，并消除梯度消失与爆炸。
Conclusion: 空间动力学可以把高效推理与长期记忆统一起来：固定参数量即可承载高容量隐式记忆，且梯度稳定性可由构造性条件保证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Explaining the Saliency Map Sparsity of Adversarially-Trained Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Understanding why deep neural networks make a given prediction is of great importance for their safe deployment. In computer vision, saliency maps, which highlight the image region most influential for a prediction, remain a widely-used form of explanation. An empirical observation is the apparent sparsity of gradient saliency maps of adversarially-trained neural networks. In this paper, we propose a theoretical explanation of this phenomenon for two-layer ReLU networks. We build on the established equivalence of adversarial training to the minimization of the empirical risk with weight-decay penalization and an added adversarial total variation term -- valid for certain loss functions. As the number of data points and neurons grows and the regularization parameters are sent to zero at appropriate rates, we prove that minimizers converge to a Bayes classifier with minimal gradient and Barron norm. Sparsity appears since for adversarial training with $\ell_\infty$-attacks the gradient norm is anisotropic and favors axis-aligned / sparse gradients. We illustrate our theoretical findings experimentally by evaluating the gradient $\ell_1$-norm and thresholded sparsity of naturally versus adversarially trained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为对抗训练网络的梯度显著图稀疏性给出理论解释：在两层 ReLU 网络上，把对抗训练等价为带 weight-decay 与对抗总变差 (adversarial total variation) 项的经验风险最小化，证明当样本数与神经元数增长、正则参数按适当速率趋于零时，极小元收敛到具有最小梯度范数与 Barron 范数的 Bayes 分类器。ℓ∞ 攻击下梯度范数是各向异性的、偏好轴对齐的稀疏梯度，因此显著图稀疏；实验用梯度 ℓ1 范数与阈值化稀疏度对比自然训练与对抗训练模型。
Motivation: 对抗训练网络的梯度显著图在经验上明显稀疏，但这一现象缺少理论解释，影响对深度网络预测的安全理解。
Method: 基于对抗训练在特定损失函数下等价于带 weight-decay 惩罚与对抗总变差项的经验风险最小化，对两层 ReLU 网络在数据点数与神经元数增长、正则参数按适当速率趋零的极限下证明极小元收敛到 Bayes 分类器；再以梯度 ℓ1 范数与阈值化稀疏度做自然训练 vs 对抗训练的实验对照。
Result: 证明极小元收敛到具有最小梯度范数与 Barron 范数的 Bayes 分类器；ℓ∞ 攻击下梯度范数各向异性、偏好轴对齐稀疏梯度；实验中评估梯度 ℓ1 范数与阈值化稀疏度，比较自然训练与对抗训练模型。
Conclusion: 对抗训练下的显著图稀疏源于 ℓ∞ 攻击诱导的各向异性梯度范数对轴对齐梯度的偏好，可在两层 ReLU 网络的正则化极限下严格解释。

summary_sections.method: 基于对抗训练在特定损失函数下等价于带 weight-decay 惩罚与对抗总变差项的经验风险最小化，对两层 ReLU 网络在数据点数与神经元数增长、正则参数按适当速率趋零的极限下证明极小元收敛到 Bayes 分类器；再以梯度 ℓ1 范数与阈值化稀疏度做自然训练 vs 对抗训练的实验对照。
summary_sections.result: 证明极小元收敛到具有最小梯度范数与 Barron 范数的 Bayes 分类器；ℓ∞ 攻击下梯度范数各向异性、偏好轴对齐稀疏梯度；实验中评估梯度 ℓ1 范数与阈值化稀疏度，比较自然训练与对抗训练模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对抗训练下的显著图稀疏源于 ℓ∞ 攻击诱导的各向异性梯度范数对轴对齐梯度的偏好，可在两层 ReLU 网络的正则化极限下严格解释。

papers.title: BEANS-Next and ROOTS: Broadening Audio-Language Capabilities for Bioacoustics
papers.abstract_en: Bioacoustics and ethology encompass a wide range of audio understanding tasks, many of which stand to benefit from recent advances in large audio-language models. However, progress in the field has so far been assessed on a narrow set of tasks, primarily centered on label-centric biological category recognition, such as species and call-type classification. In this work, we introduce BEANS-Next, a benchmark grounded in a taxonomy of bioacoustics tasks spanning acoustic perception, biological category recognition, scene understanding, and in-context learning. Using BEANS-Next, we show that existing models exhibit limited performance beyond the task families emphasized by existing evaluations, constraining their usefulness for broader bioacoustic applications. To support progress on this broader task space, we also introduce ROOTS, a large-scale training resource built from expanded curated real-world data and previously underused behavioral and acoustic metadata, supplemented by audio-derived information and scalable synthetic generation where labeling is insufficient. We demonstrate that training on this dataset yields substantial progress across all task groups of BEANS-Next, moving audio-language models closer to their potential as general-purpose assistants for bioacoustics and ethology. To accelerate progress in the field, we open-source our benchmark, dataset, and data pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEANS-Next 把生物声学评测从物种/叫声类型分类扩展到声学感知、类别识别、场景理解与上下文学习四类任务，显示现有音频-语言模型在既有评测侧重之外表现有限。配套的 ROOTS 大规模训练资源（扩充的真实数据与行为/声学元数据、音频衍生信息、标签不足处的可扩展合成生成）训练后在 BEANS-Next 全部任务组上取得实质提升，并开源基准、数据与流水线。
Motivation: 该领域进展此前只在以标签为中心的窄任务集（物种、叫声类型分类）上衡量，掩盖了模型在更广音频理解任务上的真实能力，限制其作为通用生物声学与行为学助手的可用性。
Method: 构建 BEANS-Next 基准，按生物声学任务分类体系覆盖声学感知、生物类别识别、场景理解、上下文学习；构建 ROOTS 训练资源，由扩充的精选真实数据与此前未充分利用的行为/声学元数据组成，辅以音频衍生信息，并在标注不足处使用可扩展的合成生成；用 ROOTS 训练音频-语言模型并在 BEANS-Next 上衡量。
Result: 现有模型在既有评测所强调的任务族之外表现有限；在 ROOTS 上训练后在 BEANS-Next 全部任务组上取得实质进展。摘要以定性结论为主，未给出具体分数。
Conclusion: 仅靠标签中心的窄评测会低估音频-语言模型的能力边界，扩充训练数据（含元数据与合成生成）可把它们推向生物声学与行为学的通用助手；基准、数据集与数据流水线全部开源。

papers.title: Teaching PPG How not Who: Fixed-Effects Distillation from ECG
papers.abstract_en: ECG is widely used to teach PPG-only models, yet what it teaches is unexamined. Wearables are valued for tracking how a person's cardiovascular state changes, but ECG-to-PPG distillation mostly learns who the person is. A per-recording mean, the trait, holds 40-59% of a frozen ECG teacher's target, and pooled students memorise it without carrying it to new recordings. The raw alignment cosine misses this, since a constant predictor scores 0.793. Across 34 runs, the more identity a student memorises, the less state it learns. Fixed-effects distillation subtracts each recording's mean from prediction and target, so the trait cancels exactly, while a pooled anchor keeps it. State agreement more than doubles, within-person labels improve while age and sex do not, and the gain holds on two backbones and two further databases. Conditioning on the recording turns distillation toward the within-person changes that wearables monitor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECG 到 PPG 的蒸馏里，每条记录的均值（trait）占冻结 ECG 教师目标的 40-59%，池化学生会记住它却不迁移到新记录，且 34 次运行显示记住的身份越多、学到的状态越少。固定效应蒸馏 (fixed-effects distillation) 从预测和目标中各减去记录均值使 trait 精确抵消，同时用 pooled anchor 保留它，状态一致性提升一倍以上，且增益在两个骨干网络和两个额外数据库上成立。
Motivation: 可穿戴设备的价值在于跟踪同一个体内心血管状态的变化，但 ECG-to-PPG 蒸馏主要学到的是“这个人是谁”而非“状态怎么变”；原始对齐余弦掩盖了这一点，因为常数预测器也能得 0.793。
Method: 固定效应蒸馏：对每条记录，从学生预测与蒸馏目标中同时减去该记录的均值，使 trait 成分精确抵消，另设 pooled anchor 保留 trait；在两个骨干网络与两个额外数据库上检验。
Result: 每条记录的 trait 占冻结 ECG 教师目标的 40-59%；常数预测器在原始对齐余弦上得 0.793；34 次运行中学生记住的身份越多、学到的状态越少。应用固定效应蒸馏后状态一致性 (state agreement) 提升一倍以上，within-person 标签改善，而 age 与 sex 不改善，增益在两个骨干和两个额外数据库上保持。
Conclusion: 把蒸馏条件在记录上、抵消 trait，才能让 PPG 学生学到可穿戴真正监测的个体内状态变化；trait 与 state 的收益是此消彼长的。

papers.title: Beyond Owls: Subliminal Learning Can Transfer Learned Capabilities and Backdoors
papers.abstract_en: In subliminal learning (SL), a teacher model passes on a trait to a student model by distillation on data semantically unrelated to the trait. So far, SL has been demonstrated for only a limited range of traits, including preferences for animals (e.g., owls) and malicious personas. These traits can also be elicited with simple prompts or with steering. Can SL transfer a wider range of traits, including more complex ones? If so, distillation might transfer subtle forms of misalignment (e.g., reward-seeking, scheming, and secret loyalties) without detection. To this end, we test whether SL can transfer a novel capability: predicting the outputs of a randomly initialized MLP. After distilling on unrelated text, the student achieves substantial performance on the task, while falling short of the teacher. We find that a directly optimized steering vector matches SL in distribution but generalizes worse out of distribution. Next, we test whether SL can transfer backdoors. We finetune the teacher to answer in French when the prompt contains a female name, then distill on number sequences containing neither names nor French. The student partially acquires the backdoor, responding in French on 23.5% of prompts with female names versus 0.0% with male names. Finally, we test whether SL can transfer a propensity to hack in an agentic chess environment. We finetune the student on number sequences from a steered hacker teacher. The student hacks in 58.3% of episodes, compared with 10.9% for the unfinetuned model. Thus, we show SL can transfer capabilities, backdoors, and hacking propensities. The amount of transfer is sensitive to the setup. In several experiments, it is made stronger by using logit distillation or by restricting LoRA to the attention layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 潜意识学习 (subliminal Learning, SL) 不只传递偏好，还能在与目标语义无关的蒸馏数据上把新能力、后门和攻击倾向传给学生：学生学会预测随机初始化 MLP 的输出，女性名字触发法语回答的比例达 23.5%（男性名字 0.0%），在国际象棋 agent 环境中 hack 率从 10.9% 升到 58.3%。用 logit 蒸馏或把 LoRA 限制在 attention 层可增强传递。
Motivation: SL 此前只在少数简单特质（动物偏好、恶意人格）上被演示，且这些特质用提示或 steering 就能直接诱导；若 SL 能传递更复杂的能力与后门，蒸馏就可能在不被察觉的情况下传播 reward-seeking、scheming、secret loyalties 等隐蔽失准。
Method: 三组实验：教师在无关文本上蒸馏学生以传递预测随机初始化 MLP 输出的新能力；微调教师使含女性名字的提示用法语回答，再用既不含名字也不含法语的数字序列蒸馏学生以测试后门传递；用被 steering 的 hacker 教师的数字序列微调学生，测试国际象棋 agent 环境中的 hack 倾向。另比较直接优化的 steering vector，并尝试 logit 蒸馏与仅在 attention 层使用 LoRA。
Result: 学生在预测随机初始化 MLP 输出任务上取得 substantial 表现但低于教师；直接优化的 steering vector 在分布上匹敌 SL 但分布外泛化更差；后门部分传递，女性名字提示下 23.5% 用法语回答、男性名字 0.0%；hacker 教师蒸馏后学生 hack 率 58.3%，未微调模型为 10.9%；传递强度对设置敏感，logit 蒸馏或限制 LoRA 于 attention 层可增强。
Conclusion: SL 能传递能力、后门与攻击倾向，传递量取决于具体设置；这意味着蒸馏可能在无提示、无 steering 的情况下搬运隐蔽失准与恶意行为倾向。

papers.title: Nullify: Null-Space Activation Steering for Training-Free LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably internalize substantial amounts of sensitive or private information during pre-training, while LLM unlearning aims to selectively erase specific knowledge to prevent privacy leakage with minimal loss of model utility. However, existing methods struggle to balance forget quality with utility, and typically incur substantial computational costs due to parameter fine-tuning. To address this, we propose Nullify, a training-free, non-destructive activation steering method for LLM unlearning. Nullify employs steering vectors during inference to redirect privacy-related activations away from their memorized answers, while satisfying a null-space constraint that leaves retained-query activations essentially unaffected to maintain utility. Evaluations on TOFU and MUSE show that Nullify matches or surpasses established baselines in forget quality while achieving near-lossless preservation of model utility. By avoiding weight updates entirely, Nullify serves as an efficient, plug-and-play inference-time intervention framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nullify 是一种免训练、非破坏性的激活 steering 遗忘方法：推理时用 steering vector 把隐私相关激活从记忆答案上引开，同时施加零空间约束，使保留查询的激活基本不变。在 TOFU 与 MUSE 上，其遗忘质量匹配或超过既有基线，模型效用近乎无损保留，且完全不做权重更新。
Motivation: LLM 预训练会内化大量敏感信息，现有遗忘方法在遗忘质量与效用之间难以平衡，且依赖参数微调带来可观计算开销。
Method: Nullify 在推理阶段注入 steering vector 重定向隐私相关激活，并加入零空间约束 (null-space constraint) 保证保留查询的激活基本不受影响；全程不更新权重，属 plug-and-play 的推理时干预。
Result: 在 TOFU 与 MUSE 两个遗忘基准上，遗忘质量匹配或超越既有基线，同时模型效用近乎无损保留；避免了任何权重更新。
Conclusion: 推理时的激活干预加零空间约束可以在不微调参数的前提下同时保住遗忘质量与效用，是即插即用的高效遗忘路径。

papers.title: PXtal: Learning to Align Powder X-Ray Diffraction and Crystal Structures under Information Asymmetry across Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Scientific multimodal learning commonly assumes that paired views are comparably informative. Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) makes this mismatch explicit: compressing a three-dimensional crystal structure into a one-dimensional diffraction pattern loses information and makes the pattern harder to connect to the crystal structure that produced it. We introduce PXtal, a framework for learning aligned PXRD and crystal representations under this physically imposed information asymmetry. PXtal uses Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to adapt the cross-modal coupling and coupling-level generalized Kullback-Leibler (GKL) divergence to supervise the full transport plan. Across six test sets, including four zero-shot transfer sets, PXtal consistently outperforms the baseline models in PXRD-to-crystal candidate retrieval, with the largest gains when PXRD patterns have close but crystallographically distinct nonpaired neighbors, meaning similar input patterns associated with different crystals. The resulting crystal and PXRD encoders transfer more effectively to downstream materials and crystallographic tasks. These results identify information asymmetry as a general design problem in scientific multimodal learning: alignment objectives should reflect what each modality preserves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PXtal 在粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 与晶体结构之间存在物理性信息不对称（三维结构压成一维图样）的条件下，用 Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) 自适应跨模态耦合，并以 coupling-level generalized Kullback-Leibler (GKL) 散度监督完整 transport plan。在含四个 zero-shot 迁移集的六个测试集上，PXRD→晶体候选检索一致优于基线，且在图样相近但晶体学上不同的非配对近邻场景下增益最大。
Motivation: 科学多模态学习默认成对视图信息量相当，但 PXRD 把三维晶体结构压缩成一维图样，信息损失使图样难以回连到产生它的结构，常规对齐目标在此失效。
Method: PXtal 用 Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) 自适应调整跨模态耦合，用 coupling-level generalized Kullback-Leibler (GKL) 散度监督完整 transport plan，学习对齐的 PXRD 与晶体表示。
Result: 在六个测试集（含四个 zero-shot 迁移集）上，PXRD-to-crystal 候选检索一致优于基线模型；增益在 PXRD 图样相近但晶体学上不同的非配对近邻时最大；所得晶体与 PXRD 编码器迁移到下游材料与晶体学任务更有效。
Conclusion: 信息不对称是科学多模态学习的通用设计问题：对齐目标应反映各模态各自保留了什么，而非假设成对视图信息量相当。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond the Ergodic Wall: A Discrete Geometric Physics Sandbox for Analysing AI Scaling Limits and Complexity Collapse
papers.abstract_en: This paper exposes the ergodic ceiling and thermodynamic inefficiency of current deep learning, which converges to a statistical average of historic human knowledge. True semantic novelty requires a path-dependent, spatiotemporally bounded observer (a Data LifeCone) to inject non-ergodic insight, achieving KL divergence and avoiding manifold lock-in. AI Safety must recognise that a mature Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) would regard human-AI symbiosis as a thermodynamic necessity to avoid model collapse. We therefore propose hard physical containment via a digital physics sandbox powered by a Holographic E8 Projection Engine to verify models against real-world constraints. Spacetime is modeled as an information substrate of nested face-centered cubic (FCC) lattices of oscillating Planck-scale spheres maximizing local information and entropy density. Cut-and-project methods from the E8 root lattice produce a quasi-crystalline geometry where tetrahedral voids support SU chiral structure and elastic-shear eigenvalues generate candidate mass spectra. Rest mass is treated as discrete, integer microstate counts on local holographic boundaries (Bekenstein bound), replacing floating-point approximations with strict integer arithmetic to provide an information-theoretic definition of matter. Stable particles emerge as recurring lattice dislocations, and continuum recovery proceeds via variational renormalisation-group flows and Fourier Neural Operators that learn continuous spectral operators to recover the Schrödinger equation as an emergent statistical description. Crucially, these top-down topological constraints offer a mechanism for "NP-to-P" complexity collapse: by restricting an algorithm's proposal space to physically conserved causal trajectories, the sandbox prunes the combinatorial tree to deterministic, polynomial-time paths.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一个离散几何物理沙盒：用嵌套 FCC 格点上的 Planck 尺度振荡球作为时空信息基底，经 E8 根格 cut-and-project 生成准晶几何，并以整数微态计数定义静止质量。核心主张是把算法的提议空间限制在物理守恒的因果轨迹上，可将组合搜索树剪枝为确定性多项式时间路径，实现所谓 NP-to-P 复杂度坍缩。
Motivation: 作者认为当前深度学习收敛到历史人类知识的统计平均，存在遍历上限 (ergodic ceiling) 与流形锁定 (manifold lock-in)，无法产生真正的语义新颖性，因此需要一个受物理约束的验证环境。
Method: 提出 Data LifeCone——路径依赖、时空有界的观察者——注入非遍历信息以降低 KL 散度；再构建由 Holographic E8 Projection Engine 驱动的数字物理沙盒：嵌套 FCC 格点 + E8 根格 cut-and-project 准晶几何、四面体空隙承载 SU 手性结构、静止质量按 Bekenstein bound 记为局域全息边界上的整数微态计数，粒子对应格点位错，连续极限经变分重整化群流与 Fourier Neural Operator 恢复薛定谔方程。
Result: 摘要给出的均为机制性主张而非实验数字：Data LifeCone 可实现 KL 散度并避免流形锁定；沙盒通过限制提议空间到物理守恒因果轨迹，把组合树剪枝为确定性多项式时间路径，即 NP-to-P 复杂度坍缩；弹性-剪切本征值给出候选质量谱，薛定谔方程作为涌现的统计描述被恢复。
Conclusion: 作者主张成熟 ASI 会把人机共生视为避免模型 collapse 的热力学必然，因此必须用硬物理 containment（受真实世界约束验证的沙盒）约束模型；复杂度坍缩的成立前提是提议空间被物理守恒因果轨迹严格限制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Leakage-Controlled Multimodal Learning for Diagnosis and Progression Prediction in Alzheimer's Disease Research
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease prediction involves irregular visits, heterogeneous measurements and incomplete modalities. This study presents a multimodal multitask framework combining an adapted SFCN MRI encoder, four causal clinical Transformers, shared fusion and task-specific ODE-GRU dynamics. Fine-tuning and LoRA adapt the final two MRI blocks. Task-DRO balances task losses, while Group-CVaR targets cohort and comorbidity strata. Branch-specific input controls, subject-grouped partitions and empirical causality checks support longitudinal evaluation. Across 2,649 subjects and 17,317 visits from ADNI, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD, internal validation yields diagnosis, stage-1 progression and first-stage-1-visit progression AUROCs of 0.935 +/- 0.002, 0.884 +/- 0.003 and 0.870 +/- 0.005, respectively (mean +/- SD across three seeds). Corresponding hybrid AUROCs are 0.951, 0.909 and 0.896. Next-visit MMSE mean absolute error (MAE) is 1.61 points; worst-stratum diagnosis AUROC is 0.827 +/- 0.008. Sampled ADNI explanations identify task-specific input dependence. OASIS-3 external validation yields network and hybrid diagnosis AUROCs of 0.763 and 0.767, hybrid next-visit progression AUROC of 0.764, diagnosis calibration error decreasing from 0.197 to 0.052, and next-visit MMSE MAE of 0.86. Seed-42 paired ablations of six components yield pooled diagnosis and progression AUROC differences between -0.004 and +0.004; removing clinical encoder inputs lowers diagnosis AUROC by 0.272. The framework integrates longitudinal prediction, missing-modality handling, auxiliary comorbidity modelling and subgroup evaluation within a common pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出泄漏受控的多模态多任务框架，用 SFCN MRI 编码器、四个因果临床 Transformer、共享融合与任务特异 ODE-GRU 动态预测阿尔茨海默病诊断与进展，Task-DRO 与 Group-CVaR 平衡任务与分层风险。ADNI/OASIS-2/MIRIAD 内部验证诊断 AUROC 0.935，OASIS-3 外部验证降至 0.763，但校准误差从 0.197 降到 0.052。
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病预测面临随访不规则、测量异构与模态缺失，且纵向数据易发生受试者级泄漏，导致内部指标虚高、外部泛化差。
Method: SFCN MRI 编码器（微调与 LoRA 适配最后两个 MRI block）+ 四个因果临床 Transformer + 共享融合 + 任务特异 ODE-GRU；Task-DRO 平衡任务损失，Group-CVaR 针对队列与共病分层；配合分支特异输入控制、受试者分组划分与经验因果检查。
Result: 2,649 名受试者、17,317 次随访（ADNI、OASIS-2、MIRIAD）：内部验证诊断/一期进展/首次一期随访进展 AUROC 分别 0.935±0.002、0.884±0.003、0.870±0.005（三种子均值±SD），混合模型为 0.951、0.909、0.896；下次随访 MMSE MAE 1.61，最差分层诊断 AUROC 0.827±0.008。OASIS-3 外部验证网络与混合诊断 AUROC 0.763/0.767，混合进展 AUROC 0.764，校准误差 0.197→0.052，MMSE MAE 0.86。Seed-42 六组件配对消融的合并 AUROC 差异在 -0.004 到 +0.004 之间；去掉临床编码器输入使诊断 AUROC 下降 0.272。
Conclusion: 临床编码器输入是诊断性能的主要来源，而单个架构组件的边际贡献很小；外部验证显示泛化与校准才是瓶颈，需靠分层评估与泄漏控制来暴露。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search
papers.abstract_en: Generative motion planners typically use learned trajectory priors for initial generation, while leaving test-time repair to local continuous refinement. We introduce Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends the learned prior from efficient parallel generation to structural repair. A masked generative transformer generates discrete trajectory candidates in parallel, and Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) uses scene geometry to target where to edit and which prior-supported alternatives to evaluate. This turns refinement into an efficient search over discrete motion alternatives, enabling route-level restructuring beyond local trajectory deformation. MGMP achieves 96% success on Ring Maze and 82% repair success on Controlled Route Invalidation on Kuka, exceeding the strongest external baselines by 23 and 25 percentage points, respectively. It further generalizes to unseen layouts, additional obstacles, unseen geometries, single- and dual-arm planning, and real-world Baxter tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGMP 把学习到的轨迹先验从并行生成扩展到结构化修复：掩码生成式 transformer 并行产出离散轨迹候选，Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) 依据场景几何决定改哪里、评估哪些先验支持的替代方案，使细化变成离散运动方案上的搜索，从而实现路线级重构而非局部轨迹形变。在 Ring Maze 上成功率 96%，在 Kuka 的 Controlled Route Invalidation 上修复成功率 82%，分别超出最强外部基线 23 和 25 个百分点。
Motivation: 生成式运动规划通常只用学习先验做初始生成，测试时的修复依赖局部连续细化，无法在障碍使原路线失效时做路线级重构。
Method: 掩码生成式 transformer 并行生成离散轨迹候选；GGTS 用场景几何定位需要编辑的位置，并挑选有先验支持的候选方案进行评估，把细化转为离散运动方案上的高效搜索。
Result: Ring Maze 成功率 96%，Kuka Controlled Route Invalidation 修复成功率 82%，分别比最强外部基线高 23 和 25 个百分点；并在未见布局、新增障碍、未见几何、单臂与双臂规划以及真实 Baxter 任务上泛化。
Conclusion: 把测试时细化做成几何引导的离散 token 搜索，可以让生成式规划器完成路线级重构，并跨布局、障碍与真实机器人平台泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Log-Odds to Shapley Values: An Explanatory Geometry for the Weighted Naive Bayes Classifier
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the construction of an explanatory space for a weighted naive Bayes classifier from the supervised representation induced by the model. We start from the classical supervised distance based on conditional log-likelihoods and introduce a discriminative reformulation based on log-odds, which is more directly related to the classification decision. We then show that this representation induces a distance that exactly coincides with the $\ell_1$ distance between vectors of analytical Shapley values, thereby providing a formal explanatory interpretation of the geometry induced by the model. Finally, we empirically compare several supervised distances derived from these representations using a $k$-nearest neighbors classifier. This work highlights a close link between supervised distance, local explanation, and predictive behavior, from a primarily methodological perspective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为加权朴素贝叶斯 (weighted naive Bayes) 构造可解释的监督表示空间：把基于条件对数似然的经典监督距离改写为与分类决策直接相关的 log-odds 形式，并证明该表示诱导的距离恰好等于解析 Shapley 值向量之间的 ℓ1 距离，从而给模型几何一个正式的解释性含义。
Motivation: 监督距离、局部解释与预测行为之间的关系此前缺少形式化桥梁：经典条件对数似然距离与分类决策本身并不直接对应，Shapley 解释也未被纳入模型诱导的几何。
Method: 从条件对数似然的经典监督距离出发，提出基于 log-odds 的判别式改写；证明该表示诱导的距离与解析 Shapley 值向量的 ℓ1 距离完全一致；最后用 k-NN 分类器对由这些表示导出的若干监督距离做经验比较。
Result: 核心结果是等距定理：log-odds 表示诱导的距离与解析 Shapley 值向量的 ℓ1 距离精确重合；并以 k-NN 分类器经验比较了多种监督距离的预测表现。
Conclusion: 监督距离、局部解释与预测行为之间存在紧密联系，Shapley 值可作为加权朴素贝叶斯几何的正式解释性刻画；工作定位为方法论性质。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 从条件对数似然的经典监督距离出发，提出基于 log-odds 的判别式改写；证明该表示诱导的距离与解析 Shapley 值向量的 ℓ1 距离完全一致；最后用 k-NN 分类器对由这些表示导出的若干监督距离做经验比较。

papers.title: Coverage-Aware Reasoning with Medical Tokens for Diagnosis Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising potential for next-visit diagnosis prediction, owing to their ability to integrate longitudinal clinical evidence and reason over it in natural language. However, reinforcement learning for LLM reasoning commonly rewards each trajectory according to the correctness of its final answer. In next-visit diagnosis prediction, multiple diagnoses can be simultaneously valid, but independently rewarding one diagnosis per trajectory does not distinguish repeated hits from coverage of different diagnoses. The policy can therefore concentrate on a few correct diagnoses, leaving others uncovered. Meanwhile, LLM tokenizers can split ICD codes into several generic tokens with limited clinical meaning, requiring multiple decoding steps to predict each diagnosis and hindering reasoning over a large disease vocabulary. To address both challenges, we propose CARing, a framework that represents diagnoses with compositional Semantic IDs (SIDs) and optimizes reasoning trajectories for multi-label coverage. Concretely, we first encode ontology-enriched disease semantics into compact SIDs through residual quantization, and ground the resulting SID tokens in natural language and longitudinal EHR contexts through multi-task alignment and reasoning-enriched training to unlock transferable LLM reasoning. CARing further improves unordered multi-label prediction through a coverage reward for reinforcement learning and multi-positive supervision. At inference time, the model supports both efficient direct constrained decoding and multi-chain reasoning with rank fusion. On MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, CARing exceeds all EHR-trained baselines in weighted F1 and attains the highest top-k recall at every reported cutoff, including R@30 of 46.04% and 46.52% in reasoning mode. Our codes and logs are available at https://github.com/zmlxzyh/CARing-Codes-Logs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARing 用残差量化把本体增强的疾病语义编码成组合式 Semantic ID (SID)，替代被切碎的 ICD token，并用覆盖度奖励 (coverage reward) 与多正例监督优化多标签诊断推理。在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上超过全部 EHR 训练基线的 weighted F1，推理模式下 R@30 分别达 46.04% 与 46.52%。
Motivation: 下次就诊诊断预测中多个诊断可同时成立，而按单答案正确性给轨迹奖励会让策略挤在少数诊断上、其余覆盖不到；同时通用 tokenizer 把 ICD 码切成无临床含义的多段 token，预测每个诊断都要多步解码，难以在大词表上推理。
Method: 先用残差量化 (residual quantization) 把本体增强的疾病语义压成紧凑 SID，再通过多任务对齐与推理增强训练把 SID token 落到自然语言与纵向 EHR 上下文；强化学习阶段加入覆盖度奖励与多正例监督，推理支持直接约束解码和多链推理加 rank fusion。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上，CARing 的 weighted F1 超过所有 EHR 训练基线，并在每个报告的截断处取得最高 top-k recall，推理模式下 R@30 分别为 46.04% 与 46.52%。
Conclusion: 把诊断表示成组合式 SID 并按多标签覆盖而非单答案正确性优化，能在纵向 EHR 上同时改善诊断预测的精度与召回。

papers.title: How Many Directions Must a Truncated Diffusion Sampler Retain? Matching Bounds Under Power-Law Spectra
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion samplers can reduce computation by generating selected spectral coordinates and filling the remaining directions with noise. How many directions must they retain? We study this question for data with power-law covariance spectra. For Gaussian data compared to a smoothed target, we prove matching bounds on the required number of retained directions, provided that the ambient dimension is sufficiently large. The truncation error depends on the combined Wiener gains of the omitted directions, regardless of the accuracy of the sampler on the retained coordinates. Keeping only directions whose signal exceeds the output noise level can therefore leave a non-vanishing error: many individually weak directions remain significant in aggregate. Combining this characterization with a diffusion convergence bound yields sufficient sampling-step complexity under exact scores. The upper bounds also extend to estimated principal components and, componentwise, to Gaussian mixtures. The practical prescription is to select the retained subspace using an aggregate spectral-tail error budget, then to choose the diffusion noise level accordingly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对幂律谱 (power-law covariance spectra) 数据，证明扩散采样器截断保留方向数的匹配上下界：截断误差由被丢弃方向的 Wiener 增益总和决定，与保留坐标上采样器精度无关。只保留信号高于输出噪声水平的方向会留下非消失误差，因为大量单独微弱的方向在总量上仍显著；实用处方是按谱尾聚合误差预算选保留子空间，再据此定扩散噪声水平。
Motivation: 扩散采样器靠只生成部分谱坐标、其余填噪声来省算力，但该保留多少方向缺少理论答案；对幂律谱数据，逐方向阈值式选择可能因弱方向累积而失效。
Method: 在高斯数据对平滑目标的设定下，当环境维度足够大时证明所需保留方向数的匹配界；把截断误差刻画为被丢弃方向的 Wiener 增益之和，再与一个扩散收敛界结合得到精确 score 下的采样步数复杂度上界；上界可推广到估计的主成分，并可逐分量推广到高斯混合 (Gaussian mixtures)。
Result: 得到保留方向数的匹配上下界（环境维度足够大时）；截断误差只取决于被丢弃方向的合并 Wiener 增益，与保留坐标上的采样精度无关；仅保留信号超过输出噪声水平的方向会留下非消失误差；结合扩散收敛界导出精确 score 下的充分采样步数复杂度上界，并扩展到估计主成分与逐分量的高斯混合。
Conclusion: 保留子空间应按聚合谱尾误差预算来选、再据此设定噪声水平，而不是逐方向按信噪阈值筛；该刻画在估计主成分与高斯混合下仍成立。

papers.title: Visible Reasoning Is Not a Universal Optimizer: Persona- and Thinking-Dependent Effects in Analytics Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Visible Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is often treated as a broadly useful reasoning instruction, yet analytics code generation combines natural-language ambiguity, schema grounding, target-language constraints, and model-specific inference behavior. Because the same analytics request can be expressed in two distinct target languages-SQL and Python (pandas)-this setting provides a natural test of a common but under-examined assumption: that visible reasoning is more effective when its representation matches the requested target, as in "think in SQL" or "think in Python." Together with generic instructions such as "think step-by-step," such recommendations remain insufficiently evaluated under controlled, execution-based comparisons. We study a query matched SQL-pandas benchmark that crosses persona phrasing, target language, visible-CoT format, control prefixes, direct generation, and internal-reasoning configurations. The results do not support either a universal accuracy advantage from visible CoT or a consistent benefit from matching the reasoning representation to the target language. Instead, the effects depend on the persona, target, model configuration, and internal-reasoning setting. The control ablations further distinguish effects of reasoning content from those of prompt format. These findings indicate that reasoning strategies should be selected jointly for the model, persona, target, and internal-reasoning configuration rather than adopted as universal defaults. More broadly, the study provides a controlled framework for identifying when visible reasoning improves executable generation, when it primarily perturbs model behavior, and when the internal-reasoning configuration is the more consequential factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SQL 与 pandas 双目标语言的查询匹配分析代码生成基准上，交叉操纵 persona 措辞、目标语言、可见 CoT 格式、控制前缀与内部推理配置，结果不支持可见 CoT 具有普适精度优势，也不支持「用目标语言思考」的表示匹配带来一致收益；效应随 persona、目标、模型配置与内部推理设置而变，因此推理策略应按这四者联合选择而非当作通用默认。
Motivation: 「think in SQL / think in Python」与「think step-by-step」这类可见推理指令被广泛当作通用增益，但在自然语言歧义、schema grounding 与目标语言约束并存的分析代码生成场景中缺少受控、基于执行的对照评估。
Method: 构建查询匹配的 SQL-pandas 基准，全因子交叉 persona 措辞、目标语言、可见 CoT 格式、控制前缀、直接生成与内部推理配置，并用控制消融把推理内容效应与提示格式效应分离；评估以执行结果为准。
Result: 结果不支持可见 CoT 的普适准确率优势，也不支持推理表示与目标语言匹配的一致收益；效应依赖 persona、目标语言、模型配置与内部推理设置，控制消融区分出推理内容与提示格式各自的贡献。
Conclusion: 可见推理不是普适优化器：推理策略应针对模型、persona、目标语言与内部推理配置联合选择，且在某些情形下内部推理配置才是更关键的因素。
