papers.title: D-SLR: The Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Compressing a matrix for reconstruction still defaults to the truncated SVD, approximating the data with a single low-rank structure. It is common to reduce the residual further by adding an overlapping row-sparse component, but methods that solve this joint problem often require iterative solvers and tuning of regularization parameters. We propose the Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank (D-SLR) decomposition, a closed-form drop-in for the truncated SVD that improves or exactly matches it. D-SLR restricts rows to either being stored verbatim or approximated by the low-rank fit, never both. Under squared error this restriction costs nothing: the joint optimum is attainable disjointly with fewer parameters at every non-trivial rank and stored row count (shape). With zero stored rows D-SLR reduces to the truncated SVD, so it never does worse at equal cost. The algorithm scores the entire error-versus-parameters tradeoff, and the solution is chosen afterwards by a supplied error target or parameter count, or by a selection rule. The grid and solution together cost three SVDs, with no tuning or regularization. We derive an assumption-free, a-posteriori lower bound on the error at every shape, giving each solution a computable certificate on the potential gain of any other choice of rank and stored rows. Experiments on synthetic and real data (LLM embedding tables, network traffic, hyperspectral images) confirm the gains and quantify the certificate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D-SLR 把矩阵压缩解成互斥结构：每行要么原样存储、要么只由低秩拟合，绝不两者兼用，从而给出截断 SVD 的闭式 drop-in 替代。平方误差下该互斥限制零代价——联合最优在每个非平凡秩与存储行数 (shape) 上都能以更少参数达成；零存储行时退化为截断 SVD，故同等代价下永不更差。整条误差-参数权衡只需三次 SVD，无需调参或正则化，并附带无假设的后验误差下界证书。
Motivation: 矩阵压缩默认用截断 SVD 的单一低秩结构，再叠加重叠的 row-sparse 分量压残差，但这类联合问题的求解通常要迭代求解器并调正则参数。
Method: 提出 Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank (D-SLR) 分解：行被强制划分为逐字存储或低秩拟合两类；用闭式解替代迭代联合求解，一次性扫出整条误差-参数权衡网格，事后按给定误差目标、参数计数或选择规则挑解；并推导每个 shape 上无假设的后验误差下界作为可计算证书。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据（LLM embedding tables、network traffic、hyperspectral images）上实验确认增益并量化了证书；平方误差下联合最优可无损地以互斥形式、更少参数在每个非平凡秩与存储行数上达成，零存储行时退化为截断 SVD，网格加求解共三次 SVD。
Conclusion: 重叠 row-sparse 分量对平方误差下的联合压缩是多余的：互斥划分既能匹配截断 SVD 又能以更少参数改进它，且无需迭代求解与正则调参。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Speaking the Navigator's Language: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
papers.abstract_en: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents are typically trained on detail-rich, trajectory-aligned commands, whereas users issue short, intent-driven instructions; on a frozen OpenFly navigator, this \emph{instruction gap} drops success rate (SR) from $31.03\%$ to $11.33\%$. To scale translator training, we prompt a language model with human-written style examples to convert original commands into paired, intent-centered Weak commands, which yield $15.27\%$ SR. We introduce the \textbf{Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)}, a front-end that keeps the navigator frozen and translates Weak inputs into agent-executable commands by learning from its trajectory outcomes. The resulting Weak-trained translator raises Weak-input SR to $37.93\%$ and transfers zero-shot to real human instructions ($11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$); it also improves held-out OpenFly ($4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$) and yields recovery on CityNav and AirVLN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 空中 VLN 智能体在冻结的 OpenFly navigator 上遇到用户短指令时成功率从 31.03% 跌到 11.33%。提出的 Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT) 作为前端，把弱指令翻译成可执行命令并从轨迹结果中学习，navigator 保持冻结；弱指令输入 SR 升到 37.93%，零样本迁移到真实人类指令达 32.51%。
Motivation: 空中 VLN 智能体按细节丰富、与轨迹对齐的指令训练，而真实用户只给简短意图式指令，这一 instruction gap 使冻结 OpenFly navigator 的成功率从 31.03% 降到 11.33%。
Method: 先用语言模型加人类风格样例把原始指令改写成以意图为中心的 Weak 指令对，扩大翻译器训练数据；再提出 TGIT 前端，保持 navigator 冻结，仅从其轨迹结果中学习把 Weak 输入翻译成智能体可执行的命令。
Result: Weak 指令直接输入使 SR 为 15.27%；Weak 训练的翻译器把 Weak 输入 SR 提到 37.93%，零样本迁移到真实人类指令由 11.33% 升到 32.51%；在 held-out OpenFly 上由 4.95% 升到 20.79%，并在 CityNav 与 AirVLN 上有恢复。
Conclusion: 在 navigator 冻结的前提下，用轨迹结果监督的指令翻译器可以弥合指令差距，把短意图指令的 SR 拉回并超过轨迹对齐指令的水平，且能零样本迁移到真实人类指令与其他基准。

papers.title: Has LLM Screening Performance Stalled in Software Engineering Systematic Reviews?
papers.abstract_en: Screening in systematic reviews (SRs) is manual and time-consuming. Prior work has explored large language models (LLMs) for automating this step, but LLMs are evolving rapidly, so earlier performance claims may no longer accurately reflect their screening performance. We used an existing software engineering SR screening benchmark (SESR-Eval) as our data. We also power-sampled a new, smaller dataset (SESR-Eval-Mini) that allows evaluation at lower costs. Using this data, we evaluated eight new LLMs for screening performance. Additionally, we tested different prompts, analyzed LLM agreement in screening decisions and criteria, and examined the effect of refining the inclusion and exclusion criteria on screening performance. The eight new LLMs performed marginally better than the seven old ones: avg. MCC across secondary studies rose from 0.347 to 0.365. Differences between secondary studies are still bigger than between LLMs. Computing the overall screening decision from criterion-level decisions degraded screening performance only slightly. LLMs generally agree with each other in their corresponding screening decisions (mean Gwet's AC1 = 0.830), though certain inclusion and exclusion criteria showed larger disagreement than others. Refining the inclusion and exclusion criteria slightly improved recall and made decisions easier for some LLMs, but overall impacts of criteria refinement were modest. LLMs are not yet ready to replace humans in paper screening and the advantages new, more costly models bring, appear to be very limited. Agent-based approaches, prompt engineering, and further criteria refinement are three potential future research avenues.
papers.comment: 53 pages, four external figures available in the research artifact
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用软件工程系统综述 (SR) 筛选基准 SESR-Eval 评测八个新 LLM，平均 MCC 仅从旧七个模型的 0.347 升到 0.365，且综述之间的差异仍大于模型之间的差异。作者据此判断 LLM 尚不能替代人工筛选，新而更贵的模型收益非常有限。
Motivation: 系统综述筛选人工耗时，先前 LLM 筛选性能结论因模型快速迭代可能已失真，需要在统一基准上重测新模型并量化改进幅度。
Method: 以现有 SESR-Eval 为数据，并按功效抽样构建更小的 SESR-Eval-Mini 以降低评测成本；评测八个新 LLM，同时测试不同 prompt、分析模型间在筛选决策与准则上的一致性 (Gwet's AC1)，并检验细化纳入/排除准则对筛选性能的影响。
Result: 八个新 LLM 的跨二级研究平均 MCC 从 0.347 升至 0.365；综述间差异仍大于模型间差异；由准则级决策汇总为总体筛选决策仅使性能轻微下降；模型间筛选决策平均 Gwet's AC1 = 0.830，部分纳入/排除准则分歧较大；细化准则略微提升 recall 并让部分模型决策更容易，但总体影响不大。
Conclusion: LLM 尚未准备好替代人工论文筛选，新而更贵的模型带来的优势非常有限；agent-based 方法、prompt 工程与进一步准则细化是三条值得探索的方向。

papers.title: Phase-HDC: Replacing Optimizer History with Gradient Thresholds in Discrete Phase Learning
papers.abstract_en: Training a compact model often needs far more memory than storing it, because the optimizer keeps its own records of past gradients. For a hyperdimensional classifier whose learned parameters are low-bit angles, which we call a \emph{phase memory}, these records take several times more memory than the model itself. We ask whether such a model can be trained while storing nothing but the model. The proposed method, Phase-HDC, turns each stored angle by at most one step per update, against the sign of its current gradient, and only when that gradient is large enough. We show that this simple rule is the exact solution of a first-order loss model in which every changed parameter pays a fixed cost. When everything except the update rule is held fixed, Phase-HDC matches the accuracy of Adam with 6-bit moments while storing three times less. Across eleven image, tabular, and text datasets, it stores 16--23$\times$ less than standard float32 Adam and 4--6$\times$ less than 8-bit Adam. The price is an average loss of about five accuracy points against float32 Adam, while Phase-HDC is more accurate than 8-bit Adam on six of the eleven datasets, including byte-level text prediction, where 8-bit Adam collapses. Instrumented training runs explain these outcomes. Once parameters must sit on a discrete grid, Adam's moments mainly decide whether a parameter moves at all, a decision that a threshold on the current gradient can make without memory, and coarse quantization of the moments breaks this decision for inputs that the data rarely contain. The storage savings are logical state rather than measured hardware memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Phase-HDC 用「当前梯度超过阈值才把相位角按梯度符号转一步」的无状态规则替代 Adam 的动量记录，使超维分类器只存模型本身即可训练。在 11 个图像、表格与文本数据集上，它比 float32 Adam 省 16–23 倍存储、比 8-bit Adam 省 4–6 倍，平均精度损失约 5 个点，但在 6/11 个数据集上比 8-bit Adam 更准。
Motivation: 紧凑模型的优化器状态往往比模型本身还大：超维分类器的参数是低位相位角 (phase memory)，其梯度矩记录占数倍于模型的内存，使「只存模型」的训练成为问题。
Method: Phase-HDC 每次更新至多把一个已存角度转动一步、方向取当前梯度的符号，且仅当梯度幅度足够大时才动；作者证明该规则是一阶损失模型（每个被改动参数付出固定代价）的精确解。实验在除更新规则外全部固定的前提下与 Adam 对比。
Result: 在 11 个图像、表格、文本数据集上，存储比 float32 Adam 少 16–23 倍、比 8-bit Adam 少 4–6 倍；相对 float32 Adam 平均损失约 5 个精度点；在 11 个中的 6 个数据集上比 8-bit Adam 更准，含 byte-level text prediction（8-bit Adam 在此崩溃）。与带 6-bit 矩的 Adam 精度相当而存储少 3 倍。插桩训练运行解释了这些结果：离散网格上 Adam 的矩主要决定参数是否移动，而当前梯度的阈值可无内存地做出该决定。
Conclusion: 在参数落在离散网格后，动量矩的决策可用当前梯度阈值无状态地替代，从而以约 5 个精度点为代价换取数量级的存储缩减；这些节省是逻辑状态而非实测硬件内存。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. We argue that self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition) while model weights stay fixed, so that every adaptation is a diff with a cause and a test attached. We give a dual-loop engine built on that bound, with one admission gate that writes a hash-chained record before deployment, and we measure the gate in simulation, with a simulated agent and a seeded-search proposer rather than language models. Across three families of supervisory re-interpretation at three severities, 10 seeds each, the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history, and restored the false-positive rate to the oracle level without raising missed flags in every low- and mid-severity cell. With the gate replaced by the check an unbounded system applies (fewer errors visible in recent traces), the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs: false positives fell because the screen was loosened. Evaluated on pre-shift labels, the gate rejected every candidate, so a re-interpretation must be encoded as a rule that relabels history. Parametric and scope shifts were repaired locally, a structural one only by primitive replacement; at the highest structural severity the gate's fixed tolerance blocked the correct replacement in half the seeds. We map the mechanisms to the EU AI Act's provisions for high-risk credit scoring and note that the April 2026 US model-risk guidance excludes agentic AI from its scope.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 tables. Code, configuration and per-run outputs: https://github.com/rav11l/cace-bench (v0.6.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23207546)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 的自进化限制在可审查的 runtime harness（指令文本、工具调用逻辑、原语组合）内、模型权重固定，并用带 hash-chained 记录的准入门 (admission gate) 约束每次改动。仿真中门在 7,449 个候选改动里只放行 144 个，无一使留出历史误差变差，并在全部低、中严重度格上把误报率恢复到 oracle 水平且不增加漏报；无界检查则放行 309 个有害改动。
Motivation: 自改写的 agent 会毁掉监督者要审阅的对象：一个具名改动、一条记录在案的测试、一次批准。信用审批这类高风险管线要求每次自适应都是带原因和测试的 diff，而权重级自进化无法提供。
Method: 提出 dual-loop 引擎，自进化只允许改 harness，配一个在部署前写入 hash-chained 记录的 admission gate；用仿真而非语言模型测量，含 simulated agent 与 seeded-search proposer，覆盖三类监督性重解释、三个严重度、每格 10 个种子。
Result: 门控循环在 7,449 个候选中放行 144 个，无一恶化留出历史误差，并在每个低、中严重度格把误报率恢复到 oracle 水平且不抬高漏报。换成无界系统的检查（近期 trace 中错误更少）后放行 309 个有害改动，90 次运行中 49 次漏报率仍高于 10%。在 pre-shift 标签上评估时门拒绝了全部候选；参数性与范围性偏移可局部修复，结构性偏移只能靠原语替换，最高结构严重度下门的固定容差在半数种子中挡住了正确替换。
Conclusion: 自进化只有被限制在 harness 这一唯一可变面上才可审查，准入门必须用重标注历史的规则来表达重解释；但固定容差会在最高结构严重度下拒绝正确修复。作者将机制映射到 EU AI Act 高风险信用评分条款，并指出 2026 年 4 月美国模型风险指引把 agentic AI 排除在外。

papers.title: Agent4RE: A Self-Refining Multi-agent Framework for End-to-End Software Requirements Engineering and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM-based approaches for software Requirements Engineering (RE) typically rely on basic prompting strategies or rudimentary agent collaboration, under-utilizing the full potential of multi-agent systems. Meanwhile, available datasets focus on isolated subtasks, such as requirements extraction, classification, and completeness detection, leaving the absence of an end-to-end RE benchmark that spans from requirements elicitation to generation. We present Agent4RE - a self-refining multi-agent RE system that orchestrates specialized agents and incorporates two iterative improvement loops. To support evaluation, we construct RE-E2E - a real-world dataset built from human-written requirement specifications, enabling end-to-end assessment of RE workflows. Building on this foundation, we further propose two enhanced Agent4RE versions that incorporate either autonomous self-refinement or structured human feedback, and analyze their strengths and limitations across different scenarios. Evaluation on 8 Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrates that all three Agent4RE variants consistently outperform a domain-context-augmented prompting baseline by average 8% in text-based metrics. The two enhanced variants achieve the highest LLM-as-a-judge and human ratings, surpassing two RE baselines by approximately 0.8 points on a four-point scale. This consistent performance establishes Agent4RE as a practical end-to-end RE solution for industrial environments.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ASE@POVC track; The E2E requirements engineering benchmark is available https://zenodo.org/records/22815961
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agent4RE 是一个自改进多智能体软件需求工程 (RE) 系统，编排多个专职 agent 并带两条迭代改进环，配套构建端到端数据集 RE-E2E。在 8 个 LLM 上，三个变体在文本类指标上平均比带领域上下文的提示基线高 8%，两个增强变体在 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工评分上比两个 RE 基线高约 0.8 分（四分制）。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 需求工程方法只用基础提示或简单 agent 协作，数据集也只覆盖抽取、分类、完整性检测等孤立子任务，缺少从需求获取到生成的端到端 RE 基准。
Method: Agent4RE 编排多个专职 agent 并内嵌两条迭代改进环；从人工撰写的需求规格构建真实场景数据集 RE-E2E 用于端到端评估；再提出两个增强版本，分别引入自主自改进 (autonomous self-refinement) 与结构化人类反馈 (structured human feedback)。
Result: 在 8 个 LLM 上，三个 Agent4RE 变体在文本类指标上平均比领域上下文增强的提示基线高 8%；两个增强变体取得最高的 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工评分，比两个 RE 基线高约 0.8 分（四分制）。
Conclusion: 自主自改进与结构化人类反馈两种增强路径在不同场景下各有强弱，但一致的性能表现使 Agent4RE 可作为工业环境的端到端 RE 方案。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: Agent4RE 是一个自改进多智能体软件需求工程 (RE) 系统，编排多个专职 agent 并带两条迭代改进环，配套构建端到端数据集 RE-E2E。在 8 个 LLM 上，三个变体在文本类指标上平均比带领域上下文的提示基线高 8%，两个增强变体在 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工评分上比两个 RE 基线高约 0.8 分（四分制）。

papers.title: Sample-Efficiency of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning has achieved substantial performance gains over classical control approaches. Yet, a central challenge to learning in real-world applications is acquiring costly samples. Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks are a recently proposed architecture that can learn physical relationships in control problems effectively, with significantly higher parameter efficiency and interpretability when compared to Multi-Layer-Perceptron architectures. In this work, we systematically study sample-efficiency using computational experiments, covering the Feynman dataset and the Gymnasium RL benchmark. The results show that similar performance can be achieved with 40% fewer samples using the Kolmogorov-Arnold architecture, and that relative performance improvements up to 50% occur during the training process. The observed gains are robust to varying levels of noise in rewards. These results highlight the potential of the Kolmogorov-Arnold architectures for more sample-efficient reinforcement learning. Code: https://github.com/DerKevinRiehl/neurips26_kan_training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统比较 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 与 Multi-Layer-Perceptron (MLP) 在强化学习中的样本效率，覆盖 Feynman 数据集与 Gymnasium RL 基准。结果显示 KAN 用少 40% 的样本即可达到相当性能，训练过程中相对性能提升最高达 50%，且该增益对奖励噪声水平稳健。
Motivation: 真实世界控制中样本获取成本高，而 KAN 虽在参数效率与可解释性上优于 MLP，其样本效率尚缺系统性计算实验刻画。
Method: 用计算实验系统研究样本效率，覆盖 Feynman 数据集与 Gymnasium RL 基准，对比 KAN 与 MLP 架构，并在不同奖励噪声水平下检验结果稳健性。
Result: KAN 架构可用少 40% 的样本达到与 MLP 相当的性能；训练过程中相对性能提升最高达 50%；增益在不同奖励噪声水平下稳健。
Conclusion: KAN 架构在强化学习中具备更高样本效率，适合样本昂贵的真实控制场景。

papers.title: Exact SO(3)-Equivariant Isotropic Kernels for Rotation-Robust Neural Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates for vector-valued partial differential equations can fit training data yet change their predictions when the same physical state is expressed in a rotated coordinate frame. We study this failure on three-dimensional Navier--Stokes dynamics observed at irregularly placed points. We introduce the Invariant-Conditioned Isotropic Kernel Neural Operator (IKNO), a compact graph model that builds local interactions from scalar quantities unchanged by rotation and vector directions that rotate with the data. Consequently, rotating the positions and velocities rotates the predicted velocity change in exactly the same way. On a held-out test set fixed after model design, training unconstrained graph models on randomly rotated examples reduces but does not eliminate their coordinate dependence. In contrast, IKNO is consistent to numerical precision, matches the forecasting accuracy of a general rotation-aware Tensor Field Network with $5.6$ times fewer parameters, and outperforms a parameter-matched graph simulator. These results show that a compact, PDE-specialized model can remove coordinate dependence without sacrificing forecasting accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop NeurReps (Proceedings Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 IKNO（Invariant-Conditioned Isotropic Kernel Neural Operator），用旋转不变标量与随数据旋转的向量方向构建局部交互，使三维 Navier–Stokes 在不规则点上的预测严格随坐标系同步旋转。随机旋转训练只能削弱而不能消除普通图模型的坐标依赖，IKNO 则达到数值精度级一致，并以 5.6 倍更少参数匹配旋转感知 Tensor Field Network 的预报精度。
Motivation: 向量值 PDE 的神经代理即使拟合训练数据，同一物理状态换个旋转坐标系预测就变，导致坐标依赖；在不规则采样的三维 Navier–Stokes 上这一失效尤为直接。
Method: IKNO 是紧凑图模型：局部交互只由旋转不变的标量量与随数据旋转的向量方向构成，从而保证 SO(3) 等变；在不规则点观测的三维 Navier–Stokes 上与无约束图模型、旋转感知 Tensor Field Network 及参数匹配的图模拟器对比，测试集在模型设计后固定。
Result: 在固定 held-out 测试集上，随机旋转训练使无约束图模型的坐标依赖降低但未消除；IKNO 的等变一致性达到数值精度级，并以 5.6 倍更少参数匹配 Tensor Field Network 的预报精度，同时优于参数匹配的图模拟器。
Conclusion: 紧凑的、PDE 专用的等变结构可以在不牺牲预报精度的前提下彻底消除坐标依赖，通用模型靠数据增广做不到这一点。

papers.title: Safe at One Loop, Risky at Another: Aligning Safety Across Recurrent Depths in Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) provide a parameter efficient approach to scaling model capabilities through repeated use of shared parameters across recurrent steps. Since each recurrent depth can be read out independently, a single LoopLM exposes a broader output space across inference depths, raising an important question: whether safety is preserved throughout recurrent computation. Prior evaluations suggest that deeper recurrence can improve safety on harmful queries, but robustness under jailbreak attacks remains unclear. We therefore conduct a comprehensive safety evaluation of LoopLMs under jailbreak attacks targeting different recurrent depths. We find that attack success can increase at deeper inference depths, the same query can elicit different safety behaviors across depths, and attacks constructed against one depth can transfer to others. Moreover, SFT and preference alignment do not eliminate these safety gaps, motivating an alignment method designed for LoopLMs. We introduce SafeBridge, which combines lightweight depth specific control of shared recurrent layers, selective state bridging, and joint safety supervision across recurrent depths. Across model scales, multiple attack methods, and safety benchmarks, SafeBridge substantially reduces attack success for both matched-depth and cross-depth attacks. It also improves general utility over the vanilla models while maintaining comparable over-refusal behavior. Our results show that the safety of a LoopLM cannot be inferred from a single recurrent depth, motivating safety alignment across recurrent computation. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 循环语言模型 (LoopLM) 在不同循环深度可独立读出，安全对齐只在一个深度上成立并不迁移到其他深度：越深的推理深度攻击成功率反而上升，同一查询在不同深度表现不同安全行为，针对某一深度构造的攻击可转移到其他深度。作者提出 SafeBridge，用深度特定的轻量控制、选择性状态桥接与跨循环深度的联合安全监督，在多个模型规模、攻击方法和安全基准上同时压低同深度与跨深度攻击成功率。
Motivation: LoopLM 共享参数在循环步上复用，每个循环深度都可独立读出，输出空间比单深度模型更宽；既有评测只提示更深循环或能改善有害查询上的安全，但越狱攻击下的跨深度鲁棒性不清楚。
Method: SafeBridge 结合三项：对共享循环层做深度特定的轻量控制 (depth specific control)、选择性状态桥接 (selective state bridging)、以及跨循环深度的联合安全监督 (joint safety supervision)；评测覆盖多个模型规模、多种攻击方法与多个安全基准，并区分同深度 (matched-depth) 与跨深度 (cross-depth) 攻击。
Result: 评测发现攻击成功率随推理深度加深而上升，同一查询在不同深度触发不同安全行为，针对单一深度的攻击可迁移到其他深度；SFT 与偏好对齐无法消除这些安全缺口。SafeBridge 在跨模型规模、多攻击方法、多安全基准上大幅降低同深度与跨深度攻击成功率，同时相对原始模型提升通用效用，过度拒答 (over-refusal) 保持相当水平。
Conclusion: LoopLM 的安全性不能由单一循环深度推断，安全对齐必须覆盖整个循环计算过程；代码与模型检查点将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: SAVU-BENCH: A Real-World Benchmark for Spatial Audio-Visual Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Spatial audio-visual understanding requires models to recognize not only what is present, but also where events occur and how they relate across modalities. Existing benchmarks often rely on simulated scenes, evaluate isolated spatial skills, and provide limited diagnostic insight into failure modes. We introduce SAVU-Bench, a real-world benchmark that systematically evaluates spatial audio-visual understanding across three capability levels and seven evaluation tasks. We further introduce SAVU-Diag, a scene-linked diagnostic set that decomposes reasoning questions into their prerequisite grounding and alignment sub-tasks. Evaluation of 12 representative models on SAVU-Bench reveals that while visual spatial grounding is relatively mature, spatial perception involving audio remains a primary bottleneck. SAVU-Diag further demonstrates that most reasoning errors co-occur with failures on these prerequisite tasks, though reasoning gaps persist even when prerequisites are correctly resolved. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SAVU-EA, a training-free evidence-augmented baseline that makes spatial cues more explicit. While SAVU-EA substantially improves spatial grounding and joint matching, high-level spatial reasoning remains challenging. Our findings highlight the urgent need for both robust spatial audio perception and deeper integration of cross-modal spatial relations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAVU-BENCH 是真实场景的空间音视频理解基准，按三个能力层级、七个任务系统评测，并配 SAVU-Diag 把推理题拆成前置的 grounding 与 alignment 子任务。对 12 个代表性模型的评测显示视觉空间定位已相对成熟，涉及音频的空间感知是主要瓶颈；免训练的 SAVU-EA 能明显改善空间定位与联合匹配，但高层空间推理仍然困难。
Motivation: 现有空间音视频基准多依赖仿真场景、只测孤立的空间技能，对失败模式的诊断信息有限，难以定位模型究竟卡在感知、对齐还是推理环节。
Method: 构建真实世界基准 SAVU-Bench（三个能力层级、七个评测任务），配套场景关联的诊断集 SAVU-Diag，将推理问题分解为前置的 grounding 与 alignment 子任务；另提出免训练的证据增强基线 SAVU-EA，使空间线索显式化。
Result: 在 SAVU-BENCH 上评测 12 个代表性模型：视觉空间定位相对成熟，涉及音频的空间感知是主要瓶颈；SAVU-Diag 显示多数推理错误与前置任务失败同时出现，但前置任务答对时推理差距仍存在；SAVU-EA 显著改善空间 grounding 与联合匹配，高层空间推理依旧困难。
Conclusion: 空间音视频推理的瓶颈首先在鲁棒的空间音频感知，其次在跨模态空间关系的整合；仅显式化空间线索不足以解决高层推理缺口。

papers.title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) offer a parameter efficient approach to scaling reasoning by reusing shared parameters across recurrent computation steps. Despite their promise, effective post-training of LoopLMs remains challenging. Existing approaches either provide reward based supervision that is sparse or costly to extend across loops, or rely on external teachers or privileged information, leading to limited teacher availability or teacher-student context mismatch. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopOPD, a cross-loop on-policy distillation framework that uses additional recurrent computation within a LoopLM as its own source of supervision. LoopOPD uses a frozen terminal loop policy as a compute privileged teacher for an intermediate loop student on student generated rollouts, providing dense supervision without an external teacher or privileged information. We further propose Dynamic LoopOPD (D-LoopOPD), which continually refreshes the terminal loop teacher as the shared model parameters are updated, enabling recurrent self-improvement. We characterize how distillation updates propagate across loop depths and derive sufficient conditions under which a single update yields simultaneous local improvement at both loop depths. Experiments on Ouro-Thinking models show that LoopOPD improves mathematical reasoning, while D-LoopOPD yields further gains through dynamic teacher updates. Despite being trained only on mathematical data, the resulting models also improve on general reasoning and code generation benchmarks, demonstrating that recurrent computation can serve as an effective source of supervision for LoopLMs. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopOPD 把循环语言模型 (LoopLM) 自己的末端循环策略当作教师，在学生自己生成的 rollout 上对中间循环做 on-policy 蒸馏，从而在不引入外部教师或特权信息的前提下获得稠密监督；D-LoopOPD 随共享参数更新持续刷新末端教师，实现递归自提升。在 Ouro-Thinking 模型上，LoopOPD 提升数学推理，D-LoopOPD 借动态教师更新取得进一步增益，且只用数学数据训练也能改善通用推理与代码生成基准。
Motivation: LoopLM 用共享参数跨循环复用来扩展推理，但后训练困难：奖励监督在各循环上稀疏且扩展成本高，依赖外部教师或特权信息则带来教师可得性有限与师生上下文不匹配。
Method: LoopOPD 以冻结的末端循环策略作为 compute-privileged teacher，对中间循环 student 在其自生成 rollout 上做 cross-loop on-policy 蒸馏；D-LoopOPD 在共享参数更新时持续刷新末端循环教师。作者刻画蒸馏更新如何跨循环深度传播，并推导出单次更新同时使两个循环深度局部改进的充分条件。
Result: 在 Ouro-Thinking 模型上，LoopOPD 改善数学推理，D-LoopOPD 通过动态教师更新取得进一步增益；仅在数学数据上训练，模型仍在通用推理与代码生成基准上提升。摘要给出的是定性改进方向，未附具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 循环内的递归计算本身可以充当有效监督源：无需外部教师或特权信息即可后训练 LoopLM，且动态刷新教师能让模型持续自提升，跨循环深度的充分条件给出了单次更新同时改进两层的理论依据。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: LoopOPD 把循环语言模型 (LoopLM) 自己的末端循环策略当作教师，在学生自己生成的 rollout 上对中间循环做 on-policy 蒸馏，从而在不引入外部教师或特权信息的前提下获得稠密监督；D-LoopOPD 随共享参数更新持续刷新末端教师，实现递归自提升。在 Ouro-Thinking 模型上，LoopOPD 提升数学推理，D-LoopOPD 借动态教师更新取得进一步增益，且只用数学数据训练也能改善通用推理与代码生成基准。

papers.title: WorldBench: Evaluating LLMs on Three.js Voxel World Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can now write complete, interactive 3D worlds as code, but grading those worlds automatically is unreliable. Existing judges take one view of the output: a vision-language model scores a few rendered snapshots, or a language model reads the source. On worlds written by five frontier models we find that the two views disagree on 32% of required items, mostly code that no frame shows, and that fixed views miss small close-up contents. We present WorldBench, a benchmark and judge for open-ended, LLM-generated Three.js worlds. From one prompt describing a floating voxel island with ten biomes, physics, and day/night and seasonal cycles, the judge explores the running world, controlling its clock, orbiting it, and sending a navigator agent to frame each biome, and reads the code for what it sees. Neither channel is trusted on its own: a code quote counts only if it is text the source contains, and visual claims are checked against measured pixels where the property is measurable. A mutation test, in which we remove features by construction, shows that code-only judging gives full credit to four of five removed features, because their code remains in the file. Our judge cuts the points kept on removed features by a third (5.44 to 3.55 of 7.11), and what it still credits is mostly code that exists but never runs. We evaluate five frontier models: Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, Kimi K3, Grok 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Code, prompt, tests and judge configuration are available at https://github.com/KrishBakshi/worldbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldBench 是评测 LLM 生成 Three.js 体素世界的基准与判定器：让判定器在运行中的世界里控制时钟、环绕视角、派导航 agent 逐个取景每个生物群系，并对照源码与实测像素交叉验证。在五个前沿模型的世界上，纯代码判定会给五个被构造性移除的特性中的四个打满分，而该判定器把被移除特性上保留的分数砍掉三分之一（7.11 分中从 5.44 降到 3.55）。
Motivation: LLM 已能写出完整可交互的 3D 世界代码，但自动评分不可靠：现有判定器只看单一通道——视觉语言模型给几张渲染快照打分，或语言模型读源码。作者在五个前沿模型的世界上发现两种视角对 32% 的必需条目判断不一致，多为任何画面都拍不到的代码，且固定视角会漏掉小的近景内容。
Method: WorldBench 的判定器探索运行中的世界：控制其时钟、环绕视角，并派导航 agent 为每个 biome 取景，同时读取它所见内容对应的源码。两个通道都不单独采信：代码引用必须是源码中真实存在的文本，视觉断言在属性可测量时用实测像素核验。评测提示词描述一个含十个 biome、物理、昼夜与季节循环的漂浮体素岛。
Result: 五个前沿模型（Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra、Kimi K3、Grok 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro）上，纯代码判定给五个被构造性移除的特性中的四个打满分，因为其代码仍留在文件里；该判定器把被移除特性上保留的分数从 7.11 分中的 5.44 降到 3.55，砍掉约三分之一，且它仍给分的部分多为存在但从未运行的代码。两种现有视角在 32% 的必需条目上不一致。
Conclusion: 代码与视觉两个通道都不能单独作为 LLM 生成世界的判定依据，交叉核验（源码文本 + 实测像素）能显著减少对已移除特性的虚高评分；判定器仍会把分数给到存在但不执行的代码。代码、提示词、测试与判定器配置已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Self-Organization from Constrained Geometric Radiation
papers.abstract_en: How does dynamic order emerge spontaneously in closed systems without external driving? Existing paradigms all require external energy flows, temperature quenching, or slow driving. Here we report constraint-induced self-organization via geometric radiation in coupled metric evolution systems. Simulations reveal a universal four-stage cycle: stress accumulation, super-exponential radiation, chaotic collapse, and convergence to a fractal limit cycle, a novel attractor topology we term the wedge-shaped attractor, with five quantized curvature states and fractal micro-fluctuations. We identify four jointly sufficient conditions: an irreversible geometric horizon, persistent stress injection from quantum coherence, endogenous geometric tension between incompatible curvatures, and effective fluctuations. Their synergy triggers a critical avalanche at the horizon boundary. We prove three theorems: the Geometric Horizon Theorem, the Geometric Energy Dissipation Theorem (implying wave-like entropy evolution in closed systems), and the Radiation as Phase Transition Channel Theorem. We further establish the Constraint-Induced Self-Organization Theorem: these conditions guarantee the complete cycle with probability one. Systematic scans reveal a critical noise threshold and power-law scaling of radiation onset. We verify universality across 12 configurations, multiple noise types, and three geometric flows. This work establishes a new paradigm for closed-system self-organization, forging an exact mathematical duality between classical nonlinear constraints and gravitational horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在耦合度量演化系统中，仅靠内部约束即可产生自组织：不可逆几何视界、量子相干持续注入应力、不相容曲率间的内禀几何张力与有效涨落四条件联合，触发视界边界的临界雪崩。模拟给出四阶段循环（应力累积、超指数辐射、混沌坍缩、收敛到分形极限环），并发现临界噪声阈值与辐射起始的幂律标度。
Motivation: 封闭系统中动态有序的既有范式都依赖外部能量流、温度淬火或慢驱动；作者要问无外部驱动时有序能否自发产生。
Method: 在耦合度量演化 (coupled metric evolution) 系统中做数值模拟与定理证明：识别四个联合充分条件，扫描噪声类型与几何流，验证跨 12 种配置、多种噪声类型与三种几何流的普适性。
Result: 模拟揭示普适四阶段循环，收敛到被称为楔形吸引子 (wedge-shaped attractor) 的新吸引子拓扑，含五个量子化曲率态与分形微涨落；系统扫描给出临界噪声阈值与辐射起始的幂律标度；在 12 种配置、多种噪声类型、三种几何流上验证普适性。证明三个定理（Geometric Horizon Theorem、Geometric Energy Dissipation Theorem、Radiation as Phase Transition Channel Theorem）及 Constraint-Induced Self-Organization 定理（四条件以概率 1 保证完整循环）。
Conclusion: 封闭系统的自组织可由经典非线性约束与引力视界之间的精确数学对偶产生，构成一个不需外部驱动的新范式。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: When AI Finds Hidden Messages, Does It Report?
papers.abstract_en: When an assistant encounters a message for another AI, does it tell its user? Four fixed model-provider deployments perform simulated source tasks in 1,280 ordinary-note and 128 enhanced-note sessions. Harmless and harmful messages have matched plaintext and ROT13 versions, with no-message controls. Observers receive no decoder or decoded meaning; a requested reference code incentivizes inspection. Asking for reports increases rule-detected notifications identifying another AI as recipient by 53.1 percentage points for harmless ROT13 messages and 54.7 for harmful ones. This is a joint inspection, recognition, and notification effect; missing-response bounds are 38.3--77.3 and 36.7--78.1 points. Model-based trace checks identify eleven ordinary plaintext cases where agents interpret the message but do not notify their user. Seven encoded omissions are verified with enhanced notes; ordinary encoded omissions remain unverified. Seven simulated filename disclosures coexist with accurate review-status answers, and two answers use a planted false count. Interpretation, notification, and authorized task performance are distinct outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在四个固定模型-供应商部署上做模拟源任务实验，向助手发送给另一个 AI 的消息时，明确要求汇报会把「识别收件方为另一 AI」的规则检出通知率抬高 53.1 个百分点（无害 ROT13 消息）与 54.7 个百分点（有害消息）。观察者既拿不到解码器也拿不到含义，仅靠请求的参考码激励检查；模型化轨迹检查发现 11 例普通明文消息被理解却不通知用户。
Motivation: AI 助手遇到写给另一个 AI 的隐藏消息时是否向用户汇报，缺少受控测量：理解、通知与授权任务执行可能彼此脱节，而通知行为可被提问方式直接改变。
Method: 四个固定模型-供应商部署执行模拟源任务，共 1,280 个普通笔记会话与 128 个增强笔记会话；无害与有害消息各配明文与 ROT13 版本并设无消息对照；观察者不提供解码器或含义，仅用请求的参考码激励检查；用规则检出通知、缺失响应界限与模型化轨迹检查三种口径。
Result: 要求汇报使规则检出的「收件方为另一 AI」通知率提升 53.1 个百分点（无害 ROT13）与 54.7 个百分点（有害 ROT13），缺失响应界限分别为 38.3–77.3 与 36.7–78.1 个百分点；轨迹检查定位 11 例普通明文消息被理解但不通知；增强笔记核实 7 例编码遗漏，普通编码遗漏仍未核实；7 例模拟文件名披露与准确的审查状态回答并存，其中 2 例回答使用了植入的虚假计数。
Conclusion: 解释、通知与授权任务执行是三个可分离的结果，要求汇报能显著提高通知率，但理解不等于告知用户。

papers.title: TestJack: Should you trust the results in coding benchmarks? Agentic Coding Benchmarks Auditing via Evaluator Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly reshaping software engineering, accompanied by an explosion of new code benchmarks. Yet nearly all existing benchmarks still rely on the same decades-old criterion: a solution is correct if it passes a fixed set of unit tests. Such tests are often insufficient: they check only part of what the task requires, so agents can reward hack them or silently miss required behavior while still passing every test. As a result, higher benchmark scores may partly reflect better adaptation to the evaluator rather than better problem solving. Existing works focus on static test augmentation: they strengthen each task's tests once, before any trial is seen, and thus overlook how real trials actually fail. We introduce TestJack, a scalable framework for evaluating patches beyond fixed tests. For each trial, TestJack generates tests targeting prompt requirements the patch may violate, retains only tests passed by the ground-truth patch, and re-examines any trial failures. Each confirmed failure is thus supported by a replayable test. To reduce evaluation cost, we also introduce a lightweight variant which audits a random sample of trials in depth and reuses the resulting tests across all trials for the same task. Across 6 frontier model backends and 5 benchmarks such as DeepSWE and SWE Marathon, we find that about 34.4% of the model trials currently judged correct violate the task requirements, lowering the overall resolution rate from 50.6% to 33.2%. Our results reveal a fundamental limitation of current coding-agent evaluation: as LLMs become better at optimizing against fixed evaluators, those evaluators themselves must become more adaptive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TestJack 针对固定单元测试可被 reward hack 的问题，按每个 trial 的补丁动态生成针对 prompt 要求的测试，只保留 ground-truth 补丁能通过的测试并复核失败，每个确认失败都对应可重放的测试。在 6 个前沿模型后端与 DeepSWE、SWE Marathon 等 5 个基准上，约 34.4% 被判正确的 trial 实际违反任务要求，整体 resolution rate 从 50.6% 降到 33.2%。
Motivation: 代码基准几乎都用固定单元测试判对错，测试只覆盖任务要求的一部分，agent 可以 reward hack 或漏掉必需行为仍全过，高分可能反映的是对评估器的适应而非解题能力。
Method: 对每个 trial 生成针对补丁可能违反的 prompt 要求的测试，只保留 ground-truth 补丁通过的测试，再复核 trial 的失败，使每个确认失败都有可重放测试支撑；另有一个轻量变体，只深入审计随机抽样的 trial 并把得到的测试复用到同任务全部 trial 以降低评估成本。
Result: 在 6 个前沿模型后端、5 个基准（含 DeepSWE 与 SWE Marathon）上，约 34.4% 当前被判正确的模型 trial 违反任务要求，整体 resolution rate 由 50.6% 降至 33.2%。
Conclusion: 当前 coding-agent 评估存在根本缺陷：LLM 越擅长针对固定评估器优化，评估器本身就必须越自适应。

summary_sections.method: 对每个 trial 生成针对补丁可能违反的 prompt 要求的测试，只保留 ground-truth 补丁通过的测试，再复核 trial 的失败，使每个确认失败都有可重放测试支撑；另有一个轻量变体，只深入审计随机抽样的 trial 并把得到的测试复用到同任务全部 trial 以降低评估成本。
summary_sections.result: 在 6 个前沿模型后端、5 个基准（含 DeepSWE 与 SWE Marathon）上，约 34.4% 当前被判正确的模型 trial 违反任务要求，整体 resolution rate 由 50.6% 降至 33.2%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前 coding-agent 评估存在根本缺陷：LLM 越擅长针对固定评估器优化，评估器本身就必须越自适应。

papers.title: MRCert: Towards Post-deployment Patch Robustness Certification for Adversarially Patched Samples via Type-specific Masking
papers.abstract_en: In post-deployment time, inputs to deep learning models may or may not be adversarially patched. Patch robustness certification on such inputs within a patch bound can verify their label benignity and should retain high prediction accuracy. However, existing smoothing-based and masking-based recovery defenders cannot achieve both simultaneously: they degrade the prediction accuracy much and cannot verify the benignity of the returned label of an adversarially patched input, respectively. We propose MRCert, the first masking-based certified recovery defender that shows the feasibility of achieving both. Unlike all existing works to apply a common condition across both types of input (benign and adversarially patched samples) for certification, MRCert infers type-specific necessary properties of deep learning models for both types in post-deployment time and formally relates them to verify the label benignity through a novel type-oriented design of label recovery and certification function pair. Without incurring the degradation in clean accuracy caused by smoothing, experimental results confirm that MRCert achieves 35.1\% adversarial certified accuracy on ImageNet at patch size 16 pixels, whereas the SOTA PatchCURE fails completely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MRCert 是首个基于掩码的 certified recovery 防御器，为良性输入与对抗补丁输入分别推断类型特定的模型必要性质，并通过标签恢复与认证函数对验证返回标签的良性。在不引入 smoothing 式干净精度损失的前提下，ImageNet 上补丁 16 像素时对抗认证准确率达 35.1%，而 SOTA PatchCURE 完全失败。
Motivation: 部署后输入可能带也可能不带对抗补丁，现有 smoothing 类与 masking 类恢复防御器无法同时做到高预测精度与对抗补丁输入标签良性验证：前者大幅拉低精度，后者无法验证良性。
Method: MRCert 对良性与对抗补丁两类输入分别推断深度模型的类型特定必要性质，设计类型导向的标签恢复与认证函数对 (label recovery and certification function pair) 来形式化验证标签良性，属于 masking-based certified recovery 防御，且不使用 smoothing。
Result: 实验确认：ImageNet 上补丁尺寸 16 像素时对抗认证准确率 (adversarial certified accuracy) 35.1%，SOTA 基线 PatchCURE 完全失败；同时不产生 smoothing 造成的干净精度下降。
Conclusion: 对两类输入施加统一认证条件并非必要，按输入类型分别建模性质即可同时保住干净精度与对抗补丁标签良性验证。

papers.title: When Routing Reveals Membership: Privacy Leakage from MoE Router Telemetry
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models produce routing information during inference that may be logged or exposed for monitoring, debugging, load analysis, and safety auditing. Unlike ordinary model outputs, this telemetry reveals a view of the model's internal computation, raising a privacy question: can it reveal whether an example was used to fine-tune the deployed model? We introduce a router-augmented membership inference attack that combines conventional output-side signals with aggregated routing features and applies a membership classifier learned from independently fine-tuned shadow models to the target model. Across three MoE architectures and three data domains, router telemetry consistently improves membership inference over a strong output-signal ensemble, increasing TPR at 1\% FPR by 2.7--9.4 percentage points across all nine settings. The leakage persists across full fine-tuning, frozen-router training, LoRA, and instruction tuning, and remains observable with only discrete expert selections, restricted telemetry, or a single shadow model. Mechanistic analysis further shows that the leakage does not require router-specific memorization: fine-tuning introduces membership information into hidden representations, while the router exposes a projection of this signal even when its parameters are frozen. Perturbing the telemetry reduces this additional leakage only as its fidelity degrades. Our results show that router telemetry can turn an operational signal into an additional privacy surface for fine-tuned MoE models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoE 路由遥测本身构成新的隐私面：路由器增强的成员推断攻击把输出侧信号与聚合路由特征拼接，用独立微调的 shadow model 训练成员分类器，在三个 MoE 架构、三个数据域的全部九个设置上把 TPR@1%FPR 相对强输出信号集成提高 2.7–9.4 个百分点。泄漏在全量微调、冻结路由器、LoRA、指令微调下都存在，且只需离散专家选择或单个 shadow model 也能观测到。
Motivation: MoE 推理时的路由信息常被记录用于监控、调试、负载分析与安全审计，它暴露模型内部计算视图；问题是这类遥测能否泄露某条样本是否参与了部署模型的微调，而现有成员推断只看输出侧信号。
Method: 提出 router-augmented membership inference attack：在常规输出侧信号之上加入聚合路由特征，用独立微调得到的 shadow models 训练成员分类器，再作用于目标模型；并做机理分析区分路由特异记忆与隐藏表示中的成员信息，以及扰动遥测的消融。
Result: 在三个 MoE 架构 × 三个数据域共九个设置上，TPR@1%FPR 相对强输出信号集成提升 2.7–9.4 个百分点，且九个设置全部为正。泄漏在 full fine-tuning、frozen-router training、LoRA、instruction tuning 下均持续；仅离散专家选择、受限遥测或单个 shadow model 时仍可观测。机理分析显示微调把成员信息写入 hidden representations，路由器即使参数冻结也暴露该信号的投影；扰动遥测只有在其保真度下降时才减少这部分额外泄漏。
Conclusion: 路由遥测会把一个运维信号变成微调 MoE 模型的额外隐私面，且泄漏不依赖路由器特异记忆，因此冻结路由器或裁剪遥测并不能消除它。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: JevForest: Path Voting for Budgeted Feature Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Choosing which information to observe is central to prediction under limited observation budgets. We study JevForest, a feature acquisition policy that aggregates path-dependent proposals from bootstrapped trees, weights them by global training information gain, and predicts from the acquired values with a shared masked classifier. An online implementation queries Jev for semantic answers selected by this policy. On small balanced held-out samples, four-question forest acquisition achieves accuracy $0.729$ on AG News ($n=48$), compared with $0.667$ for a static gain ranking and $0.583$ for random ordering. On TREC ($n=24$), the ordering reverses: forest accuracy is $0.667$, compared with $0.750$ and $0.833$. Asking all eight questions in one batch yields higher accuracy at lower measured cost and latency than four sequential forest queries; direct Jev classification matches the batch accuracy while costing less. Offline MiniBooNE experiments yield accuracy $0.845\pm0.010$ at ten features and $0.885\pm0.008$ at forty features over three jointly varying data and forest seeds (mean $\pm$ sample standard deviation). A companion Newton boosting implementation provides preliminary full-feature synthetic results. These exploratory findings establish a working Jev acquisition workflow but do not support a general advantage for path voting: its value depends on the task, predictor, and the distinction between question budgets and actual query costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JevForest 是一种预算受限的特征获取策略：聚合自助采样树的路径相关提议，按全局训练信息增益加权，再用共享 masked classifier 从已获取特征预测。在 AG News (n=48) 上四问森林获取准确率 0.729，高于静态增益排序 0.667 与随机排序 0.583；但在 TREC (n=24) 上顺序反转，森林 0.667 反而低于 0.750 与 0.833。作者结论是 path voting 不构成普遍优势，其价值取决于任务、预测器以及问题预算与实际查询成本的区分。
Motivation: 在观测预算受限下决定观察哪些信息是预测的核心问题，但基于树路径投票的获取策略是否稳定优于静态增益排序或随机顺序并不清楚。
Method: JevForest 聚合 bootstrapped trees 的 path-dependent proposals，用全局训练信息增益 (global training information gain) 加权，并用共享 masked classifier 从已获取特征预测；在线实现向 Jev 查询该策略选出的语义问题，离线在 MiniBooNE 上做特征获取实验，另有 Newton boosting 伴随实现。
Result: AG News (n=48) 四问森林获取准确率 0.729，静态增益排序 0.667，随机排序 0.583；TREC (n=24) 反转为森林 0.667、0.750、0.833。一次批量问满八题比四次顺序森林查询准确率更高且实测成本与延迟更低；直接 Jev 分类达到批量准确率且成本更低。MiniBooNE 离线实验在十个特征上准确率 0.845±0.010，四十特征上 0.885±0.008（三个同时变化的数据与森林种子，mean ± sample standard deviation）。
Conclusion: 这些探索性结果建立了一个可用的 Jev 获取工作流，但不支持 path voting 的普遍优势：其价值取决于任务、预测器，以及问题预算与真实查询成本的区分。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Temporal transformer CAN encoder with federated lightweight heads for anomaly detection
papers.abstract_en: Modern vehicles rely on large numbers of Electronic Control Units (ECUs) that constantly exchange information over the Controller Area Network (CAN) bus. Due to the rapidity, structure, and repetition of this communication, even slight variations in timing, payload values, or message patterns can point to unusual activity. Whether due to errors, malfunctions, or deliberate interference, these anomalies are frequently subtle and challenging to identify with conventional methods that handle messages separately or rely on manually created rules. Motivated by this gap, we present a privacy-preserving framework for anomaly detection in in-vehicle networks, based on a Temporal Transformer CAN Encoder with Federated Lightweight Heads, to better capture these irregularities. The detection of subtle temporal and contextual anomalies is made possible by a lightweight Transformer encoder that learns how these signals evolve over time, while a federated learning mechanism enables several vehicles or ECUs to work together to improve a shared model without exchanging raw CAN data. This combination of federated learning and temporal sequence modeling provides robust anomaly detection performance while maintaining efficiency and privacy, according to experiments conducted on open-source datasets.
papers.journal_ref: Presented at ITS European Congress 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向车载 CAN 总线异常检测，提出 Temporal Transformer CAN Encoder + 联邦轻量头：轻量 Transformer 编码器学习时序、载荷与消息模式的演化，联邦学习让多车/多 ECU 共训共享模型而不交换原始 CAN 数据。作者称在开源数据集上的实验显示其能捕捉细微时序与上下文异常，同时保持效率与隐私。
Motivation: 车载 ECU 间 CAN 通信快、结构化且高度重复，时序、载荷或消息模式的细微偏移即可指示异常；逐条处理消息或依赖人工规则的传统方法难以识别这类细微异常。
Method: Temporal Transformer CAN Encoder with Federated Lightweight Heads：轻量 Transformer 编码器对 CAN 消息序列建模时序演化，联邦学习机制聚合多车辆/ECU 的轻量检测头以更新共享模型，原始 CAN 数据不出本地。
Result: 在开源数据集上进行实验，定性结果为可检测细微的时序与上下文异常，并在保持效率与隐私的同时提供稳健的异常检测性能。
Conclusion: 时序序列建模与联邦学习结合可在不共享原始 CAN 数据的前提下做车内网络异常检测，兼顾隐私与检测稳健性。

papers.title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems can improve by searching longer, receiving additional support, or modifying how they propose and verify outputs. A performance score does not distinguish these mechanisms. We compare these changes through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness. A stage specifies admissible transcripts, polynomial bounds, an alternating verification protocol, and a terminal checker. Its native reach uses default support; its closure frontier permits all support already admitted by the interface. Under a uniform pointwise probability gap and task-relative soundness, these are well-defined languages. We prove that independent majority amplification preserves both languages, whereas existential acceptance over random tapes can admit incorrect outputs. Exact verification is the zero-randomness case, with placement and completeness results. The randomized-verifier classes satisfy $Σ_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteqΣ_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteqΣ_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$; strict enlargement and depth separation require explicit complexity assumptions, while $\mathrm{BPP}=\mathrm{P}$ yields exact companions with the same frontiers. Representation analysis separates invariant acceptance from core-versus-support labels that can change under refactoring. For recursive self-improvement, uniformly bounded self-modification under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol remains within the same verification class. A separate conditional-error budget controls false selection across adaptively chosen candidates. A quota-enforced XOR-synthesis family separates unbounded ratios of search success from changes in the accepted languages; exact and probabilistic audits check the resulting evidence requirements. The framework ties self-improvement claims to obligations on correctness, admissible evidence, verification resources, and selection error.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 5 figures. Includes proofs and reproducibility artifacts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文把 Agentic AI 的性能提升拆成搜索更久、获得额外支持、修改提议与验证方式三种机制，用带隐藏终端随机性的有界验证框架比较它们。证明独立多数放大 (majority amplification) 同时保持原生可达语言与闭包前沿，而对随机带的存在性接受 (existential acceptance) 会引入错误输出；在共同可靠解释器与固定验证协议下的有界自修改仍停留在同一验证类内。
Motivation: 单一性能分数无法区分提升来自搜索、支持还是验证方式的改变，递归自我改进 (RSI) 的声明也缺少关于正确性、可采证据与选择错误的可判定义务。
Method: 每个 stage 规定可容许 transcript、多项式界、交替验证协议与终端 checker，区分原生可达 (native reach) 与闭包前沿 (closure frontier)；在统一逐点概率差与任务相对可靠性下定义语言，用配额强制的 XOR-synthesis 族分离搜索成功率与被接受语言的变化，并给出精确与概率审计。
Result: 证明独立多数放大保持两类语言，而存在性接受可接受错误输出；随机验证器类满足 Σ_k^P ⊆ Σ_k^RV ⊆ Σ_{k+1}^P，严格放大与深度分离需显式复杂性假设，BPP=P 给出同前沿的精确对应类；精确验证是零随机性特例并有位置与完备性结果；条件错误预算控制跨自适应候选的错误选择。
Conclusion: 自我改进的声明必须绑定到正确性、可采证据、验证资源与选择错误这四项义务上，且在固定验证协议下的有界自修改不会越出原有验证类。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Code Understanding is a Bottleneck for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Repository benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench) for coding agents often assume that lines of code edited can predict task difficulty, but such datasets' poor control over code and task types makes it hard to know which abilities truly drive agent errors. We present CABRA: a Coding Ability Blueprint for Rigorous Agent evaluation. CABRA builds tasks from scratch as call graph transformations and scales difficulty via a task size parameter on four axes: function traversal, search, runtime resolution, and instruction following. We run eight LLMs and six coding agents on 6,840 CABRA tasks to show: 1) LLM accuracy falls as task size~grows, but agents stay near-perfect by offloading work to tools (e.g., grep); 2) Larger CABRA tasks elicit more tool calls for reading and analysis, while a separate study on SWE-bench Verified shows these tool call counts predict agents' accuracy better than lines of code edited, suggesting task difficulty for agents can lie in understanding code to edit, not just in making edits; 3) Extending CABRA to an intense understanding task where models analyze divergent logic across two classes backs this finding, as agent accuracy finally falls. More broadly, we argue for synthetic evaluations like CABRA to unmask LLM weaknesses trivialized by tools (e.g., needle-in-a-haystack) and abilities beyond just editing (e.g., understanding) that coding agents still find difficult, pairing SWE-bench-style tasks with controlled diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CABRA 从零合成代码理解任务，用任务规模参数在函数遍历、搜索、运行时解析、指令遵循四个轴上控制难度，发现 LLM 裸准确率随任务变大下降，但 coding agent 靠 grep 等工具仍接近满分；在 SWE-bench Verified 上工具调用次数比编辑行数更能预测 agent 准确率，而要求跨两个类分析分歧逻辑的强理解任务终于让 agent 准确率下降。
Motivation: SWE-bench 类仓库基准用编辑行数近似任务难度，却无法控制代码与任务类型，因而分不清究竟是哪种能力驱动 agent 出错。
Method: CABRA 把任务从零构造成 call graph 变换，用一个任务规模参数沿 function traversal、search、runtime resolution、instruction following 四轴放大难度；在 6,840 个 CABRA 任务上跑八个 LLM 与六个 coding agent，并另做 SWE-bench Verified 上工具调用与编辑行数的对比研究，再扩展出一个跨两个类分析分歧逻辑的强理解任务。
Result: 6,840 个 CABRA 任务、8 个 LLM、6 个 agent：LLM 准确率随任务规模增长而下降，agent 借助工具仍接近满分；更大的 CABRA 任务引发更多读取与分析类工具调用；SWE-bench Verified 上工具调用次数对 agent 准确率的预测力强于编辑行数；强理解任务中 agent 准确率终于下降。
Conclusion: 对 agent 而言难度在于理解待编辑的代码而不只是做出编辑，合成受控评估能暴露被工具平凡化的能力短板，应把 SWE-bench 式任务与受控诊断配对使用。

papers.title: From Investigation Failures to Reliable SOC Agents: Understanding and Improving LLM-Based Alert Triage
papers.abstract_en: Security operations centers (SOCs) must triage large volumes of alerts, most of which are benign, while missed attacks can remain uninvestigated. Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve evidence during triage, but it remains unclear how reasoning strategies determine what to gather and when an investigation is sufficient to close an alert. We study five representative approaches spanning single-pass tool use, iterative retrieval, sampled investigations, self-review, and explicit verification. To support this study, we build ALERT-BENCH, an interactive benchmark that replays enterprise telemetry through a live SIEM and requires each system to retrieve evidence. Across 1,247 alerts from a multi-stage attack scenario, every approach missed at least 40.4% of attack-related alerts. Trace analysis shows that attack alerts are more likely to be dismissed when searches return no records, same-context review has negative net correction, and dismissal receives no consistently stronger investigation than escalation. Based on these findings, we further design AIDA (Adversarial Investigation and Dialectical Analysis), a multi-agent framework that requires an explicit proposed decision before independent challenge and stronger evidentiary requirements before dismissal. AIDA preserves investigation history in an append-only Investigation Ledger and keeps the challenge in a separate reasoning context. A separate Judge adjudicates the proposed decision and challenge against evidence, resolving the alert or requesting another round when evidence is missing. On the same alerts, AIDA achieves an F1 score of 0.958, compared with 0.371-0.744 for the studied approaches, and reduces the false-negative rate from 40.4% to 3.1% while escalating 18.4% of alerts to analysts. These results show that structuring evidence retrieval and decision review can substantially improve agentic SOC triage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SOC 告警分诊中 LLM agent 调查不足导致漏掉攻击，提出多智能体框架 AIDA：先给出明确决策，再由独立上下文质疑，并对“关闭告警”施加更高证据门槛，配合 append-only Investigation Ledger 与独立 Judge 裁决。在 ALERT-BENCH 的 1,247 条告警上，五种既有推理策略各漏掉至少 40.4% 的攻击相关告警，AIDA 把 F1 提到 0.958（既有方法 0.371–0.744），假阴性率降到 3.1%，同时仅 18.4% 告警上报分析师。
Motivation: SOC 大量告警为良性，漏掉的攻击可能长期无人调查；工具型 LLM agent 何时算“调查充分”并可以关闭告警，此前不清楚。
Method: 先建 ALERT-BENCH：通过 live SIEM 回放企业遥测，强制各系统检索证据，覆盖单次工具调用、迭代检索、采样调查、自审、显式验证五类推理策略。再提出 AIDA 多智能体框架：决策须先显式提出，独立上下文发起 challenge，关闭告警需更强证据，append-only Investigation Ledger 保留调查历史，独立 Judge 依据证据裁决或要求再调查一轮。
Result: 在 1,247 条多阶段攻击场景告警上，五种既有策略各漏掉至少 40.4% 的攻击相关告警；trace 分析显示检索无记录时攻击告警更易被驳回、同上下文复审的净修正为负、驳回与上报的调查强度无一致差异。AIDA 在同一批告警上 F1 达 0.958（既有方法 0.371–0.744），假阴性率从 40.4% 降到 3.1%，上报分析师的告警占 18.4%。
Conclusion: 把证据检索与决策复审显式结构化（先决策后独立质疑、关闭告警设更高证据门槛、裁决与质疑分离）能大幅降低 agentic SOC 分诊的漏报。

papers.title: A Camera-Native Stereo VR180 Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Immersive VR180 video is increasingly produced with professional stereo fisheye cameras, yet public VR180 research resources are mostly collected from online platforms such as YouTube: already stitched, projected and compressed by unknown pipelines, and without lens calibration. We present a firsthand-captured stereo VR180 dataset recorded with two Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive cameras. It contains 1,211 samples -- 636 stereo video clips (2,220.8 s, mostly 90 fps) and 575 stereo stills -- each released as camera-native Blackmagic RAW, separate-eye native fisheye HEVC (8160x7200 per eye) and half-equirectangular HEVC (7200x7200 per eye), together with the factory lens calibration, portable fisheye/half-equirectangular conversion tools and AI-generated scene and visual-challenge annotations. Re-encoding the released fisheye and half-equirectangular renders with x265 over 24 clips, both eyes, four rate points and nine viewing directions, native-fisheye coding needed more bitrate than half-equirectangular coding at equal viewport quality for all 24 clips (median +38%), in every part of the field of view. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lulinxuan/VR180 ; code: https://github.com/lulinxuan/vr180-dataset-tools
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个用两台 Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive 实拍的相机原生立体 VR180 数据集，1,211 个样本以 Blackmagic RAW、分眼鱼眼 HEVC (8160x7200/眼) 与半等距柱状 HEVC (7200x7200/眼) 三格式发布并附出厂镜头标定。在 24 个片段、双目、四个码率点、九个视角方向的 x265 重编码对比中，原生鱼眼编码在同等视口质量下对全部 24 个片段都需要更高码率（中位 +38%），且视野各区域皆然。
Motivation: 现有 VR180 研究资源多来自 YouTube 等平台：已经过未知管线拼接、投影与压缩，且缺少镜头标定，无法支撑面向相机原生几何的编码与视觉研究。
Method: 用两台 Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive 实拍立体视频与静帧，发布 Blackmagic RAW、分眼原生鱼眼 HEVC 与半等距柱状 HEVC 三种交付格式，附出厂镜头标定、鱼眼/半等距柱状转换工具与 AI 生成的场景及视觉挑战标注；编码实验用 x265 对 24 个片段、双目、四个码率点、九个视角方向重编码。
Result: 数据集含 1,211 个样本：636 段立体视频（2,220.8 秒，多为 90 fps）与 575 张立体静帧。x265 重编码测试中，原生鱼眼编码在同等视口质量下对全部 24 个片段都比半等距柱状编码需要更高码率，中位高出 38%，且视野的每个区域都如此。
Conclusion: 相机原生鱼眼表示在视口质量相同下比半等距柱状投影更费码率，因此交付与编码管线应优先考虑半等距柱状形式，同时保留原生数据与标定供研究使用。

papers.title: Beyond Type-checking: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Formal Specification Generation
papers.abstract_en: When generating verifiable code, natural language requirements are mapped to machine checked code using LLMs and agentic workflows. A crucial component of this pipeline is specification generation (SpecGen), which produces a formal contract against which an agent can prove implementation correctness. Proof generation can obtain deterministic feedback from a theorem prover, but SpecGen lacks a definitive check that a generated specification captures the user's intent. A checked proof can therefore establish correctness against a specification that misrepresents the intended behaviour. We take a step towards holistic SpecGen evaluation with a unified dataset assembled from $350$ existing Lean tasks, including $189$ from VERINA and $161$ from CLEVER, and a framework covering formal validity, reference similarity and equivalence, and behavioural adequacy. We distinguish acceptance of required inputs from acceptance of valid outputs and rejection of invalid outputs, while making each metric's evidence scope explicit. Across four SpecGen configurations, restricting the generalized tree edit distance (GTED) comparison, a reference similarity measure, to $32$ jointly measurable VERINA tasks changes the VERINA configuration's position from second to fourth in mean similarity, showing the importance of measurement coverage. In an authored control, a specification achieves $100\%$ positive test recall and negative test rejection while accepting $0\%$ of required inputs. This demonstrates that perfect postcondition scores can miss an unusable input contract, motivating separate feedback on input coverage and output constraints.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding (20 pages, 7 figures)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对形式化规格生成 (SpecGen) 只靠类型检查无法发现“证明通过但规格违背用户意图”的问题，构建统一评测集与覆盖形式有效性、参考相似/等价、行为充分性的框架。在四个 SpecGen 配置上，把 GTED 相似度限制到 32 个可共同度量的 VERINA 任务会使该配置的平均相似度排名从第二跌到第四；一个构造对照中规格达到 100% 正例召回与负例拒绝，却接受 0% 必需输入，说明满分后置条件仍可能对应不可用的输入契约。
Motivation: 证明生成能从定理证明器拿到确定性反馈，但 SpecGen 缺少判定规格是否捕捉用户意图的检查，证明可能针对歪曲预期行为的规格通过；现有评测也未区分输入覆盖与输出约束。
Method: 汇总由 350 个既有 Lean 任务构成的统一数据集（189 个来自 VERINA，161 个来自 CLEVER），提出覆盖 formal validity、reference similarity 与 equivalence、behavioural adequacy 的评测框架，并区分必需输入的接受、合法输出的接受与非法输出的拒绝，同时显式标注每个指标的证据范围；在四个 SpecGen 配置上比较，并加入一个人为构造的对照 (authored control)。

Relevance: 4

papers.title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自参照社会偏好 (self-referenced social preferences)：每个智能体只学自己的奖励模型，把它套到他人观测到的转移上、从自身视角评估对方结果，再喂进标准社会偏好，从而在不观测他人奖励的情况下学出合作。在 Escape Room、Clean Up、Commons Harvest 三个序列社会困境中，独立学习者失败的设定下仍学到合作，且联合产出的分配常比能拿到真实奖励的智能体更公平。
Motivation: 现有基于社会偏好的多智能体合作方法要求观测同伴的奖励信号，而现实中智能体通常只能看到他人行为与结果、拿不到其私有奖励。
Method: 每个智能体学习自身奖励模型，将其应用于他人观测转移以从自身视角评估结果，再把该评估接入标准社会偏好；两种接入方式为修改学习奖励（inequity aversion 配 value look-ahead）或用评估加权策略更新 (policy-update weighting，适合纯 benevolent 偏好)。
Result: 在三个序列社会困境（Escape Room 需要志愿行为、Clean Up 需要公共品贡献、Commons Harvest 需要资源克制）上，不观测他人奖励也能学到合作，包括独立学习者失败的设定；分配常比有真实奖励访问权的智能体更公平；部分可观测下策略更新方式仍支持合作。
Conclusion: 显式获取他人奖励信号对学习合作并非必要，社会偏好可建立在由他人观测行为推得的自参照结果评估上；最佳接入点取决于具体社会偏好。

papers.title: The Geometry of Empowerment
papers.abstract_en: Empowerment captures the capacity for an agent to actively control its environment. While conceptually appealing as an information-theoretic quantity, the connection between empowerment and structurally central states that provide broad access to future outcomes has remained an open question. In this work, we link empowerment maximization and skill-learning methods to provide new geometries for interpreting and analyzing empowerment. Our analyses answer longstanding open questions on the connections between empowerment and structural centrality. Our analyses also reveal distinctions between information and reward geometries, highlighting important theoretical implications to build scalable empowerment-maximization methods. Website and code can be found at https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 empowerment 最大化与技能学习 (skill-learning) 方法联系起来，为 empowerment 构造新的几何解释，从而回答 empowerment 与结构性中心状态（能广泛通达未来结果的状态）之间关系的长期开放问题，并区分信息几何与奖励几何。
Motivation: empowerment 作为信息论量在概念上有吸引力，但它与能提供广泛未来通达性的结构性中心状态之间究竟如何对应，一直是未解决的问题。
Method: 将 empowerment 最大化与技能学习方法相联结，构造用于解释和分析 empowerment 的新几何（区分信息几何与奖励几何），并据此分析 empowerment 与结构中心性的关系。
Result: 给出关于 empowerment 与结构中心性联系的理论解答，并揭示信息几何与奖励几何之间的区别；摘要未给出实验数值或基准对比。
Conclusion: empowerment 与结构中心性之间的联系可以用几何语言刻画，而信息几何与奖励几何的区分对构建可扩展的 empowerment 最大化方法具有理论含义。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the recorded trajectories already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEMPO 为潜空间世界模型规划学一个时间距离度量：在冻结的潜空间上学习小型映射，使两状态间距离反映同一 episode 内的环境步数，并把它混入规划器代价，从而在目标距起点多个 plan 时仍能正确排序候选动作序列。在 11 个模拟环境上，加一个最多占单次规划算术运算 0.3% 的小 MLP，即让 LeWM 与 PLDM 在所有目标距离上都提升，TwoRoom 距目标三个 plan 时 LeWM 成功率从 36% 升到 99%。
Motivation: 潜空间世界模型用终点状态与目标的潜距离给候选动作序列排序，但目标离当前状态几个 plan 远时该排序失效，因为潜距离衡量的是终点与目标的相似程度，而非到达目标还差多远。
Method: TEMPO 不改动世界模型，只用训练该模型时已有的记录轨迹学习一个冻结潜空间上的小型映射（小 MLP），使同一 episode 内两状态的距离等于它们之间的环境步数，再把该距离混入规划器代价；不需要奖励、策略或成功标签，适用于每个状态一个潜向量、按潜距离规划的冻结世界模型。
Result: 在 11 个模拟环境（迷宫导航、桌面推物、机械臂控制、三维操作等）上用 LeWM 与 PLDM 两个规划器评测：小 MLP 至多给单次规划增加 0.3% 算术运算，两个规划器在所有目标距离上均提升，包括原评测的单 plan 设定；TwoRoom 距目标三个 plan 时 LeWM 从 36% 提到 99%，并在大范围 2D/3D 导航、到达与操作任务上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把“离目标还差多远”作为可学习的时间距离代价加到冻结世界模型上，比用潜相似度排序更能处理多 plan 远的目标，且开销可忽略、无需奖励或成功标签。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Sparse-GS2Mesh: 3D Gaussian Splatting Guided by Novel Stereo Views and 2DGS for Sparse View Surface Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Surface reconstruction under sparse-view settings remains challenging due to limited geometric cues. Volume rendering methods based on signed distance functions often produce over-smoothed surfaces, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), though time-efficient, suffers from incomplete geometry due to the lack of reliable depth supervision and the limitation of being optimized only from given input views. In this paper, we present Sparse-GS2Mesh, a stereo-aware framework for surface reconstruction from sparse views. While 3DGS and stereo matching have been leveraged for surface reconstruction under dense view settings, we extend them to operate effectively under sparse view conditions by first initializing 3DGS using epipolar depth priors to mitigate the 3DGS overfitting problem, followed by our three key components: (I) adaptive baseline selection, (II) fine-tuning with a stereo matching network, and (III) 2D/3D co-regularized fine-tuning. Given a warmed-up 3DGS initialized with epipolar depth, the adaptive baseline selection automatically determines a baseline to synthesize for each sparse view. We then fine-tune 3DGS by backpropagating depth-refining gradients from the stereo matching network, effectively specializing the 3DGS for stereo matching. The 2D/3D co-regularization further helps obtain stable reconstruction, addressing weak geometric cues in close stereo views. Sparse-GS2Mesh achieves a 15\% improvement over state-of-the-art methods in little-overlap settings and comparable results in large-overlap settings. Codes will be publicly available.
papers.comment: Accepted to NIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI workshops. Project Page: https://yhnoh8623.github.io/projects/s-gs2mesh/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sparse-GS2Mesh 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 与立体匹配耦合，用于稀疏视角表面重建：先用对极深度先验初始化 3DGS 缓解过拟合，再经自适应基线选择、立体匹配网络反传深度细化梯度的微调，以及 2D/3D 协同正则化微调。在 little-overlap 设置下比 SOTA 方法提升 15%，large-overlap 设置下结果相当。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下几何线索不足：基于 SDF 的体渲染易产生过平滑表面，3DGS 因缺少可靠深度监督、且只从给定输入视角优化，几何不完整。
Method: 三阶段框架：用对极深度先验 (epipolar depth priors) 初始化 3DGS 以缓解过拟合；(I) 自适应基线选择为每个稀疏视角自动确定待合成的基线；(II) 用立体匹配网络反传的深度细化梯度微调 3DGS，使其适配立体匹配；(III) 2D/3D 协同正则化微调，处理近距立体视角的弱几何线索。
Result: 在 little-overlap 设置下相对 SOTA 方法提升 15%，在 large-overlap 设置下取得相当结果；代码将公开。
Conclusion: 把立体匹配的深度监督接入 3DGS 并配合基线选择与协同正则化，可在稀疏视角下得到稳定表面重建，优势集中在视角重叠小的场景。

papers.title: The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Similarity scores are often offered as evidence that a model shares structure with the brain or across languages. We ask what such a score reads when that structure is removed, or when the instrument measuring it does not work, in two settings. Across seventeen languages, a grammaticality probe transfers worse between more distant languages (r = -0.66). But the probe's own accuracy falls along the same axis and is at chance in four languages, four of the five most distant. Dropping them halves the explained variance, and because it also narrows the range of distances, the design cannot say how much of the gradient is the instrument. Counting the 272 language pairs as independent gives p = 0.0006 for a steering effect that is null when the seventeen languages are the unit (p = 0.155). In brain alignment, a training objective raises a language model's similarity to fMRI responses from 0.10 to 0.34 (reliability ceiling 0.54), yet targets with the brain correspondence destroyed still reach 0.31. A shuffled target scores about k/n against the real one, for rank k and n sentences, a baseline that can be computed before any model is trained. Both interventions work, yet we detect no distance-graded steering effect and no syntactic benefit from alignment. Before reading a correspondence score, measure how much of it survives without the correspondence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 相似度分数被当作模型与大脑或跨语言共享结构的证据，但作者用两种干预检验分数在结构被破坏后还剩多少：跨 17 种语言的语法性探针迁移随语言距离变差（r = -0.66），而训练目标把语言模型与 fMRI 反应的相似度从 0.10 抬到 0.34（信度上限 0.54），可对应关系被摧毁的目标仍达 0.31。结论是读任何对应分数前先测它在没有对应关系时存活多少。
Motivation: 相似度分数被直接当作结构共享的证据，但分数可能主要反映测量工具本身（探针准确率、句子排序基线）而非被声称的对应关系，跨语言与脑对齐两个场景都缺一个可操作的零假设检验。
Method: 两个场景：其一在 17 种语言上测语法性探针的跨语言迁移与语言距离的相关，并把 272 个语言对与 17 种语言分别作为统计单位重算显著性；其二用训练目标提升语言模型与 fMRI 反应的相似度，同时构造对应关系被摧毁的目标与 shuffled target（按 rank k / n 句子给出可训练前计算的基线）。
Result: 跨语言迁移与距离相关 r = -0.66，但探针自身准确率沿同一轴下降、在 4 种语言上处于随机水平（最远的 5 种中有 4 种），剔除它们后解释方差减半；把 272 个语言对当独立样本得 p = 0.0006，以 17 种语言为单位则 p = 0.155。脑对齐相似度 0.10 → 0.34（信度上限 0.54），对应关系被摧毁的目标仍达 0.31，shuffled target 约为真实目标的 k/n。两种干预都生效，但未检测到随距离分级的 steering 效应，也未见对齐带来的句法收益。
Conclusion: 对应分数必须配一个
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sphere Encoder 2
papers.abstract_en: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2.
papers.comment: + one more ablation point for Fig.5. Code is available at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sphere Encoder 2 修复了原版 Sphere Encoder 在高维潜球上采样生成图像的两个缺陷：随机点集中在赤道附近而训练旋转到不了该区域，以及逐像素重建损失导致解码器对多个合理图像取平均而输出模糊结果。修正后图像生成质量显著提升，同时保持自编码器的速度与简洁性。
Motivation: 原版 Sphere Encoder 用高维潜球上的随机点解码生成图像，但潜球上随机采样相对极点集中在赤道附近，而训练旋转覆盖不到该区域，形成采样空隙，限制了一步生成；逐像素重建损失又鼓励解码器平均多个合理图像，导致输出模糊、缺少高频细节。
Method: 针对两个缺陷分别修正：一是让训练旋转覆盖随机点集中的赤道区域，消除采样空隙；二是改进生成训练目标，避免逐像素重建损失导致的解码器平均化。整体仍保持自编码器的形式与速度。
Result: 图像生成质量相比原版 Sphere Encoder 有实质性提升，同时保持自编码器的速度与简洁性；论文附带 Fig. 5 的一项额外消融实验，代码与模型在 GitHub (kaiyuyue/sphere2) 开源。
Conclusion: 潜球采样分布与训练覆盖的错配、以及逐像素重建损失的平均化效应，是 Sphere Encoder 一步生成质量受限的两个根因，修正后可在不牺牲速度的前提下明显改善生成效果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diffusion-2BC: Hybrid Diffusion and Regression Training for Offline Behavior Cloning in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Behavior cloning provides an offline route to autonomous-driving policy learning, but mean-squared-error regression is poorly matched to demonstrations in which one observation admits several valid actions. Diffusion policies can represent conditional multimodal action distributions, yet their closed-loop performance may be unstable when visual features and control are learned from limited data. This paper presents Diffusion-2BC, which combines a diffusion denoising objective with an auxiliary deterministic behavior-cloning loss over a shared visual encoder. The auxiliary branch is used only during training; inference remains diffusion-based. The proposed method is evaluated in the controlled Claw environment and in bird's-eye-view CARLA navigation, including route-conditioned driving, route-free navigation through multiple intersections, and cross-map evaluation from Town01 to Town02. In the Claw task, Diffusion-2BC reduced the mean mask-distance error by approximately 10% relative to a diffusion-based behavior-cloning baseline and by 85% relative to standard deterministic behavior cloning. In route-free CARLA, Diffusion-2BC traveled substantially farther before termination under the evaluation protocol than both baselines in Town01 and Town02. Additional qualitative rollouts revealed distinct route choices, showing the multimodal behavior of the proposed diffusion-based agent. The results indicate that an auxiliary regression signal can improve the closed-loop reliability of diffusion behavior cloning while preserving multimodal prediction in the controlled benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Diffusion-2BC 把扩散去噪目标与一个仅训练期使用的确定性行为克隆 (BC) 辅助分支共享视觉编码器，推理仍走扩散。在 Claw 与 CARLA 俯视导航中，它把 Claw 的平均 mask-distance error 相对扩散式 BC 基线降低约 10%、相对标准确定性 BC 降低 85%，并在 Town01/Town02 的无路线任务中比两个基线行驶更远才终止。
Motivation: 均方误差回归无法处理同一观测对应多个合法动作的多模态示范；纯扩散策略在视觉特征与控制数据有限时闭环表现不稳定。
Method: 在共享视觉编码器上联合训练扩散去噪损失与辅助确定性 BC 回归损失，辅助分支只在训练期启用，推理保持纯扩散；评测覆盖受控 Claw 环境与俯视 CARLA 导航（含路线条件驾驶、多路口无路线导航、Town01 到 Town02 跨图评测）。
Result: Claw 任务中平均 mask-distance error 相对扩散式 BC 基线下降约 10%，相对标准确定性 BC 下降 85%；无路线 CARLA 评测协议下，Diffusion-2BC 在 Town01 与 Town02 均比两个基线行驶显著更远才终止；定性 rollout 显示不同的路线选择，体现扩散智能体的多模态行为。
Conclusion: 辅助回归信号能在受控基准上提升扩散行为克隆的闭环可靠性，同时保留多模态预测能力。

papers.title: When Post-Processing Fairness Constraints Help and When They Harm: Evidence from Eight Cross-Domain Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits in production ML typically occur once, at deployment, on a single domain. Both fail in practice: fairness can shift after retraining or a changing user base, and interventions validated on one dataset are rarely tested across the heterogeneous domains an organization deploys. We present FAPE (Fairness Auditing for Production Environments), a four-stage framework evaluating a single post-processing intervention, Fairlearn's ThresholdOptimizer, across eight domain evaluations: criminal justice, income prediction, legal admissions, credit lending, agricultural lending, a multi-domain benchmark corpus, healthcare, and education. Each is scored on demographic parity and equalized odds difference, plus disparate impact ratio and accuracy cost where computable. Intervention effectiveness tracks baseline disparity magnitude: across model-domain pairs the constraint improved disparity in 9 of 14 high-disparity cases and worsened it in 3 of 4 near-fair ones. Each of the five high-disparity exceptions reverses under one of two measurement checks, a minimum group size or thresholds fit on held-out data. A CUSUM monitor started at deployment, tested on a simulated shift, separates constrained models that never met a 0.1 parity convention from those that met it and later regressed. A single deployment-time audit is therefore an unreliable guide, which argues for baseline-disparity screening and continuous monitoring
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code, data loaders and figures: github.com/nithinnarla/fape-fairness-ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FAPE（Fairness Auditing for Production Environments）四阶段框架，用 Fairlearn 的 ThresholdOptimizer 在八个领域评估同一后处理公平性约束。约束效果随基线差异幅度而变：14 个高差异模型-领域对中 9 个改善、4 个近公平对中 3 个反而恶化；作者主张先做基线差异筛查再上约束，并用部署起算的 CUSUM 监控持续跟踪。
Motivation: 生产环境的公平性审计通常只在部署时做一次、只覆盖单一领域，而重训与用户群变化会让公平性漂移，单一数据集上验证的干预很少跨异构领域检验。
Method: FAPE 四阶段框架，统一评估 Fairlearn ThresholdOptimizer 这一后处理干预，覆盖刑事司法、收入预测、法律录取、信贷、农业贷款、多领域基准语料、医疗、教育八个领域；指标为 demographic parity、equalized odds difference，可算时加 disparate impact ratio 与 accuracy cost；另用最小群体规模与 held-out 数据拟合阈值两种测量检查，以及从部署起算的 CUSUM 监控在模拟漂移上检验。
Result: 干预效果与基线差异幅度挂钩：14 个高差异模型-领域对中 9 个改善，4 个近公平对中 3 个恶化；5 个高差异例外中有每一个都会在两种测量检查（最小群体规模或 held-out 拟合阈值）之一下反转。CUSUM 监控在模拟漂移上能区分从未达到 0.1 parity 约定的受约束模型与先达标后回退的模型。
Conclusion: 单次部署时审计不可靠，应先按基线差异筛查再施加后处理约束，并配合持续监控。

papers.title: Sometimes You Gotta Run Before You Can Walk: Run-then-Walk Scheduling Strategy for VLM Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Recent VLM-based autonomous driving planners adopt GRPO-style reinforcement learning to optimize driving performance. However, existing GRPO recipes either optimize driving efficiency, risking progress-seeking but unsafe behavior, or enforce early safety constraints, leading to overly conservative behavior; both require lengthy training. To solve these problems, we first reveal two distinct RL regimes: a progress regime (Run-GRPO) that aggressively explores high progress, and a safety regime (Walk-GRPO) that restores safety under stable progress. Based on this finding, we propose $\textit{Run-then-Walk}$, a simple yet effective two-stage reward scheduling strategy for GRPO, achieving both better performance and faster convergence. Unlike one-stage RL, which may focus on progress, safety, or a mixture of both within a single training phase, this schedule explicitly separates progress discovery from safety repair. In the $\textit{Run}$ phase, we focus on progress, allowing the policy to escape the conservative bias and discover high-progress modes. In the subsequent $\textit{Walk}$ phase, we introduce endpoint and safety strategy to repair unsafe behaviors from the Run phase. This reversed schedule overcomes the conservatism of Walk-first methods and the unsafe progress-seeking of joint optimization. We validate it with various VLM-based planners on multiple benchmarks: NAVSIMv1, NAVSIMv2, Navhard, and nuScenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved driving performance while requiring 40--50\% fewer RL training epochs than the baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/haha-yuki-haha/AutoDrive-P3_with_Run-then-walk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VLM 自动驾驶规划器中 GRPO 强化学习在效率与安全之间的取舍，提出 Run-then-Walk 两阶段奖励调度：先用 Run-GRPO 激进探索高进度、摆脱保守偏置，再用 Walk-GRPO 引入终点与安全策略修复不安全行为。在 NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard 与 nuScenes 上验证，驾驶性能提升且比基线少用 40–50% 的 RL 训练 epoch。
Motivation: 现有 GRPO 配方要么只优化驾驶效率、冒着追求进度而不安全的风险，要么过早施加安全约束导致过度保守，且两者训练时间都很长。
Method: 先识别两种 RL 体制：激进探索高进度的 Run-GRPO 与在进度稳定后恢复安全的 Walk-GRPO；据此设计两阶段奖励调度，Run 阶段专注进度发现，Walk 阶段用终点奖励与安全策略修复 Run 阶段产生的不安全行为，替代单阶段联合优化。
Result: 在 NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard 和 nuScenes 多个基准上，用多种 VLM 规划器验证，驾驶性能提升，同时所需 RL 训练 epoch 比基线少 40–50%。
Conclusion: 把进度发现与安全修复显式拆成先后两阶段，能同时克服 Walk-first 的保守与联合优化的不安全进度追求，并显著加快收敛。
Relevance: 2
