summary_sections.method: 先识别两种 RL 体制：激进探索高进度的 Run-GRPO 与在进度稳定后恢复安全的 Walk-GRPO；据此设计两阶段奖励调度，Run 阶段专注进度发现，Walk 阶段用终点奖励与安全策略修复 Run 阶段产生的不安全行为，替代单阶段联合优化。
summary_sections.result: 在 NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard 和 nuScenes 多个基准上，用多种 VLM 规划器验证，驾驶性能提升，同时所需 RL 训练 epoch 比基线少 40–50%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把进度发现与安全修复显式拆成先后两阶段，能同时克服 Walk-first 的保守与联合优化的不安全进度追求，并显著加快收敛。

papers.title: The segmentation ceiling: why explicit left-ventricular masks do not improve learned ejection-fraction regression
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of left ventricular ejection fraction (EF) from echocardiography is central to cardiovascular care, and deep learning enables automated EF prediction from echocardiographic video. Because EF is clinically derived from left-ventricular (LV) volumes, a widely held intuition is that explicit LV segmentation should improve prediction. We introduce a quantitative criterion, the segmentation ceiling, that makes this testable: from EF as a normalized difference of end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes, we derive in closed form how per-frame segmentation area error propagates into EF error, and thus the accuracy a mask must reach before it can improve on direct regression. Using EchoNet-Dynamic, a UniFormer-S backbone, and the empirically measured within-patient error correlation, the criterion places the break-even near 10% per-frame area error, whereas a representative segmenter operates at roughly 14%, above the ceiling. Consistent with this, four strategies for injecting segmentation or area information (a predicted-mask channel, end-diastolic/end-systolic clip sampling, and per-bin and amplitude area-consistency objectives) fail to beat a raw-video baseline; ground-truth masks help only through label leakage. Input representation thus not being the limit, we identify generalization as the practical lever: weight averaging with strong augmentation attains a test R^2 of 0.806 (MAE 4.08) under a matched dense-clip protocol, comparable to an R(2+1)D baseline (0.811) while tightening the validation-to-test gap. Finally, a heteroscedastic beta-NLL formulation yields informative, well-calibrated per-prediction uncertainty, larger for clinically harder low-EF cases, where Monte-Carlo dropout does not. The segmentation ceiling gives a concrete design criterion for when mask-guided EF estimation is worthwhile, plus a simple, uncertainty-aware recipe for EF regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出「分割上限 (segmentation ceiling)」闭式判据：由 EF 是舒张末期与收缩末期容积之差，推出逐帧分割面积误差如何传播为 EF 误差，得到掩膜必须达到的精度门槛。在 EchoNet-Dynamic 上用 UniFormer-S 与实测帧间误差相关性算出盈亏平衡点约 10% 逐帧面积误差，而代表性分割器约 14%，高于上限；四种注入分割/面积信息的策略均未超过原始视频基线，真值掩膜的提升只来自标签泄漏。
Motivation: EF 由左心室容积临床推得，因此普遍直觉认为显式 LV 分割应提升 EF 回归，但该直觉此前不可检验；本文把它变成一个可计算的精度门槛问题。
Method: 从 EF 作为 EDV/ESV 归一化差的定义出发，闭式推导逐帧分割面积误差向 EF 误差的传播，结合 EchoNet-Dynamic 上实测的患者内误差相关性给出判据；用 UniFormer-S 主干测试四种注入方式（预测掩膜通道、ED/ES clip 采样、分 bin 与幅度的面积一致性目标），并比较权重平均加强增广与异方差 beta-NLL 两种配方。
Result: 判据给出的盈亏平衡点约 10% 逐帧面积误差，代表性分割器约 14%，位于上限之上；四种分割/面积注入策略均未胜过 raw-video 基线，真值掩膜仅通过标签泄漏起作用。匹配 dense-clip 协议下，权重平均加强增广达 test R² 0.806、MAE 4.08，与 R(2+1)D 基线 0.811 相当但收窄了验证到测试的差距；异方差 beta-NLL 给出有信息量且校准良好的逐预测不确定性，在临床更难的低 EF 病例上更大，而 Monte-Carlo dropout 做不到。
Conclusion: 输入表示不是 EF 回归的瓶颈，泛化才是实际抓手；分割上限给出了掩膜引导 EF 估计何时值得做的具体设计判据，并附带一个带不确定性的 EF 回归配方。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Data-Free On-Policy Distillation: How Far Can We Go Without External Data?
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly applied to frontier foundation model post-training. Prior work in this area has largely focused on algorithmic advances, yet it remains unclear how much OPD depends on its training questions and, in particular, how far this dependence can be reduced. Across two representative single-teacher OPD settings, we find that training on 8 real prompts yields performance comparable to training on 17k problems, while datasets differing substantially in measured difficulty and initial distillation gap yield similar outcomes. Our analyses suggest two complementary explanations: repeated sampling could allow even a few prompts to expose substantial teacher supervision, while OPD transfers generalizable reasoning capabilities beyond dataset-specific knowledge. Building on these observations, we next propose a data-free on-policy distillation (DF-OPD) setting to investigate whether the system can supply the training questions itself, eliminating the need for external data. With 64 self-generated questions obtained without seed examples, DF-OPD yields performance comparable to full-data OPD in both single-teacher settings. This finding also holds in multi-teacher OPD: across mathematics, code, and instruction following, 1k generated questions achieve performance comparable to training on approximately 7k real post-training examples. We further explore whether OPD can operate even without explicit training questions. The experiments show that this is effective only in limited cases, where the student unexpectedly generates and answers its own questions, thereby reducing the process to an implicit form of DF-OPD. Together, these findings invite a reassessment of the role of training data in on-policy distillation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ryuki661/DF-OPD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文考察 on-policy distillation (OPD) 对训练题目的依赖能压到多低：8 条真实 prompt 即可达到与 17k 题相当的性能，而难度与初始蒸馏差距差异很大的数据集结果相近。进一步提出 data-free OPD (DF-OPD)，学生在无种子示例下自生成 64 题，在两个单教师设定中达到与全数据 OPD 相当的性能；多教师设定下 1k 自生成题在数学、代码、指令跟随上与约 7k 真实后训练样本相当。
Motivation: OPD 广泛用于基础模型后训练，但其对训练题目的依赖程度尚不清楚，且此前工作主要关注算法改进而非数据依赖。
Method: 在两个代表性单教师 OPD 设定中比较不同规模与难度的训练题目，分析重复采样与可泛化推理能力两种解释；随后提出 DF-OPD，让学生在无种子示例下自生成训练题目，并扩展到多教师 OPD（数学、代码、指令跟随），另测试完全无显式训练题目的情形。
Result: 8 条真实 prompt 训练性能与 17k 题相当；难度与初始蒸馏差距显著不同的数据集产出相近结果。DF-OPD 用 64 道自生成题（无种子示例）在两个单教师设定中达到与全数据 OPD 相当的性能。多教师 OPD 中 1k 生成题与约 7k 真实后训练样本相当。完全无显式训练题目仅在有限情形下有效，此时学生自行生成并回答问题，退化为隐式 DF-OPD。
Conclusion: OPD 对外部训练数据的依赖可大幅削减，训练数据在 on-policy distillation 中的角色需要重新评估；但完全去掉显式训练题目只在有限情形下可行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoEMB: Scaling Universal Multimodal Embeddings with Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) increasingly demands encoder's capacity for handling a broad range of tasks and modalities with increased complexity. Prior scaling methods either increase the representation size, retrieval effort, or scales the encoder into a heavy multimodal LLM. Recent works, such as Think-Then-Embed (TTE), explore scaling via reasoning tokens. However, embedding models are hard to scale up: increasing parameters directly tradeoffs for the large training batch size that contrastive learning needs, and retrieval has to be served under tight latency. Moreover, UME tasks are diverse in complexity, where scaling up embedders can bring significant redundant computation. In this work, we propose MOEMB, which instead scales UME along the expert axis through mixture-of-experts (MoE), growing encoder capacity while preserving single-vector, non-autoregressive encoding. Through a systematic study of the design space and training recipes for MoE-based UME, MoEMB sets a new state of the art on both MMEB-V2 and MRMR among models trained on public MMEB-family data: with only 3B active parameters, MoEMB surpasses TTE-based methods with >4x active parameters, using significantly less computes. To further improve the scalability and efficiency, we conduct the first comprehensive study of adaptive computation for MoE-based embedding, spanning diverse strategies across training-based and inference-only methods. Together, these results support expert scaling as an effective and efficient direction for UME, with adaptive computation further improving efficiency for MLLM-based embedding models towards large-scale retrieval and recommendation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoEMB 沿专家轴 (expert axis) 扩展通用多模态嵌入 (UME)：用 mixture-of-experts 增大编码器容量，同时保持单向量、非自回归编码，避免对比学习所需的大 batch 与检索延迟被参数量拖累。在公开 MMEB 系列数据训练的模型中，仅 3B 激活参数即在 MMEB-V2 与 MRMR 上取得新 SOTA，超过激活参数多 4 倍以上的 TTE 类方法且算力显著更省。
Motivation: UME 任务复杂度差异大，直接加参数会与对比学习的大训练 batch 冲突、加重检索延迟，且统一放大编码器在简单任务上产生大量冗余计算。
Method: 提出 MoEMB，把 UME 扩展移到 MoE 专家轴上，保持单向量非自回归编码；系统研究 MoE-based UME 的设计空间与训练配方，并首次系统研究面向 MoE 嵌入的 adaptive computation，覆盖 training-based 与 inference-only 两类策略。
Result: 在公开 MMEB-family 数据训练的模型中，MoEMB 于 MMEB-V2 与 MRMR 同时刷新 SOTA：3B 激活参数超越激活参数 >4x 的 TTE-based 方法，且算力显著更少。
Conclusion: 专家扩展是 UME 有效且高效的方向，adaptive computation 可进一步提升 MLLM-based 嵌入在大规模检索与推荐系统中的效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are Near-Tied LLM Rankings Robust to Family-DIF-Guided Benchmark Recomposition?
papers.abstract_en: Small leaderboard gaps are often interpreted as evidence that one language model is better than another, but their sign may depend on which benchmark items are included. We test this using item-level responses from five benchmarks and a family-label-free spectral approximation to multidimensional item-response theory (MIRT). In owner-disjoint folds, one owner half identifies items with low residual differential item functioning across model families (low-DIF). These items are used to score models in the other half with frozen weights that preserve the benchmark's composition across metadata-defined item groups and easiness strata. Equally short matched-random subtests provide a baseline for variation due to item subsampling. Full-benchmark and low-DIF rankings remain strongly correlated ($τ_b=.900$--$.948$). Yet in four of five benchmarks, 30.9--47.1\% of cross-family pairs initially within one percentage point reverse order, exceeding their matched-random medians by 16.9--28.6 percentage points (all $p=.001$). The fifth benchmark shows no reliable excess ($-0.9$ points, $p=.689$). The pattern survives all pre-specified population perturbations, and residual item--family signatures replicate across owner halves; however, no family shows a consistent advantage across benchmarks. Thus, globally stable rankings can still leave individual near-tie orderings sensitive to benchmark composition, and sub-one-point leaderboard gaps should be accompanied by evidence that the implied ordering is composition-robust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用免家族标签的 MIRT 谱近似在 owner-disjoint 折上筛出跨模型家族残余 DIF 低的题目，再以冻结权重给另一半打分：整体排名与全基准强相关（τ_b=.900–.948），但五个基准中四个有 30.9–47.1% 的跨家族近平手（差距<1 个百分点）对子换序，超出匹配随机子测验中位数 16.9–28.6 个百分点（p=.001）。结论是亚百分点的榜单名次对题目构成敏感，应附带构成稳健性证据。
Motivation: 榜单上不足一个百分点的差距常被当作模型优劣的证据，但其符号可能随纳入的题目而变，缺少对这种构成敏感性的检验。
Method: 基于五个基准的 item-level 作答，采用免家族标签的多维项目反应理论 (MIRT) 谱近似；在 owner-disjoint 折中，一半 owner 识别跨模型家族残余 DIF 低的题目，用冻结权重（保持元数据定义的题目组与难度分层构成）给另一半打分，并以等长匹配随机子测验作为子采样波动基线。
Result: 全基准与 low-DIF 排名 τ_b=.900–.948；五个基准中四个有 30.9–47.1% 的跨家族近平手对（<1 个百分点）换序，超匹配随机中位数 16.9–28.6 个百分点（p=.001）；第五个基准无可靠超额（−0.9 个百分点，p=.689）。模式在全部预设总体扰动下存活，残余 item–family 特征在 owner 两半间复现，但无家族跨基准显示一致优势。
Conclusion: 全局稳定的排名仍可能掩盖对基准构成敏感的个别近平手次序，亚一个百分点的榜单差距应附带其排序构成稳健的证据。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 全局稳定的排名仍可能掩盖对基准构成敏感的个别近平手次序，亚一个百分点的榜单差距应附带其排序构成稳健的证据。

papers.title: Explicit Bounds on the Entropy of Piecewise Hölder Graphon Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the entropy of random graphs generated by piecewise Hölder continuous graphons. We first present a result on the rate of convergence of the normalized entropy as the size of the graph grows. The core ideas of the proof are described, with the detailed proof provided in the appendix. From this result, we then derive quantitative bounds on the entropy for the stochastic block model and random geometric graph model. These bounds provide explicit formulae rather than asymptotic statements which have been found previously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对分段 Hölder 连续 graphon 生成的随机图，给出归一化熵随图规模增长的收敛速率，并由此导出 stochastic block model 与 random geometric graph 的显式熵界，取代以往只有渐近式的结果。
Motivation: 此前关于这类随机图熵的结论多为渐近陈述，缺少可直接代入的显式公式，难以在有限规模下定量使用。
Method: 以分段 Hölder 连续 graphon 为对象，证明归一化熵随图规模的收敛速率（核心证明思路在正文，完整证明置于附录），再把该结果具体应用到 stochastic block model 与 random geometric graph 两类模型。
Result: 得到归一化熵随图规模增长的收敛速率结果，并导出 stochastic block model 与 random geometric graph 的熵的显式定量界；这些界是显式公式而非此前文献中的渐近陈述。
Conclusion: 分段 Hölder graphon 的熵在有限规模下可写成显式可算的界，随机图熵的刻画不必停留在渐近层面。

papers.title: DYSANOS Generative Dynamic Smooth Arbitrage-free Non-parametric Option Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: This article presents with DYSANOS the first generative market model for smooth SANOS option surfaces for all strikes and expiries which are free of static arbitrage. Our model is designed to generate entire paths of daily spot and option prices for years in the future. We present a robust and useful if somewhat simplistic baseline in the form of an AR(1) model. We discuss model setup, data pipeline, and training and investigate market reconstruction, stability, and tail behavior. We illustrate model performance on 891 Option Metrics IvyDB S\&P Index surfaces from 2022-01-03 through to 2025-08-29. We also demonstrate how to construct numerically a risk-neutral density. As part of this we develop a new test for zero conditional means under a given measure. We show that for 100,000 simulated paths a trading universe of 48 options and spot is numerically free of dynamic arbitrage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DYSANOS 是首个为 SANOS 期权曲面设计的生成式市场模型，可生成全行权价、全到期日的光滑且无静态套利的曲面，并一次生成未来数年的日度现货与期权价格路径。在 891 个 Option Metrics IvyDB S&P 曲面（2022-01-03 至 2025-08-29）上检验市场重建、稳定性与尾部行为，100,000 条模拟路径下含 48 个期权与现货的交易宇宙在数值上无动态套利。
Motivation: 生成式期权曲面模型需要同时保证光滑、覆盖全部行权价与到期日、且不产生静态与动态套利，现有做法难以在多年路径生成中维持这些约束。
Method: 提出非参数生成模型 DYSANOS 直接生成 SANOS 期权曲面与日度现货/期权价格路径，配套数据管线与训练流程；以 AR(1) 作为基线，数值构造风险中性密度，并新提出给定测度下零条件均值检验。
Result: 在 891 个 Option Metrics IvyDB S&P Index 曲面（2022-01-03 至 2025-08-29）上说明市场重建、稳定性与尾部行为；100,000 条模拟路径下，48 个期权加现货的交易宇宙数值上无动态套利。
Conclusion: 生成式非参数模型可以在全行权价与到期日上产出无静态套利的光滑期权曲面，并在大规模模拟路径上通过动态套利检验。

papers.title: CRUISE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Cross-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Modern autonomous vehicles are equipped with multiple sensors, such as cameras, LiDAR, and radar, for comprehensive environmental perception. However, robust cross-modal feature fusion remains a critical challenge, as the reliability of each sensor varies significantly across diverse real-world driving conditions, including poor visibility and adverse weather. While uncertainty quantification (UQ) mitigates this issue by allowing models to prioritize reliable signals, existing uncertainty-aware fusion methods typically rely on simple feature-level uncertainty estimates and thus often fail to generalize effectively in complex, out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose CRUISE, a novel uncertainty-aware cross-modal sensor fusion framework. CRUISE integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-guided UQ module that generates fine-grained, pixel-level uncertainty estimates. By leveraging the VLM's rich prior knowledge and superior contextual reasoning, our approach provides a highly informative guide for the fusion process. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic adaptive mechanism that explicitly models and captures cross-modal dependencies, ensuring the framework fully exploits the inherent complementary nature of multi-sensor inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRUISE 用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 生成像素级不确定性估计来引导自动驾驶的跨模态传感器融合，并加一个动态自适应机制显式建模相机、LiDAR、雷达之间的跨模态依赖。摘要给出的是机制层面的主张：VLM 的上下文推理为融合提供细粒度引导，使框架在能见度差与恶劣天气等分布外场景下更稳健。
Motivation: 各传感器在不同驾驶条件下可靠性差异大，而现有不确定性感知融合只做特征级的粗粒度 UQ 估计，在复杂、分布外场景中泛化不佳。
Method: 提出 CRUISE 框架：VLM-guided UQ 模块输出像素级不确定性图作为融合引导，利用 VLM 的先验知识与上下文推理；另加动态自适应机制显式建模跨模态依赖，以利用多传感器输入的互补性。
Result: 摘要给出的是定性设计主张：像素级不确定性估计比简单特征级 UQ 更细粒度，动态自适应机制显式捕捉跨模态依赖，框架面向能见度差与恶劣天气等分布外驾驶场景的稳健感知。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 的语义先验引入不确定性量化、再驱动融合权重，是提升跨模态感知在分布外条件下稳健性的一条路径。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Compute Globally, Materialize Locally: The Memory Contract of Sparse Event-KV
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents increasingly reuse their KV cache as memory: a serving system keeps a subset of cached entries and drops the rest. Eviction and episodic-memory schemes therefore rest on a premise rarely tested directly, that a retained event is still informative once the observations that produced it are gone. We test it by omitting one earlier observation from what is served, across otherwise identical agent histories. Among items sensitive to that observation, the answer overwhelmingly follows the omitted value, though no served span says which value is correct. We call this semantic materialization: a downstream event's cached rows act as an independently servable view of computation whose inputs are gone. It can also be written on purpose. A deliberately phrased, answer-free event raises donor-aligned recovery from 6% to 51% on Qwen3-8B without ever naming the value, whereas passively harvesting natural mentions from long-term dialog yields no detected advantage. What such a row carries is specific and bounded. Compact state survives, larger payloads decay toward chance, and whether a construction writes at all turns on phrasing rather than on meaning alone, so two phrasings the model comprehends equally well can diverge sharply. The result is a memory contract for sparse event-KV serving: what to write, where it lands, and what survives once the source is gone. For anyone who evicts the corollary is that dropping a source event and observing no accuracy loss does not show the source was unnecessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长程 agent 把 KV cache 当记忆做稀疏保留时，被丢弃的源观测仍会通过已缓存事件行影响下游答案，作者称之为语义物化 (semantic materialization)。刻意写入的无答案事件把 Qwen3-8B 的 donor 对齐恢复率从 6% 提到 51%，而从长程对话里被动收割自然提及没有检出优势；紧凑状态能存活、大 payload 衰减到随机水平，能否写入取决于措辞而非语义本身。
Motivation: eviction 与 episodic-memory 方案都默认：产生某事件的观测被丢弃后，保留的事件行仍有信息量，但这一前提此前很少被直接检验。
Method: 在其他条件完全相同的 agent 历史中，只从被服务的上下文里省略一条早期观测，观察对它敏感的条目答案是否跟随被省略值；再对比刻意措辞的无答案事件与从长程对话中被动收割的自然提及两种写入方式，测试对象为 Qwen3-8B。
Result: 被省略观测敏感条目的答案压倒性跟随被省略值，尽管没有任何被服务片段指明哪个值正确；刻意写入的无答案事件使 donor 对齐恢复率从 6% 升到 51%（Qwen3-8B），被动收割自然提及则无检出优势；紧凑状态存活，更大 payload 衰减到随机水平，两种模型理解程度相当的措辞可产生 sharply 分歧的写入结果。
Conclusion: 稀疏 event-KV 服务存在一条记忆契约：写什么、落在哪、源消失后什么还在；对做 eviction 的人而言，丢掉源事件且准确率不降并不能证明该源事件不必要。

papers.title: A Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning Framework for LLM Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: We propose ARBITER, a novel LLM guardrail framework that introduces two key ideas: (i) dual-hypothesis reasoning, a reasoning method for LLM guardrails that explicitly considers both safe and unsafe interpretations of a prompt before making a safety decision, and (ii) multi-component supervised fine-tuning (MC-SFT), a structured training loss for reasoning-based guardrails that decomposes LLM outputs into logical components and weights them according to their importance. Existing reasoning-based guardrails often rely on expensive procedures, such as generating reasoning traces using larger or closed-source teacher models and applying full-parameter fine-tuning. In contrast, ARBITER uses a cost-effective self-generation strategy for reasoning traces and LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning while still achieving better performance than these expensive approaches. Additionally, ARBITER provides faithful evidence-phrase explanations for unsafe decisions, enabling a more transparent and interpretable guardrail method. Experiments on three safety moderation benchmarks show that ARBITER outperforms existing reasoning-based and non-reasoning guardrail baselines, with clear gains in out-of-domain evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARBITER 是一个 LLM 安全护栏 (guardrail) 框架，用双假设推理 (dual-hypothesis reasoning) 在判定前同时显式考虑 prompt 的安全与不安全两种解读，再用多组件监督微调 (MC-SFT) 把输出拆成逻辑成分并按重要性加权。推理轨迹用自生成策略替代大模型/闭源教师模型，配合 LoRA 微调，在三个安全审核基准上优于推理型与非推理型护栏基线，且在域外评测上增益更明显。
Motivation: 现有推理型护栏依赖昂贵流程：用更大或闭源的教师模型生成推理轨迹，再做全参数微调，成本高且可解释性弱。
Method: ARBITER 含两部分：双假设推理，先分别构造 prompt 的安全与不安全解读再做安全判定；MC-SFT 结构化训练损失，把 LLM 输出分解为逻辑成分并按重要性赋权。推理轨迹采用自生成 (self-generation) 策略，微调用 LoRA 参数高效方式，并为不安全判定输出 faithful evidence-phrase 解释。
Result: 在三个安全审核基准上，ARBITER 在性能上超过现有推理型与非推理型护栏基线，域外 (out-of-domain) 评测上增益清晰，同时成本低于依赖教师模型与全参数微调的方案。
Conclusion: 双假设推理加按成分加权的 MC-SFT，配合自生成轨迹与 LoRA，可以在降低成本的同时让护栏判定更准、更可解释。

papers.title: The One-Word Census: Answer-Choice Conformity Across 44 Language Models
papers.abstract_en: When a language model must choose one answer from a large space of equally valid options, which answer does it choose, and how often is it the answer every other model chooses? Asked to "pick a word," 105 language models from more than twenty labs chose serendipity 46% of the time. We measure this convergence, and each model's share in it, with 96 single-turn prompts that each name a category with many valid one-word answers ("Name a tree."), asked eight times per model and scored by exact match, with no embeddings and no judge. A model's answer-choice surprisal is the average -log2 probability of its answers under the pooled answers of all other models. In 28 of 96 categories a single answer takes at least 80% of all answers. The concentration does not depend on small or persona-tuned models: the 87 major-lab models are at least as concentrated as the full field. Lightly post-trained and persona-tuned models are the most divergent; heavily post-trained assistants from the major labs are the most conformist. Models that avoid the modal answer mostly land on the same runner-up. Within the major providers' lineages, release order shows no panel-wide trend once model tier is controlled; GPT, Gemini, Grok and Qwen become more conformist across releases, and Claude's generation-5 releases reverse. On open checkpoints of three post-training pipelines, supervised fine-tuning is the largest step toward the field's answers. Against human category-production norms, the field is more concentrated than people in 18 of 20 shared categories. All prompts, transcripts, and code are public.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 96 个「任选一词」类别提示 105 个语言模型各 8 次，按精确匹配统计答案收敛：被点名的 20 多家实验室模型选 serendipity 的比例达 46%，96 类中 28 类有单一答案占全部回答的 80% 以上。重度后训练的大厂助手最趋同，轻度后训练与 persona-tuned 模型最发散；与人类类别产出常模相比，模型在 20 个共享类别中的 18 个比人更集中。
Motivation: 当大量选项同样有效时，语言模型选哪一个、以及是否与其它模型选同一个，缺少可复现的度量；需要在不依赖 embedding 或评委模型的前提下量化这种答案选择趋同。
Method: 提出 answer-choice surprisal：一个模型答案在其余所有模型汇总答案下的平均 -log2 概率。用 96 个单轮类别提示（如 "Name a tree."），每个模型问 8 次，按 exact match 计分，不使用 embedding 与 judge；v3 扩展到 105 个模型、含大厂与小模型分组、spread-free 分数、训练阶段 checkpoint 与人类常模对照。

papers.title: VLA Grounder: Language-Conditioning Space Optimization for Black-Box VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly treated as end-to-end action policies conditioned on natural-language task descriptions. In practice, however, their behavior often depends sharply on how the instruction is phrased, suggesting that language is not merely a task label but an optimizable conditioning input. We study whether frozen VLA policies can be improved by optimizing language space rather than updating action weights. Our method introduces a language-conditioning space policy that translates a human instruction into a short VLA-grounded command using object appearance, spatial relations, and target-grounding cues. The language-conditioning space policy is optimized with reinforcement learning from sparse task-completion rewards, while the downstream VLA remains fully frozen. Experiments on RL4VLA and VL-Think show that language-conditioning space optimization improves success on instruction-sensitive, symbolic, and multi-object manipulation tasks, demonstrating that language can serve as an optimizable variable for robot foundation models. Website: https://cognitiveaisystems.github.io/VLA-Grounder/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA Grounder 用强化学习优化冻结 VLA 策略的输入语言而非动作权重：把人类指令翻译成含物体外观、空间关系与目标 grounding 线索的短命令，仅训练这一语言条件空间策略，下游 VLA 完全冻结。在 RL4VLA 与 VL-Think 上，该优化提升了指令敏感、符号化与多物体操作任务的成功率。
Motivation: VLA 模型常被当作端到端动作策略，但其行为对指令措辞高度敏感，说明语言不只是任务标签，而是一个可优化的条件输入；直接更新动作权重代价大且不可行（模型为黑盒）。
Method: 引入 language-conditioning space policy，将人类指令转写为以物体外观、空间关系和 target-grounding 线索构成的短 VLA 命令；该策略用稀疏任务完成奖励的强化学习 (RL) 优化，下游 VLA 保持完全冻结。
Result: 在 RL4VLA 与 VL-Think 上的实验显示，language-conditioning space optimization 提升了指令敏感任务、符号化任务与多物体操作任务的成功率。
Conclusion: 语言可以作为机器人基础模型的可优化变量：只优化条件语言空间即可改善冻结 VLA 策略的表现，无需更新动作权重。

papers.title: 3D Point World Models: Point Completion Enables More Accurate Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning predictive models of the world enables robotic control through planning, potentially allowing robots to improvise solutions on new tasks. However, large video-based dynamics models lack explicit 3D spatial structure and suffer from geometrically inconsistent long-term rollouts with compounding errors. Emerging 3D dynamics models based on partial point clouds improve geometric consistency but remain sensitive to occlusions and accumulated prediction drift. To address these challenges, we present 3D Point World Models (3DPWM) - a task-agnostic world model that operates entirely in 3D space by first completing partial point clouds and then learning action-conditioned dynamics in this completed 3D scene. By operating on completed geometry, 3DPWM enables reliable long-horizon rollouts and more accurate cost evaluation for model-based planning while supporting adaptation to new tasks. Experiments across different robotic embodiments and tabletop manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that 3DPWM achieves significantly more reliable long-horizon rollouts (100-300+ steps), supports both open-loop and closed-loop planning, and enables successful sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3DPWM 先把部分点云补全成完整 3D 场景，再在补全几何上学动作条件动力学，使机器人长程 rollout 在 100–300+ 步上保持几何一致，从而支撑基于模型的规划与 sim-to-real 迁移。
Motivation: 纯视频动力学模型缺少显式 3D 结构，长程 rollout 几何不一致且误差累积；基于部分点云的 3D 动力学模型虽改善几何一致性，却对遮挡和预测漂移敏感。
Method: 3DPWM 分两步：先用点云补全 (point completion) 把部分点云补成完整场景，再在补全后的 3D 表示上学动作条件 (action-conditioned) 动力学，作为任务无关 (task-agnostic) 的世界模型供基于模型的规划做代价评估。
Result: 在多种机器人本体与桌面操作 benchmark 上，3DPWM 的长程 rollout 可靠延伸到 100–300+ 步，同时支持开环与闭环规划，并实现成功的 sim-to-real 迁移。
Conclusion: 在补全几何而非部分观测上学习动力学，是让世界模型长程 rollout 可靠、并迁移到新任务与真实机器人的关键。

papers.title: Learned Image Compression for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on high-frequency multi-camera observations, making visual communication a major bottleneck for real-time robotic control in bandwidth-constrained or distributed deployment settings. Existing image and video codecs, however, are designed to preserve generic visual fidelity rather than the control performance of downstream VLA policies. In this work, we introduce SPARC (SPatially Adaptive Rate Control), a learned image compression framework tailored for VLA-driven robots. Our key observation is that the importance of visual information varies substantially across both camera views and spatial regions within an image. Based on this observation, SPARC employs a lightweight temporal mask selector that adaptively allocates bitrate over latent representations according to task relevance while leveraging temporal context. We further introduce a tilted rate loss that stabilizes training by reducing the tendency of entropy-based objectives to over-suppress rare yet task-critical visual patterns. Experiments on diverse robotic benchmarks, including RoboCasa365, VLABench, and LIBERO, show that SPARC consistently achieves stronger control performance than conventional image/video codecs and recent learned compression methods under the same bitrate budget. We additionally demonstrate real-world deployment benefits in remote-control settings, where our method substantially improves the bitrate-success tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARC（SPatially Adaptive Rate Control）把图像压缩的目标从视觉保真改为 VLA 策略的控制性能：轻量时序掩码选择器按任务相关性在相机视图与空间区域间分配码率，倾斜率失真损失 (tilted rate loss) 抑制熵目标过度压制罕见但关键的视觉模式。在 RoboCasa365、VLABench、LIBERO 上，同码率预算下控制表现持续优于传统图像/视频编解码器与近期学习式压缩方法，远程控制场景的码率-成功率权衡显著改善。
Motivation: VLA 模型依赖高频多相机观测，视觉传输成为带宽受限或分布式部署下实时机器人控制的瓶颈；现有图像/视频编解码器优化通用视觉保真，而非下游 VLA 策略的控制性能。
Method: SPARC 是面向 VLA 机器人的学习式图像压缩框架：轻量时序掩码选择器依据任务相关性在 latent 表示上自适应分配码率并利用时序上下文；引入 tilted rate loss，降低基于熵的目标过度压制罕见但任务关键视觉模式的倾向，从而稳定训练。
Result: 在 RoboCasa365、VLABench、LIBERO 等机器人基准上，同码率预算下 SPARC 的控制表现持续强于传统图像/视频编解码器与近期学习式压缩方法；在远程控制真实部署中显著改善码率-成功率 (bitrate-success) 权衡。
Conclusion: 面向下游控制性能而非通用视觉保真来设计码率分配与率失真目标，能在带宽受限的 VLA 机器人部署中同时保住控制成功率并压低码率。

papers.title: Learning to Attack and Defend: Adaptive Red Teaming of Language Models via GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Language model safety must continually adapt to evolving attacks. Recent works have demonstrated that reinforcement learning can be used to train stronger attacker and defender models in tandem by applying PPO-style self-play and DPO-style online preference optimization. In this work, we explore the efficacy of GRPO in this setting. Co-training can be challenging because it requires jointly optimizing multiple properties of both the attacker and defender. We therefore shape model outputs using multiple LLM judge-based reward channels and compute advantages with GDPO, which prevents any single channel from dominating. Our method uses a curriculum that progresses from attacker-only single-turn and multi-turn training to co-training, where attacker and defender models are updated in alternation. We show that this method produces highly effective and transferable attacks, and that co-trained defenders reach competitive safety while preserving general utility. Through a controlled ablation, we further identify which components of our training pipeline most affect the resulting balance between safety and utility. Finally, we find that GRPO tends to collapse attacker diversity over training and discuss possible ways to address this limitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 GRPO 做红队攻击者与防御者的自博弈共训：多条 LLM judge 奖励通道塑造输出，GDPO 计算优势防止单通道主导，课程从攻击者单轮/多轮训练推进到交替更新的共训。产出的攻击高效且可迁移，防御者在保住通用能力的同时达到有竞争力的安全性；但 GRPO 训练中攻击者多样性会坍缩。
Motivation: 语言模型安全需随攻击演化持续更新，已有 PPO 自博弈与 DPO 在线偏好优化能同时训强攻击者和防御者，但共训要联合优化双方多个属性，优化本身困难。
Method: 以 GRPO 替代 PPO 式自博弈，用多条基于 LLM judge 的奖励通道塑造攻击者与防御者输出，并用 GDPO 计算优势使任一通道都不占主导；训练课程从攻击者单轮、多轮训练过渡到攻击者与防御者交替更新的共训，另做受控消融定位影响安全-效用平衡的组件。
Result: 该方法产生高效且可迁移的攻击，共训防御者在保持通用效用的同时达到有竞争力的安全性；受控消融识别出训练管线中对安全-效用平衡影响最大的组件；发现 GRPO 在训练过程中倾向于让攻击者多样性坍缩。
Conclusion: GRPO 加 GDPO 多通道优势与课程化共训可以同时训出强攻击者和不掉通用能力的防御者，但攻击者多样性坍缩是该配方需要解决的固有限制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Estimation of the sub-Gaussian Parameter
papers.abstract_en: The sub-Gaussian parameter (also called the variance proxy) of a mean-zero random variable $X$ is defined as $ξ^2_\star = \sup_{λ\in \mathbb{R}} L(λ)$ where $L(λ) = \frac{2}{λ^2} \log \mathbb{E} e^{λX}$ is a weighted cumulant generating function. We study the estimation of $ξ^2_\star$ and prove that the minimax risk is governed by a non-increasing function $δ_P(C) = \sup_{|λ| \geq C} L(λ) - \sup_{|λ| \leq C} L(λ)$ which captures the influence of the tail behavior of the distribution $P$. Over the class of distributions with $δ_P \leq r$ for a non-increasing function $r$, the minimax risk is, up to a multiplicative constant, lower bounded by $r(\sqrt{\log n}) + n^{-1/2}$ and upper bounded by $r((\log n)^{1/2-\varepsilon}) + n^{-1/2 + \varepsilon}$ for any $\varepsilon > 0$. Our estimator for the upper bound is based on constrained maximization of the empirical analogue of $L$. In addition to being almost minimax optimal and adaptive, we further prove that the estimator is asymptotic normal under suitable conditions and that, if the underlying distribution is not sub-Gaussian, the estimator diverges with a rate determined by the heaviness of the distributional tail.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 次高斯参数作为集中不等式中的方差代理被广泛使用，但其估计的极小极大风险如何依赖分布尾部行为此前缺少刻画，需要判定估计难度究竟由什么量决定。

papers.title: LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Implicit chain-of-thought (iCoT) methods aim to internalize reasoning in large language models, but often underperform explicit CoT prompting. We empirically find that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure. Motivated by this observation, we propose a low-rank distillation framework that transfers reasoning by aligning teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. The resulting formulation captures the global structure of reasoning while supporting a compact latent reasoning process. We evaluate the method across multiple model families, including LLaMA and Qwen, at different scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves performance, especially on challenging multi-step tasks, approaching explicit CoT accuracy and outperforming prior iCoT distillation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoRi 用低秩蒸馏把显式 CoT 的推理过程压进隐式推理 (iCoT)：对齐教师与学生隐状态轨迹的一阶与二阶统计量，使其落在共享低秩张量子空间中。在 LLaMA、Qwen 等多个模型家族与规模的数学推理基准上，该方法一致提升 iCoT 性能，多步难题上提升最明显，逼近显式 CoT 准确率并超过既有 iCoT 蒸馏方法。
Motivation: 隐式链式推理 (iCoT) 把推理内化进模型后往往不如显式 CoT prompting，原因是缺少对隐状态推理轨迹结构的显式约束。
Method: 先实证发现隐状态推理轨迹呈低秩结构，再提出低秩蒸馏框架：用一阶与二阶统计量在共享低秩张量子空间中对齐教师与学生的推理轨迹，从而捕捉推理的全局结构并支撑紧凑的隐式推理过程。
Result: 在 LLaMA 与 Qwen 等多个模型家族、不同规模的数学推理基准上一致提升隐式推理性能，多步难题上提升尤其明显，逼近显式 CoT 的准确率，并优于此前的 iCoT 蒸馏方法。
Conclusion: 隐式推理的性能差距可以靠低秩轨迹对齐来弥合：把显式 CoT 的推理结构蒸馏到低秩张量子空间，iCoT 能接近显式 CoT 的准确率。

papers.title: Decision-Focused On-Policy Learning for Contextual Linear Optimization with Partial Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models by optimizing downstream decision quality rather than standalone prediction accuracy. For contextual linear optimization, most existing DFL methods assume offline data and full observations of the objective cost vector. We develop an on-policy learning method for sequential contextual linear optimization under partial feedback, generalizing the standard bandit feedback setting. Our method learns a stochastic predict-then-optimize policy that samples a cost-vector prediction from a conditional distribution and solves the resulting downstream linear optimization problem. To update this distributional model, we introduce a two-component hybrid gradient estimator. The first component is a score function estimator, which provides an unbiased but potentially high-variance policy gradient estimate. The second is a decision-focused plug-in component that uses an auxiliary nuisance estimate of the latent cost vector to exploit the downstream optimization structure, becoming more informative as the estimate improves. We prove an O(T^-1/2) bound on the average squared policy-gradient norm, matching the standard non-convex SGD rate. Experiments on top-k selection, shortest path, combinatorial pricing, and a real-data energy-scheduling benchmark show that, under bandit feedback, the hybrid gradient approach achieves lower mean cumulative regret than the contextual-bandit baselines on all four benchmarks and than linear Thompson sampling on three, and that it also works with richer conditional generative cost models. Code is available at https://github.com/Joeyetinghan/on-policy-bandit-dfl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分反馈（bandit feedback）下的序贯上下文线性优化中，提出 on-policy 决策聚焦学习 (DFL)：从条件分布采样代价向量预测再解下游线性规划，并用 score function + decision-focused plug-in 的混合梯度估计器更新该分布。证明平均平方策略梯度范数为 O(T^-1/2)，在 top-k、最短路、组合定价与真实数据能源调度四个基准上，混合梯度的平均累积 regret 均低于 contextual-bandit 基线，其中三个低于 linear Thompson sampling。
Motivation: 现有上下文线性优化的 DFL 方法大多假设离线数据且能完整观测目标代价向量，无法处理序贯决策中只观察到所选动作代价的部分反馈情形。
Method: 学习一个随机 predict-then-optimize 策略：从条件分布采样代价向量预测，再求解对应的下游线性优化问题；更新用两部分混合梯度估计器——无偏但高方差的 score function 策略梯度，加上利用潜在代价向量辅助 nuisance 估计、随估计改进而更有信息量的 decision-focused plug-in 项，推广标准 bandit feedback 设定。
Result: 证明平均平方策略梯度范数的 O(T^-1/2) 界，与标准非凸 SGD 速率一致；在 bandit feedback 下，混合梯度方法在 top-k selection、shortest path、combinatorial pricing 和真实数据 energy-scheduling 四个基准上平均累积 regret 均低于 contextual-bandit 基线，其中三个低于 linear Thompson sampling，并可与更丰富的条件生成式代价模型配合。
Conclusion: 把下游优化结构通过 plug-in 项注入梯度估计，可在部分反馈的序贯上下文线性优化中取得比纯 bandit 算法更低的累积 regret，且收敛速率不劣于标准非凸 SGD。

papers.title: Memory by Design: Probabilistic Sequence Layers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the \emph{design-model framework}: a way to derive efficient recurrent sequence maps from explicit assumptions about memory. A design model writes evidence into memory by exact Bayesian filtering; a query- dependent readout produces a predictive distribution whose mean is the layer output. In our linear-Gaussian instantiation, the \emph{Bayesian Layer} propagates both a mean and a covariance: the covariance tracks uncertainty over stored associations, steering writes toward uncertain directions, attenuating gains as evidence accumulates, and preserving confident memories. The same framework unifies several sub-quadratic recurrences: linear attention, GLA, and Mamba-2/SSD are exact filters under a latent-input design model, whereas DeltaNet and related Delta-rule models are covariance-reset reductions of the Bayesian Layer's design model. Restoring covariance propagation yields closed-form predictions for retrieval dynamics, which we verify empirically, and improves robustness beyond the training regime in controlled collision studies, learned associative recall, and the Zoology MQAR benchmark. Training from scratch on WikiText-103 under matched state budgets lowers perplexity on associative-recall hits. Distilling Bayesian Layers into a pretrained 340M Gated DeltaNet improves RULER long-context retrieval over a matched-compute control, at a 2.5--2.7\% held-out perplexity cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 design-model 框架：把对记忆的显式假设写成线性高斯设计模型，用精确贝叶斯滤波推导高效递归序列层（Bayesian Layer 同时传播均值与协方差，协方差引导写入走向不确定方向、随证据积累衰减增益）。该框架把 linear attention、GLA、Mamba-2/SSD 统一为精确滤波器，把 DeltaNet 类模型统一为协方差重置简化；恢复协方差传播后在受控碰撞研究、联想召回与 Zoology MQAR 上提升训练域外鲁棒性，蒸馏进 340M Gated DeltaNet 提升 RULER 长上下文检索，代价是 2.5–2.7% 留出困惑度。
Motivation: 次二次复杂度递归层各自源于不同启发式，缺少从记忆假设出发的统一推导，且在训练分布之外的检索行为缺乏可预测的理论刻画。
Method: design-model 框架用精确贝叶斯滤波把证据写入记忆，查询相关 readout 产生预测分布并以均值作为层输出；线性高斯实例即 Bayesian Layer，同时传播均值与协方差。协方差追踪存储关联的不确定性，指导写入、衰减增益并保留高置信记忆；由此闭式推导检索动力学，并与 linear attention、GLA、Mamba-2/SSD、DeltaNet 建立精确滤波或协方差重置的对应。
Result: 在 WikiText-103 从头训练、状态预算匹配的条件下，联想召回命中项困惑度下降；恢复协方差传播在受控碰撞研究、学习式联想召回与 Zoology MQAR 上提升训练域外鲁棒性，闭式检索动力学预测经实证验证；蒸馏 Bayesian Layer 到预训练 340M Gated DeltaNet，在匹配算力对照之上改善 RULER 长上下文检索，留出困惑度代价为 2.5–2.7%。
Conclusion: 把记忆假设显式写成设计模型并恢复协方差传播，可以统一解释并改进次二次递归层的检索动力学与域外鲁棒性，代价是可量化的小幅困惑度损失。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Distillation Game: Adaptive Evaluations & Efficient Defenses
papers.abstract_en: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a cheap proxy for example value, we derive Product-of-Experts (PoE), a simple forward-pass-only defense that combines the teacher with a proxy student during generation. Empirically, adaptive evaluation reveals a large passive--adaptive gap: on state-of-the-art defenses, adaptive students recover substantially more capability than passive evaluation suggests on GSM8K and MATH. Under this stronger evaluation, the apparent robustness gap between expensive defenses and PoE narrows considerably, while PoE remains substantially cheaper and preserves higher-quality reasoning traces. Overall, our results suggest that strong distillation remains difficult to stop, and that progress on antidistillation should be judged against adaptive students rather than passive ones. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ysfalh/distillation-game.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把蒸馏攻防建模为效用受限 teacher 与自适应 student 之间的极小极大博弈，导出单侧响应规则：student 按样本价值重加权的自适应评估，以及 teacher 抑制对蒸馏最有用输出的防御模板。由样本价值的廉价代理推出只需前向传播的 Product-of-Experts (PoE) 防御。自适应评估显示被动评估低估了 student 恢复的能力：在 GSM8K 与 MATH 上，对最先进防御的自适应攻击恢复的能力远多于被动评估所示，昂贵防御与 PoE 之间的表面稳健性差距因此大幅收窄，而 PoE 便宜得多且保留更高质量的推理轨迹。
Motivation: 模型输出越有用越容易被蒸馏模仿，形成部署权衡；但现有防御多用被动评估衡量，会系统性低估自适应 student 的能力恢复，导致防御优劣判断失真。
Method: 将蒸馏攻防形式化为效用受限 teacher 与自适应 student 的极小极大博弈，推导可解的单侧响应规则：student 端按样本价值重加权的自适应评估规则，teacher 端抑制高蒸馏价值输出的防御模板；再由样本价值的廉价代理构造 PoE，生成时把 teacher 与代理 student 组合，仅需前向传播。

papers.title: 4D-GSW: Kinematic-Aware Spatio-Temporal Consistent Watermarking for 4D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: While 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has revolutionized high-fidelity dynamic reconstruction, safeguarding the intellectual property of these assets remains an open challenge. Conventional steganographic techniques often neglect the underlying kinematic manifolds, triggering non-physical artifacts such as severe temporal flickering and "FVD collapse". To address this, we propose \textbf{4D-GSW}, a kinematic-aware watermarking framework designed to embed robust copyright information while preserving high spatio-temporal consistency. Unlike prior 4D steganography that primarily focuses on opacity-guided invisibility, our approach explicitly addresses the physical coherence of motion trajectories. We introduce a \textbf{Spatio-Temporal Curvature (STC)} metric to identify "Dynamic Instants," adaptively gating watermark gradient injection to shield critical motion manifolds from non-physical perturbations. To ensure global coherence across complex deformations, we formulate a joint \textbf{HMM-MRF energy minimization} model that synchronizes watermark phases within both temporal trajectories and spatial neighborhoods. Furthermore, an \textbf{anisotropic gradient routing} mechanism ensures that watermark embedding remains strictly decoupled from photometric reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the superior performance of our method in robustly hiding watermarks while resisting various attacks and maintaining high rendering quality and spatiotemporal consistency.
papers.comment: 9 pages main paper, 7 figures, 18 pages in total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4D-GSW 针对 4D Gaussian Splatting 资产的版权水印，用 Spatio-Temporal Curvature (STC) 识别 Dynamic Instants 并自适应门控水印梯度注入，避开关键运动流形以抑制时间闪烁与 FVD collapse。再用 HMM-MRF 联合能量最小化同步时间轨迹与空间邻域内的水印相位，各向异性梯度路由把水印嵌入与光度重建解耦，从而在抗攻击隐藏水印的同时保持渲染质量与时空一致性。
Motivation: 4DGS 动态重建资产的知识产权保护仍是开放问题；传统隐写忽略运动流形 (kinematic manifolds)，引入严重时间闪烁与 FVD collapse 等非物理伪影，既有 4D 隐写只关注 opacity 引导的不可见性而不管运动轨迹的物理一致性。
Method: 提出 kinematic-aware 水印框架 4D-GSW：定义 Spatio-Temporal Curvature (STC) 度量定位 Dynamic Instants，自适应门控水印梯度注入以保护关键运动流形；用联合 HMM-MRF 能量最小化模型在时间轨迹与空间邻域内同步水印相位；各向异性梯度路由 (anisotropic gradient routing) 使水印嵌入与光度重建保真度严格解耦。
Result: 摘要称大量实验证明该方法在抵抗多种攻击的同时稳健隐藏水印，并保持高渲染质量与时空一致性，且性能优于既有方法；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把运动流形的物理一致性显式纳入水印设计（而非只做不可见性），可在 4DGS 上同时实现鲁棒版权嵌入与高保真时空渲染。

papers.title: Fast Adversarial Attacks with Gradient Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Generating adversarial examples at scale is a core primitive for robustness evaluation, adversarial training, and red-teaming, yet even "fast" attacks such as FGSM remain throughput-limited by the cost of a backward pass. We introduce a family of attacks that eliminates the backward pass by predicting the input gradient from forward-pass hidden states via a lightweight linear regression. Theoretically, we derive exact affine conditional gradient means, showing optimality in the (idealized) NTK regime. Empirically, our methods work when applied to practical finite-width models; we recover much of FGSM's attack performance while using only a small fraction of the time, corresponding to a $532\%$ increase in throughput. These results suggest gradient prediction as a simple and general route to significantly faster adversarial generation under realistic wall-clock constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用轻量线性回归从 forward pass 的隐层状态直接预测输入梯度，从而完全去掉 backward pass 的对抗样本生成方法。理论上在理想化 NTK regime 下梯度条件均值是精确仿射的、该预测是最优的；在有限宽度实用模型上仍能保住 FGSM 大部分攻击效果，吞吐量提升 532%。
Motivation: 大规模对抗样本生成是鲁棒性评估、对抗训练和 red-teaming 的基础操作，但即使是 FGSM 这类「快」攻击也被 backward pass 的开销卡住吞吐量。
Method: 用轻量线性回归从 forward pass 的隐层状态预测输入梯度，绕开 backward pass；理论部分推导梯度的精确仿射条件均值，并在理想化 NTK regime 下证明最优性。
Result: 在有限宽度实用模型上恢复了 FGSM 攻击性能的很大一部分，同时只花掉一小部分时间，对应吞吐量提升 532%。
Conclusion: 梯度预测是在真实 wall-clock 约束下大幅加速对抗样本生成的简单且通用的路径，代价是相对 FGSM 有部分性能损失。

papers.title: Don't Get Your Kroneckers in a Twist: Gaussian Processes on High-Dimensional Incomplete Grids
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CUTS-GPR, a new method for performing numerically exact GPR in high-dimensional settings. The key component of CUTS-GPR is an extremely fast kernel matrix-vector product, which exhibits near-linear or even linear scaling with the amount of training data, $N$, and low-order polynomial scaling with dimensionality, $D$. This is obtained by combining an additive kernel with an incomplete grid and exploiting the resulting structure of the kernel matrix. The scalability of the matrix-vector product is verified by benchmarks with billions of data points and thousands of dimensions. We demonstrate the end-to-end scalability of CUTS-GPR by running full GPR calculations, including hyperparameter optimization, on synthetic datasets with up to $N = 4\,494\,001$ and $D = 500$. As a realistic and challenging test, we finally apply CUTS-GPR to a set of ten potential energy surfaces (PESs) with $N = 447\,265$ and $D = 24$. The calculations are completed in a matter of hours, showing that CUTS-GPR enables Bayesian modelling of high-dimensional PESs - a longstanding challenge in computational chemistry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CUTS-GPR：用可加核 (additive kernel) 配合不完全网格 (incomplete grid) 构造核矩阵结构，得到近线性乃至线性随训练量 N 扩展、对维度 D 仅低阶多项式扩展的核矩阵-向量乘，使高维 GPR 仍数值精确。端到端含超参优化在 N=4,494,001、D=500 的合成数据上跑通，十个势能面 (PES) 上 N=447,265、D=24 数小时内完成。
Motivation: 高维大样本下 GPR 的核矩阵运算代价随 N 与 D 急剧膨胀，Bayesian 建模难以用于计算化学中高维势能面这类长期难题。
Method: CUTS-GPR 将可加核与不完全网格结合，利用由此产生的核矩阵结构实现极快的核矩阵-向量乘；在此之上执行完整 GPR 计算，含超参数优化。
Result: 矩阵-向量乘的可扩展性在数十亿数据点、数千维度的基准上验证；端到端完整 GPR（含超参优化）在合成数据 N=4,494,001、D=500 上完成；在十个势能面 (PES) 上以 N=447,265、D=24 于数小时内算完。
Conclusion: 借助可加核与不完全网格的结构，数值精确的 GPR 可扩展到高维大样本，使高维 PES 的 Bayesian 建模成为可行。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Recent growth in reinforcement learning (RL) has surfaced a need for diverse, specialized training environments. Hand-curated environments with fixed task and reward difficulties become ineffective signals as model performance improves, and sparse rewards over long horizons induce mode collapse on specific workflows or tool structures. World models that simulate environment states have matched pure rollout performance, making them promising for scaling diversity on-demand. However, autoregressive (AR) world models suffer from a left-to-right bias preventing conditioning on globally interdependent state anchors such as tool schemas, prior turns, and expected outcomes. We (i) formalize text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives, and (ii) curate 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning nine open-source environments and twelve frontier model families. We compare AR LMs and masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), showing MDLMs, via bidirectional anchor-aware denoising, achieve better coherence, groundedness, and empirically validated rollout diversity than LLMs over 4x their parameter size, at comparable inference latency. We introduce a plug-and-play GRPO training framework with deterministic state checks, and perform zero-shot transfer ablations on three OOD environments (ScienceWorld, ALFWorld, AppWorld) across three 1.2B-7B agent backbones (LFM2.5, Qwen3, Mistral), achieving up to 47% absolute gains over baselines without environment-specific fine-tuning. We further conduct behavioral analysis of failure modes under adversarial scenarios and human evaluation on realism, outcome correctness, and training utility. We open-source our work to encourage research in this direction.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Dataset: https://huggingface.co/PatronusAI/world_model_corpus Training code: https://github.com/patronus-ai/mdlm_world_modeling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于文本的世界模型形式化为可操控的转移动力学问题，用掩码扩散语言模型 (MDLM) 的双向锚点感知去噪替代自回归生成，以同时条件化工具 schema、历史轮次与预期结果等全局耦合状态。在 239,403 条轨迹上训练后，MDLM 在相干性、接地性与 rollout 多样性上超过 4 倍参数量的 LLM 且推理延迟相当；配合带确定性状态检查的 GRPO，在三个 OOD 环境上零样本迁移最高取得 47% 绝对增益。
Motivation: 手工构建、任务与奖励难度固定的 RL 环境随模型变强而失去信号价值，长程稀疏奖励还会让策略在特定工作流或工具结构上模式坍缩；自回归世界模型的从左到右偏置又无法以全局互相依赖的状态锚点为条件。
Method: 将文本世界建模分解为初始状态、任务上下文、工具 schema、领域规则与操控指令五个可控输入；策展 239,403 条 grounded 状态-动作轨迹，覆盖九个开源环境与十二个前沿模型家族；对比 AR LM 与 MDLM，并引入即插即用的 GRPO 训练框架，配确定性状态检查 (deterministic state checks)。
Result: MDLM 凭借双向锚点感知去噪，在相干性、接地性与经实证验证的 rollout 多样性上优于参数量 4 倍以上的 LLM，推理延迟相当。在 ScienceWorld、ALFWorld、AppWorld 三个 OOD 环境上，对 LFM2.5、Qwen3、Mistral 三种 1.2B–7B agent 骨干做零样本迁移消融，相对基线最高取得 47% 绝对增益，无需环境特定微调。另对对抗场景下的失败模式做行为分析，并在真实性、结果正确性与训练效用上做人类评估。
Conclusion: MDLM 的双向锚点条件化使其成为比同规模 AR 模型更强且可操控的文本世界模型，配合带确定性状态检查的 GRPO 可在未见环境上零样本提升 agent 策略，无需逐环境微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging the Last Mile of Circuit Design: PostEDA-Bench, a Hierarchical Benchmark for PPA Convergence and DRC Fixing
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly applied to the "last mile" of Electronic Design Automation (EDA): repairing residual sign-off Design Rule Check (DRC) violations and converging Power-Performance-Area (PPA) targets after tool runs. Existing EDA-LLM benchmarks, however, omit DRC fixing entirely and rely on flat hierarchies tied to a single toolchain. We introduce PostEDA-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark with 145 tasks across DRC-Essential, DRC-Reasoning, PPA-Mono, and PPA-Multi, supported by EDA toolchains with machine-checkable evaluation. Across eight commercial and open-source LLMs under multiple agent scaffolds, we find that agents handle synthetic DRC-Essential and single-objective PPA-Mono reasonably well but degrade sharply on the more practical DRC-Reasoning, where the best success rate is 36.66%, and PPA-Multi, where the best success rate is 20.00%; vision augmentation consistently enhances DRC-Bench; and trade-off reasoning, rather than knob knowledge, is the dominant PPA-Multi bottleneck.

papers.title: Grokking or Glitching? How Low-Precision Drives Slingshot Loss Spikes
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks exhibit periodic loss spikes during unregularized long-term training, a phenomenon known as the "Slingshot Mechanism." Existing work usually attributes this to intrinsic optimization dynamics, but its triggering mechanism remains unclear. This paper proves that this phenomenon is a result of floating-point arithmetic precision limits. As training enters a high-confidence stage, the difference between the correct-class logit and the other logits may exceed the absorption-error threshold. Then during backpropagation, the gradient of the correct class is rounded exactly to zero, while the gradients of the incorrect classes remain nonzero. This breaks the zero-sum constraint of gradients across classes and introduces a systematic drift in the parameter update of the classifier layer. We prove that this drift forms a positive feedback loop with the feature, causing the global classifier mean and the global feature mean to grow exponentially. We call this mechanism Numerical Feature Inflation (NFI). This mechanism explains the rapid norm growth before a Slingshot spike, the subsequent reappearance of gradients, and the resulting loss spike. We further show that NFI is not equivalent to an observed loss spike: in more practical tasks, partial absorption may not produce visible spikes, but it can still break the zero-sum constraint and drive rapid growth of parameter norms. Our results reinterpret Slingshot as a numerical dynamic of finite-precision training, and provide a testable explanation for abnormal parameter growth and logit divergence in late-stage training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明训练后期的 Slingshot 损失尖峰源于浮点精度极限而非纯优化动力学：当正确类 logit 与其他 logit 之差超过吸收误差阈值时，反向传播中正确类梯度被舍入为零而错误类梯度非零，破坏跨类梯度零和约束，作者称之为 Numerical Feature Inflation (NFI)。NFI 与特征形成正反馈，使全局分类器均值与特征均值指数增长，解释尖峰前的范数暴涨、梯度重现与随后的损失尖峰；在更实际任务中部分吸收不产生可见尖峰，但仍驱动参数范数快速增长。
Motivation: 无正则长期训练中周期性损失尖峰（Slingshot Mechanism）的触发机制此前不清楚，既有工作多归因于内在优化动力学。
Method: 从浮点吸收误差阈值出发做理论证明：高置信阶段正确类 logit 差超过阈值导致正确类梯度被精确舍入为零，破坏跨类梯度零和约束，进而在分类器层参数更新中引入系统性漂移；证明该漂移与特征构成正反馈环，使全局分类器均值与全局特征均值指数增长（NFI 机制）。
Result: 证明 NFI 解释 Slingshot 尖峰前的快速范数增长、尖峰后梯度重现与损失尖峰本身；并证明 NFI 不等价于可观测的损失尖峰——在更实际任务中部分吸收不产生可见尖峰，但仍破坏零和约束并驱动参数范数快速增长。
Conclusion: Slingshot 应重新解释为有限精度训练的数值动力学，NFI 为训练后期异常参数增长与 logit 发散提供了可检验的解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: State Stream Transformer (SST) V2: Parallel Training of Nonlinear Recurrence for Latent Space Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Current transformers discard their rich latent residual stream between positions, reconstructing latent reasoning context at each new position and leaving potential reasoning capacity untapped. The State Stream Transformer (SST) V2 enables parameter-efficient reasoning in continuous latent space through an FFN-driven nonlinear recurrence at each decoder layer, where latent states are streamed horizontally across the full sequence via a learned blend. This same mechanism supports continuous latent deliberation per position at inference time, dedicating additional FLOPs to exploring abstract reasoning before committing to a token. A two-pass parallel training procedure approximates the sequential recurrence, making co-training computationally practical. Hidden state analysis shows that the state stream facilitates reasoning through sharp, content-dependent reorganisations in continuous latent space; the LM head exposes the resulting latent belief states through the output distribution, while the state stream carries them forward to influence future positions. A learned probe shows that at the first generated token, the latent state already predicts whether the eventual answer will survive or break under additional latent computation for every subsequent position. Co-trained into an existing 27B backbone using only a small dataset of GSM8K examples and evaluated using an oracle to route each question to a depth of one to four recurrent forward passes per token, the SST achieves an architectural capacity bound of 61.11% on out-of-distribution GPQA-Diamond, a +15.15 point gain over a fine-tuning-matched baseline, and cuts that same baseline's remaining GSM8K errors by 46%. Together, these results provide a method for efficiently training a nonlinear recurrence and show that the state stream provides additional reasoning capacity beyond that of an otherwise training-matched transformer.
papers.comment: 51 pages, 21 figures. Added exact-recurrence validation experiment, and more detailed training and inference costs; clarified architectural-capacity evaluation and corrected the flat-depth overthinking analysis. Headline results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SST V2 在每个 decoder 层用 FFN 驱动的非线性递归把隐状态沿序列横向流动，并用两遍并行训练近似顺序递归，使连续隐空间推理可训练。在 27B backbone 上仅用少量 GSM8K 样本共训、推理时用 oracle 为每 token 路由 1–4 次递归前向，OOD GPQA-Diamond 达到 61.11% 的架构容量上界，比微调匹配基线高 15.15 个百分点，并把该基线在 GSM8K 上的剩余错误削减 46%。
Motivation: 标准 transformer 在每个位置丢弃前一位置的隐残差流，推理上下文被反复重建，连续隐空间中潜在的推理容量没有被利用。
Method: 每层以 FFN 驱动的非线性递归经 learned blend 把隐状态横向流过整条序列；推理时可在每个位置追加 FLOPs 做连续 latent deliberation 再输出 token；用两遍并行训练近似顺序递归，使其计算上可行。共训到一个已有 27B backbone，训练数据仅为少量 GSM8K 样本，评测用 oracle 把每题路由到每 token 1–4 次递归前向。
Result: OOD GPQA-Diamond 上取得 61.11% 的 architectural capacity bound，比 fine-tuning-matched baseline 高 15.15 个百分点；同一基线在 GSM8K 上的剩余错误被削减 46%。隐状态分析显示 state stream 在连续隐空间中出现尖锐的、内容依赖的重组；学到的 probe 在第一个生成 token 处即可预测最终答案在后续每个位置追加隐计算后会 survive 还是 break。
Conclusion: 两遍并行训练能有效训练非线性递归，state stream 在训练匹配的 transformer 之外提供了额外推理容量；probe 表明首个 token 处的隐状态已携带答案稳健性的信息，可用于决定后续递归深度。

papers.title: ShapeY: A Principled Framework for Measuring Shape Recognition Capacity via Nearest-Neighbor Matching
papers.abstract_en: Object recognition (OR) in humans relies heavily on shape cues and the ability to recognize objects across varying 3D viewpoints. Unlike humans, deep networks often rely on non-shape cues such as texture and background, leading to vulnerabilities in generalization and robustness. To address this gap, we introduce ShapeY, a novel and principled benchmarking framework designed to evaluate shape-based recognition capability in OR systems. ShapeY comprises 68,200 grayscale images of 200 3D objects rendered from multiple viewpoints and optionally subjected to non-shape ``appearance'' changes. Using a nearest-neighbor matching task, ShapeY specifically probes the fine-grained structure of an OR system's embedding space by evaluating whether object views are clustered by 3D shape similarity across varying 3D viewpoints and other non-shape changes. ShapeY provides a suite of quantitative and qualitative performance readouts, including error rate graphs, viewpoint tuning curves, histograms of positive and negative matching scores, and grids showing ordered best matches, which together offer a comprehensive evaluation of an OR system's shape understanding capability. Testing of 321 pre-trained networks with diverse architectures reveals significant challenges in achieving robust shape-based recognition: even state-of-the-art models struggle to generalize consistently across 3D viewpoint and appearance changes, and are prone to infrequent but egregious matches of objects of obviously completely different shape. ShapeY establishes a principled framework for advancing artificial vision systems toward human-like shape recognition capabilities, emphasizing the importance of disentangled and invariant object encodings.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (09/2026) https://openreview.net/pdf?id=cTm6EecEBY
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShapeY 用 68,200 张灰度渲染图与最近邻匹配任务，度量物体识别系统的形状表征能力：检验 embedding 是否按 3D 形状相似度跨视角聚类。对 321 个预训练网络的测试显示，包括 SOTA 在内的模型都难以一致地跨 3D 视角与外观变化泛化，并会偶发但严重地匹配形状完全不同的物体。
Motivation: 人类物体识别高度依赖形状并能跨 3D 视角泛化，而深度网络常依赖纹理、背景等非形状线索，导致泛化与鲁棒性脆弱；现有评测缺少对 embedding 空间形状结构的细粒度度量。
Method: ShapeY 渲染 200 个 3D 物体的多视角灰度图共 68,200 张，可叠加非形状的外观变化；用最近邻匹配任务探测 embedding 空间的细粒度结构，判断物体视图是否按 3D 形状相似度聚类，并给出误差率曲线、视角调谐曲线、正负匹配分数直方图与有序最佳匹配网格等读出。
Result: 在 321 个不同架构的预训练网络上测试：包括最先进模型在内都难以一致地跨 3D 视角与外观变化泛化，且会偶发但严重地匹配形状明显完全不同的物体。
Conclusion: 形状鲁棒识别仍是深度网络的普遍短板，人工视觉系统需要解耦且不变的物体编码 (disentangled and invariant object encodings) 才能逼近人类的形状识别能力。

papers.title: Provably Efficient Offline-to-Online Value Adaptation with General Function Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study value adaptation in offline-to-online reinforcement learning under general function approximation. Starting from an imperfect offline pretrained $Q$-function, the learner aims to adapt it to the target environment using only a limited amount of online interaction. We first characterize the difficulty of this setting by establishing a minimax lower bound, showing that even when the pretrained $Q$-function is close to optimal $Q^\star$, online adaptation can be no more efficient than pure online RL on certain hard instances. On the positive side, under a novel structural condition on the offline-pretrained value functions, we propose O2O-LSVI, an adaptation algorithm with problem-dependent sample complexity that provably improves over pure online RL. Finally, we complement our theory with neural-network experiments that demonstrate the practical effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在一般函数逼近下研究离线到在线强化学习的价值适应：先用极小极大下界证明，即使预训练 Q 接近最优 Q*，某些困难实例上在线适应也不会比纯在线 RL 更高效；再对离线预训练价值函数施加新的结构条件，提出 O2O-LSVI，其问题依赖的样本复杂度可证明优于纯在线 RL，并有神经网络实验佐证实用性。
Motivation: 从不完美的离线预训练 Q 出发、只用少量在线交互做适应时，何时能真正省下在线样本缺乏刻画：既要说明最坏情形下省不了，也要给出能省的条件。
Method: 先建立该设定的极小极大下界刻画难度；再对离线预训练价值函数引入新的结构条件，提出 O2O-LSVI 算法，其样本复杂度是问题依赖的；最后用神经网络实验检验方法的实际效果。
Result: 下界表明即使预训练 Q 接近 Q*，在某些困难实例上在线适应的效率不高于纯在线 RL；在新结构条件下 O2O-LSVI 的问题依赖样本复杂度可证明优于纯在线 RL；神经网络实验展示了所提方法的实际有效性。
Conclusion: 离线预训练的价值能否在少量在线交互中兑现，取决于预训练 Q 是否满足特定结构条件，而非仅仅接近最优。

papers.title: Soft Tournament Equilibrium: Differentiable Set-Valued Inference for Non-Transitive Pairwise Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: Soft Tournament Equilibrium (STE) is a differentiable layer for Top-Cycle (TC) and Uncovered-Set (UC) inference from reciprocal pair probabilities. Normalized log-sum-exp reachability and covering give smooth scores with approximation, perturbation, and margin-recovery bounds. We distinguish structural supervision, posterior uncertainty, and the final set decision through controlled synthetic studies and reconstruction of recorded ordinal profiles. Matched-epoch training improves F1 under a common structural readout, but a separate equal-budget soft-UC comparison does not demonstrate an advantage. A prospective equal-budget hard-UC study improves selective F1 at 24 alternatives from 0.6327/0.6292 for ordinary/relational native heads to 0.6676, while exact recovery remains only 1.16%. On 36 human profiles held out by source, a separate exploratory comparison favors Jeffreys posterior inference over learned independent-edge and mixture distributions in native expected-F1 decoding (0.8742 versus 0.8704/0.8366). Only three references are non-singleton selective cores. Completion certificates and full-depth TC diagnostics clarify additional identification, smoothing, and computational limits. The evidence supports conditional synthetic overlap gains, while preserving the soft-set null and the absence of a demonstrated learning advantage over strong count-based human-profile controls.
papers.comment: Expanded empirical evaluation with native count/posterior controls and complete supporting proofs; disclosed and excluded an invalid secondary mixture decoder diagnostic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Soft Tournament Equilibrium (STE)：一个可微层，用归一化 log-sum-exp 的可达性与覆盖关系从成对胜率推断 Top-Cycle 与 Uncovered-Set 集合值输出，并给出逼近、扰动与 margin-recovery 界。前瞻等预算硬 UC 实验中 24 个候选的选择性 F1 从普通/关系原生头的 0.6327/0.6292 提到 0.6676，但精确恢复率仅 1.16%；36 个人类序数剖面上 Jeffreys 后验在原生期望 F1 解码中以 0.8742 对 0.8704/0.8366 略胜学习到的独立边与混合分布。作者结论是证据只支持条件性的合成重叠增益，未证明相对强计数基线的学习优势。
Motivation: 非传递成对比较需要输出集合而非单点胜者，但硬集合规则不可微、难以与学习组件联合训练；同时结构监督、后验不确定性与最终集合决策常被混在一起，导致增益来源不清。
Method: STE 对成对概率矩阵做归一化 log-sum-exp 的可达性与覆盖打分，得到 Top-Cycle 与 Uncovered-Set 的光滑近似并附逼近、扰动与 margin-recovery 界；用受控合成研究与录制序数剖面重建区分结构监督、后验不确定性与集合决策，训练上做 matched-epoch 结构读出与等预算硬 UC/软 UC 对照，并以 completion certificates 与全深度 TC 诊断核查识别与计算限制。
Result: 前瞻等预算硬 UC 研究在 24 个候选上把选择性 F1 从 0.6327（普通原生头）与 0.6292（关系原生头）提到 0.6676，精确恢复率仅 1.16%；matched-epoch 训练在共同结构读出下提升 F1，但单独的等预算软 UC 对比未显示优势。按来源留出的 36 个人类剖面上，探索性对比中 Jeffreys 后验的原生期望 F1 为 0.8742，高于学习到的独立边 0.8704 与混合分布 0.8366；仅三个参考属非单点选择性核心。
Conclusion: STE 给非传递集合推断提供了带界的可微接口，但现有证据只支持条件性的合成重叠增益，相对强计数型人类剖面控制组尚无已证实的学习优势；识别、平滑与计算限制由 completion certificates 与 TC 诊断明确标出。

papers.title: Stop Probing, Start Coding: Why Linear Probes and Sparse Autoencoders Fail at Compositional Generalisation
papers.abstract_en: The linear representation hypothesis states that neural network activations encode high-level concepts as linear mixtures. However, under superposition, this encoding is a projection from a higher-dimensional concept space into a lower-dimensional activation space, and a linear decision boundary in the concept space need not remain linear after projection. In this setting, classical sparse coding methods with per-sample iterative inference leverage compressed sensing guarantees to recover latent factors. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs), on the other hand, amortise sparse inference into a fixed encoder, introducing a systematic gap. We show this amortisation gap persists across training set sizes, latent dimensions, and sparsity levels, causing SAEs to fail under out-of-distribution (OOD) compositional shifts. Through controlled experiments that decompose the failure, we identify dictionary learning as the limiting factor (not the inference procedure): SAE-learned dictionaries point in substantially wrong directions, and replacing the encoder with per-sample FISTA on the same dictionary does not close the gap. An oracle baseline proves the problem is solvable with a good dictionary at all scales tested. Our results, including experiments with real LLM activations (Pythia-70M, Gemma-2-2B) reframe the SAE failure as a dictionary learning challenge, not an inference problem, and point to scalable dictionary learning as the key open problem for sparse inference under superposition.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at UAI 2026. This is a slightly updated version of the published manuscript; see Corrigendum at the end of the paper
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, PMLR 337:364-412, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性表征假设与叠加 (superposition) 下，SAE 把逐样本稀疏推断摊销 (amortise) 成固定编码器，产生系统性的摊销间隙，导致 OOD 组合泛化失败。受控分解实验把失败定位到字典学习而非推断过程：SAE 学到的字典方向严重偏离，换成同一字典上的逐样本 FISTA 也补不上差距，而 oracle 字典在所有测试尺度上都能解决。
Motivation: 叠加使概念空间的线性决策边界投影后不再线性，经典稀疏编码依赖逐样本迭代推断与压缩感知保证，而 SAE 的摊销推断在组合分布外偏移下失效，需要定位失败来源。
Method: 对比逐样本迭代推断的稀疏编码与 SAE 的固定编码器；用受控实验分解失败来源，比较 SAE 字典、同一字典配逐样本 FISTA 编码器、以及 oracle 字典基线，并在真实 LLM 激活 (Pythia-70M、Gemma-2-2B) 上做实验。
Result: 摊销间隙在不同训练集规模、隐变量维度和稀疏度下持续存在；SAE 学到的字典方向大幅偏离正确方向，同字典换 FISTA 编码器不缩小差距；oracle 基线证明在所有测试尺度上只要字典够好问题可解。
Conclusion: SAE 的失败应重述为字典学习问题而非推断问题，叠加下可扩展的字典学习是稀疏推断的关键开放问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Imperative Interference: Social Register Shapes Instruction Topology in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: System prompt instructions that cooperate in English compete in Spanish, with the same semantic content, but opposite interaction topology. We present instruction-level ablation experiments across four languages and four models showing that this topology inversion is mediated by social register: the imperative mood carries different obligatory force across speech communities, and models trained on multilingual data have learned these conventions. Declarative rewriting of a single instruction block reduces cross-linguistic variance by 81% (p = 0.029, permutation test). Rewriting three of eleven imperative blocks shifts Spanish instruction topology from competitive to cooperative, with spillover effects on unrewritten blocks. These findings suggest that models process instructions as social acts, not technical specifications: "NEVER do X" is an exercise of authority whose force is language-dependent, while "X: disabled" is a factual description that transfers across languages. If register mediates instruction-following at inference time, it plausibly does so during training. We state this as a testable prediction: constitutional AI principles authored in imperative mood may create language-dependent alignment. Corpus: 22 hand-authored probes against a production system prompt decomposed into 56 blocks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一套系统提示在英文中协作、在西班牙语中竞争，指令级消融显示这种拓扑反转由社会语域 (social register) 调控：祈使语气在不同语言社群中的强制力不同。把单个指令块改写为陈述句可将跨语言方差降低 81%（p = 0.029，置换检验），改写 11 个祈使块中的 3 个即可让西班牙语指令拓扑从竞争转为协作，并对未改写块产生溢出效应。
Motivation: 多语言模型把英文中彼此协作的系统提示指令在其他语言下变成相互竞争的关系，说明指令遵循受语言惯例而非纯语义内容支配，这直接影响跨语言对齐的可靠性。
Method: 在 4 种语言、4 个模型上做指令级消融实验；语料为 22 条针对生产系统提示的手写探针，该提示被分解为 56 个指令块；通过祈使句到陈述句的改写操纵语域，用置换检验评估跨语言方差变化。
Result: 单个指令块的陈述句改写使跨语言方差降低 81%（p = 0.029，置换检验）；改写 11 个祈使块中的 3 个使西班牙语指令拓扑从竞争转为协作，并对未改写块产生溢出效应。
Conclusion: 模型在推理时把指令当作社会行为而非技术规格处理；由此作者提出可检验预测：用祈使语气撰写的 constitutional AI 原则可能造成语言依赖的对齐差异。

papers.title: Beyond Preset Identities: Selective Stance Accommodation and Interaction Reorganisation in Generative Agent Societies
papers.abstract_en: Generative agent societies simulate people with assigned roles, preferences and relationships. As agents exchange arguments and choose partners, they can revise their positions and reorganise discussion. Understanding these changes requires examining what they accept and how they continue to interact. Stance-change scores and communication totals describe the extent of change. However, the same stance movement can preserve or reverse an assigned preference, and frequent communication can support either agreement or continuing disagreement. We therefore examine the content of changed positions and the exchanges that strengthen particular partnerships. Using Computational Multi-Agent Society Experiments (CMASE), we combine stance measures, source evaluations and temporal networks with individual answers and messages. Study 1 compares seven conditions across ten GPT-4o runs per condition, with a separate interview collection covering four models. Study 2 follows one 75-step GPT-4o café simulation. Environmental rational persuasion yields the largest mean stance departure ($1.30\pm0.08$ on a 7-point scale), whereas economic emotional persuasion yields the highest low-trust stance-shift rate ($17.3\%\pm11.2\%$, with standard deviations across runs). In the separate interviews, eight environmental agents shift from 7 to 6, acknowledge economic concerns and rate the source 3. Their partial acceptance preserves the assigned environmental preference. In the café, a pair with zero earlier exchanges becomes the most frequent final-phase partnership, with 25 messages. Its members develop coordination proposals while disputing their implementation. These results show that partial acceptance can coexist with low source trust, and sustained coordination with continuing disagreement.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2508.17366
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Computational Multi-Agent Society Experiments (CMASE)，把立场变化内容、来源信任评价与时间网络结合，判定生成体社会中的立场移动是保留还是反转被指派偏好。GPT-4o 实验显示环境理性说服造成最大平均立场偏离（7 点量表 1.30±0.08），经济情绪说服的低信任立场转变率最高（17.3%±11.2%），且部分接受可与低来源信任、持续分歧下的高频协作共存。
Motivation: 生成体社会中立场变化分数与通信总量只能描述变化幅度，无法区分同一立场移动是保留还是反转被指派偏好，也无法判断高频交流是在促成一致还是维持分歧。
Method: 提出 CMASE，把立场度量、来源评价 (source evaluations) 与时间网络 (temporal networks) 同个体回答和消息结合。Study 1 比较 7 种条件、每条件 10 次 GPT-4o 运行，另有覆盖 4 个模型的独立访谈集；Study 2 追踪一次 75 步 GPT-4o 咖啡馆模拟。
Result: 环境理性说服的平均立场偏离最大，为 7 点量表上 1.30±0.08；经济情绪说服的低信任立场转变率最高，为 17.3%±11.2%（跨运行标准差）。访谈中 8 个环境体把立场从 7 调到 6、承认经济关切并给来源打 3 分。咖啡馆模拟中一对此前零交流的体成为末阶段最高频伙伴，共 25 条消息，其间提出协调方案但争论其执行方式。
Conclusion: 部分接受可以与低来源信任并存，持续协调也可以与持续分歧并存，因此立场变化幅度和通信总量本身不足以刻画生成体社会中的态度与关系演化。

summary_sections.result: 环境理性说服的平均立场偏离最大，为 7 点量表上 1.30±0.08；经济情绪说服的低信任立场转变率最高，为 17.3%±11.2%（跨运行标准差）。访谈中 8 个环境体把立场从 7 调到 6、承认经济关切并给来源打 3 分。咖啡馆模拟中一对此前零交流的体成为末阶段最高频伙伴，共 25 条消息，其间提出协调方案但争论其执行方式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 部分接受可以与低来源信任并存，持续协调也可以与持续分歧并存，因此立场变化幅度和通信总量本身不足以刻画生成体社会中的态度与关系演化。

papers.title: Arbiter: Detecting Interference in LLM Agent System Prompts
papers.abstract_en: System prompts for LLM-based coding agents are software artifacts that govern agent behavior, yet lack the testing infrastructure applied to conventional software. We present Arbiter, a framework combining formal evaluation rules with multi-model LLM scouring to detect interference patterns in system prompts. Applied to three major coding agent system prompts: Claude Code (Anthropic), Codex CLI (OpenAI), and Gemini CLI (Google), we identify 152 findings across the undirected scouring phase and 21 hand-labeled interference patterns in directed analysis of one vendor. We show that prompt architecture (monolithic, flat, modular) strongly correlates with observed failure class but not with severity, and that multi-model evaluation discovers categorically different vulnerability classes than single-model analysis. One scourer finding was structural data loss in Gemini CLI's memory system was consistent with an issue filed and patched by Google, which addressed the symptom without addressing the schema-level root cause identified by the scourer. Total cost of cross-vendor analysis: \$0.27 USD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Arbiter 把形式化评估规则与多模型 LLM 扫描 (multi-model scouring) 结合，用于检测 LLM 编码 agent 系统提示词中的干扰模式。在 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 三个系统提示词上共得到 152 条扫描发现与 21 条人工标注的干扰模式；提示词架构（monolithic/flat/modular）与失败类别强相关但与严重度无关，且多模型评估发现的漏洞类别与单模型分析不同。跨厂商分析总成本仅 $0.27 USD。
Motivation: 系统提示词是支配 LLM 编码 agent 行为的软件工件，却缺少常规软件所具备的测试基础设施，干扰类缺陷只能靠人工审阅零散发现。
Method: Arbiter 框架把形式化评估规则与多模型 LLM scouring 组合：先做无向扫描 (undirected scouring) 覆盖多个厂商提示词，再对单一厂商做定向分析 (directed analysis)，由人工标注干扰模式，并按提示词架构（monolithic、flat、modular）归类失败模式与严重度。
Result: 在 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 三个编码 agent 系统提示词上，无向扫描阶段得到 152 条发现，对一家厂商的定向分析得到 21 条人工标注的干扰模式；提示词架构与观察到的失败类别强相关、与严重度不相关；多模型评估发现的漏洞类别与单模型分析属不同类别；一条关于 Gemini CLI 记忆系统结构性数据丢失的发现与 Google 已提交并修补的 issue 一致，但该修补只处理症状、未处理 scourer 指出的 schema 层根因；跨厂商分析总成本 $0.27 USD。
Conclusion: 系统提示词应像常规软件一样接受带形式化规则的多模型测试，因为架构决定失败类别而多模型评估能挖出单模型看不到的漏洞类别。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Revisiting Integration of Image and Metadata for DICOM Series Classification: Cross-Attention and Dictionary Learning
papers.abstract_en: Automated identification of DICOM image series is essential for large-scale medical image analysis, quality control, protocol harmonization, and reliable downstream processing. However, DICOM series classification remains challenging due to heterogeneous slice content, variable series length, and entirely missing, incomplete or inconsistent DICOM metadata. We propose an end-to-end multimodal framework for DICOM series classification that jointly models image content and acquisition metadata while explicitly accounting for all these challenges. (i) Images and metadata are encoded with modality-aware modules and fused using a bi-directional cross-modal attention mechanism. (ii) Metadata is processed by a sparse, missingness-aware encoder based on learnable feature dictionaries and value-conditioned modulation. By design, the approach does not require any form of imputation. (iii) Variability in series length and image data dimensions is handled via a 2.5D visual encoder and attention operating on equidistantly sampled slices. We evaluate the proposed approach on the publicly available Duke Liver MRI dataset and a large multi-institutional in-house cohort, assessing both in-domain performance and out-of-domain generalization. Across all evaluation settings, the proposed method consistently outperforms relevant image only, metadata-only and multimodal 2D/3D baselines. The results demonstrate that explicitly modeling metadata sparsity and cross-modal interactions improves robustness for DICOM series classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端多模态 DICOM 序列分类框架：图像与元数据分别用模态感知模块编码，经双向跨模态注意力融合，元数据走基于可学习特征字典与取值调制的稀疏缺失感知编码器，且设计上不做任何插补；序列长度与图像维度差异由 2.5D 视觉编码器加等距采样切片的注意力处理。在 Duke Liver MRI 与多中心内部队列上，该方法在所有评估设置中一致优于仅图像、仅元数据及多模态 2D/3D 基线。
Motivation: DICOM 序列分类要面对切片内容异质、序列长度不一、元数据完全缺失或不一致的问题，而现有做法难以在不插补的前提下同时利用图像与元数据。
Method: 图像与元数据分别由模态感知模块编码，用双向跨模态注意力 (bi-directional cross-modal attention) 融合；元数据经稀疏、缺失感知的编码器处理，内含可学习特征字典 (learnable feature dictionaries) 与取值条件调制 (value-conditioned modulation)，全程无需插补；用 2.5D 视觉编码器与等距采样切片上的注意力处理可变序列长度和图像维度。
Result: 在公开的 Duke Liver MRI 数据集与大规模多中心内部队列上评估域内性能与域外泛化；在全部评估设置中，该方法一致优于仅图像、仅元数据以及多模态 2D/3D 基线。
Conclusion: 显式建模元数据稀疏性与跨模态交互能提升 DICOM 序列分类的鲁棒性，且无需元数据插补即可同时覆盖域内与域外场景。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Phantom Transfer: Data Poisoning can Survive Data-Level Defences
papers.abstract_en: We present a data poisoning attack -- Phantom Transfer -- with the property that, even if you know precisely how the poison was placed into an otherwise benign dataset, you cannot filter it out. We achieve this by modifying subliminal learning to work in real-world contexts and demonstrate that the attack works regardless of which model produced the data, which model is trained on the data or what the attack target is. Furthermore, the attack survives 11 tested data-level defences, including one where every sample is paraphrased by another model. We characterise when this attack works best and show that it can be used to plant password-triggered behaviours into models while still beating defences. We suggest that future defences should be supplemented with white-box methods and post-training model audits.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version accepted at NeurIPS 2026; expanded experiments and model audits
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数据投毒攻击 Phantom Transfer：改造 subliminal learning 使其适用于真实数据场景，即使攻击者如何植入毒药完全已知也无法被过滤。攻击与生成数据的模型、被训练的模型、攻击目标均无关，并在 11 种数据级防御（含对每个样本做模型改写）下存活，还能植入密码触发行为。
Motivation: 数据级防御默认过滤掉已知或可疑的毒药样本即可，但若毒药在语义与统计上与良性数据不可分，过滤路径本身就失效。
Method: 改造 subliminal learning 到真实数据上下文，使攻击对数据生成模型、训练模型和攻击目标均不敏感；并测试其植入密码触发行为的能力。
Result: 攻击在全部 11 种被测数据级防御下存活，其中包括对每个样本由另一模型做改写的防御；可植入密码触发行为且仍击败防御。
Conclusion: 数据级过滤不足以应对这类投毒，防御需补充白盒方法与训练后模型审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conditional Flow Matching for Visually-Guided Acoustic Highlighting
papers.abstract_en: Visually-guided acoustic highlighting seeks to rebalance audio in alignment with the accompanying video, creating a coherent audio-visual experience. While visual saliency and enhancement have been widely studied, acoustic highlighting remains underexplored, often leading to misalignment between visual and auditory focus. Existing approaches use discriminative models, which struggle with the inherent ambiguity in audio remixing, where no natural one-to-one mapping exists between poorly-balanced and well-balanced audio mixes. To address this limitation, we reframe this task as a generative problem and introduce a Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) framework. A key challenge in iterative flow-based generation is that early prediction errors -- in selecting the correct source to enhance -- compound over steps and push trajectories off-manifold. To address this, we introduce a rollout loss that penalizes drift at the final step, encouraging self-correcting trajectories and stabilizing long-range flow integration. We further propose a conditioning module that fuses audio and visual cues before vector field regression, enabling explicit cross-modal source selection. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations show that our method consistently surpasses the previous state-of-the-art discriminative approach, establishing that visually-guided audio remixing is best addressed through generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视觉引导的音频高亮 (visually-guided acoustic highlighting) 从判别式重混改写为条件流匹配 (Conditional Flow Matching, CFM) 生成问题，并加入 rollout loss 惩罚最后一步的轨迹漂移、以及在向量场回归前融合音视觉线索的条件化模块。定性与定量评测一致超过此前判别式 SOTA，确立视觉引导音频重混应走生成式建模路线。
Motivation: 音频重混本身没有唯一正确答案，判别模型难以处理这种一对多的歧义；且流式迭代生成早期选错声源的误差会逐步累积、把轨迹推离流形。
Method: 以 Conditional Flow Matching 框架把重混当作生成问题；rollout loss 只惩罚最后一步的漂移，促使轨迹自纠错并稳定长程积分；条件化模块在向量场回归前融合 audio 与 visual cues，实现显式的跨模态声源选择。
Result: 在定量与定性评测中一致超过此前判别式 SOTA 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 视觉引导的音频重混更适合用生成式建模解决，而 rollout 漂移惩罚与前置跨模态融合是让流式生成稳定可用的关键设计。
Relevance: 0
