papers.title: Explanation Multiplicity in SHAP: Characterization and Assessment
papers.abstract_en: SHAP explanations are widely used in high-stakes settings to justify decisions, yet they can differ substantially across repeated runs, even when the model, the input instance, and the prediction are held fixed. Prior work has documented disagreement between explanation methods; we show that substantial disagreement arises even within SHAP across reruns of the same estimator on the same trained model and instance. We call this phenomenon explanation multiplicity and develop an evaluation methodology for characterizing it under deployment-realistic computational budgets, combining a dual-seed protocol that compares model-induced and explainer-induced variability, a hierarchy of magnitude-based, rank-based, and set-based metrics, and randomized Dirichlet and Mallows null models that provide reference scales for observed disagreement. Across multiple datasets, models, and sampling strategies, we find that explanation multiplicity is pervasive and persists even for high-confidence predictions. The relative contribution of each source depends on the data regime and model: model-induced disagreement is generally greater on smaller datasets, while explainer-induced disagreement is greater on larger datasets. Commonly used L2 distance can understate this instability, while rank-based metrics reveal substantial changes in top-ranked features, including the leading feature. Improved sampling methods such as CTE do not eliminate rank-level multiplicity, and K-Means reduces run-to-run variation while its compressed-background explanations can diverge from the empirical-distribution reference. Practitioners should treat single-run SHAP outputs as realizations of a distribution rather than as authoritative artifacts.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHAP 在模型、输入实例、预测都固定时，重复运行仍给出显著不同的解释，作者称之为 explanation multiplicity。双种子协议把差异拆成 model-induced 与 explainer-induced 两源：小数据集上模型源更大，大数据集上解释器源更大；L2 会低估不稳定，rank-based 指标显示 top 特征乃至第一名特征都会换位，CTE 采样也消不掉 rank 层面的多重性。作者主张把单次 SHAP 输出当作分布的一次实现，而非权威结论。
Motivation: SHAP 被广泛用于高风险场景的决策辩护，但同一估计器、同一实例、同一预测的重复运行之间就存在大幅分歧；此前工作只记录了不同解释方法之间的分歧，同一方法内部的重跑分歧缺少刻画手段。
Method: 提出 dual-seed 协议分别度量 model-induced 与 explainer-induced 变异，配合三层指标（magnitude-based、rank-based、set-based），并用 randomized Dirichlet 与 Mallows null model 提供分歧的参考尺度；在多个数据集、模型与采样策略上、按部署可行的计算预算评估，另比较 CTE 与 K-Means 等采样方法。
Result: 在多数据集、多模型、多采样策略下 explanation multiplicity 普遍存在，且在高置信预测上依然持续；model-induced 分歧一般在较小数据集上更大，explainer-induced 分歧在较大数据集上更大；常用 L2 距离会低估不稳定，rank-based 指标显示 top 排名特征（含第一名特征）出现实质变化；CTE 未消除 rank 级多重性，K-Means 降低重跑变异但其压缩背景的解释会偏离经验分布参考。
Conclusion: 单次 SHAP 输出应被视为一个分布的实现而非权威产物，评估解释稳定性时需同时看 rank 层面并区分模型源与解释器源的变异。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 dual-seed 协议分别度量 model-induced 与 explainer-induced 变异，配合三层指标（magnitude-based、rank-based、set-based），并用 randomized Dirichlet 与 Mallows null model 提供分歧的参考尺度；在多个数据集、模型与采样策略上、按部署可行的计算预算评估，另比较 CTE 与 K-Means 等采样方法。
summary_sections.result: 在多数据集、多模型、多采样策略下 explanation multiplicity 普遍存在，且在高置信预测上依然持续；model-induced 分歧一般在较小数据集上更大，explainer-induced 分歧在较大数据集上更大；常用 L2 距离会低估不稳定，rank-based 指标显示 top 排名特征（含第一名特征）出现实质变化；CTE 未消除 rank 级多重性，K-Means 降低重跑变异但其压缩背景的解释会偏离经验分布参考。
summary_sections.conclusion: 单次 SHAP 输出应被视为一个分布的实现而非权威产物，评估解释稳定性时需同时看 rank 层面并区分模型源与解释器源的变异。

papers.title: MobileWorldBench: Towards Semantic World Modeling For Mobile Agents
papers.abstract_en: World models have shown great utility in improving the task performance of embodied agents. While prior work largely focuses on pixel-space world models, these approaches face practical limitations in GUI settings, where predicting complex visual elements in future states is often difficult. In this work, we explore an alternative formulation of world modeling for GUI agents, where state transitions are described in natural language rather than predicting raw pixels. First, we introduce MobileWorldBench, a benchmark that evaluates the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to function as world models for mobile GUI agents. Second, we release MobileWorld, a large-scale dataset consisting of 1.4M samples, that significantly improves the world modeling capabilities of VLMs. Finally, we propose a novel framework that integrates VLM world models into the planning framework of mobile agents, demonstrating that semantic world models can directly benefit mobile agents by improving task success rates. The code and dataset is available at https://github.com/jacklishufan/MobileWorld
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MobileWorldBench 把世界模型从像素预测改为用自然语言描述 GUI 状态转移，评测 VLM 作为移动 GUI 智能体世界模型的能力，并配套发布 1.4M 样本的 MobileWorld 数据集。将该 VLM 世界模型接入移动智能体的规划框架后，任务成功率得到提升。
Motivation: 像素空间世界模型在 GUI 场景难以预测未来状态中的复杂视觉元素，需要一种不依赖原始像素预测的替代建模范式。
Method: 提出三件套：MobileWorldBench 基准评测 VLM 作为 GUI 智能体世界模型的能力；发布大规模数据集 MobileWorld（1.4M 样本）训练 VLM 的语义世界建模；并提出把 VLM 世界模型集成进移动智能体规划框架的方法。
Result: MobileWorld 数据集含 1.4M 样本，被描述为能显著提升 VLM 的世界建模能力；集成框架的实验显示语义世界模型提升了移动智能体的任务成功率（task success rate）。
Conclusion: 用自然语言描述状态转移的语义世界模型可直接改善移动 GUI 智能体的规划与任务表现，绕开像素预测在 GUI 上的困难。

papers.title: One Permutation Is All You Need: Fast, Deterministic Feature Importance and Model Stress-Testing
papers.abstract_en: Reliable estimation of feature contributions in machine learning models is essential for transparency, algorithmic fairness, and regulatory compliance. While permutation feature importance is widely used, classical implementations rely on repeated Monte Carlo shuffling, introducing significant computational overhead and stochastic instability. In this paper, we show that replacing $B$ random permutations with a single, max-min rank-optimal deterministic permutation maintains or improves correlation with ground-truth importance while eliminating estimation variance and reducing complexity from $O(B \cdot n \cdot p)$ to $O(n \cdot p)$. Under location-scale feature distributions, we formally prove exact recovery of scale-adjusted linear regression coefficients, alongside improved importance estimation under concave model sensitivity. We extend this deterministic framework along two complementary dimensions. First, Systemic Feature Importance (SFI) integrates empirical feature correlations to quantify indirect feature reliance through proxy variables. Second, Importance Direction extends scalar importance to a signed, directional representation by measuring concordance between covariate displacements and output shifts. Extensive empirical validation across nearly 200 simulation scenarios demonstrates superior bias-variance trade-offs in high-dimensional and low signal-to-noise regimes. Finally, two real-world credit risk case studies show how coupling SFI with Importance Direction enables practitioners and regulators to audit models for both the magnitude and net sign of hidden reliance on protected attributes, delivering a principled, transparent, and scalable framework for model governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单个 max-min 秩最优确定性置换替代 B 次随机置换做特征重要性，复杂度从 O(B·n·p) 降到 O(n·p)，消除估计方差，同时保持或提高与真实重要性的相关性。在 location-scale 分布下可精确恢复尺度调整后的线性回归系数；近 200 个仿真场景与两个信贷风险案例中，该框架配合 SFI 与 Importance Direction 审计模型对受保护属性的隐性依赖的量级与净符号。
Motivation: 经典置换特征重要性依赖重复蒙特卡洛打乱，计算开销大且结果随机不稳定，不利于需要可复现、可审计的模型治理与合规场景。
Method: 以单个 max-min 秩最优确定性置换取代 B 次随机置换；扩展出 Systemic Feature Importance (SFI) 引入特征相关性以刻画代理变量带来的间接依赖，以及 Importance Direction 用协变量位移与输出变化的一致性把标量重要性升级为带符号的方向表示。
Result: 复杂度由 O(B·n·p) 降至 O(n·p)，估计方差被消除，与真实重要性的相关性保持或提高；在 location-scale 特征分布下形式化证明可精确恢复尺度调整的线性回归系数，并在凹模型敏感性下改进重要性估计；近 200 个仿真场景显示在高维与低信噪比区间有更优的偏差-方差权衡；两个真实信贷风险案例演示了对受保护属性隐性依赖的量级与净符号的审计。
Conclusion: 一个确定性置换即可替代重复随机打乱，在保持乃至提升重要性估计质量的同时带来可复现性与线性复杂度，配合 SFI 与方向表示可支撑模型治理审计。

papers.title: A PDE Perspective on Generative Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models have emerged as a powerful class of generative methods, with successful applications across diverse domains. Despite their empirical success, their mathematical foundations remain only partially understood, particularly regarding the stability and consistency of the stochastic and partial differential equations underlying their dynamics. In this work, we develop a partial differential equation (PDE) framework for score-based diffusion processes associated with the heat flow of a compactly supported data measure. After establishing weak well-posedness on positive-time intervals, we derive a sharp one-sided divergence bound for the score and use it to obtain sharp uniform $L^p$-stability estimates for the generative Fokker--Planck equation. This bound is the Euclidean form of the Li--Yau differential inequality. Through entropy stability methods, we prove that the generated laws converge in the $2$-Wasserstein distance at rate $\sqrt t$ as $t\to0^+$ to a probability measure supported on the data support. This holds for both deterministic and stochastic generation, for positive terminal densities with finite absolute entropy and second moment. In the deterministic case, almost every trajectory converges to a point of the data support; for empirical data, we further obtain a trajectory-wise square-root rate. These results clarify how exact-score dynamics concentrate on the data support without necessarily recovering the data distribution. An explicitly solvable case identifies the limiting weights and their dependence on Gaussian initialization, while a relative-entropy estimate quantifies the effect of score approximation. Together, these findings connect the stability and concentration mechanisms with score learning and early stopping, providing a mathematical perspective on the balance between imitation fidelity and generative diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为分数扩散模型建立 PDE 框架：在紧支撑数据测度的热流下证明正时间区间弱适定性，导出 score 的单侧散度界（Li–Yau 微分不等式的欧氏形式），并由此得到生成 Fokker–Planck 方程的尖锐一致 L^p 稳定性。熵稳定方法证明生成律在 t→0⁺ 时以 √t 速率在 2-Wasserstein 距离下收敛到支撑在数据支撑上的概率测度，确定性情形几乎每条轨迹收敛到数据支撑的某点。
Motivation: score-based diffusion 的随机与偏微分方程动力学在稳定性与一致性上数学基础仍不完整，需要说明 exact-score 动力学如何在不必然复原数据分布的前提下向数据支撑集中。
Method: 对紧支撑数据测度的热流建立分数扩散的 PDE 框架：先证正时间区间弱适定性，再导出 score 的尖锐单侧散度界（Li–Yau 不等式的欧氏形式），据此给出生成 Fokker–Planck 方程的尖锐一致 L^p 稳定估计；用熵稳定方法处理 2-Wasserstein 收敛，并给出显式可解案例与相对熵估计以量化 score 近似误差。
Result: 生成律以 √t 速率（t→0⁺）在 2-Wasserstein 距离下收敛到数据支撑上的概率测度，适用于确定性与随机生成，条件为正的终端密度、有限绝对熵与二阶矩；确定性情形几乎每条轨迹收敛到数据支撑的点，对经验数据另有逐轨迹平方根速率；显式可解案例给出极限权重及其对高斯初始化的依赖，相对熵估计量化 score 近似的影响。
Conclusion: exact-score 动力学的稳定性与集中机制解释了向数据支撑的集中而不必复原数据分布，并把 score 学习与 early stopping 联系到模仿保真度与生成多样性的平衡。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Benchmark Designers Should "Train on the Test Set" to Expose Exploitable Non-Visual Shortcuts
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs can answer many questions in vision-centric benchmarks without looking at the image, using linguistic priors and skewed answer distributions. Blind evaluation shows what a model already answers this way, but not what it could learn from the test set's own regularities. Extending partial-input auditing (e.g., hypothesis-only baselines in natural language inference), we argue that benchmark designers should "train on the test set": probe the artifact they release for exploitable patterns. Our Test-set Stress-Test (TsT) cross-validates a text-only Qwen2-7B on the test set's questions and answer options, yielding a benchmark-level score and a per-question bias score s(x); a random forest on hand-crafted features adds a fast, interpretable audit. On the template-based VSI-Bench and CV-Bench, the held-out score is 17.9 and 13.1 points above the model's own zero-shot score. On MMMU it learns little, even though GPT-4o correctly answers 52.3% of its multiple-choice questions without the image, so blind success there reflects pretrained knowledge rather than learnable test-set patterns. Iterative Bias Pruning (IBP) removes the questions with the highest s(x) and re-diagnoses; on VSI-Bench it widens a fine-tuned model's vision-blind gap more than random removal at the same rate. We also release VSI-Bench-Debiased, which lowers a fine-tuned model's blind score from 44.7 to 32.0 while its vision score falls only from 57.1 to 48.7.
papers.comment: COLM 2026. v2 corrects several results and revises the presentation. Project page: https://vision-x-nyu.github.io/test-set-training/ Code: https://github.com/vision-x-nyu/test-set-training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Test-set Stress-Test (TsT)：在基准测试集本身上交叉验证纯文本 Qwen2-7B，量化题目与选项里可被利用的非视觉捷径，并给出逐题偏置分 s(x)。在模板化的 VSI-Bench 与 CV-Bench 上，留出集得分分别比模型自身零样本高 17.9 与 13.1 分；据此做 Iterative Bias Pruning 并发布 VSI-Bench-Debiased，使微调模型盲答分从 44.7 降到 32.0，而视觉分仅从 57.1 降到 48.7。
Motivation: 多模态 LLM 可以不看图就答对视觉基准的题，但盲评只能显示模型已会的捷径，无法暴露测试集自身可被学习的规律，基准设计者缺少审计手段。
Method: TsT 在测试集的问题与选项上交叉验证纯文本 Qwen2-7B，输出基准级得分与逐题偏置分 s(x)；另用手工特征上的随机森林做快速可解释审计。Iterative Bias Pruning 按 s(x) 迭代剔除最高分题目后重新诊断，并发布去偏版本 VSI-Bench-Debiased。
Result: 模板化的 VSI-Bench 与 CV-Bench 上，TsT 留出集得分比模型零样本高 17.9 与 13.1 分；MMMU 上几乎学不到规律，尽管 GPT-4o 不看图也能答对 52.3% 的选择题。在 VSI-Bench 上，IBP 按同等比例剔除题目比随机剔除更能扩大微调模型的视觉盲差距；VSI-Bench-Debiased 把微调模型盲答分从 44.7 降到 32.0，视觉分仅从 57.1 降到 48.7。
Conclusion: 基准设计者应在自己发布的测试集上训练探针来暴露可利用的非视觉捷径；模板化基准含大量可学习捷径，而 MMMU 的盲成功主要来自预训练知识而非测试集规律，去偏可在少损视觉能力的前提下压低盲答分。

papers.title: Towards Scalable Meta-Learning of near-optimal Interpretable Models via Synthetic Model Generations
papers.abstract_en: Decision trees are widely used in high-stakes fields like finance and healthcare due to their interpretability. This work introduces an efficient, scalable method for generating synthetic pre-training data to enable meta-learning of decision trees. Our approach samples near-optimal decision trees synthetically, creating large-scale, realistic datasets. Using the MetaTree transformer architecture, we demonstrate that this method achieves performance comparable to pre-training on real-world data or with computationally expensive optimal decision trees. This strategy significantly reduces computational costs, enhances data generation flexibility, and paves the way for scalable and efficient meta-learning of interpretable decision tree models.

papers.title: BiomedXPro: Prompt Optimization for Explainable Diagnosis with Biomedical Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The clinical adoption of biomedical vision-language models is hindered by prompt optimization techniques that produce either uninterpretable latent vectors or single textual prompts. This lack of transparency and failure to capture the multi-faceted nature of clinical diagnosis, which relies on integrating diverse observations, limits their trustworthiness in high-stakes settings. To address this, we introduce BiomedXPro, an evolutionary framework that leverages a large language model as both a biomedical knowledge extractor and an adaptive optimizer to automatically generate a diverse ensemble of interpretable, natural-language prompt pairs for disease diagnosis. Experiments on multiple biomedical benchmarks show that BiomedXPro consistently outperforms state-of-the-art prompt-tuning methods, particularly in data-scarce few-shot settings. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates a strong semantic alignment between the discovered prompts and statistically significant clinical features, grounding the model's performance in verifiable concepts. By producing a diverse ensemble of interpretable prompts, BiomedXPro provides a verifiable basis for model predictions, representing a critical step toward the development of more trustworthy and clinically-aligned AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiomedXPro 用大语言模型同时充当生物医学知识抽取器与自适应优化器，进化式生成一组可读的自然语言 prompt 对，替代不可解释的隐向量或单一文本 prompt。在多个生物医学基准上，该方法持续优于 SOTA prompt-tuning，尤其在数据稀缺的 few-shot 设定下；发现的 prompt 与统计显著的临床特征语义对齐。
Motivation: 现有 prompt 优化要么输出不可解释的隐向量，要么只给单一文本 prompt，无法反映临床诊断需整合多方面观察的特性，限制了高风险场景中的可信度。
Method: 以 LLM 作为生物医学知识抽取器与自适应优化器，用进化框架自动生成多样化的可解释自然语言 prompt 对，构成集成用于疾病诊断，并分析所得 prompt 与统计显著临床特征的语义对齐。
Result: 在多个生物医学基准上持续优于 SOTA prompt-tuning 方法，优势在数据稀缺的 few-shot 设定下尤为明显；分析显示发现的 prompt 与统计显著临床特征存在强语义对齐。
Conclusion: 多样化的可解释 prompt 集成为模型预测提供了可核验的依据，是迈向更可信、与临床一致的 AI 系统的关键一步。

papers.title: An Investigation of Robustness of LLMs in Mathematical Reasoning: Benchmarking with Mathematically-Equivalent Transformation of Advanced Mathematical Problems
papers.abstract_en: Frontier large language models (LLMs) now reach near-ceiling accuracy on standard mathematical-reasoning benchmarks and gold-medal-level performance at the International Mathematical Olympiad. As these benchmarks saturate and their items leak into training data, a high score no longer shows whether a model reasons robustly or which component of its reasoning fails. To evaluate reasoning while keeping results informative and failures diagnosable, we propose GAP (Generalisation-and-Perturbation), a methodology that automatically generates mathematically equivalent variants of existing mathematics problems at scale using two disjoint, interpretable transformations: (1) surface renames, probing the binding between identifiers and latent variable roles, and (2) kernel rewrites, probing whether a high-level proof plan survives a change of mathematical setting. Compared with existing benchmarks, GAP has two key benefits: (1) novel, likely unseen variants mitigate data leakage, and (2) performance across transformation families enables failure diagnosis, each transformation testing a hypothesis about the cause of failure. We instantiate GAP on all 1,051 William Lowell Putnam Competition problems from 1938 to 2024, adding 5,255 unseen variants to form PutnamGAP, a 6,306-item competition-level mathematics corpus and the first public machine-readable dataset from the full Putnam archive. Using PutnamGAP, we evaluated 18 commercial and open-source models spanning sizes and providers. Accuracy drops across all models and variant families, most severely under kernel rewrites. This gap does not close with model strength, suggesting that even the strongest models' dominant weakness is transferring a proof plan to a changed mathematical setting, rather than handling surface changes. Further analysis provides finer failure diagnoses and potentially useful insights for improving LLM reasoning.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 9 figures, accepted at ICLR 2026 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GAP（Generalisation-and-Perturbation）：用两类互不重叠、可解释的数学等价变换（surface renames 与 kernel rewrites）批量改写既有数学题，构造 PutnamGAP（1,051 道 1938–2024 Putnam 原题 + 5,255 个新变体，共 6,306 题）。评测 18 个商业与开源模型，所有模型在所有变体族上准确率都下降，kernel rewrite 下降最重，且该差距不随模型变强而收敛。
Motivation: 标准数学推理基准已接近饱和且题目泄漏进训练数据，高分既不能说明模型是否稳健推理，也无法定位推理中哪个环节失败。
Method: GAP 自动生成数学等价变体：surface renames 检验标识符与潜在变量角色的绑定，kernel rewrites 检验高层证明方案能否跨数学设定迁移；每个变换族对应一个关于失败原因的假设，据此做失败诊断。语料为全部 1,051 道 Putnam 竞赛题（1938–2024）加 5,255 个新变体，构成 6,306 题的 PutnamGAP，是首个覆盖完整 Putnam 档案的公开机器可读数据集。
Result: 在 PutnamGAP 上评测 18 个商业与开源模型（跨规模与厂商）：所有模型在全部变体族上准确率均下降，kernel rewrites 下降最严重；该性能差距不随模型强度增大而缩小。
Conclusion: 最强模型的主导短板是把证明方案迁移到改变后的数学设定，而非处理表面改名；用跨变换族的表现可以定位失败环节，且新变体因未见而缓解数据泄漏。

papers.title: Brain foundation model-guided source-selective domain adaptation for cross-subject EEG decoding
papers.abstract_en: Cross-subject motor-imagery electroencephalography (MI-EEG) decoding remains challenging because substantial inter-subject variability can cause both negative transfer from poorly matched source subjects and persistent distribution discrepancies between source and target domains. Existing multi-source domain adaptation methods often incorporate all available source domains or estimate source relevance using signal-level or task-specific representations, while distribution alignment is frequently performed only at the feature level. These limitations may introduce irrelevant source knowledge and fail to preserve class-discriminative structures across subjects. In this study, we propose a brain foundation model-guided multi-source domain adaptation framework (BFM-MSDA) for cross-subject MI-EEG decoding. The method first utilizes representations learned by a pretrained brain foundation model to estimate source--target compatibility and retrieve target-relevant sources. Subsequently, a relevance-weighted dual alignment strategy is applied to the selected sources and the unlabeled target domain. Specifically, Cauchy--Schwarz (CS) divergence is used to reduce discrepancies in marginal feature distributions, while conditional Cauchy--Schwarz (CCS) divergence further aligns class-dependent decision distributions. Source relevance is incorporated into both alignment terms so that more transferable source subjects contribute more strongly to adaptation. Experiments on two public MI-EEG benchmarks achieve average accuracies of 86.16% and 78.41%, outperforming representative cross-subject decoding and domain adaptation methods. Additional experiments with a large source pool further demonstrate that target-aware source retrieval improves scalability while mitigating negative transfer. These results highlight the importance of informed source selection under cross-subject distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BFM-MSDA 用预训练脑基础模型 (brain foundation model) 表征评估源-目标兼容度、只检索目标相关源被试，再对选中源与无标签目标做相关性加权的双重对齐：CS divergence 对齐边缘特征分布，CCS divergence 对齐类别条件决策分布，源相关性同时进入两项对齐。在两个公开 MI-EEG 基准上平均准确率 86.16% 与 78.41%，超过代表性跨被试解码与域适应方法；大源池实验显示目标感知源检索提升可扩展性并缓解负迁移。
Motivation: 跨被试 MI-EEG 解码中被试间差异大，全量纳入源域会引入不相关知识造成负迁移，且分布对齐常只在特征层做，类别判别结构跨被试难以保持。
Method: 先用预训练脑基础模型的表征估计源-目标兼容度并检索目标相关源；随后对选中源与无标签目标域做相关性加权的双重对齐，用 Cauchy-Schwarz (CS) divergence 缩小边缘特征分布差异，用 conditional Cauchy-Schwarz (CCS) divergence 对齐类别相关决策分布，源相关性权重同时注入两项对齐项。
Result: 在两个公开 MI-EEG 基准上平均准确率分别为 86.16% 和 78.41%，优于代表性跨被试解码与域适应方法；在更大源池上的附加实验中，目标感知源检索提升可扩展性并缓解负迁移。
Conclusion: 跨被试分布偏移下，基于基础模型表征的知情源选择配合相关性加权的双重对齐，比无差别纳入全部源域更有效。

papers.title: VesselSDF: Distance Field Priors for Vascular Network Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of vascular networks from sparse CT scan slices remains a significant challenge in medical imaging, particularly due to the thin, branching nature of vessels and the inherent sparsity between imaging planes. Existing deep learning approaches, based on binary voxel classification, often struggle with structural continuity and geometric fidelity. To address this challenge, we present VesselSDF, a novel framework that leverages signed distance fields (SDFs) for robust vessel reconstruction. Our method reformulates vessel segmentation as a continuous SDF regression problem, where each point in the volume is represented by its signed distance to the nearest vessel surface. This continuous representation inherently captures the smooth, tubular geometry of blood vessels and their branching patterns. We obtain accurate vessel reconstructions while eliminating common SDF artifacts such as floating segments, thanks to our adaptive Gaussian regularizer which ensures smoothness in regions far from vessel surfaces while producing precise geometry near the surface boundaries. Our experimental results demonstrate that VesselSDF significantly outperforms existing methods and preserves vessel geometry and connectivity, enabling more reliable vascular analysis in clinical settings.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI), 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VesselSDF 把稀疏 CT 切片上的血管分割改写为连续符号距离场 (SDF) 回归，用自适应高斯正则器在远离血管表面处保证平滑、在表面边界处保留精确几何，从而消除 floating segments 等伪影并保持血管连通性。在实验中显著优于现有方法，提升血管几何与连通性。
Motivation: 稀疏 CT 层间间距大、血管细且分叉，基于二值体素分类的深度方法难以保证结构连续性与几何保真度。
Method: 将血管分割重构为连续 SDF 回归：体中每点表示到最近血管表面的符号距离，天然表达光滑管状几何与分支；配合自适应高斯正则器，远场强制平滑、近表面保留精确几何。
Result: 实验结果显示 VesselSDF 显著优于现有方法，获得准确的血管重建并消除 floating segments 等常见 SDF 伪影，同时保持血管几何与连通性。
Conclusion: 连续 SDF 表示加自适应高斯正则比二值体素分类更适合稀疏 CT 血管重建，可支持更可靠的临床血管分析。

papers.title: A Survey on Archetypal Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Archetypal analysis (AA) was originally proposed in 1994 by Adele Cutler and Leo Breiman as a computational procedure for extracting distinct aspects, so-called archetypes, from observations, with each observational record approximated as a mixture (i.e., convex combination) of these archetypes. AA thereby provides straightforward, interpretable, and explainable representations for feature extraction and dimensionality reduction, facilitating the understanding of the structure of high-dimensional data and enabling wide applications across the sciences. However, AA also faces challenges, particularly as the associated optimization problem is nonconvex. This is the first survey that provides researchers and data mining practitioners with an overview of the methodologies and opportunities that AA offers, surveying the many applications of AA across disparate fields of science, as well as best practices for modeling data with AA and its limitations. The survey concludes by explaining crucial future research directions concerning AA.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是首篇关于原型分析 (archetypal analysis, AA) 的综述，系统梳理了自 1994 年 Cutler 与 Breiman 提出以来的 AA 方法族、跨学科应用、建模最佳实践与局限，并指出其核心难点在于优化问题非凸。作者主张 AA 以凸组合形式给出可解释的原型表示，适合特征提取与降维，但非凸性决定了实践中的建模选择。
Motivation: AA 已在多个学科广泛应用，但其非凸优化带来的方法选择与实践问题此前缺少统一综述，研究者与数据挖掘从业者无从系统把握方法谱系、最佳实践与局限。
Method: 作为综述，按方法脉络梳理 AA 及其变体的优化与求解思路，汇总跨学科应用案例，并归纳用 AA 建模数据的最佳实践与局限，最后给出未来研究方向。
Result: 综述覆盖 1994 年 Cutler 与 Breiman 提出 AA 以来的方法与应用，指出其优化问题非凸这一核心挑战；全文 28 页、14 图，被 TPAMI 接收。
Conclusion: AA 是一类可解释的凸组合原型表示方法，其非凸优化是限制实践应用的关键瓶颈，未来研究应围绕该难点展开。

papers.title: Class Machine Unlearning for Complex Data via Concepts Inference and Data Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specified training data or knowledge from a trained model without requiring full retraining. This capability is particularly important for modern image classifiers and large language models (LLMs), where retraining can be computationally expensive. However, machine unlearning on complex data remains difficult because the target information is often distributed across multiple semantic elements. Existing methods mainly remove samples, modify labels, or edit model parameters to reduce the influence of the forgetting target. These approaches usually do not explicitly identify which semantic concepts connect the forgetting target to the model's prediction or generated response. As a result, it is difficult to determine which information to modify. This uncertainty may leave residual target information or unnecessarily affect knowledge that should be retained. To address this gap, we propose a concept-guided poisoning unlearning framework that explicitly identifies the concepts that contribute most strongly to the target class or knowledge and uses them to guide the model update. For image classification, our method first identifies class-relevant concepts with a Post-hoc Concept Bottleneck Model, localizes the image regions that express these concepts, and constructs replacement-based poisoned samples. For LLMs, it elicits the target knowledge through multiple questions, aggregates Integrated Gradients across the resulting responses to identify consistently important content, and masks this content to construct poisoned training targets. Experiments on multiple datasets show that the proposed framework achieves effective unlearning across different tasks while largely preserving retained model utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出概念引导的投毒遗忘框架 (concept-guided poisoning unlearning)：先定位与遗忘目标相关的语义概念，再用这些概念构造投毒样本来更新模型。图像分类用 Post-hoc Concept Bottleneck Model 识别类相关概念并定位其图像区域，LLM 侧用 Integrated Gradients 聚合多问答回答找出稳定重要片段并掩码构造投毒训练目标；在多个数据集上实现有效遗忘，同时基本保留保留知识的效用。
Motivation: 复杂数据上的机器遗忘难在目标信息分散于多个语义元素，现有删样本、改标签、编辑参数的方法不显式识别连接遗忘目标与模型预测的概念，导致改什么不确定，可能残留目标信息或伤及应保留的知识。
Method: 图像分类：用 Post-hoc Concept Bottleneck Model 识别类相关概念，定位表达这些概念的图像区域，构造基于替换的投毒样本。LLM：用多个问题引出目标知识，对各回答聚合 Integrated Gradients 找出一致重要的内容，掩码该内容构造投毒训练目标，以此引导模型更新。
Result: 在多个数据集、跨图像分类与 LLM 两类任务上，框架实现有效遗忘，并在很大程度上保留了保留部分的模型效用。
Conclusion: 显式识别连接遗忘目标与预测的语义概念并据此投毒，比盲目删样本或改参数更能兼顾遗忘彻底性与保留效用。

papers.title: An unstructured grid, nonhydrostatic, generalized vertical coordinate ocean model
papers.abstract_en: We present a method to simulate nonhydrostatic ocean flows on a horizontally-unstructured grid with a moving generalized vertical coordinate (GVC). The nonhydrostatic governing equations are transformed to a GVC system that can represent the well-known z-level, terrain-following, or isopycnal coordinates while also being able to employ a vertically-adaptive coordinate using r-adaptivity. Different vertical coordinates are accommodated with the arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE) approach in which the vertical coordinate lines translate vertically, and the layer heights are made consistent with the vertical grid velocities through a discrete layer-height equation. Vertical grid velocities are also accounted for in the discrete momentum and scalar trans-port equations. While momentum is approximately conserved, the mass, heat, and volume are conserved both locally and globally. The nonhydrostatic pressure is implemented using a pressure-correction method that enforces the transformed continuity equation. The proposed GVC framework is implemented in the SUNTANS (Fringer et al., 2006) ocean model. Non-hydrostatic internal solitary-like waves are simulated to demonstrate that isopycnal coordinates can represent similar dynamics as z-levels at a fraction of the computational cost. The nonhydrostatic lock-exchange is then simulated to demonstrate that adaptive vertical coordinates can improve the accuracy of the model by concentrating more grid layers in regions of higher vertical density gradients.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非结构水平网格的 SUNTANS 海洋模式中实现带移动广义垂直坐标 (GVC) 的非静力框架：用 ALE 让垂直坐标线可上下平移，覆盖 z-level、地形跟随、等密度面与 r-adaptivity 自适应坐标，并用 pressure-correction 强制变换后的连续方程。质量、热量、体积在局部与全局均守恒，动量近似守恒；等密度面坐标以更少计算量复现 z-level 的非静力内孤立波动力学，自适应坐标通过把网格层集中到垂直密度梯度大处提高锁交换模拟精度。
Motivation: 非静力海洋模式通常绑定固定垂直坐标，难以在同一框架内切换 z-level、地形跟随、等密度面或自适应坐标，也难在密度跃层等关键区域集中分辨率。
Method: 把非静力方程变换到 GVC 系统，用 arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE) 处理垂直坐标线平移，通过离散 layer-height 方程使层厚与垂直网格速度一致，并在动量与标量输运方程中计入网格速度；非静力压力用 pressure-correction 方法强制变换后的连续方程；整体在 SUNTANS (Fringer et al., 2006) 中实现。
Result: 质量、热量、体积局部与全局守恒，动量近似守恒；非静力内孤立波模拟显示等密度面坐标能以更小计算成本复现 z-level 的相似动力学；非静力锁交换模拟显示自适应垂直坐标通过在垂直密度梯度更大处集中更多网格层来提高模型精度。
Conclusion: GVC+ALE 框架可在同一非结构网格模式里统一多种垂直坐标并保持守恒性，等密度面与自适应坐标分别在计算成本和密度跃层分辨率上优于固定 z-level。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: The optimal information complexity of VC learning
papers.abstract_en: Steinke and Zakynthinou(2020) introduces the Conditional Mutual Information (CMI) framework of analyzing the information complexity of learning algorithms based on algorithm-dependent information-theoretic quantities. We study one of these quantities, the evaluated Conditional Mutual Information (eCMI). It has been an interesting question whether the optimal PAC guarantee for VC classes can be recovered from the algorithm-dependent analyses via CMI. And we show that it is possible to recover this guarantee by constructing a learning algorithm whose eCMI is of order O(d) in the realizable case, where d is the VC-dimension of the concept class. Specially, our algorithm is a randomized Majority-of-5 base learners with optimal in-expectation generalization guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Steinke–Zakynthinou 的条件互信息 (CMI) 框架下研究 eCMI，构造一个随机化的 Majority-of-5 基学习器，使其在 realizable 情形的 eCMI 为 O(d)（d 为 VC 维），从而从算法依赖的信息论分析中恢复出 VC 类的最优 PAC 保证。
Motivation: CMI 框架用算法依赖的信息论量刻画学习复杂度，但能否从中推出 VC 类的最优 PAC 保证一直悬而未决。
Method: 针对 evaluated Conditional Mutual Information (eCMI) 这一 CMI 框架中的量，构造一个随机化的 Majority-of-5 基学习器组合算法，并分析其在 realizable 情形下的 eCMI 阶数。
Result: 所构造算法在 realizable 情形的 eCMI 为 O(d)，d 为概念类的 VC 维；该基学习器具有 in-expectation 意义下的最优泛化保证，由此恢复出 VC 类的最优 PAC 保证。
Conclusion: VC 类的最优 PAC 保证确实可以从 CMI 这类算法依赖的信息复杂度分析中推出，关键在于把 eCMI 控制到与 VC 维同阶的 O(d)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Certified Corruption Budgets: Anytime-Valid Leaderboard Claims under Adaptive Rigging
papers.abstract_en: Public leaderboards for AI models are read continuously, and attackers can see every published standing. Vote rigging, selective disclosure of private variants, and benchmark contamination can each move a ranking. Existing guarantees assume genuine records or bound the corruption per step, which an attacker who corrupts in bursts evades. We introduce the certified corruption budget, a tolerance $\widehat{B}_t$ computed after $t$ records and published with each pairwise claim. With probability at least $1-α$, simultaneously at all times, the claim is correct or more than $\widehat{B}_t$ records were corrupted. It holds against attackers who watch every certificate, with no bound on their budget. Forged records and records altered once seen require different certificates: the certificate for forgeries fails, with probability approaching one, against an attacker who flips votes it has seen, while one that charges roughly twice as much per record remains valid, with constant bets even against attackers who see the future, and no smaller charge is valid at every level. The certified budget grows nearly as fast as any valid method allows: with a win fraction $\frac{1}{2}+δ$, each new record adds close to $2δ$ to the number of forged records the claim can withstand ($δ$ flipped). Publishing the best of $V$ private variants costs only an amount growing like $\log V$. In replays on 1.8 million Chatbot Arena votes, a few hundred rigged votes make standard confidence intervals certify false orderings, while ours stays valid. On real votes, our certificate shows that clearly separated models withstand about 2,000 forged votes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI 模型公开榜单在自适应操纵下的成对排名声明，提出 certified corruption budget：每发布一条 pairwise claim 时同时公布容忍度 $\hat{B}_t$，保证以至少 $1-\alpha$ 的概率在所有时刻同时成立——声明正确，或被篡改的记录数超过 $\hat{B}_t$。在 180 万条 Chatbot Arena 投票回放中，几百条操纵投票即可让标准置信区间认证出错误排序，而该证书仍有效；真实投票上，明显领先的模型可承受约 2,000 条伪造投票。
Motivation: 公开榜单持续被阅读且攻击者可见每次公布的排名，投票操纵、私有变体的选择性披露与基准污染都能改变排序；现有保证要么假设记录真实，要么只约束单步腐败量，会被突发式 (burst) 腐败的攻击者绕过。
Method: 引入 certified corruption budget $\hat{B}_t$：在收到 $t$ 条记录后计算并与每条 pairwise claim 一起发布，采用 anytime-valid 的下注 (betting) 构造，使声明在所有时刻同时以概率至少 $1-\alpha$ 有效；对“伪造记录”与“被看过后篡改的记录”分别给出不同证书，后者每条记录的代价约为前者的两倍，且在常数下注下仍能对抗看到未来的攻击者，并证明没有更小的代价在每个层级都有效。
Result: 在 180 万条 Chatbot Arena 投票的回放中，几百条被操纵的投票就使标准置信区间认证出错误的模型排序，而本文证书保持有效；真实投票上，证书显示明显分离的模型可承受约 2,000 条伪造投票。理论上，当胜率分数为 $\frac{1}{2}+\delta$ 时，每条新记录使可承受的伪造记录数增加接近 $2\delta$（$\delta$ 条被翻转）；发布 $V$ 个私有变体中的最优者，额外代价仅按 $\log V$ 增长。
Conclusion: 榜单排名的成对声明可以在不约束攻击者预算的前提下给出随时有效的腐败容忍证书，且容忍度增长接近任何有效方法所允许的上限；对抗“看过后再篡改”必须付出约两倍的每记录代价，否则证书会以概率趋于 1 失效。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Coverage, Not Difficulty, Sets How Much Synthetic Data an Activation Probe Needs
papers.abstract_en: Activation probes that monitor deployed language models are trained on synthetic conversations, and how many a probe needs is open. We trace learning curves over 10-590 synthetic samples for three monitoring concepts, high-stakes situations, replies harmful to a person, and replies that do not follow the user's instruction, on fourteen held-out evaluation distributions and four probe models, varying the generator LLM and the prompt's detail. The need is set by what is monitored: probes for high-stakes and harmful are within a few hundredths of their plateau from 80 samples on Gemma-3-27B-IT, instruction probes need several times as many, and the ordering holds on three smaller probe models and on real samples (from dev set). Prior work advises spending a generation budget on breadth, more kinds of data, over depth, more of each kind. We read the depth a concept needs as the half-gain size of a fitted curve, the number of samples at which half the gain is in hand. Concept and distribution account for 42-45% of its variance, the generator, probe model, and prompt detail for under 10%. What sets the value of the half-gain size is coverage, not per-kind difficulty: the number of samples of its own kind a distribution needs to saturate. Every kind, one per evaluation distribution, has a median half-gain size of 7-11 own-kind synthetic samples under all three concepts alike. What differs is how far samples of one kind transfer to the concept's other kinds, almost fully under high-stakes, less under harmful, and least under instruction, which accounts for most of the gap between concepts on generated and real samples. Breadth therefore pays differently by concept: many kinds are necessary under instruction, where no kind covers another, and nearly redundant under high-stakes, where one kind covers the rest. We release the evaluation suites, dev sets, and generated sets.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对部署语言模型的激活探针 (activation probe) 需要多少合成对话这一开放问题，作者在 10–590 个合成样本上追踪三个监控概念的学习曲线，发现决定样本量的是概念对各类样本的覆盖度而非单类难度：每个概念下每类样本的半增益 (half-gain size) 中位数都只有 7–11 个，概念间差距主要来自跨类迁移程度。因此 breadth 预算按概念区别投放：instruction 概念各类互不覆盖、必须广撒，high-stakes 概念一类即可覆盖其余、广撒近乎冗余。
Motivation: 激活探针靠合成对话训练，但需要多少合成样本、生成预算该投 breadth 还是 depth，此前没有答案；已有建议笼统主张投 breadth，未区分监控概念。
Method: 在 14 个 held-out 评估分布与 4 个 probe 模型上，对 high-stakes、harmful、instruction 三个监控概念追踪 10–590 合成样本的学习曲线，变化 generator LLM 与 prompt 细节；把 depth 需求定义为拟合曲线的半增益尺寸（增益达到一半所需样本数），并用方差分解区分概念/分布与生成器/探针/prompt 的贡献。
Result: Gemma-3-27B-IT 上 high-stakes 与 harmful 探针从 80 个样本起即距平台值仅几个百分点，instruction 需要数倍样本，且该排序在三个更小探针模型与 dev set 真实样本上保持。概念与分布解释半增益尺寸方差的 42–45%，generator、probe 模型与 prompt 细节合计不足 10%。每个概念下每类的半增益中位数均为 7–11 个同类合成样本；跨类迁移在 high-stakes 下近乎完全、harmful 下较弱、instruction 下最弱，解释了概念间在生成与真实样本上的大部分差距。
Conclusion: 合成数据需求由覆盖度（一个分布需要多少同类样本饱和）而非单类难度决定，breadth 的收益随概念而异：instruction 必须多样，high-stakes 几乎不必。作者公开评估套件、dev set 与生成数据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations. In an exploratory OpenTelemetry debugging case followed by an unrelated implementation task, the method ended with 231,951 provider-reported prompt tokens versus 912,492 under retained history, used 50% fewer cumulative input tokens, and had an estimated API cost of USD 1.28-1.44 versus approximately USD 4.38. Both arms passed the two-case primary behavioral oracle; neither fully satisfied the follow-up evaluation. The method made more requests and took 17% longer. A contrasting application-development pair produced no context or cost saving, and an earlier continuation exhibited lower manually assessed quality despite reduced context. These observations demonstrate substantial resource savings in noisy tool-use trajectories and identify workload dependence as a central consideration for reversible context management.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/boldprojekte/agent-forgetting-research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 agent-controlled forgetting：工具型 agent 的执行模型主动把已观察到的工具结果压缩成原位置的短注释，原文存入可恢复归档，由 Python harness 提供批量归档与显式恢复，全程不做任务特定训练。在 OpenTelemetry 调试加无关实现任务的两案例中，结束时 provider 报告 prompt token 为 231,951 对保留历史的 912,492，累计输入 token 少 50%，估算 API 成本 USD 1.28–1.44 对约 USD 4.38；代价是请求数更多、耗时长 17%，且换到应用开发任务对时不再省上下文与成本。
Motivation: 工具型 agent 的轨迹里历史观测载荷远大于其有效内容，全量保留历史使 prompt token 与 API 成本线性膨胀；现有压缩手段多需任务特定训练，且难以在需要时取回原文。
Method: 由执行模型自行选择先前观察到的工具结果，将其替换为原位置的短注释并把原文存入可恢复归档；Python harness 暴露 batch archival 与 explicit recovery 操作，同时保护 user instructions 与 assistant messages 不被改写；不引入任务特定模型训练。
Result: 在 OpenTelemetry 调试案例加一个无关实现任务上：结束时 provider 报告 prompt tokens 231,951 对保留历史的 912,492，累计输入 token 减少 50%，估算 API 成本 USD 1.28–1.44 对约 USD 4.38；两臂都通过两案例主行为 oracle，但都未完全满足后续评估；该方法请求数更多、耗时长 17%。对照的应用开发任务对没有产生上下文或成本节省，更早的一次续写在上下文减少的同时人工评估质量更低。
Conclusion: 可逆上下文管理在噪声较多的工具轨迹中能带来显著资源节省，但收益高度依赖工作负载，是否压缩需按任务类型判断而非默认启用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Survey on LLM-Integrated Hardware Design Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into hardware verification to automate specification interpretation, verification-artifact generation, debugging, formal reasoning, and tool orchestration. This survey provides a systematic review of LLM-assisted hardware functional verification across SystemVerilog assertion generation, stimulus and testbench generation, bug localization and design repair, model checking and equivalence checking, SAT/SMT optimization, and emerging agentic verification workflows. We organize the literature by methodology, verification objective, tool interaction, benchmark, and evaluation criterion, and examine both inference-time techniques--including prompting, retrieval, structured reasoning, and agentic workflows--and training-time adaptation. Across these areas, a common pattern emerges: LLMs are most effective as semantic reasoning, search, and orchestration components embedded within verification-aware workflows, while simulators, formal engines, coverage tools, and solvers provide executable feedback and correctness evidence. However, tool acceptance alone does not establish verification correctness, since assertions, tests, repairs, or proofs may satisfy available checks without faithfully capturing the complete design intent. We therefore identify semantic alignment between specifications and verification evidence, scalable integration with deterministic tools, generalization to unseen designs, and rigorous evaluation of correctness, cost, robustness, and human effort as key challenges. Finally, we discuss emerging directions toward specification-centered, neuro-symbolic, and persistent agentic verification systems that combine LLM flexibility with independently checkable verification evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 LLM 参与硬件功能验证的系统综述，覆盖 SystemVerilog 断言生成、测试激励与 testbench 生成、bug 定位与设计修复、模型检测与等价检查、SAT/SMT 优化以及 agentic 验证流程。核心论断是：LLM 只有作为语义推理、搜索与工具编排组件嵌入验证感知工作流时最有效，正确性证据仍由模拟器、形式化引擎、覆盖率工具和求解器提供；且工具接受并不等于验证正确，断言、测试或修复可能通过现有检查却未忠实覆盖完整设计意图。
Motivation: 硬件验证中规格解释、验证工件生成、调试与工具编排高度人工密集，而 LLM 输出可能通过现有检查却偏离设计意图，需要按方法、验证目标、工具交互、基准和评测标准系统梳理这一交叉领域。
Method: 按方法学、验证目标、工具交互、基准与评测准则组织文献，分别审查推理时技术（prompting、检索、结构化推理、agentic 工作流）与训练时自适应，覆盖断言生成、testbench 生成、bug 定位与修复、模型检测、等价检查、SAT/SMT 优化等任务。
Result: 综述性结论，无实验数字：跨领域一致模式是 LLM 作为语义推理、搜索与编排组件时最有效，模拟器、形式化引擎、覆盖率工具与求解器提供可执行反馈与正确性证据；并指出规格与验证证据的语义对齐、与确定性工具的可扩展集成、对未见设计的泛化，以及正确性、成本、鲁棒性与人力投入的严格评测是关键挑战。
Conclusion: LLM 在硬件验证中的合理定位是与可独立核查的验证证据结合的灵活组件，而非替代形式化与仿真工具；未来方向是规格中心、neuro-symbolic 与持久化 agentic 验证系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model
papers.abstract_en: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCION 在单一像素空间模型里同时做对比自监督与 flow matching 生成：表征阶段用共享全局向量作条件、以 [CLS] token 接对比损失，生成阶段改用图像自身 [CLS] 作条件并联合学习该嵌入的先验，从而无需标签、预训练编码器或自编码器。ImageNet 256x256 上 JiT-B 配方无表征引导 FID 8.92，超过对齐 DINOv2 的 iREPA（46.44）与以其为条件的 RCG（14.27）。
Motivation: 图像生成依赖类别标签、冻结的预训练编码器或单独训练的自编码器，而对比学习偏好粗粒度不变语义、flow matching 又必须保留细节与空间布局，两个目标天然冲突，难以在一个模型里同时优化。
Method: SCION 的核心是一个以 flow 时间步和嵌入向量为条件的像素空间编码器：表征学习时条件嵌入是跨图像共享的可学习全局向量，[CLS] token 经对比损失训练；生成训练时条件嵌入换成图像自身的 [CLS] 表示，patch token 经解码器重建图像；推理时用联合学习的嵌入先验采样，梯度范数平衡 (gradient-norm balancing) 与 stop-gradient 机制支撑单次运行内的联合优化。
Result: ImageNet 256x256 上，JiT-B 配方且无表征引导时 SCION FID 8.92，对比 iREPA（对齐预训练 DINOv2）46.44 与 RCG（以其为条件）14.27；JiT-L 配方下无引导 FID 5.89、加表征引导 3.47，优于 ADM 配方下的 RCG 6.24。
Conclusion: 生成与自监督表征的目标失配可以在一个模型内用条件嵌入切换与梯度平衡同时解决，自条件生成不依赖标签或预训练模型即可在 ImageNet 256x256 上超过依赖 DINOv2 的对齐与条件化方案。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SPERA: Spherical Prior EEG Foundation Model with Geometry- and Frequency-Aware Latent Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive measure of ongoing neural activity, but building general-purpose EEG models remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of subjects, devices, and electrode montages. Existing EEG foundation models predominantly rely on reconstruction-based objectives defined on the observed signal, which contains both neural and non-neural components. We introduce SPERA (Spherical Prior EEG Representation Architecture), an EEG foundation model that adopts the joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to predict in latent space. SPERA introduces a Legendre-polynomial spatial prior, incorporated into attention to encode varying scalp electrode geometries. Two further components adapt the model to EEG: factorized temporal and spatial attention interleaved with periodic full-attention blocks, and a relational spectral regularizer aligning latent similarity structure with spectral views. Pretrained on approximately 80,000 hours of EEG from 29,048 subjects across 106 datasets, SPERA achieves the highest average balanced accuracy across nine downstream tasks spanning clinical, cognitive, and BCI applications. SPERA further exhibits strong parameter efficiency under linear probing and robustness across varying recording conditions, suggesting its potential as a general-purpose backbone for diverse EEG analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPERA 用 JEPA 在潜空间做预测而非重建原始 EEG，并把 Legendre 多项式空间先验嵌入 attention 以适配不同电极排布。在约 80,000 小时、29,048 名被试、106 个数据集上预训练后，它在九项下游任务上取得最高平均 balanced accuracy，且线性探测下参数效率强。
Motivation: EEG 基础模型受被试、设备与电极 montage 异质性制约，且现有模型多用基于观测信号的重建目标，而信号中混有非神经成分。
Method: 采用 joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) 在潜空间预测；attention 中加入 Legendre 多项式空间先验编码头皮电极几何；分解式时间与空间 attention 与周期性 full-attention 块交替；再用 relational spectral regularizer 对齐潜表示相似结构与频谱视图。
Result: 预训练数据约 80,000 小时 EEG、29,048 名被试、106 个数据集；在覆盖临床、认知与 BCI 的九项下游任务上取得最高平均 balanced accuracy，并在 linear probing 下展现强参数效率与跨录制条件的稳健性。
Conclusion: 在潜空间预测并显式建模电极几何与频谱关系，可让单一 EEG backbone 跨异质数据集与多类下游任务通用。

papers.title: Does Dynamic-Point Filtering Help When Texture Is Scarce? A Controlled Study of ORB-SLAM2 Front-Ends in Synthetic Indoor Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic-point filters are routinely added to feature-based visual SLAM, and several recent systems argue that removing dynamic features can leave too few static features in low-texture regions. So far, these systems have been evaluated only on texture-rich benchmark sequences. We present a controlled study that isolates this interaction. We render synthetic indoor sequences in which surface texture (four levels, quantified by FAST-corner density and image-gradient entropy) and scene dynamics (three levels) are varied factorially along identical camera trajectories, with stereo, RGB-D, ground-truth poses and dynamic masks. On this grid we compare ORB-SLAM2 without filtering, with an optical-flow and epipolar-residual filter (FLOW), and with a multi-view depth-consistency filter (GEOM), and report trajectory error, tracking completeness and surviving static features over five runs. Because the masks give per-keypoint ground truth, we also measure each filter's dynamic-point precision and recall and its static-feature false-removal rate, so that mechanistic explanations can be tested directly. We do not propose a new filter. On 720 runs over 24 sequences, filtering helped mainly in the most dynamic cells; the benefit did not decline monotonically with texture, but at the lowest level filtering reduced tracking completeness, and ORB-SLAM2 never initialised in static L3 scenes. Contrary to our hypothesis, GEOM discarded more static keypoints than FLOW (median FRR 6.8% vs. 1.5% for RGB-D, 19.6% vs. 1.5% for stereo); its RGB-D advantage tracked dynamic-point recall and vanished in stereo mode. Data and code are available at https://github.com/felixxxue/texture-dynamics-slam.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, submitted to IROS 2026. Open-source code and dataset available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一项受控消融研究而非新方法：在合成室内场景中按纹理（4 级，用 FAST 角点密度与图像梯度熵量化）与场景动态（3 级）做因子化网格，比较 ORB-SLAM2 不加过滤、光流+对极残差过滤 (FLOW) 与多视角深度一致性过滤 (GEOM)。720 次运行显示过滤只在高动态格点明显有益，且最低纹理级反而降低跟踪完整度；GEOM 误删的静态点比 FLOW 更多（RGB-D 中位 FRR 6.8% vs 1.5%，stereo 19.6% vs 1.5%），其 RGB-D 优势随动态点召回变化、在 stereo 模式下消失。
Motivation: 动态点过滤被广泛加到特征点 SLAM 前端，但近期系统主张低纹理区删掉动态特征后静态点会过少，而这些系统只在纹理丰富的基准序列上评测过，纹理与动态的交互作用从未被隔离检验。
Method: 渲染合成室内序列，沿相同相机轨迹因子化改变 4 级纹理与 3 级动态，提供 stereo、RGB-D、真值位姿与动态掩码；在该网格上对比 ORB-SLAM2 无过滤、FLOW（光流+对极残差）与 GEOM（多视角深度一致性），报告轨迹误差、跟踪完整度与存活静态特征，每格 5 次运行；利用掩码给出的逐关键点真值测量各过滤器的动态点精确率/召回率与静态特征误删率 (FRR)。
Result: 720 次运行覆盖 24 条序列：过滤的收益主要出现在最高动态格点，且不随纹理单调下降；最低纹理级下过滤降低跟踪完整度，静态 L3 场景中 ORB-SLAM2 从未成功初始化。与假设相反，GEOM 丢弃的静态关键点多于 FLOW（RGB-D 中位 FRR 6.8% vs 1.5%，stereo 19.6% vs 1.5%）；GEOM 在 RGB-D 上的优势与动态点召回一致，但在 stereo 模式下消失。
Conclusion: 动态点过滤的收益由场景动态主导而非纹理稀缺本身，深度一致性过滤并不比光流过滤更保守地保留静态点；作者不提出新过滤器，而是提供可直接检验机理解释的受控数据集与代码。

papers.title: SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpectralCache 是面向扩散世界模型的免训练谱特征缓存：发现去噪相邻步的世界模型特征奇异子空间高度稳定、奇异值演化可预测，于是复用稳定奇异子空间、只用线性外推估计低维奇异值，并借奇异值缩放跳过部分骨干 Transformer 评测。在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上静态场景 WorldScore 保持 65.90 的同时取得 5.22 倍加速，推理效率显著超过现有免训练缓存方法。
Motivation: 扩散世界模型在去噪过程中反复调用 Transformer，推理开销巨大；现有缓存方法只利用特征或 token 级的时间冗余，未利用扩散特征本身的谱结构。
Method: 免训练的谱缓存框架 SpectralCache：复用相邻去噪步间稳定的奇异子空间，仅对低维奇异值做线性外推；再利用相邻全计算特征间的谱一致性，通过奇异值缩放 (singular value scaling) 跳过部分昂贵的骨干网络评测。
Result: 在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上，静态场景 WorldScore 保持 65.90 的同时实现 5.22 倍加速，推理效率大幅超过现有免训练缓存方法；在多个代表性世界模型上均在保持生成质量的同时提升推理效率。
Conclusion: 扩散世界模型的去噪特征具有可复用的稳定奇异子空间，利用这一谱结构可以在不训练、不损失生成质量的前提下大幅压缩推理成本。

papers.title: SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration. SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLVR 把多模态推理拆成 planning、grounding、evidence selection、integration 四个带类型的 latent stage，分别用计划、框、视觉证据和最终 rationale 监督，同时先用遮蔽泄题文本加视觉合理干扰项对比来逼模型看图。基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，MMVP 绝对提升 +9.4、BLINK Relation +14.2，V*、MathVista、ChartQA 同步改善，推理时不生成文本链。
Motivation: MLLM 常靠语言先验而非图像证据作答；显式 CoT 能缓解但自回归生成中间步骤推高推理成本，而现有 latent reasoning 对中间状态缺乏结构化控制，难以对 planning、grounding、evidence selection 分别施加监督。
Method: SLVR 训练框架分两步：先遮蔽答案泄露文本并用正确答案对比视觉上合理的干扰项，迫使模型依赖图像；再把推理组织为 planning、grounding、evidence selection、integration 四个 latent stage，分别以 plans、boxes、视觉证据、最终 rationale 作为各阶段监督信号，推理阶段不生成文本 CoT。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，MMVP 绝对增益 +9.4，BLINK Relation +14.2，V*、MathVista、ChartQA 也有提升。
Conclusion: 结构化的 latent 监督能在不付出文本 CoT 解码开销的前提下提升细粒度视觉推理，说明给 latent 中间态赋予明确功能结构是可行的。

papers.title: Strategic Governance of AI Models in Earth Science
papers.abstract_en: AI foundation models pretrained on weather and climate data are increasingly fine-tuned to Earth science tasks well beyond weather forecasting. Their development and adoption are outpacing the scientific community's ability to evaluate them. These models are judged almost entirely by benchmark skill metrics, which measure how closely a forecast reproduces a reference product but not whether a model represents the physical processes governing the system it predicts. Forecast skill and physical reliability are therefore distinct properties. The distinction is most consequential under the nonstationary conditions of a changing climate for which these models were never trained. We identify five priorities for the physical evaluation of AI models in Earth science from task-specific emulators to foundation models, spanning training data, fine-tuning, behavioral testing, mechanistic interpretability, and output validation. We recommend three activities for the coming decade: 1) open AI-ready evaluation datasets, 2) a shared reporting standard for physics-based evaluation, and 3) a dedicated research program on the safety of these models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张天气气候基础模型的 benchmark 技能分与物理可靠性是两个独立属性，只看技能分会高估模型在气候变化非平稳条件下的可信度，因为这些模型从未在这种分布上训练。作者提出五项物理评估优先事项（训练数据、微调、行为测试、机制可解释性、输出验证），并建议未来十年做三件事：开放 AI-ready 评估数据集、建立基于物理评估的共享报告标准、设立专门的模型安全研究项目。
Motivation: AI 基础模型被微调到远超天气预报的地球科学任务，开发速度超过社区评估能力；现有评估几乎只用 benchmark 技能分，衡量与参考产品的吻合度而非物理过程是否被正确表示，在气候变化的非平稳条件下这一缺口最危险。
Method: 从任务专用模拟器到基础模型，围绕训练数据、微调、行为测试 (behavioral testing)、机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 与输出验证五个环节给出物理评估优先事项；再提出三项十年期活动：开放 AI-ready 评估数据集、共享的物理评估报告标准、模型安全专门研究计划。
Result: 给出五项物理评估优先事项与三项十年期建议；核心论断为 forecast skill 与 physical reliability 是不同属性，纯技能指标无法反映模型是否表示了支配所预测系统的物理过程。
Conclusion: 地球科学 AI 模型的评估必须把物理可靠性与预报技能分开报告，尤其针对模型未训练过的气候变化非平稳条件。

summary_sections.method: 从任务专用模拟器到基础模型，围绕训练数据、微调、行为测试 (behavioral testing)、机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 与输出验证五个环节给出物理评估优先事项；再提出三项十年期活动：开放 AI-ready 评估数据集、共享的物理评估报告标准、模型安全专门研究计划。
summary_sections.result: 给出五项物理评估优先事项与三项十年期建议；核心论断为 forecast skill 与 physical reliability 是不同属性，纯技能指标无法反映模型是否表示了支配所预测系统的物理过程。
summary_sections.conclusion: 地球科学 AI 模型的评估必须把物理可靠性与预报技能分开报告，尤其针对模型未训练过的气候变化非平稳条件。

papers.title: VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can now build applications from design mockups, but a screen that looks right is not an application that works. Existing benchmarks either score visual reconstruction without a backend or test full-stack functionality from textual requirements, and few tie scores to the individual components a design requires. We introduce VISTA (VIsual Spec-To-App), an end-to-end benchmark in which coding agents turn multi-page design handoffs (Figma renders, structure, and textual requirements) into runnable full-stack Web and Mobile (Android) applications. VISTA provides 8,487 human-annotated interactive components across 18 applications (126 Web pages and 576 Android screens) and an executable evaluator that locates annotated components in the running application and probes their interactions, yielding localization, behavior, and joint scores traceable to individual design requirements. Across 14 deployed coding-agent systems, the best joint score is 0.553 on Web and 0.378 on Mobile, and 13 of 14 systems score lower on behavior than on localization on Web. Component probes detect unresponsive controls in 90.1% of audited Web deliveries. Development traces show where the process departs from the task: 44.5% of trajectories never open the design screenshots, 73.0% omit the prescribed self-audit, and 8.3% report success after a failed check. VISTA makes the gap between rendering a design and delivering a working application measurable at the level of individual components. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/kaboider/VISTA_Bench}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VISTA 把设计稿到可运行全栈 Web/Android 应用的编码任务做成组件级可执行评测：8,487 个人工标注交互组件、18 个应用（126 Web 页、576 Android 屏），由评测器在运行中的应用里定位组件并探测交互。14 个已部署编码智能体中最佳 joint score 仅 Web 0.553、Mobile 0.378，且 13/14 系统在 Web 上行为分低于定位分，组件探测在 90.1% 的受审 Web 交付中发现无响应控件。
Motivation: 现有基准要么只评视觉还原不看后端，要么只从文本需求测全栈功能，且很少把分数拆到设计稿要求的单个组件上，导致“看起来对”与“真的能用”之间的差距无法度量。
Method: VISTA（VIsual Spec-To-App）要求智能体把多页设计交付物（Figma 渲染、结构与文本需求）转成可运行的全栈 Web 与 Android 应用；配套可执行评测器在运行应用中定位标注组件并探测其交互，输出可追溯到单条设计需求的 localization、behavior 与 joint 三类分数，并记录开发轨迹（是否打开设计截图、是否做规定的自审计）。
Result: 在 14 个已部署编码智能体系统上，最佳 joint score 为 Web 0.553、Mobile 0.378；Web 上 14 个系统中 13 个的 behavior 分低于 localization 分；组件探测在受审 Web 交付的 90.1% 中检出无响应控件。轨迹分析显示 44.5% 的轨迹从未打开设计截图，73.0% 省略规定的自审计，8.3% 在检查失败后仍报告成功。
Conclusion: 渲染设计与交付可用应用之间的差距可以在单个组件层面被量化，且当前编码智能体的主要短板在行为正确性而非界面定位，过程轨迹偏离任务（不看截图、跳过自审计）是可测量的失败来源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do Sheaf Neural Networks Use Holonomy? A Measure--Intervene--Control Study
papers.abstract_en: Geometric architectures are often motivated by internal mechanisms, but accuracy alone does not show whether predictions use them. In Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs), edge transports form a connection whose cycle products define holonomy. We ask whether training changes triangle holonomy, whether predictions rely on the learned connection, and whether holonomy drives triangle counting. We use basis-independent loop readouts with identity interventions and shortcut controls. On high-homophily GraphUniverse graphs, triangle counting increases the mean SO(2) triangle rotation in Neural Sheaf Propagation (NSP) from 0.010 to 0.388 radians, while community detection ends at 0.029 radians. With more data, learned SO(2)--NSP outperforms Identity NSP, and replacing its transports after training increases error further. However, ridge regression is more accurate, diagonal maps improve without continuous rotation, and fixed-degree models develop rotation without improved counting. Thus, NSP can learn and rely on a nontrivial connection, but our experiments do not show that triangle holonomy drives its predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用 Measure–Intervene–Control 流程检验 Sheaf Neural Networks (SNN) 是否真的用上 holonomy：在高同配 GraphUniverse 图上，三角形计数任务把 Neural Sheaf Propagation (NSP) 的 SO(2) 平均三角旋转从 0.010 抬到 0.388 弧度，而社区发现只到 0.029 弧度；训练后替换 transport 会进一步增大误差，说明模型确实学到并依赖非平凡 connection。但 ridge regression 更准、对角映射在无连续旋转时也改善、固定阶模型在计数未改善时也出现旋转，因此实验不支持 holonomy 驱动预测这一因果主张。
Motivation: 几何架构常以内部机制（如 SNN 中由边 transport 构成的 connection 及其环路积 holonomy）为动机，但准确率本身无法证明预测真的用到了这些机制。
Method: Measure–Intervene–Control：用与基无关的环路读数 (basis-independent loop readouts) 测量三角形 holonomy，配合 identity 干预与 shortcut 对照，检验训练是否改变三角 holonomy、预测是否依赖学到的 connection、以及 holonomy 是否驱动三角形计数。
Result: 在高同配 GraphUniverse 图上，三角形计数使 NSP 的 SO(2) 平均三角旋转从 0.010 增至 0.388 弧度，社区发现任务仅达 0.029 弧度；数据更多时 SO(2)-NSP 优于 Identity NSP，训练后替换其 transport 会进一步增大误差。但 ridge regression 精度更高，对角映射在无连续旋转时也改善，固定阶模型在计数未改善时也发展出旋转。
Conclusion: NSP 能学到并依赖非平凡 connection，但这些实验不表明三角 holonomy 驱动其预测；准确率与机制使用需用干预式对照而非仅靠性能来判定。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: GaussianBench: Physics-Fidelity Evaluation for Gaussian Scene Representations
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting has evolved from static reconstruction toward physics-integrated representations meant to predict how scenes change under interaction. This creates an evaluation problem: a rollout can look plausible while relying on incorrect internal mechanics, and visual agreement with observed motion does not establish a correct response to a new force, material edit, contact, or thermal intervention. We introduce GaussianBench, a physics-fidelity evaluation suite for physics-integrated Gaussian scene representations. It uses frozen file-based scenes, simulator-independent scorers, and analytical or measured references. The benchmark tests conservation, continuum response, heterogeneous-material coupling, Gaussian covariance transport and rendering, thermal phase change, and counterfactual response. Each reference declares its regime of validity, and outcomes distinguish PASS, FAIL, NA, and INVALID, separating physical failures from unsupported capabilities and invalid comparisons. We also provide GaussianFlesh, a thermomechanical reference entrant in which persistent 3D Gaussians act as both rendering primitives and continuum material points, advanced by a shared-grid MPM solver with per-particle constitutive dispatch and persistent thermal and phase state. We evaluate six released external systems: PhysGaussian, GaussianFluent, OmniPhysGS, PhysDreamer, Physics3D, and GASP. Testing every system the same way reveals failures that their original evaluations missed: a system can simulate a single material correctly but fail where two materials meet, or update its Gaussians correctly for a deformation it never produced. Matched faults and tolerance audits confirm these distinctions arise from the intended tests. Physics-integrated Gaussian systems must therefore be tested on their internal physical state, not just on whether their rollouts look plausible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GaussianBench 是面向物理耦合 3D Gaussian 场景表示的物理保真度评测套件：用冻结的文件场景、模拟器无关的评分器与解析/实测参考，检验守恒、连续体响应、异质材料耦合、Gaussian 协方差输运与渲染、热相变和反事实响应，并以 PASS/FAIL/NA/INVALID 区分物理失败与不支持的能力。统一测试六个已发布系统（PhysGaussian、GaussianFluent、OmniPhysGS、PhysDreamer、Physics3D、GASP）暴露出原论文评测漏掉的故障，如单材料正确但两材料交界处失败。
Motivation: 物理耦合 Gaussian 表示的 rollout 可以看起来合理却依赖错误的内部机制，视觉一致无法证明对新外力、材料编辑、接触或热干预的响应正确，缺少统一的物理保真度评测。
Method: GaussianBench 用冻结的文件场景、模拟器无关评分器与解析或实测参考，每条参考声明其有效域，结果分为 PASS、FAIL、NA、INVALID；配套提供 GaussianFlesh 参赛件，持久 3D Gaussians 同时作渲染基元与连续体材料点，由共享网格 MPM 求解器推进，带逐粒子本构分派与持久热/相态。
Result: 统一测试六个已发布外部系统（PhysGaussian、GaussianFluent、OmniPhysGS、PhysDreamer、Physics3D、GASP）暴露出其原评测遗漏的故障：系统可能单材料模拟正确却在两材料交界处失败，或对一个它从未产生的变形正确更新 Gaussian；matched faults 与容差审计确认这些区分来自预期测试本身。
Conclusion: 物理耦合 Gaussian 系统必须按其内部物理状态来测试，而不能只看 rollout 是否看起来合理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Freeze the Decoder, Heal the Encoder: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for SVD-Based KV-Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Comparing parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes under a single, shared learning rate is a common but flawed practice: when the arms being compared have very different trainable-parameter counts, a shared rate can simultaneously depress the larger arms' means and inflate their variance, manufacturing a large, seemingly multi-seed-significant advantage for the smallest arm that is not a real effect. We document this confound in a concrete setting: post-hoc SVD-based KV-cache compression, where an already-pretrained model is converted to a low-rank (multi-head-latent-attention-style) cache by factorizing its key/value weights into a down-projection ("encoder") and an up-projection ("decoder"), after which a short fine-tune ("healing") recovers the accuracy lost to truncation. Under a shared learning rate, freezing the decoder and healing only the encoder looks like a clear win over healing the decoder or both factors; once every arm is given its own tuned learning rate, that apparent advantage disappears, and encoder-only healing instead reaches parity with the alternatives, at a real, measured saving of 3x fewer trainable parameters and 3x less optimizer-state memory. We verify this parity with per-arm learning-rate tuning and three seeds per configuration on a vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct), at the one compression ratio this protocol covers, and replicate it on a text-only testbed across two backbones. Encoder-only healing is therefore a lower-memory drop-in recipe for retrofitting low-rank KV-cache compression at training time, and the shared-learning-rate pitfall we document and correct is a cautionary result for comparing any fine-tuning recipes whose arms differ in trainable-parameter count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在后训练 SVD KV-cache 压缩的 healing 微调中，共享学习率会人为放大“只微调 encoder”这一臂的优势：一旦每臂各自调学习率，该优势消失，encoder-only 与 healing decoder 或两者持平，同时可训练参数与优化器状态内存各少 3 倍。作者据此把 encoder-only 定位为低内存的即插即用配方，并提醒任何可训练参数量不同的微调配方比较都应逐臂调学习率。
Motivation: 比较可训练参数量差异很大的 PEFT 配方时共用一个学习率是常见做法，但这会压低大参数臂的均值并抬高其方差，制造出看似多种子显著、实为假的最小参数臂优势。
Method: 在 post-hoc SVD KV-cache 压缩场景中，把预训练模型的 key/value 权重分解为 down-projection（encoder）与 up-projection（decoder），截断后做短微调 healing；比较共享学习率与逐臂调学习率两种协议，每配置跑三个种子。
Result: 共享学习率下 encoder-only 看似明显胜出；逐臂调学习率后该优势消失，encoder-only 达到持平（parity），并实测节省 3 倍可训练参数与 3 倍优化器状态内存。验证在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 视觉语言模型、该协议覆盖的单一压缩比上进行，并在两个 backbone 的纯文本测试床上复现。
Conclusion: encoder-only healing 是训练时改造低秩 KV-cache 压缩的低内存即插即用配方；共享学习率是任何可训练参数量不同的微调配方比较中的系统性陷阱，必须逐臂调学习率才能得到真实结论。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: encoder-only healing 是训练时改造低秩 KV-cache 压缩的低内存即插即用配方；共享学习率是任何可训练参数量不同的微调配方比较中的系统性陷阱，必须逐臂调学习率才能得到真实结论。

papers.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. Because data is generated through the same environment that defines what is valid, STS guarantees structural validity by construction while decoupling validity enforcement from distribution modeling, allowing each to be addressed independently. The **Generalist Populator** (GP), STS's domain-agnostic agent, addresses the remaining challenges of distributional fidelity and synthesis scalability: GP achieves **0.88** average marginal fidelity and **100\% constraint satisfaction** across all ten environments *without access to DB schemas*, while statistical synthesizers are inapplicable to seven due to necessary seed data requirements, and schema-privileged agents fail 82\% of trajectories on airline environment's tightly coupled workflows due to brittle task composition. We open-source the full framework, all ten environments, and generated datasets at https://github.com/SAP/synthesis-through-simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 schema-free 的企业数据合成范式 Synthesis Through Simulation (STS)：让 LLM agent 在带策略约束的模拟企业 API 上执行操作来生成数据，有效性由环境本身保证。其通用 agent Generalist Populator 在十个环境中平均边际保真度 0.88、约束满足率 100%，且不访问数据库 schema。
Motivation: 企业系统、数据与 schema 受商业和法律限制，工具调用 agent 的大规模训练与评测受限；表格合成受结构有效性和 schema 可得性制约，流程式方法则缺乏分布保真度。
Method: STS 让 LLM agent 通过在模拟企业环境中执行策略强制 API 操作生成数据，把结构有效性与分布建模解耦；核心为领域无关的 Generalist Populator (GP)，在无 DB schema 条件下完成分布保真与规模化合成。
Result: GP 在全部十个环境上平均边际保真度 0.88、约束满足率 100%，且不访问 DB schema；统计合成器因需要种子数据在其中七个环境不可用；有 schema 权限的 agent 在航空环境因任务组合脆弱而 82% 轨迹失败。
Conclusion: 让数据由定义有效性的同一环境生成，可在不给 schema 的前提下同时保证结构有效与分布保真；框架、十个环境与生成数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Memory Models for Spaced Repetition
papers.abstract_en: Spaced repetition software schedules reviews with a memory model fit to review logs. Accuracy on a test set is not sufficient evidence of quality since available data are produced by existing schedulers, and new solutions must extrapolate beyond them. A model also needs a simple mechanistic interpretation. We present SBD, a model that is more interpretable and 80% smaller than the current state of the art at nearly the same accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SBD 是一个用于间隔重复 (spaced repetition) 调度的记忆模型，比当前 SOTA 小 80% 而精度几乎持平，并保留简单的机制性解释。论文主张测试集精度不足以证明质量，因为现有数据由既有调度器产生，新方案必须外推到其分布之外。
Motivation: 间隔重复软件靠记忆模型拟合复习日志来排程，但可用数据都由现有调度器产生，只看测试集精度无法证明模型质量，新方案必须外推超越这些调度器，同时模型还需具备简单的机制性解释。
Method: 提出记忆模型 SBD，设计目标是在保持接近当前 SOTA 精度的同时大幅压缩参数量，并提供可解释的机制性表述，用于从复习日志拟合记忆状态并生成复习排程。
Result: SBD 比当前 state of the art 小 80%，精度接近（nearly the same accuracy），且具有更简单的机制性解释。
Conclusion: 记忆模型可以在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅缩小规模并保持机制可解释性；评估间隔重复模型时，测试集精度不足以作为质量证据，模型必须能外推到产生数据的调度器之外。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Large-Scale Semantic Table Interpretation and Data Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Graph (KG) quality depends not only on downstream graph validation, but also on the quality of tabular metadata used before integration. In metadata-only Semantic Table Interpretation (STI), where cell values are unavailable, noisy, or unsuitable, column headers become a critical source of semantic evidence for traceable KG preparation. We present an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only Column Type Annotation (CTA) and Data Quality Assessment (DQA). The framework maps headers to 39 interpretable FinalFormat types using curated lexical resources and preserves token-level traceability through SourceKeywords. Each assigned type activates validation rules based on a taxonomy of Data Quality Issues (DQIs), producing detections such as missing data, duplicates, domain violations, wrong data type, and temporal mismatch. These detections are aggregated into HeadersIQ, a lightweight, unweighted data source-level quality metric. The framework was evaluated across heterogeneous benchmarks, including UCI, Prague, Kaggle, VizNet/Sato, SOTAB, T2Dv2, and the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, comprising around 120,000 header columns. The results show broad practical coverage across noisy real-world metadata, while a parallel KG-mapping pathway supports alignment to DBpedia and Schema.org. On the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, the official GT-strict evaluation was modest. However, a blinded diagnostic audit indicates that many mismatches reflect benchmark granularity, aliasing, and ontology-selection effects rather than wholly implausible header-centric predictions. We report this audit as diagnostic evidence on disagreement patterns, not as revised benchmark performance. Overall, the paper presents a reusable workflow for metadata-driven semantic annotation, data source-level quality monitoring, and KG-oriented benchmark diagnosis.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, Workshop on Quality of Knowledge Graphs at ESWC 2026, May 11, 2026, Dubrovnik, Croatia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以列头为中心、仅用元数据的可解释框架，把表头映射到 39 种 FinalFormat 类型并保留 token 级 SourceKeywords 溯源，再按 Data Quality Issues 分类激活校验规则，聚合为 HeadersIQ 数据源级质量指标。在约 12 万个表头列的多基准评测中覆盖真实噪声元数据，SemTab 2024 官方 GT-strict 成绩一般，盲法诊断审计显示多数不匹配源于基准粒度、别名与本体选择。
Motivation: 语义表解释 (STI) 中单元格值常不可用或不可信，仅靠下游图校验无法保证 KG 质量，需要在集成前对表头元数据本身做可追溯的类型标注与质量评估。
Method: 用整理的词汇资源把表头映射到 39 种可解释 FinalFormat 类型，token 级 SourceKeywords 保留溯源；每种类型按 Data Quality Issues (DQI) 分类激活校验规则，检出缺失、重复、域违规、类型错误、时间不匹配等，聚合成无权重的 HeadersIQ 指标，并有并行 KG 映射通路对齐 DBpedia 与 Schema.org。
Result: 在 UCI、Prague、Kaggle、VizNet/Sato、SOTAB、T2Dv2 与 SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track 上评测，覆盖约 120,000 个表头列；SemTab 2024 官方 GT-strict 评价结果一般，盲法诊断审计指出多数不匹配来自基准粒度、别名与本体选择效应。
Conclusion: 表头中心的元数据驱动标注与数据源级质量监控可作为可复用工作流，同时可作为 KG 基准不一致的诊断工具；作者明确将审计作为分歧模式的诊断证据，而非修订后的基准性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering Global False Negatives On the Fly for Self-supervised Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: In self-supervised contrastive learning, negative pairs are typically constructed using an anchor image and a sample drawn from the entire dataset, excluding the anchor. However, this approach can result in the creation of negative pairs with similar semantics, referred to as "false negatives", leading to their embeddings being falsely pushed apart. To address this issue, we introduce GloFND, an optimization-based approach that automatically learns on the fly the threshold for each anchor data to identify its false negatives during training. In contrast to previous methods for false negative discovery, our approach globally detects false negatives across the entire dataset rather than locally within the mini-batch. Moreover, its per-iteration computation cost remains independent of the dataset size. Experimental results on image and image-text data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/vibalcam/GloFND.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GloFND：在自监督对比学习训练中，用优化方法为每个 anchor 在线学习阈值，从整个数据集（而非 mini-batch 内）识别 false negatives，避免语义相似的负对被错误推开，且每次迭代计算开销与数据集大小无关。
Motivation: 对比学习中负对从全数据集随机抽取，会把语义相似的样本当作负对，导致其 embedding 被错误推远；已有 false negative 发现方法通常只在 mini-batch 内局部检测，覆盖不全。
Method: GloFND 是基于优化的方法，在训练过程中为每个 anchor 在线学习阈值以判定 false negatives，检测范围覆盖整个数据集而非单个 mini-batch，且每步计算开销与数据集规模无关。
Result: 在图像与图像-文本数据上的实验验证了该方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 全局、按 anchor 自适应的 false negative 检测可在不增加数据集规模相关开销的前提下改善对比学习，实现代码已开源。
Relevance: 2
